```bash
opa test policy/ -v                  # policy unit testlari
```
Chiqish:
```
FAIL - deploy.yaml - main - container api: ruxsatsiz registry docker.io/nginx
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Darhol `enforce` rejimi — ko'p jamoa bloklanadi. Avval `audit/warn`, keyin enforce.
- Policy'lar test qilinmaydi — xato qoida prod deploy'ni to'xtatadi.
- Istisno mexanizmi yo'q yoki aksincha juda oson — har ikkalasi xavfli.

**Senior nuqta:** Bir qoida ikki joyda: CI'da (tez feedback) va admission'da (yagona haqiqiy kafolat — kimdir CI'ni aylanib o'tishi mumkin). Policy natijalarini metrika sifatida yig' — compliance holati audit uchun avtomatik dalil bo'ladi.

40327.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Open Policy Agent (OPA) — CNCF (Graduated) umumiy maqsadli policy engine: JSON input'ni **Rego** tilidagi deklarativ qoidalarga nisbatan baholab qaror (allow/deny yoki istalgan JSON) qaytaradi. Policy qarorini ilova kodidan ajratadi.

**Muammo:** Avtorizatsiya mantiqi har servisda `if user.role == ...` sifatida sochilgan, turli tillarda; o'zgartirish = har servisni qayta deploy; audit qilib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Servis / K8s / Envoy / Terraform
     | query: input JSON {user, action, resource}
     v
   OPA (policy + data, xotirada)
     | decision: {"allow": true}
     v
 Servis qarorni bajaradi
Policy bundle'lar -> HTTP server'dan pull (versiyalangan)
```
Ishlatilish: K8s admission (Gatekeeper), Envoy ext_authz, Terraform plan (Conftest), API authz, Kafka ACL.

**Amalda:**
```rego
package httpapi.authz
import rego.v1

default allow := false

allow if {
  input.method == "GET"
  input.path == ["orders", input.user.id]
}
allow if "admin" in input.user.roles
```
```bash
opa eval -d authz.rego -i input.json "data.httpapi.authz.allow"
opa run --server authz.rego &
curl -s localhost:8181/v1/data/httpapi/authz/allow \
  -d '{"input":{"method":"GET","path":["orders","u1"],"user":{"id":"u1","roles":[]}}}'
# {"result":true}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Rego o'rganish egri chizig'i tik — jamoa uchun test va namuna kutubxona kerak.
- `default allow := false` unutilsa — undefined natija noto'g'ri talqin qilinishi mumkin.
- Katta `data` (minglab user) OPA xotirasini to'ldiradi — kerakli ma'lumotni input'da yubor.

**Senior nuqta:** OPA'ni sidecar yoki lokal library sifatida ishlat — har qarorda tarmoq hop'i latency qo'shadi. Decision log'larini yoqib qo'y: "nega rad etildi" savoliga javob va audit izi. K8s-only bo'lsa Kyverno soddaroq alternativa.

40328.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kyverno — CNCF (Graduated) Kubernetes-native policy engine: policy'lar oddiy YAML (CRD) da yoziladi, yangi til shart emas. To'rt imkoniyat: **validate** (rad etish), **mutate** (avtomatik o'zgartirish), **generate** (yangi resurs yaratish) va **verifyImages** (cosign imzosini tekshirish).

**Muammo:** OPA Gatekeeper kuchli, lekin Rego o'rganish kerak. K8s jamoasi "har namespace'da default NetworkPolicy bo'lsin" yoki "`latest` tag taqiqlansin" kabi qoidalarni tez yozishni xohlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl apply --> API server --> admission webhook --> Kyverno
                                        |   mutate -> validate
                                        v
                                allow / deny (xabar bilan)
 Background controller: mavjud resurslarni skanerlaydi -> PolicyReport
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata: { name: disallow-latest-tag }
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce     # avval Audit
  rules:
    - name: require-tag
      match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Pod] } }] }
      validate:
        message: "Image tag 'latest' yoki tag'siz bo'lishi mumkin emas"
        pattern:
          spec:
            containers:
              - image: "!*:latest & *:*"
```
```bash
kubectl get policyreport -A
kyverno test ./policies          # CLI bilan offline test
kyverno apply policy.yaml --resource deploy.yaml
```
Yangi versiyalarda CEL asosidagi `ValidatingPolicy` turlari ham bor (K8s ValidatingAdmissionPolicy bilan yaqinlashish).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Webhook `failurePolicy: Fail` va Kyverno pod'lari tushsa — butun klasterda deploy to'xtaydi. HA (3 replika) va kube-system istisno.
- Mutate policy'lar GitOps bilan drift yaratadi (Argo diff ko'rsatadi) — ignoreDifferences sozla.
- Juda ko'p policy — admission latency oshadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Kyverno vs Gatekeeper: faqat K8s va YAML'ga o'rgangan jamoa — Kyverno; K8s'dan tashqarida ham (API, Terraform) bitta policy tili kerak — OPA. Oddiy validatsiyalar uchun K8s'ning o'zidagi ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL, webhook'siz) ham ko'rib chiq.

40329.a:
**Qisqa javob:** HashiCorp Vault — markaziy secret boshqaruv tizimi: statik secret'larni (KV) shifrlab saqlaydi, **dynamic secret** (so'rov bo'yicha vaqtinchalik DB login), PKI (sertifikat chiqarish), **Transit** (encryption as a service) beradi; hammasi identity asosidagi auth va to'liq audit log bilan. 2023-dan BSL litsenziyada; ochiq fork — OpenBao.

**Muammo:** DB parollari `.env`, CI variable va Slack'da; hech kim rotatsiya qilmaydi; xodim ketsa ham parol ishlaydi; kim qachon o'qiganini bilmaymiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
App (K8s SA token) --> Vault auth/kubernetes --> Vault token (TTL)
       |                                            |
       v                                            v
 database/creds/orders-ro  --> Vault DB'da user yaratadi (TTL 1h)
       |                        lease tugasa -> user o'chiriladi
 transit/encrypt/pii      --> kalit Vault'dan chiqmaydi
 audit device: har so'rov log'ga
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
vault secrets enable database
vault write database/config/orders plugin_name=postgresql-database-plugin \
  connection_url="postgresql://{{username}}:{{password}}@db:5432/orders" \
  allowed_roles=orders-ro username=vault password=...
vault write database/roles/orders-ro db_name=orders default_ttl=1h max_ttl=24h \
  creation_statements="CREATE ROLE \"{{name}}\" LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}'; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO \"{{name}}\";"
vault read database/creds/orders-ro
# username v-k8s-orders-ro-x7a..  password ...  lease_duration 1h
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Unseal kalitlari va root token'ni noto'g'ri saqlash — auto-unseal (KMS) ishlat, root token'ni revoke qil.
- Vault tushsa ilovalar secret ololmaydi — HA (Raft), lease'larni oldindan yangilash, cache.
- Dynamic secret, lekin ilova ulanishni qayta yaratmaydi — eski credential tugaganda xato.

**Senior nuqta:** Vault'ning eng katta qiymati — dynamic secret va qisqa TTL: o'g'irlangan credential bir soatda yaroqsiz. Managed alternativa (AWS Secrets Manager + IAM) ko'p hollarda soddaroq; Vault multi-cloud, PKI va Transit kerak bo'lganda o'zini oqlaydi.

40330.a:
**Qisqa javob:** External Secrets Operator (ESO) — K8s operatori: tashqi secret store'lardan (AWS Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, Vault, GCP/Azure) qiymatlarni o'qib, ularni oddiy K8s `Secret` ga sinxronlaydi va vaqti-vaqti bilan yangilaydi. Git'da faqat "qaysi secret kerak" degan havola saqlanadi.

**Muammo:** GitOps'da hammasi Git'da, lekin secret'ni Git'ga qo'yib bo'lmaydi. Qo'lda `kubectl create secret` — reproducible emas, rotatsiya unutiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Git: ExternalSecret (key: prod/orders/db)
          |
      ESO controller (refreshInterval)
          |  SecretStore auth: IRSA / Pod Identity / Vault k8s auth
          v
   AWS Secrets Manager  --> qiymat
          |
          v
   K8s Secret orders-db  --> pod env / volume
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: SecretStore
metadata: { name: aws, namespace: orders }
spec:
  provider:
    aws:
      service: SecretsManager
      region: eu-central-1
      auth: { jwt: { serviceAccountRef: { name: eso-orders } } }
---
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata: { name: orders-db, namespace: orders }
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef: { name: aws, kind: SecretStore }
  target: { name: orders-db }
  data:
    - secretKey: password
      remoteRef: { key: prod/orders/db, property: password }
```
```bash
kubectl get externalsecret -n orders   # STATUS: SecretSynced
kubectl describe externalsecret orders-db -n orders
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret yangilandi, lekin pod env eski — env o'zgaruvchilari restart'siz yangilanmaydi (Reloader yoki volume mount ishlat).
- `ClusterSecretStore` keng huquqli — bir namespace boshqa jamoa secret'ini o'qishi mumkin.
- K8s Secret baribir etcd'da — etcd encryption at rest va RBAC shart.

**Senior nuqta:** ESO vs Secrets Store CSI Driver: ESO K8s Secret yaratadi (moslik yuqori), CSI faqat volume'ga mount qiladi (etcd'ga tushmaydi). Xavfsizlik talabiga qarab tanla; manba haqiqati doim tashqi store'da qolsin.

40331.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cosign keyless signing (Sigstore) — container image'ni uzoq muddatli private key'siz imzolash: CI'ning OIDC identity'si (masalan GitHub Actions workflow) bilan **Fulcio** CA'dan ~10 daqiqalik sertifikat olinadi, imzo **Rekor** transparency log'ga yoziladi. Tekshiruvchi "bu image `acme/app` repo'sining `main` workflow'idan imzolangan"ni isbotlaydi.

**Muammo:** An'anaviy imzo — private key saqlash, rotatsiya, sizib chiqishi. Key o'g'irlansa hujumchi istalgan image'ni imzolaydi va buni hech kim bilmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CI job --OIDC token--> Fulcio --> qisqa muddatli cert (identity ichida)
   | ephemeral key bilan image digest'ni imzola
   v
Rekor log (vaqt + imzo, append-only, ommaviy)
   |
Registry: imzo image yonida (.sig / OCI referrer)
Verify: cert identity + issuer + Rekor yozuvi tekshiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# GitHub Actions
permissions: { id-token: write, packages: write }
steps:
  - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3
  - run: cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/acme/api@${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
```
```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:ab12... \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/acme/api/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main$' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```
Klasterda majburlash: Kyverno `verifyImages` yoki Sigstore policy-controller.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tag'ni imzolash/deploy qilish — tag o'zgaruvchan; doim digest (`@sha256:`) bilan.
- Verify'da identity'ni tekshirmaslik — har qanday GitHub user'ning imzosi "valid" bo'ladi.
- Public Rekor'ga ichki repo nomlari tushadi — maxfiy bo'lsa private Sigstore instance.

**Senior nuqta:** Imzo faqat "kim build qildi"ni isbotlaydi, "xavfsiz"ligini emas. Uni SBOM va SLSA provenance attestation'lari bilan birga (`cosign attest`) ishlat va admission'da majburla — aks holda imzo qog'ozda qoladi.

40332.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) — dastur yoki container ichidagi barcha komponentlar (paketlar, kutubxonalar, tranzitiv dependency'lar, versiyalar, litsenziyalar) ning mashina o'qiy oladigan ro'yxati. Standart formatlar: **CycloneDX** va **SPDX**.

**Muammo:** Log4Shell (2021) chiqqanda kompaniyalar haftalab "qaysi servisimizda log4j bor?" deb qidirgan. SBOM bo'lsa bu bitta so'rov. AQSh EO 14028, EU Cyber Resilience Act SBOM talab qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
build --> image --> syft/trivy --> SBOM (CycloneDX JSON)
                                     |
                       +-------------+------------+
                       v                          v
              cosign attest (image'ga)   Dependency-Track / grype
                                         yangi CVE chiqsa -> alert
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
syft ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0 -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json
trivy image --format spdx-json -o sbom.spdx.json ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0
grype sbom:sbom.json --fail-on high          # SBOM'dan CVE skan
cosign attest --yes --type cyclonedx --predicate sbom.json ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:...
docker buildx build --sbom=true --provenance=true -t ... .   # BuildKit
```
```bash
jq '.components[] | select(.name=="log4j-core") | .version' sbom.json
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- SBOM yaratib arxivga tashlash — undan foydalanadigan jarayon (CVE monitoring) bo'lmasa qiymati yo'q.
- Statik bog'langan binary yoki vendored kod skanerlarga ko'rinmasligi mumkin.
- SBOM'dagi CVE'lar ko'p false positive beradi — VEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) bilan "not affected" belgilash.

**Senior nuqta:** SBOM'ni build vaqtida yarat (deploy vaqtida emas) va image'ga imzolangan attestation sifatida bog'la. Shunda prod'dagi har digest uchun "ichida nima bor" savoliga isbotlangan javob bor.

40333.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, "salsa") — OpenSSF framework'i: build jarayoni yaxlitligi uchun darajalar belgilaydi. v1.0 Build track: L1 — provenance mavjud; L2 — hosted build platformasi imzolagan provenance; L3 — build'lar izolyatsiyalangan, provenance'ni build kodi soxtalashtira olmaydi.

**Muammo:** SolarWinds (2020): hujumchi build serverga kirib, imzolangan rasmiy update ichiga backdoor qo'shgan. Kod review toza edi — buzilish build bosqichida.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
source (commit sha) --> build platform (isolated runner)
                              |
                       artifact + provenance:
                       {builder id, source repo+sha,
                        build config, input digest'lar}  -- imzolangan
                              |
consumer: slsa-verifier --> "shu artifact shu repo'ning
                             shu commit'idan, shu builder'da yasalgan"
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# GitHub Actions: SLSA L3 provenance generator
provenance:
  needs: [build]
  permissions: { actions: read, id-token: write, packages: write }
  uses: slsa-framework/slsa-github-generator/.github/workflows/generator_container_slsa3.yml@v2.1.0
  with:
    image: ghcr.io/acme/api
    digest: ${{ needs.build.outputs.digest }}
```
```bash
slsa-verifier verify-image ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:... \
  --source-uri github.com/acme/api --source-branch main
```
GitHub'ning `actions/attest-build-provenance` ham SLSA provenance beradi (`gh attestation verify`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Provenance yaratib, uni deploy'da tekshirmaslik — himoya nol.
- Self-hosted runner'lar build'lar orasida tozalanmasa L3 izolyatsiya buziladi.
- SLSA build'ni himoyalaydi, lekin zararli dependency (typosquatting) yoki source'dagi backdoor'ni emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Amaliy yo'l: L2 ni tez ol (hosted CI + attest), keyin admission policy bilan "faqat bizning builder'dan chiqqan image" qoidasini majburla. Source track (branch protection, 2-kishi review) bilan birga to'liq zanjir bo'ladi.

40334.a:
**Qisqa javob:** eBPF — Linux kernel ichida, kernel kodini o'zgartirmasdan va modul yuklamasdan, xavfsiz sandbox dasturlarni ishga tushirish texnologiyasi. Dastur verifier'dan o'tadi (cheksiz sikl yo'q, xotiraga xavfsiz kirish), JIT bilan native kodga aylanadi va hook'larga (syscall, tarmoq paketi, kprobe, tracepoint) ulanadi.

**Muammo:** Kernel darajasidagi observability yoki tez tarmoq uchun avval kernel modul yozish kerak edi — bitta bug butun serverni yiqitadi. iptables minglab qoidada sekinlashadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
user space: C/Rust/Go dastur -> bytecode -> bpf() syscall
                                    |
kernel:   verifier (xavfsizmi?) -> JIT -> hook'ga ulash
             |                         (XDP, tc, kprobe, LSM)
          eBPF maps  <------------->  user space (metrikalar, policy)
```
Ishlatilishi: Cilium (CNI, kube-proxy o'rniga), Hubble/Pixie (observability), Falco/Tetragon (runtime security), Parca (continuous profiling), XDP DDoS himoyasi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
# bpftrace: qaysi process qaysi faylni ochyapti
sudo bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_openat { printf("%s %s\n", comm, str(args->filename)); }'
# Yuklangan dasturlar
sudo bpftool prog list
sudo bpftool map list
# BCC tool'lari
sudo execsnoop-bpfcc       # yangi process'lar
sudo tcplife-bpfcc         # TCP ulanishlar davomiyligi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kernel versiyasiga bog'liq: eski kernel'larda (< 5.x) BTF/CO-RE yo'q, ba'zi imkoniyatlar ishlamaydi.
- eBPF yuklash `CAP_BPF`/`CAP_SYS_ADMIN` talab qiladi — bu kuchli huquq, container'ga berishdan ehtiyot bo'l.
- Overhead nol emas: har syscall'ga hook qo'yish yuklangan tizimda sezilarli.

**Senior nuqta:** eBPF ilovani o'zgartirmasdan (instrumentatsiyasiz) ko'rinish beradi — legacy tizimlarda bebaho. Lekin u L7 semantikasini (masalan, biznes kontekst) to'liq bermaydi; OTel bilan to'ldiruvchi, almashtiruvchi emas.

40335.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Falco — CNCF (Graduated) runtime security tool: kernel syscall'larini (eBPF driver orqali) kuzatib, qoidalarga mos shubhali xulqni real vaqtda aniqlaydi — container ichida shell ochilishi, `/etc/shadow` o'qish, kutilmagan tarmoq ulanishi — va alert yuboradi.

**Muammo:** Image skaneri faqat ma'lum CVE'larni deploy'dan oldin topadi. Hujumchi zero-day orqali kirsa yoki ruxsatli credential bilan harakat qilsa — buni faqat runtime xulqidan bilish mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
syscall'lar (execve, open, connect)
     | eBPF probe
     v
Falco engine + K8s metadata (pod, ns, image)
     | qoidalar (condition + output)
     v
alert --> stdout / Falcosidekick --> Slack, SIEM, Loki
                                  --> Talon (avtomatik javob: pod'ni izolyatsiya)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
helm install falco falcosecurity/falco -n falco --create-namespace \
  --set driver.kind=modern_ebpf --set falcosidekick.enabled=true
kubectl logs -n falco -l app.kubernetes.io/name=falco -f
```
```yaml
- rule: Shell in container
  desc: Container ichida interaktiv shell
  condition: spawned_process and container and proc.name in (bash, sh, zsh) and proc.tty != 0
  output: "Shell ochildi (user=%user.name pod=%k8s.pod.name ns=%k8s.ns.name cmd=%proc.cmdline)"
  priority: WARNING
```
Test: `kubectl exec -it api-xyz -- sh` — logda `Notice/Warning Shell ochildi ...`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default qoidalar ko'p shovqin beradi — avval tuning (macro'lar bilan istisno), aks holda alert fatigue.
- Alert'ni hech kim kuzatmaydi — SIEM va on-call jarayoniga ulanmasa foydasiz.
- Avtomatik "pod'ni o'ldirish" — false positive prod'ni yiqitishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Falco — detection, prevention emas. U PSA/seccomp (oldini olish) va image signing bilan birga qatlamli himoyaning oxirgi qatlami. Qoidalarni ilovaga xos qil: "bu servis hech qachon tashqi IP'ga ulanmaydi" — eng aniq signal.

40336.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cilium — CNCF (Graduated) eBPF asosidagi Kubernetes CNI: pod tarmog'i, kube-proxy o'rnini bosuvchi load balancing, L3-L7 NetworkPolicy (identity asosida, IP emas), WireGuard/IPsec shaffof shifrlash, Hubble observability va sidecar'siz service mesh beradi.

**Muammo:** Katta klasterda kube-proxy iptables qoidalari o'n minglab — servis yangilanishi sekin, latency oshadi. Oddiy NetworkPolicy L7 ni (masalan, faqat `GET /api`) bilmaydi; pod IP'lari doim o'zgaradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod A --> eBPF (tc hook, veth) --> policy: identity(A) -> identity(B)?
            |  service LB (iptables'siz, hash map)
            v
          Pod B (boshqa node bo'lsa: VXLAN/Geneve yoki native routing,
                 WireGuard bilan shifrlangan)
L7 qoidalar -> node'dagi Envoy
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
cilium install --set kubeProxyReplacement=true --set encryption.enabled=true --set encryption.type=wireguard
cilium status --wait
cilium connectivity test
hubble observe --namespace orders --verdict DROPPED
```
```yaml
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata: { name: api-l7, namespace: orders }
spec:
  endpointSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  ingress:
    - fromEndpoints: [{ matchLabels: { app: frontend } }]
      toPorts:
        - ports: [{ port: "8080", protocol: TCP }]
          rules: { http: [{ method: GET, path: "/api/.*" }] }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kernel versiyasi talablari (5.10+ tavsiya) — eski OS'da imkoniyatlar cheklangan.
- CNI almashtirish ishlab turgan klasterda — murakkab migratsiya, ko'pincha yangi klaster osonroq.
- L7 policy Envoy proxy orqali o'tadi — qo'shimcha latency va resurs.

**Senior nuqta:** Cilium qiymati identity asosidagi policy va chuqur ko'rinish (Hubble) da. Managed K8s'lar ham uni default qilyapti (GKE Dataplane V2, AKS Azure CNI powered by Cilium) — bu ekotizim yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi.

40337.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Gateway API — Kubernetes'ning Ingress vorisi (GA 2023, v1): trafikni rollar bo'yicha ajratilgan resurslar bilan boshqaradi: `GatewayClass` (infra provayder), `Gateway` (listener, port, TLS — platform jamoasi), `HTTPRoute`/`GRPCRoute` (routing — ilova jamoasi). Header bo'yicha routing, weight bilan trafik bo'lish nativ.

**Muammo:** Ingress juda sodda: canary, header match, timeout kabi narsalar har controller'da turli annotatsiyalar (`nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/...`) — portativ emas. Bitta Ingress resursida platforma va ilova jamoasi mas'uliyati aralashgan. ingress-nginx 2026-da retire bo'lishi e'lon qilingan — migratsiya dolzarb.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
GatewayClass (infra: envoy-gateway / istio / cilium)
     |
Gateway (ns: infra, :443, TLS cert)  <- platform jamoasi
     |  allowedRoutes: namespace'lar
     v
HTTPRoute (ns: orders)  <- ilova jamoasi
   /api  --> svc api-v1 (90%) + api-v2 (10%)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata: { name: api, namespace: orders }
spec:
  parentRefs: [{ name: public-gw, namespace: infra }]
  hostnames: ["api.acme.io"]
  rules:
    - matches: [{ path: { type: PathPrefix, value: /api } }]
      backendRefs:
        - { name: api-v1, port: 8080, weight: 90 }
        - { name: api-v2, port: 8080, weight: 10 }
```
```bash
kubectl get gateway -A
kubectl describe httproute api -n orders   # status.parents: Accepted, ResolvedRefs
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Route boshqa namespace'dagi Service'ga murojaat qilsa `ReferenceGrant` kerak, aks holda `ResolvedRefs=False`.
- Barcha controller'lar barcha imkoniyatni qo'llamaydi — conformance profilini tekshir.
- CRD'lar klasterda o'rnatilmagan bo'lishi mumkin — standard channel'ni alohida o'rnat.

**Senior nuqta:** Gateway API'ning asosiy yutug'i — rol ajratish: platform jamoasi TLS va listener'ni nazorat qiladi, ilova jamoasi faqat o'z route'larini. Yangi loyihalarda Ingress o'rniga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Gateway API tanla; u service mesh (GAMMA) uchun ham umumiy API.

40338.a:
**Qisqa javob:** KEDA (Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling) — CNCF (Graduated) autoscaler: tashqi event manbalari (Kafka consumer lag, SQS/RabbitMQ navbat uzunligi, Prometheus so'rovi, cron) bo'yicha workload'ni 0 dan N gacha scale qiladi. Ichkarida HPA yaratadi va unga external metric beradi.

**Muammo:** HPA CPU/xotira bo'yicha ishlaydi, lekin queue consumer'da CPU past bo'lishi mumkin, navbatda esa 1 million xabar yig'ilgan. Shuningdek HPA 0 replikaga tushmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ScaledObject (trigger: kafka lag > 100/replika)
     |
KEDA operator --> scaler Kafka'dan lag o'qiydi
     | 0 <-> 1: KEDA o'zi (activation)
     | 1 <-> N: HPA (KEDA metrics server orqali)
     v
Deployment replicas
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata: { name: orders-consumer, namespace: orders }
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { name: orders-consumer }
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 24          # topic partition soni bilan cheklangan
  triggers:
    - type: kafka
      metadata:
        bootstrapServers: kafka:9092
        consumerGroup: orders
        topic: orders
        lagThreshold: "100"
        activationLagThreshold: "5"
```
```bash
kubectl get scaledobject -n orders     # READY, ACTIVE
kubectl get hpa -n orders              # keda-hpa-orders-consumer
kubectl describe scaledobject orders-consumer -n orders
```
Batch uchun `ScaledJob` — har xabar guruhiga alohida Job.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kafka'da replika soni partition'dan oshsa, ortiqchalari bo'sh turadi.
- Scaler auth (`TriggerAuthentication`) noto'g'ri — metrika olinmaydi, scale bo'lmaydi; KEDA operator log'ini tekshir.
- Bir Deployment'ga ham HPA, ham ScaledObject — ziddiyat.

**Senior nuqta:** Navbat asosidagi scaling — "ish hajmi" bo'yicha scaling, bu CPU proxy'sidan aniqroq. Downstream (DB) sig'imini ham hisobga ol: 100 replika consumer DB connection'larini tugatishi mumkin — `maxReplicaCount` shu chegaradan kelib chiqsin.

40339.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Istio Ambient Mesh (GA 2024, Istio 1.24) — sidecar'siz service mesh rejimi: har node'da **ztunnel** DaemonSet L4 vazifalarini (mTLS, identity, L4 authz, telemetriya) bajaradi; L7 kerak bo'lgan joyda (HTTP routing, retry, L7 policy) namespace yoki servis uchun ixtiyoriy **waypoint proxy** (Envoy) qo'shiladi.

**Muammo:** Sidecar modelida har pod'ga Envoy: 1000 pod = 1000 proxy, xotira va CPU xarajati katta; mesh upgrade = hamma pod restart; sidecar inject qilish ilova lifecycle'iga aralashadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod A --> ztunnel (node 1) ==HBONE mTLS==> ztunnel (node 2) --> Pod B
                                 |
          L7 kerak bo'lsa:  ztunnel -> waypoint (Envoy) -> ztunnel
Sidecar yo'q: pod spec o'zgarmaydi, restart kerak emas
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
istioctl install --set profile=ambient
kubectl label namespace orders istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient   # mesh'ga qo'shish
istioctl waypoint apply -n orders --enroll-namespace             # L7 kerak bo'lsa
istioctl ztunnel-config workloads | grep orders                 # PROTOCOL: HBONE
kubectl logs -n istio-system ds/ztunnel | grep orders
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Waypoint'siz L7 xususiyatlar (HTTP retry, header routing, L7 AuthorizationPolicy) ishlamaydi — policy jim e'tiborsiz qoladi.
- CNI bilan moslik va kernel talablari — avval o'z muhitingda sinab ko'r.
- ztunnel node darajasida — uning nosozligi node'dagi barcha pod'larning mesh trafigiga ta'sir qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ambient mesh'ni bosqichma-bosqich qabul qilish oson: avval faqat mTLS (L4) — arzon va keng; L7 faqat haqiqatan kerak bo'lgan servislarga. Sidecar vs ambient tanlovi — resurs xarajati va izolyatsiya (ztunnel umumiy) o'rtasidagi trade-off.

40340.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Distributed consensus — bir nechta node bitta qiymat yoki operatsiyalar log'i tartibi bo'yicha kelishishi, hatto ba'zi node'lar yiqilsa yoki tarmoq bo'linsa ham. Asosiy algoritmlar: Paxos, **Raft** (tushunarliroq). Ishlatilishi: etcd (K8s), Consul, ZooKeeper (ZAB), CockroachDB, Kafka KRaft.

**Muammo:** 3 ta node'da konfiguratsiya bor; tarmoq bo'linganda ikkala tomon "men leader'man" deb turli yozuvlarni qabul qilsa — split-brain, ma'lumot buziladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (Raft):**
```
Leader --append entry--> Follower 1
   |                \--> Follower 2
   | majority (2/3) ack -> commit -> state machine'ga qo'llash
Leader heartbeat yo'qolsa -> election timeout -> yangi term,
   ovoz yig'ish -> majority olgan leader bo'ladi
Quorum = floor(N/2)+1:  3 node -> 1 nosozlikka chidaydi
                        5 node -> 2 ta
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
etcdctl --endpoints=$EPS endpoint status -w table
# ENDPOINT | ID | IS LEADER | RAFT TERM | RAFT INDEX
etcdctl --endpoints=$EPS endpoint health
etcdctl member list -w table
```
Term tez-tez oshsa — leader beqaror (disk sekin, tarmoq jitter).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Juft son node (4) — 3 bilan bir xil chidamlilik, lekin ko'proq yozish latency'si.
- Node'larni uzoq region'larga tarqatish — har yozuv WAN RTT kutadi.
- Sekin disk (fsync) — heartbeat kechikadi, keraksiz election'lar. etcd uchun SSD shart.

**Senior nuqta:** Consensus qimmat — uni faqat kichik, kritik metadata uchun ishlat (leader election, konfiguratsiya, lock), katta ma'lumot oqimi uchun emas. CAP nuqtai nazaridan bu CP: partition paytida minority tomon yozishni rad etadi — bu bug emas, kafolat.

40341.a:
**Qisqa javob:** WAL (Write-Ahead Log) — o'zgarish asosiy ma'lumot fayllariga yozilishidan **oldin** ketma-ket (append-only) log'ga yoziladi va `fsync` qilinadi. Crash bo'lsa, tizim log'ni qayta o'ynab (replay) commit qilingan ma'lumotni tiklaydi. Bu durability (ACID'dagi D) kafolati.

**Muammo:** Ma'lumot sahifalarini har commit'da diskka tasodifiy joylarga yozish sekin; xotirada ushlab tursak — elektr o'chsa yo'qoladi. WAL ikkalasini hal qiladi: ketma-ket yozish tez, sahifalar keyinroq (checkpoint) yoziladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
UPDATE --> WAL record (xotira bufer) --> COMMIT: WAL fsync diskka
              |                              |  "commit OK" mijozga
              v
     shared buffers'dagi sahifa o'zgaradi (dirty)
              |
       checkpoint: dirty sahifalar data fayllarga
Crash -> oxirgi checkpoint'dan WAL replay -> izchil holat
WAL shuningdek: replication (stream), PITR (arxiv)
```

**Amalda (PostgreSQL):**
```sql
SELECT pg_current_wal_lsn();
SELECT pg_walfile_name(pg_current_wal_lsn());
SHOW wal_level;            -- replica / logical
SHOW synchronous_commit;   -- on: fsync kutadi
```
```bash
ls $PGDATA/pg_wal | head
pg_waldump $PGDATA/pg_wal/000000010000000000000003 | head
```
Boshqa misollar: etcd WAL, Kafka log, MySQL redo log, RocksDB WAL.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `fsync=off` yoki yolg'on fsync qiladigan disk kesh — crash'da ma'lumot buziladi.
- Replication slot yoki arxiv ishlamasa `pg_wal` to'lib, disk tugaydi va DB to'xtaydi.
- `synchronous_commit=off` — tezroq, lekin crash'da oxirgi ~soniya commit'lari yo'qolishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** WAL — DB'ning haqiqiy manbasi: replication, CDC (Debezium logical decoding) va backup hammasi undan o'qiydi. WAL hajmi va arxiv kechikishini monitoring qil — bu ko'p prod incident'larning birinchi signali.

40342.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Connection pooling — qat'iy sondagi tayyor DB ulanishlarini ko'p client o'rtasida qayta ishlatish. PostgreSQL'da har ulanish alohida process (~5-10 MB), shuning uchun minglab to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulanish DB'ni o'ldiradi. Tool'lar: ilova ichidagi pool (pgxpool, HikariCP), tashqi pooler — PgBouncer, RDS Proxy, Pgpool.

**Muammo:** 200 pod x har birida 20 ulanish = 4000 ulanish. Postgres `max_connections=500`: yangi pod'lar `FATAL: too many connections` oladi; ulanish ochish (TLS + auth) har so'rovga 20-50 ms qo'shadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
200 pod (har biri pool 5) = 1000 client ulanish
        |
   PgBouncer (transaction mode)
        |  50 ta server ulanish (qayta ishlatiladi)
        v
   PostgreSQL (max_connections=200)
```

| Rejim | Server ulanish qachon qaytadi | Cheklov |
|---|---|---|
| session | client uzilganda | tejash kam |
| transaction | tranzaksiya tugaganda | session state (SET, advisory lock, LISTEN) ishlamaydi |
| statement | har so'rovdan keyin | multi-statement tranzaksiya yo'q |

**Amalda:**
```ini
; pgbouncer.ini
[databases]
orders = host=pg-primary port=5432 dbname=orders
[pgbouncer]
pool_mode = transaction
default_pool_size = 40
max_client_conn = 5000
```
```bash
psql -p 6432 -U admin pgbouncer -c "SHOW POOLS;"   # cl_waiting > 0 = pool tor
```
```go
cfg, _ := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
cfg.MaxConns = 10
cfg.MaxConnLifetime = 30 * time.Minute
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Transaction mode'da prepared statement'lar — PgBouncer 1.21+ `max_prepared_statements` bilan qo'llaydi, eskilarida xato.
- Pool juda katta — DB'da contention oshadi; optimal ~ CPU yadro x 2-4.
- Uzun tranzaksiyalar ulanishni band qiladi — pool och qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Pool hajmini "ko'proq = tezroq" deb emas, DB sig'imidan teskari hisobla: DB nechta parallel so'rovni samarali bajaradi, shuni replikalar soniga bo'l. `cl_waiting` va so'rov kutish vaqti — asosiy metrikalar.

40343.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Sharding — ma'lumot qatorlarini shard key bo'yicha (masalan `tenant_id`) bir nechta mustaqil DB instance'ga gorizontal bo'lish. Har shard ma'lumotning faqat bir qismini saqlaydi — yozish va saqlash sig'imi gorizontal oshadi. Narxi: shard'lararo so'rov, tranzaksiya va resharding murakkab.

**Muammo:** Bitta Postgres 10 TB, yozish 50k/s — eng katta instance ham yetmaydi, vacuum va backup soatlab davom etadi. Read replica faqat o'qishni scale qiladi, yozishni emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
so'rov (tenant_id=42)
     |
 routing qatlami: hash(42) mod N  yoki lookup jadval
     |
 +---------+---------+---------+
 shard 0   shard 1   shard 2   shard 3
 tenant'lar tenant'lar ...
Strategiyalar: hash (teng taqsimot), range (vaqt/ID oraliq),
directory (tenant -> shard jadvali, eng moslashuvchan)
```

**Amalda:**
```sql
-- Citus (Postgres extension)
SELECT create_distributed_table('orders', 'tenant_id');
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = 42;     -- bitta shard
SELECT count(*) FROM orders;                   -- hamma shard'ga fan-out
```
Boshqa yechimlar: Vitess (MySQL), MongoDB sharding, CockroachDB/Spanner (avtomatik).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `user_id % N` — N o'zgarsa deyarli hamma ma'lumot ko'chadi. Consistent hashing yoki ko'p virtual shard (masalan 1024 logical -> 8 fizik).
- Noto'g'ri shard key — hot shard (bitta katta mijoz) yoki har so'rov fan-out.
- Shard'lararo JOIN va unique constraint — ilova darajasida yoki ishlamaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Sharding — oxirgi chora: avval indeks, query optimizatsiya, vertikal scale, read replica, partitioning, arxivlash. Kerak bo'lsa, shard key'ni asosiy access pattern'dan tanla (ko'pincha tenant) — tranzaksiyalar bitta shard ichida qolsin.

40344.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Read-write splitting — yozish so'rovlari (`INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE`, tranzaksiyalar) primary'ga, o'qish (`SELECT`) asinxron read replica'larga yo'naltiriladi. O'qish yukini gorizontal taqsimlaydi, lekin replica'dan eski ma'lumot o'qish xavfi bor.

**Muammo:** Ilova trafigining 90% o'qish (katalog, dashboard), primary CPU 85% — yozishlar ham sekinlashadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
App
 | write / tx  ----------> Primary --WAL stream--> Replica 1
 | read (stale OK) ------------------------------> Replica 2
 | read-your-writes kerak -> Primary
Routing: ilova (2 ta DSN), proxy (ProxySQL, Pgpool), driver (target_session_attrs)
```

**Amalda:**
```go
type DB struct{ rw, ro *pgxpool.Pool }

func (d *DB) GetOrder(ctx context.Context, id int64, fresh bool) (Order, error) {
    pool := d.ro
    if fresh { pool = d.rw }   // foydalanuvchi hozirgina yozgan bo'lsa
    var o Order
    err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, status FROM orders WHERE id=$1`, id).Scan(&o.ID, &o.Status)
    return o, err
}
```
```bash
# libpq: faqat standby'ga ulanish
psql "host=db1,db2 dbname=orders target_session_attrs=prefer-standby"
```
AWS Aurora: alohida reader endpoint (`cluster-ro-...`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Read-after-write: foydalanuvchi profilini yangiladi, sahifa replica'dan eski qiymatni ko'rsatadi. Yechim: yozgandan keyin N soniya primary, yoki LSN asosida kutish.
- Tranzaksiya ichidagi `SELECT` replica'ga ketsa — izchillik buziladi.
- Replica tushsa, barcha o'qish primary'ga ag'dariladi — primary sig'imini hisobga ol.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval tekshir: muammo haqiqatan o'qish yukidami? Ko'pincha cache yoki indeks arzonroq yechim. Splitting'ni har so'rov uchun "stale qabul qilinadimi" degan aniq qaror bilan qil — default primary, ruxsat berilganlari replica.

40345.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Replication lag — primary'da commit qilingan o'zgarish asinxron replica'da qo'llanishigacha bo'lgan kechikish (vaqt yoki bayt/LSN). Bu davrda replica'dan o'qilgan ma'lumot eski bo'ladi; failover bo'lsa lag ichidagi commit'lar yo'qolishi mumkin.

**Muammo:** Foydalanuvchi to'lov qildi, "Mening buyurtmalarim" sahifasi replica'dan o'qiydi va buyurtmani ko'rsatmaydi — u qayta to'laydi. Yoki primary yiqildi, replica 30 s orqada edi — 30 s ma'lumot yo'qoldi (RPO).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Primary: commit LSN 0/5000
   | WAL send (tarmoq)       -> write_lag
Replica: diskka yozildi      -> flush_lag
   | apply (bitta jarayon)   -> replay_lag
Replica LSN 0/4A00 --> lag
Sabablar: katta tranzaksiya, sekin disk, tarmoq, replica'dagi
uzun so'rov (hot_standby_feedback / conflict), replica CPU
```

**Amalda (PostgreSQL):**
```sql
-- Primary'da
SELECT application_name, state, write_lag, flush_lag, replay_lag,
       pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), replay_lsn) AS bytes_lag
FROM pg_stat_replication;
-- Replica'da
SELECT now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() AS lag;
```
Prometheus (postgres_exporter): `pg_replication_lag_seconds > 10` uchun alert.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()` primary'da yozuv bo'lmasa ham o'sadi — bo'sh tizimda yolg'on alert.
- Katta `UPDATE` (millionlab qator) yoki `CREATE INDEX` — to'satdan katta lag.
- Synchronous replication lag'ni yo'qotadi, lekin har commit'ga RTT qo'shadi va replica tushsa yozish to'xtaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Lag'ni nolga tushirib bo'lmaydi — dizaynni unga moslashtir: read-your-writes uchun primary, failover uchun RPO talabiga qarab sync/quorum replication (`synchronous_standby_names = 'ANY 1 (r1, r2)'`). Lag — SLI sifatida monitoring qilinishi kerak.

40346.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Dual-write muammosi — servis bitta biznes amalda ikki xil tizimga (masalan DB va Kafka) alohida yozadi; ular orasida umumiy tranzaksiya yo'q, shuning uchun biri muvaffaqiyatli, ikkinchisi muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa tizimlar nomuvofiq qoladi. Yechim: Transactional Outbox yoki CDC.

**Muammo:**
```go
tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO orders ...`)   // 1. DB
tx.Commit()
producer.Send("order.created", ev)  // 2. Kafka  <- shu yerda crash?
```
- DB commit bo'ldi, Kafka'ga yuborilmadi -> to'lov/ombor servisi buyurtmani hech qachon ko'rmaydi.
- Teskari tartib: Kafka'ga yuborildi, DB commit yiqildi -> boshqalar mavjud bo'lmagan buyurtmani qayta ishlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (xato holatlar):**
```
DB ok  + MQ ok   -> to'g'ri
DB ok  + MQ fail -> event yo'qoldi
DB fail + MQ ok  -> "arvoh" event
retry              -> dublikat event
2PC/XA - Kafka qo'llamaydi, sekin, koordinator SPOF
```

**Amalda — to'g'ri yondashuv:**
```sql
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO orders (id, ...) VALUES (...);
INSERT INTO outbox (id, aggregate_id, type, payload)
  VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 42, 'order.created', '{...}');
COMMIT;   -- ikkalasi atomik
```
Keyin relay (Debezium yoki poller) outbox'dan Kafka'ga publish qiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Retry qo'shsak bo'ldi" deb o'ylash — process crash'da retry ham yo'qoladi.
- Outbox at-least-once beradi — consumer'lar idempotent bo'lishi shart.
- Kodda yashirin dual-write: DB + Redis cache, DB + Elasticsearch ham xuddi shu muammo.

**Senior nuqta:** Code review'da "bitta handler'da ikki tizimga yozish"ni qizil bayroq deb qara. Asosiy prinsip: bitta manba haqiqati (DB), qolgan tizimlar unga asinxron, idempotent tarzda ergashadi.

40347.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Transactional Outbox — event biznes ma'lumot bilan **bitta lokal ACID tranzaksiyada** `outbox` jadvaliga yoziladi. Alohida relay jarayoni (Debezium CDC yoki poller) outbox'ni o'qib event'ni broker'ga (Kafka) publish qiladi. Natija: DB va event izchil, at-least-once yetkazib berish.

**Muammo:** Dual-write: DB va Kafka'ga alohida yozish crash paytida event yo'qolishi yoki arvoh event'ga olib keladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Servis --tx--> [orders] + [outbox]   (bitta COMMIT)
                     |
      +--------------+--------------+
      | CDC: Debezium WAL o'qiydi   | Polling: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE
      v                             v   SKIP LOCKED, published_at
    Kafka topic (key = aggregate_id -> tartib saqlanadi)
      |
   Consumer (idempotent: event_id bo'yicha dedup)
```

**Amalda (polling relay):**
```sql
CREATE TABLE outbox (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, aggregate_id text NOT NULL,
  type text NOT NULL, payload jsonb NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), published_at timestamptz);

-- relay har 200 ms
WITH batch AS (
  SELECT id FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
UPDATE outbox o SET published_at = now()
FROM batch WHERE o.id = batch.id
RETURNING o.*;   -- Kafka'ga yubor, keyin COMMIT
```
Debezium'da `io.debezium.transforms.outbox.EventRouter` SMT outbox qatorlarini topic'larga yo'naltiradi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Publish va `published_at` belgilash orasida crash -> qayta yuboriladi (dublikat). Consumer `event_id` bo'yicha dedup qilishi shart.
- Outbox jadvali cheksiz o'sadi — tozalash job'i yoki partition.
- Bir nechta relay instance'i tartibni buzadi — `SKIP LOCKED` + aggregate bo'yicha key, yoki bitta leader.

**Senior nuqta:** CDC (Debezium) ilova kodiga polling yuk qo'shmaydi va latency past, lekin Kafka Connect infratuzilmasini talab qiladi; polling sodda va kichik hajmda yetarli. Ikkalasida ham kafolat "kamida bir marta" — exactly-once'ni consumer idempotency'si beradi.

40348.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Saga — bir nechta servis bo'ylab biznes tranzaksiyani lokal tranzaksiyalar ketma-ketligi sifatida bajarish; biror qadam yiqilsa, oldingi qadamlar **compensating** amallar bilan bekor qilinadi (rollback emas, teskari biznes amal). Ikki usul: **choreography** (event'lar orqali) va **orchestration** (markaziy koordinator).

**Muammo:** Buyurtma: to'lovni yech -> omborda band qil -> yetkazishni rejalash. Har biri alohida servis va DB; 2PC mikroservislarda amaliy emas (lock'lar, koordinator nosozligi).

**Qanday ishlaydi (orchestration):**
```
Orchestrator (state saqlaydi)
 1. Payment.charge      ok
 2. Inventory.reserve   ok
 3. Shipping.schedule   FAIL
    -> kompensatsiya teskari tartibda:
 2'. Inventory.release
 1'. Payment.refund
 holat: ORDER_CANCELLED
```
Choreography: `OrderCreated` -> Payment `PaymentCharged` chiqaradi -> Inventory tinglaydi ... — markaz yo'q, lekin oqimni kuzatish qiyin.

**Amalda:** Orchestration uchun Temporal, AWS Step Functions, Camunda:
```go
func OrderSaga(ctx workflow.Context, o Order) error {
    var comp []func()
    defer func() { /* xatoda comp'larni teskari tartibda chaqir */ }()
    if err := workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Charge, o).Get(ctx, nil); err != nil { return err }
    comp = append(comp, func() { workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Refund, o) })
    if err := workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Reserve, o).Get(ctx, nil); err != nil { return err }
    comp = append(comp, func() { workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Release, o) })
    return workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, Schedule, o).Get(ctx, nil)
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Izolyatsiya yo'q: oraliq holatlar boshqalarga ko'rinadi (to'lov yechildi, lekin buyurtma hali bekor). Semantic lock (`PENDING` status) ishlat.
- Kompensatsiya ham yiqilishi mumkin — retry va idempotency shart; ba'zi amallar qaytarilmaydi (email yuborildi).
- Choreography'da sikl va "kim nima qiladi" yo'qolishi.

**Senior nuqta:** 3+ qadam va murakkab xato yo'llari bo'lsa orchestration (Temporal) ni tanla — holat ko'rinadi va test qilinadi. Avval savol ber: bu servis chegaralari to'g'rimi? Ko'p saga — ko'pincha noto'g'ri bo'lingan domen belgisi.

40349.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Event sourcing — entity'ning joriy holatini ustidan yozish o'rniga, uning barcha o'zgarishlarini o'zgarmas (immutable) event'lar ketma-ketligi sifatida append-only saqlash. Joriy holat event'larni qayta o'ynab (fold) hisoblanadi. To'liq tarix, audit va vaqtda orqaga qaytish imkoni beradi.

**Muammo:** `UPDATE accounts SET balance = 70` — nega 70 bo'ldi, oldin nima edi, kim o'zgartirdi — ma'lumot yo'qolgan. Bank, ledger, compliance talab qiladigan domenlarda bu qabul qilinmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Event store (stream: account-42)
 v1 AccountOpened   {owner: "Ali"}
 v2 MoneyDeposited  {amount: 100}
 v3 MoneyWithdrawn  {amount: 30}
      |
  fold -> balance = 70 (joriy holat)
      |
  projection'lar -> read model'lar (CQRS)
Snapshot: har 100 event'da holat saqlanadi -> tez yuklash
Concurrency: append expectedVersion=3 (optimistic lock)
```

**Amalda:**
```go
func (a *Account) Apply(e Event) {
    switch ev := e.(type) {
    case MoneyDeposited: a.Balance += ev.Amount
    case MoneyWithdrawn: a.Balance -= ev.Amount
    }
    a.Version++
}
// store.Append(ctx, "account-42", expectedVersion=3, MoneyWithdrawn{30})
// boshqa yozuvchi oldin yozgan bo'lsa -> ErrConcurrency, qayta urin
```
Tool'lar: EventStoreDB (KurrentDB), Axon, Marten (Postgres), yoki Postgres jadvali `(stream_id, version) UNIQUE`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Event sxemasi evolyutsiyasi: eski event'lar abadiy — upcasting/versiyalash kerak.
- GDPR "o'chirish huquqi" va immutable log — crypto-shredding (shaxsiy ma'lumotni alohida kalit bilan shifrlab, kalitni o'chirish).
- Har CRUD tizimga qo'llash — murakkablik qiymatdan oshadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Event sourcing'ni butun tizimga emas, tarix biznes qiymatiga ega bo'lgan bounded context'ga (ledger, buyurtma lifecycle) qo'lla. Event'lar — domen faktlari ("MoneyWithdrawn"), CRUD o'zgarishlari ("BalanceUpdated") emas.

40350.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) — yozish (command) va o'qish (query) uchun alohida modellar, ko'pincha alohida saqlash joylari. Write model biznes qoidalari va izchillikka optimallashadi, read model'lar esa aniq so'rovlarga (denormalizatsiya, qidiruv) — ular event'lar orqali asinxron yangilanadi, ya'ni eventual consistent.

**Muammo:** Bitta normalizatsiyalangan model: yozish uchun qulay, lekin dashboard so'rovi 8 ta JOIN va 3 soniya. Indeks qo'shsang yozish sekinlashadi. Bitta model ikki qarama-qarshi talabni bajara olmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Command (PlaceOrder) --> Write model (Postgres, invariantlar)
                              | event / CDC
                              v
                    Projector(lar)
                     |         |           |
               Elasticsearch  Redis    ClickHouse
               (qidiruv)    (karta)   (analitika)
Query --> read model (tez, denormalizatsiyalangan)
```

**Amalda:**
```go
// Command tomoni
func (s *Svc) PlaceOrder(ctx context.Context, c PlaceOrder) error {
    return s.tx(ctx, func(tx pgx.Tx) error {
        // invariantlarni tekshir, orders + outbox'ga yoz
    })
}
// Projector: order.placed event'ini o'qib read jadvalni yangilaydi
// UPSERT INTO order_summary (...) ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO UPDATE ... WHERE version < EXCLUDED.version
```
Read model'ni noldan qayta qurish mumkin bo'lishi kerak (event'larni qayta o'ynash).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eventual consistency UX'ga ta'sir qiladi: foydalanuvchi buyurtma qildi, ro'yxatda hali yo'q. Optimistic UI yoki command javobida natijani qaytar.
- Projector'lar idempotent bo'lmasa dublikat event read model'ni buzadi.
- Oddiy CRUD'ga CQRS — keraksiz murakkablik.

**Senior nuqta:** CQRS event sourcing'ni talab qilmaydi — eng yengil shakli bitta DB'da alohida query modellar yoki materialized view. Murakkablikni o'qish va yozish yuklari yoki modellari haqiqatan ajralganda qo'sh; projection lag'ini metrika sifatida kuzat.

40351.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Anycast — bitta IP manzilni dunyoning turli joylaridagi ko'p server BGP orqali bir vaqtda e'lon qiladi; internet routing'i paketni topologik jihatdan eng yaqin (eng qisqa BGP yo'l) nuqtaga olib boradi. Ishlatilishi: DNS root serverlar, 1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8, CDN edge, AWS Global Accelerator, Cloudflare.

**Muammo:** Unicast IP bitta joyda: Toshkentdagi foydalanuvchi AQShdagi serverga 200 ms. DNS asosida geo-yo'naltirish TTL va resolver joylashuviga bog'liq, sekin o'zgaradi. DDoS bitta nuqtaga yig'iladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
             203.0.113.10 (bir xil IP)
   PoP Frankfurt    PoP Singapur    PoP Virginia
        \                |               /
          BGP e'lon: "203.0.113.0/24 men orqali"
User (Toshkent) --> ISP routing --> eng yaqin: Frankfurt
PoP yiqilsa -> e'lonni qaytarib oladi -> trafik keyingisiga
DDoS -> butun dunyo PoP'lariga tarqaladi (yutiladi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
traceroute 1.1.1.1          # turli shaharlardan turli yo'l
dig +short CHAOS TXT id.server @1.1.1.1    # qaysi PoP javob berdi
curl -s https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace | grep colo   # colo=FRA
aws globalaccelerator list-accelerators   # 2 ta statik anycast IP
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Eng yaqin" = BGP bo'yicha, geografik emas: ISP peering sababli uzoq PoP'ga tushish mumkin.
- TCP uchun: route o'zgarsa uzun ulanish boshqa PoP'ga tushib uziladi — shuning uchun anycast ko'pincha UDP (DNS) va qisqa HTTP uchun; stateful bo'lsa connection tracking kerak.
- O'z anycast'ingni qilish uchun o'z ASN va /24 prefiks kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Anycast tarmoq darajasida failover va DDoS yutishni beradi — DNS failover'dan tezroq (TTL kutilmaydi). Global Accelerator yoki CDN orqali uni o'z IP blokisiz ham olish mumkin.

40352.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CDN (Content Delivery Network) — dunyo bo'ylab tarqalgan edge serverlar tarmog'i: kontentni (statik fayl, rasm, video, ba'zan API javoblari) foydalanuvchiga yaqin joyda cache'laydi. Natija: past latency, origin'ga yuk kamayadi, trafik sakrashlari va DDoS yutiladi. Misollar: CloudFront, Cloudflare, Fastly, Akamai.

**Muammo:** Origin Frankfurtda, Osiyo foydalanuvchisi 2 MB JS'ni 300 ms RTT bilan yuklaydi; aksiya kuni trafik 50x — origin yiqiladi; egress xarajati katta.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
User --> DNS/anycast --> Edge PoP (yaqin)
                          | cache HIT -> darhol javob
                          | MISS
                          v
                    (Origin Shield / regional cache)
                          |
                       Origin (S3 / ALB)
Cache kaliti: host + path (+ tanlangan query/header/cookie)
TTL: Cache-Control: max-age, s-maxage
```

**Amalda:**
```http
# Origin javobi: hash'langan statik fayl
Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
# HTML: CDN qisqa, brauzer har safar tekshiradi
Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=60, max-age=0, stale-while-revalidate=30
```
```bash
curl -sI https://cdn.acme.io/app.3f9a.js | grep -iE 'x-cache|age|cache-control'
# x-cache: Hit from cloudfront   age: 3540
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E123 --paths "/index.html"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cache kaliti'ga keraksiz cookie/header kirsa hit ratio 0% ga tushadi.
- Shaxsiy javobni (`Set-Cookie`, user ma'lumoti) cache'lash — boshqa foydalanuvchiga sizib chiqadi. `private` / `no-store`.
- Invalidation'ga tayanish — sekin va pullik; fayl nomida versiya/hash ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Asosiy metrika — cache hit ratio (bayt va so'rov bo'yicha) va origin'ga tushayotgan yuk. Origin Shield qo'shish ko'p PoP'dan bir vaqtdagi MISS'larni (thundering herd) bitta so'rovga yig'adi.

40353.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Head-of-Line (HoL) blocking — navbatdagi birinchi element kechiksa, uning orqasidagilar tayyor bo'lsa ham kutib qoladi. HTTP/1.1'da bitta ulanishda javoblar ketma-ket; HTTP/2 buni ilova darajasida hal qildi, lekin TCP darajasida qoldi — bitta yo'qolgan paket barcha stream'larni to'xtatadi. HTTP/3 (QUIC, UDP ustida) stream'larni transport darajasida mustaqil qiladi.

**Muammo:** Mobil tarmoqda 2% paket yo'qolishi: HTTP/2 da bitta TCP ulanish orqali 50 ta resurs — bitta paket yo'qolsa hammasi retransmit'ni kutadi, sahifa "qotadi".

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
HTTP/1.1: req1 -> resp1 (sekin) | req2 kutadi  (ilova HoL)
           brauzer 6 ta ulanish ochib aylanib o'tadi

HTTP/2 (TCP):  stream A [1][2][X][4]   X yo'qoldi
               stream B [1][2][3]      <- B ham kutadi (TCP tartib)

HTTP/3 (QUIC): stream A [1][2][X][4]   faqat A kutadi
               stream B [1][2][3] -> darhol ilovaga
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
curl -sI --http3 https://cloudflare.com | head -1     # HTTP/3 200
curl -sI https://example.com | grep -i alt-svc        # alt-svc: h3=":443"
```
```nginx
# nginx 1.25+
listen 443 quic reuseport;
listen 443 ssl;
http2 on;
add_header Alt-Svc 'h3=":443"; ma=86400';
```
Navbat tizimlarida ham HoL bor: Kafka partition'da bitta "zaharli" xabar butun partition'ni to'xtatadi (DLQ yechimi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Korporativ firewall UDP/443 ni bloklaydi — HTTP/3 fallback ishlashi shart.
- HTTP/2 da ham server tomonda sekin javob boshqalarni bloklamaydi, lekin TCP darajasidagi HoL qoladi — bularni chalkashtirma.

**Senior nuqta:** HTTP/3 eng ko'p yutuqni yuqori yo'qotishli va yuqori RTT tarmoqlarda (mobil) beradi; data center ichida farq kichik. Umumiy saboq: mustaqil ish birliklarini bitta tartibli navbatga qo'yma.

40354.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute (GCP'da Cloud Interconnect) — on-prem data center bilan cloud provayder o'rtasidagi **maxsus xususiy fizik ulanish** (1/10/100 Gbps), public internetni chetlab o'tadi. Barqaror latency, yuqori o'tkazuvchanlik, arzonroq egress beradi.

**Muammo:** Bank o'z data center'idan cloud'ga kuniga 20 TB ma'lumot replikatsiya qiladi. Internet orqali VPN: latency o'zgaruvchan, 1.25 Gbps tunnel chegarasi, egress qimmat, regulyator "public internet emas" talab qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
On-prem router --cross-connect--> DX location (colo)
                                       |
                              AWS backbone
                                       |
          Virtual Interface (VIF):
           private VIF  -> VGW / DX Gateway -> VPC'lar
           transit VIF  -> Transit Gateway
           public VIF   -> AWS public servislari (S3)
BGP: on-prem prefikslar <-> VPC CIDR'lar almashinadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws directconnect describe-connections
aws directconnect describe-virtual-interfaces \
  --query 'virtualInterfaces[].{name:virtualInterfaceName,state:virtualInterfaceState,bgp:bgpPeers[0].bgpStatus}'
```
Router tomonda: `show bgp summary` — DX peer `Established` holatida bo'lsin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default holatda **shifrlanmagan** — MACsec (10/100G) yoki ustidan IPsec VPN kerak.
- Bitta ulanish = SPOF. AWS resiliency tavsiyasi: ikki xil DX location, har birida 2 ulanish; zaxira sifatida Site-to-Site VPN.
- Yangi ulanish o'rnatish haftalar (provayder, colo) — rejani oldindan tuz.

**Senior nuqta:** Direct Connect'ni hajm va izchillik talabi asoslasa ol: odatda doimiy bir necha Gbps trafik yoki compliance. Kichik hajmda VPN arzon va tez; gibrid arxitekturada DX + Transit Gateway markaziy hub bo'ladi.

40355.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) — regional hub-and-spoke router: yuzlab VPC, Site-to-Site VPN va Direct Connect'ni bitta markaziy nuqta orqali ulaydi. Route table'lar orqali kim kim bilan gaplashishini (segmentatsiya) boshqaradi.

**Muammo:** 30 ta VPC'ni VPC peering bilan to'liq ulash = 30*29/2 = 435 peering; peering tranzitiv emas, route'lar har joyda qo'lda. On-prem VPN har VPC'ga alohida.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
        VPC prod-a   VPC prod-b   VPC shared (DNS, egress)
             \           |            /
              +----- Transit Gateway -----+
             /           |            \
       VPC dev       VPN (on-prem)    Direct Connect GW
TGW route table'lar:
  rt-prod: prod <-> shared, prod <-> on-prem
  rt-dev:  dev  <-> shared   (dev -> prod YO'Q)
Inter-region: TGW peering
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-transit-gateway-vpc-attachment \
  --transit-gateway-id tgw-0abc --vpc-id vpc-111 --subnet-ids subnet-a subnet-b
aws ec2 search-transit-gateway-routes --transit-gateway-route-table-id tgw-rtb-01 \
  --filters Name=type,Values=propagated
# VPC route table'da: 10.0.0.0/8 -> tgw-0abc
```
Terraform'da odatda network akkauntida yaratiladi va RAM orqali boshqa akkauntlarga ulashiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Narx: har attachment soatiga + har GB qayta ishlash ($0.02/GB) — katta ichki trafikda qimmat.
- CIDR'lar ustma-ust tushsa (hamma VPC 10.0.0.0/16) — routing imkonsiz. IPAM bilan oldindan rejala.
- Default route table associate/propagate yoqilgan — hammasi hammaga ochiq bo'lib qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** TGW landing zone'ning markazi: markazlashgan egress (NAT, firewall) va inspection VPC orqali. Faqat ikki VPC o'rtasida juda katta trafik bo'lsa, peering arzonroq (data processing to'lovi yo'q) — gibrid ham normal.

40356.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS PrivateLink — VPC ichida ENI (Interface VPC Endpoint) yaratib, AWS servislariga (SQS, KMS, ECR) yoki boshqa akkaunt/SaaS servislariga public internetsiz, AWS backbone orqali xususiy IP bilan ulanish. Faqat bitta servis ochiladi, butun tarmoq emas.

**Muammo:** Private subnet'dagi pod'lar ECR va S3'ga NAT Gateway orqali chiqadi — har GB uchun to'lov va internet ekspozitsiyasi. SaaS vendor (Snowflake, MongoDB Atlas) bilan VPC peering — CIDR to'qnashuvi va butun tarmoq ochiq.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Consumer VPC                         Provider VPC
 app --> ENI 10.0.3.15 (endpoint) ==> Endpoint Service --> NLB --> servis
          | private DNS:
          | sqs.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com -> 10.0.3.15
Bir yo'nalishli: provider consumer tarmog'iga kira olmaydi
CIDR to'qnashuvi muammo emas
```
Gateway endpoint (S3, DynamoDB) — boshqa tur: route table orqali, bepul.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-111 --vpc-endpoint-type Interface \
  --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.ecr.dkr \
  --subnet-ids subnet-a subnet-b --security-group-ids sg-endpoints \
  --private-dns-enabled
dig +short api.ecr.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com   # 10.x.x.x bo'lishi kerak
```
O'z servisingni ochish: NLB yarat -> `aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint-service-configuration --network-load-balancer-arns ...` -> consumer akkauntlarga ruxsat.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Interface endpoint pullik (soat x AZ + GB) — 20 servis x 3 AZ tez yig'iladi. Shared services VPC'da markazlashtir.
- Endpoint security group'i 443 ni ruxsat bermasa — timeout.
- Private DNS yoqilmasa ilova baribir public endpoint'ga ketadi.

**Senior nuqta:** PrivateLink — "servis darajasidagi" ulanish, peering — "tarmoq darajasidagi". Multi-tenant SaaS va akkauntlar orasida minimal ekspozitsiya uchun PrivateLink to'g'ri tanlov; S3/DynamoDB uchun har doim bepul gateway endpoint qo'y — NAT xarajatini sezilarli kamaytiradi.

40357.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Multi-region active-active — ilova bir vaqtda ikki yoki undan ko'p region'da to'liq ishlaydi va trafikni qabul qiladi; foydalanuvchi eng yaqin/sog'lom region'ga yo'naltiriladi, ma'lumot region'lar orasida replikatsiya qilinadi. Eng past RTO (deyarli nol) va latency, lekin eng murakkab va qimmat DR strategiyasi.

**Muammo:** Global foydalanuvchilar uchun latency va bitta region to'liq ishdan chiqishi (bunday holatlar real) — biznes daqiqalab ham to'xtay olmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Users --> Route 53 latency/geo + health check (yoki anycast)
           |                         |
     eu-central-1               us-east-1
     app + DB (yozadi)  <==>    app + DB (yozadi)
           replikatsiya (asinxron)
Konflikt: ikkala region bir yozuvni o'zgartirsa?
 - last-writer-wins (DynamoDB Global Tables)
 - CRDT
 - "home region": har user/tenant faqat bitta region'da yoziladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws dynamodb create-table ... --stream-specification StreamEnabled=true,StreamViewType=NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
aws dynamodb update-table --table-name orders \
  --replica-updates '[{"Create":{"RegionName":"us-east-1"}}]'
aws route53 list-health-checks
```
Boshqa variantlar: Aurora Global Database (bitta writer, tez failover — aslida active-passive yozish), Spanner/CockroachDB (sinxron consensus, yozish latency'si yuqori).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Asinxron replikatsiya + ikki tomonlama yozish = konfliktlar va yo'qolgan yangilanishlar; unique constraint (masalan username) global darajada buziladi.
- Har region qolganining yukini ko'tara olishi kerak (N+1 sig'im) — aks holda failover kaskad yiqilish.
- Region'lararo data transfer xarajati katta.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p hollarda "partitioned active-active" eng amaliy: har tenant'ning home region'i bor, yozishlar faqat u yerda — konflikt yo'q. Failover'ni muntazam (game day) sinab ko'r; sinalmagan DR — DR emas.

40358.a:
**Qisqa javob:** DR failover routing — primary endpoint'ning health check'i yiqilganda trafikni avtomatik zaxira region/endpoint'ga yo'naltirish. Eng keng tarqalgani — DNS darajasida (Route 53 failover routing policy), shuningdek Global Accelerator yoki CDN origin failover.

**Muammo:** Primary region tushdi. Kimdir tunda uyg'onib DNS'ni qo'lda o'zgartirguncha 40 daqiqa o'tadi. Avtomatik routing RTO'ni daqiqalarga tushiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Route 53: api.acme.io
  PRIMARY   -> ALB eu-central-1  [health check: /healthz har 10s]
  SECONDARY -> ALB eu-west-1
Health check 3 marta yiqilsa -> SECONDARY javob beriladi
Klient resolver TTL (60s) tugagach yangi IP oladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws route53 create-health-check --caller-reference hc-$(date +%s) \
  --health-check-config Type=HTTPS,FullyQualifiedDomainName=api-eu.acme.io,ResourcePath=/healthz,RequestInterval=10,FailureThreshold=3
```
```hcl
resource "aws_route53_record" "primary" {
  zone_id = var.zone_id
  name    = "api.acme.io"
  type    = "A"
  set_identifier  = "primary"
  health_check_id = aws_route53_health_check.eu.id
  failover_routing_policy { type = "PRIMARY" }
  alias { name = aws_lb.eu.dns_name, zone_id = aws_lb.eu.zone_id, evaluate_target_health = true }
}
```
```bash
dig +short api.acme.io    # failover'dan keyin IP o'zgarganini tekshir
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DNS TTL va klient kesh (JVM DNS cache, eski resolver'lar) — failover sekinroq bo'ladi.
- `/healthz` faqat "process tirik"ni tekshirsa, DB yiqilganda failover bo'lmaydi; aksincha juda chuqur tekshiruv — dependency nosozligida keraksiz failover.
- Zaxira region'da ma'lumot yoki sig'im tayyor emas — trafik u yerga borib ham yiqiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Avtomatik failover'ni avtomatik failback'dan ajrat: qaytish odatda qo'lda va nazoratli bo'lsin (flapping'dan saqlanish). AWS Route 53 ARC (Application Recovery Controller) data plane'dagi routing control'lar orqali ishonchliroq, qo'lda boshqariladigan failover beradi.

40359.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pilot Light — DR strategiyasi: zaxira region'da faqat "yadro" doim ishlaydi — asosan ma'lumot (DB replikatsiyasi, S3 replikatsiya) va minimal infra; compute (app serverlar) o'chirilgan yoki 0 ga tushirilgan, faqat avariyada IaC orqali ko'tariladi. RTO o'nlab daqiqa - soatlar, RPO daqiqalar, xarajat past.

**Muammo:** Biznes bir necha soatlik uzilishga chiday oladi, lekin ma'lumot yo'qolishiga emas. Ikkinchi region'da to'liq nusxani ushlab turish ikki baravar xarajat.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Primary (eu-central-1)          DR (eu-west-1)
 App x 20  ----------------->   App x 0 (AMI/image tayyor)
 Aurora writer ==replika==>     Aurora Global secondary (doim)
 S3 ======== CRR =========>     S3 replika
Avariya:
 1. DB promote (secondary -> writer)
 2. terraform apply -var dr_active=true  (ASG/EKS scale)
 3. DNS failover
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws rds failover-global-cluster --global-cluster-identifier orders-global \
  --target-db-cluster-identifier arn:aws:rds:eu-west-1:123:cluster:orders-dr --allow-data-loss
terraform -chdir=envs/dr apply -var app_desired_count=20
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z1 --change-batch file://dr.json
```
AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) server darajasida shunga o'xshash model beradi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Avariya paytida DR region'da instance sig'imi yoki service quota yetmasligi — kvotalarni oldindan oshir.
- Runbook va IaC eskiradi — sinalmagan pilot light avariyada ishlamaydi.
- Secret'lar, sertifikatlar, AMI/image'lar DR region'ga ko'chirilmagan.

**Senior nuqta:** Strategiyani RTO/RPO va narx bo'yicha tanla: backup & restore (soatlar) -> pilot light -> warm standby -> active-active (eng qimmat). Pilot light'ni chorakda bir marta to'liq failover mashqi bilan sina va haqiqiy RTO'ni o'lcha.

40360.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Warm Standby — DR strategiyasi: zaxira region'da prod'ning kichraytirilgan, lekin **to'liq ishlaydigan** nusxasi doim ishlab turadi (barcha servislar, kam replika). Avariyada trafik o'tkaziladi va sig'im scale up qilinadi. RTO daqiqalar, RPO soniyalar-daqiqalar; Pilot Light'dan qimmat, active-active'dan arzon.

**Muammo:** Pilot Light'da compute'ni noldan ko'tarish 30-60 daqiqa va ko'p xato nuqtasi. Biznes RTO talabi 15 daqiqa.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Primary (100%)                  Standby (10-20% sig'im)
 EKS 30 node, App x 30           EKS 3 node, App x 3  (ishlayapti)
 Aurora writer   ==replika==>    Aurora reader
Avariya:
 DB promote -> HPA/Karpenter scale -> DNS/GA trafik o'tkazish
Standby doim tirik -> sintetik testlar bilan tekshiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Standby doimiy tekshiruv (canary)
curl -fsS https://api-dr.acme.io/healthz
# Failover
aws rds failover-global-cluster --global-cluster-identifier orders-global \
  --target-db-cluster-identifier <dr-cluster-arn>
kubectl --context dr scale deploy/api --replicas=30
aws globalaccelerator update-endpoint-group --endpoint-group-arn <dr-eg> --traffic-dial-percentage 100
```

| Strategiya | RTO | RPO | Xarajat |
|---|---|---|---|
| Backup & Restore | soatlar | soatlar | eng past |
| Pilot Light | 10s daqiqa | daqiqalar | past |
| Warm Standby | daqiqalar | soniyalar | o'rta |
| Active-Active | ~0 | ~0 | eng yuqori |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Scale up sekin: Karpenter node + image pull + app warm-up; kvotalar va spot mavjudligi.
- Standby'ga deploy unutiladi — versiyalar farq qiladi. Bir xil GitOps pipeline ikki region'ga.
- Kichik standby kesh va connection pool'lari sovuq — birdan 100% trafik uni yiqitadi; trafikni bosqichma-bosqich o'tkaz.

**Senior nuqta:** Warm standby'ning afzalligi — u doim "tirik", shuning uchun haqiqiy trafik ulushi (masalan 5%) berib uzluksiz sinash mumkin. Bu DR ishonchliligini qog'ozdagi rejadan haqiqiy faktga aylantiradi.

40361.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cold start — serverless funksiyaga so'rov kelganda tayyor (warm) ijro muhiti bo'lmasa, provayder yangisini yaratishi kerak: microVM (Firecracker) ishga tushirish, kod paketini yuklash, runtime'ni init qilish va handler'dan tashqaridagi init kodini bajarish. Bu birinchi so'rovga 100 ms dan bir necha soniyagacha kechikish qo'shadi.

**Muammo:** API Lambda'da: p50 40 ms, lekin p99 2.5 s — Java + Spring init. Trafik sakrashida yuzlab yangi muhit bir vaqtda cold start oladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
so'rov -> warm muhit bormi?
   ha  -> handler (tez)
   yo'q -> COLD:
     1. microVM yaratish
     2. kod/image yuklash (paket hajmiga bog'liq)
     3. runtime init (JVM, Node, Python)
     4. init kod (SDK client, DB ulanish, config)  <- sening kodlaring
     5. handler
 Muhit bir necha daqiqa idle'dan keyin o'chiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# CloudWatch Logs Insights: cold start'lar
fields @timestamp, @initDuration, @duration
| filter @type = "REPORT" and ispresent(@initDuration)
| stats count(), avg(@initDuration), max(@initDuration) by bin(1h)
```
```go
// Init'ni handler'dan tashqarida, bir marta
var client = dynamodb.NewFromConfig(mustLoadConfig())
func handler(ctx context.Context, e events.APIGatewayProxyRequest) (events.APIGatewayProxyResponse, error) { ... }
```
Kamaytirish: kichik paket, Go/Rust yoki tez runtime, arm64, lazy import, Provisioned Concurrency, SnapStart.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- VPC'dagi Lambda — 2019'dan keyin Hyperplane ENI bilan katta muammo emas; eski maslahatlarga ishonma.
- "Warmer" ping'lar (har 5 daqiqa) — faqat bitta muhitni iliq tutadi, parallel trafikda foyda yo'q.
- Init'da tarmoq so'rovlari (secret o'qish) cold start'ni uzaytiradi va init timeout (10 s) ga olib kelishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Cold start'ni p99 latency SLO bilan baholash kerak, o'rtacha bilan emas. Latency-kritik sinxron yo'lda Provisioned Concurrency (pullik) yoki container/K8s; async/event yuklarda cold start deyarli ahamiyatsiz.

40362.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Lambda SnapStart — funksiya versiyasi publish qilinganda Lambda init bosqichini bir marta bajaradi, init qilingan microVM xotira va disk holatining shifrlangan Firecracker snapshot'ini cache'laydi; keyingi cold start'larda noldan init o'rniga snapshot'dan tiklanadi. Java uchun boshlangan (2022), 2024-dan Python va .NET ham qo'llaydi.

**Muammo:** Java + Spring Boot Lambda cold start 4-8 s: JVM yuklash, class loading, DI konteyner. Provisioned Concurrency doimiy to'lovni talab qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
publish version:
  init (JVM + Spring) -> beforeCheckpoint hook -> snapshot (shifrlangan, cache)
invoke (cold):
  snapshot'dan restore -> afterRestore hook -> handler
  4-8 s  -->  ~200-600 ms
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name orders \
  --snap-start ApplyOn=PublishedVersions
aws lambda publish-version --function-name orders
# Alias faqat versiyaga ishora qilsin ($LATEST'da SnapStart ishlamaydi)
```
```java
// CRaC hook'lari: snapshot'dan keyin ulanishlarni qayta yarat
public class Hooks implements org.crac.Resource {
  public void beforeCheckpoint(Context<? extends Resource> c) { pool.close(); }
  public void afterRestore(Context<? extends Resource> c)    { pool = newPool(); }
}
```
Log'da `Restore Duration` maydoni ko'rinadi (`Init Duration` o'rniga).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- **Noyoblik:** init'da yaratilgan random seed, UUID, vaqt yoki kriptografik kalit barcha restore'lar uchun bir xil bo'ladi — `afterRestore` da qayta generatsiya qil.
- Init'da ochilgan tarmoq ulanishlari snapshot'dan keyin o'lik — qayta ulanish kerak.
- Provisioned Concurrency, EFS va katta ephemeral storage bilan cheklovlar bor; Python/.NET uchun snapshot keshlash va restore pullik.

**Senior nuqta:** SnapStart — "init natijasini qayta ishlatish" g'oyasi: u xavfsiz bo'lishi uchun init kod deterministik va unikal holatdan xoli bo'lishi kerak. Yoqishdan oldin kodni aynan shu nuqtai nazardan review qil.

40363.a:
**Qisqa javob:** API Gateway — client'lar va backend servislar orasidagi application-layer (L7) reverse proxy: yagona kirish nuqtasi bo'lib, routing, autentifikatsiya (JWT/OAuth), rate limiting, request validatsiya, TLS, CORS, log/metrika va ba'zan javob transformatsiyasini markazlashtiradi. Misollar: AWS API Gateway, Kong, Apigee, Envoy Gateway, Tyk.

**Muammo:** 30 ta mikroservis, har biri auth, rate limit, CORS, logging'ni o'zicha qiladi — turlicha va xatolar bilan. Mobil client 30 ta turli host'ni bilishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Client --> API Gateway
             | 1. TLS termination
             | 2. AuthN: JWT imzo/exp tekshirish
             | 3. Rate limit (API key / user bo'yicha)
             | 4. Validatsiya (OpenAPI schema)
             | 5. Routing: /orders -> orders-svc, /users -> users-svc
             | 6. Log, metrika, trace header
             v
         Backend servislar
```

**Amalda (Kong declarative):**
```yaml
_format_version: "3.0"
services:
  - name: orders
    url: http://orders.svc:8080
    routes: [{ name: orders, paths: [/v1/orders] }]
    plugins:
      - name: jwt
      - name: rate-limiting
        config: { minute: 600, policy: redis, redis_host: redis }
```
```bash
curl -i https://api.acme.io/v1/orders -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# 429 Too Many Requests  + RateLimit-Remaining: 0
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Gateway'ga biznes mantiqini qo'yish — u "smart pipe" monolitiga aylanadi.
- SPOF va bottleneck: HA, autoscaling va timeout'lar shart.
- Gateway'da auth bor deb backend'da avtorizatsiyani tashlab ketish — ichki trafik gateway'ni aylanib o'tishi mumkin (BOLA xavfi).

**Senior nuqta:** Gateway — cross-cutting concern'lar uchun (north-south trafik); servislararo (east-west) uchun service mesh. BFF (Backend for Frontend) pattern'i turli client'lar uchun alohida yupqa gateway beradi — umumiy "hamma uchun bitta" gateway'dan ko'ra soddaroq evolyutsiya qiladi.

40364.a:
**Qisqa javob:** REST — resurslar va HTTP metodlari asosidagi arxitektura uslubi, odatda HTTP/1.1 yoki HTTP/2 ustida JSON. gRPC — Google'ning RPC framework'i: HTTP/2 ustida binary Protobuf, `.proto` fayldagi qat'iy contract'dan kod generatsiyasi, multiplexing va 4 xil streaming (unary, server, client, bidirectional). gRPC ichki servislararo aloqada tez; REST ommaviy API va brauzer uchun qulay.

**Muammo:** Ichki servislar sekundiga 50k so'rov almashadi: JSON parse CPU'ni yeydi, contract faqat hujjatda, versiyalar mos kelmay runtime xatolar chiqadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
REST:  GET /orders/42  Accept: application/json
       <- 200 {"id":42,"status":"paid"}      (matn, o'qiladi)

gRPC:  orders.v1.OrderService/GetOrder  (HTTP/2 POST)
       <- protobuf binary (kichik, tez parse)
       .proto -> protoc -> Go/Java/Python client+server stub
```

| | REST | gRPC |
|---|---|---|
| Format | JSON (matn) | Protobuf (binary) |
| Contract | OpenAPI (ixtiyoriy) | .proto (majburiy) |
| Streaming | SSE/WebSocket alohida | nativ, ikki tomonlama |
| Brauzer | to'liq | gRPC-Web/Connect proxy kerak |
| Debug | curl | grpcurl |
| Cache | HTTP cache | yo'q |

**Amalda:**
```protobuf
syntax = "proto3";
package orders.v1;
service OrderService { rpc GetOrder(GetOrderRequest) returns (Order); }
message GetOrderRequest { int64 id = 1; }
message Order { int64 id = 1; string status = 2; }
```
```bash
grpcurl -plaintext localhost:9090 list
grpcurl -plaintext -d '{"id":42}' localhost:9090 orders.v1.OrderService/GetOrder
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- gRPC HTTP/2 uzun ulanishlari L4 load balancer'da bitta pod'ga yopishib qoladi — L7 LB (Envoy, mesh) yoki client-side balancing kerak.
- Protobuf maydon raqamini qayta ishlatish yoki o'zgartirish — backward compatibility buziladi (`reserved` ishlat, `buf breaking` bilan CI'da tekshir).
- Deadline qo'ymaslik — gRPC'da default timeout yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p tashkilotlar gibrid: tashqarida REST/JSON, ichkarida gRPC. Connect protokoli bir server'dan gRPC, gRPC-Web va JSON-over-HTTP berib, bu tanlovni yumshatadi.

40365.a:
**Qisqa javob:** REST'da server qat'iy endpoint'lar va javob shakllarini belgilaydi; GraphQL'da bitta endpoint va tiplangan schema bor, client aynan qaysi maydonlar kerakligini so'rovda o'zi tanlaydi — over-fetching (ortiqcha ma'lumot) va under-fetching (ko'p so'rov) yo'qoladi. Narxi: HTTP caching qiyin, N+1 muammo, so'rov murakkabligini cheklash va avtorizatsiya maydon darajasida.

**Muammo:** Mobil ekran uchun foydalanuvchi, uning 5 ta buyurtmasi va har buyurtma mahsulot nomi kerak: REST'da 7 ta so'rov yoki maxsus endpoint; har endpoint 40 maydon qaytaradi, 5 tasi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
POST /graphql
query { user(id: 1) { name orders(last: 5) { id product { title } } } }
     |
 resolver'lar: user -> orders -> product (har buyurtma uchun!)
     |                          ^ N+1: DataLoader bilan batch
 javob: aynan so'ralgan shakl
```

**Amalda:**
```graphql
type Query { user(id: ID!): User }
type User  { id: ID!  name: String!  orders(last: Int = 10): [Order!]! }
type Order { id: ID!  product: Product! }
```
```js
// DataLoader: bitta tick'dagi barcha product so'rovlarini bitta SQL'ga
const productLoader = new DataLoader(ids =>
  db.query('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ANY($1)', [ids]).then(rows => ids.map(id => rows.find(r => r.id === id))));
```
Himoya: query depth/complexity limit, persisted queries (faqat ruxsat etilgan so'rovlar), introspection'ni prod'da cheklash.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hamma narsa `POST /graphql` va 200 status — CDN cache va standart monitoring (status code bo'yicha) ishlamaydi; xatolar `errors` maydonida.
- Chuqur ichma-ich so'rov — DoS vektori.
- Avtorizatsiya faqat endpoint darajasida — maydon/obyekt darajasida tekshirilmasa ma'lumot sizadi.

**Senior nuqta:** GraphQL ko'p client (web, iOS, Android) turli ma'lumot shakllariga muhtoj bo'lganda va frontend jamoalari mustaqil harakat qilishi kerak bo'lganda o'zini oqlaydi; oddiy CRUD yoki servislararo aloqa uchun REST/gRPC soddaroq. Federation (Apollo) ko'p jamoali katta schema uchun.

40366.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Webhook HMAC tekshiruvi — jo'natuvchi (masalan Stripe, GitHub) request body'dan umumiy secret bilan HMAC-SHA256 hisoblab header'ga qo'yadi; qabul qiluvchi xuddi shu xom body'dan qayta hisoblab, **constant-time** solishtiradi. Bu so'rov haqiqiy jo'natuvchidan va o'zgartirilmaganini isbotlaydi; timestamp esa replay hujumdan himoya qiladi.

**Muammo:** Webhook endpoint ommaviy URL. Hujumchi `POST /webhooks/payment {"status":"paid"}` yuborib, to'lanmagan buyurtmani "to'langan" qilishi mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Jo'natuvchi:
  sig = HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + raw_body)
  header: X-Signature: t=1696300000,v1=5f2b...
Qabul qiluvchi:
  1. timestamp |now - t| < 5 min?   (replay)
  2. expected = HMAC(secret, t + "." + raw_body)
  3. constant_time_equal(expected, v1)?
  4. event_id avval ko'rilganmi? (idempotency)
```

**Amalda (Go):**
```go
func verify(r *http.Request, secret []byte) ([]byte, error) {
    body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 1<<20))  // XOM body
    if err != nil { return nil, err }
    t, sig := parseHeader(r.Header.Get("X-Signature"))
    ts, _ := strconv.ParseInt(t, 10, 64)
    if d := time.Since(time.Unix(ts, 0)); d > 5*time.Minute || d < -5*time.Minute {
        return nil, errors.New("eskirgan timestamp")
    }
    mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, secret)
    mac.Write([]byte(t + "."))
    mac.Write(body)
    want := mac.Sum(nil)
    got, err := hex.DecodeString(sig)
    if err != nil || !hmac.Equal(want, got) { return nil, errors.New("imzo noto'g'ri") }
    return body, nil
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- JSON'ni parse qilib qayta serialize qilgandan keyin HMAC hisoblash — bo'shliq/tartib o'zgaradi, imzo mos kelmaydi. Doim xom bayt.
- `==` yoki `bytes.Equal` bilan solishtirish — timing attack; `hmac.Equal` ishlat.
- Secret rotatsiyasi: o'tish davrida ikki secret'ni ham qabul qil.

**Senior nuqta:** Imzo tekshiruvidan keyin ham webhook'ni "trigger" deb qabul qil: kritik amallarda provayder API'sidan holatni qayta so'ra va event_id bo'yicha idempotent qayta ishla — webhook'lar takrorlanadi va tartibsiz keladi.

40367.a:
**Qisqa javob:** JWT (JSON Web Token) — nuqta bilan ajratilgan uch base64url qism: `header.payload.signature`. **Header** — algoritm (`alg`, `kid`), **Payload** — claim'lar (`sub`, `iss`, `aud`, `exp`, `iat`, rollar), **Signature** — header+payload ustidan imzo (HS256 umumiy secret yoki RS256/ES256 asimmetrik kalit). Payload shifrlanmagan — har kim o'qiy oladi, faqat o'zgartira olmaydi.

**Muammo:** Har so'rovda session'ni markaziy DB'dan tekshirish mikroservislarda bottleneck. JWT o'zida ma'lumot va imzo saqlaydi — servis uni lokal tekshiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImsxIn0 . eyJzdWIiOiI0MiIsImV4cCI6MTcwMH0 . SflKx...
   header {alg:RS256,kid:k1}            payload {sub:42,exp:1700...}     imzo
Tekshirish:
 1. kid -> JWKS'dan public key (cache)
 2. alg kutilganmi (whitelist)?
 3. imzo to'g'rimi?
 4. exp/nbf, iss, aud tekshir
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
echo "$TOKEN" | cut -d. -f2 | tr '_-' '/+' | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | jq
# {"sub":"42","iss":"https://auth.acme.io","aud":"orders","exp":1700003600}
```
```go
tok, err := jwt.Parse(raw, keyfunc.Keyfunc, // JWKS'dan
    jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{"RS256"}),
    jwt.WithIssuer("https://auth.acme.io"),
    jwt.WithAudience("orders"),
    jwt.WithExpirationRequired())
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `alg: none` yoki RS256 -> HS256 almashtirish hujumi — algoritmni whitelist qil.
- Payload'ga maxfiy ma'lumot (parol, PII) qo'yish — u ochiq.
- Uzoq `exp` va revoke imkoni yo'q — o'g'irlangan token kunlab ishlaydi. Qisqa access token (5-15 min) + refresh token rotatsiyasi.
- `aud` tekshirilmasa, boshqa servis uchun berilgan token sening servisingda ham ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** JWT — stateless, shuning uchun revocation qiyin; bu trade-off'ni ongli tanla. Brauzerda token'ni `localStorage`ga emas, HttpOnly cookie'ga qo'yish XSS ta'sirini kamaytiradi.

40368.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OAuth 2.0 — **avtorizatsiya** (delegatsiya) framework'i: foydalanuvchi parolini bermasdan, uchinchi tomon ilovasiga uning nomidan API'ga cheklangan kirish (access token, scope) beradi. OpenID Connect (OIDC) — OAuth 2.0 ustidagi **autentifikatsiya** qatlami: qo'shimcha ravishda **ID token** (JWT) beradi, unda "foydalanuvchi kim" (`sub`, `email`, `iss`, `aud`) aniq yozilgan.

**Muammo:** OAuth access token'ni "login" uchun ishlatish xavfli: access token API uchun, kim uchun berilganini standart tarzda aytmaydi — token substitution hujumlari bo'lgan. OIDC bu bo'shliqni yopadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (Authorization Code + PKCE):**
```
App --> /authorize?response_type=code&scope=openid profile orders:read
          &code_challenge=...   --> IdP (login + MFA + consent)
App <-- redirect ?code=abc
App --> /token (code + code_verifier) -->
App <-- access_token (API uchun)
        id_token     (OIDC: kim kirdi - faqat app uchun)
        refresh_token
App --> API: Authorization: Bearer access_token
```

| | OAuth 2.0 | OIDC |
|---|---|---|
| Maqsad | ruxsat (nimaga kira oladi) | identity (kim) |
| Token | access token | + ID token (JWT) |
| Scope | ixtiyoriy | `openid` majburiy |
| Qo'shimcha | - | `/userinfo`, discovery (`/.well-known/openid-configuration`) |

**Amalda:**
