```yaml
          ssh: { host: 10.0.1.15, credentialsId: agent-ssh }
```
Diagnostika: Manage Jenkins -> Nodes (online/offline, disk, clock), `/computer/linux-1/log`.

**Nega controller'da build yo'q:**
- Build kodi controller fayl tizimiga (credential'lar, `secrets/`, konfiguratsiya) kira oladi — xavfsizlik.
- Og'ir build controller'ni sekinlashtiradi — butun UI va scheduler ta'sirlanadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Controller yagona nuqta (SPOF) — HA yo'q (open source'da), `JENKINS_HOME` backup shart.
- Agent'lar doimiy va iflos — oldingi build qoldiqlari; ephemeral agent'lar afzal.
- Agent va controller Java versiyalari mos kelmasligi.

**Senior nuqta:** Controller'ni kichik va barqaror ushla (kam plugin, JCasC), hamma ishni ephemeral agent'larga ber. Juda katta Jenkins'ni bitta ulkan controller o'rniga bir nechta jamoa controller'lariga bo'lish ko'pincha osonroq.

40635.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Agent buzilgan deb faraz qilib himoya qil: Agent -> Controller security (agent controller'da fayl o'qish/yozish va buyruq bajarishni cheklash) yoqiq bo'lsin (Jenkins 2.326+ da doim yoqiq), remoting orqali CLI o'chirilsin, agent'lar ephemeral va izolyatsiyalangan bo'lsin, controller'da build ishlamasin, credential'lar minimal scope bilan.

**Muammo:** Agent'da ishonchsiz kod ishlaydi (PR'lar, dependency skriptlari). Agar agent controller'ga erkin murojaat qila olsa — `JENKINS_HOME/secrets/` dan barcha credential'larni o'g'irlash yoki controller'da kod bajarish mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
build kodi (ishonchsiz) -> agent jarayoni
   | remoting kanali
   v
controller: Agent->Controller filtr: ruxsat etilmagan callable/fayl kirishi -> rad
agent ko'radigan narsa: faqat o'z workspace'i va berilgan credential'lar
```

**Amalda (choralar ro'yxati):**
```yaml
jenkins:
  numExecutors: 0                      # controller'da build yo'q
  remotingSecurity:
    enabled: true                      # agent -> controller himoyasi
  slaveAgentPort: -1                   # TCP inbound port o'chiq, WebSocket ishlat
security:
  globalJobDslSecurityConfiguration:
    useScriptSecurity: true
```
- Agent'lar: Kubernetes pod (ephemeral), alohida namespace, NetworkPolicy (faqat controller va kerakli manzillar), `privileged: false`, `runAsNonRoot`.
- Credential'lar: folder darajasida, faqat kerakli job'lar ko'radi; prod credential'lari alohida agent pool'da.
- Ishonch zonalari: PR build'lari alohida agent'larda, prod deploy agent'lariga ulanmaydi.
- Plugin'larni yangilab turish — Jenkins security advisory'lari.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bir agent'da ham PR build, ham prod deploy — PR kodi prod credential'larini oladi.
- Script approval'da "hammasini approve" — sandbox chetlab o'tiladi.
- Eski JNLP agent port ochiq va internetga ko'rinadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Jenkins xavfsizligi — ishonch zonalarini ajratish: kim kod yozadi, qayerda ishlaydi, qaysi credential'ni ko'radi. Controller'ni internetdan yashirib, SSO va RBAC bilan himoyala.

40636.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `step-security/harden-runner` — GitHub Actions runner uchun EDR-ga o'xshash agent: job'ning tarmoq chiqishlarini (egress), DNS so'rovlarini, jarayonlar va fayl o'zgarishlarini kuzatadi; `audit` rejimida xulqni yozadi, `block` rejimida ruxsat etilmagan domenlarga chiqishni bloklaydi. Supply-chain hujumlarini (secret exfiltration) aniqlash uchun.

**Muammo:** 2025-yil `tj-actions/changed-files` hodisasi: mashhur action buzilib, CI log'lariga secret'larni chiqardi. Harden-Runner aynan shunday g'ayritabiiy tarmoq chaqiruvini aniqlab bergan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
job boshida harden-runner agent ishga tushadi
   step'lar -> outbound ulanishlar -> agent kuzatadi
   audit: hammasi yoziladi -> insights sahifasi (qaysi step qaysi domenga)
   block: allowed-endpoints ro'yxatida yo'q -> bloklanadi + alert
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: step-security/harden-runner@v2   # amalda commit SHA bilan pin qil
        with:
          egress-policy: block
          allowed-endpoints: >
            github.com:443
            api.github.com:443
            proxy.golang.org:443
            sum.golang.org:443
            ghcr.io:443
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: go build ./...
```
Jarayon: avval `egress-policy: audit` bilan bir necha run -> insights'dan kerakli domenlar ro'yxati -> `block` ga o'tish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Darhol `block` — build'lar sababsiz yiqiladi; avval audit.
- Faqat GitHub-hosted Linux runner va ba'zi self-hosted sozlamalarda to'liq ishlaydi.
- Ruxsat ro'yxatiga `*.amazonaws.com` kabi keng domenlar — hujumchi ham o'sha cloud'dan foydalanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Harden-Runner — qatlamlardan biri: action'larni SHA bilan pin qilish, `permissions` minimal, OIDC va Dependabot (actions ecosystem) bilan birga ishlat.

40637.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `runs.using: "composite"` — `action.yml` ichida action turini e'lon qiladi: bu action JavaScript (`node20`) yoki Docker (`docker`) emas, balki `runs.steps` ro'yxatidagi oddiy step'lardan (`run` va `uses`) iborat composite action.

**Action turlari:**
| `using` | Qanday ishlaydi | Qachon |
|---|---|---|
| `composite` | Step'lar ketma-ketligi, runner'da bevosita | Mavjud buyruq va action'larni birlashtirish |
| `node20` (yangi `node24`) | JS fayl (`main: dist/index.js`) | Murakkab mantiq, GitHub API |
| `docker` | Konteyner (`image: Dockerfile`) | Maxsus muhit; faqat Linux runner |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
uses: ./.github/actions/lint
  runner action.yml ni o'qiydi -> using: composite
  -> steps[0] run (shell: bash) -> steps[1] uses: actions/setup-python ...
  hammasi chaqiruvchi job'ning runner va workspace'ida
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# .github/actions/lint/action.yml
name: Lint
description: Python lint (ruff) ishga tushiradi
inputs:
  path: { description: tekshiriladigan papka, default: '.' }
runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with: { python-version: '3.12' }
    - run: pip install ruff==0.6.9
      shell: bash
    - run: ruff check "${{ inputs.path }}" --output-format=github
      shell: bash
    - run: echo "lint tugadi" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      shell: bash
```
Action ichidagi fayllarga yo'l: `${{ github.action_path }}/script.sh`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `run` step'da `shell:` yozilmasa — `Required property is missing: shell`.
- `${{ inputs.x }}` ni `run` ichiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'yish — injection xavfi; `env:` orqali ber.
- Composite ichida `if:` va `continue-on-error` qo'llab-quvvatlanadi, lekin `timeout-minutes` step darajasida cheklangan.

**Senior nuqta:** Oddiy birlashtirish uchun composite, tashqi API va murakkab mantiq uchun JS action. Node 20 runtime ham eskirish jadvalida — JS action'larni yangilab tur.

40638.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `include` — GitLab CI'da tashqi YAML fayllarni pipeline'ga qo'shish: `local` (shu repo'dagi fayl), `project` + `file` (boshqa GitLab loyihasidan, `ref` bilan), `remote` (URL), `template` (GitLab tayyor shablonlari), `component` (CI/CD Catalog komponentlari). Pipeline'ni modullashtirish va markaziy shablonlarni qayta ishlatish uchun.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
.gitlab-ci.yml
  include:
    - local: ci/test.yml
    - project: acme/ci-templates, ref: v3.1.0, file: go.yml
    - component: gitlab.com/acme/components/sast@2.0.0
  -> barcha fayllar birlashtiriladi (merged YAML)
  -> lokal ta'riflar include qilinganlarni ustidan yozadi (deep merge)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
include:
  - local: 'ci/lint.yml'
  - project: 'acme/ci-templates'
    ref: 'v3.1.0'                 # tag bilan pin
    file: ['/templates/go.yml', '/templates/docker.yml']
  - template: 'Jobs/Secret-Detection.gitlab-ci.yml'
  - component: '$CI_SERVER_FQDN/acme/components/deploy@1.4.0'
    inputs:
      environment: production

# shablondagi job'ni moslashtirish
go-test:
  variables:
    GO_VERSION: "1.23"
```
Shablonda `extends` va `!reference` bilan qayta ishlatish:
```yaml
.go-base:
  image: golang:$GO_VERSION
deploy:
  extends: .go-base
  script:
    - !reference [.setup, script]
    - ./deploy.sh
```
Natijani ko'rish: Pipeline editor -> "Full configuration" tab.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ref` siz `project` include — default branch; shablon o'zgarsa hamma loyiha buziladi.
- `remote` include — tashqi URL'dan kod bajarish (supply-chain xavfi), ishonchli manba bilan cheklang.
- Merge qoidalari: ro'yxatlar (`script`) birlashtirilmaydi, butunlay almashtiriladi — kutilmagan natija.
- Ichma-ich include chuqurligi va soni cheklangan.

**Senior nuqta:** Zamonaviy usul — CI/CD Components: versiyalangan, typed `inputs` bilan, katalogda ko'rinadigan. Platforma jamoasi uchun bu ichki "kutubxona" — SemVer va changelog bilan boshqar.

40639.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `runner.temp` — har job uchun vaqtinchalik papka, job boshida bo'sh va tugagach tozalanadi (oraliq fayllar, kalit fayllari uchun). `runner.workspace` — workspace'ning ota papkasi (`/home/runner/work/<repo>`); repo odatda `github.workspace` ga (`/home/runner/work/<repo>/<repo>`) checkout qilinadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (GitHub-hosted Linux):**
```
/home/runner/work/
  _temp/                 <- runner.temp  (RUNNER_TEMP), job'dan keyin tozalanadi
  api/                   <- runner.workspace
    api/                 <- github.workspace (GITHUB_WORKSPACE), checkout shu yerga
/opt/hostedtoolcache     <- runner.tool_cache (setup-* action'lar)
```
| O'zgaruvchi | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `runner.temp` / `$RUNNER_TEMP` | Vaqtinchalik fayllar |
| `github.workspace` / `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE` | Repo checkout joyi, step'lar default working dir |
| `runner.workspace` | Workspace ota papkasi |
| `runner.tool_cache` | O'rnatilgan tool'lar cache'i |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4
  - name: Kubeconfig'ni vaqtinchalik faylga yozish
    run: |
      echo "$KUBECONFIG_B64" | base64 -d > "$RUNNER_TEMP/kubeconfig"
      chmod 600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/kubeconfig"
      echo "KUBECONFIG=$RUNNER_TEMP/kubeconfig" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
    env: { KUBECONFIG_B64: '${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_B64 }}' }
  - run: kubectl get ns
  - run: |
      echo "temp=$RUNNER_TEMP workspace=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
      ls "${{ runner.workspace }}"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret fayllarni `github.workspace` ga yozish — keyingi `upload-artifact path: .` bilan artifact'ga tushib qoladi. `runner.temp` ishlat.
- Self-hosted (persistent) runner'da workspace job'lar orasida saqlanadi — oldingi build qoldiqlari. `runner.temp` tozalanadi, workspace esa yo'q.
- Yo'llarni hardcode qilish (`/home/runner/...`) — Windows/macOS va self-hosted'da buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Yo'llarni doim kontekst o'zgaruvchilaridan ol. Ephemeral runner bo'lmasa, job oxirida workspace tozalash (`if: always()`) qadamini qo'sh.

40640.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Docker-in-Docker (dind) `privileged: true` talab qiladi — konteyner host kernel'iga deyarli to'liq kirish oladi, ya'ni CI job'i runner host'ni egallashi mumkin. Xavfsizlashtirish: imkon qadar dind'dan voz kechib daemon'siz/rootless build tool'lariga o'tish (BuildKit rootless, Buildah, Podman); dind majbur bo'lsa — TLS yoqish, alohida ephemeral runner, ishonchli loyihalar bilan cheklash.

**Variantlar solishtirmasi:**
| Usul | Privileged | Xavf | Izoh |
|---|---|---|---|
| dind + TLS | Ha | Yuqori | Izolyatsiyalangan runner'da |
| Docker socket mount (`/var/run/docker.sock`) | Yo'q, lekin | Juda yuqori | Host daemon'ga to'liq root |
| BuildKit rootless | Yo'q (seccomp/apparmor sozlash) | Past | Tavsiya |
| Buildah / Podman | Yo'q | Past | OCI, daemon'siz |
| Kaniko | Yo'q | Past | 2025 da arxivlangan |

**Qanday ishlaydi (dind):**
```
job konteyner (docker CLI) --TLS:2376--> service konteyner docker:dind (privileged)
                                             |
                                       host kernel
```

**Amalda (dind majbur bo'lsa):**
```yaml
build:
  image: docker:27
  services:
    - name: docker:27-dind
  variables:
    DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2376
    DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: "/certs"
    DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: 1
    DOCKER_CERT_PATH: "/certs/client"
  tags: [ isolated-dind ]           # faqat shu maqsaddagi runner
  script:
    - docker build -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA .
```
Afzal variant (BuildKit rootless):
```yaml
build:
  image: moby/buildkit:rootless
  variables:
    BUILDKITD_FLAGS: --oci-worker-no-process-sandbox
  script:
    - buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0
        --local context=. --local dockerfile=.
        --output type=image,name=$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA,push=true
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: ""` (TLS o'chiq) — tarmoqdagi boshqa konteynerlar daemon'ga 2375 orqali ulanadi.
- Umumiy (shared) runner'da privileged — bir loyiha boshqa loyiha job'lariga kira oladi.
- Socket mount'ni "privileged emas, demak xavfsiz" deb o'ylash.

**Senior nuqta:** CI runner'ni ishonchsiz kod bajaradigan joy deb qara. Image build'ni rootless tool'ga o'tkazish ko'pincha bir kunlik ish, lekin butun bir hujum sinfini yo'q qiladi.

40641.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kaniko — Google'ning ochiq kodli tool'i: Dockerfile'dan container image'ni Docker daemon'siz va privileged rejimsiz, oddiy konteyner (masalan Kubernetes pod) ichida build qiladi. **Muhim:** Google 2025-yilda loyihani arxivladi (yangi rivojlanish va xavfsizlik tuzatishlari yo'q); yangi loyihalar uchun BuildKit (rootless) yoki Buildah tavsiya etiladi (Chainguard fork'ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi).

**Nega afzal edi:** Kubernetes'da Docker daemon yo'q (containerd), dind esa privileged talab qiladi. Kaniko Dockerfile buyruqlarini userspace'da bajarib, fayl tizimi snapshot'laridan layer yasaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kaniko executor (konteyner ichida)
  1. base image'ni yuklab, o'z root fayl tizimiga ochadi
  2. har RUN/COPY -> buyruqni bevosita bajaradi
  3. fayl tizimi snapshot -> o'zgargan fayllar = yangi layer
  4. image'ni registry'ga push
(daemon yo'q, privileged yo'q, lekin konteyner ichida root)
```

**Amalda (GitLab):**
```yaml
build:
  image:
    name: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:debug
    entrypoint: [""]
  script:
    - /kaniko/executor
        --context "$CI_PROJECT_DIR"
        --dockerfile "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/Dockerfile"
        --destination "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
        --cache=true --cache-repo "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE/cache"
```
Registry auth: `/kaniko/.docker/config.json`.

**Alternativalar (2025-2026):**
| Tool | Holat |
|---|---|
| BuildKit rootless (`buildctl`) | Faol, tez, keng qo'llab-quvvatlangan |
| Buildah | Faol, Red Hat |
| Kaniko (Chainguard fork) | Fork orqali qo'llab-quvvatlanadi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kaniko konteynerni root sifatida ishlatadi — "rootless" emas, faqat "privileged'siz".
- Multi-stage va katta build'larda sekin (snapshot'lash).
- Arxivlangan tool — yangi CVE'lar tuzatilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Tool tanlashda loyiha holati (maintenance, xavfsizlik tuzatishlari) funksiya kabi muhim. Kaniko'dan BuildKit'ga ko'chish odatda bir necha qator o'zgarish.

40642.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Buildah — Red Hat (containers loyihasi) yaratgan CLI tool: OCI va Docker formatidagi image'larni daemon'siz va root'siz (rootless) build qiladi. Dockerfile/Containerfile'dan (`buildah build`) yoki skript orqali qadam-baqadam (`from`, `run`, `copy`, `commit`) image yasaydi. Podman ichida ham shu kutubxona ishlatiladi.

**Nega kerak:** Docker daemon root huquqida doimiy ishlaydi — hujum yuzasi. Buildah har buyruq uchun oddiy jarayon, user namespace orqali rootless — CI va Kubernetes'da xavfsizroq.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
buildah (oddiy foydalanuvchi)
  -> user namespace (uid 0 konteyner ichida = uid 100000 host'da)
  -> storage driver (overlay/fuse-overlayfs, vfs)
  -> layer'lar -> OCI image -> push
daemon yo'q: jarayon tugadi = hammasi tugadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Dockerfile bilan
buildah build -t ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2 -f Containerfile .
buildah push ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2

# skript bilan (Dockerfile'siz)
ctr=$(buildah from gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12)
buildah copy $ctr ./bin/api /api
buildah config --entrypoint '["/api"]' --user 65532 $ctr
buildah commit $ctr ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2
```
GitLab/Kubernetes'da:
```yaml
build:
  image: quay.io/buildah/stable
  variables:
    STORAGE_DRIVER: vfs
    BUILDAH_ISOLATION: chroot
  script:
    - buildah login -u "$CI_REGISTRY_USER" -p "$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD" "$CI_REGISTRY"
    - buildah build -t "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA" .
    - buildah push "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Rootless konteyner ichida user namespace ruxsat etilmagan — `BUILDAH_ISOLATION=chroot` va `vfs` (sekinroq) kerak bo'ladi.
- `vfs` storage — har layer to'liq nusxa, disk va vaqt ko'p.
- Docker'ga xos Dockerfile kengaytmalari (ba'zi BuildKit `--mount` sintaksislari) to'liq mos kelmasligi mumkin.
- `buildah login -p` — parol `ps` da; `--password-stdin` ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Buildah + Podman + Skopeo — Red Hat/OpenShift ekotizimida standart; BuildKit esa Docker ekotizimida. Tanlov jamoa ekotizimiga bog'liq — ikkalasi ham daemon'siz va rootless.

40643.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `GITHUB_TOKEN` — har workflow job'i uchun GitHub avtomatik yaratadigan installation access token (GitHub App token). Faqat shu repo'ga ta'sir qiladi, huquqlari `permissions:` bloki bilan cheklanadi va job tugashi bilan (maksimal 24 soat) bekor bo'ladi. Secret yaratish shart emas: `${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` yoki `${{ github.token }}`.

**Nega kerak:** Workflow repo'ga komment yozishi, release yaratishi, package push qilishi, PR label qo'yishi kerak. Shaxsiy PAT ishlatish — uzoq muddatli, odamga bog'liq, keng huquqli. `GITHUB_TOKEN` qisqa muddatli va avtomatik.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
job boshlandi -> GitHub App token (repo scope, permissions bo'yicha)
   -> steps: gh CLI, actions/checkout, API chaqiruvlar
job tugadi -> token yaroqsiz
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  comment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write          # job darajasida kengaytirish
    steps:
      - run: gh pr comment "$PR" --body "Build OK"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
```

**Muhim xususiyatlar:**
| Xususiyat | Tafsilot |
|---|---|
| Rekursiya himoyasi | `GITHUB_TOKEN` bilan qilingan push/PR yangi workflow'ni ishga tushirmaydi (`workflow_dispatch` va `repository_dispatch` bundan mustasno) |
| Fork PR | Faqat read huquqi, secret'larsiz |
| Default huquq | Org/repo sozlamasi: "read" (tavsiya) yoki "read and write" |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Release workflow `GITHUB_TOKEN` bilan tag push qiladi, lekin "on: push tags" workflow ishga tushmaydi — rekursiya himoyasi. GitHub App token kerak.
- Boshqa repo'ga yozish — `GITHUB_TOKEN` bilan bo'lmaydi.
- `pull_request_target` + PR kodini checkout — fork kodi write token bilan ishlaydi (klassik "pwn request").

**Senior nuqta:** Org darajasida default'ni "read" qil va har workflow'da `permissions:` ni aniq yoz. Repo'lar orasidagi ish uchun PAT emas, GitHub App token.

40644.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Workflow boshida (top-level) `permissions:` ni minimal qilib yoz (masalan `contents: read`), keyin faqat kerak bo'lgan job'da kengaytir (`id-token: write`, `packages: write`). `permissions` e'lon qilinsa, ko'rsatilmagan barcha scope'lar `none` bo'ladi. Org/repo default'ini "Read repository contents" ga o'tkaz.

**Muammo:** Eski repo'larda default `GITHUB_TOKEN` "read and write" — buzilgan third-party action kodni o'zgartira, release yarata, workflow'ni o'zgartira oladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
org default (read) 
   -> workflow permissions: { contents: read }      (qolganlari none)
      -> job build: meros oladi (contents: read)
      -> job publish: permissions: { contents: read, packages: write, id-token: write }
job darajasidagi permissions workflow darajasini to'liq almashtiradi (birlashtirmaydi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
name: release
on: { push: { tags: ['v*'] } }
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [ { uses: actions/checkout@v4 }, { run: make test } ]
  publish:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write        # GitHub Release yaratish
      packages: write        # ghcr.io push
      id-token: write        # OIDC / cosign keyless
      attestations: write    # build provenance
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make release
```
Asosiy scope'lar: `contents`, `pull-requests`, `issues`, `packages`, `id-token`, `actions`, `checks`, `deployments`, `security-events`, `attestations`. Qiymatlar: `read`, `write`, `none`.
Tekshirish: job log'ining boshida "GITHUB_TOKEN Permissions" bo'limi beriladigan huquqlarni ko'rsatadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Job darajasida faqat `id-token: write` yozish — `contents` endi `none`, `actions/checkout` private repo'da yiqiladi.
- `permissions: write-all` — qulay, lekin maqsadga zid.
- `pull_request` fork'dan — yozish huquqi baribir berilmaydi; buni chetlab o'tish uchun `pull_request_target` ishlatish xavfli.

**Senior nuqta:** Least privilege'ni avtomatik tekshir: OpenSSF Scorecard yoki `zizmor` workflow'larni keng permission, pin qilinmagan action va injection xavfi uchun skanerlaydi — CI'ga qo'sh.

40645.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `on: schedule` va POSIX cron ifodasi: `- cron: '0 2 * * *'` — har kuni 02:00 **UTC** da. Workflow faqat default branch'dagi fayl bo'yicha ishlaydi; vaqt aniq kafolatlanmaydi (yuklama paytida kechikadi yoki ba'zan tashlab ketiladi), eng kichik interval — 5 daqiqa.

**Cron formati:**
```
 +------------ daqiqa (0-59)
 | +---------- soat (0-23, UTC!)
 | | +-------- oy kuni (1-31)
 | | | +------ oy (1-12)
 | | | | +---- hafta kuni (0-6, 0=yakshanba)
 | | | | |
 0 2 * * *      har kuni 02:00 UTC (Toshkent 07:00)
 30 4 * * 1-5   ish kunlari 04:30 UTC
 */15 * * * *   har 15 daqiqa
 0 0 1 * *      har oy 1-sanasi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
name: nightly
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 2 * * *'       # "toq" daqiqa - :00 dagi tirbandlikdan qochish
  workflow_dispatch:           # qo'lda ham ishga tushirish uchun
jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make e2e
      - if: failure()
        run: gh issue create --title "Nightly failed $(date -u +%F)" --body "$RUN_URL"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
```
`github.event.schedule` — qaysi cron ifodasi ishga tushirganini bildiradi (bir nechta cron bo'lsa).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Mahalliy vaqt deb o'ylash — hammasi UTC (Toshkent = UTC+5).
- Public repo'da 60 kun faollik bo'lmasa scheduled workflow'lar avtomatik o'chiriladi.
- `0 * * * *` — butun dunyo shu vaqtni tanlaydi, kechikish ko'p; toq daqiqa tanla.
- Aniq vaqt kerak bo'lgan biznes ish (to'lov, hisobot) uchun Actions cron'ga tayanish — Kubernetes CronJob yoki cloud scheduler ishonchliroq.

**Senior nuqta:** Scheduled job yiqilganini hech kim ko'rmaydi — failure'da issue/alert yarat. Bir xil ishning ikki marta bajarilishiga chidamli (idempotent) qil, chunki qayta ishga tushirish kerak bo'ladi.

40646.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab CI'da bir xil nomli o'zgaruvchi bir necha joyda e'lon qilinsa, ustunlik (yuqori yutadi) taxminan: pipeline execution policy / scan execution policy > pipeline o'zgaruvchilari (manual run, trigger, schedule, API) > project CI/CD variables > group (ichki group ustun) > instance > `.gitlab-ci.yml` job `variables` > global `variables` > deployment variables > predefined variables. UI'da berilgan o'zgaruvchi YAML'dagini bosib ketadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
predefined: CI_COMMIT_SHA ...                (eng past)
YAML global:   LOG_LEVEL=info
YAML job:      LOG_LEVEL=debug               (global'ni yengadi)
instance -> group -> subgroup -> project UI: LOG_LEVEL=warn  (YAML'ni yengadi)
manual run / API: LOG_LEVEL=trace            (deyarli eng yuqori)
job ichida natija: trace
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
variables:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  DEPLOY_ENV: staging

deploy:
  variables:
    LOG_LEVEL: debug
  script:
    - echo "LOG_LEVEL=$LOG_LEVEL DEPLOY_ENV=$DEPLOY_ENV"
```
```bash
# API orqali pipeline o'zgaruvchisi bilan ishga tushirish (eng yuqori ustunlik)
glab ci run -b main --variables LOG_LEVEL:trace
```
Project variable sozlamalari: Protected (faqat protected branch/tag), Masked / Masked and hidden, Expand variable reference, Environment scope (`production`, `review/*`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- YAML'da o'zgaruvchini o'zgartirib, lekin project UI'da shu nom borligini bilmaslik — o'zgarish ta'sir qilmaydi.
- Protected variable unprotected branch'da bo'sh — job jim yiqiladi yoki noto'g'ri qiymat ishlatadi.
- Pipeline o'zgaruvchilarini istalgan developer bera oladi — xavfsizlik uchun ularni cheklash mumkin (project sozlamasida faqat Maintainer'larga ruxsat).
- Aniq tartib GitLab versiyalari bilan o'zgargan — rasmiy hujjatdagi "CI/CD variable precedence" ni tekshir.

**Senior nuqta:** Secret'lar faqat UI/external secret manager'da (Vault, cloud) va environment scope bilan; YAML'da faqat sir bo'lmagan default'lar. Muhim deploy o'zgaruvchilarini pipeline darajasida o'zgartirishni rol bilan chekla.

40647.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pipeline Syntax Generator (Snippet Generator) — Jenkins ichidagi web sahifa (`<jenkins-url>/pipeline-syntax`, yoki job sahifasida "Pipeline Syntax" havolasi): ro'yxatdan step (masalan `checkout`, `withCredentials`, `junit`) tanlab, formani to'ldirasan va u to'g'ri Groovy snippet'ini yaratib beradi. Declarative Directive Generator — `options`, `when`, `agent` kabi direktivalar uchun.

**Nega kerak:** Har plugin o'z step sintaksisiga ega va hujjatlari tarqoq. Generator aynan sizning Jenkins'ingizda o'rnatilgan plugin versiyalari bo'yicha snippet beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
/pipeline-syntax
  Sample Step: [withCredentials: Bind credentials to variables]
  Bindings: Secret text -> Variable: TOKEN, Credentials: npm-token
  [Generate Pipeline Script]
        v
withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'npm-token', variable: 'TOKEN')]) {
    // some block
}
```

**Amalda (foydali sahifalar):**
| URL | Nima |
|---|---|
| `/pipeline-syntax` | Snippet Generator |
| `/pipeline-syntax/html` | Barcha step'lar ma'lumotnomasi (o'rnatilgan plugin'lar bo'yicha) |
| `/pipeline-syntax/globals` | Global o'zgaruvchilar: `env`, `params`, `currentBuild` |
| Declarative Directive Generator | `options`, `triggers`, `when` va boshqalar |

Misol natija (checkout):
```groovy
checkout scmGit(
  branches: [[name: '*/main']],
  userRemoteConfigs: [[credentialsId: 'gh-app', url: 'https://github.com/acme/api.git']]
)
```
Declarative'ni tekshirish (linter):
```bash
curl -X POST -F "jenkinsfile=<Jenkinsfile" https://jenkins.example.com/pipeline-model-converter/validate
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Generator ba'zan barcha default parametrlarni yozadi — snippet keraksiz uzun; ortiqchasini olib tashla.
- Snippet o'rnatilgan plugin versiyasiga bog'liq — boshqa Jenkins'da ishlamasligi mumkin.
- Generatorda credential tanlash — credential ID Jenkinsfile'ga yoziladi, qiymat emas (bu to'g'ri), lekin ID nomlanishi standart bo'lsin.

**Senior nuqta:** Generator — o'rganish va tez snippet uchun; takrorlanadigan qismlarni shared library'ga chiqar va Jenkinsfile'larni linter bilan CI'da tekshir.

40648.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SonarQube Scanner — CI'da ishlaydigan klient: loyiha kodini (va test/coverage hisobotlarini) tahlil qilib natijani SonarQube serverga (yoki SonarQube Cloud'ga) yuboradi, keyin (sozlansa) Quality Gate natijasini kutib, pipeline'ni o'tkazadi yoki yiqitadi. Turli variantlari bor: `sonar-scanner` CLI, Maven/Gradle plugin, .NET scanner, GitHub/GitLab integratsiyalari.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CI: test -> coverage.out / lcov.info / jacoco.xml
   v
sonar-scanner: kodni lokal tahlil qiladi -> hisobot -> SonarQube server
   v
server: background task (Compute Engine) -> issue'lar, coverage, duplication
   v
Quality Gate: PASSED/FAILED -> scanner (qualitygate.wait=true) -> exit code
   v
PR decoration: MR/PR'da izoh va status
```

**Amalda:**
```properties
# sonar-project.properties
sonar.projectKey=acme_api
sonar.sources=.
sonar.exclusions=**/*_test.go,**/vendor/**
sonar.tests=.
sonar.test.inclusions=**/*_test.go
sonar.go.coverage.reportPaths=coverage.out
```
```yaml
# GitHub Actions
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
  with: { fetch-depth: 0 }            # blame va yangi kod aniqlash uchun
- run: go test -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...
- uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action@v5
  env:
    SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
    SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ vars.SONAR_HOST_URL }}
  with:
    args: -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `fetch-depth: 1` (shallow) — "new code" va blame noto'g'ri, ogohlantirish chiqadi.
- Coverage hisobot yo'li noto'g'ri — SonarQube 0% ko'rsatadi, xato bermaydi.
- Test fayllarini `sources` ga qo'shish — duplication va issue'lar sun'iy oshadi.
- Token'ni log'ga chiqarish; Global Analysis Token o'rniga loyiha token'i ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Scanner natijasini PR'ga (decoration) chiqar — dasturchi kontekstda ko'radi. Tahlilni test job'idan keyin, lekin merge'ni bloklash faqat "new code" shartlari bo'yicha bo'lsin.

40649.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Review Apps — GitLab funksiyasi: har branch yoki merge request uchun dinamik environment (masalan `review/feature-x`) avtomatik deploy qilinadi, MR sahifasida "View app" havolasi chiqadi; branch o'chirilganda yoki MR yopilganda `on_stop` job'i muhitni o'chiradi. GitLab'dagi ephemeral/preview environment ko'rinishi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
MR ochildi (branch feature-x)
  -> deploy_review job: environment review/feature-x
     url: https://feature-x.review.example.com
  -> MR sahifasida "View app" tugmasi
MR merge/yopildi yoki auto_stop_in muddati tugadi
  -> stop_review job (on_stop) -> namespace o'chiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
deploy_review:
  stage: deploy
  image: alpine/helm:3.16
  script:
    - helm upgrade --install "review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG" ./chart
        -n "review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG" --create-namespace
        --set image.tag=$CI_COMMIT_SHA
        --set ingress.host=$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.review.example.com
  environment:
    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG
    url: https://$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.review.example.com
    on_stop: stop_review
    auto_stop_in: 3 days
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"

stop_review:
  stage: deploy
  image: alpine/helm:3.16
  variables:
    GIT_STRATEGY: none          # branch o'chgan bo'lishi mumkin
  script:
    - helm uninstall "review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG" -n "review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG"
    - kubectl delete ns "review-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG" --wait=false
  environment:
    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG
    action: stop
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
      when: manual
```
Operate -> Environments sahifasida barcha review muhitlar va "Stop" tugmasi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `GIT_STRATEGY: none` yo'q — branch o'chirilgach stop job checkout qila olmay yiqiladi va muhit abadiy qoladi.
- `auto_stop_in` yo'q — unutilgan muhitlar pul yeydi.
- `CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG` 63 belgidan uzun bo'lishi mumkin — DNS/namespace chegarasi.
- Review app'lar prod secret'lari bilan — alohida, cheklangan credential'lar ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Review App'ning qiymati — reviewer va PM o'zgarishni kod o'qimasdan ko'radi. Narxni boshqarish (TTL, kvota, kichik replika, umumiy DB) dizaynning bir qismi bo'lsin.

40650.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `continue-on-error: true` — step (yoki job) yiqilsa ham job/workflow muvaffaqiyatsiz deb belgilanmaydi va keyingi step'lar davom etadi. Muhim bo'lmagan qadamlar uchun: eksperimental linter, ixtiyoriy hisobot yuklash, yangi til versiyasidagi matrix job.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
step A: OK
step B (continue-on-error: true): exit 1
   -> steps.B.outcome    = failure
   -> steps.B.conclusion = success   (job uchun)
step C: ishlaydi
job natijasi: success (yashil, B'da ogohlantirish belgisi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        go: ['1.22', '1.23']
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - go: '1.24'
            experimental: true
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}   # job darajasi
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: newlint
        continue-on-error: true                     # step darajasi
        run: golangci-lint run --enable-only=newcheck ./...
      - name: Lint natijasini xabar qilish
        if: steps.newlint.outcome == 'failure'
        run: echo "::warning::Yangi lint qoidalari buzilgan, hozircha bloklamaydi"
      - run: go test ./...
```
`outcome` — haqiqiy natija, `conclusion` — `continue-on-error` qo'llangandan keyingisi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Muhim step'ga (test, xavfsizlik skaneri) qo'yish — xatolar jim o'tib ketadi, pipeline doim yashil.
- `if: failure()` keyingi step'da ishlamaydi — chunki job "failure" emas; `steps.<id>.outcome` ni tekshir.
- Vaqtinchalik qo'yilgan `continue-on-error` abadiy qoladi — TODO va muddat qo'y.
- GitLab ekvivalenti `allow_failure: true` (pipeline sariq "warning" bilan).

**Senior nuqta:** `continue-on-error` — yangi qoidani "audit rejimida" joriy qilish vositasi: avval ogohlantirish, jamoa tuzatgach — bloklovchi qilish. Natijani ko'rinadigan qil (warning, summary), aks holda hech kim e'tibor bermaydi.

40651.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitOps — deploy modeli: klaster va infra'ning kerakli holati (desired state) Git'da deklarativ saqlanadi, klaster ichidagi agent (ArgoCD, Flux) Git'ni o'qib (pull), live holatni unga muttasil moslaydi (reconcile). Deploy = Git'ga merge.

**Muammo:** Klassik push-CD'da CI pipeline `kubectl apply` qiladi. Natija: CI'da prod kubeconfig/admin token saqlanadi (CI buzilsa — prod ham buziladi), kimdir qo'lda `kubectl edit` qilsa hech kim bilmaydi, "prod'da hozir nima turibdi?" savoliga javob yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
dev --PR--> Git (manifests) <--pull-- ArgoCD/Flux (klaster ichida)
                 ^                         |
                 |                         v  apply + diff
   CI: test, build, image push        Kubernetes API
   + manifestda image tag'ini yangilash   (live state)
```
CI faqat image yaratadi va config repo'ga commit/PR qiladi. Klasterga hech kim tashqaridan kirmaydi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
# deploy = tag'ni o'zgartirib merge qilish
yq -i '.images[0].newTag="1.4.2"' apps/api/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml
git commit -am "api: 1.4.2" && git push   # -> PR -> review -> merge
argocd app get api-prod    # Sync: Synced, Health: Healthy
# rollback = git revert
git revert <sha> && git push
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- App kodi va manifest'larni bitta repo'da saqlash — har kod commit'i sync trigger qiladi, CI loop'lar paydo bo'ladi. Odatda alohida config repo.
- Secret'larni ochiq YAML'da Git'ga qo'yish — Sealed Secrets/ESO kerak.
- GitOps CI'ni almashtirmaydi: test, build, scan hali ham CI'da.

**Senior nuqta:** GitOps'ning asosiy foydasi — audit (har o'zgarish = commit, review, author) va xavfsizlik (prod credential CI'dan chiqadi). Narxi — "tez qo'lda fix" imkoni yo'qoladi; incident'da ham o'zgarish Git orqali o'tishi kerak, shuning uchun tez merge jarayonini oldindan tayyorla.

40652.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OpenGitOps (CNCF) to'rt tamoyili: 1) **Declarative** — tizim holati deklarativ tasvirlanadi; 2) **Versioned and Immutable** — holat versiyalangan, o'zgarmas tarix bilan saqlanadi (odatda Git); 3) **Pulled Automatically** — agent desired state'ni o'zi tortib oladi; 4) **Continuously Reconciled** — agent doimiy actual va desired holatni solishtirib, farqni tuzatadi.

**Nega aynan shu to'rttasi:** har biri bitta muammoni yopadi:

| Tamoyil | Yopadigan muammo |
|---|---|
| Declarative | "Qanday qilish" skriptlari emas, "nima bo'lishi kerak" — idempotent |
| Versioned/Immutable | Audit, review, `git revert` bilan rollback |
| Pulled | Klasterga tashqi credential kerak emas |
| Reconciled | Drift (qo'lda o'zgarish) avtomatik aniqlanadi/tuzatiladi |

**Qanday ishlaydi (reconcile loop):**
```text
loop har N soniya / webhook:
  desired = render(Git@HEAD)
  actual  = kube-api.get()
  diff    = desired - actual
  if diff: apply(diff)   -> status: Synced
```

**Amalda:** tamoyillarni tekshirish:
```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deploy api --replicas=10   # qo'lda drift
argocd app get api-prod   # OutOfSync -> selfHeal yoqilgan bo'lsa 3 ga qaytadi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Pipeline'dan `kubectl apply` qilib "GitOps qildik" deyish — 3 va 4-tamoyil yo'q.
- `latest` tag ishlatish — Git o'zgarmagan, lekin holat o'zgaradi; 2-tamoyil buziladi. Immutable tag yoki digest ishlat.
- "Git" shart emas — OCI registry yoki S3 ham versiyalangan manba bo'la oladi (Flux OCIRepository).

**Senior nuqta:** Intervyuda tamoyillarni yodlab aytish yetmaydi — har birini buzish nimaga olib kelishini ayt. Masalan HPA `replicas`ni o'zgartiradi: bu "drift" emas, shuning uchun `replicas`ni manifestdan olib tashlash yoki `ignoreDifferences` kerak.

40653.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ArgoCD — Kubernetes uchun CNCF graduated GitOps CD tool'i. Klaster ichida ishlaydi, Git (yoki Helm/OCI) repo'dagi manifest'larni render qiladi, live holat bilan solishtiradi va farqni sync qiladi; UI, CLI, RBAC, SSO beradi.

**Muammo:** O'nlab servis va klasterni "hozir nima deploy qilingan, Git bilan mos keladimi" deb kuzatish qo'lda imkonsiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi (komponentlar):**
```text
Git/Helm/OCI --> repo-server (helm template, kustomize build -> YAML)
                      |
                      v
            application-controller --diff--> kube-api (live)
                      |  sync (apply)            ^
                      v                          |
            argocd-server (UI/API/SSO) ----------+
            redis (cache), dex (SSO, ixtiyoriy)
```
- **repo-server** — manifest generatsiya (Helm, Kustomize, plain, plugin).
- **application-controller** — reconcile loop (default ~3 daqiqa polling yoki webhook).
- **argocd-server** — UI/API, RBAC.

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl create ns argocd
kubectl apply -n argocd -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/stable/manifests/install.yaml
argocd app create api --repo https://github.com/org/deploy.git \
  --path apps/api/prod --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace api
argocd app sync api
argocd app get api      # Sync Status / Health Status
```
`Synced + Healthy` — Git bilan mos va resurslar sog'lom. `OutOfSync` — diff bor.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default `admin` parolini qoldirish va UI'ni internetga ochish.
- Bitta ArgoCD'dan 100+ klasterni boshqarish — controller sharding kerak (`ARGOCD_CONTROLLER_REPLICAS`).
- Katta monorepo'da repo-server CPU/memory tugaydi — `reposerver.parallelism.limit`.

**Senior nuqta:** Topologiya qarori: markaziy ArgoCD (hub-spoke, bitta panel, lekin hamma klaster credential'i bir joyda) yoki har klasterda o'z ArgoCD'si (izolyatsiya, lekin ko'p instance). Blast radius va operatsion yukni solishtirib tanla.

40654.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `Application` — ArgoCD'ning asosiy CRD'si: "qaysi manbadan (repo, revision, path) qaysi joyga (klaster, namespace) qanday siyosat bilan (sync policy) deploy qilish" ni deklarativ yozadi.

**Muammo:** UI'da qo'lda yaratilgan app'lar Git'da yo'q — ArgoCD o'zi ham GitOps bilan boshqarilishi kerak ("app of apps").

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: api-prod
  namespace: argocd
  finalizers: [resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io]   # app o'chsa resurslar ham
spec:
  project: payments              # AppProject: ruxsat chegarasi
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/org/deploy.git
    targetRevision: main
    path: apps/api/overlays/prod
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: api
  syncPolicy:
    automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true }
    syncOptions: [CreateNamespace=true, ServerSideApply=true]
    retry: { limit: 5, backoff: { duration: 10s, factor: 2 } }
  ignoreDifferences:
    - group: apps
      kind: Deployment
      jsonPointers: [/spec/replicas]   # HPA boshqaradi
```
```bash
kubectl apply -f api-prod.yaml
argocd app diff api-prod
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `project: default` — hamma repo va hamma namespace'ga ruxsat; jamoalar uchun alohida `AppProject` (sourceRepos, destinations, clusterResourceWhitelist).
- Finalizer'siz app'ni o'chirsang resurslar klasterda qoladi (yetim); finalizer bilan — hammasi o'chadi, ehtiyot bo'l.
- `targetRevision: HEAD` prod'da — har merge darhol prod'ga. Tag/branch strategiyasini aniq qil.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p source kerak bo'lsa (`sources:` — Helm chart bitta repo'da, values boshqasida) multi-source ishlat. Application'larni qo'lda yozish ko'paysa — ApplicationSet'ga o't.

40655.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ApplicationSet — `Application`lar fabrikasi: generator (List, Cluster, Git directory/file, Matrix, Merge, SCM Provider, Pull Request) natijalarini template'ga qo'yib, ko'plab Application yaratadi va ularni sinxron ushlab turadi.

**Muammo:** 30 servis x 4 klaster = 120 deyarli bir xil Application YAML. Yangi klaster qo'shilsa — 30 ta fayl qo'lda.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
generator(lar) --> parametrlar [{cluster: prod-eu, url: ...}, ...]
                         |
                         v
            template (Application) --> N ta Application
```

**Amalda (Matrix: har klaster x har servis papkasi):**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: ApplicationSet
metadata: { name: services, namespace: argocd }
spec:
  goTemplate: true
  generators:
    - matrix:
        generators:
          - clusters: { selector: { matchLabels: { env: prod } } }
          - git:
              repoURL: https://github.com/org/deploy.git
              revision: main
              directories: [{ path: "apps/*" }]
  template:
    metadata: { name: "{{.path.basename}}-{{.name}}" }
    spec:
      project: default
      source: { repoURL: https://github.com/org/deploy.git, targetRevision: main, path: "{{.path.path}}" }
      destination: { server: "{{.server}}", namespace: "{{.path.basename}}" }
      syncPolicy: { automated: { selfHeal: true } }
```
Yangi klasterni `env=prod` label bilan ro'yxatdan o'tkazdingmi — barcha servis avtomatik deploy bo'ladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Generator natijasidan element yo'qolsa, Application (va uning resurslari) o'chadi. Himoya: `syncPolicy.preserveResourcesOnDeletion: true` yoki `applicationsSync: create-only`.
- Hamma klasterga bir vaqtda chiqarish — `strategy: RollingSync` (progressive sync) bilan bosqichma-bosqich qil.
- Pull Request generator — preview muhit uchun zo'r, lekin fork PR'lardan xavfsizlik.

**Senior nuqta:** ApplicationSet — platform jamoaning "self-service" vositasi: dev papka qo'shadi, platform template'ni boshqaradi. Lekin template xatosi bir zarbada yuzlab app'ga tegadi — template o'zgarishlarini staging klaster to'plamida sina.

40656.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Sync wave — `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "<int>"` annotation. ArgoCD bitta sync ichida resurslarni wave raqami bo'yicha o'sish tartibida qo'llaydi (manfiy ham bo'ladi, default `0`); keyingi wave oldingi wave **healthy** bo'lgandan keyin boshlanadi.

**Muammo:** CRD avval, keyin uni ishlatadigan CR; ConfigMap/Secret avval, keyin Deployment; DB avval, keyin app. Tartibsiz apply — "no matches for kind" yoki CrashLoop.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
phase: PreSync -> Sync -> PostSync
 har phase ichida:
   wave -1: Namespace, CRD
   wave  0: ConfigMap, Secret          (default)
   wave  1: Database StatefulSet  -- healthy kutiladi
   wave  2: API Deployment
   wave  3: Ingress
 bir wave ichida: kind bo'yicha tartib (Namespace, CRD, ... ), keyin nom
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: postgres
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "1"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "2"
```
```bash
argocd app sync api --dry-run
argocd app get api --show-operation   # qaysi wave'da turibdi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Wave faqat bitta Application ichida ishlaydi; app'lar orasidagi tartib uchun app-of-apps'da Application resurslariga wave qo'y.
- Custom resource uchun health check bo'lmasa ArgoCD uni darhol "healthy" deb oladi — keyingi wave erta boshlanadi. Lua health check yoz.
- Wave'lar orasidagi pauza (`ARGOCD_SYNC_WAVE_DELAY`, default 2s) — ko'p wave sync'ni sekinlashtiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Wave'larni haddan tashqari ko'paytirma: ilova o'zi dependency'ni retry bilan kutadigan qilib yozilsa (eventual consistency), deploy tartibiga bog'liqlik kamayadi va tizim mustahkamroq bo'ladi.

40657.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ArgoCD sync bosqichlari: **PreSync** (asosiy resurslardan oldin), **Sync** (asosiy manifest'lar), **PostSync** (hammasi healthy bo'lgandan keyin), **SyncFail** (sync yiqilsa). Yana `Skip` va (yangi versiyalarda) `PreDelete`/`PostDelete` hook'lari bor. Hook — `argocd.argoproj.io/hook` annotation'li resurs (odatda Job).

**Muammo:** Deploy faqat "YAML'ni apply qilish" emas: oldin DB migration, keyin smoke test, yiqilsa — Slack xabari yoki tozalash.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
PreSync hooks --ok--> Sync (wave'lar bo'yicha) --healthy--> PostSync hooks
     |                      |
     +------- fail ---------+----> SyncFail hooks
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: db-migrate
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: BeforeHookCreation,HookSucceeded
spec:
  backoffLimit: 1
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: migrate
          image: org/api:1.4.2
          command: ["./migrate", "up"]
```
`hook-delete-policy`: `HookSucceeded` (muvaffaqiyatdan keyin o'chir), `HookFailed`, `BeforeHookCreation` (keyingi sync'dan oldin eskisini o'chir — nom to'qnashuvini oldini oladi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PreSync migration yangi kodga mos, lekin hali ishlab turgan eski pod'larga mos bo'lmasa — downtime. Migration backward-compatible (expand/contract) bo'lishi shart.
- Delete policy'siz Job qoladi va keyingi sync'da "already exists" xatosi.
- Helm hook'lari (`helm.sh/hook: pre-install`) ArgoCD'da tegishli ArgoCD hook'lariga map qilinadi, lekin to'liq bir xil emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Migration'ni deploy'ga bog'lash qulay, lekin uzoq migration sync'ni bloklaydi. Katta jadvallarda migration'ni alohida pipeline/Job sifatida, ilova relizidan ajratib boshqar.

40658.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Auto-sync** (`syncPolicy.automated`) — Git'da yangi commit paydo bo'lsa ArgoCD o'zi sync qiladi (qo'lda "Sync" tugmasi shart emas). **Self-heal** (`selfHeal: true`) — Git o'zgarmagan bo'lsa ham, klasterdagi qo'lda o'zgarishni (drift) aniqlab Git holatiga qaytaradi.

**Muammo:** Auto-sync'siz — merge qilindi, lekin kimdir sync bosishni unutdi. Self-heal'siz — kimdir `kubectl edit` qildi, app `OutOfSync` bo'lib qoladi va keyingi deploy'gacha shu holat yashaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
            Git o'zgardi?  --ha--> auto-sync --> apply
            live != desired, Git o'zgarmagan?
                          --ha--> selfHeal=true ? apply : faqat OutOfSync ko'rsat
```
Self-heal default 5 soniya kutib qayta urinadi (`--self-heal-timeout-seconds`).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
syncPolicy:
  automated:
    prune: true
    selfHeal: true
    allowEmpty: false     # Git bo'sh bo'lsa hammasini o'chirma
```
```bash
kubectl -n api set image deploy/api api=org/api:hotfix   # qo'lda
kubectl -n api get deploy api -o jsonpath='{..image}'     # bir necha soniyadan keyin eski tag
argocd app history api
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Incident paytida qo'lda fix qilding — self-heal uni darhol bekor qiladi. Vaqtincha o'chirish: `argocd app set api --self-heal=false` (va buni qaytarishni unutma).
- HPA, VPA, mutating webhook o'zgartiradigan maydonlar doimiy "drift" — `ignoreDifferences` bilan chiqarib tashla, aks holda sync loop.
- Prod'da auto-sync + `targetRevision: main` = har merge darhol prod. Gate kerak bo'lsa — PR approval yoki sync window.

**Senior nuqta:** Self-heal GitOps'ning "Git — yagona haqiqat" va'dasini amalga oshiradi. Uni o'chirib qo'yish — drift'ni qonuniylashtirish. To'g'ri yo'l: hotfix'ni ham Git'dan tez o'tkazadigan jarayon.

40659.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Prune — Git'dan o'chirilgan manifest'ga mos resursni klasterdan ham o'chirish. Auto-sync'da default `prune: false` (xavfsizlik uchun): ArgoCD resursni faqat `OutOfSync` (orphan "requires pruning") deb belgilaydi.

**Muammo:** `old-worker` Deployment'ni Git'dan o'chirding, lekin klasterda ishlashda davom etadi — resurs yeydi, eski kod queue'dan xabar o'qiydi. Yoki teskari: noto'g'ri path tufayli butun app "o'chirilgan" ko'rinadi va prune hammasini yo'q qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
live resurslar (app label/tracking annotation bilan)
   minus  Git'dagi resurslar
   =      prune nomzodlari --prune=true--> delete
```
ArgoCD resursni o'ziniki deb `app.kubernetes.io/instance` label yoki tracking annotation orqali taniydi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
argocd app diff api                 # "requires pruning" ro'yxati
argocd app sync api --prune         # qo'lda bir martalik prune
```
```yaml
syncPolicy:
  automated: { prune: true }
  syncOptions: [PruneLast=true]     # prune'ni oxirida, yangi resurslar healthy bo'lgach
---
metadata:
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: Prune=false   # shu resursni hech qachon prune qilma (PVC, CRD)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PVC, Namespace, CRD prune bo'lsa — ma'lumot yo'qoladi. Ularga `Prune=false` yoki `Delete=false` qo'y.
- `allowEmpty: false` qoldir — xato commit repo'ni bo'shatib qo'ysa hammasi o'chib ketmaydi.
- Bir resurs ikki app tomonidan kuzatilsa — biri uni prune qilishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod'da `prune: true` + `PruneLast` + muhim stateful resurslarga `Prune=false` — muvozanatli sozlama. Prune'siz GitOps'da yetim resurslar to'planadi va "Git = haqiqat" yolg'onga aylanadi.

40660.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flux v2 — GitOps Toolkit: alohida controller'lar to'plami. **Source Controller** (Git/Helm/OCI/Bucket'dan artifact), **Kustomize Controller** (manifest'larni apply), **Helm Controller** (HelmRelease), **Notification Controller** (alert va webhook receiver), **Image Reflector + Image Automation** (yangi image tag'ini topib Git'ga commit).

**Muammo:** Monolit CD tool o'rniga — har vazifa alohida, kompozitsiya qilinadigan CRD/controller; UI yo'q, hammasi `kubectl`/`flux` CLI va CRD'lar orqali.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
GitRepository/OCIRepository/HelmRepository  (source-controller)
        | artifact (tar.gz, revision)
        +--> Kustomization  (kustomize-controller) --> kube-api
        +--> HelmRelease    (helm-controller)      --> kube-api
ImageRepository -> ImagePolicy -> ImageUpdateAutomation --git push--> repo
events --> Alert/Provider (notification-controller) --> Slack
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
flux bootstrap github --owner=org --repository=fleet --path=clusters/prod --personal=false
flux get sources git
flux get kustomizations -A
flux reconcile kustomization apps --with-source   # darhol sync
flux logs --level=error
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Flux'da o'rnatilgan UI yo'q (Weave GitOps/Headlamp plugin alohida). Vizual panel kerak bo'lsa ArgoCD qulayroq.
- Image Automation Git'ga yozadi — deploy key'ga write ruxsat kerak, bu xavfsizlik qarori.
- `bootstrap` Flux'ning o'zini ham repo'ga yozadi — Flux upgrade ham GitOps orqali.

**Senior nuqta:** ArgoCD vs Flux: ArgoCD — UI, multi-tenancy/RBAC, ko'p klasterni markazdan boshqarish; Flux — yengil, Kubernetes-native, har klaster o'zini boshqaradi, OCI artifact va Helm'ni chuqurroq qo'llaydi. Ikkalasi ham CNCF graduated.

40661.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flux `Kustomization` (`kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io`) — source artifact'idagi papkani `kustomize build` qilib klasterga apply qiladigan reconcile birligi: interval, prune, health check, `dependsOn`, `postBuild` substitution, decryption (SOPS) bilan.

Diqqat: bu `kustomize.config.k8s.io` dagi `kustomization.yaml` fayl emas — nomi bir xil, lekin Flux CRD.

**Muammo:** "infra (cert-manager, ingress) avval, keyin app'lar" tartibi va har qatlamni sog'liq bo'yicha tekshirish kerak.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata: { name: apps, namespace: flux-system }
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef: { kind: GitRepository, name: fleet }
  path: ./apps/prod
  prune: true
  wait: true                  # barcha resurslar ready bo'lishini kut
  timeout: 5m
  dependsOn:
    - name: infra-controllers # avval bu Ready bo'lsin
  postBuild:
    substitute: { CLUSTER: prod-eu }
  decryption: { provider: sops, secretRef: { name: sops-age } }
```
```bash
flux get kustomizations
# NAME   REVISION        READY  MESSAGE
# apps   main@sha1:ab12  True   Applied revision: main@sha1:ab12
flux diff kustomization apps --path ./apps/prod
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `prune: true` + noto'g'ri `path` = hamma resurs o'chadi.
- `dependsOn` faqat bir namespace/Kustomization darajasida; sikl bo'lsa ikkalasi ham kutib qoladi.
- `wait: true` CRD'siz custom resurslar uchun ready'ni bilmasa — `healthChecks` ni aniq yoz.

**Senior nuqta:** Odatiy tuzilma: `clusters/<name>` -> `infra-controllers` -> `infra-configs` -> `apps`, har biri `dependsOn` bilan. Bu klasterni noldan tiklashni (DR) bitta `flux bootstrap` ga aylantiradi.

40662.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `HelmRelease` — Flux Helm Controller CRD'si: qaysi chart (HelmRepository/OCI), qaysi versiya, qanday values bilan release bo'lishini deklarativ yozadi; controller `helm install/upgrade`ni o'zi bajaradi, drift'ni aniqlaydi, xatoda rollback/uninstall qiladi.

**Muammo:** `helm upgrade` ni CI'dan qo'lda chaqirish — values qayerdan kelgani noaniq, yiqilgan release `pending-upgrade` holatida qoladi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: HelmRepository
metadata: { name: bitnami, namespace: flux-system }
spec: { type: oci, url: oci://registry-1.docker.io/bitnamicharts, interval: 1h }
---
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata: { name: redis, namespace: cache }
spec:
  interval: 15m
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: redis
      version: "20.x"          # semver range
      sourceRef: { kind: HelmRepository, name: bitnami, namespace: flux-system }
  values:
    architecture: replication
  valuesFrom:
    - kind: Secret
      name: redis-values
  install: { remediation: { retries: 3 } }
  upgrade:
    remediation: { retries: 3, remediateLastFailure: true, strategy: rollback }
  driftDetection: { mode: enabled }
```
```bash
flux get helmreleases -A
helm history redis -n cache
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `version: "*"` yoki keng range — upstream yangi major chiqarsa prod o'zi upgrade bo'ladi. Aniq versiya yoki Renovate bilan PR.
- `valuesFrom` dagi Secret o'zgarsa reconcile `interval` gacha kutadi.
- Helm release secret'lari (`sh.helm.release.v1.*`) to'planadi — `maxHistory` qo'y.

**Senior nuqta:** HelmRelease drift detection Helm'ning eng katta zaif nuqtasini (release ichidagi qo'lda o'zgarishlar ko'rinmaydi) yopadi. Chart versiyasini Git'da pin qilib, yangilashni bot PR'lari orqali o'tkazish — reproducible va auditli.

40663.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Progressive delivery — yangi versiyani hammaga birdaniga emas, bosqichma-bosqich (canary, blue-green, feature flag) chiqarib, har bosqichda real metrikalarni avtomatik tahlil qilish va yomon bo'lsa avtomatik orqaga qaytarish. Maqsad — xato bo'lsa zararni (blast radius) kichik foydalanuvchi ulushida ushlash.

**Muammo:** Rolling update hamma pod'ni ketma-ket almashtiradi; xato faqat yuklama ostida chiqsa, sezganingda 100% foydalanuvchi jabrlanadi. Staging hech qachon prod'ni to'liq takrorlamaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
v2: 5% --analiz(5m)--> 25% --analiz--> 50% --analiz--> 100%
          |                 |
          +-- error>1% -----+--> abort: 0% v2, 100% v1
```
Komponentlar: trafik bo'luvchi (Istio, Linkerd, NGINX/Gateway API, ALB), metrika manbai (Prometheus, Datadog), controller (Argo Rollouts, Flagger), ixtiyoriy feature flag (LaunchDarkly, OpenFeature).

**Amalda (Argo Rollouts):**
```yaml
strategy:
  canary:
    steps:
      - setWeight: 5
      - analysis: { templates: [{ templateName: success-rate }] }
      - setWeight: 25
      - pause: { duration: 10m }
      - setWeight: 100
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trafik kam bo'lsa 5% canary statistik ahamiyatsiz — 10 so'rovdan xulosa qilinmaydi. Minimal so'rov sonini shart qil.
- DB schema o'zgarishi canary'ni befoyda qiladi: ikkala versiya bir DB'ni ishlatadi, rollback DB'ni qaytarmaydi.
- Faqat texnik metrika (5xx) — biznes metrikasi (checkout conversion) tushishini ko'rmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Progressive delivery deploy (kod serverga chiqdi) va release'ni (foydalanuvchi ko'rdi) ajratadi. Eng katta qiymat — avtomatik rollback; buning uchun avval yaxshi SLI va alert chegaralari kerak, aks holda analiz tasodifiy qaror beradi.

40664.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Argo Rollouts — Kubernetes controller: `Deployment` o'rniga `Rollout` CRD ishlatiladi, u canary/blue-green strategiyani step'lar bilan bajaradi, trafikni mesh/ingress orqali bo'ladi va `AnalysisRun` natijasiga ko'ra promote yoki abort qiladi.

**Muammo:** Native Deployment faqat `RollingUpdate`/`Recreate` biladi: trafik foizini boshqarib bo'lmaydi, pauza va metrika tahlili yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
Rollout --> stable ReplicaSet (v1)   <--- 80% ---+
        \-> canary ReplicaSet (v2)   <--- 20% ---+-- Istio VirtualService / NGINX / Gateway API
              |
          AnalysisRun (Prometheus) -- fail --> abort, canary 0
```
Trafik router bo'lmasa, foiz replica nisbati bilan taxminlanadi (4 stable + 1 canary = ~20%).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata: { name: api }
spec:
  replicas: 10
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  template: { metadata: { labels: { app: api } }, spec: { containers: [{ name: api, image: org/api:1.5.0 }] } }
  strategy:
    canary:
      canaryService: api-canary
      stableService: api-stable
      trafficRouting: { nginx: { stableIngress: api } }
      steps:
        - setWeight: 10
        - pause: { duration: 5m }
        - setWeight: 50
        - pause: {}            # qo'lda promote kutadi
```
```bash
kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api --watch
kubectl argo rollouts promote api
kubectl argo rollouts abort api
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Mavjud Deployment'ni ko'chirish: `workloadRef` bilan Deployment'ga havola qilib bosqichma-bosqich o't, aks holda ikki controller bitta pod'larni boshqaradi.
- ArgoCD'da Rollout health'i to'g'ri ko'rinishi uchun ArgoCD versiyasi uni qo'llashi kerak (built-in).
- `pause: {}` — cheksiz kutish; kimdir promote qilishni unutsa reliz osilib qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Rollouts'ni ArgoCD bilan birga ishlatganda Git'da faqat image tag o'zgaradi, qolgan orkestratsiyani controller qiladi. Abort'dan keyin Git hali yangi tag'ni ko'rsatadi — Git'ni ham revert qilish kerak, aks holda keyingi sync qayta urinadi.

40665.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `AnalysisTemplate` — Argo Rollouts'da "canary sog'lommi?" savolini deklarativ yozadigan shablon: metrika provider (Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, New Relic, Web, Job), so'rov, `successCondition`/`failureCondition`, interval va necha marta tekshirish. Undan `AnalysisRun` yaratiladi.

**Muammo:** Inson Grafana'ga qarab "yaxshiga o'xshaydi" deyishi — sekin va subyektiv. Qaror mezonini kodda yozish kerak.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AnalysisTemplate
metadata: { name: success-rate }
spec:
  args: [{ name: service }]
  metrics:
    - name: success-rate
      interval: 1m
      count: 5
      failureLimit: 1           # 1 tadan ko'p fail -> abort
      successCondition: result[0] >= 0.99
      provider:
        prometheus:
          address: http://prometheus.monitoring:9090
          query: |
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="{{args.service}}",code!~"5.."}[2m]))
            /
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="{{args.service}}"}[2m]))
```
Rollout'da: `- analysis: { templates: [{ templateName: success-rate }], args: [{ name: service, value: api-canary }] }`.

```bash
kubectl get analysisrun
kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api   # AnalysisRun: Successful / Failed / Inconclusive
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trafik yo'q bo'lsa `0/0 = NaN` — natija Inconclusive yoki noto'g'ri success. `or vector(1)` yoki minimal so'rov sharti.
- Butun servis bo'yicha metrika — canary va stable aralashadi; label bilan faqat canary pod'larini filtrla.
- Prometheus ishlamay qolsa — analysis `Error`; `consecutiveErrorLimit` ni sozla.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng ishonchli tahlil — canary'ni stable bilan solishtirish (nisbiy), absolyut chegara emas: sutkalik trafik o'zgarishi ikkalasiga bir xil ta'sir qiladi. `ClusterAnalysisTemplate` bilan standart tahlillarni platforma darajasida ulash mumkin.

40666.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flagger (Flux loyihasi) — progressive delivery operatori: mavjud `Deployment`ga `Canary` CRD orqali havola qiladi, `-primary` nusxasini yaratadi, trafikni mesh/ingress (Istio, Linkerd, NGINX, Contour, Gateway API, App Mesh) orqali bosqichma-bosqich o'tkazadi va metrika tahlili bilan promote/rollback qiladi.

**Muammo:** Argo Rollouts Deployment'ni `Rollout`ga almashtirishni talab qiladi; Flagger mavjud Deployment'ni o'zgartirmasdan o'raydi — Helm chart'larga invaziv emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
siz: Deployment "api" (image yangilandi)
Flagger: api-primary (stable, trafik oladi)  <-- 90%
         api (canary, yangi image)           <-- 10%  -> metrikalar ok -> 20..50%
         muvaffaqiyat: yangi spec api-primary'ga ko'chiriladi, api 0 ga scale
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: flagger.app/v1beta1
kind: Canary
metadata: { name: api, namespace: prod }
spec:
  targetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }
  service: { port: 80 }
  analysis:
    interval: 1m
    threshold: 5          # 5 marta fail -> rollback
    maxWeight: 50
    stepWeight: 10
    metrics:
      - name: request-success-rate
        thresholdRange: { min: 99 }
        interval: 1m
      - name: request-duration
        thresholdRange: { max: 500 }
    webhooks:
      - name: load-test
        url: http://flagger-loadtester.test/
        metadata: { cmd: "hey -z 1m -q 10 http://api-canary.prod/" }
```
```bash
kubectl -n prod get canary api -w   # Progressing -> Succeeded / Failed
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trafik bo'lmasa analiz o'tmaydi — load-test webhook kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
- HPA'ni ham `autoscalerRef` bilan bering, aks holda primary'da HPA yo'q.
- Canary tugaguncha yangi deploy kelsa — Flagger analizni qayta boshlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Flux ekotizimida Flagger tabiiy tanlov, ArgoCD'da — Argo Rollouts. Asosiy farq: Flagger primary/canary nusxa usuli (resurs ikki baravar vaqtincha), Rollouts — bitta CRD'da ReplicaSet'lar.

40667.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Software supply chain security — kod yozilishidan production'da ishlashigacha bo'lgan butun zanjirni himoyalash: source (repo, review), dependency'lar, build tizimi, artifact (image), registry va deploy. Savol: "prod'da ishlayotgan narsa haqiqatan biz review qilgan kodmi?"

**Muammo (real hodisalar):** SolarWinds (2020 — build server buzilib, imzolangan update'ga backdoor), Codecov (CI skripti o'zgartirilib env secret'lar o'g'irlangan), `xz-utils` (2024 — maintainer sifatida kirgan hujumchi backdoor), `tj-actions/changed-files` (2025 — action tag'lari zararli commit'ga qayta yo'naltirildi).

**Qanday ishlaydi (hujum nuqtalari va himoya):**
```text
dev -> source -> deps -> build -> artifact -> registry -> deploy -> runtime
 |       |         |       |         |           |          |
MFA   branch    lockfile  ephemeral  SBOM,     imzo       admission
signed protect  pin, SCA  runner,    provenance (cosign)  policy (Kyverno)
commits review            SLSA
```

**Amalda (minimal zanjir):**
```bash
syft org/api:1.4.2 -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json      # nima ichida
grype sbom:sbom.json --fail-on high                    # zaifliklar
cosign sign --yes org/api@sha256:...                   # kim yaratdi
cosign attest --yes --type cyclonedx --predicate sbom.json org/api@sha256:...
# klasterda: Kyverno faqat imzolangan image'ni qabul qiladi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat CVE skanerlash = supply chain security deb o'ylash. Build tizimi buzilsa toza kodga ham backdoor tushadi.
- Tag bo'yicha deploy (`:1.4.2`) — tag qayta yozilishi mumkin; digest ishlat.
- CI'da uzoq muddatli cloud kalitlar — OIDC federation bilan almashtir.

**Senior nuqta:** Framework'lar: SLSA (build yaxlitligi darajalari), NIST SSDF, OpenSSF Scorecard. Hammasini birdan qilma: avval eng arzon yuqori foydali qadamlar — action pinning, branch protection, OIDC, imzolash + admission tekshiruv.

40668.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts) v1.0 Build track darajalari: **L1** — provenance mavjud (build qanday bo'lgani yozilgan, imzosiz bo'lishi mumkin); **L2** — hosted build platformasi imzolagan provenance; **L3** — mustahkamlangan (hardened) platforma: build'lar bir-biridan izolyatsiyalangan, imzo kaliti build kodi yeta olmaydigan joyda — provenance'ni soxtalashtirib bo'lmaydi. (L0 — hech narsa.)

**Muammo:** "Bu image qaysi commit'dan, qaysi tizimda build bo'lgan?" — buni isbotlay olmasang, buzilgan build'ni aniqlab bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**

| Daraja | Talab | Nimadan himoya |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | Provenance yaratiladi | Xato/tasodifiy build, kuzatuv |
| L2 | Hosted builder, imzolangan provenance | Build'dan keyin artifact almashtirish |
| L3 | Izolyatsiya, kalitlar build'dan himoyalangan | Build ichidan provenance soxtalash, cache poisoning |

**Amalda (GitHub Actions, L3 ga yaqin):**
```yaml
permissions: { id-token: write, attestations: write, contents: read }
steps:
  - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2
    with: { subject-path: dist/app.tar.gz }
```
yoki `slsa-framework/slsa-github-generator` reusable workflow. Tekshirish:
```bash
gh attestation verify dist/app.tar.gz --owner org
slsa-verifier verify-artifact app.tar.gz --provenance-path app.intoto.jsonl \
  --source-uri github.com/org/app --source-tag v1.4.2
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Provenance yaratib, uni hech kim **tekshirmasa** — foyda nol. Deploy paytida verify majburiy bo'lsin.
- SLSA v0.1 da L4 bor edi; v1.0 da Build track L3 gacha, L4 olib tashlangan (source track alohida ishlanmoqda).
- Self-hosted persistent runner bilan L3 da'vo qilish — izolyatsiya talabi bajarilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p tashkilot uchun realistik maqsad L2-L3: GitHub Actions/GitLab hosted runner + attestation + admission'da tekshiruv. SLSA build yaxlitligini beradi, lekin manba kodning o'zi zararli bo'lsa (xz kabi) — himoya qilmaydi.

40669.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Keyless signing — uzoq muddatli private key saqlamasdan imzolash: Cosign vaqtinchalik key pair yaratadi, OIDC token (GitHub Actions, Google, ...) bilan Fulcio'dan shu public key'ga identity bog'langan ~10 daqiqalik sertifikat oladi, artifact'ni imzolaydi, imzoni Rekor transparency log'ga yozadi va private key'ni tashlaydi.

**Muammo:** Klassik imzoda private key — eng qimmat secret: o'g'irlansa hujumchi hamma narsani imzolaydi, rotatsiya og'riqli. Keyless'da o'g'irlanadigan uzoq muddatli kalit yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
CI job --OIDC token (repo, workflow, ref)--> Fulcio
   |  ephemeral keypair                         | sertifikat (SAN = workflow identity, 10 min)
   v                                            v
 sign(image digest) --> imzo + cert --> Rekor (log entry, timestamp)
                                   --> registry (sha256-<digest>.sig)
verify: cert identity + issuer tekshiriladi, Rekor'da imzo sertifikat amal qilgan vaqtda qo'yilgani isbotlanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
permissions: { id-token: write, packages: write }
steps:
  - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3
  - run: cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/org/api@${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
```
```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc... \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/org/api/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Verify'da identity'ni tekshirmaslik (`--certificate-identity-regexp '.*'`) — har kim o'z GitHub akkauntidan imzolab o'tadi.
- Tag'ni imzolash — imzo digest'ga bog'lanadi; tag'ga emas, digest bo'yicha imzola va deploy qil.
- Public Rekor'ga yozish — repo nomi/identity ochiq bo'ladi; private loyihalar uchun xususiy Sigstore instance.

**Senior nuqta:** Keyless'da "kalit"ning o'rnini identity egallaydi: xavfsizlik endi CI workflow'ini kim o'zgartira olishiga bog'liq. Shuning uchun release workflow'ni branch protection va CODEOWNERS bilan himoyala.

40670.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Rekor — Sigstore'ning transparency log'i: imzo metadata'sini (artifact hash, imzo, sertifikat, attestation) append-only, Merkle tree asosidagi o'zgarmas jurnalga yozadi. Har kim yozuvni tekshira oladi va log'dan yozuvni jim o'chirib bo'lmaydi.

**Muammo:** Keyless sertifikat 10 daqiqada eskiradi. Bir oydan keyin "imzo sertifikat amal qilgan paytda qo'yilganmi?" — buni ishonchli vaqt belgisi isbotlaydi. Yana: kimdir sening identity'ing bilan imzolasa, sen buni log'ni monitoring qilib bilib olasan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
cosign sign --> Rekor: entry {hash, sig, cert} --> Merkle tree'ga qo'shiladi
             <-- SET / inclusion proof (signed timestamp, log index)
cosign verify --> inclusion proof tekshiriladi (offline ham bo'ladi, bundle bilan)
```
Certificate Transparency (TLS sertifikatlar uchun) bilan bir xil g'oya.

**Amalda:**
```bash
rekor-cli search --sha sha256:abc123...
rekor-cli get --log-index 123456789 --format json | jq .
# o'z identity'ingni kuzatish
rekor-cli search --email release@org.com
```
Cosign verify yozuvni avtomatik tekshiradi; air-gapped muhitda `--offline` bilan bundle ichidagi proof ishlatiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Public Rekor'ga yozilgan ma'lumot ochiq va o'chirilmaydi — private repo nomlari, email'lar sizib chiqadi.
- `--tlog-upload=false` bilan imzolab, verify'da log'ni talab qilish — verify yiqiladi (yoki aksincha xavfsizlik zaiflashadi).
- Log'ni yozish yetmaydi — anomaliyani bilish uchun o'z identity'ing bo'yicha monitoring (rekor-monitor) qo'y.

**Senior nuqta:** Transparency log'ning kuchi — oldini olishda emas, **aniqlashda**: kompromat yashirin qolmaydi. Enterprise'da o'z Rekor/Fulcio instance'ini (Sigstore scaffolding) yuritish — maxfiylik va mustaqillik, lekin operatsion yuk.

40671.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Fulcio — Sigstore'ning bepul code-signing Certificate Authority'si: OIDC identity'ni (email, GitHub Actions workflow, SPIFFE ID) tekshirib, shu identity'ni ephemeral public key'ga bog'laydigan qisqa muddatli (~10 daqiqa) X.509 sertifikat beradi.

**Muammo:** Klassik code-signing sertifikat qimmat, yillab amal qiladi va kalit boshqaruvi og'ir. Developer/CI uchun "men kimman" ni allaqachon IdP isbotlaydi — Fulcio buni sertifikatga aylantiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
client: keypair yaratadi
  --> Fulcio: {public key, OIDC token, proof-of-possession}
Fulcio: tokenni issuer bo'yicha tekshiradi (GitHub, Google, Microsoft, ...)
  <-- X.509 cert: SAN = identity, extension'larda issuer, repo, workflow, commit SHA
cert CT log'ga yoziladi; client imzolab, private key'ni o'chiradi
```
GitHub Actions sertifikatida: `Build Signer URI`, `Source Repository Digest`, `Runner Environment` kabi OID extension'lar — verify'da ularni tekshirish mumkin.

**Amalda:**
```bash
cosign verify org/api@sha256:... \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/org/api/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  --certificate-github-workflow-repository org/api
# sertifikatni ko'rish
cosign download signature org/api@sha256:... | jq -r .Cert | base64 -d | openssl x509 -text -noout
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sertifikat qisqa yashaydi — verify Rekor timestamp'iga tayanadi; log'siz verify ishlamaydi.
- Faqat issuer'ni tekshirish (GitHub) — har qanday GitHub repo o'tadi. Identity (repo + workflow + ref) aniq bo'lsin.
- Shaxsiy email bilan interaktiv imzo CI'da emas — CI'da workload identity ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Fulcio + Rekor birga "kalit egasi kim" savolini "qaysi workflow, qaysi commit" savoliga almashtiradi — bu provenance policy yozishni ancha soddalashtiradi.

40672.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Syft (Anchore) — SBOM generator: container image, papka, arxiv yoki binary ichidagi paketlarni (OS: apk/deb/rpm; til: npm, pip, Go modules, Maven, Cargo ...) aniqlab, CycloneDX, SPDX yoki o'z JSON formatida SBOM chiqaradi.

**Muammo:** Log4Shell (2021) paytida savol: "qaysi servislarimizda log4j bor?" SBOM bo'lmasa — har image'ni qo'lda ochib qidirish, kunlar ketadi. SBOM bilan — bitta qidiruv.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
image layers --> fayl tizimi katalogi --> cataloger'lar (dpkg db, package-lock.json, go buildinfo, jar manifest)
            --> paketlar ro'yxati (name, version, purl, license, location) --> CycloneDX/SPDX
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
syft ghcr.io/org/api:1.4.2                         # jadval
syft ghcr.io/org/api:1.4.2 -o cyclonedx-json=sbom.cdx.json -o spdx-json=sbom.spdx.json
syft dir:. -o cyclonedx-json                        # source kod
jq '.components[] | select(.name|test("log4j"))' sbom.cdx.json
# image'ga biriktirish
cosign attest --yes --type cyclonedx --predicate sbom.cdx.json ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:...
```
Chiqishda har paket uchun `purl` (`pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.21`) — skanerlar shu bo'yicha CVE topadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Statik binary'lar (Go'dan tashqari), vendored/copy qilingan kod, `curl | sh` bilan o'rnatilgan tool'lar — SBOM'da ko'rinmaydi.
- Multi-stage build'da final image SBOM'i build tool'larini ko'rsatmaydi — bu to'g'ri, lekin build provenance alohida.
- SBOM'ni yaratib saqlamaslik — incident vaqtida eski versiyalar uchun yo'q bo'ladi. Registry'da attestation sifatida yoki Dependency-Track'da saqla.

**Senior nuqta:** SBOM'ning qiymati — markazlashtirilgan saqlashda: barcha SBOM'larni Dependency-Track (yoki shunga o'xshash) ga yuborsang, yangi CVE chiqqanda "qayerda ta'sir bor" degan savolga daqiqalarda javob olasan. Buildkit `--sbom=true` ham SBOM yaratadi.

40673.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grype (Anchore) — ochiq kodli vulnerability scanner: image, papka yoki tayyor SBOM'dagi paketlarni zaiflik bazalari (NVD, GitHub Advisories, distro security feed'lari) bilan solishtirib CVE ro'yxatini beradi.

**Muammo:** Image'da yuzlab paket bor; qaysi birida ma'lum zaiflik borligini va tuzatilgan versiya mavjudmi — buni avtomatik bilish kerak, ayniqsa CI gate sifatida.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
image/dir --(ichki syft)--> paketlar ---+
SBOM fayl ------------------------------+--> moslashtirish (purl, CPE, distro version)
                     grype DB (kunlik yangilanadi) --+
                                                     v
                         CVE, severity, fixed-in, EPSS/KEV
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
grype ghcr.io/org/api:1.4.2
# NAME      INSTALLED  FIXED-IN  TYPE  VULNERABILITY   SEVERITY
# openssl   3.0.11     3.0.13    apk   CVE-2024-0727   Medium
grype sbom:./sbom.cdx.json --only-fixed --fail-on high
grype db update && grype db status
```
`.grype.yaml` da ignore (sabab bilan):
```yaml
ignore:
  - vulnerability: CVE-2023-XXXX
    reason: "kod yo'li ishlatilmaydi, VEX bilan tasdiqlangan"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `FIXED-IN` bo'sh CVE'lar uchun gate qo'yish — tuzatish yo'q, pipeline abadiy qizil. `--only-fixed` ishlat.
- Offline/air-gapped CI'da DB yangilanmasa — eski natija. DB yoshini monitor qil.
- Grype va Trivy natijalari farq qiladi (turli manba va matching) — ikkalasini bir-biriga solishtirib "qaysi to'g'ri" deb vaqt yo'qotma, bittasini standart qil.

**Senior nuqta:** SBOM'ni bir marta yaratib, uni qayta-qayta Grype bilan skanerlash (image'ni qayta yuklamasdan) — eski relizlarni yangi CVE'larga arzon tekshirish usuli. Prioritet uchun severity emas, KEV (aktiv exploit) va EPSS dan foydalan.

40674.a:
**Qisqa javob:** in-toto (CNCF graduated) — supply chain'ning har qadamini (checkout, test, build, package) kim bajargani va qanday input/output bilan bajarganini kriptografik attestation sifatida yozish va oxirida butun zanjir oldindan belgilangan **layout** (siyosat) ga mosligini tekshirish framework'i. Bugun uning **attestation formati** (Statement + Predicate) SLSA, Cosign, GitHub attestations'da standart.

**Muammo:** Har qadam alohida xavfsiz bo'lishi mumkin, lekin qadamlar orasida artifact almashtirilsa (build'dan keyin, packaging'dan oldin) — buni hech kim sezmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
layout (project owner imzolagan):
  step "build": faqat ci-key imzolaydi, material = src/*, product = app.bin
  step "package": material = app.bin (build product'iga teng bo'lishi shart)
har qadam --> link metadata {materials hashes, products hashes, command} + imzo
verify: imzolar + hash zanjiri layout'ga mosmi?
```
Attestation tuzilishi:
```json
{ "_type": "https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1",
  "subject": [{ "name": "ghcr.io/org/api", "digest": { "sha256": "abc..." } }],
  "predicateType": "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1",
  "predicate": { "buildDefinition": { }, "runDetails": { } } }
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
in-toto-run --step-name build --key ci.key --materials src --products app.bin -- make build
in-toto-verify --layout root.layout --layout-keys owner.pub
```
Amalda ko'pincha to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, Cosign/Witness/GitHub attestations orqali ishlatiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Attestation yig'ib, layout/policy bilan tekshirmaslik — hujjat bor, himoya yo'q.
- Har qadam uchun alohida kalit boshqaruvi og'ir — keyless (Sigstore) bilan birga ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** in-toto — "til" (format), SLSA — "nima yozilishi kerakligi" (provenance predicate), Sigstore — "qanday imzolanadi", Kyverno/OPA — "qayerda tekshiriladi". Bu to'rttasini bir zanjir sifatida tushuntira olish — senior signal.

40675.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kyverno image verification — `verifyImages` qoidasi: admission webhook pod yaratilishidan oldin image imzosini (Cosign key yoki keyless identity, Notary) va attestation'larni (SBOM, SLSA provenance, vuln scan) tekshiradi; mos kelmasa so'rov rad etiladi. Qo'shimcha: tag'ni digest'ga almashtiradi (`mutateDigest`).

**Muammo:** Image'ni imzolash foydasiz, agar klaster imzosiz image'ni ham ishga tushiraversa. Tekshiruv nuqtasi — admission.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
kubectl apply pod --> kube-api --> Kyverno admission webhook
                                    |  cosign verify (registry + Rekor)
                                    |  identity/issuer mos? attestation shartlari?
                              allow (+ image digest bilan) / deny
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata: { name: verify-signed-images }
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce
  webhookTimeoutSeconds: 30
  rules:
    - name: keyless
      match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Pod] } }] }
      verifyImages:
        - imageReferences: ["ghcr.io/org/*"]
          mutateDigest: true
          attestors:
            - entries:
                - keyless:
                    subject: "https://github.com/org/*/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/*"
                    issuer: "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
                    rekor: { url: https://rekor.sigstore.dev }
```
```bash
kubectl run t --image=ghcr.io/org/api:unsigned
# Error from server: admission webhook "mutate.kyverno.svc-fail" denied the request: ... signature mismatch
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Avval `Audit` rejimida ishga tushir — darhol `Enforce` system pod'larni ham bloklashi mumkin; `kube-system` ni exclude qil.
- Webhook `failurePolicy: Fail` + Kyverno yiqilsa — klasterda hech narsa schedule bo'lmaydi. Kyverno'ni HA qilib ishlat.
- Registry rate limit va tarmoq kechikishi — verify natijalari cache'lanadi, lekin timeout'ni sozla.

**Senior nuqta:** Yangi versiyalarda Kyverno'da alohida `ImageValidatingPolicy` (CEL asosida) ham bor. Muqobil: Sigstore policy-controller, Connaisseur, Ratify (Gatekeeper bilan). Qaysi tool bo'lmasin — identity'ni aniq pin qilish asosiy.

40676.a:
