**Qisqa javob:** Nx (Nrwl) — monorepo build tizimi va framework: loyiha/dependency graph (kod importlarini tahlil qilib avtomatik), `affected` buyruqlari, lokal va remote cache (Nx Cloud yoki self-hosted), **distributed task execution** (task'larni bir nechta CI agent'ga taqsimlash), kod generatorlari va plugin'lar (React, Angular, Node, Go, Gradle ...).

**Muammo:** Katta monorepo'da faqat "tez build" emas, arxitektura nazorati ham kerak: qaysi paket qaysi biriga bog'lanishi mumkin, yangi servisni standart shaklda yaratish, CI'ni ko'p mashinaga bo'lish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
nx graph -> projects + deps (import tahlili, package.json, plugin'lar)
nx affected -t test --base=main
   -> affected projects -> task graph -> cache (lokal/remote)
   -> Nx Agents: task'lar N ta CI mashinaga bo'linadi
module boundaries: tag'lar bo'yicha lint qoidasi (scope:billing -> scope:auth taqiqlangan)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
npx create-nx-workspace@latest org
npx nx graph                                   # brauzerda vizual graph
npx nx affected -t lint test build --base=origin/main --parallel=3
npx nx g @nx/node:application services/api     # generator
npx nx show project api --web
```
`nx.json`:
```json
{ "targetDefaults": { "build": { "dependsOn": ["^build"], "cache": true } },
  "namedInputs": { "production": ["default", "!{projectRoot}/**/*.spec.ts"] } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Nx plugin'lari va generatorlariga ko'p tayanish — framework versiyasi Nx versiyasiga bog'lanib qoladi; yangilash `nx migrate` bilan.
- `namedInputs` noto'g'ri — test fayl o'zgarishi production build cache'ini bekor qiladi yoki aksincha.
- Remote cache (Nx Cloud) tijoriy; self-hosted variantlar shartlarini tekshir.

**Senior nuqta:** Nx vs Turborepo: Nx — ko'proq imkoniyat (boundaries, generatorlar, distributed execution), ko'proq konvensiya; Turborepo — sodda va yengil. Tanlov jamoa hajmi va kerakli boshqaruv darajasiga bog'liq.

40719.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Git pre-commit hook — `.git/hooks/pre-commit` dagi skript: `git commit` paytida commit yaratilishidan **oldin** lokal ishga tushadi; nol bo'lmagan exit code commit'ni to'xtatadi. Odatda format, lint, secret skanerlash, katta fayl tekshiruvi. U majburiy emas: `git commit --no-verify` bilan o'tkazib yuboriladi.

**Muammo:** Formatlash xatosi yoki tasodifan commit qilingan `.env` CI'da 10 daqiqadan keyin topiladi (yoki secret allaqachon push qilingan). Lokal hook buni soniyalarda ushlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
git commit
  -> pre-commit (staged fayllar)  -- exit 1 --> commit bekor
  -> prepare-commit-msg -> commit-msg (xabar formati) -> commit yaratildi
  -> post-commit
git push -> pre-push
```
`.git/hooks/` repo bilan **klonlanmaydi** — har developer o'zi o'rnatadi (shuning uchun `pre-commit`, husky, lefthook kabi tool'lar).

**Amalda:**
```bash
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM -- '*.go')
[ -z "$files" ] || gofmt -l $files | (! grep .) || { echo "gofmt kerak"; exit 1; }
gitleaks protect --staged --redact
EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
git config core.hooksPath .githooks     # repo ichidagi umumiy hook papkasi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hook'ga ishonib CI'da tekshirmaslik — `--no-verify` yoki hook o'rnatilmagan mashina. Har tekshiruv CI'da takrorlanishi shart.
- Sekin hook (butun test suite) — developer'lar `--no-verify`ni odat qiladi. Faqat staged fayllar, soniyalar.
- Staged va working tree farqi: hook working tree'dagi faylni tekshirsa, commit'ga boshqa versiya tushadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Pre-commit — developer tajribasi uchun (tez feedback), xavfsizlik nazorati uchun emas. Server tomonda: push protection (GitHub secret scanning), branch protection va CI check'lar majburiy qatlam.

40720.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `pre-commit` (pre-commit.com) — Python'da yozilgan ko'p tilli hook menejeri: `.pre-commit-config.yaml` da hook'lar repo URL va **versiya (rev)** bilan e'lon qilinadi, tool o'zi ularni izolyatsiyalangan muhitga o'rnatadi va faqat staged fayllarga ishga tushiradi. Hook'lar repo bilan birga versiyalanadi.

**Muammo:** Qo'lda yozilgan `.git/hooks` skriptlari klonlanmaydi, har developer'da boshqa tool versiyasi, Python/Node/Go hook'larini o'rnatish og'riqli.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# .pre-commit-config.yaml
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v5.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
      - id: check-added-large-files
        args: [--maxkb=500]
      - id: check-yaml
  - repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks
    rev: v8.21.2
    hooks: [{ id: gitleaks }]
  - repo: https://github.com/antonbabenko/pre-commit-terraform
    rev: v1.96.2
    hooks: [{ id: terraform_fmt }, { id: terraform_validate }]
```
```bash
pipx install pre-commit
pre-commit install                    # .git/hooks/pre-commit ni o'rnatadi
pre-commit install --hook-type commit-msg
pre-commit run --all-files            # butun repo bo'yicha (CI'da ham shu)
pre-commit autoupdate                 # rev'larni yangilash
```
CI'da: `pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure` yoki pre-commit.ci xizmati.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `rev` sifatida mutable tag — teoriyada qayta yozilishi mumkin; yuqori xavfsizlik talabida commit SHA (`autoupdate --freeze`).
- Yangi hook qo'shib `--all-files` ishga tushirmaslik — eski fayllar keyingi tegilganda kutilmaganda "yiqiladi".
- Har developer `pre-commit install` qilishini unutadi — CI tekshiruvi baribir kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Yagona `.pre-commit-config.yaml` ham lokal, ham CI uchun manba bo'lsa — "menda o'tdi, CI'da yiqildi" holatlari yo'qoladi. JS loyihalarda muqobil: husky + lint-staged; tez, ko'p tilli muqobil: lefthook.

40721.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Trunk-based development'da feature flag lifecycle: 1) flag yaratiladi (nomi, egasi, tozalash muddati bilan), 2) yangi kod flag ortida (default OFF) kichik PR'lar bilan `main`ga merge qilinadi, 3) prod'ga deploy (kod bor, lekin o'chiq), 4) bosqichma-bosqich yoqiladi (ichki xodimlar -> 5% -> 100%), 5) barqaror bo'lgach flag va eski kod yo'li **o'chiriladi**.

**Muammo:** Trunk-based'da uzoq yashovchi branch yo'q — tugallanmagan feature ham main'ga tushadi. Flag uni foydalanuvchidan yashiradi. Lekin tozalanmagan flag'lar texnik qarzga aylanadi (Knight Capital 2012: eski flag qayta ishlatilib $440M yo'qotish).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
create flag (owner, expiry) -> code behind flag -> merge main -> deploy (OFF)
   -> enable: internal -> 5% -> 50% -> 100%   (har qadamda metrika)
   -> remove flag + old path (PR) -> flag config'dan o'chirish
```

**Amalda (OpenFeature, Go):**
```go
client := openfeature.NewClient("checkout")
ctx := openfeature.NewEvaluationContext(userID, map[string]any{"country": "UZ"})
if ok, _ := client.BooleanValue(context.Background(), "new-checkout-flow", false, ctx); ok {
    return newCheckout(req)
}
return oldCheckout(req)
```
Tozalashni majburlash: flag'da `expires: 2026-12-01`, CI'da muddati o'tgan flag'lar uchun ogohlantirish (yoki LaunchDarkly/Unleash "stale flag" hisobotlari).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default qiymat noto'g'ri (`true`) — flag servisi ishlamasa tugallanmagan feature hammaga yoqiladi.
- Flag'lar bir-biriga bog'liq (A yoqilgan va B o'chiq) — test kombinatsiyalari portlaydi.
- Release flag va uzoq muddatli ops/permission flag'larini aralashtirish — har biri boshqa lifecycle'ga ega.

**Senior nuqta:** Flag turlarini ajrat: release (qisqa, kunlar-haftalar), experiment (A/B), ops/kill switch (uzoq), permission (doimiy). Faqat release flag'lar uchun qat'iy tozalash muddati — bu qarzni nazoratda ushlaydi.

40722.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Dark launch** — yangi kodni prod'ga chiqarish, lekin foydalanuvchilar uni ko'rmaydi (flag ortida yoki faqat ichki chaqiruvlar, ba'zan real so'rovlar bilan "fon"da ishlaydi). **Shadowing (traffic mirroring)** — jonli kiruvchi so'rovlarni nusxalab yangi versiyaga ham yuborish; foydalanuvchiga faqat eski versiya javobi qaytadi, yangisining javobi tashlanadi (yoki solishtiriladi).

**Muammo:** Yangi versiya real yuklama va real ma'lumot shakllarida qanday ishlashini foydalanuvchiga ta'sir qilmasdan bilish kerak (yangi DB, qayta yozilgan servis).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
shadowing:
client --> proxy (Istio/Envoy/NGINX) --> v1 --> javob client'ga
                     \--copy (fire-and-forget)--> v2 --> javob tashlanadi, metrika/diff
dark launch:
client --> app (flag OFF uchun user'lar) --> eski yo'l
                 + fon: yangi yo'l ham chaqiriladi yoki faqat internal user'larga ON
```

**Amalda (Istio mirroring):**
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1
kind: VirtualService
metadata: { name: search }
spec:
  hosts: [search]
  http:
    - route: [{ destination: { host: search, subset: v1 }, weight: 100 }]
      mirror: { host: search, subset: v2 }
      mirrorPercentage: { value: 10.0 }
```
NGINX: `mirror /mirror;` direktivasi.

| | Dark launch | Shadowing |
|---|---|---|
| Qatlam | Ilova (flag) | Tarmoq (proxy) |
| Real user ko'radimi | Tanlangan guruh ko'rishi mumkin | Hech qachon |
| Asosiy maqsad | Kod prod'da, release keyin | Yangi versiyani real trafik bilan sinash |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Mirror qilingan yozish so'rovlari (POST /payment) — yangi versiya ham to'lov qiladi yoki xat yuboradi! Shadow'da side effect'larni o'chir yoki faqat read so'rovlar.
- Shadow trafik yuklamani oshiradi — umumiy DB/downstream'lar ikki baravar yuk oladi.
- Mirror javoblari tashlanadi — xatolarni ko'rish uchun alohida metrika/diff (Diffy kabi) kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Shadowing — qayta yozish (rewrite) va migratsiyalar uchun eng kuchli xavfsiz vosita: eski va yangi javoblarni solishtirib, farq foizini nolga tushirgandan keyingina canary'ga o't.

40723.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Provenance — artifact (image, binary) qanday paydo bo'lgani haqidagi imzolangan, tekshiriladigan metadata: qaysi source repo va **commit SHA**dan, qaysi build platformasi va workflow'da, qanday parametrlar va dependency'lar bilan, qachon build qilingan. Standart format — SLSA Provenance (in-toto attestation).

**Muammo:** Registry'da `api:1.5.0` turibdi. U haqiqatan bizning CI'da, review qilingan main branch'dan build qilinganmi yoki kimdir noutbukidan push qilganmi? Provenance'siz — bilib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
build platformasi (GitHub Actions) --> provenance:
  subject:  ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc
  builder:  https://github.com/actions/runner (github-hosted)
  source:   git+https://github.com/org/api@refs/tags/v1.5.0, commit 9f1e...
  workflow: .github/workflows/release.yml, inputs, start/finish vaqt
--> imzo (Sigstore) --> registry/Rekor
deploy/admission: provenance'ni tekshir -> repo == org/api, ref == tag, builder ishonchli?
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
permissions: { id-token: write, attestations: write, packages: write, contents: read }
steps:
  - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
    id: push
    with: { push: true, tags: ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 }
  - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2
    with: { subject-name: ghcr.io/org/api, subject-digest: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}, push-to-registry: true }
```
```bash
gh attestation verify oci://ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 --owner org
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Provenance'ni build skripti o'zi yozsa (platforma emas) — buzilgan build soxta provenance yozadi (SLSA L1). Platforma yaratgan va imzolagan bo'lsin (L2/L3).
- Faqat yaratish, tekshirmaslik — hujjat bor, nazorat yo'q.
- Provenance'dagi source'ga ishonish — source'ning o'zi review qilinganini (branch protection) alohida ta'minlash kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Provenance incident response'da ham bebaho: "zararli image qaysi commit, qaysi run'dan?" savoliga darhol javob. Policy'da eng muhim tekshiruvlar — source repo, ref (tag/main) va builder identity.

40724.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CycloneDX — OWASP Foundation'ning BOM (Bill of Materials) standarti (ECMA-424): komponentlar (paketlar, purl, hash, litsenziya), dependency graph, servislar va zaifliklar haqidagi ma'lumotni JSON/XML/Protobuf'da ifodalaydi. Xavfsizlik va zaiflik boshqaruviga yo'naltirilgan; SBOM'dan tashqari SaaSBOM, HBOM, ML-BOM, CBOM (kriptografiya) va VEX'ni ham qo'llaydi.

**Muammo:** Turli tool'lar (Syft, Trivy, Grype, Dependency-Track) bir-birining SBOM'ini tushunishi uchun umumiy format kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi (minimal hujjat):**
```json
{
  "bomFormat": "CycloneDX",
  "specVersion": "1.6",
  "metadata": { "component": { "type": "container", "name": "org/api", "version": "1.5.0" } },
  "components": [
    { "type": "library", "name": "golang.org/x/net", "version": "v0.30.0",
      "purl": "pkg:golang/golang.org/x/net@v0.30.0",
      "licenses": [{ "license": { "id": "BSD-3-Clause" } }] }
  ],
  "dependencies": [{ "ref": "pkg:golang/org/api", "dependsOn": ["pkg:golang/golang.org/x/net@v0.30.0"] }]
}
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
syft ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.cdx.json
trivy image --format cyclonedx --output sbom.cdx.json ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0
cyclonedx validate --input-file sbom.cdx.json
# Dependency-Track'ga yuklash (doimiy monitoring)
curl -X POST https://dtrack.org.com/api/v1/bom -H "X-Api-Key: $KEY" \
  -F project=$UUID -F bom=@sbom.cdx.json
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `purl` bo'lmagan komponentlar — skanerlar ularni CVE bazasiga moslay olmaydi.
- Spec versiyalari farqi (1.4/1.5/1.6) — iste'molchi tool qo'llamasligi mumkin.
- SBOM build'dan keyin emas, artifact'ning o'zidan yaratilsin — aks holda "nima reja qilingan"ni ko'rsatadi, "nima yetkazilgan"ni emas.

**Senior nuqta:** CycloneDX vs SPDX: CycloneDX xavfsizlik use-case'lariga (VEX, zaifliklar, servislar) qulayroq, SPDX litsenziya/compliance va ISO standarti sifatida kuchli. Ko'p tool ikkalasini chiqaradi; mijoz/regulator talabiga qarab tanla.

40725.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SPDX (Software Package Data Exchange) — Linux Foundation standarti, **ISO/IEC 5962:2021**: dasturiy paketlar, fayllar, ular orasidagi munosabatlar, litsenziyalar va copyright haqidagi ma'lumotni almashish formati (tag-value, JSON, YAML, RDF). Litsenziya identifikatorlari (`Apache-2.0`, `MIT`) ham SPDX License List'dan keladi. SPDX 3.0 (2024) — profillarga (Security, Build, AI, Dataset) bo'lingan yangi model.

**Muammo:** Kompaniya mahsulotidagi barcha open source litsenziyalarini bilishi kerak (GPL kodi yopiq mahsulotda — huquqiy risk); AQSh EO 14028 kabi talablar SBOM'ni so'raydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (JSON fragment, SPDX 2.3):**
```json
{
  "spdxVersion": "SPDX-2.3",
  "dataLicense": "CC0-1.0",
  "SPDXID": "SPDXRef-DOCUMENT",
  "name": "org-api-1.5.0",
  "packages": [
    { "SPDXID": "SPDXRef-Package-net", "name": "golang.org/x/net", "versionInfo": "v0.30.0",
      "licenseConcluded": "BSD-3-Clause",
      "externalRefs": [{ "referenceCategory": "PACKAGE-MANAGER", "referenceType": "purl",
                         "referenceLocator": "pkg:golang/golang.org/x/net@v0.30.0" }] }
  ],
  "relationships": [{ "spdxElementId": "SPDXRef-DOCUMENT", "relationshipType": "DESCRIBES",
                      "relatedSpdxElement": "SPDXRef-Package-net" }]
}
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
syft ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 -o spdx-json > sbom.spdx.json
docker buildx build --sbom=true -t org/api:1.5.0 --push .   # BuildKit SPDX attestation
jq -r '.packages[] | "\(.name) \(.licenseConcluded)"' sbom.spdx.json | sort -u
```
Kod fayllarida: `// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `NOASSERTION` litsenziyalar — tool aniqlay olmagan; compliance uchun qo'lda ko'rib chiqish kerak.
- SPDX 2.x va 3.0 tuzilishi ancha farq qiladi — tool qo'llovini tekshir.
- Faqat SBOM yaratish litsenziya muammosini hal qilmaydi — policy (ruxsat etilgan litsenziyalar ro'yxati) va tekshiruv kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** SPDX — huquqiy/compliance jamoalar va davlat xaridlari tilida gapiradi; CycloneDX — xavfsizlik jamoalari tilida. Supply chain dasturida ko'pincha ikkalasini ham yaratib saqlash eng arzon yo'l.

40726.a:
**Qisqa javob:** VEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) — mashina o'qiy oladigan hujjat: ma'lum bir mahsulotga nisbatan aniq CVE'ning holatini bildiradi — `not_affected` (sabab bilan), `affected`, `fixed`, `under_investigation`. Maqsad: SBOM + scanner bergan yuzlab "nazariy" zaifliklardan haqiqatan muhimlarini ajratish. Formatlar: OpenVEX, CycloneDX VEX, CSAF VEX.

**Muammo:** Scanner image'da 200 CVE ko'rsatadi. Ko'pchiligi ishlatilmaydigan funksiyada yoki kompilyatsiya qilinmagan kodda. Har mijoz/audit bir xil savolni beradi; jamoa har safar qo'lda tushuntiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
SBOM (komponentlar) + scanner (CVE ro'yxati)
   + VEX (vendor bayonoti: CVE-X not_affected, vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path)
   --> filtrlangan natija: faqat affected/under_investigation
```
`not_affected` asoslari (justification): `component_not_present`, `vulnerable_code_not_present`, `vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path`, `vulnerable_code_cannot_be_controlled_by_adversary`, `inline_mitigations_already_exist`.

**Amalda (OpenVEX):**
```json
{
  "@context": "https://openvex.dev/ns/v0.2.0",
  "@id": "https://org.com/vex/api-1.5.0",
  "author": "security@org.com",
  "timestamp": "2026-10-01T10:00:00Z",
  "statements": [{
    "vulnerability": { "name": "CVE-2024-45338" },
    "products": [{ "@id": "pkg:oci/api@sha256:abc..." }],
    "status": "not_affected",
    "justification": "vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path",
    "impact_statement": "html tokenizer ishlatilmaydi"
  }]
}
```
```bash
vexctl create --product pkg:oci/api@sha256:abc --vuln CVE-2024-45338 \
  --status not_affected --justification vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path > api.vex.json
trivy image --vex api.vex.json ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0
grype ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0 --vex api.vex.json
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `not_affected`ni asossiz qo'yish — bu xavfli yolg'on; har bayonotni texnik dalil (reachability tahlili) bilan qo'llab-quvvatla.
- VEX ma'lum mahsulot versiyasiga bog'langan — kod o'zgarsa qayta baholash kerak.
- Imzolanmagan VEX — har kim CVE'larni "yopib" qo'yishi mumkin; attestation sifatida imzola.

**Senior nuqta:** VEX — triage natijasini qayta ishlatiladigan aktivga aylantiradi. `govulncheck` kabi reachability tool'lari VEX yaratishni avtomatlashtirishi mumkin. VEX bilan CVE shovqini kamayadi va jamoa haqiqiy riskka e'tibor beradi.

40727.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SLSA provenance — SLSA spec'idagi in-toto attestation predicate turi (`https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1`): artifact qaysi **build platformasi** (`builder.id`), qaysi **build ta'rifi** (buildType, externalParameters: repo, ref, workflow), qaysi **resolvedDependencies** (source commit, base image) bilan yaratilganini yozadi. Build platformasi yaratib imzolaydi.

**Muammo:** "Provenance" umumiy so'z; SLSA uni aniq sxema bilan standartlashtiradi — shunda verifier (slsa-verifier, Kyverno, `gh attestation`) har qanday platformaning provenance'ini bir xil qoidalar bilan tekshira oladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```json
{
  "_type": "https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1",
  "subject": [{ "name": "ghcr.io/org/api", "digest": { "sha256": "abc..." } }],
  "predicateType": "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1",
  "predicate": {
    "buildDefinition": {
      "buildType": "https://actions.github.io/buildtypes/workflow/v1",
      "externalParameters": { "workflow": { "repository": "https://github.com/org/api",
                                            "ref": "refs/tags/v1.5.0", "path": ".github/workflows/release.yml" } },
      "resolvedDependencies": [{ "uri": "git+https://github.com/org/api@refs/tags/v1.5.0",
                                 "digest": { "gitCommit": "9f1e..." } }]
    },
    "runDetails": { "builder": { "id": "https://github.com/actions/runner/github-hosted" },
                    "metadata": { "invocationId": "https://github.com/org/api/actions/runs/123" } }
  }
}
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
slsa-verifier verify-image ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc... \
  --source-uri github.com/org/api --source-tag v1.5.0
cosign verify-attestation --type slsaprovenance1 \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/org/' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com ghcr.io/org/api@sha256:abc...
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- v0.2 va v1 predicate formatlari farq qiladi (`predicateType` URI boshqa) — verifier qaysi birini kutishini bil.
- `externalParameters`ni tekshirmaslik — boshqa branch yoki fork'dan build ham o'tadi.
- Provenance image digest'iga bog'langan; tag'ni qayta push qilsang eski provenance yangi image'ga tegishli emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Provenance tekshiruvining kuchi — "faqat shu repo, shu workflow, protected ref'dan, ishonchli builder'da build qilingan narsa prod'ga chiqadi" degan bitta qoidada. Bu qoida bilan hatto registry credential'i o'g'irlansa ham soxta image deploy bo'lmaydi.

40728.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Docker Content Trust (DCT) — Notary v1 / The Update Framework (TUF) asosidagi Docker imzo mexanizmi: `DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1` bo'lsa `docker push` tag'ni imzolaydi, `docker pull` esa faqat imzolangan tag'larni oladi. Bugun u **eskirgan** (Notary v1 deyarli rivojlanmaydi, Docker Hub'da qo'llov kamaymoqda); zamonaviy alternativalar — Sigstore Cosign va Notary Project **Notation** (Notary v2).

**Muammo:** Registry yoki tarmoq buzilsa, `nginx:1.27` tag'i ostida boshqa image berilishi mumkin. Imzo publisher va yaxlitlikni isbotlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (DCT):**
```text
docker push (DCT=1) --> root key + repository (targets) key bilan tag->digest imzosi
                    --> Notary server (TUF metadata: root, targets, snapshot, timestamp)
docker pull (DCT=1) --> Notary'dan imzolangan tag->digest --> faqat shu digest pull
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
export DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1
docker trust key generate alice
docker trust signer add --key alice.pub alice org/api
docker push org/api:1.5.0          # imzolaydi
docker trust inspect --pretty org/api:1.5.0
```
Zamonaviy ekvivalent:
```bash
cosign sign --yes org/api@sha256:...                        # Sigstore
notation sign --key mykey org/api@sha256:...                # Notation (X.509, KMS)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DCT faqat Docker CLI darajasida ishlaydi — Kubernetes (containerd) uni tekshirmaydi; klaster himoyasi uchun admission policy kerak.
- Root key yo'qolsa repository imzosini tiklash juda og'ir; offline saqlash shart edi.
- DCT imzosi registry'ga emas, alohida Notary serverga bog'langan — ko'p registry'lar (ECR, GHCR) uni qo'llamaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Yangi tizimda DCT'ni tanlama. Tanlov Cosign (keyless, Sigstore ekotizimi, OSS'da keng) va Notation (X.509 PKI, korporativ CA va Azure/AWS signer integratsiyasi) orasida; ikkalasi OCI referrers orqali imzoni registry'da saqlaydi.

40729.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pipeline deadlock — ikki yoki undan ko'p job/pipeline bir-birini kutib, hech biri oldinga siljiy olmaydigan holat: A resurs 1 ni (lock, runner, muhit) ushlab resurs 2 ni kutadi, B esa resurs 2 ni ushlab resurs 1 ni kutadi. Natija — pipeline'lar timeout'gacha (yoki abadiy) osilib turadi.

**Muammo:** Real misollar: ikki deploy pipeline staging va prod lock'larini teskari tartibda oladi; parent job barcha runner'larni band qilib, child job'lar uchun runner qolmaydi; Terraform state lock'ini yiqilgan job qo'yib ketdi va hamma kutadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
Pipeline A: lock(staging) ... lock(prod)  <- kutyapti
Pipeline B: lock(prod)    ... lock(staging) <- kutyapti
                 ^ sikl = deadlock

Runner starvation:
4 runner: 4 ta parent job ishlab turibdi, har biri child job'ni kutadi -> child'ga runner yo'q
```

**Amalda (oldini olish):**
```yaml
# GitHub Actions: muhit bo'yicha bitta concurrency group, timeout majburiy
concurrency: { group: deploy-${{ inputs.env }}, cancel-in-progress: false }
jobs:
  deploy:
    timeout-minutes: 30
```
```bash
# Terraform: osilib qolgan lock'ni tekshirib ochish (ehtiyot bilan)
terraform force-unlock <LOCK_ID>
# GitLab: resource_group bir vaqtda bitta job
# .gitlab-ci.yml -> deploy_prod: { resource_group: production }
```
Qoidalar: lock'larni doim bir xil global tartibda olish; trigger/child pipeline'lar uchun alohida runner pool; har job va lock'da timeout.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Timeout'siz job'lar — deadlock sezilmaydi, faqat "CI sekin" shikoyati.
- `cancel-in-progress: true` deploy'da — yarim qolgan deploy; deploy'larda navbat (false) yaxshiroq.
- Lock'ni qo'lda majburan ochish, boshqa job hali ishlayotganda — state buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Deadlock'ni klassik shartlar (mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no preemption, circular wait) orqali tahlil qil va bittasini buz: odatda aylanma kutishni lock tartibi bilan, hold-and-wait'ni esa "hamma lock'ni birdaniga ol yoki hech birini" bilan.

40730.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CI/CD blast radius — CI/CD tizimi (runner, pipeline, credential, plugin) buzilsa yoki xato ishlasa yetkazilishi mumkin bo'lgan maksimal zarar: qaysi muhitlar, akkauntlar, secret'lar va ma'lumotlarga yeta oladi. CI/CD odatda eng imtiyozli tizim, shuning uchun uning blast radius'ini ataylab kichraytirish kerak.

**Muammo:** Bitta Jenkins serverida barcha prod cloud kalitlari, kubeconfig'lar va DB parollari. Zaif plugin yoki zararli PR -> butun kompaniya infratuzilmasi (Codecov, CircleCI 2023 hodisalari).

**Qanday ishlaydi (kamaytirish qatlamlari):**
```text
katta:   CI (admin kalit hamma akkauntga) --push--> prod
kichik:  CI: faqat build + image push (registry'ga yozish)
         prod klaster ichidagi ArgoCD/Flux --pull--> Git   (prod credential CI'da yo'q)
         OIDC: job -> 15 daqiqalik role, faqat shu repo/branch/environment uchun
         runner: ephemeral, alohida pool (untrusted PR vs release)
         environment protection: prod uchun approval + faqat main
```

**Amalda (AWS role trust, faqat main'dagi release workflow):**
```json
"Condition": {
  "StringEquals": {
    "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
    "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub": "repo:org/api:environment:production"
  }
}
```
```yaml
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production         # required reviewers, faqat protected branch
    permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bitta "ci-admin" IAM user hamma repo uchun — bitta repo buzilsa hammasi buziladi. Repo/muhit bo'yicha alohida role.
- `sub` claim'ni wildcard (`repo:org/*`) — har qanday repo, har qanday branch prod role'ni oladi.
- Self-hosted runner'lar prod VPC ichida — runner buzilsa tarmoq ichidan hujum.

**Senior nuqta:** Savol: "Eng kam ishonchli kod (fork PR, yangi dependency) qaysi eng qimmat secret'ga yeta oladi?" Javob "hech qaysi" bo'lmaguncha arxitekturani o'zgartir. Pull-based GitOps + OIDC + ephemeral izolyatsiyalangan runner'lar — eng ta'sirli uchlik.

40731.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Argo Rollouts'da avtomatik rollback: canary bosqichidagi `AnalysisRun` muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa (failureLimit oshsa) Rollout **abort** qilinadi — trafik darhol 100% stable ReplicaSet'ga qaytariladi, canary ReplicaSet 0 ga scale qilinadi va Rollout `Degraded` holatiga o'tadi. Inson aralashuvi shart emas.

**Muammo:** Kechasi 3 da chiqqan reliz error rate'ni 8% ga oshirdi. Inson alert'ni ko'rib, tahlil qilib, rollback qilguncha 20-30 daqiqa. Avtomatik analiz buni 1-3 daqiqada qiladi va faqat canary ulushiga ta'sir qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
setWeight 20 -> AnalysisRun (har 1m, 5 marta)
   success-rate: 0.995 ok, 0.97 FAIL, 0.96 FAIL  (failureLimit: 1 -> oshdi)
   -> AnalysisRun Failed -> Rollout abort
   -> trafik: stable 100%, canary 0 -> status Degraded
```
Background analysis (butun rollout davomida) yoki inline analysis step ishlatiladi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
strategy:
  canary:
    analysis:                      # background: 2-qadamdan boshlab doimiy
      templates: [{ templateName: success-rate }]
      startingStep: 1
      args: [{ name: service, value: api-canary }]
    steps:
      - setWeight: 10
      - pause: { duration: 5m }
      - setWeight: 30
      - pause: { duration: 10m }
      - setWeight: 100
```
```bash
kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api
# Status: Degraded  Message: RolloutAborted: metric "success-rate" assessed Failed
kubectl argo rollouts retry rollout api      # tuzatgandan keyin qayta urinish
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Abort'dan keyin Git'da hali yangi image tag turibdi — ArgoCD keyingi sync'da Rollout spec'ini o'zgartirmaydi, lekin keyingi o'zgarish qayta canary boshlaydi. Git'ni revert qil.
- To'liq promote bo'lgandan (100%) keyin abort mexanizmi ishlamaydi — bu oddiy rollback (`undo`) talab qiladi.
- DB migration allaqachon bajarilgan bo'lsa trafik rollback'i yetmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Avtomatik rollback faqat metrikalar canary'ni stable'dan ajrata olsa ishonchli. Abort hodisasini notification bilan jamoaga yetkaz va postmortem'da analiz chegaralarini kalibrla — juda qattiq bo'lsa yaxshi relizlar ham abort qilinadi.

40732.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Canary step weight — progressive rollout'ning ma'lum bosqichida yangi (canary) versiyaga yo'naltiriladigan trafik foizi. Argo Rollouts'da `setWeight: 20`, Flagger'da `stepWeight` (har qadam qo'shiladigan foiz) va `maxWeight`. Weight'lar ketma-ketligi va har birida kutish vaqti risk va tezlik muvozanatini belgilaydi.

**Muammo:** Juda katta birinchi qadam (50%) — xato bo'lsa yarim foydalanuvchi jabrlanadi. Juda kichik (1%) kam trafikli servisda — statistik ma'nosiz, analiz hech narsani ko'rmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
trafik router bilan (Istio/NGINX/Gateway API): aniq foiz
   steps: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%
router'siz (faqat replica): weight = canary pod / jami pod
   replicas 10, setWeight 20 -> 2 canary pod, 8 stable (taxminiy)
   setWeight 5 va 10 replica -> 1 pod (aslida 10%)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
strategy:
  canary:
    trafficRouting:
      istio: { virtualService: { name: api, routes: [primary] } }
    steps:
      - setWeight: 5
      - pause: { duration: 10m }
      - setWeight: 25
      - pause: { duration: 10m }
      - setWeight: 50
      - pause: { duration: 10m }
    # 100% oxirgi qadamdan keyin avtomatik
```
```bash
kubectl argo rollouts get rollout api   # Step: 3/6, SetWeight: 25, ActualWeight: 25
```
Header-based routing (`setHeaderRoute`) bilan avval faqat ichki xodimlarni canary'ga yo'naltirish ham mumkin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Router'siz kichik weight — pod soni yaxlitlanadi; `ActualWeight` ni tekshir.
- Sticky session yo'q — bitta foydalanuvchi so'rovlari v1 va v2 orasida sakraydi (UI/API mos kelmasligi).
- Weight'ni oshirish bilan canary pod'lar yetarli scale qilinmasa — canary yuklamadan yiqiladi (bu versiya xatosi emas). `dynamicStableScale`, HPA'ni tekshir.

**Senior nuqta:** Weight tanlash: birinchi qadam kutilgan xatoni ko'rish uchun yetarli so'rov beradigan eng kichik foiz bo'lsin (masalan "10 daqiqada kamida 1000 so'rov"). Qadamlar soni ko'p bo'lsa reliz uzayadi — ko'p deploy qiladigan jamoada 3-4 qadam odatda yetarli.

40733.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flagger `MetricTemplate` — custom metrika so'rovini (Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, New Relic, Graphite, InfluxDB, Stackdriver ...) qayta ishlatiladigan resurs sifatida belgilaydigan CRD. `Canary.spec.analysis.metrics[]` unga `templateRef` bilan havola qiladi va `thresholdRange` (min/max) beradi. O'rnatilgan `request-success-rate` va `request-duration` dan tashqari biznes yoki maxsus metrikalar uchun kerak.

**Muammo:** O'rnatilgan metrikalar mesh/ingress'ga bog'liq va faqat HTTP; sizga esa "queue consumer lag", "checkout xatolari" yoki gRPC status'lari kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
MetricTemplate (provider + query, {{ namespace }}, {{ target }}, {{ interval }} o'zgaruvchilar)
Canary.analysis.metrics: templateRef + thresholdRange
Flagger har interval: query -> qiymat -> range ichida? -> yo'q: failedChecks++
failedChecks >= threshold -> rollback
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: flagger.app/v1beta1
kind: MetricTemplate
metadata: { name: error-rate, namespace: flagger-system }
spec:
  provider: { type: prometheus, address: http://prometheus.monitoring:9090 }
  query: |
    100 * sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace="{{ namespace }}",pod=~"{{ target }}-[0-9a-zA-Z]+(-[0-9a-zA-Z]+)",status=~"5.."}[{{ interval }}]))
    /
    sum(rate(http_requests_total{namespace="{{ namespace }}",pod=~"{{ target }}-[0-9a-zA-Z]+(-[0-9a-zA-Z]+)"}[{{ interval }}]))
---
# Canary ichida
analysis:
  metrics:
    - name: error-rate
      templateRef: { name: error-rate, namespace: flagger-system }
      thresholdRange: { max: 1 }      # 1% dan oshmasin
      interval: 1m
```
```bash
kubectl -n prod describe canary api   # Events: "Halt advancement error-rate 3.2 > 1"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trafik yo'q bo'lsa so'rov bo'sh/NaN qaytaradi — Flagger buni xato deb hisoblaydi va canary to'xtaydi. Load tester webhook yoki `or on() vector(0)`.
- Pod regex canary va primary pod'larini ajratmasa — o'rtacha metrika regressiyani yashiradi.
- Provider credential'i Secret'da (`secretRef`) — Datadog/New Relic kalitlarini to'g'ri namespace'ga qo'y.

**Senior nuqta:** MetricTemplate'larni platforma jamoasi markaziy namespace'da saqlab, servis jamoalari faqat chegaralarni tanlasa — standart va sifatli canary analiz butun tashkilotda bir xil bo'ladi.

40734.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Blue-green cutover latency — trafikni Blue (eski) muhitdan Green (yangi) muhitga o'tkazish buyrug'idan barcha **yangi** so'rovlar Green'ga borguncha ketgan vaqt. Mexanizmga bog'liq: Kubernetes Service selector yoki mesh — soniyalar (endpoint propagation), load balancer target group — soniyalar-daqiqalar (health check, deregistration delay), DNS — TTL va resolver cache'larga qarab daqiqalar-soatlar.

**Muammo:** Cutover sekin yoki notekis bo'lsa bir vaqtda ikkala versiya trafik oladi (mos kelmaslik), rollback ham shuncha sekin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**

| Mexanizm | Odatdagi kechikish | Nimaga bog'liq |
|---|---|---|
| K8s Service selector | 1-5 s | EndpointSlice -> kube-proxy/iptables yangilanishi |
| Istio/Gateway API weight | 1-5 s | xDS konfiguratsiya tarqalishi |
| ALB target group almashtirish | 5-60 s | health check, listener rule |
| DNS | TTL (60 s) ... soatlar | client/resolver cache, TTL'ni hurmat qilmaslik |

```text
mavjud ulanishlar: keep-alive/HTTP2/gRPC uzoq yashovchi ulanishlar Blue'da qoladi
   -> Blue'ni darhol o'chirma: connection draining
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# K8s: Service selector'ni almashtirish
kubectl patch svc api -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"api","version":"green"}}}'
kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api -w
# Argo Rollouts blue-green
kubectl argo rollouts promote api      # activeService -> green
```
```yaml
strategy:
  blueGreen:
    activeService: api
    previewService: api-preview
    autoPromotionEnabled: false
    scaleDownDelaySeconds: 300     # Blue 5 daqiqa tirik — tez rollback va draining
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DNS cutover'dan oldin TTL'ni kamaytirishni unutish (bir kun oldin 60 s ga) — eski TTL (1 soat) davomida trafik Blue'ga boradi.
- Uzoq yashovchi ulanishlar (gRPC, WebSocket) — selector o'zgarsa ham eski pod'ga yopishib qoladi; ulanish yoshini cheklash (max connection age).
- Blue'ni darhol scale down — tez rollback imkoniyati yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Cutover latency'ni o'lcha (sintetik so'rovlar versiya header'i bilan) — "100% Green" momenti taxmin emas, o'lchov bo'lsin. Rollback ham xuddi shu mexanizm, shuning uchun tez cutover = tez rollback.

40735.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pipeline concurrency lock — bir target (muhit, Terraform state, klaster) uchun bir vaqtda faqat **bitta** deploy pipeline/job bajarilishini kafolatlaydigan mexanizm; qolganlari navbatda kutadi yoki bekor qilinadi. GitHub Actions'da `concurrency`, GitLab'da `resource_group`, Jenkins'da `lock()` (Lockable Resources) yoki `disableConcurrentBuilds()`.

**Muammo:** Ikki merge ketma-ket bo'ldi, ikkita deploy parallel ishladi: eski commit'ning deploy'i kechroq tugab, yangisini ustidan yozdi — prod'da eski versiya. Yoki ikki `terraform apply` bir state'ga.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
merge #1 -> deploy-prod (lock oldi) ---------> tugadi (lock bo'shadi)
merge #2 -> deploy-prod (kutyapti) ................> boshlandi
merge #3 -> (pending #2 ni almashtiradi — faqat eng oxirgisi kutadi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# GitHub Actions
concurrency:
  group: deploy-production
  cancel-in-progress: false       # ishlayotgan deploy'ni o'ldirma, navbatga qo'y
```
```yaml
# GitLab CI
deploy_prod:
  stage: deploy
  resource_group: production
  script: ./deploy.sh
```
```groovy
// Jenkins
pipeline {
  options { disableConcurrentBuilds() }
  stages { stage('Deploy') { steps { lock('prod-env') { sh './deploy.sh' } } } }
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `cancel-in-progress: true` deploy'da — yarim apply qilingan migratsiya yoki Terraform. Deploy uchun false, PR testlar uchun true.
- GitHub `concurrency`da bitta guruhda faqat bitta **pending** run turadi — oraliq run'lar bekor qilinadi (odatda kerakli xatti-harakat, lekin bilib qo'y).
- Lock CI darajasida, lekin kimdir lokal `terraform apply` qilsa — state lock (DynamoDB/S3 lockfile) ham kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Concurrency lock'ni target bo'yicha granular qil (`deploy-${{ env }}-${{ service }}`) — butun kompaniya bitta global lock'da kutib qolmasin. GitOps'da reconcile controller'ning o'zi bitta yozuvchi bo'lgani uchun bu muammoning katta qismi yo'qoladi.

40736.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Sync window — ArgoCD `AppProject`dagi vaqt jadvali (cron + davomiylik): `allow` oynasi faqat shu vaqtda sync'ga ruxsat beradi, `deny` oynasi shu vaqtda sync'ni taqiqlaydi. Applications, namespace'lar yoki klasterlar bo'yicha qo'llanadi; `manualSync: true` bilan deny paytida ham qo'lda sync'ga ruxsat berish mumkin.

**Muammo:** Juma kechqurun yoki "Black Friday" paytida avtomatik sync prod'ga yangi o'zgarish chiqarmasligi kerak (change freeze), lekin hotfix imkoniyati qolishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
sync so'rovi (auto yoki manual) --> project windows tekshiriladi
   deny oynasi faol?        -> bloklanadi (manualSync: true bo'lsa qo'lda ruxsat)
   allow oynalari bor va hech biri faol emas? -> bloklanadi
   aks holda -> sync
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AppProject
metadata: { name: payments, namespace: argocd }
spec:
  syncWindows:
    - kind: deny
      schedule: "0 18 * * 5"      # juma 18:00 dan
      duration: 62h               # dushanba 08:00 gacha
      applications: ["*-prod"]
      manualSync: true            # hotfix uchun qo'lda sync mumkin
      timeZone: "Asia/Tashkent"
    - kind: allow
      schedule: "0 9 * * 1-4"
      duration: 8h
      clusters: [prod-eu]
```
```bash
argocd proj windows list payments
argocd app get api-prod     # "Sync windows: Denied"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `timeZone` ko'rsatmaslik — default UTC, oyna kutilgandan boshqa soatda ishlaydi.
- Deny oynasida self-heal ham ishlamaydi — drift oyna tugaguncha tuzatilmaydi.
- Allow oynasi qo'shilishi bilan qolgan barcha vaqt avtomatik "taqiqlangan"ga aylanadi — bu ko'pincha kutilmagan.

**Senior nuqta:** Change freeze — risk boshqaruvi vositasi, lekin uzun freeze'lar o'zgarishlarni to'plab, freeze'dan keyingi relizni xavfliroq qiladi. Freeze'ni minimal va aniq maqsadli qil; Flux'da analog — Kustomization'ni `suspend` qilish yoki tashqi jadval.

40737.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ArgoCD SSO — foydalanuvchilarni lokal akkauntlar o'rniga tashkilot IdP'si (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google, GitHub, Keycloak) orqali autentifikatsiya qilish: bevosita **OIDC** yoki ichki **Dex** orqali (SAML, LDAP, GitHub connector). IdP'dan kelgan group claim'lari `argocd-rbac-cm` dagi rollarga map qilinadi.

**Muammo:** Lokal `admin` va umumiy parollar — kim nima qilganini bilib bo'lmaydi, xodim ketganda kirishni olish unutiladi, MFA yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
user --> ArgoCD UI/CLI --redirect--> IdP (login + MFA)
     <-- ID token (email, groups: ["platform-admins", "payments-dev"])
ArgoCD RBAC: g, payments-dev, role:payments-deployer
             p, role:payments-deployer, applications, sync, payments/*, allow
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# argocd-cm
data:
  url: https://argocd.org.com
  admin.enabled: "false"
  oidc.config: |
    name: Entra ID
    issuer: https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0
    clientID: <client-id>
    clientSecret: $oidc.entra.clientSecret
    requestedScopes: ["openid", "profile", "email"]
    requestedIDTokenClaims: { groups: { essential: true } }
---
# argocd-rbac-cm
data:
  policy.default: role:readonly
  scopes: "[groups]"
  policy.csv: |
    p, role:payments-deployer, applications, get, payments/*, allow
    p, role:payments-deployer, applications, sync, payments/*, allow
    g, payments-dev, role:payments-deployer
    g, platform-admins, role:admin
```
```bash
argocd login argocd.org.com --sso
argocd account get-user-info
argocd admin settings rbac can role:payments-deployer sync applications 'payments/api-prod' \
  --policy-file policy.csv
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `policy.default: role:admin` yoki `readonly` o'rniga keng default — har kirgan odam ko'p narsa qila oladi.
- Entra ID 200+ guruhli foydalanuvchida groups claim'ni token'ga qo'ymaydi (overage) — guruh filtrlash yoki app role'lar.
- SSO yoqib, `admin` lokal akkauntni o'chirmaslik — yon eshik qoladi (break-glass uchun saqlasang, parolini vault'da va audit bilan).

**Senior nuqta:** RBAC'ni AppProject chegaralari bilan birga loyihala: jamoa faqat o'z project'ida sync qila oladi, `exec` va `override` huquqlari alohida. RBAC konfiguratsiyasining o'zi ham Git'da va review'dan o'tsin.

40738.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flux Source Controller — tashqi manbalarni kuzatib, ularni klaster ichidagi boshqa controller'lar uchun **artifact** (tar.gz + revision + checksum) ga aylantiradigan controller. CRD'lari: `GitRepository`, `OCIRepository`, `HelmRepository`, `HelmChart`, `Bucket` (S3/GCS/Azure Blob). Autentifikatsiya, imzo tekshiruvi (GPG, Cosign) va polling shu yerda.

**Muammo:** Har controller (Kustomize, Helm) o'zi Git'ga borib klonlasa — takroriy yuklama, credential'lar har joyda. Source Controller "manba olish"ni bitta joyga yig'adi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
GitRepository (url, ref, interval, secretRef, verify)
  --> source-controller: clone/fetch, imzo tekshiruvi, ignore qoidalari
  --> artifact: http://source-controller.flux-system.svc/gitrepository/flux-system/app/<sha>.tar.gz
  --> status.artifact.revision = main@sha1:ab12...
Kustomization/HelmRelease --> sourceRef orqali artifact'ni yuklab oladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata: { name: app, namespace: flux-system }
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: ssh://git@github.com/org/deploy.git
  ref: { branch: main }
  secretRef: { name: deploy-key }
  ignore: |
    /*
    !/apps/
---
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2
kind: OCIRepository
metadata: { name: manifests, namespace: flux-system }
spec:
  interval: 5m
  url: oci://ghcr.io/org/manifests
  ref: { semver: ">=1.0.0" }
  verify: { provider: cosign }        # imzolanmagan artifact qabul qilinmaydi
```
```bash
flux get sources all -A
flux reconcile source git app
kubectl -n flux-system describe gitrepository app    # auth/clone xatolari
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Katta monorepo'ni har daqiqada klonlash — CPU/tarmoq yuki; `ignore` va sparse checkout, yoki CI'da OCI artifact chiqarib `OCIRepository` ishlat.
- Deploy key'ga write ruxsat kerak emas (image automation'dan tashqari) — read-only qil.
- Juda kichik `interval` + ko'p repo — Git provider rate limit; webhook receiver bilan interval'ni kattalashtir.

**Senior nuqta:** OCI artifact yondashuvi (CI manifest'larni `flux push artifact` bilan registry'ga imzolab qo'yadi, klaster OCIRepository'dan Cosign verify bilan oladi) — Git'ga klaster ichidan kirishni yo'q qiladi va supply chain tekshiruvini deploy manbasiga ham qo'llaydi.

40739.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flux Kustomize Controller — `Kustomization` CRD'larini reconcile qiladi: Source Controller artifact'ini yuklab oladi, `kustomize build` qiladi (kustomization.yaml bo'lmasa avtomatik yaratadi), SOPS bilan shifrlangan secret'larni ochadi, `postBuild` o'zgaruvchilarini qo'yadi, server-side apply bilan klasterga qo'llaydi, prune va health check qiladi.

**Muammo:** Manifest'larni to'g'ri tartibda, faqat o'zgarganini, garbage collection va sog'liq tekshiruvi bilan apply qilish — buni ishonchli avtomatlashtirish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
artifact (rev ab12) --> kustomize build --> SOPS decrypt --> substitute ${VAR}
   --> server-side apply (dry-run diff, keyin apply) --> inventory (qaysi obyektlar meniki)
   --> prune: inventory'da bor, yangi build'da yo'q -> delete
   --> health check (wait/healthChecks) --> status Ready=True, lastAppliedRevision
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata: { name: api, namespace: flux-system }
spec:
  interval: 10m
  retryInterval: 1m
  sourceRef: { kind: GitRepository, name: app }
  path: ./apps/api/prod
  prune: true
  targetNamespace: api
  serviceAccountName: api-deployer     # multi-tenancy: cheklangan RBAC bilan apply
  healthChecks:
    - { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api, namespace: api }
  decryption: { provider: sops, secretRef: { name: sops-age } }
```
```bash
flux get kustomizations
flux events --for Kustomization/api
flux build kustomization api --path ./apps/api/prod   # lokal render
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `serviceAccountName`siz — controller cluster-admin huquqi bilan apply qiladi; multi-tenant klasterda jamoa boshqa namespace'ga yoza oladi.
- Immutable maydon o'zgarsa (Job spec, Service clusterIP) apply yiqiladi — `force: true` qayta yaratadi, ehtiyot bo'l.
- Health check timeout'i qisqa bo'lsa sekin start qiladigan ilovalar "failed" ko'rinadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Server-side apply va inventory asosidagi prune — Flux'ni `kubectl apply --prune`dan ancha ishonchli qiladi. Multi-tenancy uchun har tenant Kustomization'i o'z ServiceAccount'i bilan — bu GitOps'ning RBAC chegarasi.

40740.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flux Notification Controller ikki yo'nalishda ishlaydi: **chiquvchi** — Flux hodisalarini (`Alert` + `Provider`) Slack, Teams, Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, generic webhook'larga yuboradi va Git commit status'ini (GitHub/GitLab) yangilaydi; **kiruvchi** — `Receiver` orqali Git provider/registry webhook'larini qabul qilib, tegishli manbani darhol reconcile qiladi.

**Muammo:** Reconcile yiqilsa (noto'g'ri manifest, health check) hech kim bilmaydi — GitOps "jim" ishlaydi. Polling interval (5-10 daqiqa) deploy'ni sekinlashtiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
chiquvchi:  kustomize/helm controller event --> Alert (filtr: severity, kind) --> Provider (Slack)
kiruvchi:   GitHub push webhook --> Receiver (/hook/<token-hash>) --> GitRepository reconcile darhol
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta3
kind: Provider
metadata: { name: slack, namespace: flux-system }
spec: { type: slack, channel: deploys, secretRef: { name: slack-webhook } }
---
apiVersion: notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta3
kind: Alert
metadata: { name: prod-errors, namespace: flux-system }
spec:
  providerRef: { name: slack }
  eventSeverity: error
  eventSources: [{ kind: Kustomization, name: "*" }, { kind: HelmRelease, name: "*" }]
---
apiVersion: notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Receiver
metadata: { name: github, namespace: flux-system }
spec:
  type: github
  events: [push]
  secretRef: { name: webhook-token }
  resources: [{ kind: GitRepository, name: app }]
```
```bash
kubectl -n flux-system get receiver github -o jsonpath='{.status.webhookPath}'
flux get alerts
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `eventSeverity: info` hamma narsa uchun — Slack kanal shovqinga to'ladi va jamoa uni o'chirib qo'yadi.
- Receiver endpoint'ini Ingress orqali ochib, secret/HMAC tekshiruvini sozlamaslik.
- Faqat Slack xabari — muhim yiqilishlar uchun Prometheus metrikasi (`gotk_reconcile_condition`) asosidagi alert ishonchliroq.

**Senior nuqta:** GitHub commit status provider'i (`type: github`) Flux natijasini commit yoniga yozadi — developer PR/commit sahifasida "prod'ga chiqdimi" ni ko'radi. Bu GitOps'ning "ko'rinmaslik" muammosini yaxshi yopadi.

40741.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `PipelineRun` — Tekton `Pipeline`ining bitta bajarilishi: qaysi Pipeline (`pipelineRef` yoki inline `pipelineSpec`), qaysi parametrlar, qaysi workspace'lar (PVC, ConfigMap, Secret, emptyDir), ServiceAccount, timeout'lar. Controller undan har Task uchun `TaskRun` yaratadi va DAG bo'yicha boshqaradi; natijalar va status shu obyektda yoziladi.

**Muammo:** Pipeline — shablon (nima qilish), PipelineRun — aniq ish (qaysi commit, qaysi image tag, qaysi muhit). Bu ajratish bitta Pipeline'ni ko'p marta turli kirishlar bilan ishlatish imkonini beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
PipelineRun (params, workspaces)
   --> controller: tasks DAG
       clone (TaskRun -> Pod) --> test, lint (parallel TaskRun'lar) --> build (TaskRun)
   --> status: conditions (Succeeded True/False), childReferences, results
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1
kind: PipelineRun
metadata: { generateName: ci-run- }
spec:
  pipelineRef: { name: ci }
  params:
    - { name: repo-url, value: https://github.com/org/api }
    - { name: revision, value: 9f1e2c3 }
  workspaces:
    - name: src
      volumeClaimTemplate:
        spec: { accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce], resources: { requests: { storage: 1Gi } } }
    - name: docker-config
      secret: { secretName: registry-creds }
  taskRunTemplate: { serviceAccountName: ci-bot }
  timeouts: { pipeline: 30m, tasks: 20m, finally: 5m }
```
```bash
kubectl create -f pipelinerun.yaml     # generateName uchun create, apply emas
tkn pipelinerun logs -f --last
tkn pipelinerun describe ci-run-x8k2l
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `generateName` bilan `kubectl apply` ishlamaydi — `create` kerak.
- `volumeClaimTemplate` har run uchun yangi PVC yaratadi — tozalanmasa PVC'lar to'planadi (pruner yoki owner reference).
- ServiceAccount'ga ortiqcha huquq — PipelineRun yaratishga ruxsati bor har kim uni ishlatadi.

**Senior nuqta:** PipelineRun'larni odatda inson emas, Tekton Triggers (EventListener) yaratadi. Tekton Chains PipelineRun/TaskRun natijalaridan avtomatik imzolangan SLSA provenance chiqaradi — bu Tekton'ni supply chain uchun kuchli qiladi.

40742.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `TaskRun` — Tekton `Task`ining bitta bajarilishi: Task'ning har `step`i bitta **Pod** ichida ketma-ket container sifatida ishga tushiriladi; parametrlar, workspace'lar va natijalar (`results`) shu obyektga bog'lanadi. Mustaqil ham, PipelineRun ichida ham yaratiladi.

**Muammo:** Build qadamlari (checkout, compile, test) umumiy fayl tizimini ulashishi kerak — bir Pod ichidagi step'lar `/workspace` va volume'larni ulashadi, alohida pod'lar orasida esa PVC kerak bo'lardi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
TaskRun --> Pod
   init: entrypoint binary'ni nusxalaydi
   step-1 (golang:1.23)  : go build   --> tugashini /tekton/run fayl orqali bildiradi
   step-2 (golang:1.23)  : go test    --> step-1 tugashini kutadi (entrypoint wrapper)
   step-3 (alpine)       : echo -n "$(digest)" > $(results.digest.path)
   sidecar'lar (masalan dind, DB) step'lar davomida ishlaydi
```
Barcha container'lar bir vaqtda start bo'ladi, lekin Tekton entrypoint ularni tartib bilan ishga tushiradi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1
kind: Task
metadata: { name: go-test }
spec:
  params: [{ name: package, default: "./..." }]
  workspaces: [{ name: source }]
  results: [{ name: coverage }]
  steps:
    - name: test
      image: golang:1.23
      workingDir: $(workspaces.source.path)
      script: |
        go test -coverprofile=c.out $(params.package)
        go tool cover -func=c.out | tail -1 | awk '{print $3}' | tr -d '\n' > $(results.coverage.path)
---
apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1
kind: TaskRun
metadata: { generateName: go-test-run- }
spec:
  taskRef: { name: go-test }
  workspaces: [{ name: source, persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: src-pvc } }]
```
```bash
tkn taskrun logs -f --last
kubectl get taskrun -o jsonpath='{.items[-1:].status.results}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Pod resurs so'rovi — step'larning **maksimal** emas, Tekton ularni shunday hisoblaydi (ketma-ket ishlagani uchun); lekin LimitRange bilan kutilmagan natijalar bo'lishi mumkin.
- Results hajmi cheklangan (default 4 KB atrofida termination message) — katta ma'lumotni workspace orqali uzat.
- Step yiqilsa keyingilar ishlamaydi — tozalash uchun `finally` (Pipeline darajasida) yoki `onError: continue`.

**Senior nuqta:** Task granularligi — trade-off: bitta Task'da ko'p step tezroq (bitta pod, umumiy fayl tizimi), alohida Task'lar esa parallellik va qayta ishlatishni beradi. Tekton Hub/Artifact Hub'dagi tayyor Task'larni versiya bilan pin qilib ishlat.

40743.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab CI'da matrix job — `parallel: matrix:` bilan bitta job ta'rifidan o'zgaruvchilar kombinatsiyalari bo'yicha bir nechta parallel job yaratish. Har kombinatsiya alohida job bo'lib, o'zgaruvchilarni env sifatida oladi. Bitta job uchun maksimal 200 ta variant.

**Muammo:** Kodni Go 1.22/1.23 va amd64/arm64 da test qilish yoki 5 ta region'ga deploy — bir xil job'ni nusxa-ko'chirish YAML'ni shishiradi va xatoga moyil.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
test:
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - GO: ["1.22", "1.23"]
        ARCH: [amd64, arm64]
--> 4 job: test: [1.22, amd64], test: [1.22, arm64], test: [1.23, amd64], test: [1.23, arm64]
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
test:
  stage: test
  image: golang:${GO}
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - GO: ["1.22", "1.23"]
        ARCH: [amd64, arm64]
  tags: [$ARCH]                     # mos runner'ga yo'naltirish
  script:
    - go test ./...

deploy:
  stage: deploy
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - REGION: [eu-central-1, us-east-1]
  environment: prod/$REGION
  resource_group: prod-$REGION
  script: ./deploy.sh $REGION

report:
  needs:
    - job: test
      parallel:
        matrix:
          - GO: "1.23"
            ARCH: amd64            # faqat bitta matrix variantiga bog'lanish
  script: ./report.sh
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kombinatsiyalar tez ko'payadi (3x3x4 = 36 job) — runner navbati va xarajat; keraksiz kombinatsiyalarni ajratib alohida ro'yxat elementlari bilan yoz.
- `needs` matrix job'ga ishora qilganda variantni aniq ko'rsatmasang — hamma variantlarni kutadi.
- Job nomi kombinatsiya bilan uzun bo'ladi; artifact nomlarida o'zgaruvchidan foydalan, aks holda bir-birini ustidan yozadi.

**Senior nuqta:** `parallel: N` (oddiy son) testlarni shard'larga bo'lish uchun (`CI_NODE_INDEX`/`CI_NODE_TOTAL`), `parallel: matrix` esa turli konfiguratsiyalar uchun — ularni adashtirma. GitHub Actions'dagi analog — `strategy.matrix` (include/exclude bilan).

40744.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Secrets Store CSI Driver — Kubernetes CSI driver: `SecretProviderClass` bo'yicha tashqi secret store'dan (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager — provider plugin'lar orqali) secret'larni olib, pod'ga **tmpfs volume'dagi fayl** sifatida mount qiladi. Default'da Kubernetes `Secret` obyekti yaratilmaydi (ixtiyoriy `secretObjects` sync bor).

**Muammo:** Kubernetes `Secret` etcd'da saqlanadi va `get secrets` huquqi bor har kim o'qiydi. Ba'zi compliance talablari secret'ning klaster API'sida umuman bo'lmasligini talab qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
pod start --> kubelet --> CSI driver (DaemonSet) --> provider (aws/vault/azure)
   --> pod ServiceAccount identity (IRSA / Workload Identity / Vault k8s auth) bilan secret oladi
   --> /mnt/secrets/db-password (tmpfs, faqat shu pod'da)
rotation (ixtiyoriy): davriy qayta o'qish, fayl yangilanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: secrets-store.csi.x-k8s.io/v1
kind: SecretProviderClass
metadata: { name: api-secrets, namespace: api }
spec:
  provider: aws
  parameters:
    objects: |
      - objectName: "prod/db"
        objectType: "secretsmanager"
        jmesPath:
          - { path: password, objectAlias: db-password }
---
# pod spec
volumes:
  - name: secrets
    csi:
      driver: secrets-store.csi.k8s.io
      readOnly: true
      volumeAttributes: { secretProviderClass: api-secrets }
containers:
  - name: api
    volumeMounts: [{ name: secrets, mountPath: /mnt/secrets, readOnly: true }]
```
```bash
kubectl exec deploy/api -- cat /mnt/secrets/db-password
kubectl -n kube-system logs ds/csi-secrets-store -c secrets-store
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret faqat pod start'da mount bo'ladi — store ishlamasa pod `ContainerCreating`da qoladi.
- Env var kerak bo'lsa `secretObjects` bilan baribir K8s Secret yaratiladi — asosiy foyda yo'qoladi.
- Rotation yoqilgan bo'lsa ham ilova faylni qayta o'qishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Tanlov: CSI Driver — secret etcd'ga tushmaydi, sidecar yo'q; ESO — eng oddiy integratsiya (oddiy Secret, env var); Vault Agent — dinamik secret va template. Threat model'ga qarab tanla: asosiy xavf etcd/RBAC'mi yoki secret rotatsiyasimi.

40745.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Zero-downtime migration — **expand/contract** (parallel change) pattern: 1) **expand** — eski kodga zarar qilmaydigan qo'shimcha o'zgarish (yangi nullable ustun/jadval); 2) ilova ikkala joyga yozadi (dual write), eskisidan o'qiydi; 3) **backfill** — eski ma'lumotni yangi ustunga ko'chirish (batch'larda); 4) ilova yangi ustundan o'qiydi; 5) eski ustunga yozishni to'xtatish; 6) **contract** — eski ustunni o'chirish. Har qadam alohida reliz va har birida rollback mumkin.

**Muammo:** Rolling deploy paytida eski va yangi pod'lar bir vaqtda ishlaydi va bitta DB'ni ishlatadi. `ALTER TABLE RENAME COLUMN` qilinsa — eski pod'lar darhol sinadi; rollback qilsang — yangi schema eski kod bilan mos emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi (`name` -> `full_name` misolida):**
```text
reliz 1: ADD COLUMN full_name NULL          kod: name'dan o'qiydi, ikkalasiga yozadi
reliz 2: backfill (batch 10k, throttle)      kod: o'zgarmaydi
reliz 3: kod full_name'dan o'qiydi (ikkalasiga yozishda davom) -> tekshirish
reliz 4: kod faqat full_name'ga yozadi
reliz 5: DROP COLUMN name (+ NOT NULL constraint)
```

**Amalda (PostgreSQL):**
```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN full_name text;            -- tez, metadata o'zgarishi
-- backfill batch'lab (uzun lock va WAL portlashidan qochish)
UPDATE users SET full_name = name
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE full_name IS NULL LIMIT 10000);
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_full_name ON users(full_name);
ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT full_name_nn CHECK (full_name IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID;
ALTER TABLE users VALIDATE CONSTRAINT full_name_nn;     -- yengil lock bilan
```
`SET lock_timeout = '5s';` — migration uzoq lock kutib, butun trafikni bloklamasligi uchun.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bir relizda hamma qadamlarni qilish — "zero-downtime" yo'qoladi.
- `CREATE INDEX` (CONCURRENTLY'siz) va `NOT NULL` ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'shish katta jadvalda uzoq `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` lock.
- Contract qadamini unutish — eski ustunlar yillab qoladi va chalkashlik.

**Senior nuqta:** Migration'ni kod relizidan ajratilgan, alohida kuzatiladigan jarayon sifatida boshqar (va `lock_timeout` + retry bilan). Har qadam "oldingi va keyingi kod versiyasi bilan mos" bo'lishi kerak — bu qoidani PR review checklist'iga qo'sh.

40746.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **In-tree** plugin — CI engine'ning o'z kodi bilan birga yetkaziladigan, uning jamoasi tomonidan saqlanadigan va release qilinadigan funksiya (GitLab CI'ning o'rnatilgan keyword'lari, Tekton core). **Out-of-tree** — alohida loyihada yashaydigan, runtime'da yuklanadigan tashqi plugin/action (Jenkins plugin'lari, GitHub Marketplace action'lari, CircleCI orb'lari). Out-of-tree moslashuvchan, lekin supply chain xavfi va versiya muvofiqligi muammosi yuqoriroq.

**Muammo:** CI ekotizimi tashqi kodga to'la: o'rtacha workflow 5-15 third-party action ishlatadi, har biri sizning secret'laringiz va kodingiz bilan bir xil muhitda ishlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**

| | In-tree | Out-of-tree |
|---|---|---|
| Kim saqlaydi | CI vendor | Har kim (community, bitta maintainer) |
| Yangilanish | CI versiyasi bilan | Mustaqil, tez-tez |
| Ishonch/review | Vendor jarayoni | Noma'lum |
| Xavf | Past | Tag qayta yozish, maintainer akkaunti buzilishi, typosquatting |

```text
tj-actions/changed-files (2025): hujumchi barcha tag'larni zararli commit'ga yo'naltirdi
  -> @v35 ishlatgan minglab workflow log'ga secret'larni chiqardi
```

**Amalda (out-of-tree xavfini kamaytirish):**
```yaml
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683   # v4.2.2 — SHA pin
    with: { persist-credentials: false }
permissions: { contents: read }
```
GitHub org sozlamasi: "Allow only actions created by GitHub / verified creators / ro'yxatdagilar"; Jenkins'da plugin'lar soni minimal va Update Center'dan faqat kerakli.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Jenkins'da 100+ plugin — har biri yangilashda bir-biriga mos kelmasligi va zaiflik manbai.
- Out-of-tree action'ni tag bilan ishlatish — kod sizdan so'ramay o'zgaradi.
- "Kichik" action (masalan, Slack xabari) ga ham butun job secret'lari ochiq.

**Senior nuqta:** Out-of-tree kodni "dependency" kabi boshqar: inventarizatsiya, pin, avtomatik yangilash PR'lari (Renovate), review va allowlist. Muhim pipeline'larda trivial action'lar o'rniga 5 qatorlik `run:` skript ko'pincha xavfsizroq.

40747.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Action pinning — third-party GitHub Action'ni o'zgaruvchan tag (`@v4`) yoki branch (`@main`) bilan emas, **to'liq 40 belgili commit SHA** bilan chaqirish. Tag'ni egasi (yoki hujumchi) istalgan commit'ga ko'chirishi mumkin; commit SHA esa o'zgarmas — aynan review qilingan kod ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** `uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v45` — 2025-yil martida hujumchi tag'larni secret'larni log'ga chiqaradigan commit'ga yo'naltirdi; tag bilan ishlatgan barcha repo'lar avtomatik zararlandi, SHA bilan pin qilganlar zarar ko'rmadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
@v4          -> tag (ko'chiriladi)    -> bugun A, ertaga zararli B
@main        -> branch (har push)     -> eng xavfli
@<sha40>     -> commit (o'zgarmas)    -> faqat review qilingan kod
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
  - uses: actions/setup-go@3041bf56c941b39c61721a86cd11f3bb1338122a # v5.2.0
```
```bash
# tag -> SHA aniqlash
git ls-remote https://github.com/actions/checkout refs/tags/v4.2.2
# avtomatik pin qilish
npx pin-github-action .github/workflows/*.yml
# yoki: renovate "helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests" preset (SHA + izohda versiya, yangilash PR'lari)
```
GitHub org/repo sozlamasida "Require actions to be pinned to a full-length commit SHA" policy'sini yoqish mumkin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Qisqa SHA (`@11bd719`) — to'liq SHA emas; fork'dagi to'qnashuv riski va policy'lar uni qabul qilmaydi.
- Pin qilib, hech qachon yangilamaslik — xavfsizlik tuzatishlari o'tib ketadi. Renovate/Dependabot bilan yangila.
- Pin qilingan action ichida o'zi boshqa action'ni `@main` bilan chaqirsa yoki `curl | sh` qilsa (composite/Docker action) — pin to'liq himoya qilmaydi; Docker action image'i ham digest bilan bo'lishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** SHA pinning + avtomatik yangilash PR'lari + review — o'zgarmaslik va yangilanishni birlashtiradi. Qo'shimcha: StepSecurity Harden-Runner kabi egress monitoring, `permissions` minimal va allowlist'dagi action'lar.

40748.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kaniko — Dockerfile'dan image'ni **Docker daemon'siz va privileged huquqsiz** oddiy container (pod) ichida user-space'da build qilib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri registry'ga push qiladigan tool. Bu "hermetic"/izolyatsiyalangan build'ga yaqinlashtiradi: host Docker socket'i mount qilinmaydi. Diqqat: Google `GoogleContainerTools/kaniko`ni 2025-yilda **arxivladi**; yangi tizimlar uchun BuildKit rootless, Buildah yoki Chainguard fork'i ko'rib chiqiladi.

**Muammo:** CI pod'ida `docker build` uchun `/var/run/docker.sock` mount qilish = node'ga root kirish: pod istalgan container'ni privileged ishga tushirib host'ni egallashi mumkin. Docker-in-Docker esa privileged pod talab qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
kaniko executor (pod ichida):
  base image'ni registry'dan oladi -> o'z fayl tizimiga ochadi
  har Dockerfile buyrug'ini bajaradi -> fayl tizimi snapshot -> layer
  --cache=true: layer'larni registry'dagi cache repo'dan qayta ishlatadi
  natija image'ni push qiladi (lokal daemon yo'q)
```

**Amalda (Kubernetes Job / Tekton step):**
```yaml
containers:
  - name: build
    image: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:v1.23.2
    args:
      - --context=git://github.com/org/api.git#refs/tags/v1.5.0
      - --dockerfile=Dockerfile
      - --destination=ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0
      - --cache=true
      - --reproducible                # timestamp'larni olib tashlaydi
      - --digest-file=/workspace/digest
    volumeMounts: [{ name: docker-config, mountPath: /kaniko/.docker }]
```
BuildKit rootless alternativasi:
```bash
buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=. --local dockerfile=. \
  --output type=image,name=ghcr.io/org/api:1.5.0,push=true
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kaniko container ichida root sifatida fayl tizimini o'zgartiradi — uni boshqa ish bilan bir pod'da ishlatma (u o'z container fayl tizimini "buzadi").
- Multi-stage va murakkab Dockerfile'larda BuildKit'dan sekinroq; ba'zi BuildKit sintaksisi (`RUN --mount`) qisman qo'llanadi.
- Arxivlangan loyiha — yangi CVE tuzatishlari kelmaydi; migratsiya rejasini tuz.

**Senior nuqta:** "Hermetic" so'zi bu yerda asosan izolyatsiyani anglatadi; to'liq hermetic build (tarmoqsiz, faqat e'lon qilingan input'lar) uchun pinned base digest, lockfile'lar va `--network=none` kabi qo'shimcha choralar kerak. Daemonless build + SLSA provenance — CI'dagi image build'ning zamonaviy standarti.

40749.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pipeline flakiness rate — kod o'zgarmagan holda (masalan, xuddi shu commit'da retry qilinganda o'tadigan) yiqilgan run'lar ulushi. Sabablari: beqaror testlar (vaqt, tartib, race condition), tarmoq/registry timeout'lari, umumiy test muhiti, resurs yetishmasligi. Yuqori flakiness — CI'ga ishonchni yemiradi: developer'lar qizil natijani "yana flaky" deb e'tiborsiz qoldiradi va haqiqiy xatolar o'tib ketadi.

**Muammo:** 2% flaky test ehtimoli x 200 test = har run'ning katta qismi tasodifan yiqiladi. "Re-run" tugmasi odat bo'ladi, CI vaqti va xarajati oshadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (o'lchash):**
```text
flaky run = fail -> o'sha SHA'da retry -> pass
flakiness rate = flaky run'lar / jami run'lar (masalan haftalik)
test darajasida: test_X 500 run'da 12 marta fail, keyin pass -> 2.4% flaky
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Go: shubhali testni ko'p marta va race detector bilan
go test -run TestCheckout -count=200 -race ./checkout/
# tartibga bog'liqlikni topish
go test -shuffle=on ./...
# JUnit hisobotlarini yig'ib flaky'larni aniqlash (BuildPulse, Datadog CI Visibility, GitLab "flaky tests", Trunk)
```
Jarayon:
```text
1. aniqlash (avtomatik, retry natijalari bo'yicha)
2. karantin (alohida, bloklamaydigan suite; ticket va egasi bilan)
3. tuzatish: sleep -> polling/condition, umumiy holat -> izolyatsiya, vaqt -> fake clock
4. qaytarish va kuzatish
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Avtomatik retry'ni hamma joyga yoqish — flakiness yashirinadi, haqiqiy race condition'lar prod'ga chiqadi. Retry bo'lsa ham o'lchab qayd et.
- Karantin "qabriston"ga aylanishi — karantindagi testlar uchun SLA (masalan 2 hafta) yoki o'chirish.
- Infra flakiness (registry 429, DNS) ni test xatosi bilan aralashtirish — sababi bo'yicha klassifikatsiya qil.

**Senior nuqta:** Flakiness'ni platforma metrikasi sifatida kuzat (maqsad < 1-2%) va egalarini belgila. Ko'pincha "flaky test" — ilovadagi haqiqiy concurrency xatosining yagona ko'rinadigan belgisi, shuning uchun uni o'chirishdan oldin sababini tushun.

40750.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avtomatik metrika gating — canary/progressive rollout paytida real vaqt telemetriyasi (golden signals: latency, traffic, errors, saturation va biznes metrikalari) oldindan belgilangan chegaralar yoki baseline bilan avtomatik solishtiriladi; natijaga ko'ra reliz keyingi bosqichga **promote** qilinadi yoki **abort/rollback** qilinadi — inson qaror qabul qilishi shart emas.

**Muammo:** Inson Grafana'ga qarab qaror qilsa: sekin, charchoqqa moyil, tunda ishlamaydi va subyektiv. Ko'p deploy qiladigan jamoada (kuniga o'nlab) qo'lda gating — bottleneck.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```text
canary 10% --> har 1m: query metrikalar (faqat canary vs stable)
   error_rate(canary) <= max(1%, stable * 1.2)?
   p99(canary) <= stable_p99 * 1.25?
   min so'rovlar >= 500?         (statistik yetarlilik)
   --> hammasi ok N marta: promote -> 30%
   --> fail >= limit: abort -> 0%, alert
   --> ma'lumot yetarli emas: inconclusive -> pauza (inson)
```

**Amalda (Argo Rollouts, nisbiy solishtirish):**
```yaml
metrics:
  - name: error-ratio-vs-stable
    interval: 1m
    count: 10
    failureLimit: 2
    successCondition: result[0] <= 1.2
    provider:
      prometheus:
        address: http://prometheus:9090
        query: |
          (sum(rate(http_requests_total{rollouts_pod_template_hash="{{args.canary-hash}}",code=~"5.."}[2m]))
            / sum(rate(http_requests_total{rollouts_pod_template_hash="{{args.canary-hash}}"}[2m])))
          /
          (sum(rate(http_requests_total{rollouts_pod_template_hash="{{args.stable-hash}}",code=~"5.."}[2m]))
            / sum(rate(http_requests_total{rollouts_pod_template_hash="{{args.stable-hash}}"}[2m])) + 0.0001)
```
Flagger'da — MetricTemplate + `thresholdRange`; Spinnaker'da — Kayenta.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat absolyut chegaralar — kunlik trafik o'zgarishida soxta abort yoki soxta success.
- Ma'lumot yetarli bo'lmagan holatni "success" deb hisoblash — kam trafikli servisda gating hech narsani tekshirmaydi.
- Faqat texnik metrikalar — checkout konversiyasi tushishi yoki noto'g'ri hisob-kitob 5xx bermaydi; biznes SLI qo'sh.

**Senior nuqta:** Gating sifati SLI sifatiga teng: avval servisning SLO va SLI'larini aniqla, keyin ularni gate qil. Abort'lar statistikasini kuzat — juda ko'p soxta abort jamoani gate'ni o'chirishga undaydi, juda kam bo'lsa — chegaralar bo'sh.

40751.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cloud computing — server, storage, tarmoq va tayyor servislarni internet orqali **talab bo'yicha** olib, faqat ishlatganingiz uchun to'lash (pay-as-you-go). Uchta model farqi — **kim nimani boshqaradi**: IaaS (siz OS'dan yuqorini), PaaS (siz faqat kod va data), SaaS (siz faqat foydalanasiz).

**Muammo:** O'z data center'ingiz bo'lsa — server sotib olish haftalar, quvvat oldindan rejalanadi, ishlatilmagan server ham pul yeydi. Cloud'da 2 daqiqada server olasiz, kerak bo'lmasa o'chirasiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi (kim boshqaradi):**
```
            On-prem   IaaS     PaaS     SaaS
Ilova        SIZ      SIZ      SIZ      provayder
Data         SIZ      SIZ      SIZ      SIZ (qisman)
Runtime      SIZ      SIZ      prov.    provayder
OS           SIZ      SIZ      prov.    provayder
Hypervisor   SIZ      prov.    prov.    provayder
Hardware     SIZ      prov.    prov.    provayder
```

| Model | Misol | Siz boshqarasiz |
|---|---|---|
| IaaS | EC2, Azure VM, GCE | OS, patch, runtime, ilova |
| PaaS | Elastic Beanstalk, App Service, App Engine, Cloud Run | kod, config, data |
| SaaS | Google Workspace, GitHub, Slack | foydalanuvchilar, ruxsatlar |

**Amalda:**
```bash
# IaaS: VM olasiz, ichini o'zingiz sozlaysiz
aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-0abc --instance-type t3.micro
ssh ec2-user@IP 'sudo dnf update -y && sudo dnf install -y nginx'

# PaaS: faqat kodni berasiz
gcloud run deploy api --source .   # build, TLS, scaling — provayderda
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Cloud = arzon" emas: doim yoqiq katta VM on-prem'dan qimmat bo'lishi mumkin.
- PaaS'da vendor lock-in kuchliroq — runtime cheklovlari (timeout, disk) bor.
- SaaS'da ham data va access sizning javobgarligingiz.

**Senior nuqta:** Tanlov — nazorat va operatsion yuk o'rtasidagi trade-off. Kichik jamoa uchun PaaS/serverless default bo'lsin; IaaS'ga faqat aniq ehtiyoj (maxsus kernel, GPU, litsenziya) bo'lsa tushing.

40752.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Shared Responsibility Model: provayder **cloud'ning o'zi** (bino, hardware, hypervisor, global tarmoq) xavfsizligiga, mijoz **cloud ichidagi** narsalar (data, IAM, tarmoq qoidalari, kod) xavfsizligiga javob beradi. Chegara servis modeliga qarab siljiydi: IaaS'da mijozda ko'p, Serverless'da kam.

**Muammo:** Ko'p incident "AWS himoya qiladi deb o'ylagandik" dan: public S3 bucket, `0.0.0.0/0` ga ochiq SSH, patch qilinmagan AMI. Bularning hammasi mijoz tomonida.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
             IaaS (EC2)   PaaS (RDS)   Serverless (Lambda)
Data/IAM       MIJOZ        MIJOZ         MIJOZ
Ilova kodi     MIJOZ        MIJOZ         MIJOZ
Runtime        MIJOZ        provayder     provayder
OS patch       MIJOZ        provayder     provayder
Tarmoq (SG)    MIJOZ        MIJOZ         MIJOZ (VPC bo'lsa)
Hardware       provayder    provayder     provayder
```

**Amalda:** mijoz qismini tekshirish:
```bash
# public bucket'lar bormi
aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket my-bucket
# 22-port dunyoga ochiq SG'lar
aws ec2 describe-security-groups \
  --filters Name=ip-permission.from-port,Values=22 \
            Name=ip-permission.cidr,Values=0.0.0.0/0 \
  --query 'SecurityGroups[].GroupId'
# Lambda'da sizning qismingiz: execution role
aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name fn --query Role
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- RDS'da OS patch provayderda, lekin **minor version upgrade** oynasini siz sozlaysiz.
- Shifrlash imkoniyatini provayder beradi, yoqish — sizda.
- Lambda'da OS yo'q, lekin kod dependency'laridagi CVE sizniki.

**Senior nuqta:** Javobgarlik chegarasini servis bo'yicha jadvalga yozib qo'ying va guardrail'larni (SCP, Config rule, Security Hub) mijoz qismiga qo'ying. Managed servis tanlash — javobgarlikni provayderga o'tkazishning eng arzon yo'li.

40753.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Region** — geografik hudud (`us-east-1`), ichida 3+ **AZ**. **AZ** — mustaqil quvvat/tarmoqli bir yoki bir necha data center. **Local Zone** — region'ning katta shahar yaqinidagi kichik kengaytmasi (past latency). **Edge Location** — CloudFront/Route 53 kabi servislar uchun foydalanuvchiga yaqin PoP.

**Muammo:** Bitta data center yonsa yoki elektr o'chsa, ilova to'xtamasligi kerak (AZ). Butun hudud muammosi yoki qonun talabi (data mamlakat ichida) — region. Foydalanuvchi uzoqda — edge.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Region eu-central-1 (Frankfurt)
+-----------------------------------------+
|  AZ-a  <--~1-2ms-->  AZ-b  <-->  AZ-c   |
|  (DC1,DC2)          (DC3)      (DC4)    |
+-----------------------------------------+
        |                     \
   Local Zone (yaqin shahar)   Edge Location x 600+ (CDN cache, DNS)
```

| Daraja | Maqsad | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| Region | data rezidentlik, DR | `us-east-1` |
| AZ | HA (bitta DC nosozligi) | `us-east-1a` |
| Local Zone | <10ms latency (gaming, media) | `us-east-1-bos-1a` |
| Edge | cache, DNS, WAF | CloudFront PoP |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 describe-availability-zones --region eu-central-1 \
  --query 'AvailabilityZones[].[ZoneName,ZoneId,ZoneType]' --output table
```
`ZoneId` (`euc1-az1`) muhim: `us-east-1a` nomi har akkauntda boshqa fizik AZ'ga map bo'ladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- AZ'lar orasidagi trafik pullik (~$0.01/GB har yo'nalish) — chatty servislar qimmatga tushadi.
- Hamma servis hamma region'da yo'q; yangi region'lar opt-in.
- Akkauntlar orasida AZ nomi bilan emas, `ZoneId` bilan solishtiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Default — multi-AZ, single-region. Multi-region murakkablikni (data replikatsiya, consistency) 2-3 baravar oshiradi; faqat RTO/RPO yoki qonun talab qilsa qiling.

40754.a:
**Qisqa javob:** VPC (AWS) / VNet (Azure) — cloud ichida sizga ajratilgan **mantiqan izolyatsiyalangan virtual tarmoq**. IP diapazoni (CIDR), subnet'lar, route table, gateway va firewall qoidalarini o'zingiz belgilaysiz.

**Muammo:** Cloud'da minglab mijoz bir xil fizik tarmoqda. Sizning DB'ingiz boshqa mijoz yoki internetdan ko'rinmasligi kerak — VPC shu chegarani beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
VPC 10.0.0.0/16
+---------------------------------------------+
| AZ-a                     AZ-b               |
| public 10.0.1.0/24       public 10.0.2.0/24 | --> IGW --> internet
| private 10.0.11.0/24     private 10.0.12.0/24| --> NAT GW
| route tables, SG, NACL                      |
+---------------------------------------------+
```
Subnet bitta AZ'da yashaydi; VPC esa region bo'yicha.

**Amalda:**
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = "10.0.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
}
resource "aws_subnet" "app_a" {
  vpc_id            = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block        = "10.0.11.0/24"
  availability_zone = "eu-central-1a"
}
```
```bash
aws ec2 describe-vpcs --query 'Vpcs[].[VpcId,CidrBlock,IsDefault]'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CIDR'ni kichik tanlash (`/24`) — keyin EKS pod IP'lari yetmaydi.
- Boshqa VPC/on-prem bilan **kesishadigan** CIDR — keyin peering/VPN qilib bo'lmaydi.
- Default VPC'da prod ishlatish (hamma subnet public).

**Senior nuqta:** CIDR'ni tashkilot darajasida IPAM bilan rejalang (masalan har akkauntga `/16`, kelajakdagi peering uchun kesishmasdan). Bu keyin o'zgartirish eng qimmat qarorlardan biri.

40755.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Farq **route table'da**: public subnet'da `0.0.0.0/0 -> Internet Gateway`, private subnet'da `0.0.0.0/0 -> NAT Gateway` (yoki umuman default route yo'q). Shuning uchun private'dagi resursga internetdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kirib bo'lmaydi.

**Muammo:** Load balancer internetdan ko'rinishi kerak, DB va app server'lar esa yo'q. Lekin app server `apt update` yoki tashqi API uchun chiqishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
internet
   ^ v
  IGW
   |
[public subnet]  ALB, NAT GW, (bastion)
   |  route: 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw-xxx
   v
[private subnet] app, DB
      route: 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-xxx   (faqat chiquvchi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# subnet qaysi route table'ga bog'langan va default route qayerga
aws ec2 describe-route-tables \
  --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-0abc \
  --query 'RouteTables[].Routes[?DestinationCidrBlock==`0.0.0.0/0`]'
```
`GatewayId: igw-...` bo'lsa public, `NatGatewayId: nat-...` bo'lsa private.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Public subnet'dagi instance'ga public IP berilmasa, IGW bo'lsa ham internetga chiqolmaydi.
- NAT Gateway public subnet'da turishi kerak, private'da emas.
- "Private" — bu xavfsizlik kafolati emas; SG qoidalari baribir kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Odatiy 3 qatlam: public (faqat LB/NAT), private-app, isolated-data (default route yo'q). NAT xarajatini kamaytirish uchun S3/DynamoDB'ga gateway endpoint qo'ying.

40756.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Internet Gateway (IGW) — VPC'ni internetga ulaydigan, AWS boshqaradigan, gorizontal scale bo'ladigan va redundant komponent. Public IP'li resurslar uchun 1:1 NAT qiladi; bandwidth cheklovi va to'lovi yo'q (trafik o'zi pullik).

**Muammo:** VPC default'da yopiq. Veb-sayt internetdan kirilishi uchun chiqish/kirish nuqtasi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
EC2 (10.0.1.5, public 3.120.4.7)
   |  paket src=10.0.1.5
   v
route 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw
   v
IGW: src 10.0.1.5 -> 3.120.4.7 (1:1 NAT)
   v
internet
```
Bitta VPC'ga bitta IGW. Instance o'z OS'ida public IP'ni ko'rmaydi — tarjimani IGW qiladi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
IGW=$(aws ec2 create-internet-gateway --query InternetGateway.InternetGatewayId --output text)
aws ec2 attach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IGW --vpc-id vpc-0abc
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0pub \
  --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id $IGW
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- IGW ulangan, lekin route qo'shilmagan — trafik yurmaydi.
- Instance'da public/Elastic IP yo'q — IGW tarjima qila olmaydi.
- IPv6 uchun faqat chiquvchi kerak bo'lsa — **Egress-only IGW** ishlatiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** IGW o'zi xavfsizlik chegarasi emas, faqat yo'l. Kim ochiq bo'lishini SG/NACL va qaysi subnet'ga route berilganligi hal qiladi. 2024-dan beri public IPv4 manzil ham soatbay pullik — kerak bo'lmasa bermang.

40757.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **NAT Gateway** — AWS boshqaradigan, 100 Gbps gacha avtomatik scale bo'ladigan, AZ ichida HA servis; soat + GB uchun to'lov. **NAT Instance** — iptables MASQUERADE qiladigan oddiy EC2: arzon, lekin patch, scaling va failover sizda.

**Muammo:** Private subnet'dagi server tashqi API'ga chiqishi kerak, lekin internetdan unga kirish bo'lmasligi kerak — buni NAT hal qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
private app 10.0.11.7 --> NAT (public subnet, EIP 18.1.2.3) --> IGW --> internet
```
