```
javob: internet --> 18.1.2.3:port --> NAT jadvali --> 10.0.11.7
```

| | NAT Gateway | NAT Instance |
|---|---|---|
| Boshqaruv | AWS | siz (AMI, patch) |
| Bandwidth | 5 -> 100 Gbps auto | instance turiga bog'liq |
| HA | AZ ichida; har AZ'ga bittadan qo'ying | skript bilan failover |
| SG | qo'llanmaydi | qo'llanadi |
| Narx | ~$0.045/soat + $0.045/GB | instance narxi |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id subnet-pub-a --allocation-id eipalloc-0abc
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-priv-a \
  --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0abc
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bitta NAT GW'ni hamma AZ ishlatsa: o'sha AZ yiqilsa hammasi uziladi + cross-AZ trafik to'lovi.
- S3'ga trafik NAT orqali o'tib katta GB to'lovi — gateway endpoint qo'ying.
- NAT Instance'da source/dest check'ni o'chirish esdan chiqadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod'da har AZ'ga NAT GW. Hisobda "NatGateway-Bytes" katta bo'lsa — VPC Flow Logs bilan kim ishlatayotganini toping; ko'pincha S3/ECR trafigi, endpoint bilan bepul qilinadi.

40758.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Security Group** — ENI/instance darajasida, **stateful**, faqat Allow qoidalari. **NACL** — subnet darajasida, **stateless**, Allow va Deny, raqam tartibida birinchi mos kelgan qoida ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** Instance'ni himoyalash uchun SG yetarli; lekin butun subnet uchun ma'lum IP'ni **bloklash** kerak bo'lsa (SG'da Deny yo'q) — NACL.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
internet -> [NACL subnet chegarasi: in qoidasi] -> [SG instance: in qoidasi] -> app
app -> [SG: javob avtomatik ruxsat] -> [NACL: OUT qoidasi kerak! 1024-65535] -> internet
```
Stateful = SG ulanishni eslaydi, javobga alohida qoida kerak emas. Stateless = NACL har paketni alohida tekshiradi.

| | SG | NACL |
|---|---|---|
| Daraja | ENI | subnet |
| Holat | stateful | stateless |
| Qoidalar | faqat Allow | Allow + Deny |
| Baholash | hammasi birga | raqam bo'yicha, birinchi mos |
| Manba | CIDR yoki boshqa SG | faqat CIDR |

**Amalda:**
```bash
# SG: faqat ALB SG'dan 8080
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-app \
  --protocol tcp --port 8080 --source-group sg-alb
# NACL: yomon IP'ni bloklash
aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0abc --ingress \
  --rule-number 50 --protocol -1 --cidr-block 203.0.113.9/32 --rule-action deny
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- NACL'da ephemeral portlar (1024-65535) OUT ochilmasa — javoblar yo'qoladi.
- SG'da Deny yo'q — "bloklash" uchun SG ishlamaydi.
- NACL qoida raqamlari oralig'ini (10, 20...) qoldirmaslik.

**Senior nuqta:** Asosiy nazorat SG'da, SG-to-SG reference bilan (IP emas). NACL'ni default holatda qoldirib, faqat qo'pol subnet chegaralari uchun ishlating — murakkab NACL debug'ni og'irlashtiradi.

40759.a:
**Qisqa javob:** VPC peering — ikki VPC'ni AWS ichki tarmog'i orqali private IP bilan bog'lash (bir yoki boshqa akkaunt/region). Cheklovlar: **tranzitiv emas**, CIDR'lar **kesishmasligi** shart, N VPC uchun N(N-1)/2 ulanish.

**Muammo:** `shared-services` VPC'dagi monitoring `app` VPC'dagi server'larga private IP bilan yetishi kerak, internetga chiqmasdan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
VPC-A 10.0.0.0/16 <==pcx==> VPC-B 10.1.0.0/16 <==pcx==> VPC-C 10.2.0.0/16
A -> C : YO'Q (B orqali o'tmaydi, tranzitiv emas)
Ikki tomonda ham route table'ga yozuv kerak.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-id vpc-A --peer-vpc-id vpc-B
aws ec2 accept-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-A --destination-cidr-block 10.1.0.0/16 \
  --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-B --destination-cidr-block 10.0.0.0/16 \
  --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc
```
SG'larda ham peer CIDR'ga ruxsat bering.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat accept qilib, route qo'shmaslik — "ulandi, lekin ping yo'q".
- 10 ta VPC = 45 peering — boshqarib bo'lmaydi.
- Peering orqali boshqa VPC'ning IGW/NAT'idan foydalanib bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** 2-3 VPC uchun peering eng arzon va tez (bir AZ ichida trafik to'lovi yo'q). Ko'proq bo'lsa yoki markaziy firewall kerak bo'lsa — Transit Gateway; faqat bitta servisni ochish kerak bo'lsa — PrivateLink.

40760.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Transit Gateway (TGW) — region darajasidagi boshqariladigan **hub router**: yuzlab VPC, VPN va Direct Connect'ni bitta markazga ulaydi va ular orasida **tranzitiv** routing beradi.

**Muammo:** 30 ta VPC'ni peering bilan full mesh qilish = 435 ulanish. On-prem VPN'ni ham har VPC'ga alohida ulash kerak bo'lardi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
        VPC-A   VPC-B   VPC-C
           \      |      /
            [ Transit Gateway ] -- route tables (segmentatsiya)
           /      |       \
     VPN on-prem  DX GW   Inspection VPC (firewall)
```
Har ulanish — attachment. TGW route table'lari bilan "prod dev'ni ko'rmasin" kabi segmentatsiya qilinadi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-transit-gateway --description core \
  --options DefaultRouteTableAssociation=disable,DefaultRouteTablePropagation=disable
aws ec2 create-transit-gateway-vpc-attachment --transit-gateway-id tgw-0abc \
  --vpc-id vpc-A --subnet-ids subnet-a1 subnet-a2
# VPC tomonida
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-A --destination-cidr-block 10.0.0.0/8 \
  --transit-gateway-id tgw-0abc
```
Organization bo'ylab ulashish — AWS RAM orqali.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Narx: har attachment soatbay + har GB uchun ($0.02/GB) — katta trafikda sezilarli.
- Default route table hammani hamma bilan bog'laydi — segmentatsiya yo'qoladi.
- Attachment subnet'ini har AZ'da bermaslik — o'sha AZ trafigi yetib bormaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** TGW — landing zone'ning markaziy qismi: markaziy egress va inspection VPC (Network Firewall) bilan. Yuqori hajmli ikki VPC orasida baribir to'g'ridan-to'g'ri peering qo'yish mumkin — arzonroq.

40761.a:
**Qisqa javob:** PrivateLink — bitta **servisni** boshqa VPC'ga sizning subnet'ingizdagi **private IP'li ENI (interface endpoint)** orqali ochish. Trafik internetga chiqmaydi, ikki VPC tarmog'i umuman birlashmaydi.

**Muammo:** SaaS provayder yoki boshqa jamoa servisiga ulanish kerak, lekin butun VPC'ni peering qilish (va CIDR kesishmasligini ta'minlash) ortiqcha va xavfli.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Consumer VPC (10.0.0.0/16)            Provider VPC (10.0.0.0/16 ham bo'lishi mumkin!)
app --> ENI 10.0.11.50 (endpoint) ===PrivateLink===> NLB --> servis
     DNS: api.vendor.com -> 10.0.11.50
```
Bir tomonlama: consumer provider'ga ulanadi, teskarisi yo'q.

**Amalda:**
```bash
# AWS servisi uchun (masalan ECR, STS, SSM)
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0abc --vpc-endpoint-type Interface \
  --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.ecr.api \
  --subnet-ids subnet-a subnet-b --security-group-ids sg-endpoint \
  --private-dns-enabled
```
Provider tomoni: NLB oldiga `create-vpc-endpoint-service-configuration`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Endpoint SG'si 443'ni app SG'dan ochmasa — timeout.
- `private-dns-enabled` o'chiq — app hali public endpoint'ga boradi.
- Har endpoint har AZ'da soatbay pullik — 20 servis x 3 AZ tez yig'iladi.

**Senior nuqta:** PrivateLink — "servis darajasidagi" ulanish, eng kam ruxsat printsipiga mos. Ko'p akkauntda interface endpoint'larni markaziy shared VPC'da qo'yib, Route 53 orqali ulashish xarajatni kamaytiradi.

40762.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Gateway VPC Endpoint — **faqat S3 va DynamoDB** uchun, route table'ga qo'shiladigan **bepul** yozuv. Private subnet bu servislarga NAT yoki public IP'siz, AWS ichki tarmog'i orqali chiqadi.

**Muammo:** Private subnet'dagi ETL kuniga 5 TB S3'ga yozadi. NAT GW orqali bo'lsa ~$0.045/GB = oyiga minglab dollar. Gateway endpoint bilan — $0.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
private app --> route table:
   pl-6ea54007 (S3 prefix list) -> vpce-0abc   <-- gateway endpoint
   0.0.0.0/0                    -> nat-0abc
S3 trafigi NAT'ga umuman bormaydi.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0abc \
  --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.s3 \
  --route-table-ids rtb-priv-a rtb-priv-b
```
Endpoint policy bilan faqat o'z bucket'laringizga ruxsat:
```json
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":"*","Action":"s3:*",
  "Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::corp-*","arn:aws:s3:::corp-*/*"]}]}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat shu region'dagi S3 ishlaydi; boshqa region bucket'i hali NAT orqali.
- On-prem yoki peered VPC gateway endpoint'dan foydalana olmaydi — ular uchun S3 **interface** endpoint (pullik).
- Bucket policy'da `aws:SourceVpce` cheklovi qo'yilsa, konsol kirishi ham bloklanishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Har yangi VPC shabloniga S3 va DynamoDB gateway endpoint'ini default qo'shing — bu cloud'dagi eng oson "bepul" tejash va data exfiltration'ni endpoint policy bilan cheklash vositasi.

40763.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **ALB** — L7 (HTTP/HTTPS/gRPC), host/path bo'yicha routing. **NLB** — L4 (TCP/UDP/TLS), juda past latency, statik IP, client IP saqlanadi. **GWLB** — L3, trafikni firewall/IDS appliance'lari orqali shaffof o'tkazadi (GENEVE).

**Muammo:** Bitta domen ostida `/api` va `/web` turli servisga borishi kerak (ALB). O'yin server UDP va statik IP kerak (NLB). Barcha trafik Palo Alto firewall'dan o'tishi kerak (GWLB).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ALB:  client --HTTPS--> ALB (TLS tugaydi, header o'qiladi) --> /api -> TG-api
                                                           --> host=admin -> TG-admin
NLB:  client --TCP--> NLB (paketni ochmaydi) --> target (src IP = client)
GWLB: VPC trafik --> GWLB endpoint --> GWLB --GENEVE--> firewall fleet --> qaytadi
```

| | ALB | NLB | GWLB |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qatlam | L7 | L4 | L3 |
| Protokol | HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket | TCP, UDP, TLS | IP |
| Statik IP | yo'q (DNS) | ha, har AZ | - |
| WAF | ha | yo'q | - |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws elbv2 create-rule --listener-arn $LISTENER --priority 10 \
  --conditions Field=path-pattern,Values='/api/*' \
  --actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=$TG_API
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- ALB orqasida client IP faqat `X-Forwarded-For` da — log'da ALB IP'ni ko'rasiz.
- NLB'da endi SG qo'llash mumkin (2023+), lekin default'da yo'q — target SG'ni to'g'ri ochish kerak.
- Health check yo'li noto'g'ri — barcha target unhealthy.

**Senior nuqta:** HTTP servis uchun default — ALB (WAF, routing, auth). NLB — non-HTTP, juda yuqori RPS, PrivateLink provider yoki statik IP talab qilinganda. Ikkalasi zanjiri (NLB -> ALB) statik IP + L7 uchun ishlatiladi.

40764.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **EBS** — bitta EC2'ga ulanadigan block disk (bitta AZ). **S3** — HTTP API orqali obyekt storage, cheksiz, 11 to'qqizlik durability. **EFS** — ko'p instance bir vaqtda mount qiladigan managed NFS (POSIX).

**Muammo:** DB uchun tez lokal disk kerak (EBS). Rasmlar va backup uchun arzon cheksiz joy (S3). 10 ta web server bitta umumiy papkani ko'rishi kerak (EFS).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
EBS:  EC2 --(block, /dev/nvme1n1)--> volume (1 AZ, odatda 1 instance)
S3:   har kim --HTTPS PUT/GET--> bucket/key (region, 3+ AZ)
EFS:  EC2 x N --NFSv4.1--> mount target (har AZ) --> fayl tizimi
```

| | EBS | S3 | EFS |
|---|---|---|---|
| Turi | block | object | file (NFS) |
| Kirish | 1 EC2 (io2 multi-attach istisno) | HTTP API | ko'p client |
| Latency | sub-ms | ~10-100ms | ms |
| Narx/GB | ~$0.08 (gp3) | ~$0.023 | ~$0.30 (Standard) |
| K8s | ReadWriteOnce | - | ReadWriteMany |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-volume --size 100 --volume-type gp3 --availability-zone eu-central-1a
aws s3 cp backup.tar.gz s3://corp-backups/2026/
sudo mount -t efs fs-0abc:/ /mnt/shared   # amazon-efs-utils
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- EBS boshqa AZ'dagi instance'ga ulanmaydi — snapshot orqali ko'chirish kerak.
- S3'ni fayl tizimi deb ishlatish (append, rename yo'q; Mountpoint ham to'liq POSIX emas).
- EFS'da ko'p kichik faylli build — sekin va qimmat.

**Senior nuqta:** Default qoida: holat (state) — managed DB yoki S3'da, EBS faqat haqiqatan lokal disk kerak bo'lsa. Shared fayl tizimi (EFS) ko'pincha arxitektura hidi — S3 + obyekt API ko'proq scale bo'ladi.

40765.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **gp3** — umumiy SSD (3000 IOPS / 125 MB/s bazaviy, alohida oshiriladi). **io2 Block Express** — kritik DB uchun 256K IOPS gacha, sub-ms latency, 99.999% durability. **st1** — ketma-ket katta o'qish uchun throughput HDD. **sc1** — eng arzon cold HDD.

**Muammo:** Noto'g'ri tur — yo pul isrof (hamma joyda io2), yo sekin DB (gp2 kichik hajmda IOPS yetmaydi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**

| Tur | Media | Maks IOPS | Maks MB/s | Ishlatish |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| gp3 | SSD | 16 000 (yangi: 80 000) | 1 000 (yangi: 2 000) | boot, app, ko'p DB |
| io2 BE | SSD | 256 000 | 4 000 | Oracle, SAP, katta Postgres |
| st1 | HDD | 500 | 500 | log, Kafka, big data |
| sc1 | HDD | 250 | 250 | arxiv, kam kirish |

gp2'da IOPS hajmga bog'langan edi (3 IOPS/GB); gp3'da mustaqil va ~20% arzon.

**Amalda:**
```bash
# gp2 -> gp3, downtime'siz
aws ec2 modify-volume --volume-id vol-0abc --volume-type gp3 --iops 6000 --throughput 250
aws ec2 describe-volumes-modifications --volume-id vol-0abc
# ichida yuklamani ko'rish
iostat -x 1   # r/s + w/s ~ IOPS, %util, await
```
CloudWatch: `VolumeQueueLength` doim yuqori bo'lsa — IOPS yetmayapti.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Instance turi ham EBS bandwidth limitiga ega — katta volume, kichik instance = baribir sekin.
- st1/sc1 boot volume bo'la olmaydi.
- `modify-volume` dan keyin 6 soat qayta o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Hamma gp2'ni gp3'ga o'tkazish — deyarli har audit'da birinchi tejash. io2'ga faqat o'lchangan IOPS/latency talab bilan o'ting; ko'p hollarda managed DB (Aurora) bu savolni yo'q qiladi.

40766.a:
**Qisqa javob:** IMDSv2 — EC2 metadata servisi (`169.254.169.254`) ning session'li versiyasi: avval `PUT` bilan token olinadi, keyin har so'rov shu token header bilan. Bu **SSRF** orqali IAM credential o'g'irlashni deyarli imkonsiz qiladi.

**Muammo:** 2019 Capital One incident: ilovadagi SSRF orqali hujumchi `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/role` ni GET qilib role kalitlarini oldi. IMDSv1'da oddiy GET yetarli edi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
1) PUT /latest/api/token
   X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600   --> TOKEN
2) GET /latest/meta-data/...
   X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: TOKEN               --> ma'lumot
SSRF odatda faqat GET, custom header qo'yolmaydi -> bloklanadi.
Hop limit=1: paket bitta hop'dan o'tmaydi -> container ichidan (qo'shimcha hop) kirib bo'lmaydi.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
TOKEN=$(curl -sX PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token \
  -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300')
curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" \
  http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id

# Majburiy qilish
aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-options --instance-id i-0abc \
  --http-tokens required --http-put-response-hop-limit 1
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eski SDK/agent'lar faqat v1 ishlatadi — `required` qilishdan oldin CloudWatch `MetadataNoToken` metrikasini tekshiring.
- EKS'da hop limit=1 pod'larni ham bloklaydi — bu yaxshi, pod'lar IRSA/Pod Identity ishlatsin.
- Faqat launch template'da emas, account default'ida ham yoqing.

**Senior nuqta:** Organization darajasida `ec2:MetadataHttpTokens=required` SCP sharti va akkaunt default'i bilan v1'ni butunlay taqiqlang. 2024+ yangi AMI'lar (AL2023) default'da v2.

40767.a:
**Qisqa javob:** EC2 Auto Scaling — Auto Scaling Group (ASG) dagi instance sonini metrika yoki jadvalga qarab `min`/`max` oralig'ida avtomatik o'zgartiradi va nosoz instance'ni almashtiradi. Maqsad — yetarli quvvat, eng past narxda.

**Muammo:** Kunduzi 20 server kerak, kechasi 3 ta. Qo'lda boshqarsangiz yo pul isrof, yo cho'qqida sayt yiqiladi. Bitta server o'lsa ham kimdir uni qayta yaratishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Launch Template (AMI, tur, user-data, SG)
        v
ASG: min=2 desired=4 max=20, subnet'lar 3 AZ
        |  health check (EC2 yoki ELB) --> unhealthy -> terminate + yangi
        |  scaling policy (CPU 60%) --> desired o'zgaradi
        v
Target Group (ALB) ga avtomatik register
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name web \
  --launch-template LaunchTemplateName=web,Version='$Latest' \
  --min-size 2 --max-size 20 --desired-capacity 4 \
  --vpc-zone-identifier "subnet-a,subnet-b,subnet-c" \
  --target-group-arns $TG --health-check-type ELB --health-check-grace-period 120
aws autoscaling describe-scaling-activities --auto-scaling-group-name web --max-items 5
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `health-check-type EC2` — ilova o'lgan, lekin VM tirik; ELB health check ishlating.
- Instance'da state (lokal fayl, sessiya) — scale-in'da yo'qoladi.
- Uzun boot (10 daqiqa) — cho'qqiga kech qoladi; warm pool yoki tezroq AMI.

**Senior nuqta:** ASG — "cattle" modeli: instance'lar bir xil va istalgan payt o'ladi. Yangilanish uchun Instance Refresh ishlating, qo'lda SSH emas. K8s'da shu rolni Karpenter/Cluster Autoscaler o'ynaydi.

40768.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Target Tracking** — metrikani maqsadda ushlaydi (CPU 60%). **Step** — alarm chegarasiga qarab qadam-qadam qo'shadi. **Scheduled** — vaqt jadvali bo'yicha. **Predictive** — ML bilan kunlik naqshni bashorat qilib oldindan scale qiladi.

**Muammo:** Trafik turi har xil: silliq o'sish (target tracking), keskin portlash (step), ma'lum aksiya vaqti (scheduled), har kuni 9:00 dagi takroriy cho'qqi (predictive).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Target tracking: CPU 80% > 60% maqsad --> desired = ceil(cur * 80/60)
Step:  CPU 70-85% -> +2;  85%+ -> +5
Scheduled: 08:30 da min=10, 20:00 da min=2
Predictive: o'tgan 14 kun naqshi --> 09:00 dan oldin oldindan ko'tarish
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws autoscaling put-scaling-policy --auto-scaling-group-name web \
  --policy-name cpu60 --policy-type TargetTrackingScaling \
  --target-tracking-configuration '{
    "PredefinedMetricSpecification":{"PredefinedMetricType":"ASGAverageCPUUtilization"},
    "TargetValue":60}'
aws autoscaling put-scheduled-update-group-action --auto-scaling-group-name web \
  --scheduled-action-name morning --recurrence "30 8 * * MON-FRI" --min-size 10
```
`ALBRequestCountPerTarget` ko'pincha CPU'dan yaxshiroq signal.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Scale-in juda agressiv — flapping (yoqildi-o'chdi). Cooldown/warmup to'g'ri bo'lsin.
- Predictive'ni avval `ForecastOnly` rejimda sinamasdan yoqish.
- Ilova bottleneck'i DB bo'lsa, app scale qilish yordam bermaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Odatiy kombinatsiya: Target Tracking (asos) + Scheduled/Predictive (ma'lum cho'qqilar). Metrika so'rov soni yoki queue chuqurligi bo'lsin — CPU kech signal.

40769.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Spot — AWS'ning bo'sh quvvati, On-Demand'dan **90% gacha arzon**, lekin AWS uni **2 daqiqa ogohlantirish** bilan qaytarib olishi mumkin. Spot Fleet (va zamonaviy usul — ASG mixed instances / EC2 Fleet) ko'p turdagi instance va AZ'lardan sig'imni yig'ib, uzilish xavfini taqsimlaydi.

**Muammo:** CI runner'lar, batch, stateless web'ga On-Demand narxini to'lash isrof. Lekin bitta Spot turi qaytarilsa hamma birdan o'ladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Target: 20 vCPU
pool: m5.large/a, m5a.large/b, m6i.large/c, c5.xlarge/a ...
strategy: price-capacity-optimized --> eng chuqur, arzon pool'lar
interrupt --> 2 min notice (IMDS + EventBridge) --> drain --> yangi pool'dan almashtirish
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# instance ichida uzilish xabarini kuzatish
TOKEN=$(curl -sX PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 60')
curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" \
  http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/spot/instance-action
# 404 = hammasi joyida; JSON {"action":"terminate","time":...} = 2 daqiqa qoldi
```
ASG: `MixedInstancesPolicy` — `OnDemandBaseCapacity=2`, qolgani Spot, 10+ instance turi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bitta instance turi — tez-tez `InsufficientInstanceCapacity`.
- State'li ishni (DB) Spot'da ishlatish.
- `lowest-price` strategiyasi — eng ko'p uziladigan pool'lar; `price-capacity-optimized` ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Spot'ga mos workload: stateless, idempotent, checkpoint qila oladigan. K8s'da Karpenter + node termination handler bilan Spot'ni 60-80% gacha ishlatish odatiy; kritik qism On-Demand baza ustida turadi.

40770.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ikkalasi — 1 yoki 3 yilga majburiyat evaziga chegirma. **Savings Plans** — soatlik $ sarf majburiyati; Compute SP EC2/Fargate/Lambda'ga, istalgan region/oila/OS'ga avtomatik qo'llanadi (~66% gacha). **Reserved Instances** — aniq instance oilasi/region'ga bog'langan; Standard RI chegirmasi biroz yuqoriroq (72% gacha), moslashuvchanlik kam.

**Muammo:** Doim ishlaydigan baza yuklama (masalan 40 vCPU 24/7) uchun On-Demand to'lash — yiliga katta isrof.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Majburiyat: $10/soat Compute SP
Soatlik sarf $14 --> birinchi $10 (On-Demand ekvivalenti) chegirma bilan, qolgan $4 On-Demand
Soatlik sarf $7  --> baribir $10 to'laysiz (ishlatilmagan majburiyat kuyadi)
```

| | Compute SP | EC2 Instance SP | Standard RI | Convertible RI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chegirma | ~66% | ~72% | ~72% | ~54% |
| Region o'zgartirish | ha | yo'q | yo'q | yo'q |
| Fargate/Lambda | ha | yo'q | yo'q | yo'q |
| RDS/ElastiCache | yo'q | yo'q | ha (o'z RI'si) | - |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ce get-savings-plans-purchase-recommendation \
  --savings-plans-type COMPUTE_SP --term-in-years ONE_YEAR \
  --payment-option NO_UPFRONT --lookback-period-in-days THIRTY_DAYS
aws ce get-savings-plans-utilization --time-period Start=2026-09-01,End=2026-10-01
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cho'qqi yuklamaga majburiyat olish — ishlatilmagan qism pul kuydiradi.
- RDS, ElastiCache, OpenSearch uchun SP yo'q (Database Savings Plans 2025 dan cheklangan) — ular uchun RI.
- Arxitektura o'zgarishi (Graviton'ga o'tish) EC2 Instance SP'ni foydasiz qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval rightsizing va Spot, keyin barqaror minimumning ~70-80% iga Compute SP. Utilization va coverage'ni oylik FinOps metrikasi qiling.

40771.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon ECS — AWS'ning o'z, to'liq boshqariladigan container orkestratori. Control plane bepul va ko'rinmaydi; IAM, ALB, CloudWatch bilan nativ. Kubernetes'dan soddaroq, lekin faqat AWS'da.

**Muammo:** 5-10 ta mikroservisni container'da ishlatish kerak, lekin jamoada K8s mutaxassisi yo'q va EKS control plane, upgrade, addon'larga vaqt yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Task Definition (image, CPU/mem, env, IAM task role, port)
      v
Service (desired=3, deployment: rolling/blue-green, ALB target group)
      v
Cluster capacity: Fargate  yoki  EC2 (capacity provider + ASG)
      v
Task = 1+ container birga (K8s pod'ga o'xshash)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ecs register-task-definition --cli-input-json file://taskdef.json
aws ecs update-service --cluster prod --service api \
  --task-definition api:42 --force-new-deployment
aws ecs describe-services --cluster prod --services api \
  --query 'services[0].deployments[].[status,runningCount,desiredCount]'
# container ichiga kirish
aws ecs execute-command --cluster prod --task <id> --container api \
  --interactive --command /bin/sh
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Task role (ilova ruxsati) va execution role (image pull, log) ni chalkashtirish.
- Deployment circuit breaker yoqilmasa, buzuq versiya cheksiz restart bo'ladi.
- `awsvpc` rejimida har task ENI oladi — EC2'da ENI limiti tugashi.

**Senior nuqta:** AWS-only jamoa va oddiy servislar uchun ECS + Fargate ko'pincha eng kam operatsion yuk. K8s ekotizimi (operator, Helm, multi-cloud) kerak bo'lsa — EKS. Tanlov texnologiya emas, jamoa imkoniyati bo'yicha.

40772.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Fargate — ECS va EKS uchun **serverless compute**: server/node yo'q, siz task/pod uchun vCPU va xotirani so'raysiz, AWS uni izolyatsiyalangan microVM'da ishga tushiradi va soniyabay to'laysiz.

**Muammo:** EC2 node'larda: AMI patch, node scaling, bin-packing, instance turini tanlash. Kichik jamoa uchun bu ortiqcha yuk.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ECS task / EKS pod (cpu=0.5, mem=1GB)
      v
Fargate: alohida microVM (Firecracker), o'z kernel'i
      v
ENI sizning subnet'ingizda, SG task'ga
Node yo'q --> SSH yo'q, DaemonSet yo'q (EKS'da)
```

**Amalda:**
```json
{"family":"api","requiresCompatibilities":["FARGATE"],
 "networkMode":"awsvpc","cpu":"512","memory":"1024",
 "runtimePlatform":{"cpuArchitecture":"ARM64"},
 "containerDefinitions":[{"name":"api","image":"123.dkr.ecr...:v42",
   "portMappings":[{"containerPort":8080}]}]}
```
```bash
aws ecs run-task --launch-type FARGATE --cluster prod --task-definition api \
  --network-configuration 'awsvpcConfiguration={subnets=[subnet-a],securityGroups=[sg-api]}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Doimiy katta yuklamada Fargate EC2'dan 20-40% qimmat.
- CPU/xotira faqat belgilangan kombinatsiyalarda (0.25 vCPU -> 16 vCPU).
- EKS Fargate'da DaemonSet, privileged, GPU ishlamaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Fargate — operatsion vaqtni pulga almashtirish. ARM64 (Graviton) + Fargate Spot bilan narx sezilarli tushadi. Katta, barqaror klasterda EC2 + Karpenter arzonroq.

40773.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon EKS — AWS boshqaradigan sertifikatlangan Kubernetes. Control plane (API server, etcd) AWS tomonidan 3 AZ'da HA, patch va upgrade qilinadi; worker node'lar (managed node group, Karpenter, Fargate yoki EKS Auto Mode) sizning tanlovingiz.

**Muammo:** O'zingiz K8s control plane'ini (etcd backup, sertifikat rotatsiyasi, HA) yuritish — og'ir va xavfli ish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
AWS akkaunti (ko'rinmaydi)          Sizning VPC
+---------------------+            +--------------------------+
| API server x2+      | <--ENI---> | node'lar (EC2/Fargate)   |
| etcd x3 (3 AZ)      |            | VPC CNI: pod = VPC IP    |
+---------------------+            +--------------------------+
IAM -> K8s auth: Access Entries (eski: aws-auth ConfigMap)
Pod -> AWS: IRSA yoki EKS Pod Identity
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
eksctl create cluster --name prod --region eu-central-1 --version 1.33 \
  --nodegroup-name ng1 --node-type m7g.large --nodes 3
aws eks update-kubeconfig --name prod
kubectl get nodes -o wide
aws eks describe-cluster --name prod --query 'cluster.[version,status]'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har versiya ~14 oy standart support; keyin extended support 6 baravar qimmat — upgrade'ni kechiktirmang.
- VPC CNI IP'larni tez tugatadi — kichik subnet'lar; prefix delegation yoki katta CIDR.
- `aws-auth` ConfigMap'ni buzib klasterga kirishni yo'qotish (Access Entries'ga o'ting).

**Senior nuqta:** EKS narxi control plane emas ($0.10/soat), balki upgrade ritmi va addon'larni (CNI, CoreDNS, ingress) yuritish. Klasterni IaC bilan qayta yaratiladigan qiling — blue/green klaster upgrade xavfsizroq.

40774.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Lambda — event'ga (S3 upload, API Gateway, SQS xabari) javoban kodingizni ishga tushiradigan serverless compute. Har chaqiriq izolyatsiyalangan **Firecracker microVM** dagi execution environment'da bajariladi; millisekund va xotira bo'yicha to'lov, 15 daqiqagacha.

**Muammo:** Kuniga 200 marta ishlaydigan rasm o'lchamini o'zgartirish uchun 24/7 server ushlash isrof.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
event --> Lambda service --> bo'sh environment bormi?
              | yo'q (cold)                     | ha (warm)
              v                                 v
   microVM + runtime + kod yuklash + INIT    handler(event) chaqiriladi
              v
       handler(event) --> natija
environment bir necha daqiqa saqlanadi, keyingi chaqiriqlarda qayta ishlatiladi
1 environment = bir vaqtda 1 so'rov; concurrency = parallel environment soni
```

**Amalda:**
```python
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client("s3")          # INIT: bir marta, qayta ishlatiladi

def handler(event, context):
    for r in event["Records"]:
        key = r["s3"]["object"]["key"]
        print(f"processing {key}, left={context.get_remaining_time_in_millis()}")
```
```bash
aws lambda invoke --function-name resize --payload file://ev.json out.json
aws logs tail /aws/lambda/resize --follow
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Account concurrency limiti (default 1000) — bitta funksiya hammasini yeb qo'yadi; reserved concurrency qo'ying.
- `/tmp` va global o'zgaruvchilar warm chaqiriqlar orasida saqlanadi — state "oqishi".
- Async/SQS trigger'lari retry qiladi — handler idempotent bo'lishi shart.

**Senior nuqta:** Lambda — notekis, event-driven yuklama uchun ajoyib; doimiy yuqori RPS'da container arzonroq. DB ulanishlarini RDS Proxy orqali boshqaring, aks holda concurrency DB'ni bo'g'adi.

40775.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cold start — yangi execution environment yaratish kechikishi: microVM, runtime start, kodni yuklash, INIT kodi. Kamaytirish: kichik paket va yengil INIT, **Provisioned Concurrency** (oldindan isitilgan), **SnapStart** (Java, Python, .NET — init'dan keyingi snapshot'dan tiklash).

**Muammo:** API'da p99 latency 50ms, lekin ba'zi so'rovlar 2-3 soniya — bu cold start. Java/Spring'da 5+ soniya bo'lishi mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
cold:  [microVM ~100ms][runtime][kod yuklash][INIT: SDK, DB pool][handler]
warm:                                                         [handler]
SnapStart: [snapshot'dan tiklash][handler]   (INIT oldindan bajarilgan)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# cold start'ni o'lchash: REPORT qatoridagi Init Duration
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/lambda/api \
  --filter-pattern '"Init Duration"' --query 'events[].message' | head
# Provisioned concurrency alias'ga
aws lambda put-provisioned-concurrency-config --function-name api \
  --qualifier live --provisioned-concurrent-executions 10
```
Kod tomonda: og'ir import'larni kamaytiring, faqat kerakli SDK client, arm64, xotirani oshirish (CPU ham oshadi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- VPC ichidagi Lambda endi cold start'ni sezilarli oshirmaydi (2019 Hyperplane ENI) — eski maslahat.
- SnapStart'da snapshot'dan keyin unique ID/random seed va ochiq ulanishlar qayta yaratilishi kerak.
- Provisioned concurrency doim pullik — trafik yo'q bo'lsa ham.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval o'lchang: cold start ulushi ko'pincha <1%. Faqat foydalanuvchi ko'radigan sinxron yo'lda optimallashtiring; async ishlarda e'tibor bermang.

40776.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon Aurora — MySQL va PostgreSQL bilan mos, cloud uchun qayta yozilgan relational DB. Asosiy g'oya: **compute va storage ajratilgan**; storage 3 AZ bo'ylab **6 nusxada**, yozish 4/6, o'qish 3/6 quorum bilan.

**Muammo:** Oddiy RDS'da replika o'z diskiga to'liq nusxa saqlaydi, failover daqiqalar, replica lag katta. Aurora'da hamma instance bitta umumiy storage'ni ko'radi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Writer --redo log--> Aurora storage (10GB segmentlar, 6 nusxa / 3 AZ)
Reader1 ---------------^   (bir xil storage, odatda <100ms lag)
Reader2 ---------------^
Writer o'lsa --> reader ~30s ichida writer bo'ladi (data ko'chirilmaydi)
1 AZ yo'qolsa ham yozish ishlaydi; 1 AZ + 1 nusxa yo'qolsa ham o'qish.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier prod \
  --query 'DBClusters[0].[Endpoint,ReaderEndpoint,DBClusterMembers]'
aws rds failover-db-cluster --db-cluster-identifier prod   # failover sinash
```
Ilova: yozish -> cluster endpoint, o'qish -> reader endpoint.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- I/O-intensive yuklamada Standard'da I/O to'lovi katta — **I/O-Optimized** konfiguratsiyani ko'ring.
- Reader'dan o'qish eventual — yozib darhol o'qish writer'dan bo'lsin.
- Aurora PostgreSQL'da ba'zi extension/versiyalar kechikib keladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Aurora — failover va read scaling uchun kuchli, lekin narxi RDS'dan yuqori. Global Database bilan region'lararo <1s lag. DNS cache tufayli failover'da ilova ulanishni qayta o'rnatishi kerak — retry va RDS Proxy.

40777.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Aurora Serverless v2 — Aurora instance'ining sig'imini **ACU** (1 ACU ~ 2 GB RAM + mos CPU) larda yuklamaga qarab soniyalar ichida, ulanishlarni uzmasdan oshirib-tushiradi. Endi **0 ACU** gacha tushib (auto-pause) to'xtashi ham mumkin.

**Muammo:** Dev/test yoki notekis yuklamali DB uchun doim katta instance ushlash isrof; v1 esa scale qilganda ulanishlarni uzar va sekin edi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
min ACU=0.5 ............ max ACU=64
yuklama oshdi --> 2 -> 8 -> 24 ACU (bosqichma-bosqich, ms-soniya)
yuklama tushdi --> asta pastga (buffer pool ehtiyotkor kamayadi)
Provisioned va Serverless v2 instance'lar bitta klasterda aralasha oladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws rds modify-db-cluster --db-cluster-identifier dev \
  --serverless-v2-scaling-configuration MinCapacity=0,MaxCapacity=16
aws rds create-db-instance --db-cluster-identifier dev \
  --db-instance-identifier dev-1 --db-instance-class db.serverless --engine aurora-postgresql
```
CloudWatch: `ServerlessDatabaseCapacity`, `ACUUtilization`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- ACU narxi provisioned'dan ~qimmatroq — doim yuqori yuklamada provisioned arzon.
- Min ACU juda past — cache sovuq, birinchi so'rovlar sekin; 0 dan uyg'onish ~15s.
- `max_connections` ACU'ga bog'liq — past min'da ulanish yetmasligi.

**Senior nuqta:** Yaxshi naqsh: writer provisioned (bashorat qilinadigan), reader'lar Serverless v2 (cho'qqilarni yutadi). Max ACU'ni byudjet guardrail sifatida qo'ying.

40778.a:
**Qisqa javob:** DynamoDB — AWS'ning to'liq boshqariladigan serverless key-value/document NoSQL bazasi: istalgan hajmda bir xonali ms latency, 3 AZ replikatsiya, PITR backup, Global Tables (multi-region active-active).

**Muammo:** Sessiya, savatcha, IoT event kabi juda ko'p oddiy key bo'yicha o'qish/yozish — relational DB'ni bunga scale qilish qimmat va murakkab.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Item: PK (partition key) [+ SK (sort key)] + atributlar (<=400KB)
hash(PK) --> partition (har biri ~3000 RCU / 1000 WCU, 10GB)
Query: bitta PK ichida SK bo'yicha (tez)
Scan: butun jadval (qimmat, sekin)
GSI: boshqa kalit bo'yicha ko'rinish (eventual)
```
Rejim: On-Demand (so'rov bo'yicha to'lov) yoki Provisioned (+auto scaling).

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws dynamodb put-item --table-name Orders \
  --item '{"PK":{"S":"USER#42"},"SK":{"S":"ORDER#2026-10-03#981"},"total":{"N":"120"}}'
aws dynamodb query --table-name Orders \
  --key-condition-expression 'PK = :u AND begins_with(SK, :p)' \
  --expression-attribute-values '{":u":{"S":"USER#42"},":p":{"S":"ORDER#2026-10"}}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hot partition — bitta PK'ga ko'p trafik (masalan `status=ACTIVE`) throttle bo'ladi.
- Scan'ni prod yo'lida ishlatish — sekin va qimmat.
- Ad-hoc query, JOIN, agregatsiya yo'q — keyin analitika uchun export kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** DynamoDB'ni access pattern'lardan boshlab loyihalang, jadval sxemasidan emas. Pattern'lar noaniq yoki tez o'zgaradigan bo'lsa — Postgres yaxshiroq tanlov.

40779.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Single-table design — bir nechta entity'ni (user, order, item) **bitta** DynamoDB jadvalida umumiy `PK`/`SK` va GSI'lar bilan saqlash, shunda bog'liq ma'lumot bitta `Query` bilan olinadi. Shart: access pattern'lar oldindan aniq bo'lishi.

**Muammo:** DynamoDB'da JOIN yo'q. Har entity alohida jadvalda bo'lsa, "user va uning oxirgi 10 buyurtmasi" uchun bir necha so'rov kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PK          SK                    atributlar
USER#42     PROFILE               name, email
USER#42     ORDER#2026-10-01#7    total, status
USER#42     ORDER#2026-10-03#9    total, status
ORDER#9     ITEM#1                sku, qty
GSI1: GSI1PK=status#PENDING, GSI1SK=createdAt  --> "kutayotgan buyurtmalar"
Query PK=USER#42 --> profil + buyurtmalar bitta so'rovda
```

**Amalda:** avval pattern ro'yxati:
```
1. User profilini ol           -> PK=USER#id, SK=PROFILE
2. User buyurtmalari (yangi)   -> PK=USER#id, SK begins_with ORDER#, ScanIndexForward=false
3. Status bo'yicha buyurtmalar -> GSI1
```
```bash
aws dynamodb query --table-name App --key-condition-expression 'PK=:p' \
  --expression-attribute-values '{":p":{"S":"USER#42"}}' --no-scan-index-forward
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Yangi access pattern — ko'pincha backfill va yangi GSI kerak.
- Jadvalni o'qish va debug qilish qiyin; o'qiladigan tooling kerak.
- Hamma narsani bitta jadvalga majburlash — har xil lifecycle/backup talabi bo'lsa ajrating.

**Senior nuqta:** Single-table — performans optimizatsiyasi, dogma emas. AWS ham hozir "bog'liq va birga o'qiladigan entity'lar uchun" deb tavsiya qiladi; GraphQL/tez o'zgaradigan mahsulotda multi-table oddiyroq.

40780.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Route 53 — AWS'ning yuqori mavjud authoritative DNS servisi (100% SLA), domen ro'yxatdan o'tkazish va health check bilan. Routing policy'lar: **Simple, Weighted, Latency, Failover, Geolocation, Geoproximity, Multivalue, IP-based**.

**Muammo:** Bitta domen trafigini region'lar orasida taqsimlash, yangi versiyaga 10% yuborish yoki region yiqilsa avtomatik zaxiraga o'tish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
client --> resolver --> Route 53: api.corp.com?
   Weighted:  90% -> ALB-v1, 10% -> ALB-v2
   Latency:   foydalanuvchiga eng yaqin region ALB
   Failover:  primary healthy? -> primary : secondary
   Geo:       UZ -> eu-central-1, US -> us-east-1
```

| Policy | Ishlatish |
|---|---|
| Simple | bitta resurs |
| Weighted | canary, A/B |
| Latency | multi-region tezlik |
| Failover | active-passive DR |
| Geolocation | qonun, kontent lokalizatsiyasi |
| Multivalue | 8 tagacha sog'lom IP |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123 --change-batch '{
 "Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{
   "Name":"api.corp.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"v2","Weight":10,
   "AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z215JYRZR1TBD5","DNSName":"alb-v2...elb.amazonaws.com",
   "EvaluateTargetHealth":true}}}]}'
dig +short api.corp.com
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Yuqori TTL — failover'da client'lar eski IP'da qoladi.
- Geolocation'da "Default" yozuv yo'q — mos kelmagan mamlakat javob olmaydi.
- Zone apex'da CNAME bo'lmaydi — Alias ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** DNS failover — daqiqalar darajasida (TTL + resolver cache). Soniyalar kerak bo'lsa Global Accelerator. Health check'lar ilovaning haqiqiy bog'liqliklarini tekshirsin, faqat `200 OK` emas.

40781.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CloudFront — AWS'ning global CDN'i: statik fayl, dinamik API va video'ni 600+ edge location orqali foydalanuvchiga yaqin joydan beradi. Cache, TLS, WAF, edge funksiyalar (CloudFront Functions, Lambda@Edge) bir joyda.

**Muammo:** S3 bucket Frankfurt'da, foydalanuvchi Toshkent va Sidneyda. Har so'rov okean kesib o'tadi — sekin, va origin barcha yuklamani o'zi ko'taradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
user --> eng yaqin edge (DNS orqali)
           | cache HIT --> darhol javob
           | MISS --> regional edge cache --> origin (S3/ALB) --> keshlaydi
Cache key = URL + tanlangan header/cookie/query (Cache Policy)
TTL: Cache-Control: max-age / s-maxage
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# kesh'ni tozalash (deploy'dan keyin)
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1ABC --paths '/index.html' '/assets/*'
# HIT yoki MISS?
curl -sI https://cdn.corp.com/app.js | grep -iE 'x-cache|age|cache-control'
# x-cache: Hit from cloudfront
```
S3 origin'ni faqat CloudFront o'qishi uchun **Origin Access Control (OAC)** ishlating (eski OAI emas).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cache key'ga barcha cookie/header qo'shish — hit ratio ~0%.
- Fayl nomida versiya yo'q (`app.js`) — har deploy'da invalidation kerak; `app.3f9a.js` ishlating.
- Dinamik shaxsiy javobni keshlab, boshqa foydalanuvchiga ko'rsatish.

**Senior nuqta:** Asosiy metrika — cache hit ratio va origin yuklamasi. Statik asset'lar uzoq TTL + immutable nom, HTML qisqa TTL. CloudFront'dan S3/AWS origin'ga data transfer bepul — internetga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri S3'dan berishdan ko'pincha arzon.

40782.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Global Accelerator — sizga **2 ta statik Anycast IP** beradi; trafik eng yaqin AWS edge'da qabul qilinib, AWS global backbone orqali sog'lom region'dagi ALB/NLB/EC2'ga yetkaziladi. L4 (TCP/UDP), keshlamaydi.

**Muammo:** Multi-region ilovada DNS failover sekin (TTL, resolver cache), client'lar IP'ni allowlist qilgan, va internet orqali uzoq yo'l jitter beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
client --> 75.2.x.x (anycast) --> eng yaqin edge
             --> AWS backbone --> endpoint group eu-central-1 (weight, health)
                              \-> endpoint group us-east-1
region unhealthy --> ~30 soniyada boshqasiga (IP o'zgarmaydi)
```

| | CloudFront | Global Accelerator |
|---|---|---|
| Qatlam | L7 HTTP | L4 TCP/UDP |
| Kesh | ha | yo'q |
| IP | dinamik (DNS) | 2 statik anycast |
| Ishlatish | web, API, statik | o'yin, VoIP, IoT, tez failover |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws globalaccelerator create-accelerator --name api --region us-west-2
aws globalaccelerator create-endpoint-group --listener-arn $L \
  --endpoint-group-region eu-central-1 \
  --endpoint-configurations EndpointId=$ALB_ARN,Weight=100 --region us-west-2
```
(GA API faqat `us-west-2` orqali boshqariladi.)

**Tuzoqlar:**
- HTTP kontentni keshlash kerak bo'lsa GA yordam bermaydi — CloudFront kerak.
- Narx: soatbay + DT-Premium — kichik trafikda nisbatan qimmat.
- Client IP saqlash faqat ma'lum endpoint turlarida.

**Senior nuqta:** GA — "DNS'ga ishonmaslik" vositasi: IP allowlist talab qiladigan B2B mijozlar va soniyalar ichidagi failover uchun. Oddiy veb uchun CloudFront + Route 53 yetarli.

40783.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Direct Connect (DX) — on-prem data center'ni AWS'ga **maxsus fizik optik liniya** (1/10/100 Gbps) orqali ulash. Internet chetlab o'tiladi: barqaror bandwidth, bashorat qilinadigan latency, arzonroq chiquvchi trafik. Default'da **shifrlanmagan**.

**Muammo:** Bank on-prem DB'dan har kuni 20 TB AWS'ga sinxronlaydi. VPN internet orqali — tezlik va latency o'zgaruvchan, ~1.25 Gbps tunnel limiti.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
On-prem router --cross-connect--> DX location (colo) --> AWS backbone
        BGP sessiya, VIF (virtual interface):
          Private VIF  --> VGW / DX Gateway --> VPC'lar
          Transit VIF  --> DX Gateway --> Transit Gateway
          Public VIF   --> AWS public servislar (S3 public endpoint)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws directconnect describe-connections --query 'connections[].[connectionName,bandwidth,connectionState]'
aws directconnect describe-virtual-interfaces --query 'virtualInterfaces[].[virtualInterfaceType,bgpPeers[0].bgpStatus]'
```
Router tomonda BGP holati: `show bgp summary` — `Established` bo'lishi kerak.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bitta DX liniya = bitta nuqtali nosozlik. Kamida 2 ta, turli location'da (yoki DX + VPN zaxira).
- Provision qilish haftalar/oylar — oxirgi daqiqada rejalamang.
- Shifrlash: 10/100G'da **MACsec**, yoki DX ustidan IPsec VPN.

**Senior nuqta:** DX — tarmoq loyihasi, bitta API chaqiriq emas: BGP, ASN, route summarization, failover testi kerak. AWS Resiliency Toolkit "maximum resiliency" modeli (4 ulanish, 2 location) kritik tizimlar uchun standart.

40784.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Site-to-Site VPN — on-prem router (**Customer Gateway**) ni AWS'dagi **Virtual Private Gateway** yoki **Transit Gateway** bilan internet orqali **IPsec** shifrlangan tunnel bilan ulash. Har ulanish = 2 tunnel (2 xil AWS endpoint), har biri ~1.25 Gbps.

**Muammo:** Ofis yoki kichik data center'ni AWS VPC bilan tezda (soatlarda) va arzon xavfsiz bog'lash kerak; DX uchun vaqt/byudjet yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
on-prem CGW (public IP) ==IPsec tunnel 1==> AWS endpoint A --+
                        ==IPsec tunnel 2==> AWS endpoint B --+--> VGW/TGW --> VPC
routing: static yoki BGP (tavsiya: BGP, avtomatik failover)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-customer-gateway --type ipsec.1 --public-ip 198.51.100.10 --bgp-asn 65010
aws ec2 create-vpn-connection --type ipsec.1 --customer-gateway-id cgw-0abc \
  --transit-gateway-id tgw-0abc
aws ec2 describe-vpn-connections --query 'VpnConnections[].VgwTelemetry[].[OutsideIpAddress,Status]'
```
AWS router uchun tayyor konfiguratsiya fayli beradi (Cisco, Juniper, strongSwan, pfSense).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat bitta tunnel sozlangan — AWS texnik ishida ulanish uziladi.
- MTU/MSS: IPsec overhead tufayli katta paketlar tushadi — MSS clamp 1379.
- Trafik bo'lmasa tunnel uxlaydi — DPD va doimiy keepalive.

**Senior nuqta:** VPN — DX'ning zaxirasi yoki boshlang'ich yo'l. Ko'proq bandwidth kerak bo'lsa TGW + ECMP bilan bir nechta VPN'ni birlashtiring yoki Accelerated VPN.

40785.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS IAM — AWS'da **kim** (autentifikatsiya) **nima qila olishini** (avtorizatsiya) boshqaradigan global, bepul servis: user, group, role, policy. Har bir AWS API chaqiriq IAM tomonidan tekshiriladi.

**Muammo:** Dasturchi, CI pipeline, Lambda va EC2 — har biri AWS'ga kirishi kerak, lekin faqat kerakli darajada. Hamma bitta admin kalit ishlatsa — bitta oqish hamma narsani yo'qotadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Principal (user / role session / servis)
   --> so'rov: Action=s3:GetObject, Resource=arn:aws:s3:::b/k, Context(IP, MFA, tag)
   --> IAM: identity policy + resource policy + SCP + boundary --> Allow / Deny
```
Asosiy obyektlar: **User** (odam/kalit), **Group** (user'lar to'plami), **Role** (vaqtinchalik assume qilinadigan identity), **Policy** (JSON ruxsat).

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws sts get-caller-identity          # men kimman?
aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/app \
  --action-names s3:GetObject --resource-arns arn:aws:s3:::corp-data/x.csv
aws iam generate-service-last-accessed-details --arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/app
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Root user'ni kundalik ishlatish va MFA'siz qoldirish.
- `AdministratorAccess` ni "keyin toraytiramiz" deb berish — hech qachon torayilmaydi.
- Access key'larni kodga yoki `.env` ga yozish.

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsad — odamlarda uzoq muddatli kalit nol (SSO), workload'larda faqat role. IAM Access Analyzer bilan ishlatilmagan ruxsatlarni muntazam kesib, least privilege'ga iterativ yaqinlashing.

40786.a:
**Qisqa javob:** IAM policy — ruxsatlarni ta'riflovchi JSON hujjat. Asosiy elementlar: `Version`, `Statement[]`, ichida `Effect` (Allow/Deny), `Action` (`s3:GetObject`), `Resource` (ARN), ixtiyoriy `Condition` (IP, MFA, tag) va resource-based policy'da `Principal`.

**Muammo:** "Bu Lambda faqat bitta bucket'ning `uploads/` papkasidan o'qisin va faqat shifrlangan ulanish orqali" — buni aniq ifodalash kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Statement = Effect + Action + Resource [+ Condition] [+ Principal]
identity-based: user/role'ga biriktiriladi (Principal yo'q — u biriktirilgan identity)
resource-based: bucket/KMS key/SQS'ga biriktiriladi (Principal kerak)
```

**Amalda:**
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "ReadUploads",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::corp-data/uploads/*",
      "Condition": {"Bool": {"aws:SecureTransport": "true"}}
    },
    {
      "Sid": "ListOnlyPrefix",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::corp-data",
      "Condition": {"StringLike": {"s3:prefix": "uploads/*"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
`ListBucket` bucket ARN'ga, `GetObject` obyekt ARN'ga (`/*`) — eng ko'p xato shu yerda.

```bash
aws accessanalyzer validate-policy --policy-type IDENTITY_POLICY --policy-document file://p.json
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `"Version": "2012-10-17"` ni tushirib qoldirish — policy variable'lar ishlamaydi.
- `"Action": "s3:*", "Resource": "*"` — keng ruxsat.
- `NotAction`/`NotResource` ni Allow bilan ishlatish — kutilmagan keng ruxsat.

**Senior nuqta:** Policy'larni IaC'da yozing, PR'da `validate-policy` va Access Analyzer "unused access" bilan tekshiring. Tag'ga asoslangan (ABAC) condition'lar ko'p jamoali muhitda policy sonini keskin kamaytiradi.

40787.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Tartib: (1) default — **implicit deny**; (2) biror joyda **explicit Deny** bo'lsa — darhol rad; (3) aks holda barcha cheklovchi qatlamlar (SCP, RCP, permission boundary, session policy) ruxsat berishi **va** identity yoki resource policy'da **explicit Allow** bo'lishi kerak.

**Muammo:** "Policy'da Allow bor, lekin AccessDenied" — bu deyarli har doim boshqa qatlam (SCP, boundary, KMS key policy, bucket policy) sabab.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
so'rov
  v
explicit Deny bormi (har qanday policy'da)? --ha--> DENY
  v yo'q
SCP / RCP ruxsat beradimi? --yo'q--> DENY
  v
resource policy Allow beradimi (bir akkaunt ichida)? --ha--> ALLOW
  v
permission boundary ruxsat beradimi? --yo'q--> DENY
  v
session policy (assume vaqtida) ruxsat beradimi? --yo'q--> DENY
  v
identity policy Allow? --ha--> ALLOW, yo'q--> DENY (implicit)
Cross-account: IKKALA tomonda (identity + resource) Allow kerak.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/app \
  --action-names kms:Decrypt --resource-arns arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:111:key/abc \
  --query 'EvaluationResults[].[EvalActionName,EvalDecision,MatchedStatements[].SourcePolicyId]'
```
AccessDenied xabari endi qaysi turdagi policy rad etganini ko'rsatadi: `...with an explicit deny in a service control policy`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- KMS: key policy ruxsat bermasa, IAM Allow yetarli emas.
- Permission boundary ruxsat **bermaydi**, faqat chegaralaydi.
- Simulator SCP va resource policy'larni har doim to'liq hisobga olmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Debug tartibi: xato matni -> CloudTrail event (`errorCode`, `errorMessage`) -> qatlam bo'yicha tekshirish. Guardrail'larni Deny (SCP) bilan, ruxsatlarni Allow bilan yozing — ikkalasini aralashtirmang.

40788.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **IAM User** — uzoq muddatli credential'li doimiy identity (parol, access key). **IAM Role** — hech qanday doimiy credential'siz identity; ishonilgan entity (EC2, Lambda, pod, boshqa akkaunt, SSO foydalanuvchisi) uni **assume** qilib vaqtinchalik (15 daq - 12 soat) kalit oladi.

**Muammo:** User access key'i GitHub'ga tushib qolsa — u o'chirilguncha ishlaydi. Role kaliti esa bir soatda o'zi tugaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Role = trust policy (KIM assume qila oladi) + permission policy (NIMA qila oladi)
EC2 --instance profile--> sts:AssumeRole --> AccessKeyId + SecretKey + SessionToken (1 soat)
GitHub Actions --OIDC token--> sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity --> vaqtinchalik kalit
```

**Amalda:** CI uchun kalitsiz role:
```json
{"Effect":"Allow",
 "Principal":{"Federated":"arn:aws:iam::111:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com"},
 "Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
 "Condition":{"StringEquals":{
   "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud":"sts.amazonaws.com",
   "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub":"repo:corp/api:ref:refs/heads/main"}}}
```
```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222:role/deploy --role-session-name me
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name legacy-bot   # eski kalitlarni toping
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- OIDC trust'da `sub` shartini qo'ymaslik — har qanday repo role'ni assume qiladi.
- Ilovaga user kaliti berish o'rniga instance role ishlatmaslik.
- Role session muddatini 12 soat qilib, qisqa muddat afzalligini yo'qotish.

**Senior nuqta:** Zamonaviy standart: odamlar — Identity Center (SSO), workload'lar — role (instance profile, IRSA/Pod Identity, OIDC). IAM user faqat role ishlata olmaydigan eski tizim uchun istisno, kalit rotatsiyasi va alert bilan.

40789.a:
**Qisqa javob:** IAM Identity Center (sobiq AWS SSO) — korporativ IdP (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace) bilan ulanib, xodimlarga barcha AWS akkauntlariga **bitta login** bilan, vaqtinchalik credential orqali kirishni beruvchi markaziy servis. Ruxsatlar **Permission Set** larda.

**Muammo:** 40 ta akkaunt, 200 xodim. Har akkauntda IAM user yaratish, xodim ketganda hammasini o'chirish — xavfli va qo'lda.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Okta/Entra (user, group) --SCIM sync--> Identity Center
Permission Set "ReadOnly", "DevPowerUser"
Assignment: group "payments-dev" + PS "DevPowerUser" + akkaunt "payments-dev"
     --> har akkauntda avtomatik role: AWSReservedSSO_DevPowerUser_xxx
User login --> portal --> akkaunt+role tanlaydi --> 1-12 soatlik kalit
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws configure sso          # profil: sso_start_url, sso_region, account, role
aws sso login --profile payments-dev
aws s3 ls --profile payments-dev
```
`~/.aws/config` da faqat profil — hech qanday doimiy secret yo'q.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- IdP'da group'lar to'g'ri SCIM sync qilinmasa — ketgan xodim hali kira oladi.
- Hammaga `AdministratorAccess` permission set berish.
- Identity Center o'zi bir region'da — o'sha region muammosiga break-glass rejasi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Xodim offboarding'i IdP'da bitta joyda bo'lishi — asosiy xavfsizlik yutug'i. Break-glass uchun MFA'li 1-2 favqulodda IAM user/root, CloudTrail alert bilan.

40790.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SCP (Service Control Policy) — AWS Organizations'da OU yoki akkauntga qo'yiladigan **maksimal ruxsat chegarasi**. U hech narsaga ruxsat **bermaydi**, faqat cheklaydi; SCP taqiqlagan narsani akkauntdagi admin, hatto root ham qila olmaydi (management account'dan tashqari).

**Muammo:** 50 ta akkauntda kimdir CloudTrail'ni o'chirmasligi, ruxsat etilmagan region'da resurs yaratmasligi kerak — har akkaunt IAM'iga ishonib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Root OU (SCP: FullAWSAccess)
  +-- Prod OU (SCP: deny region != eu-*, deny cloudtrail:Stop*)
  |     +-- payments-prod akkaunt
  +-- Sandbox OU (SCP: deny ec2 katta instance turlari)
Samarali ruxsat = IAM Allow  KESISHMA  barcha yuqori SCP'lar
```

**Amalda:**
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{
  "Sid":"DenyOutsideEU","Effect":"Deny","NotAction":["iam:*","sts:*","route53:*","cloudfront:*","support:*"],
  "Resource":"*",
  "Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:RequestedRegion":["eu-central-1","eu-west-1"]}}
}]}
```
```bash
aws organizations attach-policy --policy-id p-abc --target-id ou-xyz
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Global servislarni (IAM, CloudFront) region SCP'sidan istisno qilmaslik — ular `us-east-1` da.
- SCP management (payer) akkauntga ta'sir qilmaydi — u yerda workload ishlatmang.
- Allow-list SCP'lar keng ko'lamda boshqarib bo'lmaydi — deny-list ko'proq ishlatiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** SCP — preventiv guardrail; uni avval sandbox OU'da sinang, keyin prod'ga. RCP (Resource Control Policy, 2024) bilan birga "data perimeter" quriladi: faqat o'z org'dagi identity'lar o'z resurslaringizga kira oladi.

40791.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CloudTrail — AWS akkauntidagi **har bir API chaqiriqni** (kim, qachon, qaysi IP'dan, qaysi parametr bilan, natija) yozadigan audit servisi. Management event'lar default'da 90 kun Event History'da; uzoq saqlash uchun **Trail** (S3) yoki CloudTrail Lake.

**Muammo:** Kecha prod'dagi security group o'zgardi va sayt yiqildi. Kim, qachon o'zgartirdi? Yoki hujumchi qaysi kalit bilan nima qildi?

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Konsol / CLI / SDK / servis --> AWS API --> CloudTrail event (JSON)
   management events: CreateBucket, AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress (default)
   data events: s3:GetObject, lambda:Invoke (alohida yoqiladi, pullik)
   --> S3 (org trail, log file validation) --> Athena / SIEM
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events \
  --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress \
  --start-time 2026-10-02 --query 'Events[].[EventTime,Username,CloudTrailEvent]' --max-results 5
```
Event ichida: `userIdentity.arn`, `sourceIPAddress`, `requestParameters`, `errorCode`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat Event History'ga ishonish — 90 kundan keyin yo'q, data event'lar yo'q.
- Trail bucket'i shu akkauntda va o'chirilishi mumkin — hujumchi izni o'chiradi.
- Data event'larni hamma bucket'ga yoqish — katta xarajat.

**Senior nuqta:** Organization trail -> alohida log-archive akkauntidagi Object Lock'li bucket, SCP bilan `StopLogging` taqiqlangan. Muhim event'larga (root login, IAM o'zgarishi) EventBridge orqali real-time alert.

40792.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CloudWatch — AWS'ning kuzatuv servisi: **Metrics** (CPU, latency, custom), **Logs** (jamlash, Logs Insights so'rovlari), **Alarms** (chegara -> SNS/autoscaling), Dashboards, shuningdek Synthetics, Container Insights, Application Signals.

**Muammo:** 30 servis, 200 instance. Qaysi biri sekin, xato qayerda, qachon odamni uyg'otish kerak — bularni bir joyda ko'rish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
AWS servislari --(avtomatik)--> Metrics (namespace AWS/EC2, AWS/ApplicationELB)
CloudWatch Agent / ilova --> custom metrics + Logs (log group / stream)
Metric --> Alarm (5 daqiqa ichida 3/3 nuqta > 80%) --> SNS --> PagerDuty / ASG
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm --alarm-name api-5xx --namespace AWS/ApplicationELB \
  --metric-name HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count --dimensions Name=LoadBalancer,Value=app/prod/abc \
  --statistic Sum --period 60 --evaluation-periods 5 --datapoints-to-alarm 3 \
  --threshold 50 --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold --alarm-actions $SNS
```
Logs Insights:
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter level = "ERROR"
| stats count() by bin(5m), service
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Log group'larga retention qo'ymaslik — "Never expire", xarajat yillar davomida o'sadi.
- EC2 xotira va disk metrikasi default'da yo'q — agent kerak.
- Yuqori cardinality'li custom metric (har user_id) — katta hisob.

**Senior nuqta:** Alarm'lar simptomga (5xx, latency SLO) qo'yilsin, CPU'ga emas. Katta hajmda log'larni S3 + Athena yoki boshqa backend'ga yuborish arzon bo'lishi mumkin — ingestion narxini kuzating.

40793.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SSM Session Manager — instance'dagi SSM Agent orqali **22-port ochmasdan, bastion va public IP'siz**, IAM bilan boshqariladigan shell sessiyasi. Har sessiya CloudTrail'da, buyruq chiqishi esa S3/CloudWatch'ga log qilinishi mumkin.

**Muammo:** Bastion host + SSH kalitlari: kalitlarni tarqatish, ketgan xodim kaliti, ochiq 22-port, kim nima qilgani noma'lum.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
siz (aws ssm start-session) --IAM tekshiruv--> SSM servisi
                                                  ^
instance: SSM Agent --chiquvchi HTTPS 443--> SSM endpoint (NAT yoki VPC endpoint orqali)
Kiruvchi port yo'q. Instance role: AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ssm describe-instance-information --query 'InstanceInformationList[].[InstanceId,PingStatus]'
aws ssm start-session --target i-0abc
# port forwarding: private RDS'ga lokal 5432 orqali
aws ssm start-session --target i-0abc --document-name AWS-StartPortForwardingSessionToRemoteHost \
  --parameters host=db.internal,portNumber=5432,localPortNumber=5432
```
Private subnet uchun endpoint'lar: `ssm`, `ssmmessages`, `ec2messages`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Instance "Managed" ro'yxatda yo'q — role yo'q yoki 443 chiqishi/endpoint yo'q.
- `ssm:StartSession` ni `Resource: *` bilan berish — hamma serverga kirish.
- Sessiya log'i yoqilmasa audit faqat "kirdi" darajasida.

**Senior nuqta:** SSH'ni butunlay yopib, Session Manager'ni tag-asoslangan IAM (`ssm:resourceTag/Env=dev`) bilan ishlating. Lekin maqsad — umuman kirishga ehtiyoj qolmasligi (immutable infra, observability).

40794.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS KMS — shifrlash kalitlarini yaratish, saqlash (FIPS HSM'larda), rotatsiya va ishlatishni IAM + key policy bilan boshqaradigan servis. Kalit KMS'dan hech qachon ochiq holda chiqmaydi; katta ma'lumot **envelope encryption** bilan shifrlanadi.

**Muammo:** Ilova o'zi kalit saqlasa — kalit kod/config'da oqadi, rotatsiya va kim ishlatganini kuzatish yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi (envelope):**
```
1) GenerateDataKey(KMS key) --> plaintext data key + encrypted data key
2) ilova data'ni plaintext key bilan AES-256-GCM shifrlaydi, plaintext key'ni xotiradan o'chiradi
3) saqlaydi: ciphertext + encrypted data key
O'qish: Decrypt(encrypted data key) --> plaintext key --> data'ni ochish
Har Decrypt CloudTrail'da.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws kms create-key --description "app data" --key-usage ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/app-data --target-key-id <key-id>
aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id <key-id>          # yillik avtomatik
aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/app-data --plaintext fileb://secret.txt \
  --query CiphertextBlob --output text
```

| Kalit turi | Kim boshqaradi | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| AWS owned | AWS | ko'rinmaydi |
| AWS managed (`aws/s3`) | AWS | o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi |
| Customer managed | siz | to'liq nazorat, $1/oy |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Key policy'da akkaunt root'ga ruxsat yo'q — kalit "boshqarib bo'lmaydigan" bo'lib qoladi.
- Kalitni o'chirish (`ScheduleKeyDeletion`) — u bilan shifrlangan hamma narsa qaytmas yo'qoladi.
- KMS API so'rov limiti — har obyektga Decrypt; S3 Bucket Key bilan kamaytiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Customer managed key — cross-account kirish va "kalitni o'chirib ma'lumotni kriptografik yo'q qilish" nazorati uchun. Key policy'ni least privilege va `kms:ViaService` sharti bilan yozing.

40795.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Secrets Manager** — secret'lar uchun: avtomatik rotatsiya (RDS uchun tayyor), versiyalash, cross-account, replikatsiya; ~$0.40/secret/oy. **SSM Parameter Store** — ierarxik config key-value (`/app/prod/db_host`), `SecureString` (KMS) bilan; Standard tier bepul, rotatsiya yo'q.

**Muammo:** DB parolini env faylda saqlash — oqadi va hech qachon almashtirilmaydi. Har 30 kunda parolni ilovani to'xtatmasdan almashtirish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Secrets Manager rotatsiya:
 createSecret (AWSPENDING) --> setSecret (DB'da yangi parol) --> testSecret --> finishSecret (AWSCURRENT)
 ilova har ulanishda / cache TTL bilan GetSecretValue qiladi
Parameter Store:
 /app/prod/feature_x = "on"    (String)
 /app/prod/api_key   = ****    (SecureString, KMS)
```

| | Secrets Manager | Parameter Store |
|---|---|---|
| Rotatsiya | ha (Lambda) | yo'q |
| Narx | $0.40/secret | Standard bepul |
| Hajm | 64 KB | 4 KB / 8 KB (Advanced) |
| Cross-account | resource policy | cheklangan |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws secretsmanager create-secret --name prod/db --secret-string '{"user":"app","password":"..."}'
aws secretsmanager rotate-secret --secret-id prod/db --rotation-rules AutomaticallyAfterDays=30
aws ssm put-parameter --name /app/prod/db_host --value db.internal --type String
aws ssm get-parameters-by-path --path /app/prod --with-decryption
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ilova secret'ni faqat start'da o'qisa — rotatsiyadan keyin ulanish xatosi.
- Secret qiymatini CloudFormation/Terraform output yoki state'da ochiq qoldirish.
- Har so'rovda `GetSecretValue` — narx va throttling; caching client ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Odatiy bo'linish: haqiqiy credential — Secrets Manager (rotatsiya bilan), oddiy config va feature flag — Parameter Store. RDS uchun eng yaxshisi — `ManageMasterUserPassword` yoki IAM DB auth (umuman parol yo'q).

40796.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS WAF — CloudFront, ALB, API Gateway, AppSync, Cognito va App Runner oldida ishlaydigan **L7 web application firewall**: SQLi, XSS, yomon bot, rate flood va geo bo'yicha so'rovlarni bloklaydi. Qoidalar **Web ACL** da.

**Muammo:** Login endpoint'iga sekundiga 5000 credential-stuffing so'rov; yoki ilovada hali tuzatilmagan SQLi. Kod tuzatilgunga qadar chekkada himoya kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
so'rov --> CloudFront/ALB --> Web ACL (priority tartibida):
   1. IP allowlist        -> Allow
   2. AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet -> Block
   3. SQLi rule set       -> Block
   4. rate-based: >300/5min/IP on /login -> Block
   default action        -> Allow
Har qoida: Count (faqat log) yoki Block/Allow/CAPTCHA/Challenge
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws wafv2 list-available-managed-rule-groups --scope REGIONAL \
  --query 'ManagedRuleGroups[].Name'
aws wafv2 get-sampled-requests --web-acl-arn $ACL --rule-metric-name rate-login \
  --scope REGIONAL --time-window StartTime=2026-10-03T00:00:00Z,EndTime=2026-10-03T06:00:00Z \
  --max-items 20
```
Log'larni S3/CloudWatch'ga yoqib, Athena'da `action='BLOCK'` ni tahlil qiling.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Managed rule'larni darhol Block'da yoqish — haqiqiy foydalanuvchilar bloklanadi; avval Count.
- `SizeRestrictions_BODY` katta upload'larni bloklaydi.
- WAF'ni "kodni tuzatish o'rniga" deb ko'rish.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval Count rejimida 1-2 hafta, false positive'larni scope-down bilan tozalab, keyin Block. Rate-based rule'lar va Bot Control eng ko'p qiymat beradi; WAF — defense in depth qatlami.

40797.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Shield Standard** — barcha AWS mijozlari uchun bepul va avtomatik L3/L4 DDoS himoyasi (SYN flood, UDP reflection). **Shield Advanced** (~$3000/oy + trafik, 1 yillik) — 24/7 Shield Response Team, DDoS sababli scaling xarajatidan moliyaviy himoya, L7 avtomatik mitigation, batafsil telemetriya.

**Muammo:** Biznes uchun kritik sayt 500 Gbps hujum ostida. Standard tarmoq qatlamini ushlaydi, lekin L7 HTTP flood va hujum paytida autoscaling hisobi sizda qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
L3/L4 flood --> AWS edge (Standard: avtomatik filtr)
L7 HTTP flood --> WAF qoidalari (siz yozasiz)
     Advanced: avtomatik WAF qoidasi yaratish, SRT yordami,
               Route 53 health-based detection, cost protection
Himoya qilinadigan resurs: CloudFront, Route 53, GA, ALB, EIP
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws shield create-subscription                     # Advanced (qimmat, ehtiyot!)
aws shield create-protection --name web --resource-arn $CLOUDFRONT_ARN
aws shield list-attacks --start-time FromInclusive=2026-09-01T00:00:00Z
```
Arxitektura tomonda: hamma narsani CloudFront/GA ortiga yashiring, origin IP'ni oshkor qilmang.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Origin ALB to'g'ridan-to'g'ri internetga ochiq — hujumchi CDN'ni chetlab o'tadi.
- Advanced'ni yoqib, resurslarni "protected" qilib qo'shmaslik.
- L7 himoya uchun WAF baribir sozlanishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p kompaniya uchun Standard + CloudFront + WAF rate rule'lari yetarli. Advanced — DDoS sababli moliyaviy/reputatsion zarar katta bo'lgan (fintech, gaming, media) va org bo'yicha ko'p resursi borlar uchun.

40798.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GuardDuty — CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS log'lari (va ixtiyoriy S3, EKS audit, RDS login, Lambda, runtime monitoring) ni tahdid razvedkasi va ML bilan tahlil qilib, **buzilgan instance, o'g'irlangan credential, kripto-mayning** kabi tahdidlarni topadigan servis. Agent kerak emas (runtime'dan tashqari).

**Muammo:** Kimdir EC2'da kripto-mayner ishga tushirdi yoki access key Tor'dan ishlatilyapti — buni log'larni qo'lda kuzatib topish imkonsiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CloudTrail + Flow Logs + DNS (GuardDuty o'zi oladi, siz yoqmasangiz ham)
     --> threat intel (yomon IP/domen) + anomaliya ML
     --> Finding: "CryptoCurrency:EC2/BitcoinTool.B!DNS" severity 8
     --> EventBridge --> SNS / Lambda (avtomatik izolyatsiya) / Security Hub
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws guardduty create-detector --enable
DET=$(aws guardduty list-detectors --query 'DetectorIds[0]' --output text)
aws guardduty list-findings --detector-id $DET \
  --finding-criteria '{"Criterion":{"severity":{"Gte":7}}}'
aws guardduty create-sample-findings --detector-id $DET   # pipeline'ni sinash
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat bitta region'da yoqish — hujumchi ishlatilmagan region'da mayning qiladi.
- Finding'lar hech kimga yetib bormaydi (alert routing yo'q).
- Pentest/skaner IP'lari uchun suppression qoidasi yo'q — shovqin.

**Senior nuqta:** Org darajasida delegated admin akkauntdan barcha akkaunt va region'larda yoqing. Yuqori severity finding'lar uchun avtomatik javob (instance'ni karantin SG'ga o'tkazish, kalitni deaktivatsiya) — incident playbook'ning bir qismi.

40799.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Security Hub — GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, IAM Access Analyzer, Config va third-party tool'lar topilmalarini **yagona formatda (ASFF/OCSF)** jamlaydigan va akkauntlarni CIS, AWS FSBP, PCI-DSS, NIST standartlariga qarshi avtomatik tekshiradigan markaziy security posture servisi.

**Muammo:** 5 ta security servis, 40 akkaunt, 10 region — har biri o'z konsolida. "Umumiy holatimiz qanday va eng muhim 10 muammo qaysi?" degan savolga javob yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
GuardDuty   \
Inspector    \
Macie         ---> Security Hub (aggregator region, delegated admin) --> score, dashboard
Config rules /        |
3rd party   /         +--> EventBridge --> Jira / Slack / auto-remediation
Standartlar: FSBP "S3.1 Block Public Access yoqilmagan" -> FAILED
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws securityhub enable-security-hub --enable-default-standards
aws securityhub get-findings --filters '{
  "SeverityLabel":[{"Value":"CRITICAL","Comparison":"EQUALS"}],
  "WorkflowStatus":[{"Value":"NEW","Comparison":"EQUALS"}]}' \
  --query 'Findings[].[Title,Resources[0].Id]' --max-items 10
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hamma standartni birdan yoqish — minglab finding, hech kim ko'rmaydi.
- AWS Config yoqilmasa — control tekshiruvlari ishlamaydi.
- Finding'larga egalik (owner) va SLA yo'q — dashboard faqat bezak.

**Senior nuqta:** Security Hub — "yagona navbat"; qiymat triage jarayonidan keladi: severity bo'yicha egasi, muddati, avtomatik suppression qoidalari. FSBP'dan boshlang, keyin compliance talab qilgan standart.

40800.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon Inspector — EC2 instance, ECR image'lari va Lambda funksiyalarini **dasturiy zaifliklar (CVE)** va EC2 uchun **tarmoqqa keraksiz ochiqlik** bo'yicha avtomatik va uzluksiz skanerlaydigan servis. Yangi CVE chiqsa, mavjud resurslarni qayta baholaydi.

**Muammo:** 300 ta container image va 100 instance. Log4Shell kabi CVE chiqqanda "qaysi joyda zaif kutubxona bor?" ga daqiqalarda javob kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
EC2: SSM Agent (yoki agentless EBS snapshot skan) --> paket inventari
ECR: push'da + uzluksiz (image'lar) --> OS + til paketlari (npm, pip, Maven, Go)
Lambda: funksiya kodi va layer'lar
   --> CVE bazasi bilan solishtirish --> finding + Inspector score (CVSS + ochiqlik)
   --> Security Hub / EventBridge
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws inspector2 enable --resource-types EC2 ECR LAMBDA
aws inspector2 list-findings --filter-criteria '{
  "severity":[{"comparison":"EQUALS","value":"CRITICAL"}],
  "vulnerabilityId":[{"comparison":"EQUALS","value":"CVE-2021-44228"}]}' \
  --query 'findings[].resources[0].id'
# SBOM eksport
aws inspector2 create-sbom-export --report-format CYCLONEDX_1_4 --s3-destination bucketName=corp-sbom
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- SSM Agent ishlamayotgan instance'lar skanerlanmaydi (agentless rejimini yoqing).
- Faqat skan — tuzatish yo'q; patch jarayoni bo'lmasa finding'lar to'planadi.
- Eski ECR image'lar ham skanerlanib xarajat qo'shadi — lifecycle policy.

**Senior nuqta:** Inspector — runtime inventari; CI'da (Trivy/Grype) "shift left" skan bilan birga ishlating. Ustuvorlik: internetga ochiq + exploit mavjud + CRITICAL; qolganini rejali patch siklida.

40801.a:
**Qisqa javob:** S3 storage class'lari saqlash narxi va o'qish narxi/tezligi orasidagi trade-off: **Standard** (tez-tez), **Intelligent-Tiering** (noma'lum naqsh, avtomatik), **Standard-IA / One Zone-IA** (oyda kam), **Glacier Instant Retrieval** (kam, lekin ms'da), **Glacier Flexible** (daqiqa-soat), **Deep Archive** (12-48 soat, eng arzon). Plus **Express One Zone** — bir xonali ms latency.

**Muammo:** 500 TB log va backup Standard'da — oyiga ~$11 500. Ko'pi hech qachon o'qilmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**

| Class | $/GB-oy (taxm.) | Min muddat | O'qish |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | 0.023 | - | ms, bepul |
| Intelligent-Tiering | 0.023 -> 0.004 | - | ms (arxiv tier'lar ixtiyoriy) |
| Standard-IA | 0.0125 | 30 kun | ms, $/GB |
| Glacier Instant | 0.004 | 90 kun | ms, qimmatroq $/GB |
| Glacier Flexible | 0.0036 | 90 kun | 1 daq - 12 soat |
| Deep Archive | 0.00099 | 180 kun | 12-48 soat |

**Amalda:** lifecycle qoidasi:
```json
{"Rules":[{"ID":"logs","Status":"Enabled","Filter":{"Prefix":"logs/"},
  "Transitions":[{"Days":30,"StorageClass":"STANDARD_IA"},
                 {"Days":180,"StorageClass":"DEEP_ARCHIVE"}],
  "Expiration":{"Days":2555}}]}
```
```bash
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket corp-logs --lifecycle-configuration file://lc.json
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kichik obyektlar (<128 KB) IA'da 128 KB deb hisoblanadi — qimmatlashadi.
- Minimum muddatdan oldin o'chirish — qolgan kunlar baribir to'lanadi.
- Glacier'dan tiklash vaqtini DR rejasida hisobga olmaslik.

**Senior nuqta:** Naqsh noma'lum bo'lsa — Intelligent-Tiering default. S3 Storage Lens va Storage Class Analysis bilan o'lchab, keyin lifecycle yozing.

40802.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Versioning** — bucket'dagi har obyektning barcha versiyalarini saqlaydi: ustidan yozish yangi versiya yaratadi, o'chirish faqat **delete marker** qo'yadi. **MFA Delete** — versiyani butunlay o'chirish yoki versioning'ni to'xtatish uchun root'ning MFA kodini talab qiladi.

**Muammo:** Skript xato bilan `aws s3 rm --recursive` qildi yoki ransomware fayllarni shifrlangan nusxa bilan almashtirdi. Versioning bo'lmasa — ma'lumot yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PUT report.csv  --> v1
PUT report.csv  --> v2 (v1 saqlanadi)
DELETE report.csv --> delete marker (v1, v2 hali bor)
GET report.csv  --> 404, lekin GET ?versionId=v2 --> ishlaydi
DELETE ?versionId=v1 --> butunlay o'chadi (MFA Delete bo'lsa — MFA kerak)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket corp-data --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled
aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket corp-data --prefix report.csv
# tiklash: delete marker'ni o'chirish
aws s3api delete-object --bucket corp-data --key report.csv --version-id <marker-id>
```
Eski versiyalar uchun lifecycle: `NoncurrentVersionExpiration: {NoncurrentDays: 90}`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Versioning'ni bir marta yoqsangiz o'chirib bo'lmaydi, faqat `Suspended`.
- Lifecycle'siz eski versiyalar cheksiz to'planadi — hisob ikki baravar.
- MFA Delete faqat root + CLI orqali yoqiladi, avtomatlashtirish qiyin.

**Senior nuqta:** Amalda MFA Delete o'rniga ko'proq **Object Lock** va alohida akkauntga replikatsiya ishlatiladi — avtomatlashtirish va ransomware'ga qarshi kuchliroq.

40803.a:
**Qisqa javob:** S3 Object Lock — **WORM** (Write Once Read Many): obyekt versiyasini belgilangan retention muddati davomida o'chirib yoki ustidan yozib bo'lmaydi. **Compliance** rejimida hech kim (root ham) qisqartira olmaydi; **Governance** rejimida maxsus ruxsatli user chetlab o'ta oladi. Alohida **Legal Hold** — muddatsiz qulf.

**Muammo:** Hujumchi admin kalitini o'g'irlab, backup'larni o'chirib, keyin to'lov talab qiladi. Yoki regulyator (SEC 17a-4) yozuvlarni 7 yil o'zgarmas saqlashni talab qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
bucket: Object Lock enabled (versioning majburiy)
PUT backup.tar  + Retention: COMPLIANCE, RetainUntil=2027-10-03
DELETE ?versionId=...  --> AccessDenied (2027 gacha)
DELETE (versiyasiz)    --> faqat delete marker, versiya qoladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws s3api create-bucket --bucket corp-backup-lock --object-lock-enabled-for-bucket \
  --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=eu-central-1
aws s3api put-object-lock-configuration --bucket corp-backup-lock \
  --object-lock-configuration '{"ObjectLockEnabled":"Enabled",
   "Rule":{"DefaultRetention":{"Mode":"GOVERNANCE","Days":30}}}'
aws s3api get-object-retention --bucket corp-backup-lock --key db.dump --version-id v1
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Compliance rejimida test uchun 10 yil qo'yish — bucket'ni ham, akkauntni ham yopa olmaysiz (faqat to'laysiz).
- Governance'da `s3:BypassGovernanceRetention` ruxsati keng berilsa — himoya yo'q.
- Object Lock faqat versiyani himoya qiladi, delete marker qo'yishni emas — o'qishda chalkashlik.

**Senior nuqta:** Backup bucket'ni alohida, minimal kirishli akkauntda Object Lock bilan saqlang — bu ransomware'ga qarshi eng kuchli himoya. Avval Governance bilan sinab, keyin Compliance.

40804.a:
**Qisqa javob:** S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) — bucket'ga yozilgan yangi obyektlarni boshqa region'dagi (va ixtiyoriy boshqa akkauntdagi) bucket'ga **asinxron** avtomatik nusxalash. Ikkala bucket'da **versioning** yoqilgan bo'lishi shart. Bir region ichida — SRR.

**Muammo:** DR talabi: region yo'qolsa ham ma'lumot boshqa joyda bo'lsin; yoki compliance nusxani boshqa akkauntda talab qiladi; yoki boshqa qit'adagi foydalanuvchilarga yaqin nusxa.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
eu-central-1 bucket (src) --PUT--> replication rule (prefix/tag filtr)
     --> IAM role --> eu-west-1 bucket (dst), storage class / owner o'zgartirish mumkin
odatda soniya-daqiqalar; RTC bilan 99.99% 15 daqiqa ichida (SLA)
mavjud (eski) obyektlar --> S3 Batch Replication bilan alohida
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws s3api put-bucket-replication --bucket src-bucket --replication-configuration '{
  "Role":"arn:aws:iam::111:role/s3-repl",
  "Rules":[{"ID":"all","Status":"Enabled","Priority":1,"Filter":{},
    "DeleteMarkerReplication":{"Status":"Disabled"},
    "Destination":{"Bucket":"arn:aws:s3:::dst-bucket","StorageClass":"STANDARD_IA"}}]}'
aws s3api head-object --bucket src-bucket --key a.txt --query ReplicationStatus
# PENDING | COMPLETED | FAILED
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Qoidani yoqishdan oldingi obyektlar replikatsiya qilinmaydi.
- SSE-KMS obyektlar uchun manzil kaliti va ruxsat alohida sozlanadi.
- Delete marker replikatsiyasi yoqilsa, tasodifiy o'chirish ham nusxalanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Replikatsiya — backup emas: buzilgan yoki shifrlangan fayl ham nusxalanadi. DR uchun CRR + boshqa akkaunt + Object Lock kombinatsiyasi; `ReplicationLatency` va FAILED hodisalariga alert qo'ying.

40805.a:
**Qisqa javob:** S3 Event Notification — bucket'da hodisa bo'lganda (`s3:ObjectCreated:*`, `s3:ObjectRemoved:*`, restore, replication) uni **SQS, SNS, Lambda** yoki **EventBridge** ga avtomatik yuborish. Prefix/suffix bo'yicha filtr qilish mumkin.

**Muammo:** Foydalanuvchi rasm yuklagan zahoti thumbnail yasash kerak — bucket'ni har daqiqada ro'yxatlab tekshirish (polling) sekin va qimmat.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PUT uploads/cat.jpg --> S3 --> notification config:
    prefix=uploads/ suffix=.jpg --> SQS queue --> worker
    yoki --> EventBridge (ko'p qoida, ko'p target, filter boy)
Event JSON: Records[].s3.bucket.name, .object.key (URL-encoded!), .size
Yetkazish: at-least-once, tartib kafolatlanmagan
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws s3api put-bucket-notification-configuration --bucket corp-uploads \
  --notification-configuration '{"QueueConfigurations":[{
    "QueueArn":"arn:aws:sqs:eu-central-1:111:thumbs",
    "Events":["s3:ObjectCreated:*"],
    "Filter":{"Key":{"FilterRules":[{"Name":"prefix","Value":"uploads/"},
                                     {"Name":"suffix","Value":".jpg"}]}}}]}'
# yoki EventBridge'ga
aws s3api put-bucket-notification-configuration --bucket corp-uploads \
  --notification-configuration '{"EventBridgeConfiguration":{}}'
```
SQS queue policy S3'ga `sqs:SendMessage` ruxsat berishi shart.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Lambda natijani **o'sha** prefix'ga yozsa — cheksiz loop va katta hisob.
- Key URL-encoded (`my+file.jpg`) — decode qilmasangiz `NoSuchKey`.
- Dublikat event'lar — ishlov idempotent bo'lsin.

**Senior nuqta:** To'g'ridan-to'g'ri Lambda o'rniga S3 -> SQS -> Lambda: buffer, retry, DLQ beradi. Ko'p iste'molchi yoki murakkab filtr kerak bo'lsa — EventBridge.

40806.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon EventBridge — serverless **event bus**: AWS servislari, o'z ilovalaringiz va SaaS hamkorlardan event qabul qiladi va JSON **pattern** qoidalari bilan 20+ turdagi target'ga (Lambda, SQS, Step Functions, API destination) yo'naltiradi. Qo'shimcha: Scheduler (cron), Pipes (source -> target), Archive/Replay, Schema Registry.

**Muammo:** `OrderPlaced` hodisasini 5 ta servis eshitishi kerak. Order servisi har birini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chaqirsa — qattiq bog'lanish va har yangi iste'molchi uchun deploy.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
producer --PutEvents--> custom bus "orders"
   rule1: {"detail-type":["OrderPlaced"],"detail":{"total":[{"numeric":[">",1000]}]}} --> fraud SQS
   rule2: {"detail-type":["OrderPlaced"]} --> email Lambda
   rule3: {"source":["aws.ec2"],"detail-type":["EC2 Instance State-change Notification"]} --> ops
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws events put-events --entries '[{"EventBusName":"orders","Source":"com.corp.orders",
  "DetailType":"OrderPlaced","Detail":"{\"id\":\"981\",\"total\":1200}"}]'
aws events put-rule --event-bus-name orders --name big-orders \
  --event-pattern '{"detail-type":["OrderPlaced"],"detail":{"total":[{"numeric":[">",1000]}]}}'
aws events put-targets --event-bus-name orders --rule big-orders \
  --targets Id=1,Arn=arn:aws:sqs:eu-central-1:111:fraud
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Target ishlamasa event yo'qoladi — target'ga DLQ va retry policy qo'ying.
- Event 256 KB limit — katta payload'ni S3'da saqlab havola yuboring.
- Tartib va exactly-once kafolati yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** EventBridge — domen hodisalari integratsiyasi uchun (past-o'rta throughput, boy filtr). Yuqori throughput va replay/tartib kerak bo'lsa — Kinesis yoki Kafka (MSK). Event schema'ni contract sifatida versiyalang.
