- Lock fayl (`package-lock.json`) da registry URL'lari hardcode — muhitlar o'rtasida sinadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Alternativlar: Artifactory, Nexus, GitHub Packages. Tanlovda asosiy savol — format qamrovi, ko'p cloud va narx; AWS-ga to'liq tayangan jamoaga CodeArtifact operatsion jihatdan eng yengil.

40888.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon Bedrock — bir nechta provayderning foundation model'larini (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, Meta Llama, Mistral, Cohere va boshqalar) **bitta API** orqali serverless taqdim etadi, qo'shimcha imkoniyatlar bilan: Knowledge Bases (RAG), Agents, Guardrails, fine-tuning, model evaluation. Ma'lumotingiz model o'qitishga ishlatilmaydi.

**Muammo:** LLM'ni o'zingiz host qilish — GPU, scaling, xavfsizlik. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri tashqi API — ma'lumot chegaradan chiqadi, compliance, IAM va audit muammosi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
App (IAM role) -> bedrock-runtime: Converse / InvokeModel (VPC endpoint)
                     |
              Guardrails (PII mask, mavzu filtri, prompt attack)
                     |
              Model (on-demand yoki provisioned throughput)
                     |
   Knowledge Base: S3 hujjatlar -> embedding -> vektor store (OpenSearch Serverless, Aurora pgvector, S3 Vectors)
CloudTrail + invocation logging -> audit
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws bedrock-runtime converse --model-id anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0 \
  --messages '[{"role":"user","content":[{"text":"Incident xulosasini yoz"}]}]' \
  --inference-config maxTokens=512
```
Ko'p model ID'lari region'lararo **inference profile** (`us.` / `eu.` prefiksi) orqali chaqiriladi — throughput uchun.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Model access/quota (tokens per minute) cheklovi — throttling; retry + backoff, kerak bo'lsa provisioned throughput.
- Xarajat token bo'yicha — uzun kontekst va cheksiz loop'lar hisobni oshiradi; budget va metrikalar.
- Prompt injection — Guardrails yordam beradi, lekin tool'lar ruxsatini cheklash (least privilege) asosiy himoya.

**Senior nuqta:** Model'ni abstraksiya orqasiga qo'y (Converse API bir xil format beradi) — model almashtirish oson bo'lsin. Sifatni evaluation dataset bilan o'lchab borish kerak.

40889.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Private CA — boshqariladigan **ichki (private) sertifikat markazi**: root va subordinate CA'lar, kalitlar FIPS 140 HSM'da. Ichki servislar, mTLS, IoT qurilmalar, VPN uchun X.509 sertifikat chiqaradi; ACM, cert-manager (aws-privateca-issuer), IAM Roles Anywhere bilan integratsiya.

**Muammo:** Ichki servislar o'rtasida TLS/mTLS kerak, lekin public CA ichki domen (`*.svc.cluster.local`) uchun sertifikat bermaydi. O'z OpenSSL CA'ingiz — root kalit noutbukda, revocation yo'q, audit yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Root CA (offline-ga yaqin, kam ishlatiladi, 10 yil)
   v
Subordinate CA (issuing, 3-5 yil)
   v
Leaf sertifikatlar: servis-a (7-90 kun), qurilma-123 ...
Revocation: CRL (S3) yoki OCSP
```
Rejim: **general-purpose** yoki arzonroq **short-lived certificate** rejimi (7 kungacha sertifikatlar, revocation shart emas).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# cert-manager + aws-privateca-issuer
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata: {name: payments-tls}
spec:
  secretName: payments-tls
  commonName: payments.internal.example.com
  duration: 720h
  renewBefore: 240h
  issuerRef: {group: awspca.cert-manager.io, kind: AWSPCAClusterIssuer, name: pca}
```
```bash
aws acm-pca describe-certificate-authority --certificate-authority-arn arn:...
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Narx: har CA uchun oylik to'lov (general-purpose ~$400/oy) — har jamoaga alohida CA yaratish qimmat; RAM bilan ulashish.
- Uzoq muddatli sertifikatlar va qo'lda yangilash — muddat tugashi outage'ning klassik sababi.
- Root CA'dan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri leaf chiqarish — root buzilsa hammasi qayta.

**Senior nuqta:** Qisqa muddatli sertifikat + avtomatik rotation revocation muammosini deyarli yo'qotadi. Service mesh (Istio) o'z CA'siga ega — Private CA'ni uning upstream root'i qilish mumkin.

40890.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS AppConfig (Systems Manager qismi) — ilova konfiguratsiyasi va feature flag'larni **kod deploy qilmasdan** xavfsiz tarqatadi: validator (JSON Schema/Lambda), bosqichli deployment strategiyasi (masalan 10 daqiqada 20% dan) va CloudWatch alarm yonsa **avtomatik rollback**.

**Muammo:** Konfiguratsiyani o'zgartirish uchun to'liq deploy kerak (sekin) yoki env var'ni qo'lda o'zgartirish — noto'g'ri qiymat bir zumda butun fleet'ni yiqitadi (ko'p yirik outage'lar aynan "config push"dan).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Application -> Environment (prod) -> Configuration profile (flags / freeform JSON)
   new version --validate--> deployment strategy (Linear 20% / 10 min, bake 10 min)
                                 |
                       CloudWatch alarm "5xx>2%" yonsa -> ROLLBACK
App: AppConfig Agent (sidecar/Lambda extension) localhost:2772 dan poll qiladi + cache
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws appconfig start-deployment --application-id app1 --environment-id prod \
  --configuration-profile-id flags --configuration-version 7 \
  --deployment-strategy-id AppConfig.Linear20PercentEvery6Minutes
curl http://localhost:2772/applications/app1/environments/prod/configurations/flags
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ilova har so'rovda AppConfig API'ni chaqiradi — throttling va xarajat; agent/cache ishlat.
- Validatorsiz deploy — JSON xatosi hamma joyga tarqaladi.
- Rollback alarm'lari yo'q — bosqichli deploy faqat sekin xato bo'lib qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Konfiguratsiya o'zgarishi — kod o'zgarishi kabi xavfli. Unga ham review, bosqichli rollout va avtomatik rollback qo'llash SRE amaliyotining asosi.

40891.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon Athena — S3'dagi ma'lumotga **serverless SQL** (Trino/Presto asosida): klaster yo'q, skanerlangan bayt uchun to'lanadi (~$5/TB). Jadval sxemasi Glue Data Catalog'da. CSV/JSON/Parquet/ORC/Iceberg o'qiydi.

**Muammo:** CloudTrail, ALB, Flow log'lar va biznes ma'lumot S3'da terabaytlab yotadi. Ularni tahlil qilish uchun DB'ga yuklash yoki doimiy klaster ushlab turish qimmat.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
S3: s3://logs/alb/year=2026/month=10/day=03/*.parquet
   v  Glue Catalog: jadval + partition'lar
SQL -> Athena engine (parallel worker'lar) -> faqat kerakli partition va ustunlarni o'qiydi
   v
Natija S3'ga (query result location)
```
Narxni kamaytirish uchun 3 qoida: **Parquet** (columnar, siqilgan), **partition** (`WHERE day=...`), **kerakli ustunlar** (`SELECT *` emas).

**Amalda:**
```sql
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE alb_logs (...) PARTITIONED BY (day string)
STORED AS PARQUET LOCATION 's3://logs/alb/'
TBLPROPERTIES ('projection.enabled'='true','projection.day.type'='date',
  'projection.day.format'='yyyy/MM/dd','projection.day.range'='2025/01/01,NOW',
  'storage.location.template'='s3://logs/alb/${day}');

SELECT elb_status_code, count(*) FROM alb_logs
WHERE day = '2026/10/03' GROUP BY 1;
```
Partition projection — `MSCK REPAIR` siz yangi partition'larni avtomatik tushunadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Partition'siz JSON ustida `SELECT *` — bitta so'rov yuzlab dollar. Workgroup'da "bytes scanned" limiti qo'y.
- Millionlab mayda fayl — sekin; fayllarni 128 MB+ ga birlashtir.
- Interaktiv dashboard'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Athena'ga ulash — har yangilanish pul.

**Senior nuqta:** Athena ad-hoc va kam takrorlanuvchi so'rovlar uchun ideal. Doimiy, past latency'li analitika kerak bo'lsa — Redshift/ClickHouse; o'zgaruvchan data lake uchun Iceberg jadvallari (ACID, time travel).

40892.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **AWS Glue** — serverless ETL/ma'lumot integratsiyasi servisi: Spark (yoki Python shell/Ray) job'lari, crawler'lar, workflow'lar. **Glue Data Catalog** — Hive metastore-mos markaziy metadata ombori (database, jadval, sxema, partition), uni Athena, Redshift Spectrum, EMR, Lake Formation ishlatadi.

**Muammo:** Data lake'da S3 fayllari bor, lekin qaysi fayl qaysi jadval, qanday ustunlar — hech kim bilmaydi. Har tool o'z sxemasini yuritsa nomuvofiqlik.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
S3 raw (JSON) --crawler--> Data Catalog: raw.orders (sxema aniqlandi)
       |
Glue ETL job (Spark): tozalash, join, Parquet'ga yozish, partition
       v
S3 curated --> Data Catalog: curated.orders
       v
Athena / Redshift Spectrum / EMR / QuickSight -- bitta katalog
```
Bookmark — job faqat yangi ma'lumotni qayta ishlaydi (inkremental).

**Amalda:**
```python
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
glue = GlueContext(SparkContext.getOrCreate())
df = glue.create_dynamic_frame.from_catalog(database="raw", table_name="orders",
        transformation_ctx="src")          # bookmark uchun
glue.write_dynamic_frame.from_options(frame=df, connection_type="s3",
  connection_options={"path":"s3://lake/curated/orders","partitionKeys":["day"]},
  format="parquet")
```
```bash
aws glue start-crawler --name raw-orders
aws glue get-tables --database-name curated --query 'TableList[].Name'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Crawler sxemani "taxmin" qiladi — har ishlaganda ustun turini o'zgartirishi mumkin; muhim jadvallarni IaC bilan aniq e'lon qil.
- Kichik job'ga ko'p DPU — Glue soatbay DPU narxi; Flex execution yoki auto scaling.
- Job bookmark o'chiq — har safar hammasini qayta ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Catalog — data platformaning "manba haqiqati". Uni Lake Formation ruxsatlari bilan birga boshqarsang, qaysi jamoa qaysi ustunni ko'rishini bir joyda nazorat qilasan.

40893.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon Redshift — boshqariladigan, petabayt hajmli **data warehouse**: columnar storage, MPP (massively parallel processing), siqish, natija cache. Variantlar: **provisioned RA3** (compute va storage alohida) va **Redshift Serverless** (RPU bo'yicha). S3'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'rash uchun Spectrum, zero-ETL integratsiyalar (Aurora, DynamoDB -> Redshift).

**Muammo:** OLTP DB'da (PostgreSQL) milliard qatorli `GROUP BY` hisobotlar soatlab ishlaydi va prod yukiga zarar beradi. Analitika uchun alohida, ustunli tizim kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SQL -> Leader node (plan, kompilyatsiya)
          |  parallel
   Compute node 1 .. N  (har biri slice'larga bo'lingan)
          |
   RMS (managed storage, S3 asosida) - ustunli bloklar + zone maps
Distribution: KEY / EVEN / ALL / AUTO   Sort key: filtr ustuni
```

**Amalda:**
```sql
CREATE TABLE sales (
  sale_id BIGINT, customer_id INT, sale_date DATE, amount DECIMAL(12,2))
DISTKEY(customer_id) SORTKEY(sale_date);

COPY sales FROM 's3://lake/sales/' IAM_ROLE default FORMAT AS PARQUET;

EXPLAIN SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) FROM sales
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1;   -- DS_BCAST/DS_DIST = tarmoq shuffle
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Qator-qator `INSERT` — juda sekin; `COPY` bilan batch yuklash.
- Noto'g'ri DISTKEY — skew (bitta node hammasini ishlaydi) yoki join'da katta shuffle.
- Redshift'ni OLTP sifatida ishlatish (ko'p kichik update) — mos emas.

**Senior nuqta:** 2025-2026'da tanlov kengaygan: Redshift Serverless, Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, Iceberg + Athena. Qaror: so'rov konkurensiyasi, latency talabi, ma'lumot hajmi va jamoa ko'nikmasi bo'yicha — benchmark bilan.

40894.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Lambda Function URL — Lambda funksiyaga bevosita beriladigan HTTPS endpoint (`https://<id>.lambda-url.<region>.on.aws`). API Gateway yoki ALB kerak emas. Auth: `AWS_IAM` (SigV4) yoki `NONE` (ochiq); CORS va response streaming qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.

**Muammo:** Webhook qabul qiluvchi yoki oddiy bitta endpoint uchun API Gateway sozlash ortiqcha murakkablik va qo'shimcha xarajat.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Client --HTTPS--> https://abc123.lambda-url.eu-central-1.on.aws/path
                        |  auth: AWS_IAM | NONE
                        v
                  Lambda (event: API GW payload v2.0 formatiga o'xshash)
```
API Gateway bilan farq:
| | Function URL | API Gateway |
|---|---|---|
| Narx | Qo'shimcha to'lov yo'q | Request bo'yicha |
| Custom domen | Yo'q (CloudFront oldiga qo'yiladi) | Bor |
| Throttling, usage plan, API key | Yo'q (faqat reserved concurrency) | Bor |
| WAF | CloudFront orqali | Bevosita (REST) |
| Timeout | Lambda limitigacha (15 daq) | 29 s default |
| Streaming | Bor | Cheklangan |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws lambda create-function-url-config --function-name webhook --auth-type AWS_IAM \
  --cors '{"AllowOrigins":["https://app.example.com"],"AllowMethods":["POST"]}'
```
Ochiq (`NONE`) bo'lsa, CloudFront + OAC orqali himoyalash mumkin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `NONE` bilan ochiq endpoint, signature tekshiruvisiz webhook — har kim chaqiradi va hisob o'sadi.
- Rate limit yo'q — DDoS'da Lambda concurrency tugaydi; reserved concurrency qo'y.
- Bir nechta route kerak bo'lsa, Lambda ichida router yozish kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Function URL — oddiy holatlar uchun. API boshqaruvi (auth, throttle, versiyalash) kerak bo'lsa, API Gateway pul qiymatiga arziydi.

40895.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Lambda Extensions API — Lambda execution environment ichida funksiya bilan birga ishlaydigan **qo'shimcha process'lar** (extension) yozish imkoni. Ular lifecycle event'larini (`INIT`, `INVOKE`, `SHUTDOWN`) oladi; telemetry (log/metrika/trace) yig'ish, secret'larni oldindan yuklash, xavfsizlik agent'lari uchun ishlatiladi. Layer sifatida tarqatiladi.

**Muammo:** Monitoring agent'ini funksiya kodiga qo'shish — har so'rovda tashqi API'ga sinxron yuborish latency qo'shadi; funksiya tugagach agent'ga yuborishga vaqt qolmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Execution environment (microVM)
  +-- Runtime + funksiya kodi
  +-- Extension process (/opt/extensions/my-ext)
        Register -> Extensions API
        Next event loop: INVOKE ... INVOKE ... SHUTDOWN (2 s gacha flush)
        Telemetry API'ga subscribe -> log/metric/trace stream olish
  Funksiya javob qaytaradi; extension fonda batch'lab yuboradi
```
Turlari: **external** (alohida process, istalgan tilda) va **internal** (runtime ichida, masalan `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS`).

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name api \
  --layers arn:aws:lambda:eu-central-1:177933569100:layer:AWS-Parameters-and-Secrets-Lambda-Extension:12
# Funksiya ichidan: http://localhost:2773/secretsmanager/get?secretId=prod/db
```
Misollar: Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic extension'lari, ADOT (OTel) collector, AppConfig agent, Parameters and Secrets extension.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Extension init vaqtini qo'shadi — cold start uzayadi.
- Extension CPU/xotirani funksiya bilan bo'lishadi — memory sozlamasini qayta ko'rib chiq.
- Og'ir extension post-invoke ish qilsa, billing davomiyligi oshadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Extension'lar observability'ni kod o'zgartirmasdan qo'shadi, lekin cold start va narx uchun o'lchab ko'r — har funksiyaga beshta agent qo'yma.

40896.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bular **adapter**lar: API Gateway/ALB/Function URL event'ini oddiy HTTP so'rovga aylantirib, mavjud web framework ilovasini Lambda ichida ishlatadi. `@codegenie/serverless-express` (avval `aws-serverless-express`) — Node.js Express/Koa uchun; **Mangum** — Python ASGI (FastAPI, Starlette) uchun. Tilga bog'liq bo'lmagan alternativ — **AWS Lambda Web Adapter**.

**Muammo:** Mavjud Express/FastAPI ilovani Lambda'ga ko'chirmoqchisiz, lekin Lambda handler `event`/`context` qabul qiladi, HTTP server emas. Har route uchun alohida funksiya yozish — katta qayta yozish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
API Gateway event (JSON: path, headers, body base64)
   v
Adapter: event -> HTTP request obyekt
   v
Express app / FastAPI app (odatdagi routing, middleware)
   v
Adapter: HTTP response -> {statusCode, headers, body}
```

**Amalda:**
```python
# Python + FastAPI
from fastapi import FastAPI
from mangum import Mangum
app = FastAPI()
@app.get("/health")
def health(): return {"ok": True}
handler = Mangum(app, lifespan="off")
```
```js
// Node.js + Express
const serverlessExpress = require('@codegenie/serverless-express');
const app = require('./app');
exports.handler = serverlessExpress({ app });
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Butun monolit bitta Lambda'da ("lambdalith") — katta paket, sekin cold start; lekin ko'pincha bu maqbul trade-off.
- Binary javoblar (rasm) — API Gateway'da binary media type sozlanmasa buziladi.
- Ilova ichidagi fon task'lar va in-memory sessiya — Lambda'da ishonchsiz.

**Senior nuqta:** Adapter migratsiyani tezlashtiradi va vendor lock-in'ni kamaytiradi (ilova konteynerda ham ishlaydi). Trafik doimiy va yuqori bo'lsa, xuddi shu ilovani ECS/Fargate'da ishlatish arzonroq bo'lishi mumkin.

40897.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Short polling** (`WaitTimeSeconds=0`) — SQS serverlarining bir qismini so'raydi va darhol qaytadi, navbat bo'sh bo'lsa ham (bo'sh javob ham API chaqiruv sifatida to'lanadi). **Long polling** (`WaitTimeSeconds` 1-20) — xabar kelguncha yoki vaqt tugaguncha kutadi va barcha serverlarni so'raydi — bo'sh javoblar va xarajat keskin kamayadi.

**Muammo:** Worker `while true: receive()` qiladi; navbat ko'pincha bo'sh. Short polling'da sekundiga o'nlab bo'sh chaqiruv — oyiga millionlab to'lanadigan request va CPU isrofi. Bundan tashqari short polling ba'zan xabar bor bo'lsa ham bo'sh qaytaradi (faqat serverlar namunasi so'raladi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Short:  receive -> [bo'sh] receive -> [bo'sh] receive -> [msg]   (ko'p chaqiruv)
Long:   receive(wait=20) ..........kutish..........-> [msg]       (1 chaqiruv)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Navbat darajasida default
aws sqs set-queue-attributes --queue-url $Q \
  --attributes ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds=20
# Yoki har chaqiruvda
aws sqs receive-message --queue-url $Q --wait-time-seconds 20 --max-number-of-messages 10
```
```python
msgs = sqs.receive_message(QueueUrl=q, WaitTimeSeconds=20, MaxNumberOfMessages=10)
```
Lambda event source mapping o'zi long polling ishlatadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- HTTP client timeout 20 s dan kichik — long poll uziladi (SDK read timeout > WaitTimeSeconds bo'lsin).
- `MaxNumberOfMessages=1` — batch'siz, chaqiruvlar soni 10x.
- Bitta thread'da ketma-ket bir nechta navbatni long poll qilish — biri boshqasini kutib qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Deyarli har doim long polling (20 s) + batch 10. Short polling faqat darhol javob muhim va navbat doim to'la bo'lgan maxsus holatlarda.

40898.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Visibility timeout — consumer xabarni olgandan keyin u boshqa consumer'larga **ko'rinmaydigan** davr (default 30 s, max 12 soat). Shu vaqt ichida `DeleteMessage` qilinmasa, xabar yana ko'rinadi va qayta yetkaziladi. Shuning uchun SQS standart — **at-least-once**, ishlov idempotent bo'lishi shart.

**Muammo:** Worker xabarni olib, ishlayotganda yiqilsa — xabar yo'qolmasligi kerak. Lekin timeout ishlov vaqtidan qisqa bo'lsa, ikkinchi worker ham xuddi shu xabarni oladi — dublikat to'lov, ikki marta email.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
t=0   Worker A: ReceiveMessage -> msg (ko'rinmas, timeout=60s)
t=45  Worker A: DeleteMessage  -> tugadi           (normal)

t=0   Worker A: ReceiveMessage -> msg
t=20  Worker A yiqildi
t=60  msg yana ko'rinadi -> Worker B oladi (receiveCount=2)
      ... maxReceiveCount'ga yetsa -> DLQ
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws sqs set-queue-attributes --queue-url $Q --attributes VisibilityTimeout=120
# Uzoq ish: ishlov paytida "heartbeat" bilan uzaytirish
aws sqs change-message-visibility --queue-url $Q --receipt-handle "$RH" --visibility-timeout 300
```
Lambda bilan: navbat visibility timeout >= **6 x funksiya timeout** (AWS tavsiyasi).

**Idempotentlik:** xabardagi `orderId`/idempotency key'ni DB'da unique constraint yoki DynamoDB conditional write bilan tekshir.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Timeout ishlov p99 vaqtidan qisqa — doimiy dublikatlar.
- Juda uzun timeout (12 soat) — worker yiqilsa xabar soatlab "osilib" qoladi.
- Batch'da bitta xato tufayli hammasini qayta qaytarish — Lambda'da `ReportBatchItemFailures` ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Exactly-once yetkazib berish yo'q; exactly-once **effekt** — idempotent consumer bilan quriladi.

40899.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Redrive policy — asosiy navbatda xabar `maxReceiveCount` martadan ko'p qabul qilinib, o'chirilmasa, uni avtomatik **Dead-Letter Queue** ga ko'chiradi. Bug tuzatilgach, **DLQ redrive** (konsol yoki `StartMessageMoveTask` API) bilan xabarlar asl navbatga qaytariladi.

**Muammo:** "Zaharli" xabar (noto'g'ri format, bug) har safar consumer'ni yiqitadi va cheksiz qayta urinadi — resurs yeydi, boshqa xabarlarni sekinlashtiradi, FIFO'da esa butun guruhni bloklaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
orders-queue (redrive: maxReceiveCount=5, DLQ=orders-dlq)
   msg receiveCount 1..5 -> har safar xato
   v 6-urinish o'rniga
orders-dlq  (retention 14 kun)
   v alarm: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible > 0
Tekshiruv -> bug fix -> deploy -> redrive (DLQ -> orders-queue, tezlik cheklovi bilan)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws sqs set-queue-attributes --queue-url $Q --attributes '{
  "RedrivePolicy":"{\"deadLetterTargetArn\":\"arn:aws:sqs:eu-central-1:111:orders-dlq\",\"maxReceiveCount\":\"5\"}"}'
aws sqs start-message-move-task --source-arn arn:aws:sqs:eu-central-1:111:orders-dlq \
  --max-number-of-messages-per-second 50
```
DLQ'da `RedriveAllowPolicy` — qaysi navbatlar uni DLQ sifatida ishlata olishini cheklaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DLQ retention asl navbatdan qisqa — xabar DLQ'ga kelganda allaqachon muddati o'tgan bo'lishi mumkin (enqueue vaqti asl xabardan hisoblanadi). DLQ retention'ni uzunroq qo'y.
- DLQ'ga alarm yo'q — xabarlar jimgina yig'iladi va yo'qoladi.
- `maxReceiveCount=1` — vaqtinchalik tarmoq xatosi ham DLQ'ga yuboradi.

**Senior nuqta:** DLQ — xatoni yashirish emas, uni ko'rinadigan qilish. Har DLQ egasi, alarm'i va runbook'i bo'lsin.

40900.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SNS message filtering — har subscription'ga **filter policy** (JSON) biriktiriladi; SNS faqat shartga mos xabarlarni o'sha subscriber'ga yetkazadi. Filtr message **attribute**'lari yoki **body** (`FilterPolicyScope: MessageBody`) bo'yicha ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** Bitta `orders` topic'iga 10 xil event tushadi. Har subscriber (Lambda, SQS) hammasini oladi va ichida `if type != ...: return` qiladi — keraksiz chaqiruvlar, xarajat va kod murakkabligi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Publisher -> SNS topic "orders"  {eventType: "created", country: "UZ", amount: 120}
                |
   +------------+--------------+
   v                           v
SQS billing                  Lambda notify-uz
filter: eventType=[created]  filter: country=[UZ], amount=[{numeric:[">",100]}]
```
Operatorlar: aniq qiymat, `prefix`, `anything-but`, `numeric` oraliq, `exists`, `$or`, `suffix`, `equals-ignore-case`.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws sns set-subscription-attributes --subscription-arn $SUB \
  --attribute-name FilterPolicyScope --attribute-value MessageBody
aws sns set-subscription-attributes --subscription-arn $SUB \
  --attribute-name FilterPolicy --attribute-value \
  '{"eventType":["created"],"amount":[{"numeric":[">",100]}]}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Filter policy o'zgarishi bir necha daqiqagacha tarqaladi — darhol ishlaydi deb test qilma.
- Atribut publisher tomonidan yuborilmagan (`MessageAttributes` yo'q) — hech narsa mos kelmaydi, xabarlar jim yo'qoladi.
- Filter policy hajmi va murakkabligi limitlari bor (kombinatsiyalar soni).

**Senior nuqta:** Filtr — fan-out'da xarajat va coupling'ni kamaytiradi. Juda murakkab routing kerak bo'lsa (content-based, ko'p maqsad, schema) EventBridge mosroq; SNS esa yuqori throughput va oddiylik uchun.

40901.a:
**Qisqa javob:** EventBridge Schema Registry — event'lar sxemalarini (OpenAPI 3 yoki JSON Schema Draft 4) saqlaydi va versiyalaydi. **Schema discovery** yoqilsa, event bus'dan o'tayotgan event'larning sxemasi avtomatik aniqlanadi. Sxemadan Java, Python, TypeScript, Go uchun tipli **code binding**'lar generatsiya qilinadi.

**Muammo:** Event-driven tizimda producer va consumer'lar turli jamoalarda. "Bu event'da qaysi maydonlar bor?" degan savolga javob — Slack'da so'rash. Producer maydon nomini o'zgartirsa, consumer prod'da sinadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Producer -> event bus "orders"
              | discovery (yoqilgan bo'lsa)
              v
         Schema Registry: discovered-schemas / orders@OrderCreated v1, v2...
              |
              +-> code bindings (IDE/CLI): OrderCreated class
              +-> custom registry: jamoa tomonidan qo'lda boshqariladigan "contract"
```
AWS servis event'lari (`aws.ec2`, `aws.s3`) uchun tayyor sxemalar ham bor.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws schemas create-discoverer --source-arn arn:aws:events:eu-central-1:111:event-bus/orders
aws schemas list-schemas --registry-name discovered-schemas
aws schemas describe-schema --registry-name discovered-schemas --schema-name orders@OrderCreated
aws schemas get-code-binding-source --registry-name discovered-schemas \
  --schema-name orders@OrderCreated --language Python36 out.zip
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Discovery'ni prod'da doimiy yoqib qo'yish — event hajmi bo'yicha to'lov.
- Discovered sxema faqat "ko'rilgan" event'larni aks ettiradi — ixtiyoriy maydon kamdan-kam kelsa sxemada yo'q.
- Registry compatibility'ni majburlamaydi (Confluent Schema Registry'dagi kabi breaking change'ni bloklamaydi) — CI'da contract test kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Event — public API. Sxemani versiyala, faqat qo'shimcha (additive) o'zgarish qil, buzuvchi o'zgarishda yangi event turi chiqar.

40902.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS AppSync — boshqariladigan **GraphQL** API (va 2024'dan AppSync Events — WebSocket Pub/Sub API) servisi: resolver'lar DynamoDB, Lambda, RDS (Data API), HTTP, OpenSearch, EventBridge, Bedrock'ga ulanadi; real-time **subscription**'lar, server-side cache, Cognito/IAM/OIDC/API key/Lambda auth.

**Muammo:** Mobil/web klient bir ekran uchun 5 ta REST endpoint chaqiradi (over/under-fetching), real-time yangilanish uchun WebSocket serverni o'zingiz scale qilishingiz kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Client (Amplify / Apollo)
  query { order(id:"1"){ status items{name} customer{email} } }
     v
AppSync: auth -> schema validation -> resolver'lar (JS yoki VTL)
     |-- order     -> DynamoDB GetItem
     |-- items     -> Lambda
     |-- customer  -> HTTP (CRM API)
  mutation updateOrder -> subscription onOrderUpdated -> WebSocket orqali klientlarga push
```

**Amalda:**
```graphql
type Order { id: ID! status: String! }
type Mutation { updateOrder(id: ID!, status: String!): Order }
type Subscription { onOrderUpdated(id: ID!): Order @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateOrder"]) }
```
```js
// APPSYNC_JS resolver
export function request(ctx) { return { operation: 'GetItem', key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id }) }; }
export function response(ctx) { return ctx.result; }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- N+1: ro'yxatdagi har element uchun alohida Lambda chaqiruv — BatchInvoke yoki pipeline resolver.
- Subscription faqat AppSync orqali o'tgan mutation'dan ishga tushadi — DB'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'zgartirsangiz klient bilmaydi.
- Query chuqurligi/murakkabligi cheklanmagan — qimmat so'rovlar bilan DoS.

**Senior nuqta:** GraphQL frontend'ga moslashuvchanlik beradi, lekin backend'ga murakkablik (caching, authz har maydon). Bir nechta klient turi va ko'p manbali ma'lumot bo'lsa o'zini oqlaydi.

40903.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Elastic Beanstalk** — PaaS: kodingizni yuklaysiz, u siz uchun EC2, ASG, ELB, CloudWatch'ni **ko'rinadigan** CloudFormation resurslari sifatida yaratadi — ostidagi infra'ni sozlash mumkin. **App Runner** — source kod yoki container image'dan to'liq boshqariladigan serverless web servis: infra ko'rinmaydi, auto scaling va TLS avtomatik.

**Muammo:** Kichik jamoa web ilovani tez deploy qilmoqchi, lekin EKS/ECS + ALB + ASG'ni o'rganish va yuritishga vaqt yo'q.

**Taqqoslash:**
| | Elastic Beanstalk | App Runner |
|---|---|---|
| Abstraksiya | EC2 asosida, infra sizning akkauntda ko'rinadi | To'liq abstrakt |
| Nazorat | `.ebextensions`, instance turi, SSH | CPU/RAM, concurrency, VPC connector |
| Scale to zero | Yo'q | Deyarli (paused, xotira uchun to'lov) |
| Platformalar | Java, .NET, Node, Python, PHP, Go, Docker | Container image yoki kod (Python, Node, Java...) |
| Deploy strategiyalari | rolling, immutable, blue/green (CNAME swap) | avtomatik rolling |

**Amalda:**
```bash
eb init -p python-3.12 myapp && eb create prod-env && eb deploy
aws apprunner create-service --service-name api \
  --source-configuration '{"ImageRepository":{"ImageIdentifier":"111.dkr.ecr.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/api:1.2","ImageRepositoryType":"ECR"}}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Beanstalk'da konsoldan qo'lda o'zgartirish — keyingi deploy'da yo'qoladi; hammasi `.ebextensions`/IaC'da.
- App Runner'da ichki resurslarga (RDS) chiqish uchun VPC connector unutiladi.
- Ikkalasini ham "katta mikroservis platformasi" sifatida ishlatish — ECS/EKS mosroq.

**Senior nuqta:** Bu servislar AWS'da kamroq rivojlanmoqda; yangi loyihalar uchun ko'pincha **ECS Fargate** (yoki ECS Express Mode) yaxshiroq balans beradi. Tanlovdan oldin servisning yo'l xaritasi va region mavjudligini tekshir.

40904.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Batch — container'lashgan **batch job**'larni navbatga qo'yib, kerakli compute'ni (EC2 On-Demand/Spot, Fargate yoki EKS) avtomatik ko'tarib, bajarib, keyin o'chiradigan boshqariladigan scheduler. Array job, dependency, retry, priority qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.

**Muammo:** Kechasi 10 000 ta video transkodlash yoki genom tahlili kerak. O'zingiz cluster ushlab tursangiz kunduzi bo'sh turadi; qo'lda scale qilish va Spot uzilishlarini boshqarish murakkab.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Job definition (image, vCPU, memory, retry, timeout)
   v submit
Job queue (priority) --> Compute environment(lar)
                           - Spot (arzon, birinchi)
                           - On-Demand (fallback)
   v
Scheduler: pending job'lar uchun instance'lar ko'tariladi -> job'lar ishlaydi -> bo'shasa 0 ga
Array job: 1 submit = 10 000 child (AWS_BATCH_JOB_ARRAY_INDEX)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws batch submit-job --job-name transcode --job-queue spot-queue \
  --job-definition ffmpeg:3 --array-properties size=10000 \
  --retry-strategy '{"attempts":3,"evaluateOnExit":[{"onStatusReason":"Host EC2*","action":"RETRY"},{"onReason":"*","action":"EXIT"}]}'
aws batch list-jobs --job-queue spot-queue --job-status FAILED
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Job idempotent emas — Spot uzilishidan keyin retry natijani buzadi/dublikat qiladi.
- Compute environment `maxvCpus` juda kichik — job'lar `RUNNABLE` holatida qotadi (yoki instance turi quota'si yetmaydi).
- Juda qisqa (bir necha soniyalik) job'lar — scheduling overhead; ularni bitta job ichida guruhla.

**Senior nuqta:** Batch vs Step Functions Distributed Map vs K8s Job: og'ir, uzoq, ko'p resursli hisoblash — Batch; ko'p qisqa serverless qadamlar — Step Functions; allaqachon K8s platforma bo'lsa — Kueue/Argo Workflows.

40905.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CloudFormation StackSets — bitta template'ni **bir operatsiyada ko'p akkaunt va region'larga** stack sifatida deploy qilish, yangilash va o'chirish. **Service-managed** rejimda Organizations bilan integratsiya: yangi akkaunt OU'ga qo'shilsa, stack avtomatik deploy bo'ladi.

**Muammo:** 100 akkaunt x 4 region'ga bir xil baseline (CloudTrail, Config qoidalari, IAM rollar, GuardDuty) kerak. Qo'lda 400 ta stack — drift va unutilgan akkauntlar.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Admin (management yoki delegated admin akkaunt)
  StackSet "security-baseline" (template)
     | deployment targets: OU=Workloads, regions=[eu-central-1, us-east-1]
     | operation preferences: MaxConcurrentPercentage=25, FailureTolerancePercentage=10
     v
  Stack instance'lar: acct-A/eu-central-1, acct-A/us-east-1, acct-B/...
  Auto-deployment: yangi akkaunt OU'ga kirdi -> avtomatik stack
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws cloudformation create-stack-set --stack-set-name security-baseline \
  --template-body file://baseline.yml --permission-model SERVICE_MANAGED \
  --auto-deployment Enabled=true,RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval=false \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
aws cloudformation create-stack-instances --stack-set-name security-baseline \
  --deployment-targets OrganizationalUnitIds=ou-abc-123 \
  --regions eu-central-1 us-east-1 \
  --operation-preferences MaxConcurrentPercentage=25,FailureTolerancePercentage=10
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Global resurslar (IAM role) bir nechta region'da yaratilsa nom konflikti — IAM'ni bitta region'da deploy qil.
- Yuqori concurrency bilan buzuq update hamma akkauntga bir vaqtda tarqaladi — bosqichli deploy.
- Bitta akkauntda xato bo'lsa, operatsiya to'xtaydi — failure tolerance'ni tushunib sozla.

**Senior nuqta:** StackSets — org baseline uchun kuchli. Terraform ishlatadigan jamoalar uchun muqobil: Control Tower + AFT yoki har akkauntga pipeline. Muhimi — baseline'ni "bitta joydan, bosqichma-bosqich" tarqatish.

40906.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Drift detection — CloudFormation stack'idagi resurslarning **haqiqiy holatini** template'dagi kutilgan holat bilan solishtiradi va qo'lda (konsol, CLI) qilingan o'zgarishlarni ko'rsatadi: `IN_SYNC`, `MODIFIED`, `DELETED`, `NOT_CHECKED`.

**Muammo:** Kimdir incident paytida konsolda SG qoidasini yoki instance turini o'zgartirdi. Keyingi `update-stack` uni jimgina qaytaradi yoki kutilmagan xato beradi; DR uchun template endi haqiqatni aks ettirmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Template (kutilgan): SG ingress 443 from 10.0.0.0/8
Haqiqiy:             SG ingress 443 + 22 from 0.0.0.0/0   (qo'lda qo'shilgan)
   v detect-stack-drift
Natija: MODIFIED  PropertyDifferences: SecurityGroupIngress[1] ADD
```
Faqat template'da e'lon qilingan xususiyatlar tekshiriladi; hamma resurs turi qo'llab-quvvatlanmaydi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
ID=$(aws cloudformation detect-stack-drift --stack-name network --query StackDriftDetectionId --output text)
aws cloudformation describe-stack-drift-detection-status --stack-drift-detection-id $ID
aws cloudformation describe-stack-resource-drifts --stack-name network \
  --stack-resource-drift-status-filters MODIFIED DELETED \
  --query 'StackResourceDrifts[].[LogicalResourceId,PropertyDifferences]'
```
Avtomatlashtirish: AWS Config `cloudformation-stack-drift-detection-check` qoidasi -> SNS alert.

**Drift'ni tuzatish yo'llari:**
1. Template'ni yangilab haqiqatga moslash (o'zgarish to'g'ri bo'lsa).
2. Stack'ni qayta deploy qilib qo'lda o'zgarishni bekor qilish.
3. Resource import — tashqarida yaratilgan resursni stack'ga olish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Drift detection o'zi hech narsani tuzatmaydi.
- Template'da e'lon qilinmagan xususiyat o'zgarsa — ko'rinmaydi.
- Davriy tekshiruv yo'q — drift oylab yig'iladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Drift'ning asl yechimi — prod'ga konsoldan yozish ruxsatini olib tashlash (read-only + break-glass). Detection — xavfsizlik to'ri.

40907.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Custom resource — CloudFormation o'zi qo'llab-quvvatlamaydigan amalni stack lifecycle'iga (`Create`/`Update`/`Delete`) qo'shish usuli: CloudFormation **Lambda** (yoki SNS) ni chaqiradi, u ishni bajaradi va natijani pre-signed S3 URL'ga `SUCCESS`/`FAILED` deb yuboradi.

**Muammo:** Stack yaratilganda DB'ga boshlang'ich ma'lumot yozish, tashqi SaaS'da (Datadog, DNS provayder) resurs yaratish, AMI ID'ni qidirish kerak — native resurs turi yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Template: Type: Custom::DbSeed  ServiceToken: <Lambda ARN>  Properties: {...}
  CREATE -> Lambda(event: RequestType=Create, ResponseURL, ...)
              ish -> PUT ResponseURL {Status: SUCCESS, PhysicalResourceId, Data}
  UPDATE -> Lambda(RequestType=Update, OldResourceProperties)
  DELETE -> Lambda(RequestType=Delete)  -- stack o'chirilganda
```
`Fn::GetAtt CustomRes.Attr` bilan `Data` dagi qiymatlar boshqa resurslarga uzatiladi.

**Amalda:**
```python
import cfnresponse
def handler(event, context):
    try:
        if event["RequestType"] == "Create":
            seed_db(event["ResourceProperties"]["DbArn"])
        cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {"Seeded": "true"}, "db-seed-1")
    except Exception as e:
        cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Error": str(e)})
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Lambda javob yubormasdan yiqilsa — stack ~1 soatgacha `IN_PROGRESS` da qotadi (`ServiceTimeout` xususiyati bilan qisqartirish mumkin). Har doim try/except + javob.
- `Delete` ni hisobga olmaslik — stack o'chirilmaydi yoki rollback osilib qoladi.
- `PhysicalResourceId` o'zgarsa CloudFormation buni "almashtirish" deb, eskisiga `Delete` yuboradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval CloudFormation Registry'dagi tayyor resource type yoki provider'ni qidir. Custom resource — oxirgi chora: u siz yuritadigan kod va uni test qilish kerak.

40908.a:
**Qisqa javob:** VPC Reachability Analyzer — ikki nuqta (masalan EC2 -> RDS, IGW -> instance) orasidagi tarmoq yo'lini **paket yubormasdan**, konfiguratsiyani formal (automated reasoning) tahlil qilib tekshiradi. Yo'l yo'q bo'lsa, aynan **qaysi komponent** (route table, SG, NACL, TGW) to'sayotganini ko'rsatadi.

**Muammo:** "Servis DB'ga ulana olmayapti" — route, SG, NACL, peering, TGW route table, endpoint policy... qaysi biri? Qo'lda har birini tekshirish soatlab, `telnet` esa faqat "ishlamaydi" deydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Source: eni-app (10.0.1.5)  Destination: eni-rds (10.1.2.9)  port 5432/tcp
   v  konfiguratsiya modeli
Yo'l: ENI -> SG(out) -> NACL(out) -> route table -> TGW attachment -> TGW RT -> ...
Natija: Not reachable
  Explanation: TGW route table tgw-rtb-xyz da 10.1.0.0/16 uchun marshrut yo'q
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
P=$(aws ec2 create-network-insights-path --source i-0app --destination i-0db \
     --protocol tcp --destination-port 5432 --query NetworkInsightsPath.NetworkInsightsPathId --output text)
A=$(aws ec2 start-network-insights-analysis --network-insights-path-id $P \
     --query NetworkInsightsAnalysis.NetworkInsightsAnalysisId --output text)
aws ec2 describe-network-insights-analyses --network-insights-analysis-ids $A \
  --query 'NetworkInsightsAnalyses[0].[NetworkPathFound,Explanations]'
```
Har tahlil uchun kichik to'lov ($0.10).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Konfiguratsiya to'g'ri bo'lsa ham ilova tinglamayotgan yoki OS firewall (iptables) bloklayotgan bo'lishi mumkin — u buni ko'rmaydi.
- Third-party appliance ichidagi qoidalarni tahlil qilmaydi.
- Natijani keyin tekshirish uchun saqlab qo'ymaslik — IaC o'zgarishidan keyin regressiya testi sifatida ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Troubleshooting tartibi: Reachability Analyzer (konfiguratsiya) -> Flow Logs (haqiqiy trafik) -> host darajasi (`ss -lntp`, `tcpdump`).

40909.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Network Access Analyzer — tarmoq **siyosatini** (Network Access Scope) e'lon qilib, butun VPC/akkaunt bo'ylab unga zid **mumkin bo'lgan** yo'llarni topadi. Masalan: "DB subnet'lardan IGW'ga yo'l bo'lmasin", "prod VPC dev VPC'ga yeta olmasin". Reachability Analyzer bitta yo'lni, Access Analyzer esa **hamma** yo'llarni tekshiradi.

**Muammo:** Auditor so'raydi: "Karta ma'lumotlari saqlanadigan muhitga internetdan yo'l yo'qligini isbotlang". Yuzlab SG va route table'ni qo'lda ko'rib chiqib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Scope (talab):
  MatchPaths: Source = subnet tag:tier=db, Destination = Internet Gateway
  ExcludePaths: (ruxsat etilgan istisnolar)
   v analiz (automated reasoning)
Findings: eni-0x (db subnet) -> NAT GW -> IGW  ... yo'l topildi (buzilish!)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-network-insights-access-scope --match-paths '[{
  "Source":{"ResourceStatement":{"ResourceTypes":["AWS::EC2::Subnet"]}},
  "Destination":{"ResourceStatement":{"ResourceTypes":["AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"]}}}]'
aws ec2 start-network-insights-access-scope-analysis --network-insights-access-scope-id nis-123
aws ec2 get-network-insights-access-scope-analysis-findings --network-insights-access-scope-analysis-id nisa-456
```
AWS tayyor scope'lar beradi (masalan "barcha IGW'dan kiruvchi yo'llar").

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Finding — "mumkin bo'lgan yo'l", haqiqiy trafik emas; Flow Logs bilan solishtir.
- Scope juda keng — yuzlab finding, hech kim ko'rmaydi. Aniq invariantlarni yoz.
- Bir martalik audit — o'zgarishlardan keyin regulyar (jadval bilan) ishga tushir.

**Senior nuqta:** Bu "tarmoq uchun unit test": segmentatsiya invariantlarini kod sifatida yoz va har tarmoq o'zgarishidan keyin avtomatik tekshir.

40910.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **CloudFront** — CDN: HTTP(S) kontentni edge'da **cache**'laydi, statik va dinamik web, video, API uchun. **Global Accelerator** — cache'siz: istalgan **TCP/UDP** trafikni 2 ta statik **anycast IP** orqali eng yaqin edge'ga olib, AWS private backbone bo'ylab region endpoint'iga yetkazadi; health check bilan soniyalarda region failover.

**Muammo:** Global foydalanuvchilar uchun latency. Lekin hamma trafik cache'lanmaydi: o'yin serverlari (UDP), IoT (MQTT), VoIP yoki statik IP talab qiladigan B2B mijozlar (firewall allowlist).

**Taqqoslash:**
| | CloudFront | Global Accelerator |
|---|---|---|
| Protokol | HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, gRPC | TCP, UDP |
| Cache | Bor | Yo'q |
| IP | O'zgaruvchan (DNS) | 2 ta statik anycast IP |
| Failover | Origin group (5xx'da) | Endpoint group, health check, traffic dial |
| Xavfsizlik | WAF, Shield, Functions | Shield |
| Narx | Data transfer + request | Soatlik + DT-Premium |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
User --anycast--> eng yaqin edge --AWS backbone--> ALB/NLB/EC2 (us-east-1 yoki eu-west-1)
                       (internet "yarim yo'li" yo'q, kam jitter)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws globalaccelerator create-accelerator --name game --ip-address-type IPV4 --region us-west-2
aws globalaccelerator update-endpoint-group --endpoint-group-arn $EG \
  --traffic-dial-percentage 0 --region us-west-2    # region'ni trafikdan chiqarish
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Statik web sayt uchun GA tanlash — cache yo'q, qimmatroq.
- CloudFront'ga statik IP kerak deb kutish — yo'q.
- Ikkalasini birga ishlatish odatda ma'nosiz (CloudFront allaqachon edge'da).

**Senior nuqta:** Qaror: HTTP va cache'lanadigan — CloudFront; non-HTTP, statik IP yoki tez multi-region failover — Global Accelerator.

40911.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Transfer Family — **SFTP, FTPS, FTP va AS2** protokollari orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri S3 yoki EFS'ga fayl qabul qilish/yuborish uchun boshqariladigan server. Foydalanuvchi auth: servis-managed SSH kalitlar, AD yoki Lambda/API Gateway orqali custom IdP. Managed workflow'lar (fayl kelgach skan, dekompressiya, nusxa).

**Muammo:** Bank yoki hamkor kompaniya hali ham faqat SFTP bilan fayl yuboradi. O'z SFTP serveringiz (EC2 + vsftpd) — patch, HA, disk to'lishi, kalit boshqaruvi va audit muammosi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Partner --SFTP (22)--> Transfer Family endpoint (public / VPC, Elastic IP)
                          | auth: SSH key / custom IdP (Lambda)
                          | user -> IAM role + logical home dir
                          v
                   s3://partner-inbox/acme/  --> S3 event -> Lambda/Step Functions ishlov
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws transfer create-server --protocols SFTP --identity-provider-type SERVICE_MANAGED \
  --endpoint-type VPC --endpoint-details VpcId=vpc-0abc,SubnetIds=subnet-1,AddressAllocationIds=eipalloc-1
aws transfer create-user --server-id s-123 --user-name acme \
  --role arn:aws:iam::111:role/transfer-acme --home-directory-type LOGICAL \
  --home-directory-mappings '[{"Entry":"/","Target":"/partner-inbox/acme"}]' \
  --ssh-public-key-body "ssh-ed25519 AAAA..."
sftp -i acme.key acme@s-123.server.transfer.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Narx: server soatbay (har protokol uchun), fayl kam bo'lsa ham to'lanadi.
- Logical home directory'siz — hamkor butun bucket'ni ko'radi.
- Oddiy FTP (shifrlanmagan) faqat VPC ichida ruxsat — internetda FTPS/SFTP.

**Senior nuqta:** Hamkor uchun statik IP (Elastic IP) va kirish uchun IP allowlist (SG) — B2B integratsiyada odatiy talab. Fayl kelishi bilan event-driven pipeline ishga tushsin, cron emas.

40912.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon MQ — **Apache ActiveMQ** va **RabbitMQ** uchun boshqariladigan message broker: standart protokollar (AMQP, MQTT, STOMP, OpenWire, JMS) qo'llab-quvvatlanadi. Asosiy maqsad — mavjud ilovalarni kodini qayta yozmasdan cloud'ga ko'chirish.

**Muammo:** Legacy Java ilova JMS/ActiveMQ ga bog'langan. SQS/SNS'ga o'tish — kodni qayta yozish. O'z broker'ingizni EC2'da yuritish — HA, patch, disk, monitoring yuki.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
App (JMS / AMQP client) --TLS--> Amazon MQ broker
  ActiveMQ:  active/standby (2 AZ, umumiy EFS storage)
  RabbitMQ:  3 node klaster (3 AZ), quorum queue'lar
Monitoring: CloudWatch (QueueSize, ConsumerCount), broker web konsol
```

**SQS/SNS bilan taqqoslash:**
| | Amazon MQ | SQS/SNS |
|---|---|---|
| Protokol | AMQP, MQTT, JMS, STOMP | AWS API (HTTPS) |
| Scale | Broker o'lchami bilan cheklangan | Deyarli cheksiz |
| Boshqaruv | Instance turi, maintenance oynasi | Serverless |
| Routing | Exchange/topic murakkab | Oddiy (filter) |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws mq create-broker --broker-name orders --engine-type RABBITMQ --engine-version 3.13 \
  --host-instance-type mq.m5.large --deployment-mode CLUSTER_MULTI_AZ \
  --publicly-accessible false --users Username=app,Password=...
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Single-instance deployment prod'da — bitta AZ, broker o'chsa hammasi to'xtaydi.
- Maintenance oynasida broker qayta ishga tushadi — client reconnect logikasi bo'lsin.
- Consumer'lar sekin — navbat xotirani to'ldiradi va broker flow control yoqadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Yangi cloud-native ilova uchun odatda SQS/SNS/EventBridge yoki Kafka (MSK). Amazon MQ — "lift-and-shift" va standart protokol talab qilinganda to'g'ri tanlov.

40913.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **SQS** — xabarlar **navbati**: har xabar bitta consumer tomonidan qayta ishlanadi va o'chiriladi; worker'lar mustaqil scale qiladi. **Kinesis Data Streams** — tartiblangan **stream (log)**: yozuvlar 24 soatdan 365 kungacha saqlanadi, bir nechta consumer ilova bir xil ma'lumotni mustaqil o'qiydi va **replay** qila oladi; tartib shard (partition key) ichida.

**Muammo:** Noto'g'ri tanlov: task queue uchun Kinesis (shard boshqaruvi, bitta sekin yozuv shard'ni bloklaydi) yoki analitika/event sourcing uchun SQS (o'qilgan xabar yo'qoladi, ikkinchi consumer ko'rmaydi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SQS:     producer -> [m1 m2 m3] -> worker A oladi m1, worker B oladi m2 -> delete
Kinesis: producer -> shard-1: r1 r2 r3 r4 ...  (ofset/sequence number)
                       app X (analitika) o'qiydi o'z checkpoint'i bilan
                       app Y (arxiv) o'qiydi o'z checkpoint'i bilan
```
| | SQS | Kinesis Data Streams |
|---|---|---|
| Model | Queue, competing consumers | Log, ko'p mustaqil consumer |
| Tartib | Standard: yo'q; FIFO: group ichida | Shard ichida |
| Saqlash | Max 14 kun, o'qib o'chiriladi | 24 soat - 365 kun, replay |
| Scale | Avtomatik | Shard'lar yoki on-demand rejim |
| Har xabar ack | Bor (visibility, DLQ) | Yo'q, checkpoint |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws kinesis put-record --stream-name clicks --partition-key user-42 --data "$(echo '{"p":"/home"}' | base64)"
aws kinesis describe-stream-summary --stream-name clicks
aws sqs send-message --queue-url $Q --message-body '{"jobId":1}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kinesis'da partition key kam xilma-xil — hot shard, `ProvisionedThroughputExceeded`.
- Kinesis'da bitta buzuq yozuv consumer'ni to'xtatadi (navbatdagi kabi alohida DLQ yo'q, bisect/on-failure destination sozlash kerak).
- SQS'da tartib kutish (standard queue) — tartib kerak bo'lsa FIFO.

**Senior nuqta:** Savol: "Xabar — bajariladigan ish (task)mi yoki sodir bo'lgan fakt (event)mi?" Task — SQS; ko'p iste'molchili event stream — Kinesis yoki MSK (Kafka).

40914.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon Data Firehose (avval Kinesis Data Firehose) — streaming ma'lumotni qabul qilib, **buferlab**, ixtiyoriy transformatsiya (Lambda, format konvertatsiya Parquet/ORC'ga, dinamik partition) qilib, S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, Splunk, Snowflake, Iceberg jadvallari, HTTP endpoint'larga **avtomatik yetkazadigan** to'liq boshqariladigan servis. Consumer kod yozish kerak emas.

**Muammo:** Log/clickstream'ni S3'ga yozish uchun consumer ilova yozish: batch'lash, retry, siqish, fayl hajmini boshqarish — hammasi o'zingizda. Firehose buni konfiguratsiya bilan hal qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Source: Direct PUT | Kinesis Data Streams | MSK | CloudWatch Logs | WAF logs
   v
Buffer: hajm (1-128 MB) YOKI vaqt (0-900 s) - qaysi biri oldin
   v
[Lambda transform] -> [JSON -> Parquet, Glue schema] -> [dinamik partition: customer_id]
   v
S3 (gzip/snappy) / Redshift (S3 orqali COPY) / OpenSearch / Splunk / HTTP
   v xato bo'lsa
S3 error prefix (backup)
```
Deyarli real vaqt (buffer interval'iga bog'liq), "exactly-once" emas — dublikat bo'lishi mumkin.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws firehose put-record --delivery-stream-name clicks \
  --record Data="$(echo '{"user":42,"page":"/"}' | base64)"
aws firehose describe-delivery-stream --delivery-stream-name clicks \
  --query 'DeliveryStreamDescription.Destinations[0].ExtendedS3DestinationDescription.BufferingHints'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kichik buffer (1 MB / 60 s) — S3'da millionlab mayda fayl, Athena sekin va qimmat.
- Lambda transform xato bersa yozuvlar error prefix'ga ketadi — uni monitor qil.
- Firehose'dan "har bir event darhol" kutish — u batch tizim.

**Senior nuqta:** Firehose — "stream'dan data lake'ga" eng kam kodli yo'l. Murakkab stateful ishlov (windowing, join) kerak bo'lsa — Managed Flink.

40915.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Glue DataBrew — **kod yozmasdan** vizual interfeysda ma'lumotni tozalash va normallashtirish tool'i: 250+ tayyor transformatsiya (dublikatlarni olib tashlash, format standartlash, bo'sh qiymatlarni to'ldirish, PII masking), data profiling va qayta ishlatiladigan "recipe"lar.

**Muammo:** Data analitik yoki data scientist ma'lumotni tayyorlashga vaqtining katta qismini sarflaydi va har o'zgarish uchun data engineer'dan Spark job so'raydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Dataset (S3, Redshift, RDS, Glue Catalog)
   v
Project: namuna (masalan 500 qator) ustida vizual tahrir
   -> Recipe: [trim spaces, split column, mask email, remove duplicates ...]
   v
Profile job: null %, unikal qiymatlar, taqsimot, korrelyatsiya
   v
Recipe job: butun dataset'ga qo'llash -> S3 (Parquet/CSV) - jadval bilan
```
Recipe — JSON/YAML, versiyalanadi va CI'da qayta ishlatiladi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws databrew create-recipe-job --name clean-customers --dataset-name customers \
  --recipe-reference Name=customers-clean,RecipeVersion=1.0 \
  --outputs '[{"Location":{"Bucket":"lake","Key":"curated/customers/"},"Format":"PARQUET"}]' \
  --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/databrew
aws databrew start-job-run --name clean-customers
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Namuna ustida ishlagan recipe to'liq ma'lumotda kutilmagan qiymatlarga duch keladi — profile job bilan tekshir.
- Narx: interaktiv sessiya soatbay va job node-soat bo'yicha — katta, tez-tez ishlaydigan pipeline uchun Glue Spark arzonroq bo'lishi mumkin.
- Recipe'lar konsolda tarqoq — versiyalash va egalikni yo'lga qo'y.

**Senior nuqta:** DataBrew — self-service tayyorlash uchun. Prod data pipeline'ni esa test qilinadigan kod (dbt, Spark) sifatida yuritish uzoq muddatda ishonchliroq.

40916.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Lake Formation — S3 data lake ustida **markazlashgan, nozik ruxsat** boshqaruvi: database/jadval/**ustun**/**qator**/cell darajasida `GRANT`/`REVOKE`, LF-Tag asosidagi ruxsat (tag-based access control), cross-account ulashish va audit. Athena, Redshift Spectrum, EMR, Glue shu ruxsatlarga bo'ysunadi.

**Muammo:** S3 bucket policy va IAM bilan "marketing jamoasi `customers` jadvalini ko'rsin, lekin `email` va `phone` ustunlarini emas, faqat o'z mamlakati qatorlarini" degan talabni amalga oshirib bo'lmaydi — IAM fayl darajasida ishlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
S3 location ro'yxatdan o'tadi (Lake Formation boshqaradi)
Glue Catalog: sales.customers (id, name, email, country)
   GRANT SELECT (id, name, country) ON sales.customers TO role/marketing
   Row filter: country = 'UZ'
Athena so'rov (role/marketing) -> LF vaqtinchalik credential beradi
   -> faqat ruxsat etilgan ustun/qatorlar qaytadi
```
LF-Tags: `classification=pii` tag'li ustunlar faqat `pii-reader` rolga — yangi jadvallar avtomatik qamrab olinadi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws lakeformation grant-permissions \
  --principal DataLakePrincipalIdentifier=arn:aws:iam::111:role/marketing \
  --permissions SELECT \
  --resource '{"TableWithColumns":{"DatabaseName":"sales","Name":"customers","ColumnNames":["id","name","country"]}}'
aws lakeformation list-permissions --resource '{"Table":{"DatabaseName":"sales","Name":"customers"}}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "IAMAllowedPrincipals" default ruxsati qolib ketgan — LF ruxsatlari amalda ishlamaydi.
- Kimdir S3'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri (bucket policy orqali) kira oladi — LF chetlab o'tiladi; bucket kirishini yop.
- Jadval-jadval qo'lda grant — scale bo'lmaydi; LF-Tags ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Data mesh'da Lake Formation domain jamoalariga o'z ma'lumotini boshqarish va boshqa akkauntlarga xavfsiz ulashish imkonini beradi — markaziy governance va decentralized egalik.

40917.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon QuickSight — serverless **BI** servisi: dashboard'lar, interaktiv vizualizatsiya, SPICE in-memory engine, ML insight'lar (anomaliya, prognoz), tabiiy til so'rovlari (Amazon Q in QuickSight) va ilovaga **embedded** analitika. 2025 oxiridan QuickSight **Amazon Quick Suite** tarkibiga kirdi.

**Muammo:** Biznes foydalanuvchilarga hisobot kerak, lekin Tableau/Power BI uchun server, litsenziya va DB'ga og'ir to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'rovlar muammosi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Data sources: Athena, Redshift, RDS/Aurora, S3, Snowflake, SaaS
   v
Dataset: Direct Query (har safar manbaga) | SPICE (import, tez, jadval bilan refresh)
   v
Analysis -> Dashboard -> foydalanuvchilar / embedded (ilovaga iframe/SDK)
Row-level security: user/guruh -> qaysi qatorlar
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws quicksight create-ingestion --aws-account-id 111 --data-set-id sales-ds \
  --ingestion-id refresh-$(date +%s)
aws quicksight list-dashboards --aws-account-id 111
```
Narx modeli: author/reader foydalanuvchi bo'yicha (reader capacity pricing katta auditoriya uchun) + SPICE hajmi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Direct Query'ni katta Athena jadvaliga ulash — har dashboard ochilishi pul va sekin; SPICE ishlat.
- Row-level security sozlanmagan embedded dashboard — mijoz boshqa mijoz ma'lumotini ko'radi.
- SPICE refresh muvaffaqiyatsizligini kuzatmaslik — eski ma'lumot jim ko'rsatiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** BI tanlovida asosiy masala tool emas, "semantic layer" — metrikalar ta'rifi bir joyda bo'lsin, aks holda har dashboard "daromad"ni har xil hisoblaydi.

40918.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Managed Microsoft AD (Directory Service) — AWS boshqaradigan, **haqiqiy Windows Server domain controller**'larida (2 AZ) ishlaydigan Microsoft Active Directory: Group Policy, Kerberos, LDAP, on-prem AD bilan **trust**, schema kengaytirish. Patch, backup, replikatsiya AWS tomonidan.

**Muammo:** Windows workload'lar (SQL Server, .NET, fayl serverlar, FSx for Windows), RDS SQL Server Windows auth, WorkSpaces uchun AD kerak. EC2'da o'z DC'laringizni yuritish — patch, FSMO, backup, HA yuki.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
On-prem AD (corp.local) <--forest trust (DX/VPN)--> AWS Managed AD (aws.corp.local)
                                                    DC1 (AZ-a)  DC2 (AZ-b)
                                                        |
           EC2 Windows (domain join), RDS SQL Server, FSx for Windows, WorkSpaces,
           IAM Identity Center (AD identity source)
```
Variantlar: **AD Connector** (faqat proxy — on-prem AD'ga yo'naltiradi, ma'lumot saqlamaydi), **Simple AD** (Samba, cheklangan).

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ds create-microsoft-ad --name aws.corp.local --password '...' --edition Standard \
  --vpc-settings VpcId=vpc-0abc,SubnetIds=subnet-a,subnet-b
aws ds describe-directories --query 'DirectoryDescriptions[].[Name,Stage,DnsIpAddrs]'
```
EC2 avtomatik domain join: SSM `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` hujjati.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Domain Admins huquqi berilmaydi — sizda delegated admin OU; ba'zi legacy ilovalar shuni talab qiladi.
- VPC DHCP options/DNS sozlanmagan — instance'lar domenni topa olmaydi.
- Trust uchun on-prem va AWS o'rtasida kerakli portlar (53, 88, 389, 445...) ochilmagan.

**Senior nuqta:** Agar maqsad faqat "on-prem login bilan AWS'ga kirish" bo'lsa — AD Connector arzonroq. Cloud'da mustaqil, on-prem uzilsa ham ishlaydigan AD kerak bo'lsa — Managed AD.

40919.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management, RFC 7643/7644) — tashqi IdP (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace) dan IAM Identity Center'ga **foydalanuvchi va guruhlarni avtomatik provisioning/deprovisioning** qiluvchi standart REST protokol. SAML login'ni ta'minlaydi, SCIM esa "kim bor" ro'yxatini sinxronlaydi.

**Muammo:** Faqat SAML bo'lsa, Identity Center'da foydalanuvchi va guruhlarni qo'lda yaratish kerak. Xodim ishdan ketdi — IdP'da o'chirildi, lekin AWS'da guruh a'zoligi qoldi. Xavfsizlik va audit muammosi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Okta / Entra ID (manba haqiqat)
   | SAML 2.0  -> autentifikatsiya (login)
   | SCIM 2.0  -> POST/PATCH/DELETE /Users, /Groups (bearer token bilan)
   v
IAM Identity Center
   guruh "platform-admins" -> permission set "AdministratorAccess" -> akkauntlar
Xodim ketdi -> IdP'da disable -> SCIM -> Identity Center'da disable -> kirish yo'q
```

**Amalda:**
1. Identity Center: identity source = External IdP, **Automatic provisioning** yoqish -> SCIM endpoint + access token olish.
2. IdP'da AWS ilovasida SCIM URL va token'ni kiritish, guruhlarni "push" qilish.
```bash
aws identitystore list-groups --identity-store-id d-123 --query 'Groups[].DisplayName'
aws identitystore list-users --identity-store-id d-123 --filters AttributePath=UserName,AttributeValue=ali@corp.com
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- SCIM access token muddati (1 yil) tugaydi — sinxronlash jim to'xtaydi. Muddatni kuzat va rotatsiya qil.
- Nested guruhlar Identity Center'da qo'llab-quvvatlanmaydi (Entra'dan tekis guruh push qilinadi).
- IdP va Identity Center'da qo'lda o'zgartirish — konflikt; manba haqiqat faqat IdP.

**Senior nuqta:** Joiner-Mover-Leaver jarayoni avtomatlashtirilgan bo'lishi kerak: HR tizimi -> IdP -> SCIM -> AWS. Shunda kirish huquqi lavozim bilan birga o'zgaradi va auditda isbotlanadi.

40920.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **User Pools** — ilova foydalanuvchilari uchun **identity provider**: ro'yxatdan o'tish, login, MFA, parol tiklash, social/SAML/OIDC federatsiya; natijada JWT (ID, access, refresh token). **Identity Pools** (Federated Identities) — tasdiqlangan (yoki mehmon) foydalanuvchiga **vaqtinchalik AWS IAM credential** beradi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri S3/DynamoDB'ga murojaat qilish uchun.

**Muammo:** Mobil ilova foydalanuvchilarini autentifikatsiya qilish kerak (User Pool), va ba'zan foydalanuvchi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri S3'ga rasm yuklashi kerak — backend orqali emas (Identity Pool).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
User -> User Pool login -> JWT (id_token, access_token)
          |                        |
          | API GW/ALB JWT tekshiradi -> backend
          v
   Identity Pool: JWT -> STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
          v
   Vaqtinchalik AWS credential (role: authenticated) -> S3 PutObject (faqat o'z prefix'iga)
```
| | User Pools | Identity Pools |
|---|---|---|
| Javob beradi | "Kim bu?" (authN) | "AWS'da nima qila oladi?" (AWS authZ) |
| Natija | JWT token'lar | AWS access key + session token |
| Manba | O'z directory'si + federatsiya | User Pool, Google, Apple, SAML, guest |

**Amalda:**
```json
{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject"],
 "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::uploads/${cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub}/*"}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Guest (unauthenticated) access yoqilgan, role juda keng — har kim AWS resursingizga kiradi.
- ID token'ni API authorization uchun ishlatish — access token mo'ljallangan.
- Policy'da foydalanuvchi prefix'i yo'q — bir foydalanuvchi boshqasining fayllarini o'qiydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p ilovalarga faqat User Pool yetadi; S3'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yuklash uchun pre-signed URL ko'pincha Identity Pool'dan soddaroq va nazoratliroq.

40921.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) — fizik, virtual (VMware, Hyper-V) yoki boshqa cloud serverlarni **block darajasida uzluksiz replikatsiya** qilib, AWS'da arzon "staging area"da saqlaydi; avariyada daqiqalarda to'liq o'lchamli EC2 sifatida ishga tushiradi. RPO — soniyalar, RTO — daqiqalar. CloudEndure Disaster Recovery'ning vorisi.

**Muammo:** On-prem DR site — ikkinchi data center, ikki hissa hardware va litsenziya, deyarli hech qachon ishlatilmaydi. Backup'dan tiklash esa soatlab yoki kunlab.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Source server (agent) --block-level CDC (TLS)--> Staging subnet:
                                                 kichik replication server + arzon EBS
                                                 (point-in-time snapshot'lar)
Drill / avariya:
   Launch -> konvertatsiya (driver, boot) -> to'liq EC2 recovery instance (target subnet)
Failback: AWS -> on-prem teskari replikatsiya
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Source serverda agent
sudo python3 aws-replication-installer-init --region eu-central-1 --no-prompt
aws drs describe-source-servers --query 'items[].[sourceServerID,dataReplicationInfo.dataReplicationState]'
aws drs start-recovery --is-drill --source-servers sourceServerID=s-123
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Drill hech qachon qilinmagan — launch template (subnet, SG, instance turi) noto'g'ri ekanini avariya paytida bilasiz.
- Ilova bog'liqliklari (DNS, AD, litsenziya serveri) DR region'da yo'q — server ishga tushadi, ilova ishlamaydi.
- Replikatsiya tarmoq kanali yetarli emas — lag o'sib, RPO buziladi; `lagDuration` ni kuzat.

**Senior nuqta:** DRS server darajasidagi DR uchun; cloud-native ilovalarda esa DR'ni arxitekturada (multi-AZ, Aurora Global, IaC bilan region qayta yaratish) qurish arzonroq va ishonchliroq.

40922.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) — **lift-and-shift (rehost)** migratsiya uchun tavsiya etilgan asosiy servis: manba serverlardan block darajasida uzluksiz replikatsiya, test instance'larni ishga tushirish, so'ng minimal downtime bilan **cutover**. Avtomatik konvertatsiya (boot, driver) va post-launch action'lar (SSM).

**Muammo:** 300 ta VM'ni AWS'ga ko'chirish kerak. Qo'lda image eksport/import — sekin, xatoga moyil, har biri uchun uzoq downtime.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
1. Agent o'rnatish (yoki agentless vCenter) -> replikatsiya staging area'ga
2. Initial sync -> "Ready for testing"
3. Launch test instance -> ilova testi -> "Ready for cutover"
4. Cutover: manbada yozuvni to'xtat -> oxirgi sync (soniyalar) -> cutover instance
5. DNS/LB'ni yangi instance'ga o'tkaz -> "Finalize" -> manbani o'chirish
Wave'lar: serverlar to'lqin-to'lqin, bog'liqliklar bo'yicha guruhlanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws mgn describe-source-servers --query 'items[].[sourceServerID,lifeCycle.state]'
aws mgn start-test --source-server-ids s-123
aws mgn start-cutover --source-server-ids s-123
aws mgn finalize-cutover --source-server-id s-123
```

**MGN vs DRS vs DMS:**
| Servis | Maqsad |
|---|---|
| MGN | Server migratsiyasi (bir martalik ko'chirish) |
| DRS | Doimiy DR replikatsiya |
| DMS | Ma'lumotlar bazasi migratsiyasi/CDC |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Test bosqichini o'tkazib yuborish — cutover kuni litsenziya/IP hardcode muammolari chiqadi.
- Lift-and-shift'dan keyin rightsizing qilmaslik — on-prem "katta" VM'lar AWS'da qimmat.
- Ilova bog'liqliklarini (discovery) xaritalamasdan wave tuzish — yarim tizim AWS'da, yarmi on-prem, latency.

**Senior nuqta:** Rehost — tezlik uchun; keyin optimizatsiya (replatform: RDS, containerlar). "Migrate then modernize" rejasi va unga byudjet oldindan bo'lsin.

40923.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Migration Hub — migratsiya portfelini **bitta joyda kuzatish va rejalash**: discovery ma'lumotlari (Application Discovery Service), serverlarni ilovalarga guruhlash, MGN/DMS va hamkor tool'lar bo'yicha statusni ko'rish, Strategy Recommendations va Orchestrator (migratsiya workflow shablonlari).

**Muammo:** Yirik migratsiyada yuzlab server, o'nlab jamoa, bir nechta tool. "Qaysi ilova qaysi bosqichda?" degan savolga Excel jadvalidan javob qidiriladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Discovery (agent / agentless / import CSV)
   -> serverlar, CPU/RAM, tarmoq bog'liqliklari
   v
Ilovalarga guruhlash (app = web + db + cache)
   v
Strategy recommendations (rehost / replatform / refactor)
   v
Migratsiya: MGN, DMS, hamkor tool'lar -> status Migration Hub'ga
   v
Dashboard: Not started / In progress / Completed (har ilova)
```
Home region tanlanadi — barcha migratsiya ma'lumotlari shu yerda.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws discovery start-continuous-export
aws migrationhub list-migration-tasks --progress-update-stream MGN
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Discovery'ni qisqa muddat (1-2 kun) yig'ish — oy oxiri yukini va kam ishlatiladigan bog'liqliklarni ko'rmaysiz; kamida 2-4 hafta.
- Tool'ni maqsad deb bilish — asosiy ish ilova egalari bilan muloqot va wave rejasi.
- Home region'ni keyin o'zgartirish qiyin.

**Senior nuqta:** Migratsiya — dastur boshqaruvi muammosi. 7R (retire, retain, rehost, relocate, repurchase, replatform, refactor) bo'yicha har ilovaga qaror va egasi belgilansa, tool'lar faqat kuzatishni yengillashtiradi.

40924.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Well-Architected Framework — cloud workload'larni loyihalash va baholash uchun best practice'lar to'plami, **oltita ustun**: Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, Sustainability. Har ustun dizayn tamoyillari va savollar (masalan "Workload'ingiz komponent nosozligiga qanday chidaydi?") dan iborat.

**Muammo:** Jamoalar arxitekturani intuitsiya bilan quradi; zaif joylar (bitta AZ, backup sinalmagan, xarajat nazorati yo'q) faqat incident yoki katta hisobdan keyin ochiladi.

**Ustunlar va asosiy savol:**
| Ustun | Mohiyati | Misol amaliyot |
|---|---|---|
| Operational Excellence | Ishga tushirish va yaxshilash | IaC, runbook, postmortem |
| Security | Ma'lumot va tizimni himoyalash | Least privilege, shifrlash, audit |
| Reliability | Nosozlikdan tiklanish | Multi-AZ, backup sinovi, quota |
| Performance Efficiency | Resursdan samarali foydalanish | To'g'ri instance, cache, o'lchash |
| Cost Optimization | Keraksiz xarajatni yo'qotish | Rightsizing, Savings Plan, tag |
| Sustainability | Ekologik ta'sirni kamaytirish | Utilization, Graviton, data lifecycle |

Qo'shimcha **Lens**'lar: Serverless, SaaS, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Financial Services va boshqalar.

**Amalda:** review jarayoni:
```
1. Workload'ni aniqla (chegara, egasi, biznes kritikligi)
2. Har ustun savollariga javob (ko'pincha WA Tool'da)
3. High/Medium risk'lar ro'yxati (HRI)
4. Ustuvorlik -> backlog -> 3-6 oyda qayta review
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Review'ni bir martalik "auditor uchun hujjat" qilish.
- Barcha ustunlarni teng muhim deb bilish — trade-off bor (masalan reliability va cost).
- Tavsiyalarni kontekstsiz qo'llash (har ichki tool uchun multi-region).

**Senior nuqta:** Framework — savollar ro'yxati, javob emas. Uning qiymati — jamoani muntazam ravishda xavf va trade-off haqida gapirishga majburlashda.

40925.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Well-Architected Tool — AWS konsolidagi **bepul** servis: workload'ni ro'yxatdan o'tkazib, Framework (va Lens) savollariga javob berasiz, u **High/Medium risk**'larni (HRI/MRI) ko'rsatadi, improvement plan tuzadi va milestone'lar bilan vaqt bo'yicha progressni kuzatadi.

**Muammo:** Well-Architected review Word hujjat yoki Excel'da qilinsa, natijalar yo'qoladi, keyingi review'da nima o'zgarganini ko'rib bo'lmaydi va ko'p workload bo'yicha umumiy rasm yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Workload "payments-api" (egasi, muhit, region'lar, akkauntlar)
   + Lens: WA Framework, Serverless Lens, custom lens (kompaniya standartlari)
   v
Savollar -> javoblar -> risk: HIGH / MEDIUM / NONE
   v
Improvement plan (har risk uchun yo'riqnoma havolasi)
   v
Milestone "2026-Q3" saqlanadi -> keyingi review'da solishtirish
   v
Jira integratsiyasi / API orqali hisobot, Trusted Advisor tekshiruvlari bog'lanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws wellarchitected create-workload --workload-name payments-api --environment PRODUCTION \
  --aws-regions eu-central-1 --review-owner platform@corp.com \
  --lenses wellarchitected serverless --description "Payments"
aws wellarchitected list-lens-review-improvements --workload-id w-123 --lens-alias wellarchitected \
  --query 'ImprovementSummaries[?Risk==`HIGH`].QuestionTitle'
aws wellarchitected create-milestone --workload-id w-123 --milestone-name 2026-Q3
```
**Custom lens** — kompaniyaning o'z talablari (masalan "har servisda SLO bor") JSON'da yoziladi va tashkilot bo'ylab ulashiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Savollarga "ha" deb belgilab qo'yish, dalilsiz — natija yolg'on xavfsizlik hissi.
- Improvement plan backlog'ga tushmaydi — hech narsa o'zgarmaydi.
- Juda katta "workload" (butun kompaniya) — natija umumiy va foydasiz.

**Senior nuqta:** Tool'ni production readiness review'ga bog'la: yangi kritik servis HRI'larsiz prod'ga chiqmasin — bu jarayonni tekshiriladigan qiladi.

40926.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Trusted Advisor — akkauntingizni avtomatik tekshirib, besh (endi olti) yo'nalishda tavsiya beradi: **Cost Optimization**, **Performance**, **Security**, **Fault Tolerance**, **Service Limits (quota)** va **Operational Excellence**. Basic/Developer support'da faqat asosiy tekshiruvlar; to'liq to'plam Business/Enterprise support bilan.

**Muammo:** Bo'sh Elastic IP, ishlatilmayotgan EBS, MFA'siz root, ochiq S3, bitta AZ'dagi RDS, 80%ga yetgan quota — hammasini qo'lda topish mumkin emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Trusted Advisor checks (davriy yangilanadi)
  [qizil] Security: S3 bucket ochiq ruxsat, SG 0.0.0.0/0 -> 22
  [sariq] Cost: kam ishlatiladigan EC2 (CPU < 10%, 14 kun)
  [sariq] Fault tolerance: RDS Multi-AZ o'chiq
  [qizil] Service limits: VPC per region 4/5
   v
Organizational view (barcha akkauntlar) / EventBridge / Support API
```
Trusted Advisor Priority (Enterprise) — TAM tomonidan saralangan eng muhim tavsiyalar.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws support describe-trusted-advisor-checks --language en --region us-east-1 \
  --query 'checks[?category==`security`].[id,name]'
aws support describe-trusted-advisor-check-result --check-id Pfx0RwqBli --region us-east-1
```
EventBridge: `source: aws.trustedadvisor`, `status: ERROR` -> Slack.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tavsiyalarni hech kim ko'rmaydi — har kategoriya uchun egasi va alert bo'lsin.
- "Kam ishlatilgan" degani doim isrof emas (DR standby, mavsumiy).
- Security Hub mavjud bo'lsa, xavfsizlik tekshiruvlari takrorlanadi — bitta manba tanlang.

**Senior nuqta:** Trusted Advisor — "past osilgan meva" topuvchi. Chuqurroq tahlil uchun Cost Optimization Hub, Compute Optimizer, Security Hub va Service Quotas alohida ishlatiladi.

40927.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Service Quotas — har akkaunt va region bo'yicha AWS servis limitlarini (vCPU soni, VPC soni, Lambda concurrency, EIP va h.k.) **ko'rish, oshirishni so'rash va kuzatish** uchun markaziy servis. Ko'p quota'lar uchun CloudWatch'da usage metrikasi bor — alarm qo'yish mumkin.

**Muammo:** Black Friday'da autoscaling 200 instance ko'tarmoqchi, lekin On-Demand vCPU quota'si 256 — `VcpuLimitExceeded`, servis yiqiladi. Yoki DR region'da quota'lar default (kichik) — failover paytida infra ko'tarilmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Quota: "Running On-Demand Standard instances" = 512 vCPU (eu-central-1)
Usage metrika (AWS/Usage): hozir 410
   v CloudWatch alarm: usage / quota > 80%
   v
Quota increase request -> (ko'pincha avtomatik tasdiq, ba'zan support case)
Organizations: quota request template - yangi akkauntlarga avtomatik
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 \
  --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 1024
aws service-quotas list-requested-service-quota-change-history --service-code ec2
```
CloudWatch metric math: `SERVICE_QUOTA(m1)` funksiyasi bilan foiz alarm.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Quota'ni faqat prod region'da oshirib, DR region'ni unutish.
- Hard limit'lar (o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan) — arxitektura shunga moslashishi kerak (masalan SG'dagi qoidalar soni).
- Ba'zi limitlar Service Quotas'da emas, API throttling (rate limit) sifatida — ularni ham hisobga ol.

**Senior nuqta:** Quota — capacity planning'ning bir qismi. Har yirik launch yoki DR mashqidan oldin "quota checklist" bo'lsin; yangi akkauntlar uchun template bilan oldindan oshir.

40928.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Budgets — xarajat, foydalanish (usage), RI/Savings Plans qamrovi va utilization bo'yicha **byudjet** o'rnatadi; **haqiqiy** yoki **prognoz** qilingan qiymat chegaradan oshsa email/SNS/Chatbot alert yuboradi va ixtiyoriy **Budget Actions** (IAM/SCP policy qo'llash, EC2/RDS'ni to'xtatish) bajaradi.

**Muammo:** Xarajat haqida faqat oy oxiridagi hisobdan bilish. Sandbox akkauntda kimdir GPU instance qoldirib ketdi — $15k.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Budget: team-a-prod, $10 000/oy, filter: tag CostCenter=team-a
  Alert 1: ACTUAL > 80%      -> Slack
  Alert 2: FORECASTED > 100% -> Slack + email menejer
  Action:  ACTUAL > 120%     -> SCP "DenyEC2RunInstances" (tasdiq bilan yoki avtomatik)
Ma'lumot kuniga bir necha marta yangilanadi (real-time emas)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws budgets create-budget --account-id 111 \
  --budget '{"BudgetName":"sandbox","BudgetLimit":{"Amount":"500","Unit":"USD"},"TimeUnit":"MONTHLY","BudgetType":"COST"}' \
  --notifications-with-subscribers '[{"Notification":{"NotificationType":"FORECASTED","ComparisonOperator":"GREATER_THAN","Threshold":100},"Subscribers":[{"SubscriptionType":"SNS","Address":"arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111:budget"}]}]'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat ACTUAL alert — kech bo'ladi; FORECASTED alert ham qo'y.
- Budget ma'lumoti soatlab kechikadi — tez "yonish"ni ushlash uchun Cost Anomaly Detection va servis metrikalari kerak.
- Prod'da avtomatik stop action — xarajat uchun outage; prod'da faqat alert.

**Senior nuqta:** Budget — har jamoa/akkaunt uchun egalik va javobgarlik vositasi. Sandbox'larda qattiq (action bilan), prod'da yumshoq (alert + review) siyosat.

40929.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Cost Categories — xarajatni **qoidalar** asosida (akkaunt, tag, servis, charge type, boshqa category) biznes ma'nosidagi guruhlarga (jamoa, mahsulot, biznes birlik, muhit) xaritalaydi. Natija Cost Explorer, Budgets, CUR va Anomaly Detection'da o'lchov sifatida ishlatiladi. **Split charge** — umumiy xarajatni (shared network, support) proporsional taqsimlaydi.

**Muammo:** Tag'lar to'liq emas, akkaunt tuzilmasi tashkilot tuzilmasiga mos emas. CFO "Payments mahsuloti qancha turadi?" deb so'raydi — javob yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Cost Category "Product":
  Rule 1: account in [payments-prod, payments-dev]   -> "Payments"
  Rule 2: tag Product = checkout                    -> "Checkout"
  Rule 3: account = shared-network                  -> "Shared"
  Default                                           -> "Unallocated"
Split charge: "Shared" -> Payments 60% / Checkout 40% (yoki proporsional)
```
Qoidalar retroaktiv qo'llanadi (joriy va oldingi oy uchun qayta hisoblanadi, cheklovlar bilan).

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ce create-cost-category-definition --name Product --rule-version CostCategoryExpression.v1 \
  --rules '[{"Value":"Payments","Rule":{"Dimensions":{"Key":"LINKED_ACCOUNT","Values":["222","333"]}}}]' \
  --default-value Unallocated
aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-09-01,End=2026-10-01 --granularity MONTHLY \
  --metrics UnblendedCost --group-by Type=COST_CATEGORY,Key=Product
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Unallocated" ulushi katta — tag siyosati ishlamayapti; uni KPI sifatida kuzat.
- Qoidalar tartibi muhim — birinchi mos kelgani qo'llanadi.
- Kategoriyalarni tez-tez qayta tuzish — tarixiy taqqoslash buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Showback/chargeback'ning asosi — Cost Categories + cost allocation tag'lar + akkaunt strategiyasi birgalikda. Maqsad — "Unallocated" < 5%.

40930.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Athena Federated Query — Athena'dan S3'dan tashqari manbalarga ham SQL so'rov: DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Redshift, DocumentDB, OpenSearch, CloudWatch Logs, Redis, HBase, on-prem JDBC va h.k. Har manba uchun **Lambda data source connector** ishlatiladi; turli manbalarni bitta so'rovda `JOIN` qilish mumkin.

**Muammo:** Analitik savol: "S3'dagi clickstream'ni DynamoDB'dagi user profillari va Aurora'dagi buyurtmalar bilan bog'la". ETL pipeline qurish uchun haftalar kerak, bir martalik savol uchun esa bu ortiqcha.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SELECT ... FROM awsdatacatalog.lake.clicks c
JOIN dynamo.default.users u ON c.user_id = u.id
JOIN pg.public.orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
   v
Athena engine -> har manba uchun connector Lambda'ni chaqiradi
   -> Lambda manbadan o'qiydi (predicate pushdown imkon qadar) -> spill S3'ga
   -> Athena join/aggregate
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Serverless Application Repository'dan connector deploy qilinadi, keyin:
aws athena create-data-catalog --name dynamo --type LAMBDA \
  --parameters function=arn:aws:lambda:eu-central-1:111:function:athena-dynamodb
```
```sql
SELECT u.country, count(*) FROM "dynamo"."default"."users" u
WHERE u.plan = 'pro' GROUP BY 1;
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Prod OLTP DB'ga katta skan so'rovi — prod yukiga zarar; read replica'ga ulan.
- Lambda timeout (15 daq) va xotira cheklovi — katta jadval sekin; pushdown bo'lmasa hammasi tortiladi.
- Narx: Athena skan + Lambda chaqiruv + manba (DynamoDB RCU) — uchtasi ham.

**Senior nuqta:** Federated query — ad-hoc tadqiqot va kam takrorlanadigan hisobotlar uchun. Muntazam ishlatiladigan so'rov bo'lsa, ma'lumotni data lake'ga olib kelish (zero-ETL, DMS, CDC) arzonroq va barqarorroq.

40931.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Clean Rooms — bir nechta kompaniya (masalan reklamachi va publisher) o'z ma'lumotlarini **bir-biriga xom holda ko'rsatmasdan** birgalikda tahlil qilish imkonini beradi: har tomon ma'lumoti o'z S3/Glue'sida qoladi, faqat ruxsat etilgan so'rov turlari va **agregatsiya chegaralari** bilan natija olinadi. Differential privacy, kriptografik hisoblash (C3R) va Clean Rooms ML qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.

**Muammo:** Reklama kampaniyasi samarasini o'lchash uchun brend va media kompaniya mijoz ro'yxatlarini solishtirishi kerak. Ro'yxatlarni almashish — GDPR buzilishi va raqobat xavfi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Collaboration (a'zolar: Brand, Publisher)
  Brand: configured table "customers" - analysis rule: AGGREGATION
         (faqat COUNT/SUM, min 100 foydalanuvchi guruhda, email ustuni faqat JOIN uchun)
  Publisher: configured table "impressions"
   v
Ruxsat etilgan so'rov: JOIN by hashed_email -> COUNT(DISTINCT) by campaign
   v
Natija faqat "query runner"ga, xom qatorlar hech kimga ko'rinmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```sql
SELECT i.campaign_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.hashed_email) AS reached
FROM customers c JOIN impressions i ON c.hashed_email = i.hashed_email
GROUP BY i.campaign_id;      -- guruhda < 100 bo'lsa natija qaytmaydi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Analysis rule juda bo'sh — ko'p takroriy so'rovlar bilan individual ma'lumotni "farq" orqali tiklash (differencing attack); differential privacy yordam beradi.
- Join kaliti (email) hash'i tuzsiz — lug'at hujumi bilan tiklanishi mumkin.
- Huquqiy kelishuvsiz texnik yechim — compliance baribir talab qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Privacy-enhancing technology — texnik va huquqiy masala birgalikda. Analysis rule'larni xavfsizlik jamoasi bilan birga loyihala.

40932.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Audit Manager — AWS foydalanishingiz bo'yicha **audit dalillarini (evidence) uzluksiz va avtomatik yig'adi** (Config, Security Hub, CloudTrail, API snapshot'lar) va ularni framework kontrollariga (SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, CIS) xaritalab, auditorga tayyor hisobot (assessment report) beradi.

**Muammo:** Har yillik audit oldidan jamoa haftalab skrinshot va eksport yig'adi: "Barcha S3 bucket'lar shifrlanganmi? Isbot?" Qo'lda yig'ilgan dalil eskiradi va to'liq emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Framework (tayyor yoki custom) -> Control set'lar -> Control'lar
   control "S3 encryption at rest" <- data source: AWS Config rule s3-bucket-server-side-encryption-enabled
   control "MFA for privileged users" <- Security Hub finding / IAM snapshot
   control "Incident response policy" <- manual evidence (PDF yuklanadi)
   v
Assessment (scope: akkauntlar, servislar) -> kunlik evidence yig'ish
   v
```
