```python
              "UpdateExpression": "SET balance = balance + :a",
              "ExpressionAttributeValues": {":a": {"N": "100"}}}},
  {"Put": {"TableName": "transfers", "Item": {"id": {"S": "tx-77"}},
           "ConditionExpression": "attribute_not_exists(id)"}}])
```
Xatoda `CancellationReasons` qaysi item sabab bo'lganini ko'rsatadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bir xil item'ga parallel tranzaksiyalar — `TransactionConflict`; retry + backoff.
- Global Tables'da tranzaksiya faqat yozilgan region ichida ACID; boshqa region'ga asinxron va LWW bilan boradi.
- Hamma narsani tranzaksiyaga o'rash — 2x narx va konflikt; faqat haqiqiy invariant uchun.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p holatda tranzaksiya o'rniga bitta item'ga conditional write (optimistic locking, `version` atributi) yetadi va arzonroq. Tranzaksiya — bir nechta item invariantini birga saqlash kerak bo'lganda.

40975.a:
**Qisqa javob:** S3 Batch Operations — milliardlab obyekt ustida **bitta job** bilan katta hajmli operatsiya: copy (boshqa bucket/region/storage class), tag/ACL/metadata o'zgartirish, Object Lock retention, Glacier'dan restore, **Lambda chaqirish**, replikatsiya (Batch Replication), checksum hisoblash. Obyektlar ro'yxati S3 Inventory yoki CSV manifest'dan; progress, retry va yakuniy **completion report**.

**Muammo:** 2 milliard obyektni shifrlash kalitini almashtirish uchun qayta nusxalash yoki tag qo'yish. O'z skriptingiz — oylab ishlaydi, throttling, qayerda to'xtaganini bilmaysiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Manifest: S3 Inventory (CSV/Parquet) yoki CSV (bucket,key[,version])
   yoki avtomatik manifest generatsiya (filtr: prefix, yaratilgan sana, storage class)
   v
Job: operatsiya + IAM role + priority + (ixtiyoriy) tasdiqlash
   v
S3 parallel bajaradi, retry qiladi
   v
Completion report: muvaffaqiyatli / xato obyektlar ro'yxati (S3'ga)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws s3control create-job --account-id 111 --operation '{"S3PutObjectTagging":{"TagSet":[{"Key":"retention","Value":"7y"}]}}' \
  --manifest '{"Spec":{"Format":"S3InventoryReport_CSV_20161130"},"Location":{"ObjectArn":"arn:aws:s3:::inv/manifest.json","ETag":"abc"}}' \
  --report '{"Bucket":"arn:aws:s3:::reports","Format":"Report_CSV_20180820","Enabled":true,"ReportScope":"FailedTasksOnly"}' \
  --priority 10 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/batch-ops --confirmation-required
aws s3control describe-job --account-id 111 --job-id <id> --query 'Job.ProgressSummary'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Copy operatsiyasi 5 GB'dan katta obyektlarni ko'chirmaydi — ular uchun Lambda yoki boshqa yo'l.
- Narx: job + har obyekt uchun to'lov + asosiy operatsiya (PUT/COPY) narxi — milliardlab obyektda sezilarli; avval hisobla.
- Inventory eski — job boshlanganda yangi yaratilgan obyektlar kirmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Katta o'zgarishni avval kichik manifest (1000 obyekt) bilan sina, `--confirmation-required` bilan ko'rib chiq, keyin to'liq ishga tushir. Completion report — operatsiyaning audit isboti.

40976.a:
**Qisqa javob:** S3 Storage Lens — butun tashkilot (barcha akkaunt, region, bucket, prefix) bo'yicha S3 **foydalanish, xarajat samaradorligi, ma'lumot himoyasi va faollik** metrikalarini bitta dashboard'da ko'rsatadigan analitika. Bepul (free metrics) va pulli (advanced metrics: prefix darajasi, faollik, CloudWatch'ga eksport, tavsiyalar) darajalari bor.

**Muammo:** 3000 bucket, petabaytlab ma'lumot. Savollar: qaysi bucket o'sib ketyapti? Qayerda lifecycle yo'q? Qaysi bucket'larda shifrlash/versioning o'chiq? Qaysi ma'lumot 1 yildan beri o'qilmagan, lekin Standard'da turibdi?

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Barcha akkauntlar (Organizations) -> Storage Lens configuration (delegated admin)
   v kunlik metrikalar (60+)
Dashboard:
  Summary:      jami hajm, obyekt soni, o'sish %
  Cost:         noncurrent versiya hajmi, tugallanmagan multipart upload'lar, storage class taqsimoti
  Protection:   versioning, replication, SSE, Object Lock holati
  Activity:     GET/PUT so'rovlar (advanced) -> "sovuq" bucket'lar
   v
Eksport: S3 (CSV/Parquet) -> Athena / CloudWatch (alarm uchun)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws s3control list-storage-lens-configurations --account-id 111
aws s3control put-storage-lens-configuration --account-id 111 --config-id org-lens \
  --storage-lens-configuration file://lens.json
```
Odatiy topilmalar va harakat:
- Tugallanmagan multipart upload'lar -> lifecycle `AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload` (7 kun).
- Katta noncurrent versiyalar -> `NoncurrentVersionExpiration`.
- Kam o'qiladigan ma'lumot -> Intelligent-Tiering yoki Glacier.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Metrikalar kunlik — real vaqt monitoringi emas.
- Faqat default dashboard'ni ko'rish — org darajasidagi config yaratilmagan, faqat bitta akkaunt ko'rinadi.
- Advanced metrics narxi obyekt soniga bog'liq — milliardlab obyektda hisobla.

**Senior nuqta:** Storage Lens — "qayerga qarash kerak"ni ko'rsatadi; haqiqiy tejash lifecycle siyosatlari va egalar bilan ishlashdan keladi. Har chorakda top-10 o'suvchi bucket'ni egasi bilan ko'rib chiq.

40977.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CloudFront field-level encryption — POST so'rovdagi belgilangan **sezgir maydonlarni** (karta raqami, passport) **edge'da public key bilan** shifrlaydi. Ma'lumot origin'ga shifrlangan holda yetadi va faqat private key'ga ega maxsus servis (masalan to'lov servisi) uni ochadi. Oraliq qatlamlar (LB, log'lar, boshqa mikroservislar) ochiq qiymatni ko'rmaydi.

**Muammo:** HTTPS faqat transport'ni himoyalaydi: origin'da TLS tugagach, karta raqami web server log'iga, APM'ga, xato xabarlariga tushishi mumkin — va butun zanjir PCI scope'iga kiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Brauzer --HTTPS POST card=4111...--> CloudFront edge
                                       field-level encryption profile:
                                       "card" maydonini RSA public key bilan shifrlash
   --> ALB --> API gateway --> Order servis (card = "AYAD...shifrlangan")  -> log'da ham shifrlangan
                                   --> Payment servis (private key) -> deshifrlash -> to'lov
```
Faqat `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` POST so'rovlar uchun, ko'pi bilan 10 ta maydon.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws cloudfront create-public-key --public-key-config '{"CallerReference":"k1","Name":"pay-key","EncodedKey":"-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----..."}'
aws cloudfront create-field-level-encryption-profile --field-level-encryption-profile-config file://profile.json
aws cloudfront create-field-level-encryption-config --field-level-encryption-config file://fle.json
# keyin distribution cache behavior'ga FieldLevelEncryptionId biriktiriladi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- JSON body (`application/json`) bilan ishlamaydi — zamonaviy SPA/API'lar uchun cheklov.
- Private key'ni barcha servislarga tarqatish — maqsad yo'qoladi; faqat bitta servis, KMS/HSM'da.
- Keyni rotatsiya qilish rejasi yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Amalda ko'p kompaniyalar karta ma'lumotini umuman qabul qilmaydi: to'lov provayderining hosted field/iframe yoki tokenizatsiya SDK'si ishlatiladi — PCI scope'ni eng ko'p qisqartiruvchi yechim.

40978.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **CloudFront Functions** — juda yengil JavaScript (cheklangan runtime), har bir edge location'da (600+ PoP), sub-millisekund, faqat viewer request/response'da; tarmoq/disk kirish yo'q; juda arzon. **Lambda@Edge** — to'liq Node.js/Python, regional edge cache'larda, viewer va **origin** event'larida, tarmoq chaqiruvi, body'ga kirish, 5-30 s gacha ishlash; qimmatroq va sekinroq.

**Muammo:** Edge'da logika kerak: URL rewrite, A/B test, header qo'shish, token tekshirish, geo-routing yoki rasm o'lchamini o'zgartirish. Har biri uchun noto'g'ri tool — yo ortiqcha xarajat, yo imkoniyat yetmaydi.

**Taqqoslash:**
| | CloudFront Functions | Lambda@Edge |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime | JS (ECMAScript 5.1 + ba'zi ES6+) | Node.js, Python |
| Event | viewer request/response | viewer + origin request/response |
| Ishlash vaqti | < 1 ms | 5 s (viewer), 30 s (origin) |
| Tarmoq / body | Yo'q | Bor |
| Joylashuv | Har edge PoP | Regional edge cache |
| Narx | ~1/6 Lambda@Edge | Yuqoriroq |
| Ma'lumot | KeyValueStore (lokal o'qish) | Har qanday servis |

**Amalda:**
```js
// CloudFront Function: /docs -> /docs/index.html
function handler(event) {
  var req = event.request;
  if (req.uri.endsWith('/')) req.uri += 'index.html';
  else if (!req.uri.includes('.')) req.uri += '/index.html';
  return req;
}
```
```bash
aws cloudfront test-function --name rewrite --if-match ETAG --event-object fileb://event.json
```
Lambda@Edge misollari: origin'ni dinamik tanlash, autentifikatsiya uchun tashqi IdP chaqiruvi, rasm transformatsiyasi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Lambda@Edge'ni oddiy header uchun ishlatish — keraksiz latency va narx.
- Lambda@Edge faqat `us-east-1` da yaratiladi, log'lari esa turli region'lardagi CloudWatch'ga tushadi.
- CloudFront Functions'da `fetch` yo'q — tashqi tekshiruv kerak bo'lsa ishlamaydi (JWT'ni lokal kalit bilan tekshirish mumkin).

**Senior nuqta:** Qoida: avval CloudFront Functions; faqat tarmoq, body yoki origin event kerak bo'lsa Lambda@Edge. Ikkalasini birga ham ishlatish mumkin (viewer'da Function, origin'da Lambda@Edge).

40979.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Route 53 Traffic Flow — murakkab DNS routing'ni (geolocation, latency, failover, weighted, geoproximity) **vizual editor**da daraxt (traffic policy) sifatida qurish va uni bir nechta domen/record'ga versiyalab qo'llash vositasi. Geoproximity (bias bilan) routing faqat Traffic Flow orqali (endi oddiy record'larda ham) mavjud.

**Muammo:** "Yevropa foydalanuvchilari -> eu region (latency bo'yicha 2 ta region orasida), eu yiqilsa -> us; Osiyo -> 90% ap, 10% yangi region (canary)" — buni oddiy record'lar bilan qurish o'nlab bog'langan alias record'lar va xatoga moyil.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Traffic policy v3 (JSON / vizual):
  Start: geolocation
    Europe ---> latency rule
                  eu-central-1 (health check) --failover--> us-east-1
                  eu-west-1    (health check)
    Asia   ---> weighted: ap-southeast-1 90% | ap-south-1 10%
    Default --> us-east-1
   v
Policy record: api.example.com -> policy v3   (versiyalar, rollback)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws route53 create-traffic-policy --name api-global --document file://policy.json
aws route53 create-traffic-policy-instance --hosted-zone-id Z123 --name api.example.com \
  --ttl 60 --traffic-policy-id <id> --traffic-policy-version 3
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Narx: har policy record oyiga sezilarli to'lov (~$50) — oddiy holat uchun ortiqcha.
- Health check'siz endpoint'lar — failover hech qachon ishlamaydi.
- DNS TTL va client cache — routing o'zgarishi darhol emas; resolver'lar EDNS client subnet'ni har doim yubormaydi, geolocation noaniq bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** DNS routing — qo'pol vosita (TTL, cache). Tez va aniq failover kerak bo'lsa Global Accelerator; DNS esa Traffic Flow bilan global trafik siyosatini versiyalangan holda boshqarish uchun yaxshi.

40980.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Route 53 DNSSEC signing — public hosted zone yozuvlariga **kriptografik imzo** (RRSIG) qo'shadi. Resolver imzoni zanjir bo'yicha (root -> TLD -> sizning zona) tekshiradi va soxta javobni rad etadi. Bu **DNS spoofing va cache poisoning**'dan himoya; shifrlash emas (maxfiylik bermaydi). Route 53 Resolver'da esa DNSSEC **validation** ham yoqiladi.

**Muammo:** Hujumchi resolver cache'ini zaharlab `bank.example.com` ni o'z IP'siga yo'naltiradi. Foydalanuvchi soxta saytga tushadi (TLS ham ba'zan yordam bermaydi — noto'g'ri sertifikat ogohlantirishini foydalanuvchi o'tkazib yuboradi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
KMS asimmetrik kalit (ECC_NIST_P256, us-east-1) -> KSK (key-signing key, siz boshqarasiz)
Route 53 -> ZSK (zone-signing key, avtomatik boshqariladi va rotatsiya)
Zona: A record + RRSIG;  DNSKEY record'lar
Registrator/parent zonaga: DS record (KSK hash'i) -> ishonch zanjiri
Resolver: root -> .com DS -> example.com DNSKEY -> RRSIG tekshiruv -> OK / SERVFAIL
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws route53 create-key-signing-key --hosted-zone-id Z123 --name ksk1 \
  --key-management-service-arn arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/abc --status ACTIVE --caller-reference k1
aws route53 enable-hosted-zone-dnssec --hosted-zone-id Z123
aws route53 get-dnssec --hosted-zone-id Z123     # DS record qiymatini olish -> registratorga
dig +dnssec example.com A        # javobda RRSIG va "ad" flag
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DS record'ni parent'ga qo'yish yoki olib tashlash tartibini buzish — butun domen `SERVFAIL` (to'liq outage). Yoqishda: avval signing, TTL kut, keyin DS; o'chirishda teskari.
- KMS kalitini o'chirish yoki policy'dan Route 53'ni chiqarish — imzolash to'xtaydi.
- `DNSSECInternalFailure` va `DNSSECKeySigningKeysNeedingAction` CloudWatch alarm'larisiz ishlash.

**Senior nuqta:** DNSSEC qiymati yuqori, lekin noto'g'ri operatsiya bilan o'z-o'zingizga outage qilish oson. Runbook, alarm'lar va staging domen'da mashqdan keyin yoq.

40981.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **HTTP API** — yengil, past latency, REST API'dan ~70% gacha arzon: Lambda/HTTP proxy, JWT authorizer (OIDC/Cognito), CORS, avtomatik deploy. **REST API** — to'liq funksiyali: API key va usage plan (throttling/kvota mijoz bo'yicha), request validation va transformatsiya (VTL), AWS WAF bevosita, private endpoint, cache, X-Ray, canary deploy, edge-optimized endpoint, AWS servislariga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri integratsiya.

**Muammo:** Yangi serverless API uchun qaysi birini tanlash? REST — qimmatroq va murakkab, HTTP — ba'zi zarur funksiyalar yo'q bo'lishi mumkin.

**Taqqoslash:**
| Funksiya | HTTP API | REST API |
|---|---|---|
| Narx (1M so'rov) | ~$1.00 | ~$3.50 |
| JWT authorizer | Bor (native) | Cognito / Lambda authorizer |
| API key / usage plan | Yo'q | Bor |
| WAF | Yo'q (CloudFront orqali) | Bor |
| Request validation / mapping | Cheklangan | To'liq |
| Cache | Yo'q | Bor |
| Private API (faqat VPC) | Yo'q | Bor |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws apigatewayv2 create-api --name orders --protocol-type HTTP \
  --target arn:aws:lambda:eu-central-1:111:function:orders
aws apigatewayv2 create-authorizer --api-id abc --authorizer-type JWT --name cognito \
  --identity-source '$request.header.Authorization' \
  --jwt-configuration Audience=client-id,Issuer=https://cognito-idp.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/pool-id
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tashqi hamkorlarga API sotish (kvota, API key) kerak bo'lsa HTTP API'ni tanlash — keyin migratsiya.
- REST API'ni faqat "u yaxshiroq" deb tanlab, oddiy ichki API uchun 3.5x to'lash.
- Ikkalasida ham default timeout 29 s (REST'da regional API uchun oshirish mumkin) — uzun ishlar uchun asinxron pattern.

**Senior nuqta:** Default — HTTP API; aniq kerakli funksiya (usage plan, WAF bevosita, private API, validation) bo'lsa — REST API. Qarorni funksiya ro'yxatidan, odatdan emas.

40982.a:
**Qisqa javob:** API Gateway WebSocket API — klient bilan **doimiy, ikki tomonlama** ulanishni AWS boshqaradi: ulanishlar `$connect`, `$disconnect`, `$default` va custom route'lar (xabardagi `action` maydoni bo'yicha) orqali Lambda/HTTP/AWS servislariga yo'naltiriladi. Backend klientga `@connections` API (`PostToConnection`) orqali xabar yuboradi.

**Muammo:** Chat, jonli bildirishnoma, real vaqtdagi dashboard uchun server push kerak. O'z WebSocket serveringiz — minglab doimiy ulanishni scale qilish, sticky sessiya va qayta ulanishni boshqarish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Client --wss://abc.execute-api.../prod-->  API Gateway (ulanishni ushlab turadi)
  $connect    -> Lambda: connectionId'ni DynamoDB'ga yoz (user_id bilan), auth
  sendMessage -> Lambda: xabarni qayta ishlash
  $disconnect -> Lambda: connectionId'ni o'chir
Backend (istalgan servis):
  POST https://abc.execute-api.../prod/@connections/{connectionId}  -> klientga push
```

**Amalda:**
```python
apigw = boto3.client("apigatewaymanagementapi",
                     endpoint_url="https://abc.execute-api.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/prod")
for conn in connections_for_room(room):
    try:
        apigw.post_to_connection(ConnectionId=conn, Data=json.dumps(msg).encode())
    except apigw.exceptions.GoneException:
        delete_connection(conn)      # eskirgan ulanish
```
```bash
wscat -c wss://abc.execute-api.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/prod
```

**Cheklovlar:** ulanish maks. 2 soat, idle timeout 10 daqiqa (klient ping yuborishi kerak), xabar hajmi 128 KB (32 KB frame).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `GoneException`ni ishlamaslik — o'lik ulanishlar DynamoDB'da yig'iladi.
- Klient qayta ulanish (reconnect + backoff) logikasi yo'q — 2 soatda yoki tarmoq uzilishida xabarlar yo'qoladi.
- Katta guruhga (100k klient) fan-out'ni bitta Lambda'da ketma-ket — sekin; parallel/batch.

**Senior nuqta:** Pub/Sub uchun sodda yo'l — AppSync Events yoki IoT Core (MQTT over WSS) bo'lishi mumkin. API Gateway WebSocket — custom protokol va to'liq nazorat kerak bo'lganda.

40983.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Lambda DLQ — **asinxron** chaqiruv (S3, SNS, EventBridge event'lari) barcha qayta urinishlardan (default 2 marta retry) keyin ham muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa, event'ni SQS navbat yoki SNS topic'ga yuboradi — event yo'qolmaydi. Bugun uning o'rniga **on-failure destination** tavsiya etiladi: u ko'proq kontekst (xato xabari, stack, so'rov) yuboradi va SQS, SNS, Lambda, EventBridge, S3 ga yo'naltira oladi.

**Muammo:** S3 event Lambda'ni chaqirdi, Lambda tashqi API ishlamagani uchun 3 marta yiqildi — event jimgina yo'qoldi. Fayl hech qachon qayta ishlanmadi va hech kim bilmadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Async invoke -> Lambda ichki navbat
   urinish 1 (xato) -> ~1 daq -> urinish 2 (xato) -> ~2 daq -> urinish 3 (xato)
   v
MaximumRetryAttempts (0-2), MaximumEventAgeInSeconds (60 s - 6 soat) tugadi
   v
On-failure destination (tavsiya) : {requestContext, requestPayload, responsePayload(xato)}
yoki DLQ (eski)                  : faqat asl event
```
Eslatma: SQS/Kinesis/DynamoDB Streams (event source mapping) uchun bu sozlama emas — ularda navbatning o'z DLQ'si yoki ESM on-failure destination ishlatiladi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws lambda put-function-event-invoke-config --function-name thumb \
  --maximum-retry-attempts 2 --maximum-event-age-in-seconds 3600 \
  --destination-config '{"OnFailure":{"Destination":"arn:aws:sqs:eu-central-1:111:thumb-failures"}}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sinxron chaqiruv (API Gateway) uchun DLQ kutish — ishlamaydi, xato klientga qaytadi.
- DLQ/destination'ga alarm yo'q — muvaffaqiyatsiz event'lar yig'iladi va retention tugab yo'qoladi.
- Lambda role'da DLQ/destination'ga yozish ruxsati yo'q (`sqs:SendMessage`).

**Senior nuqta:** Har asinxron Lambda uchun "xato bo'lsa nima bo'ladi?" savoliga javob bo'lsin: destination, alarm va redrive jarayoni. Idempotent handler bo'lmasa, retry'lar o'zi muammo yaratadi.

40984.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Lambda Layer — kutubxonalar, custom runtime, umumiy kod yoki konfiguratsiyani o'z ichiga olgan **qayta ishlatiladigan ZIP arxiv**. Funksiyaga 5 tagacha layer biriktiriladi; ular execution environment'da `/opt` ga ochiladi (`/opt/python`, `/opt/nodejs/node_modules`, `/opt/bin`). Funksiya + barcha layer'lar ochilgan hajmi 250 MB dan oshmasligi kerak.

**Muammo:** 30 ta Lambda bir xil og'ir kutubxonalardan (numpy, pandas, umumiy SDK) foydalanadi. Har birida alohida paketlash — deploy sekin, kod konsolda tahrirlanmaydi, kutubxona yangilanishi 30 joyda.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Layer "common-deps:7"  (python/lib/python3.12/site-packages/...)
Layer "otel-ext:3"     (extensions/...)
       v  biriktirish (versiya ARN bilan)
Funksiya A, B, C ...
Runtime: /opt/python -> sys.path ga avtomatik qo'shiladi
Layer versiyalari o'zgarmas (immutable): yangilash = yangi versiya + funksiyani yangilash
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
mkdir -p layer/python && pip install -r requirements.txt -t layer/python \
  --platform manylinux2014_aarch64 --only-binary=:all:
cd layer && zip -r ../deps.zip . && cd ..
aws lambda publish-layer-version --layer-name common-deps --zip-file fileb://deps.zip \
  --compatible-runtimes python3.12 --compatible-architectures arm64
aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name api \
  --layers arn:aws:lambda:eu-central-1:111:layer:common-deps:7
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Layer arxitekturasi (x86_64 / arm64) funksiyaga mos emas — native kutubxonalar import xatosi.
- Layer'lar orasida bir xil paketning turli versiyalari — tartib bo'yicha ustma-ust yoziladi, kutilmagan xatolar.
- Layer versiyasini yangilab, funksiyalar eski versiyada qolib ketadi — IaC'da markazlashtir.

**Senior nuqta:** Layer'lar umumiy runtime komponentlari (extension'lar, agent'lar) uchun yaxshi. Ilova bog'liqliklari uchun esa ko'pincha funksiya bilan birga paketlash (yoki container image) reproducible build va testni osonlashtiradi.

40985.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Lambda container image — funksiyani ZIP o'rniga **OCI/Docker image** sifatida (ECR'da, **10 GB gacha**) paketlash. AWS base image'lari (Runtime Interface Client bilan) yoki o'z image'ingiz + RIC ishlatiladi; lokal test uchun Runtime Interface Emulator. Execution modeli o'zgarmaydi — bu baribir Lambda (15 daq, event-driven).

**Muammo:** ML model + kutubxonalar 2 GB — ZIP'ning 250 MB chegarasiga sig'maydi. Jamoa allaqachon Docker bilan build/scan/deploy pipeline'iga ega va bir xil tool'larni ishlatmoqchi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Dockerfile (FROM public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.12)
   v docker build (linux/arm64 yoki amd64)
ECR (image scan, imzo)
   v
Lambda funksiya (PackageType=Image, ImageUri=...@sha256:digest)
Cold start: Lambda image'ni bo'laklab cache'laydi (lazy loading) - katta image ham amalda tez
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
FROM public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.12
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt --no-cache-dir
COPY app/ ${LAMBDA_TASK_ROOT}/app/
CMD ["app.handler.main"]
```
```bash
docker build --platform linux/arm64 --provenance=false -t infer .
docker run -p 9000:8080 infer &
curl -XPOST localhost:9000/2015-03-31/functions/function/invocations -d '{"x":1}'
aws lambda update-function-code --function-name infer --image-uri 111.dkr.ecr.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/infer@sha256:abc...
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Image'ni `:latest` tag bilan ko'rsatish — Lambda deploy paytida digest'ni qotiradi; yangi push avtomatik ishlamaydi.
- Image arxitekturasi funksiya `Architectures`ga mos emas — `exec format error`.
- Layer'lar container image funksiyalarida ishlatilmaydi — hammasi image ichida bo'lishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Container image Lambda va ECS/EKS o'rtasida bir xil build pipeline beradi. Lekin juda katta image'larni kamaytirish (multi-stage build, keraksiz fayllarni olib tashlash) cold start va xavfsizlik (kamroq paket — kamroq CVE) uchun baribir muhim.

40986.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AppConfig feature flags — AppConfig'ning maxsus konfiguratsiya turi (`AWS.AppConfig.FeatureFlags`): boolean flag'lar, atributlar (masalan `limit: 100`), **multi-variant flag'lar** (foydalanuvchi kontekstiga qarab turli qiymat — segmentlash, foizli rollout), validatsiya, bosqichli deploy va CloudWatch alarm bo'yicha **avtomatik rollback**. Kod deploy qilmasdan funksiyani yoqish/o'chirish.

**Muammo:** Yangi to'lov oqimini chiqarish xavfli. Deploy = yoqish bo'lsa, xato bo'lganda rollback uchun yana deploy kerak (10-30 daqiqa). Flag bilan esa deploy va release ajraladi: kod prod'da o'chiq turadi, flag bilan bosqichma-bosqich yoqiladi va bir zumda o'chiriladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Flag "new-checkout": enabled=true, variants: [beta-users -> on, 10% -> on, default -> off]
   v deploy strategy: Linear 25% / 5 daq + bake 10 daq, alarm "checkout_errors"
AppConfig Agent (sidecar / Lambda extension) -> lokal cache -> ilova
   if flags["new-checkout"].enabled: new_flow() else: old_flow()
Alarm yonsa -> avtomatik rollback (eski flag qiymati)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
curl "http://localhost:2772/applications/shop/environments/prod/configurations/flags?flag=new-checkout"
# multi-variant: kontekst bilan
curl -H "Context: userId=42" -H "Context: tier=gold" \
  "http://localhost:2772/applications/shop/environments/prod/configurations/flags"
```
```python
flags = requests.get(AGENT_URL, timeout=0.2).json()
use_new = flags.get("new-checkout", {}).get("enabled", False)   # default = xavfsiz qiymat
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Flag'larni hech qachon o'chirmaslik — kodda yuzlab o'lik `if`lar (flag qarzi). Har flag'ga egasi va muddat.
- AppConfig'ga kirib bo'lmasa default qiymat xavfli (masalan "hammaga yoq") bo'lishi.
- Flag'ni ruxsat (authorization) uchun ishlatish — flag xavfsizlik chegarasi emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Feature flag'lar deploy riskini kamaytiradi, lekin test matritsasini oshiradi (flag kombinatsiyalari). Muqobillar: LaunchDarkly, Unleash, OpenFeature standarti — vendor'dan mustaqil SDK uchun OpenFeature'ni ko'rib chiq.

40987.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SSM Patch Manager — EC2 va on-prem (hybrid activation) Linux/Windows/macOS serverlarida OS va ba'zi ilova patch'larini **skanerlash (Scan) va o'rnatish (Install)**ni avtomatlashtiradi: **patch baseline** (qaysi patch'lar, qancha kundan keyin avtomatik tasdiq), patch group'lar, maintenance window'lar va compliance hisoboti. Yangi usul — **Quick Setup patch policy** (org bo'ylab).

**Muammo:** 2000 server, yangi kritik CVE. Qaysi serverlar zaif, qaysi biri patch qilingan — bilmaysiz. SSH bilan qo'lda `yum update` — sekin va izsiz, reboot'lar servisni uzadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Patch baseline "linux-prod": Security, Critical/Important, 7 kundan keyin auto-approve
   v
Patch group / tag: Patch Group = prod-web
   v
Maintenance window: Yakshanba 02:00, concurrency 10%, error threshold 5%
   v
AWS-RunPatchBaseline (Operation=Install, RebootOption=RebootIfNeeded)
   v
Compliance: COMPLIANT / NON_COMPLIANT (har instance, har patch) -> Security Hub / Config
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ssm send-command --document-name AWS-RunPatchBaseline \
  --targets Key=tag:PatchGroup,Values=prod-web --parameters Operation=Scan \
  --max-concurrency 20% --max-errors 5%
aws ssm list-compliance-summaries --filters Key=ComplianceType,Values=Patch,Type=EQUAL
aws ssm describe-instance-patch-states --instance-ids i-0abc \
  --query 'InstancePatchStates[].[MissingCount,FailedCount,InstalledPendingRebootCount]'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Barcha serverlarni bir vaqtda patch + reboot — butun servis yiqiladi; concurrency va ASG/LB'dan chiqarish (drain).
- SSM Agent ishlamayapti yoki instance profile'da `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` yo'q — server "managed" ro'yxatida ko'rinmaydi.
- `InstalledPendingReboot` holatini e'tiborsiz qoldirish — patch o'rnatilgan, lekin kernel eski.

**Senior nuqta:** Immutable infratuzilmada (ASG, K8s node'lar) patch qilish o'rniga **yangi AMI** (EC2 Image Builder) chiqarib, instance'larni almashtirish afzal. Patch Manager — uzoq yashovchi (pet) serverlar uchun.

40988.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SSM State Manager — instance'larni **belgilangan holatda saqlash** uchun association'lar: qaysi SSM hujjati (yoki Ansible playbook, Chef recipe), qaysi target'larga, qanday jadval bilan qo'llanishini belgilaydi va drift bo'lsa qayta qo'llaydi. Masalan: CloudWatch agent o'rnatilgan va sozlangan, antivirus ishlayapti, domenga qo'shilgan, SSH root login o'chiq.

**Muammo:** Yangi serverlar to'g'ri sozlanadi, lekin vaqt o'tib kimdir agent'ni o'chiradi yoki konfiguratsiyani o'zgartiradi. Yuzlab serverda bunday drift'ni topish va tuzatish uchun Puppet/Chef server yuritish kerak edi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Association:
  document: AWS-ConfigureAWSPackage (AmazonCloudWatchAgent, install)
  targets:  tag Environment=prod
  schedule: rate(30 minutes)
  compliance severity: HIGH
   v
Har 30 daqiqada (va yangi instance target'ga qo'shilganda darhol) qo'llanadi
   v
Compliance: Association COMPLIANT / NON_COMPLIANT -> Config / Security Hub
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ssm create-association --name AWS-ApplyAnsiblePlaybooks \
  --targets Key=tag:Role,Values=web \
  --parameters SourceType=S3,SourceInfo='{"path":"https://s3.amazonaws.com/cfg/web.yml"}',PlaybookFile=web.yml \
  --schedule-expression "rate(1 hour)" --max-concurrency 10% --max-errors 5% \
  --compliance-severity HIGH
aws ssm list-associations
aws ssm describe-association-executions --association-id <id>
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Association xato beradi, lekin hech kim kuzatmaydi — compliance'ni Config/alert'ga ula.
- Juda tez-tez jadval + og'ir playbook — CPU yuki.
- State Manager va boshqa tool (Ansible pull, Chef) bir xil fayl uchun "jang" qiladi — bitta manba.

**Senior nuqta:** State Manager — agent'siz qo'shimcha infra talab qilmaydigan desired-state tizimi. Immutable infratuzilmada uning roli kichrayadi (holat AMI'da), lekin bootstrap va compliance tekshiruvi uchun foydali.

40989.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Stack policy — CloudFormation stack'iga biriktiriladigan JSON hujjat: stack **update** paytida qaysi resurslarni yangilash (`Update:Modify`), almashtirish (`Update:Replace`) yoki o'chirish (`Update:Delete`) mumkin emasligini belgilaydi. Bir marta qo'yilgach, policy'da ruxsat etilmagan barcha resurslar himoyalanadi (default deny).

**Muammo:** Template'da RDS'ning xususiyatini (masalan `DBInstanceIdentifier` yoki engine) o'zgartirish CloudFormation tomonidan **replacement** (yangi DB yaratish, eskisini o'chirish) deb talqin qilinadi — prod ma'lumot yo'qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```json
{"Statement":[
  {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"Update:*","Principal":"*","Resource":"*"},
  {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["Update:Replace","Update:Delete"],"Principal":"*",
   "Resource":"LogicalResourceId/ProdDatabase"}
]}
```
```
update-stack -> change set: ProdDatabase  Replacement: True
   v stack policy tekshiruvi
DENY -> update muvaffaqiyatsiz, stack rollback, DB o'zgarmaydi
Ataylab o'zgartirish kerak bo'lsa: --stack-policy-during-update-body (vaqtinchalik override)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws cloudformation set-stack-policy --stack-name prod-db --stack-policy-body file://policy.json
aws cloudformation create-change-set --stack-name prod-db --change-set-name c1 --template-body file://t.yml
aws cloudformation describe-change-set --stack-name prod-db --change-set-name c1 \
  --query 'Changes[].ResourceChange.[LogicalResourceId,Action,Replacement]'
```

**Bog'liq himoyalar:**
| Mexanizm | Nimadan himoya |
|---|---|
| Stack policy | Stack update paytida o'zgartirish/almashtirish |
| `DeletionPolicy: Retain/Snapshot` | Stack yoki resurs o'chirilganda ma'lumot yo'qolishi |
| `UpdateReplacePolicy` | Replacement'da eski resursni saqlash |
| Termination protection | Butun stack'ni o'chirish |
| RDS deletion protection | Resursning o'zini o'chirish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Stack policy'ni stack'ni o'chirishdan himoya deb o'ylash — yo'q, termination protection va DeletionPolicy kerak.
- Change set'ni ko'rmasdan update — "Replacement: True"ni o'tkazib yuborish.
- Policy'ni hech qachon vaqtincha override qilmaslik kerak deb, kerakli o'zgarishni konsoldan qilish (drift).

**Senior nuqta:** Stateful resurslar (DB, bucket) uchun himoya qatlamlari birga: DeletionPolicy + deletion protection + stack policy + change set review. Ko'p jamoalar stateful resurslarni alohida, kam o'zgaradigan stack'ga ajratadi.

40990.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CloudFormation **modules** — bir nechta resursdan iborat standart konfiguratsiyani (masalan "shifrlangan, versioning yoqilgan, public access bloklangan S3 bucket + bucket policy") CloudFormation Registry'da `Organization::Service::Name::MODULE` turi sifatida ro'yxatdan o'tkazib, template'larda **oddiy resurs kabi** qayta ishlatish. Deploy paytida modul ichidagi resurslarga ochiladi.

**Muammo:** 50 jamoa har biri S3 bucket'ni o'zicha yozadi: kimdir shifrlashni unutadi, kimdir public access'ni ochiq qoldiradi. Copy-paste snippet'lar vaqt o'tib bir-biridan farqlanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Platform jamoa: module "Acme::S3::SecureBucket::MODULE" (fragment template + parametrlar)
   v cfn submit (Registry, StackSets/RAM orqali org bo'ylab)
Jamoa template:
  Resources:
    Data:
      Type: Acme::S3::SecureBucket::MODULE
      Properties: {BucketName: team-a-data}
   v deploy
Stack'da: DataBucket, DataBucketPolicy (ochilgan resurslar, logical ID prefiks bilan)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
cfn init     # module turini tanlash
cfn submit --set-default
aws cloudformation describe-type --type MODULE --type-name Acme::S3::SecureBucket::MODULE
```
2025'dan CloudFormation CLI'da **local modules** (Rain/`aws cloudformation package` uslubida, registry'siz) ham rivojlangan — fayl orqali modul ishlatish.

**Muqobillar:** CDK constructs (dasturlash tilida qayta ishlatish), Terraform modules, Service Catalog products, CloudFormation Guard bilan siyosat tekshiruvi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Modul yangilanishi barcha foydalanuvchilarga keyingi deploy'da ta'sir qiladi — versiyalash va changelog kerak.
- Modul ichidagi logical ID'lar o'zgarsa — resurslar almashtiriladi (replacement).
- Faqat modul bilan "majburlash" — jamoa uni chetlab o'tib oddiy resurs yozishi mumkin; CloudFormation Hooks yoki Guard bilan siyosatni majburla.

**Senior nuqta:** Qayta ishlatish (module) va majburlash (Hooks/SCP/Guard) — ikki xil vosita. "Golden path" modul yaxshi standart beradi, lekin xavfsizlik invariantlari policy bilan himoyalanishi kerak.

40991.a:
**Qisqa javob:** IAM Roles Anywhere — AWS **tashqarisidagi** workload'lar (on-prem serverlar, boshqa cloud'dagi VM/pod'lar, CI agent'lar) **X.509 sertifikat** bilan autentifikatsiya qilib, STS orqali **vaqtinchalik** IAM role credential olishi. Uzoq muddatli access key kerak emas.

**Muammo:** On-prem backup serveri S3'ga yozadi — buning uchun IAM user access key diskda yillab yotadi. U oqib ketsa yoki rotatsiya unutilsa — jiddiy xavf. On-prem'da allaqachon PKI (ichki CA) bor.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Trust anchor: sizning CA (AWS Private CA yoki tashqi CA sertifikati)
Profile:      qaysi role'lar, session davomiyligi
Role trust policy: Principal rolesanywhere.amazonaws.com + sertifikat atributlari sharti
   v
On-prem server: sertifikat + private key
   aws_signing_helper credential-process --certificate ... --private-key ... \
     --trust-anchor-arn ... --profile-arn ... --role-arn ...
   v CreateSession (sertifikat bilan imzolangan)
STS vaqtinchalik credential (1 soat) -> AWS CLI/SDK odatdagidek ishlaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```ini
# ~/.aws/config
[profile backup]
credential_process = aws_signing_helper credential-process \
  --certificate /etc/pki/backup.crt --private-key /etc/pki/backup.key \
  --trust-anchor-arn arn:aws:rolesanywhere:eu-central-1:111:trust-anchor/ta-1 \
  --profile-arn arn:aws:rolesanywhere:eu-central-1:111:profile/p-1 \
  --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/onprem-backup
```
```json
"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:PrincipalTag/x509Subject/CN":"backup01.corp.local"}}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trust policy'da sertifikat atributi sharti yo'q — CA chiqargan **har qanday** sertifikat role'ni ola oladi.
- Private key diskda ochiq — access key bilan bir xil xavf; TPM/HSM yoki PKCS#11 ishlat.
- Sertifikat revocation (CRL) sozlanmagan — o'g'irlangan sertifikat muddati tugaguncha ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Kubernetes yoki GitHub Actions kabi OIDC beradigan tizimlarda OIDC federation soddaroq; Roles Anywhere — PKI mavjud bo'lgan serverlar uchun "nol statik kalit" yo'li.

40992.a:
**Qisqa javob:** VPC Traffic Mirroring — Nitro instance'lar ENI'laridagi **to'liq paketlarni (payload bilan)** nusxalab, VXLAN orqali tahlil qiluvchi target'ga (IDS/IPS appliance, NLB yoki Gateway Load Balancer ortidagi monitoring fleet) yuboradi. Filter'lar bilan faqat kerakli trafik (port, protokol, yo'nalish) nusxalanadi.

**Muammo:** Flow Logs faqat metadata beradi ("kim kim bilan gaplashdi"). Hujumni aniqlash (exploit payload, zararli fayl uzatish) yoki ilova protokol muammosini tahlil qilish uchun paket ichini ko'rish kerak — instance'ga agent o'rnatmasdan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Source ENI (prod web)  --mirror session (filter: tcp 80,443 kiruvchi)-->  VXLAN (UDP 4789)
                                                                           v
                                    Target: NLB / GWLB -> Suricata / Zeek / Wireshark fleet
Original trafik o'zgarmaydi; nusxa alohida ketadi (instance bandwidth'idan ulush oladi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-traffic-mirror-target --network-load-balancer-arn arn:...:loadbalancer/net/ids/abc
aws ec2 create-traffic-mirror-filter --description web-in
aws ec2 create-traffic-mirror-filter-rule --traffic-mirror-filter-id tmf-1 --traffic-direction ingress \
  --rule-number 100 --rule-action accept --protocol 6 --destination-port-range FromPort=443,ToPort=443 \
  --source-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0
aws ec2 create-traffic-mirror-session --network-interface-id eni-0web --traffic-mirror-target-id tmt-1 \
  --traffic-mirror-filter-id tmf-1 --session-number 1 --packet-length 256   # faqat header'lar
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- TLS shifrlangan trafik — payload ko'rinmaydi; faqat SNI/sertifikat metadata yoki TLS terminatsiya nuqtasida mirroring.
- Barcha trafikni nusxalash — instance tarmog'i va target fleet yuklanadi, narx (session soatbay) oshadi.
- Nitro'ga asoslanmagan yoki ba'zi kichik instance turlari qo'llab-quvvatlanmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Mirroring — maqsadli vosita (yuqori xavfli segment, incident tekshiruvi), hamma joyga emas. Zamonaviy alternativa — eBPF asosidagi host/pod darajasidagi kuzatuv (Cilium Hubble, Falco).

40993.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AWS Verified Access — ichki web ilovalar (va 2024'dan TCP resurslar: SSH, RDP, DB) uchun **VPN'siz zero-trust kirish**: har so'rov foydalanuvchi **identity**si (IAM Identity Center yoki OIDC IdP — Okta, Entra) va **qurilma holati** (CrowdStrike, Jamf, JumpCloud signallari) asosida Cedar policy bilan baholanadi.

**Muammo:** VPN bir marta ulangach butun ichki tarmoqqa kirish beradi; buzilgan noutbuk orqali hujumchi lateral harakat qiladi. VPN konsentrator'lar tor joy va foydalanuvchi uchun noqulay.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
User (brauzer) -> https://admin.corp.example.com
   v
Verified Access endpoint
   trust provider 1: IdP (user, guruh, MFA)
   trust provider 2: device (EDR: OS patch, disk shifrlash, risk score)
   Cedar policy: permit when context.idp.groups.contains("ops")
                       && context.crowdstrike.assessment.overall > 50;
   v ruxsat
Ichki ALB / ENI (private) -> ilova
Har so'rov log'lanadi (kim, qaysi qurilma, qaror)
```

**Amalda:**
```cedar
permit(principal, action, resource)
when {
  context.oidc.groups has "admins" &&
  context.oidc.email.address like "*@corp.example.com" &&
  context.jamf.risk == "LOW"
};
```
```bash
aws ec2 describe-verified-access-instances
aws ec2 describe-verified-access-endpoints --query 'VerifiedAccessEndpoints[].[EndpointDomain,Status.Code]'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat identity tekshirib, qurilma signalini qo'shmaslik — buzilgan qurilmadan to'g'ri parol bilan kirish mumkin.
- Ilova ichida qo'shimcha authorization yo'q — Verified Access'dan o'tgan har kim hamma narsani qiladi.
- Narx endpoint-soat va ulanish bo'yicha — kam ishlatiladigan ko'p ilovada hisobla.

**Senior nuqta:** Zero-trust kirish — "tarmoqda bo'lish = ishonch" modelidan voz kechish. Muqobillar: Cloudflare Access, Zscaler, Google BeyondCorp. Asosiysi — identity + qurilma + har so'rov bo'yicha qaror va log.

40994.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GuardDuty EKS Protection ikki qismdan iborat: **EKS Audit Log Monitoring** — K8s API audit log'larini tahlil qiladi (anonim kirish, shubhali `exec`, privileged pod yaratish, RBAC eskalatsiya); **Runtime Monitoring** (EKS, ECS, EC2) — node'larga eBPF agent qo'yib, container ichidagi jarayon, fayl va tarmoq xulqini kuzatadi (kripto-mayner, reverse shell, container escape urinishlari).

**Muammo:** Klasterda buzilgan pod kripto-mayner ishlatadi yoki service account token bilan API'ga hujum qiladi. Oddiy metrikalar faqat "CPU baland" deydi; kim va nima qilayotganini ko'rsatmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
EKS control plane audit log (GuardDuty mustaqil oqim oladi, sizning logging sozlamangizdan qat'i nazar)
   + Runtime agent (DaemonSet, EKS add-on) -> process/file/network event'lari
   + VPC Flow Logs, DNS log'lar, threat intel
   v ML + qoidalar
Finding misollari:
  PrivilegeEscalation:Kubernetes/PrivilegedContainer
  Execution:Kubernetes/ExecInKubeSystemPod
  CryptoCurrency:Runtime/BitcoinTool.B
  Execution:Runtime/ReverseShell
   v
Security Hub / EventBridge -> Lambda (pod'ni izolyatsiya: NetworkPolicy deny, node cordon)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws guardduty update-detector --detector-id <id> --features \
  '[{"Name":"EKS_AUDIT_LOGS","Status":"ENABLED"},
    {"Name":"RUNTIME_MONITORING","Status":"ENABLED",
     "AdditionalConfiguration":[{"Name":"EKS_ADDON_MANAGEMENT","Status":"ENABLED"}]}]'
aws guardduty list-findings --detector-id <id> \
  --finding-criteria '{"Criterion":{"resource.resourceType":{"Eq":["EKSCluster"]}}}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Runtime agent'i ba'zi node'larda (Fargate, Bottlerocket eski versiya) o'rnatilmagan — qamrovni tekshir.
- Finding'lar keladi, lekin javob runbook'i yo'q — aniqlash qiymati yo'qoladi.
- Faqat aniqlashga tayanish — profilaktika (Pod Security Standards, least privilege RBAC, image skan) asosiy.

**Senior nuqta:** Aniqlash va javob avtomatlashtirilgan bo'lsin: yuqori jiddiylikdagi finding -> pod'ni karantin (label + deny NetworkPolicy) va forensic uchun node snapshot, keyin odam tekshiradi.

40995.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Amazon Detective — CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, GuardDuty finding'lari, EKS audit log'lari va Security Hub ma'lumotlaridan avtomatik **behavior graph** quradi va ML bilan tahlil qilib, xavfsizlik hodisasini **tekshirish (investigation)** — "nima bo'ldi, qachondan beri, ta'sir doirasi qanday" — savollariga vizual javob beradi. Aniqlash emas, tergov vositasi.

**Muammo:** GuardDuty "role X g'ayrioddiy IP'dan API chaqirdi" deydi. Analitik keyin soatlab CloudTrail'da Athena so'rovlari yozadi: bu role yana nima qildi? Bu IP boshqa nimalarga ulangan? Odatiy xulqi qanday edi?

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Manbalar (avtomatik, 1 yilgacha tarix) -> Behavior graph
  entity'lar: IAM role, user, EC2, IP, EKS pod, S3 bucket
  aloqalar:   role -> API chaqiruvlari -> resurslar;  IP -> instance'lar
   v
GuardDuty finding'dan "Investigate in Detective":
  - role'ning odatiy faolligi vs hodisa vaqti (baseline bilan solishtirish)
  - yangi geolokatsiya, yangi API'lar, yangi user agent
  - finding group'lar: bir hujumga tegishli bog'langan finding'lar
  - investigation summary (generativ AI bilan xulosa)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws detective list-graphs
aws detective start-investigation --graph-arn arn:aws:detective:eu-central-1:111:graph:abc \
  --entity-arn arn:aws:iam::222:role/ci-deployer \
  --scope-start-time 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z --scope-end-time 2026-10-03T00:00:00Z
aws detective get-investigation --graph-arn ... --investigation-id <id>
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Detective'ni incident boshlangandan keyin yoqish — tarix yo'q (u faqat yoqilgandan keyingi ma'lumotni yig'adi).
- Faqat bitta akkauntda — hujumchi akkauntlar bo'ylab harakat qiladi; org darajasida delegated admin.
- Narx ingest qilingan hajmga bog'liq — katta muhitda hisobla.

**Senior nuqta:** Detective "dalil to'plash" vaqtini soatlardan daqiqalarga qisqartiradi. Lekin javob jarayoni (playbook, containment qarorlari, kommunikatsiya) oldindan tayyor bo'lmasa, tez tergov ham yordam bermaydi.

40996.a:
**Qisqa javob:** KMS asymmetric keys — KMS'da yaratiladigan **RSA, ECC (NIST, secp256k1) yoki SM2** public/private kalit juftlari. Private key KMS HSM'dan **hech qachon chiqmaydi**; public key'ni yuklab olish mumkin. Ishlatilishi: raqamli **imzo** (`Sign`/`Verify`), **asimmetrik shifrlash** (RSA) va kalit kelishuvi (ECDH, `DeriveSharedSecret`).

**Muammo:** Kod imzolash, JWT imzolash, hujjat yaxlitligi yoki AWS'dan tashqaridagi tomon sizga shifrlangan ma'lumot yuborishi kerak — lekin private key'ni serverda faylda saqlash xavfli va auditlanmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Imzo:
  App -> KMS Sign(KeyId, digest, ECDSA_SHA_256) -> imzo
  Tekshiruvchi (AWS tashqarisida): public key bilan lokal Verify (KMS'siz)

Shifrlash:
  Tashqi tomon: public key (yuklab olingan) bilan RSA-OAEP shifrlaydi
  App -> KMS Decrypt(ciphertext) -> plaintext   (CloudTrail'da audit)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws kms create-key --key-spec ECC_NIST_P256 --key-usage SIGN_VERIFY --description "JWT signing"
aws kms get-public-key --key-id alias/jwt --query PublicKey --output text | base64 -d > pub.der
aws kms sign --key-id alias/jwt --message fileb://digest.bin --message-type DIGEST \
  --signing-algorithm ECDSA_SHA_256 --query Signature --output text
```

**Simmetrik bilan farq:**
| | Simmetrik (AES) | Asimmetrik |
|---|---|---|
| Tashqarida ishlatish | Yo'q (faqat KMS orqali) | Public key — istalgan joyda |
| Imzo | HMAC kalitlari | Bor |
| Envelope encryption | Asosiy usul | Kam ishlatiladi |
| Avtomatik rotation | Bor | Yo'q (qo'lda yangi kalit) |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Asimmetrik shifrlash bilan katta ma'lumot — RSA hajm limiti; envelope encryption ishlat.
- Avtomatik rotation yo'q — kalitni almashtirish rejasi (JWKS'da bir nechta `kid`) oldindan bo'lsin.
- Har JWT uchun KMS `Sign` — yuqori RPS'da throttling va latency; quota'ni hisobla.

**Senior nuqta:** KMS bilan imzolash private key oqib ketish xavfini yo'qotadi va har imzo audit qilinadi. Yuqori hajmda esa KMS'da saqlangan kalit bilan qisqa muddatli imzolovchi kalitlarni chiqarish (key hierarchy) muvozanat beradi.

40997.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SQS **FIFO** navbatida `MessageDeduplicationId` — **5 daqiqalik** deduplikatsiya oynasi ichida bir xil ID bilan yuborilgan takroriy xabarlarni SQS qabul qiladi, lekin yetkazmaydi. Yoki **content-based deduplication** yoqilsa, ID xabar body'sining SHA-256 hash'idan avtomatik olinadi.

**Muammo:** Producer xabar yubordi, tarmoq uzildi, javob kelmadi — producer qayta yuboradi. Natija: navbatda bir xil buyurtma ikki marta, mijozdan ikki marta pul yechiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
t=0s    Send(body=order-77, DedupId="order-77")  -> qabul, navbatga
t=3s    Send(body=order-77, DedupId="order-77")  -> qabul (200 OK), lekin NAVBATGA QO'SHILMAYDI
t=6min  Send(..., DedupId="order-77")            -> oyna tugagan -> yangi xabar sifatida!
MessageGroupId: tartib va parallelizm birligi (har group ichida qat'iy tartib)
```

**Amalda:**
```python
sqs.send_message(QueueUrl=q_fifo, MessageBody=json.dumps(order),
                 MessageGroupId=f"customer-{order['customer_id']}",
                 MessageDeduplicationId=f"order-{order['id']}")
```
```bash
aws sqs create-queue --queue-name orders.fifo \
  --attributes FifoQueue=true,ContentBasedDeduplication=false,DeduplicationScope=messageGroup,FifoThroughputLimit=perMessageGroupId
```
High throughput FIFO rejimi (`perMessageGroupId`) bilan ko'p group'larda yuqori TPS.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Dedup faqat **producer tomonida** va 5 daqiqa ichida — consumer qayta ishlashi (visibility timeout tugashi) baribir dublikat beradi; consumer idempotent bo'lishi shart.
- Content-based dedup + body'da timestamp — har xabar "boshqacha", dedup ishlamaydi.
- Bitta `MessageGroupId` hamma xabar uchun — parallelizm yo'q, throughput juda past.

**Senior nuqta:** End-to-end exactly-once effekt uchun uch qatlam: producer dedup ID, broker dedup, consumer'da idempotency key (DB unique constraint). SQS dedup faqat birinchisini qisqa oynada hal qiladi.

40998.a:
**Qisqa javob:** EventBridge Pipes — **bitta manbadan bitta target'ga** point-to-point integratsiya: source (SQS, Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams, MSK/Kafka, MQ) -> ixtiyoriy **filter** -> ixtiyoriy **enrichment** (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, API destination) -> **target** (14+ servis: Step Functions, EventBridge bus, SQS, Lambda, ECS task, Kinesis...). Glue Lambda yozmasdan, batch, retry va DLQ boshqaruvi bilan.

**Muammo:** "DynamoDB'da yangi buyurtma bo'lsa, faqat `status=PAID` bo'lganlarini olib, mijoz ma'lumoti bilan boyitib, Step Functions'ni ishga tushir." Buning uchun odatda polling, filtr, chaqiruv va xato boshqaruvi uchun Lambda yoziladi va yuritiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Source: DynamoDB Stream (orders)
   v  batch, starting position
Filter: {"dynamodb":{"NewImage":{"status":{"S":["PAID"]}}}}    (filtrlanganlar uchun to'lov yo'q)
   v
Enrichment: API destination GET /customers/{id}  (sinxron)
   v  input transformer
Target: Step Functions (fulfillment workflow)
Xato: retry + DLQ (SQS)
```
Pipes vs Rules: Rule — bus'dagi ko'p event'ni ko'p target'ga (fan-out); Pipe — polling talab qiladigan manbadan bitta target'ga, tartib va batch bilan.

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws pipes create-pipe --name paid-orders \
  --source arn:aws:dynamodb:...:table/orders/stream/2026... \
  --source-parameters '{"DynamoDBStreamParameters":{"StartingPosition":"LATEST","BatchSize":10},
    "FilterCriteria":{"Filters":[{"Pattern":"{\"dynamodb\":{\"NewImage\":{\"status\":{\"S\":[\"PAID\"]}}}}"}]}}' \
  --enrichment arn:aws:lambda:...:function:add-customer \
  --target arn:aws:states:...:stateMachine:fulfillment --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/pipe
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Filter pattern manba event formatiga mos emas (masalan SQS'da `body` JSON string) — hech narsa o'tmaydi.
- Enrichment sekin yoki yiqiladi — butun pipe throughput'i tushadi; timeout va retry'ni sozla.
- Murakkab logikani enrichment Lambda'ga yig'ish — yana "glue kod"ga qaytish.

**Senior nuqta:** Pipes integratsiya kodini konfiguratsiyaga aylantiradi — kamroq kod, kamroq bug. Lekin biznes logika qayerda yashashini aniq ajrat: transport va routing — Pipes'da, qaror — servis kodida.

40999.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cost allocation tag'lar — resurslarga qo'yilgan tag'lar (`Environment`, `Owner`, `CostCenter`, `Project`, `Service`) **Billing konsolida aktivlashtirilgandan keyin** Cost Explorer, CUR va Budgets'da xarajatni guruhlash o'lchoviga aylanadi. Ikki turi: **user-defined** (siz qo'yasiz) va **AWS-generated** (`aws:createdBy`, `aws:cloudformation:stack-name`).

**Muammo:** Oylik hisob $400k. "Qaysi jamoa yoki mahsulot qancha sarflaydi?" degan savolga javob yo'q — natijada hech kim javobgar emas va optimallashtirish motivatsiyasi yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
1. Tag siyosati (standart kalitlar, ruxsat etilgan qiymatlar)
2. Majburlash: IaC default_tags, SCP/Tag Policy (yaratishda tag talab), Config required-tags
3. Billing -> Cost allocation tags -> Activate (faqat aktivlashtirilgandan keyingi xarajatlar tag'lanadi!)
4. Cost Explorer / CUR: group by tag:CostCenter
5. Tag'lanmagan xarajat -> Cost Categories qoidalari bilan (akkaunt bo'yicha) to'ldirish
```

**Amalda:**
```hcl
provider "aws" {
  default_tags { tags = { Environment = "prod", Owner = "team-payments", CostCenter = "CC-1042" } }
}
```
```bash
aws ce update-cost-allocation-tags-status \
  --cost-allocation-tags-status TagKey=CostCenter,Status=Active TagKey=Owner,Status=Active
aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-09-01,End=2026-10-01 --granularity MONTHLY \
  --metrics UnblendedCost --group-by Type=TAG,Key=CostCenter
```
Organizations **Tag Policy** — kalit yozilishi (`CostCenter` vs `costcenter`) va qiymatlarni standartlashtiradi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tag'ni aktivlashtirmaslik — resurslarda bor, lekin billing'da ko'rinmaydi; aktivlashtirish retroaktiv emas (cheklangan backfill imkoniyati bor).
- Hamma resurs tag'lanmaydi (data transfer, ba'zi umumiy xarajatlar) — akkaunt strategiyasi va split charge kerak.
- Kalitlarda case farqi — bir xil ma'noli ikki xil tag, hisobot bo'linadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Tag'lar — FinOps'ning "manba ma'lumoti". Maqsadli KPI: tag'langan xarajat ulushi > 95%; va har oy jamoalarga o'z xarajat hisoboti (showback) — xulq shundan o'zgaradi.

41000.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Sustainability — Well-Architected'ning oltinchi ustuni (2021): cloud workload'ning **atrof-muhitga ta'sirini** (energiya, uglerod) kamaytirish. Asosiy g'oya: kamroq resurs bilan bir xil biznes natija — yuqori utilization, keraksiz ishni yo'qotish, samarali hardware (Graviton, zamonaviy instance'lar), ma'lumot lifecycle'i va to'g'ri region tanlovi. AWS bu ustunda **shared responsibility**: AWS — "cloud'ning" barqarorligi, siz — "cloud'dagi" barqarorlik.

**Muammo:** Kechalari bo'sh turgan dev muhitlar, 10% CPU'dagi katta instance'lar, hech kim o'qimaydigan petabaytlab eski log'lar — bular ham pul, ham energiya isrofi.

**Dizayn tamoyillari va amaliyot:**
```
1. Ta'sirni tushun      -> Customer Carbon Footprint Tool, metrikalar (per request kWh/CO2)
2. Maqsad qo'y          -> "1000 so'rov uchun vCPU-soat" ni kamaytirish
3. Utilization'ni oshir -> rightsizing, autoscaling, Karpenter consolidation, serverless
4. Samarali tech        -> Graviton (~60% gacha kam energiya bir xil ishda), yangi avlod instance
5. Managed servislar    -> umumiy infra yuqori utilization bilan
6. Downstream ta'sir    -> klientga kamroq ma'lumot (siqish, cache), kamroq qayta hisoblash
Ma'lumot: lifecycle (S3 Glacier, o'chirish), dublikatlarni yo'qotish
Region: qayta tiklanadigan energiya ulushi yuqori region (latency/rezidentlik imkon bersa)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Dev muhitni ish vaqtidan tashqari o'chirish (EventBridge Scheduler)
aws scheduler create-schedule --name dev-stop --schedule-expression "cron(0 20 ? * MON-FRI *)" \
  --target '{"Arn":"arn:aws:scheduler:::aws-sdk:ecs:updateService","RoleArn":"...","Input":"{\"Cluster\":\"dev\",\"Service\":\"api\",\"DesiredCount\":0}"}' \
  --flexible-time-window Mode=OFF
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sustainability'ni alohida "yashil loyiha" deb, cost optimization'dan ajratish — ular ko'pincha bir xil harakatlar.
- Faqat hardware'ga e'tibor — eng katta isrof odatda bo'sh resurslar va keraksiz ma'lumot.
- O'lchovsiz maqsadlar — "yashilroq bo'lamiz" o'rniga proxy metrika (vCPU-soat, GB-oy per tranzaksiya).

**Senior nuqta:** Amalda sustainability va xarajat optimizatsiyasi 80% bir-biriga mos keladi: utilization'ni oshirish ikkalasini ham yaxshilaydi. Uni engineering KPI'lariga (unit economics) qo'shish eng samarali yo'l.

41001.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Container — host kernel'ni bo'lishadigan **oddiy Linux process**, faqat namespace'lar bilan izolyatsiyalangan (o'z PID, tarmoq, fayl tizimi ko'rinishi) va cgroup'lar bilan cheklangan. VM esa hypervisor ustida **o'z kernel'i bilan to'liq guest OS** ishlatadi. Tub farq — kernel umumiymi yoki alohidami.

**Muammo:** Bitta serverda 50 ta servisni izolyatsiyalash kerak. 50 VM = 50 kernel, har biri GB RAM va daqiqalab boot. 50 container = 50 process, MB va millisekundlar.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
VM:                               Container:
+-------+-------+                 +------+------+------+
| app   | app   |                 | app  | app  | app  |
| libs  | libs  |                 | libs | libs | libs |
| kernel| kernel|  <- har VM'da   +------+------+------+
+-------+-------+                 | container runtime  |
|  hypervisor   |                 | HOST KERNEL (bitta)|
|  hardware     |                 | hardware           |
```

| | Container | VM |
|---|---|---|
| Izolyatsiya | namespace/cgroup (kernel umumiy) | hardware virtualizatsiya |
| Start | ms | soniya-daqiqa |
| Overhead | MB | GB |
| Boshqa OS kernel | yo'q (Linux'da Linux) | ha |
| Xavfsizlik chegarasi | zaifroq | kuchli |

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run -d --name web nginx
ps -ef | grep nginx             # host'da oddiy process sifatida ko'rinadi
docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' web
ls -l /proc/<PID>/ns            # uning namespace'lari
uname -r; docker run --rm alpine uname -r   # bir xil kernel
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Container ichida root = xavfsiz" — kernel umumiy, kernel exploit host'ni buzadi.
- macOS/Windows'dagi Docker aslida yashirin Linux VM ichida ishlaydi.
- Container'ni VM kabi ishlatish (ichida systemd, SSH, ko'p servis).

**Senior nuqta:** Ishonchsiz kod yoki multi-tenant yuklama uchun container yetarli chegara emas — gVisor, Kata yoki Firecracker kabi sandbox/microVM. Ko'p cloud'lar ikkalasini birlashtiradi: microVM ichida container.

41002.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Namespace — kernel resursining **ko'rinishini** process uchun ajratadi. Linux'da 8 tur: **PID** (process daraxti), **NET** (tarmoq stack), **MNT** (mount'lar), **UTS** (hostname), **IPC** (shared memory, MQ), **USER** (UID/GID map), **CGROUP** (cgroup ko'rinishi), **TIME** (monotonic/boot vaqt ofseti).

**Muammo:** Ikki container ikkalasi ham 80-portni tinglashi, o'z `/` va o'z PID 1 ga ega bo'lishi, bir-birining process'larini ko'rmasligi kerak — bitta kernel'da.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
host:  PID 1 systemd ... PID 4312 nginx
           |
   container PID ns:  PID 1 nginx  (host'da 4312)
   NET ns: eth0 10.0.0.5  <-veth-> host docker0
   MNT ns: / = overlay merged dir
   UTS ns: hostname=web-1
   USER ns: container UID 0 -> host UID 100000
```
Process `clone()`/`unshare()` bilan yangi namespace oladi, `setns()` bilan mavjudiga qo'shiladi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
# docker'siz o'zingiz namespace yarating
sudo unshare --pid --fork --mount-proc --uts --net bash
hostname test; ps aux     # faqat bash va ps; PID 1 = bash
ip a                      # faqat lo (DOWN)

# ishlab turgan container namespace'iga kirish
PID=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' web)
sudo nsenter -t $PID -n ss -tlnp      # container tarmog'ini host tool bilan ko'rish
lsns -p $PID
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Docker default'da USER namespace'ni yoqmaydi — container root = host root UID 0.
- `--pid=host`, `--net=host` izolyatsiyani butunlay olib tashlaydi.
- Namespace resursni **cheklamaydi** — bu cgroup ishi.

**Senior nuqta:** `nsenter` — distroless container'ni debug qilishning eng kuchli usuli: host tool'larini container namespace'ida ishlatasiz. User namespace (rootless, K8s `hostUsers: false`) — container escape oqibatini keskin kamaytiradi.

41003.a:
**Qisqa javob:** cgroups (control groups) — process guruhlari uchun CPU, xotira, I/O va PID **resurslarini cheklash va hisoblash** kernel mexanizmi. **v1** — har controller alohida ierarxiya; **v2** — yagona ierarxiya, to'g'ri page cache/writeback hisobi, PSI (pressure) metrikalari, xavfsiz delegatsiya. 2025-2026 da asosiy distrolar va K8s v2 ni default ishlatadi, v1 deprecated.

**Muammo:** Bitta container xotira oqishi bilan butun host'ni OOM'ga olib kirmasligi, CPU'ni yolg'iz egallamasligi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
v1: /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/docker/<id>/   /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/docker/<id>/  (alohida daraxtlar)
v2: /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-<id>.scope/
       memory.max   cpu.max   io.max   pids.max   memory.pressure
cpu.max = "50000 100000"  -> har 100ms da 50ms = 0.5 CPU
memory.max oshsa -> cgroup ichida OOM kill
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
stat -fc %T /sys/fs/cgroup        # cgroup2fs = v2, tmpfs = v1
docker run -d --name app --memory 256m --cpus 0.5 --pids-limit 200 nginx
CG=/sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' app).scope
cat $CG/memory.max $CG/cpu.max $CG/pids.max
cat $CG/memory.current $CG/memory.pressure
cat $CG/cpu.stat        # nr_throttled, throttled_usec
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Runtime limitni bilmasa host resursini ko'radi: eski JVM v2'ni o'qimaydi (JDK 15+ o'qiydi); Go 1.25+ faqat CPU limitidan GOMAXPROCS oladi, xotira uchun `GOMEMLIMIT` ni o'zingiz qo'ying.
- `memory.current` page cache'ni ham o'z ichiga oladi — "xotira to'lib boryapti" degan noto'g'ri xulosa.
- K8s 1.35 dan kubelet cgroup v1 node'da default ishga tushmaydi — eski node OS'larni yangilang.

**Senior nuqta:** v2 ning PSI (`memory.pressure`, `cpu.pressure`) — "ilova resurs kutib qolyapti" ning eng aniq signali, utilization'dan foydaliroq. `memory.high` (soft throttle) OOM'dan oldin yumshoq bosim beradi.

41004.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ikki qatlam: **high-level runtime** (containerd, CRI-O) — image pull/unpack, snapshot, tarmoq, lifecycle va API (CRI) ni boshqaradi; **low-level OCI runtime** (runc, crun, youki, gVisor `runsc`, Kata) — `config.json` ni olib, kernel bilan namespace/cgroup yaratadi va process'ni ishga tushiradi.

**Muammo:** "Docker" bitta narsa emas. K8s debug qilganda qaysi qatlam xato berayotganini bilish kerak: image pull xatosi (containerd) yoki `exec format error`/seccomp (runc).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
docker CLI --> dockerd --+
kubelet --CRI gRPC-------+--> containerd --> containerd-shim-runc-v2 --> runc --> process
                              (image, snapshot)    (har container)       (chiqib ketadi)
kubelet --CRI gRPC--> CRI-O --> conmon --> runc/crun --> process
```

| Qatlam | Misollar | Vazifa |
|---|---|---|
| CLI/orkestrator | docker, nerdctl, kubelet, podman | foydalanuvchi interfeysi |
| High-level | containerd, CRI-O | image, storage, lifecycle |
| Low-level (OCI) | runc, crun, youki, runsc, kata | namespace + cgroup + exec |

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker info | grep -iE 'runtime|cgroup'
crictl info | jq '.config.containerd.runtimes'     # K8s node'da
ctr -n k8s.io containers ls                         # containerd darajasida
pstree -p $(pgrep -f containerd-shim | head -1)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- K8s node'da `docker ps` bo'sh — kubelet containerd'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatadi (`crictl` kerak).
- `ctr` namespace'larini (`k8s.io`, `moby`) bilmaslik — "image yo'q" deb o'ylash.
- Low-level runtime'ni almashtirish (crun) seccomp/cgroup xatti-harakatida farq berishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** RuntimeClass bilan bitta klasterda turli low-level runtime'lar (runc oddiy, gVisor ishonchsiz yuklama uchun) ishlatish mumkin. Bu qatlamlarni bilish incident paytida to'g'ri log'ga (kubelet, containerd, shim) tez borishga yordam beradi.

41005.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OCI (Linux Foundation) uchta spec belgilaydi: **Image Spec** (manifest, config, layer formati), **Runtime Spec** (`config.json` + bundle va lifecycle: create/start/kill/delete), **Distribution Spec** (registry push/pull HTTP API). Shu tufayli Docker'da build qilingan image Podman, containerd, CRI-O'da ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** 2015 gacha Docker formati yagona vendor'ga bog'liq edi. Har tool o'z formatini o'ylab topsa — image'lar ko'chmas bo'lardi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Build (BuildKit/Buildah) --Image Spec--> manifest + config + layer tar.gz (digest bilan)
     --Distribution Spec--> registry (/v2/<name>/manifests/<ref>, /blobs/<digest>)
     --pull, unpack--> rootfs + config.json  (Runtime bundle)
     --Runtime Spec--> runc create / start
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# image'ni OCI layout sifatida ko'rish
skopeo copy docker://nginx:1.27 oci:./nginx-oci:1.27
cat nginx-oci/index.json | jq
# registry API bevosita
TOKEN=$(curl -s "https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:library/nginx:pull" | jq -r .token)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json' \
  https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/library/nginx/manifests/1.27 | jq '.manifests[].platform'
# runtime bundle
runc spec     # namuna config.json
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Docker v2 schema 2 va OCI media type'lari aralash — eski registry'lar OCI index'ni qabul qilmasligi.
- "OCI-compatible" deyilgan tool hamma spec'ni (masalan artifacts/referrers) qo'llashi shart emas.
- Image Spec v1.1 (2024) referrers API'sini registry qo'llamasa imzo/SBOM bog'lanmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** OCI standart bo'lgani uchun registry endi umumiy artifact storage: Helm chart, SBOM, imzo (cosign), Wasm. Tool tanlashda "OCI 1.1 + referrers" qo'llovi supply chain uchun muhim mezon.

41006.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `runc` — OCI Runtime Spec'ning reference implementatsiyasi, Go'da yozilgan CLI. `config.json` va rootfs'ni olib namespace, cgroup, mount, capability, seccomp'ni sozlaydi, process'ni `exec` qiladi va **o'zi chiqib ketadi** — container'ni shim kuzatib turadi.

**Muammo:** Kernel primitivlarini (clone, pivot_root, setns, cgroup yozish) to'g'ri tartibda va xavfsiz chaqirish murakkab; runc bu ishni hamma high-level runtime uchun bajaradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
runc create <id>  --> runc init (yangi namespace'larda), cgroup'ga qo'shiladi,
                      mount, pivot_root, capability/seccomp, kutadi
runc start <id>   --> foydalanuvchi process'i exec (PID 1)
runc state/kill/delete
```

**Amalda:** Docker'siz container:
```bash
mkdir -p mycont/rootfs && cd mycont
docker export $(docker create alpine) | tar -C rootfs -xf -
runc spec                        # config.json yaratadi (args: "sh")
sudo runc run demo               # ichida: ps, hostname
sudo runc list
```
`config.json` ichida `linux.namespaces`, `process.capabilities`, `linux.resources` ni ko'ring.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- runc CVE'lari (2019 CVE-2019-5736, 2024 "Leaky Vessels" CVE-2024-21626, 2025 mount race'lar) — host'ga escape; runc'ni yangilab turing.
- runc ko'pincha containerd paketi bilan keladi — containerd yangilansa ham runc eski qolishi mumkin.
- `crun` (C) tezroq va kam xotira, lekin xatti-harakat farqlari bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Node patch siyosatida runc alohida kuzatiladigan komponent bo'lsin (`runc --version`). Low-level runtime — host va container o'rtasidagi eng nozik nuqta; ishonchsiz yuklama uchun gVisor/Kata.

41007.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `containerd` — CNCF graduated high-level runtime: image pull, content store, snapshotter (overlayfs), container metadata va CRI plugin. `containerd-shim` (hozir `containerd-shim-runc-v2`) — har container (yoki pod) uchun kichik process: runc'ni chaqiradi, stdio va exit code'ni ushlaydi, container'ning parent'i bo'ladi. Shu tufayli containerd restart/upgrade bo'lsa ham container'lar ishlashda davom etadi.

**Muammo:** Agar container'lar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri daemon'ning child'i bo'lsa, daemon upgrade = hamma container o'ladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
containerd (daemon) --ttrpc--> shim (PID 1501) --> runc create/start --> exit
                                    |
                                    +-- child: app process (PID 1502)
containerd o'lsa: shim + app yashaydi; qayta start'da shim'ga qayta ulanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl status containerd
ps -ef --forest | grep -A2 containerd-shim
ctr -n k8s.io images ls | head
ctr -n k8s.io tasks ls
crictl ps; crictl logs <id>
cat /etc/containerd/config.toml | grep -E 'SystemdCgroup|snapshotter'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `SystemdCgroup = false` va kubelet `cgroupDriver: systemd` mos kelmasligi — node beqaror.
- containerd 2.x da config versiyasi va eski CRI sozlamalari o'zgargan — upgrade'dan oldin migrate qiling.
- Disk to'lishi: `/var/lib/containerd` dagi eski snapshot'lar; kubelet image GC chegaralarini sozlang.

**Senior nuqta:** Shim modeli — "daemonless runtime" g'oyasiga yaqin: control plane (containerd) va data plane (container) ajratilgan. Bu node agent'larini to'xtovsiz upgrade qilish imkonini beradi.

41008.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CRI-O — **faqat Kubernetes** uchun yozilgan yengil CRI runtime (Red Hat/CNCF). Versiyasi K8s versiyasiga mos keladi (1.33 <-> 1.33), Docker'siz OCI image'larni pull qilib, `conmon` + runc/crun orqali ishga tushiradi. OpenShift'da default.

**Muammo:** containerd umumiy maqsadli (Docker, nerdctl, buildkit ham ishlatadi). Faqat K8s node'i uchun minimal, K8s bilan qadamma-qadam versiyalanadigan runtime ham kerak edi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet --CRI gRPC (unix:///var/run/crio/crio.sock)--> CRI-O
    image: containers/image (Podman, Skopeo bilan bir xil kutubxona)
    storage: containers/storage (overlay)
    tarmoq: CNI
    --> conmon (monitor) --> crun/runc --> container
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl status crio
crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///var/run/crio/crio.sock ps
crictl images; crictl inspect <id> | jq .info.runtimeSpec.linux.namespaces
cat /etc/crio/crio.conf.d/*.conf
journalctl -u crio -f
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CRI-O minor versiyasini K8s'dan farqli qoldirish — CRI xususiyatlari mos kelmaydi.
- `docker`, `ctr` buyruqlari ishlamaydi — faqat `crictl`/`podman`.
- Registry sozlamalari `/etc/containers/registries.conf` da — mirror'larni u yerda qo'ying.

**Senior nuqta:** containerd va CRI-O orasida K8s uchun funksional farq kam; tanlov odatda distro/platformaga (OpenShift -> CRI-O, EKS/GKE/AKS -> containerd) bog'liq. Muhimi — node image'ni standartlashtirish.

41009.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Sandboxed runtime'lar container va host kernel orasiga qo'shimcha chegara qo'yadi. **gVisor** (`runsc`) — userspace'da Go'da yozilgan "application kernel" (Sentry) syscall'larni ushlab o'zi bajaradi. **Kata Containers** — har pod'ni o'z guest kernel'li yengil microVM'da (QEMU, Cloud Hypervisor, Firecracker) ishlatadi. Ikkalasi ham OCI runtime sifatida ulanadi.

**Muammo:** SaaS platforma mijozlarning ixtiyoriy kodini ishlatadi. Oddiy container'da bitta kernel CVE = boshqa mijozlar va host buziladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
runc:   app --syscall--> HOST kernel
gVisor: app --syscall--> Sentry (userspace kernel) --cheklangan syscall--> host kernel
Kata:   app --syscall--> guest kernel (VM ichida) --virtio--> hypervisor --> host
```

| | runc | gVisor | Kata |
|---|---|---|---|
| Izolyatsiya | namespace | syscall interception | VM |
| Overhead | ~0 | syscall/I-O og'ir ishlarda sezilarli | ~ boot + xotira |
| Moslik | to'liq | ba'zi syscall'lar yo'q | yuqori |

**Amalda:** K8s RuntimeClass:
```yaml
apiVersion: node.k8s.io/v1
kind: RuntimeClass
metadata: {name: gvisor}
handler: runsc
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: untrusted}
spec:
  runtimeClassName: gvisor
  containers: [{name: app, image: python:3.13-slim, command: ["python","-c","print(1)"]}]
```
```bash
docker run --rm --runtime=runsc alpine dmesg   # gVisor'ning o'z "kernel" xabarlari
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- gVisor'da I/O va tarmoq og'ir ilovalar sekinlashadi — benchmark qiling.
- Kata nested virtualization talab qiladi — ko'p cloud VM'larida yo'q yoki sekin.
- Sandbox = xavfsizlikning hammasi emas; tarmoq siyosati va IAM baribir kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** GKE Sandbox (gVisor), AWS Lambda/Fargate (Firecracker) shu g'oyani ishlatadi. Faqat ishonchsiz yuklamani RuntimeClass bilan sandbox'ga yuboring — hamma narsani emas.

41010.a:
**Qisqa javob:** overlay2 — Docker/containerd'ning default storage driver'i, Linux **OverlayFS** union mount'iga asoslangan. Bir nechta read-only image layer'lari (**lowerdir**) ustiga container'ning yoziladigan qatlami (**upperdir**) qo'yiladi va container birlashgan ko'rinishni (**merged**) ko'radi; **workdir** — atomik operatsiyalar uchun ichki joy.

**Muammo:** 100 ta container bitta 500 MB image'dan ishlasa — 50 GB nusxa emas, bitta nusxa + har biriga kichik yozish qatlami kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
merged/  (container ko'radi:  /etc/nginx.conf, /app/log.txt ...)
   ^
upperdir/  (RW: container yozgan va o'zgartirgan fayllar, whiteout'lar)
lowerdir/  layer3 (RO)  COPY app
           layer2 (RO)  RUN apt install
           layer1 (RO)  debian base
Fayl o'chirilsa -> upperdir'da "whiteout" (char device 0/0) yaratiladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run -d --name w nginx
docker inspect -f '{{json .GraphDriver.Data}}' w | jq
# LowerDir, UpperDir, MergedDir, WorkDir yo'llari
mount | grep overlay | head -1
docker exec w sh -c 'echo hi > /tmp/x'
sudo ls $(docker inspect -f '{{.GraphDriver.Data.UpperDir}}' w)/tmp
docker system df -v
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Container ichida katta yoziladigan ma'lumot (DB) upperdir'da — sekin va container o'chsa yo'qoladi; volume ishlating.
- Inode tugashi: ko'p kichik faylli image'lar `/var/lib/docker` da inode'ni yeydi.
- XFS'da `ftype=1` bo'lmasa overlay ishlamaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** overlay — read-mostly ish uchun optimallashgan. Yozish intensiv ish har doim volume'ga. containerd'da snapshotter'lar (overlayfs, stargz/SOCI lazy pull) image start vaqtini keskin qisqartirishi mumkin.

41011.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Copy-on-Write: image layer'lari barcha container'lar orasida **bo'lishiladi** va o'zgarmaydi. Container faylni birinchi marta o'zgartirganda, storage driver uni read-only qatlamdan container'ning RW qatlamiga **to'liq nusxalaydi (copy-up)**, keyin o'zgartiradi. O'qish uchun nusxa olinmaydi.

**Muammo:** Disk va page cache tejash, container'ni ms'da yaratish — buning uchun fayllarni oldindan nusxalamaslik kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
container A  RW: (bo'sh)          container B  RW: /etc/app.conf (copy-up qilingan)
                \                           /
              RO image: /etc/app.conf, /usr/bin/app (bitta nusxa)
B "echo x >> /etc/app.conf" -> butun fayl upper'ga ko'chiriladi -> keyin append
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run -d --name a ubuntu sleep inf
docker exec a sh -c 'dd if=/dev/zero of=/big bs=1M count=500'   # yangi fayl
docker diff a          # A /big, C /etc ... (A=added, C=changed, D=deleted)
docker ps -s           # SIZE: yozish qatlami hajmi (virtual = + image)
# 1 GB fayldagi 1 baytni o'zgartirish ham 1 GB copy-up!
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Katta faylga (DB fayli, log) birinchi yozish sekin va disk ikki baravar sarflanadi.
- `RUN chmod -R` yoki `chown -R` Dockerfile'da — barcha fayllar yangi layer'ga nusxalanadi, image ikki baravar kattalashadi (`COPY --chown` ishlating).
- Image'dagi faylni o'chirish image hajmini kamaytirmaydi — faqat whiteout qo'shadi.

**Senior nuqta:** CoW tufayli "bitta RUN ichida o'rnat va tozala" qoidasi bor. Ish vaqtida yoziladigan hamma narsa (cache, upload, DB) — volume yoki tmpfs; root fayl tizimini `--read-only` qilish xavfsizlik va performans uchun yaxshi.

41012.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Multi-stage Dockerfile — bir nechta `FROM` bosqichli Dockerfile: og'ir build stage'da compiler, SDK va dependency'lar bilan yig'asiz, oxirgi stage'ga faqat tayyor artefaktni `COPY --from=` bilan olasiz. Natija — kichik, kam CVE'li, build tool'larsiz production image.

**Muammo:** `FROM golang:1.25` + `go build` = 1 GB image ichida compiler, git, source kod va ehtimol `.netrc` secret. Pull sekin, hujum yuzasi katta.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
stage "build" (golang:1.25)  --> /out/app (statik binary)
                                     |  COPY --from=build
stage final (distroless/static)  <---+   ~15 MB
Build stage layer'lari yakuniy image'ga kirmaydi.
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM golang:1.25 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod go mod download
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \
    CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o /out/app ./cmd/api

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /out/app /app
USER nonroot
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]
```
```bash
docker build -t api:1 . && docker images api
docker build --target build -t api:debug .   # faqat build stage
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CGO yoqiq binary'ni `static` image'ga ko'chirish — `no such file or directory` (libc yo'q).
- Oxirgi stage'da CA sertifikat va timezone yo'qligi — TLS/vaqt xatolari.
- `COPY . .` ni dependency yuklashdan oldin qo'yish — cache har safar buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Multi-stage + BuildKit cache mount'lar = kichik image va tez CI. Test va lint'ni ham alohida stage qilib (`--target test`) bitta Dockerfile'da reproducible pipeline qurish mumkin.

41013.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Distroless image'lar (Google `gcr.io/distroless`, Chainguard) — faqat ilova va uning runtime bog'liqliklari (libc, CA sertifikatlar, tzdata) bor; **shell, package manager va OS utilitalari yo'q**. Natija: kichik hajm, kam CVE, hujumchi uchun foydali tool yo'q.

**Muammo:** `debian` base'da 100+ paket — skaner o'nlab CVE ko'rsatadi (ilova ularni ishlatmasa ham), hujumchi RCE topsa `sh`, `curl`, `apt` tayyor turibdi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
debian:12          ~120 MB, bash, apt, coreutils, ~100 paket
distroless/base    ~20 MB, glibc, ssl, tzdata, /etc/passwd (nonroot)
distroless/static  ~2 MB, faqat CA, tzdata (statik Go/Rust uchun)
Variantlar: :nonroot (UID 65532), :debug (busybox shell bilan)
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
FROM gcr.io/distroless/java21-debian12:nonroot
COPY app.jar /app.jar
ENTRYPOINT ["java","-jar","/app.jar"]
```
Debug (shell yo'q):
```bash
docker exec -it app sh          # ishlamaydi: executable file not found
kubectl debug -it pod/app --image=busybox:1.37 --target=app   # ephemeral container
docker run --rm -it --pid=container:app --network=container:app nicolaka/netshoot
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `RUN` buyrug'i shell form'da final stage'da ishlamaydi — hamma narsani build stage'da qiling.
- `ENTRYPOINT` shell form (`ENTRYPOINT java -jar`) — `/bin/sh` yo'q, start bo'lmaydi.
- Distroless "zaifliksiz" degani emas — glibc/openssl CVE'lari baribir bo'ladi; muntazam rebuild.

**Senior nuqta:** Distroless'ning eng katta qiymati — skaner shovqini kamayib, haqiqiy CVE'lar ko'rinadi. Debug amaliyotini (ephemeral container, nsenter) jamoaga oldindan o'rgating, aks holda "shell qo'shib qo'yamiz" bosimi paydo bo'ladi.

41014.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `ENTRYPOINT` — container'ning **asosiy executable'i** (doim ishlaydi). `CMD` — unga beriladigan **default argumentlar** (yoki ENTRYPOINT bo'lmasa — default buyruq). `docker run image ARGS` faqat `CMD` ni almashtiradi; `ENTRYPOINT` ni faqat `--entrypoint` bilan.

**Muammo:** Image "tool" kabi ishlashi kerak: `docker run mycli --help`, `docker run mycli migrate`. Agar hammasi `CMD` da bo'lsa, foydalanuvchi butun buyruqni qayta yozishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]   CMD ["serve","--port","8080"]
docker run img                 --> /app serve --port 8080
docker run img migrate up      --> /app migrate up        (CMD almashdi)
docker run --entrypoint sh img --> sh                      (ENTRYPOINT almashdi)
K8s: command = ENTRYPOINT, args = CMD
```

| Dockerfile | `docker run img` | `docker run img x` |
|---|---|---|
| faqat CMD ["a"] | a | x |
| faqat ENTRYPOINT ["e"] | e | e x |
| ENTRYPOINT ["e"] + CMD ["a"] | e a | e x |

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
FROM alpine:3.22
COPY entrypoint.sh /entrypoint.sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["serve"]
```
```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -e
[ "$1" = "serve" ] && ./wait-for-db.sh
exec /app "$@"        # exec — signal'lar /app'ga yetsin
```
```bash
docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Entrypoint}} {{.Config.Cmd}}' img
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Wrapper skriptda `exec` yo'q — shell PID 1 bo'lib SIGTERM'ni yutadi.
- ENTRYPOINT shell form'da bo'lsa CMD umuman e'tiborga olinmaydi.
- K8s'da `command:` yozib, ENTRYPOINT'ni bilmasdan almashtirish.

**Senior nuqta:** Qoida: ENTRYPOINT = "nima", CMD = "default qanday". Ikkalasini exec (JSON) formda yozing va K8s manifest'ida `args` dan foydalaning — image xulqi bashorat qilinadigan bo'ladi.

41015.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Exec form** (`CMD ["node","server.js"]`) — `node` to'g'ridan-to'g'ri **PID 1** bo'ladi va `SIGTERM` ni o'zi oladi. **Shell form** (`CMD node server.js`) — aslida `/bin/sh -c "node server.js"`; PID 1 = `sh`, u odatda signalni child'ga uzatmaydi, ilova graceful shutdown qila olmaydi va grace period'dan keyin `SIGKILL` bilan o'ldiriladi.

**Muammo:** Deploy paytida har pod 30 soniya "Terminating" da qotadi va keyin so'rovlar uzilib, 502 lar chiqadi — sabab ko'pincha shell form.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
shell form:  PID 1 /bin/sh -c "node server.js"
                  +-- PID 7 node   <-- SIGTERM yetib bormaydi
             docker stop -> SIGTERM -> sh (e'tiborsiz) -> 10s -> SIGKILL -> hammasi o'ladi
exec form:   PID 1 node  <-- SIGTERM -> process.on('SIGTERM') -> drain -> exit 0
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker exec app ps -o pid,args     # PID 1 kim?
time docker stop app               # ~10s = signal ishlanmadi; <1s = to'g'ri
```
```js
process.on('SIGTERM', () => {
  server.close(() => process.exit(0));   // yangi ulanish qabul qilmaydi, mavjudlarini tugatadi
});
```
Shell kerak bo'lsa (env kengaytirish): `CMD ["sh","-c","exec node server.js --port $PORT"]`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PID 1 bo'lgan process uchun kernel default signal handler'larni qo'llamaydi — ilova SIGTERM'ni o'zi tutmasa, exec form'da ham to'xtamaydi.
- `npm start` orqali ishga tushirish — npm signal'ni ishonchli uzatmaydi; `node` ni bevosita chaqiring.
- Exec form'da `$VAR` kengaytirilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Graceful shutdown zanjiri: exec form -> ilovada SIGTERM handler -> readiness `false` -> drain -> exit; K8s'da `preStop` sleep va `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` bilan muvofiqlashtiring. Zombie va signal uchun `tini`/`--init`.

41016.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Rootless rejim — container daemon'i (dockerd/podman) va container'lar host'da **oddiy foydalanuvchi** sifatida, user namespace ichida ishlaydi. Container ichida UID 0 bo'lsa ham host'da u imtiyozsiz UID (masalan 100000) ga map qilingan. Container escape bo'lsa hujumchi faqat shu user huquqini oladi.
