**Muammo:** Oddiy Docker'da `dockerd` root bo'lib ishlaydi; docker guruhidagi har kim amalda host root, va runc/kernel escape'i to'g'ridan-to'g'ri root beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
host user alice (UID 1000), /etc/subuid: alice:100000:65536
  podman (UID 1000) --user ns--> container UID 0  = host UID 1000
                                 container UID 1  = host UID 100000
tarmoq: slirp4netns / pasta (userspace), portlar < 1024 cheklangan
storage: fuse-overlayfs yoki native overlay (kernel 5.11+)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Podman — default rootless
podman run --rm alpine id            # uid=0(root)
podman unshare cat /proc/self/uid_map
ps -o user,pid,cmd -C sleep          # host'da alice ko'rinadi

# Docker rootless
dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install
export DOCKER_HOST=unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock
docker info | grep -i rootless
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- 80/443 portlar: `net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start=80` yoki yuqori port + LB.
- Tarmoq performansi (slirp4netns) sekinroq; `pasta` yaxshiroq.
- Bind-mount qilingan host fayllarda UID mapping tufayli ruxsat xatolari.

**Senior nuqta:** Rootless (daemon darajasi) va "container ichida root bo'lmaslik" (`USER 10001`) — ikki alohida himoya; ikkalasini ham qo'llang. K8s'da ekvivalenti — user namespaces (`hostUsers: false`, 1.33+ beta default yoqilgan).

41017.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Linux capabilities — root huquqini ~40 ta mayda bo'lakka ajratish: `CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE` (1024 dan past port), `CAP_NET_ADMIN` (tarmoq sozlash, iptables), `CAP_SYS_ADMIN` (mount, namespace va boshqa ko'p narsa — "yangi root"). Docker default'da ~14 ta capability qoldiradi; best practice — `--cap-drop=ALL` va faqat keraklisini qo'shish.

**Muammo:** Ilova faqat 443-portni tinglashi kerak, lekin buning uchun to'liq root berish — butun kernel API'ni ochadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
process -> bind(:443) -> kernel: CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE bormi? -> ha -> OK
Docker default: CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, FOWNER, FSETID, KILL, SETGID, SETUID,
                SETPCAP, NET_BIND_SERVICE, NET_RAW, SYS_CHROOT, MKNOD, AUDIT_WRITE, SETFCAP
Default'da YO'Q: SYS_ADMIN, NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE, SYS_MODULE ...
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run --rm --cap-drop=ALL --cap-add=NET_BIND_SERVICE -p 443:443 myapp
docker exec app grep Cap /proc/1/status
capsh --decode=00000000a80425fb        # bitmask'ni o'qish
```
K8s:
```yaml
securityContext:
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  capabilities: {drop: ["ALL"], add: ["NET_BIND_SERVICE"]}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Non-root user bilan capability qo'shish — ambient capability'siz ishlamaydi (K8s'da drop ALL + add kombinatsiyasi buni hal qiladi).
- `NET_RAW` default'da bor — ARP/ICMP spoofing; keraksiz bo'lsa olib tashlang.
- "Ishlamayapti — SYS_ADMIN qo'shamiz" — amalda privileged ga yaqin.

**Senior nuqta:** Pod Security Standards "restricted" profili `drop: ALL` ni talab qiladi — buni namespace darajasida majburlang. Capability so'rovi bo'lsa — aniq syscall/funksiya bilan asoslansin.

41018.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `--privileged` container'ga **barcha capability'lar**, host'ning barcha `/dev` qurilmalari, seccomp/AppArmor/SELinux o'chirilgan va `/sys` yozish huquqi beradi. Amalda bu host root: diskni mount qilish, kernel modul yuklash yoki cgroup orqali host'da buyruq bajarish bilan bir necha soniyada escape qilinadi.

**Muammo:** "Docker-in-Docker ishlamayapti" yoki "qurilmaga kirish kerak" degan sabab bilan `--privileged` qo'yiladi va unutiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (escape misoli):**
```
privileged container ichida:
  fdisk -l                      -> host diski /dev/nvme0n1p1 ko'rinadi
  mount /dev/nvme0n1p1 /mnt     -> host fayl tizimi
  chroot /mnt                   -> host'da root shell
  (yoki: echo ... > /mnt/etc/cron.d/x, ssh kalit qo'shish)
```

**Amalda:** tekshirish va alternativa:
```bash
docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.Privileged}}' app
kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged==true) | .metadata.namespace+"/"+.metadata.name'
# o'rniga: faqat kerakli qurilma va capability
docker run --device /dev/fuse --cap-add SYS_ADMIN --security-opt apparmor=unconfined ...
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CI runner'larda DinD uchun privileged — har pipeline host'ni egallashi mumkin; Kaniko/BuildKit rootless ishlating.
- Monitoring agent'lariga "qulay" deb privileged berish.
- `privileged: false`, lekin `hostPath: /` mount — xuddi shunday xavfli.

**Senior nuqta:** Privileged'ni Pod Security Admission (`baseline`/`restricted`) yoki Kyverno/OPA bilan bloklang, istisnolarni alohida namespace'da, ro'yxat va egasi bilan saqlang. CNI, CSI kabi tizim agent'lari ham ko'pincha capability ro'yxati bilan ishlay oladi.

41019.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Zombie (defunct) — ishini tugatgan, lekin parent'i `wait()` bilan exit status'ini **o'qimagan** process; u faqat process jadvalida PID egallab turadi. Container'da PID 1 odatda oddiy ilova bo'lib, yetim (orphan) process'larni reap qilmaydi — zombie'lar to'planib PID limitini tugatadi.

**Muammo:** Ilova har so'rovda `sh -c` yoki healthcheck skript chaqiradi. Bir hafta o'tib `fork: Resource temporarily unavailable` — PID'lar tugagan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PID 1 app (wait() chaqirmaydi)
  +-- PID 20 sh -c "curl ..."   --> tugadi --> <defunct>
  +-- PID 35 worker --> uning child'i 36 yetim qoldi --> PID 1 ga "meros" o'tadi
Linux'da yetim process namespace'ning PID 1 iga beriladi; u reap qilmasa -> zombie
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker exec app ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,cmd | awk '$3 ~ /Z/'
# STAT "Z" = zombie
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/.../pids.current
# Yechim:
docker run --init myapp          # tini PID 1 bo'ladi
```
Dockerfile'da:
```dockerfile
RUN apk add --no-cache tini
ENTRYPOINT ["/sbin/tini","--","/app"]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Zombie'ni `kill -9` bilan o'ldirib bo'lmaydi — u allaqachon o'lgan; parent'ni tuzatish yoki o'ldirish kerak.
- K8s'da `shareProcessNamespace: true` bo'lsa pause container PID 1 bo'lib reap qiladi — boshqa xulq.
- Zombie'lar xotira yemaydi, lekin PID va kernel task strukturasi egallaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p process ishga tushiradigan har container'ga init (tini, `--init`) standart bo'lsin. Yaxshiroq — bitta container'da bitta asosiy process va shell'ga chiqmaslik.

41020.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `tini` va `dumb-init` — container'da **PID 1** bo'lib ishlaydigan minimal init: ilovani child sifatida ishga tushiradi, kelgan signallarni (`SIGTERM`, `SIGINT`) unga **uzatadi** va yetim/zombie process'larni **reap** qiladi. `docker run --init` Docker'ga o'rnatilgan tini'ni qo'shadi.

**Muammo:** PID 1 kernel uchun maxsus: default signal handler'lar qo'llanmaydi va yetim process'lar unga tushadi. Oddiy ilova bu vazifalarga mo'ljallanmagan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PID 1 tini
  +-- PID 7 app
        +-- child'lar ...
SIGTERM --> tini --> app'ga uzatadi (dumb-init: butun process group'ga)
yetim tugadi --> tini waitpid() --> zombie yo'q
app exit code --> tini shu kod bilan chiqadi
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.13-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends tini && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/tini","--"]
CMD ["gunicorn","app:app","-b","0.0.0.0:8000"]
```
```bash
docker run --init --rm alpine sh -c 'sleep 100 & sleep 100 & wait' &
docker exec <id> ps -o pid,cmd     # PID 1 = /sbin/docker-init (tini)
```
K8s'da `--init` flag yo'q — tini'ni image'ga qo'shing.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ilova o'zi SIGTERM'ni ishlamasa tini ham yordam bermaydi — u faqat uzatadi.
- Shell wrapper + tini: tini -> sh -> app; sh signalni yutadi — skriptda `exec` kerak.
- `dumb-init` signalni process group'ga yuboradi — ba'zi ilovalar ikki marta signal oladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Go/Rust bitta binary, shell chaqirmaydi va SIGTERM'ni ishlaydi — init shart emas. Node, Python, shell skript va subprocess ishlatadigan har qanday image'da tini — arzon sug'urta.

41021.a:
**Qisqa javob:** BuildKit — Docker'ning zamonaviy (23.0+ dan default) build engine'i: Dockerfile'ni dependency grafiga aylantirib mustaqil stage'larni **parallel** bajaradi, keraksiz stage'larni o'tkazib yuboradi, **cache mount**, **secret mount**, **SSH forwarding**, remote/registry cache va multi-platform build'ni qo'llaydi.

**Muammo:** Eski builder ketma-ket ishlardi, har build'da dependency'larni qayta yuklardi, secret'lar layer'ga tushib qolardi va CI'da cache yo'q edi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Dockerfile --> LLB graf
  stage test ----\
  stage lint -----+--> parallel
  stage build ---/ --> final
cache: lokal / --cache-to type=registry / type=gha
RUN --mount=type=cache   -> build'lar orasida saqlanadigan papka (layer'ga kirmaydi)
RUN --mount=type=secret  -> faqat shu RUN vaqtida /run/secrets/...
RUN --mount=type=ssh     -> host SSH agent (private git)
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM node:22 AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm ci
RUN --mount=type=ssh git clone git@github.com:corp/private.git
```
```bash
docker buildx build --ssh default \
  --cache-from type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/corp/api:cache \
  --cache-to type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/corp/api:cache,mode=max \
  -t ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 --push .
docker buildx du        # build cache hajmi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `# syntax=` qatorisiz yangi frontend xususiyatlari ishlamasligi mumkin.
- CI'da ephemeral runner — cache export qilinmasa har build noldan.
- `mode=min` (default) faqat final stage cache'ini saqlaydi — multi-stage uchun `mode=max`.

**Senior nuqta:** CI build vaqtini qisqartirishning eng katta yutuqlari: to'g'ri layer tartibi + cache mount + registry cache. `docker buildx bake` bilan ko'p image'ni bitta deklarativ faylda parallel build qilish mumkin.

41022.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `docker buildx` bitta buyruq bilan bir nechta platforma (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`, ...) uchun image yasab, ularni bitta tag ostida **multi-arch manifest list (OCI index)** ga yig'adi. Yasash QEMU emulyatsiyasi (binfmt_misc), native builder node'lar yoki cross-compilation orqali.

**Muammo:** Jamoa Apple Silicon (arm64) da ishlaydi, prod esa Graviton (arm64) va x86 aralash. `amd64` image arm64 node'da `exec format error` beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t api:1 --push .
   amd64 builder --> manifest A (digest a1)
   arm64 builder --> manifest B (digest b2)
   index api:1 --> [{amd64: a1}, {arm64: b2}]
pull'da client o'z arxitekturasiga mos manifest'ni tanlaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run --privileged --rm tonistiigi/binfmt --install all   # QEMU
docker buildx create --name multi --use --bootstrap
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 --push .
docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4
```
Go'da emulyatsiyasiz tez cross-compile:
```dockerfile
FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.25 AS build
ARG TARGETOS TARGETARCH
RUN GOOS=$TARGETOS GOARCH=$TARGETARCH CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app .
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- QEMU orqali kompilyatsiya 5-20 baravar sekin — CI vaqti portlaydi.
- Multi-platform natijani `--load` bilan lokal docker'ga yuklab bo'lmaydi (containerd image store'siz) — `--push` kerak.
- Base image barcha platformani qo'llamasa build yiqiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng tez yo'l — `$BUILDPLATFORM` + cross-compile yoki har arxitektura uchun native runner (GitHub arm64 runner'lar) va keyin `imagetools create` bilan birlashtirish. arm64 (Graviton) ko'pincha 20-40% arzonroq — multi-arch'ga investitsiya o'zini oqlaydi.

41023.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Image manifest** — bitta platformadagi image'ni ta'riflaydigan JSON: config blob digest'i va layer'lar ro'yxati (digest, hajm, media type). **Manifest list / OCI image index** — bitta tag ostida bir nechta manifest'ni platforma (`os/arch/variant`) bo'yicha ko'rsatadigan yuqori darajali JSON.

**Muammo:** `docker pull nginx` Mac M3 va x86 server'da turli binary olishi kerak, lekin tag bitta. Shuningdek layer'larni qayta yuklamaslik uchun ularni digest bo'yicha aniqlash kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
tag nginx:1.27 --> index (sha256:aaa)
     +-- linux/amd64 --> manifest (sha256:bbb)
     |       config: sha256:ccc (env, cmd, history)
     |       layers: sha256:d1, sha256:d2, sha256:d3
     +-- linux/arm64 --> manifest (sha256:eee) --> ...
     +-- (attestation manifest: SBOM/provenance)
Hammasi content-addressable: digest = sha256(JSON yoki blob)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker buildx imagetools inspect nginx:1.27 --raw | jq '.manifests[] | {platform, digest}'
skopeo inspect --raw docker://nginx:1.27 | jq .mediaType
skopeo inspect --raw --override-arch arm64 docker://nginx:1.27 | jq .   # bitta platforma
crane manifest nginx:1.27 | jq
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Index digest va platforma manifest digest'ini chalkashtirish — imzo/pin noto'g'ri narsaga.
- BuildKit attestation'lari index'ga `unknown/unknown` platforma sifatida qo'shiladi — eski tool'lar chalkashadi.
- Docker v2 (`application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json`) va OCI media type'lari farqi.

**Senior nuqta:** Deploy'da index digest bilan pin qiling (`image@sha256:...`) — barcha arxitektura uchun o'zgarmas ma'lumot. Imzo va SBOM ham shu digest'ga referrers orqali bog'lanadi.

41024.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **bridge** (default) — container o'z NET namespace'ida private IP oladi, host'dagi Linux bridge (`docker0`) ga veth orqali ulanadi; tashqariga NAT, kirish `-p` port publish orqali. **host** — container host'ning tarmoq stack'ini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatadi (izolyatsiya yo'q, NAT yo'q). **none** — faqat loopback.

**Muammo:** Ikki container 8080 da tinglashi va bir-birini nom bilan topishi kerak (bridge); yoki maksimal tarmoq performansi kerak (host); yoki batch tarmoqsiz ishlashi kerak (none).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
bridge:
 container eth0 172.18.0.2 <--veth--> br-xxx (172.18.0.1) --iptables NAT--> host eth0
 -p 8080:80  --> DNAT host:8080 -> 172.18.0.2:80
 user-defined bridge: ichki DNS (127.0.0.11) container nomini resolve qiladi
host:
 container == host tarmog'i; app :80 = host :80
none:
 faqat lo
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker network create appnet
docker run -d --name db --network appnet postgres:17
docker run --rm --network appnet alpine ping -c1 db      # nom bilan topadi
docker run -d --network host nginx                       # host:80 band
docker run --rm --network none alpine ip a               # faqat lo
docker network inspect appnet | jq '.[0].Containers'
sudo iptables -t nat -L DOCKER -n
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default `bridge` tarmog'ida nom bilan DNS ishlamaydi — user-defined network yarating.
- `-p 5432:5432` barcha interfeysda (0.0.0.0) ochadi — `-p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432` yozing.
- Docker Desktop (Mac/Windows) da `--network host` boshqacha ishlaydi (VM ichida).

**Senior nuqta:** Prod'da DB portlarini publish qilmang — faqat ichki network. Host networking'ni faqat o'lchangan zarurat (yuqori PPS, multicast) bo'lsa ishlating — port to'qnashuvi va izolyatsiya yo'qligi narxi bor.

41025.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Docker Swarm** — Docker Engine'ga o'rnatilgan oddiy klasterlash: `docker swarm init`, Compose fayl bilan `stack deploy`, routing mesh, secret'lar; o'rganish oson, lekin ekotizim kichik va rivojlanishi sekin (Mirantis qo'llab-quvvatlaydi). **Kubernetes** — sanoat standarti: deklarativ API + controller'lar, HPA/autoscaling, kengaytiriladigan CRD/operator, boy storage/network ekotizimi, lekin ancha murakkab.

**Muammo:** 3 ta server, 10 ta servis va kichik jamoa — K8s ortiqchami? Yoki 200 servis, multi-tenant — Swarm yetmaydimi?

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Swarm: manager x3 (Raft) --> worker'lar; service = replicas + image; ingress routing mesh
K8s:   API server + etcd + scheduler + controllers --> kubelet'lar
       Deployment, Service, Ingress, HPA, CRD/Operator, RBAC, NetworkPolicy
```

| | Swarm | Kubernetes |
|---|---|---|
| O'rganish | soatlar | haftalar-oylar |
| Autoscaling | yo'q (tashqi) | HPA, VPA, Karpenter |
| Ekotizim | kichik | ulkan (Helm, operator, mesh) |
| Managed | deyarli yo'q | EKS, GKE, AKS |
| Kengaytirish | cheklangan | CRD + controller |

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker swarm init
docker stack deploy -c compose.yaml shop
docker service ls; docker service scale shop_api=5

kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml
kubectl autoscale deployment api --cpu-percent=60 --min=2 --max=20
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Swarm'da stateful yuklama va volume boshqaruvi zaif.
- K8s'ni "rezyume uchun" tanlash — kichik jamoada operatsion yuk mahsulotdan ko'p.
- Swarm'ni tanlab, keyin K8s'ga ko'chish narxini hisobga olmaslik.

**Senior nuqta:** 2026 da yangi loyiha uchun real tanlov odatda Swarm vs K8s emas, balki "managed PaaS (ECS/Fargate, Cloud Run) vs managed K8s". Swarm faqat juda kichik, on-prem va Docker'ni yaxshi biladigan jamoa uchun mantiqli.

41026.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `HEALTHCHECK` — Dockerfile instruktsiyasi: Docker Engine container ichida berilgan buyruqni muntazam bajaradi, exit 0 = healthy, 1 = unhealthy. Holat `docker ps` da ko'rinadi va Swarm/Compose `depends_on: condition: service_healthy` uchun ishlatadi. **Kubernetes uni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi** — o'z liveness/readiness/startup probe'larini ishlatadi.

**Muammo:** Process tirik (container "Up"), lekin ilova deadlock'da yoki DB'ga ulana olmayapti. Orkestrator buni bilishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
start --> start-period (60s: xatolar hisoblanmaydi)
har interval (30s): CMD timeout(3s) ichida
   exit 0 --> healthy
   exit 1 x retries(3) --> unhealthy
Docker o'zi restart QILMAYDI; Swarm qayta yaratadi, Compose depends_on kutadi
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=60s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["/app","healthcheck"]
```
(distroless'da `curl` yo'q — ilovaning o'zida `healthcheck` subcommand yaxshi.)
```bash
docker ps   # STATUS: Up 2 minutes (healthy)
docker inspect -f '{{json .State.Health}}' app | jq '.Log[-1]'
```
K8s ekvivalenti:
```yaml
readinessProbe: {httpGet: {path: /readyz, port: 8080}, periodSeconds: 5}
livenessProbe:  {httpGet: {path: /livez,  port: 8080}, failureThreshold: 3}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Health check tashqi bog'liqlikni (DB) tekshirsa — DB yiqilganda hamma container restart siklida (cascade).
- `curl` ni faqat healthcheck uchun image'ga qo'shish — hujum yuzasi.
- start-period yo'q — sekin start bo'ladigan JVM ilovasi doim unhealthy.

**Senior nuqta:** Liveness = "process tuzalmas holatdami" (faqat ichki), readiness = "trafik qabul qila oladimi" (bog'liqliklar bilan). Bu ikkalasini aralashtirish production'dagi eng ko'p uchraydigan o'z-o'zini DDoS qilish sababi.

41027.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Volume** — Docker boshqaradigan storage (`/var/lib/docker/volumes/`), nom bilan, container'dan mustaqil yashaydi, driver'lar (NFS, cloud) qo'llanadi. **Bind mount** — host'dagi aniq yo'lni container'ga ulash (dev'da kod uchun qulay). **tmpfs** — faqat RAM'da, diskka yozilmaydi, container to'xtasa yo'qoladi.

**Muammo:** Container o'chirilsa uning yozish qatlami ham yo'qoladi. Postgres ma'lumoti, dev'da jonli kod o'zgarishi va vaqtinchalik secret fayllari uchun turli yechim kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
volume:  pgdata (Docker) --> /var/lib/docker/volumes/pgdata/_data --> container:/var/lib/postgresql/data
bind:    /home/me/project --> container:/app        (host yo'li, host UID/ruxsatlari)
tmpfs:   RAM --> container:/run/secrets  (size cheklovi bilan)
```

| | Volume | Bind mount | tmpfs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Boshqaruv | Docker | siz (host yo'li) | kernel RAM |
| Saqlanadi | ha | ha (host'da) | yo'q |
| Portativ | ha | yo'q (host'ga bog'liq) | - |
| Ishlatish | DB, prod data | dev kod, config | cache, secret |

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker volume create pgdata
docker run -d -v pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:17
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app:ro -w /app node:22 node test.js
docker run --rm --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=64m,noexec alpine df -h /tmp
docker volume ls; docker volume inspect pgdata
# backup
docker run --rm -v pgdata:/data -v "$PWD":/bk alpine tar czf /bk/pg.tgz -C /data .
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bind mount bo'sh bo'lmagan papka ustiga — image ichidagi fayllar yashirinadi.
- `docker compose down -v` / `docker system prune --volumes` — ma'lumot butunlay o'chadi.
- Bind mount'da UID mos kelmasligi — `Permission denied`.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod'da DB'ni bitta host volume'ida ishlatish — o'sha host = SPOF; managed DB yoki replikatsiyali storage afzal. Read-only (`:ro`) va `noexec` opsiyalari arzon xavfsizlik qatlami.

41028.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Docker Compose — ko'p container'li ilovani (servislar, tarmoqlar, volume'lar, env, healthcheck, bog'liqliklar) bitta deklarativ **`compose.yaml`** da ta'riflab, `docker compose up` bilan ko'tarish vositasi. Compose v2 — `docker` CLI plagini (eski `docker-compose` v1 Python'da, deprecated). `version:` kaliti endi kerak emas.

**Muammo:** Lokal muhitda API + Postgres + Redis + worker kerak. Har birini uzun `docker run` bilan ishga tushirish, tarmoq va tartibni qo'lda boshqarish — xatoga moyil.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
compose.yaml --> docker compose up
   project tarmog'i <proj>_default yaratiladi (servis nomi = DNS)
   depends_on + healthcheck bo'yicha tartib
   volume'lar <proj>_pgdata
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
services:
  api:
    build: .
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:8080:8080"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:app@db:5432/app
    depends_on:
      db: {condition: service_healthy}
    develop:
      watch: [{action: sync, path: ./src, target: /app/src}]
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    environment: {POSTGRES_USER: app, POSTGRES_PASSWORD: app}
    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL","pg_isready -U app"]
      interval: 5s
volumes: {pgdata: {}}
```
```bash
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose ps; docker compose logs -f api
docker compose watch          # kod o'zgarsa avtomatik sync/rebuild
docker compose down           # -v qo'shsangiz data ham o'chadi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `depends_on` healthcheck'siz faqat start tartibini kafolatlaydi, tayyorlikni emas.
- Secret'larni `environment` ga yozib git'ga commit qilish — `.env` + `.gitignore` yoki `secrets:`.
- Compose'ni ko'p server'li prod orkestrator deb ishlatish.

**Senior nuqta:** Compose — lokal dev va integration test'lar (CI'da) uchun ideal; `profiles` va override fayllar bilan muhitlarni ajrating. Prod'ga yaqinlik uchun bir xil image'ni ishlating, faqat config farq qilsin.

41029.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kaniko (Google) — Dockerfile'dan image'ni **Docker daemon'siz va privileged'siz**, oddiy container (masalan K8s pod) ichida build qiladigan tool. Har instruktsiyani userspace'da bajarib, fayl tizimi snapshot'idan layer yasaydi va registry'ga push qiladi. Diqqat: Google 2025 da loyihani arxivladi; Chainguard fork'i davom etmoqda, ko'p jamoa BuildKit rootless yoki Buildah'ga o'tmoqda.

**Muammo:** K8s'dagi CI runner'da image build qilish kerak. DinD — privileged talab qiladi; host `docker.sock` ni mount qilish — host root'ni beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kaniko pod (executor image)
   context (git/S3/lokal) olinadi
   FROM base image --> o'z root'iga extract
   har RUN --> pod ichida bajariladi --> fayl tizimi diff --> layer
   --> registry'ga push (cache: --cache-repo)
Daemon yo'q, namespace yaratmaydi (shuning uchun privileged kerak emas)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: kaniko}
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: kaniko
    image: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:latest
    args: ["--context=git://github.com/corp/api.git#refs/heads/main",
           "--destination=ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4",
           "--cache=true","--cache-repo=ghcr.io/corp/api-cache"]
    volumeMounts: [{name: regcred, mountPath: /kaniko/.docker}]
  volumes: [{name: regcred, secret: {secretName: regcred,
            items: [{key: .dockerconfigjson, path: config.json}]}}]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kaniko container ichida root sifatida fayl tizimini o'zgartiradi — uni boshqa ish bilan bir pod'da ishlatmang.
- Ba'zi BuildKit xususiyatlari (`RUN --mount=type=cache`) to'liq qo'llanmaydi.
- Arxivlangan loyihada CVE tuzatishlari sekin — fork yoki alternativa tanlang.

**Senior nuqta:** 2026 uchun tavsiya: BuildKit rootless (`moby/buildkit:rootless`) yoki Buildah — yaxshiroq qo'llab-quvvatlanadi va cache kuchliroq. Asosiy printsip o'zgarmaydi: CI'da daemon socket va privileged yo'q.

41030.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Red Hat'ning daemonsiz uchligi: **Buildah** — OCI image **build** qilish (Dockerfile yoki skript bilan); **Podman** — container va **pod**'larni ishga tushirish, Docker CLI bilan mos (`alias docker=podman`); **Skopeo** — image'larni lokal yuklamasdan registry'lar orasida **inspect, copy, sync, sign/delete** qilish.

**Muammo:** Docker monolit daemon (root) — build, run va registry ishlarining hammasini bitta privilegiyali process orqali. Bu xavfsizlik va CI uchun noqulay.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Buildah  --build--> containers/storage --push--> registry
Podman   --run----> containers/storage --> conmon --> crun
Skopeo   registry A ---------copy (stream)---------> registry B
Hammasi bir xil kutubxonalar: containers/image, containers/storage
Daemon yo'q, rootless default.
```

| Tool | Asosiy ish | Docker ekvivalenti |
|---|---|---|
| Buildah | image build | `docker build` |
| Podman | run, pod, compose, quadlet | `docker run` |
| Skopeo | inspect/copy/sync | `docker pull`+`tag`+`push` (daemonsiz) |

**Amalda:**
```bash
buildah bud -t api:1 .                         # Dockerfile'dan
podman run -d --name api -p 8080:8080 api:1
podman pod create --name shop -p 8080:80; podman run -d --pod shop nginx
podman generate kube shop > shop.yaml          # K8s YAML
skopeo inspect docker://ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 | jq .Digest
skopeo copy docker://docker.io/library/nginx:1.27 docker://registry.corp/mirror/nginx:1.27
skopeo sync --src docker --dest dir nginx:1.27 ./offline
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Podman'da restart policy daemon'siz — systemd/Quadlet bilan boshqaring.
- Rootless podman bilan bind mount'da UID mapping muammolari.
- `docker-compose` uchun `podman compose` / `podman-compose` farqlari.

**Senior nuqta:** Skopeo — air-gapped muhitga image ko'chirish va registry mirror'larini sinxronlash uchun eng qulay tool. Podman + Quadlet esa bitta server'dagi container servislar uchun K8s'siz yengil, systemd-native yechim.

41031.a:
**Qisqa javob:** BuildKit **secret mount**: `RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci` va build'da `docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=$HOME/.npmrc .`. Secret faqat shu `RUN` davomida tmpfs'ga mount qilinadi va **hech qaysi layer'ga yozilmaydi**. `ARG`/`ENV`/`COPY` bilan secret berish — `docker history` va layer'larda qoladi.

**Muammo:** Private npm/pip registry tokeni yoki git kaliti build vaqtida kerak. `ARG NPM_TOKEN` bilan bersangiz, image'ni olgan har kim tokenni ko'radi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ARG TOKEN  --> image config/history'da ochiq      (YOMON)
COPY .npmrc + RUN rm --> oldingi layer'da qoladi  (YOMON)
RUN --mount=type=secret --> /run/secrets/<id> faqat shu RUN vaqtida, layer'da yo'q (YAXSHI)
RUN --mount=type=ssh --> host SSH agent socket'i forward (kalit image'ga kirmaydi)
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM node:22 AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci
# env sifatida ham mumkin:
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=gh_token,env=GH_TOKEN ./fetch-private.sh
```
```bash
docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=$HOME/.npmrc --secret id=gh_token,env=GH_TOKEN -t api .
docker history --no-trunc api | grep -i token     # hech narsa chiqmasligi kerak
```
GitHub Actions: `docker/build-push-action` ning `secrets:` maydoni.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret qiymatini `RUN echo $X > file` bilan faylga yozish — u holda layer'ga tushadi.
- Multi-stage'da ham `ARG` final stage'ga o'tmasa ham build cache/registry cache'da qolishi mumkin.
- Secret o'zgarsa BuildKit cache'ni bekor qilmaydi — kutilmagan eski natija.

**Senior nuqta:** Image'ni secret skaner (trivy `--scanners secret`, gitleaks) bilan CI'da tekshiring. Eng yaxshisi — build vaqtida umuman uzoq muddatli secret kerak bo'lmasin: OIDC bilan qisqa muddatli registry token.

41032.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Har Dockerfile instruktsiyasi layer va cache kalitiga ega. Builder har qadamda: oldingi layer bir xilmi **va** instruktsiya matni bir xilmi (`COPY`/`ADD` uchun fayllar checksum'i ham) — ha bo'lsa cache'dan oladi. Bitta qadam o'zgarsa, **undan keyingi hammasi** qayta bajariladi. Shuning uchun kam o'zgaradigan narsa yuqorida, tez o'zgaradigan pastda.

**Muammo:** Har kod o'zgarishida `npm ci` 3 daqiqa qayta ishlaydi — chunki `COPY . .` dependency o'rnatishdan oldin turibdi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
YOMON:                         YAXSHI:
FROM node:22                   FROM node:22
COPY . .          <- har safar COPY package*.json ./   <- kamdan-kam o'zgaradi
RUN npm ci        <- qayta!    RUN npm ci                <- CACHED
                               COPY . .                  <- faqat shu va keyingilar
```
`RUN` uchun faqat buyruq matni tekshiriladi: `RUN apt-get update` tashqi o'zgarishni sezmaydi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker build --progress=plain -t api . 2>&1 | grep -E 'CACHED|RUN'
docker build --no-cache -t api .                # hammasini qayta
docker build --no-cache-filter deps -t api .    # faqat bitta stage
```
CI'da cache saqlash:
```bash
docker buildx build --cache-from type=gha --cache-to type=gha,mode=max -t api .
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `RUN apt-get update` alohida qatorda — eski indeks cache'da qoladi; `update && install` bitta RUN'da.
- `.dockerignore` yo'q — `.git` o'zgarishi `COPY . .` cache'ini har safar buzadi.
- `ARG BUILD_DATE` ni boshida e'lon qilib ishlatish — har build'da hamma narsa invalid.

**Senior nuqta:** Cache — reproducibility'ga ham ta'sir qiladi: base image'ni digest bilan pin qiling va rejalashtirilgan `--pull --no-cache` rebuild'lar bilan xavfsizlik patch'larini oling. Cache mount'lar (`--mount=type=cache`) layer cache buzilganda ham paket yuklashni tejaydi.

41033.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `.dockerignore` — build context'dan (builder'ga yuboriladigan papkadan) chiqarib tashlanadigan fayllar ro'yxati, `.gitignore` sintaksisiga o'xshash. Natija: tezroq build, barqaror cache va `.env`, kalitlar, `.git` kabi narsalar image'ga tasodifan tushmaydi.

**Muammo:** `COPY . .` bilan 2 GB `node_modules`, `.git` tarixi va `.env` (prod parollari) image'ga kirdi; image public registry'ga push qilindi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
docker build .  --> context (butun papka) --> BuildKit
   .dockerignore filtri context yuborilishidan OLDIN qo'llanadi
   COPY . .  faqat filtrdan o'tganlarni ko'radi
```

**Amalda:**
```gitignore
# .dockerignore
.git
.github
node_modules
dist
coverage
*.log
.env
.env.*
!.env.example
**/*.pem
Dockerfile*
compose*.yaml
```
```bash
# context hajmini ko'rish
docker build --progress=plain . 2>&1 | grep 'transferring context'
# image ichida nima borligini tekshirish
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh api -c 'ls -la /app; ls -la /app/.env 2>/dev/null'
```
Har Dockerfile uchun alohida: `api.Dockerfile` + `api.Dockerfile.dockerignore`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `.dockerignore` faqat context ildizida ishlaydi — subpapkadagi fayl e'tiborsiz.
- Allowlist uslubi (`*` keyin `!src`) kuchli, lekin kerakli faylni unutish oson.
- `node_modules` ni ignore qilib, keyin host'dagi native modullarni kutish.

**Senior nuqta:** Allowlist yondashuvi (`*` + `!kerakli`) secret oqishiga eng chidamli. Bundan tashqari CI'da image'ni secret skaner bilan tekshirish — `.dockerignore` xato qilinsa ham ikkinchi himoya.

41034.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CSI (Container Storage Interface) — orkestrator (K8s, Nomad) va storage provayderi o'rtasidagi **standart gRPC interfeysi**. Storage vendor (EBS, EFS, Ceph, Portworx, NetApp) K8s kodiga tegmasdan driver yozadi; K8s `PersistentVolumeClaim` orqali disklarni yaratadi, ulaydi, kengaytiradi va snapshot oladi.

**Muammo:** Ilgari storage driver'lar K8s ichida (in-tree) edi — har bugfix uchun K8s release kutilardi va kod bazasi shishardi. In-tree driver'lar endi olib tashlangan/CSI'ga ko'chirilgan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PVC (10Gi, sc=gp3) --> external-provisioner --CSI CreateVolume--> controller plugin --> AWS API
Pod schedule --> external-attacher --ControllerPublish--> diskni node'ga ulash
kubelet --NodeStage/NodePublish--> node plugin (DaemonSet) --> format + mount --> pod
Qo'shimcha: resizer (ExpandVolume), snapshotter (CreateSnapshot)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata: {name: gp3}
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
parameters: {type: gp3, encrypted: "true"}
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
allowVolumeExpansion: true
reclaimPolicy: Delete
```
```bash
kubectl get csidrivers
kubectl get pvc,pv
kubectl describe pvc data-db-0     # Events: provisioning xatolari
kubectl get volumeattachments
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `volumeBindingMode: Immediate` — disk boshqa AZ'da yaratiladi, pod schedule bo'lmaydi.
- `reclaimPolicy: Delete` prod DB uchun — PVC o'chsa disk ham ketadi.
- CSI driver IAM ruxsati (IRSA/Pod Identity) yo'q — PVC `Pending`.

**Senior nuqta:** Stateful K8s'da muammolar ko'pincha CSI darajasida (attach timeout, AZ mos kelmasligi, multi-attach). StorageClass'larni platforma jamoasi standartlashtirib, VolumeSnapshot bilan backup'ni avtomatlashtirsin.

41035.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CNI (Container Network Interface) — container/pod uchun tarmoq interfeysi yaratish, IP berish (IPAM) va routing sozlashning standart spetsifikatsiyasi. Runtime pod yaratganda CNI plugin binary'sini `ADD`/`DEL`/`CHECK` buyruqlari bilan chaqiradi. Implementatsiyalar: Calico, Cilium (eBPF), Flannel, AWS VPC CNI, Azure CNI.

**Muammo:** K8s modeli: har pod o'z IP'iga ega, barcha pod'lar NAT'siz bir-biriga yetadi. Buni turli muhitlarda (bare metal, AWS, overlay) qanday qilishni K8s o'zi hal qilmaydi — CNI'ga topshiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet --> containerd --> pod sandbox (NET ns) yaratildi
   --> CNI plugin ADD (stdin: config JSON, env: CNI_NETNS, CNI_IFNAME)
       --> veth juftligi / ENI, IP (IPAM), route, (overlay VXLAN yoki BGP yoki VPC routing)
   <-- natija: IP 10.244.1.23
NetworkPolicy ijrosi ham CNI'da (Calico, Cilium); Flannel qo'llamaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ls /etc/cni/net.d/ /opt/cni/bin/
cat /etc/cni/net.d/10-*.conflist | jq
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=cilium
cilium status; cilium connectivity test
kubectl get pod -o wide        # pod IP'lari
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- AWS VPC CNI'da pod IP'lari subnet'dan — subnet kichik bo'lsa pod'lar `Pending` (IP yo'q).
- CNI'ni ishlab turgan klasterda almashtirish — deyarli har doim downtime va qayta yaratish.
- NetworkPolicy yozildi, lekin CNI uni qo'llamaydi — hech narsa bloklanmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** CNI tanlovi klaster hayoti davomidagi eng qiyin o'zgartiriladigan qarorlardan biri: NetworkPolicy, observability (Hubble), kube-proxy almashtirish (eBPF), IP rejasi. 2026 da Cilium amalda default tanlovga aylangan.

41036.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CRI (Container Runtime Interface) — `kubelet` va container runtime o'rtasidagi **gRPC API** (RuntimeService: pod sandbox va container lifecycle; ImageService: pull/list/remove). Shu tufayli K8s qayta compile qilinmasdan containerd, CRI-O yoki boshqa CRI-mos runtime bilan ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** Ilgari kubelet ichida Docker uchun maxsus kod (dockershim) bor edi; har yangi runtime K8s kodiga qo'shilishi kerak edi. CRI bu bog'liqlikni uzdi; dockershim 1.24 da olib tashlandi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet --gRPC unix socket--> CRI runtime
   RunPodSandbox   --> pause/sandbox + NET ns (CNI)
   CreateContainer / StartContainer
   StopContainer / RemovePodSandbox
   PullImage / ListImages
socket: /run/containerd/containerd.sock yoki /var/run/crio/crio.sock
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get nodes -o wide          # CONTAINER-RUNTIME: containerd://2.1.x
crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/containerd/containerd.sock version
crictl pods; crictl ps -a
crictl inspectp <pod-id> | jq .info.runtimeSpec.linux.namespaces
crictl logs --tail 50 <container-id>
crictl rmi --prune                 # ishlatilmagan image'lar
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `crictl` bilan container'ni qo'lda o'chirish — kubelet uni qayta yaratadi (desired state).
- kubelet va runtime cgroup driver'i (systemd vs cgroupfs) mos kelmasligi.
- Runtime upgrade'da CRI API versiyasi (v1) qo'llanishini tekshirmaslik.

**Senior nuqta:** `crictl` — node darajasidagi debug tool'i: kubectl ishlamay qolganda (API server yo'q) ham pod'larni ko'rish va log o'qish imkonini beradi. Incident runbook'ga kiriting.

41037.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Alpine** — `musl libc` + BusyBox + `apk`, ~5 MB, shell bor. **Distroless** — odatda Debian `glibc` asosida, shell va package manager **yo'q**. Alpine'da musl tufayli moslik muammolari (DNS, Python wheel'lar, performans) bo'lishi mumkin; distroless glibc bilan mosroq va hujum yuzasi kichikroq, lekin debug qiyinroq.

**Muammo:** Python ilova Alpine'da: `pip install` wheel topolmay manbadan kompilyatsiya qiladi (10 daqiqa), K8s'da DNS ba'zan g'alati ishlaydi. Yoki distroless'da muammo bo'lsa ichiga kirib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**

| | Alpine | Distroless (Debian) |
|---|---|---|
| libc | musl | glibc |
| Shell | ash (BusyBox) | yo'q (`:debug` variantda bor) |
| Paket menejer | apk | yo'q |
| Hajm | ~5-8 MB | ~2 MB (static) - 20 MB (base) |
| Python/Node native | musllinux wheel kerak | manylinux ishlaydi |
| DNS | musl resolver (search/ndots farqlari) | glibc resolver |

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run --rm alpine:3.22 ldd --version 2>&1 | head -1   # musl
docker run --rm python:3.13-alpine python -c "import platform;print(platform.libc_ver())"
# Go statik binary uchun ikkalasi ham mos:
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o app .   # FROM gcr.io/distroless/static yoki alpine
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- glibc uchun build qilingan binary'ni Alpine'ga ko'chirish — `not found` (aslida dynamic loader yo'q).
- musl'da `malloc` ba'zi yuklamalarda sezilarli sekin (Python, Rust) — benchmark qiling.
- Distroless'da `HEALTHCHECK CMD curl` — curl yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Statik Go/Rust -> `distroless/static` yoki `scratch`; Python/Java/Node -> distroless yoki `-slim` Debian. Alpine'ni tanlash sababi "kichik" bo'lsa — hozir distroless va Chainguard/Wolfi image'lar shu hajmda glibc bilan ham mavjud.

41038.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Quadlet — Podman'ga o'rnatilgan systemd **generator**: `.container`, `.pod`, `.volume`, `.network`, `.kube` deklarativ fayllarini o'qib, avtomatik systemd service unit'larini yaratadi. Container'lar oddiy Linux servisi kabi `systemctl` bilan boshqariladi — restart, bog'liqlik, log (journald), boot'da start.

**Muammo:** Bitta server'da 5 ta container servis kerak, K8s ortiqcha. `docker run --restart always` va qo'lda skriptlar — boshqarish, tartib va yangilash qiyin. Eski `podman generate systemd` deprecated.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
/etc/containers/systemd/web.container   (yoki ~/.config/containers/systemd/ — rootless)
   systemctl daemon-reload
   --> generator --> /run/systemd/generator/web.service
   systemctl start web --> podman run ... (conmon systemd ostida)
```

**Amalda:**
```ini
# /etc/containers/systemd/web.container
[Unit]
Description=Web API
After=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4
PublishPort=8080:8080
Environment=LOG_LEVEL=info
Volume=api-data.volume:/data
AutoUpdate=registry
HealthCmd=/app healthcheck

[Service]
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
```bash
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl start web
systemctl status web; journalctl -u web -f
/usr/libexec/podman/quadlet -dryrun        # generatsiyani tekshirish
podman auto-update                         # yangi image bo'lsa yangilash
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `[Install]` bo'limisiz boot'da start bo'lmaydi; `systemctl enable` generated unit'larda ishlamaydi.
- Rootless'da user log out bo'lsa servis to'xtaydi — `loginctl enable-linger user`.
- Fayl nomi xato yoki noto'g'ri papka — generator jim o'tkazib yuboradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Quadlet — edge/IoT va kichik server'lar uchun "K8s'siz GitOps": fayllarni Ansible yoki git bilan tarqatasiz, systemd ishonchli supervisor bo'ladi. `.kube` turi K8s YAML'ni ham ishga tushira oladi — keyin K8s'ga ko'chish oson.

41039.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Docker context — Docker CLI qaysi **engine/daemon** bilan gaplashishini nomlangan profil sifatida saqlash mexanizmi (lokal socket, SSH orqali masofaviy server, TCP+TLS). `docker context use` bilan almashtirasiz va keyingi barcha buyruqlar o'sha host'da bajariladi.

**Muammo:** Lokal, staging server va build server'da docker buyruqlarini ishlatish kerak. `DOCKER_HOST` ni har safar qo'lda eksport qilish va TLS sertifikatlarini boshqarish chalkash.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
docker CLI --> joriy context
   default  --> unix:///var/run/docker.sock
   staging  --> ssh://deploy@staging.corp   (SSH tunnel orqali remote dockerd)
   colima   --> unix:///Users/me/.colima/default/docker.sock
DOCKER_HOST yoki --context flag context'dan ustun
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker context ls
docker context create staging --docker "host=ssh://deploy@staging.corp"
docker context use staging
docker ps                          # staging server'dagi container'lar
docker --context default ps        # bir martalik
docker context use default
docker context inspect staging | jq '.[0].Endpoints'
```
Compose bilan: `docker --context staging compose up -d` — fayllar lokal, container'lar remote.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Context'ni unutib, prod'da `docker system prune` ishlatish — terminal prompt'ga joriy context'ni chiqaring.
- SSH context — remote'dagi docker guruhi amalda root; kirishni cheklang.
- `build` remote'da bo'ladi — butun lokal context tarmoq orqali yuboriladi (sekin).

**Senior nuqta:** Context'lar dev qulayligi uchun; prod deploy CI/CD va audit bilan bo'lsin, odam laptopidan emas. Docker Desktop alternativalari (Colima, OrbStack, Rancher Desktop) ham o'z context'ini qo'shadi — muammo bo'lsa avval `docker context ls` ni tekshiring.

41040.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Docker Content Trust (DCT) — `DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1` bo'lsa CLI faqat **Notary v1** (TUF) bilan imzolangan tag'larni pull/push qiladi va publisher'ni tekshiradi. Lekin bu texnologiya amalda eskirgan: Docker Hub DCT/Notary v1 ni bosqichma-bosqich to'xtatmoqda; zamonaviy standart — **Sigstore cosign** yoki **Notation (Notary v2)** bilan OCI imzolar + K8s admission'da tekshiruv.

**Muammo:** Registry buzilsa yoki tag ustidan zararli image push qilinsa, siz uni bilmasdan prod'ga olasiz. Imzo — "bu image'ni aynan biz build qildik" degan kriptografik isbot.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
DCT (eski): push --> Notary server'ga tag->digest imzosi (root/targets/snapshot kalitlari)
            pull --> imzo tekshiriladi, yo'q bo'lsa rad
cosign (zamonaviy): imzo OCI artifact sifatida registry'da, digest'ga bog'langan
            keyless: OIDC identity (GitHub Actions) + Fulcio sertifikat + Rekor log
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# eski usul
export DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1
docker trust inspect --pretty nginx:1.27

# zamonaviy (CI'da keyless)
cosign sign ghcr.io/corp/api@sha256:abc...
cosign verify ghcr.io/corp/api@sha256:abc... \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/corp/api/.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```
K8s'da: Kyverno `verifyImages` yoki Sigstore policy-controller bilan imzosiz image'ni bloklash.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tag'ni imzolab, deploy'da tag ishlatish — digest bilan pin qiling.
- DCT root kalitini yo'qotish — repo'ni tiklash juda qiyin.
- Imzo tekshirilmasa (admission policy yo'q) — imzolashdan foyda yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Imzo — supply chain'ning bir qismi: imzo + SLSA provenance + SBOM, va eng muhimi — admission'da majburiy tekshiruv. Yangi loyihalarda DCT emas, cosign/Notation ishlating.

41041.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OCI artifact — container image bo'lmagan har qanday narsa (Helm chart, Wasm modul, OPA policy bundle, SBOM, imzo, ML model) OCI manifest formatida, o'z `artifactType`/media type'i bilan **oddiy container registry'da** saqlanishi. OCI 1.1 `subject` maydoni va **referrers API** artifactni image'ga bog'laydi (masalan "bu image'ning SBOM'i").

**Muammo:** Helm chart'lar uchun alohida chart repo, imzolar uchun alohida server, SBOM uchun S3 — har biri uchun alohida auth, replikatsiya va retention.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
registry: ghcr.io/corp/api
  sha256:img   (image manifest)
     ^ subject
     +-- sha256:sig   artifactType=application/vnd.dev.cosign...  (imzo)
     +-- sha256:sbom  artifactType=application/spdx+json          (SBOM)
GET /v2/corp/api/referrers/sha256:img --> bog'langan artifact'lar ro'yxati
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Helm chart OCI'da
helm push mychart-1.2.0.tgz oci://ghcr.io/corp/charts
helm install app oci://ghcr.io/corp/charts/mychart --version 1.2.0

# ixtiyoriy fayl (ORAS)
oras push ghcr.io/corp/policies:v1 --artifact-type application/vnd.corp.policy policy.rego
oras attach ghcr.io/corp/api@sha256:abc --artifact-type application/spdx+json sbom.spdx.json
oras discover ghcr.io/corp/api@sha256:abc -o tree
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Registry referrers API'ni qo'llamasa — tool'lar "tag schema" fallback'iga o'tadi (`sha256-abc.sig` tag'lari).
- Registry retention/GC artifact'larni subject bilan birga o'chirmasligi yoki aksincha.
- Har registry ixtiyoriy media type'ni qabul qilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Registry — yagona "artifact store" bo'lishi auth, replikatsiya va air-gap'ni soddalashtiradi. Registry tanlashda OCI 1.1 + referrers qo'llovini talab qiling (Harbor, ECR, GHCR, ACR, Zot qo'llaydi).

41042.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Trivy** (Aqua, open source) va **Docker Scout** (Docker) — image layer'laridan OS paketlari (apk, dpkg, rpm) va til dependency'larini (npm, pip, Go module, Maven) inventarlab, CVE bazalari bilan solishtiradigan va qaysi versiyada tuzatilganini ko'rsatadigan skanerlar. Trivy qo'shimcha: IaC misconfig, secret, litsenziya, SBOM generatsiya.

**Muammo:** Image'da 300 paket bor; qaysi birida kritik zaiflik borligini va uni yangilash mumkinligini bilish kerak — har release'da avtomatik.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
image --> layer'larni ochish --> paket bazalari (/lib/apk/db, /var/lib/dpkg/status,
          package-lock.json, go binary buildinfo) --> SBOM
SBOM x CVE DB (NVD, distro advisories, GHSA) --> finding: CVE, severity, installed, fixed
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4
trivy image --format cyclonedx -o sbom.json ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4
trivy sbom sbom.json                         # keyinroq qayta skanerlash

docker scout quickview ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4
docker scout cves --only-severity critical,high ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4
docker scout recommendations ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4   # yaxshiroq base image
```
`.trivyignore` da sabab va muddat bilan istisno.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--ignore-unfixed` siz — tuzatib bo'lmaydigan yuzlab finding, jamoa skanerga ishonmay qo'yadi.
- Faqat build vaqtida skanerlash — ertaga chiqqan CVE ko'rinmaydi; registry'dagi image'larni muntazam qayta skanerlang.
- Statik Go binary'da faqat buildinfo bor — `-trimpath` va vendoring natijaga ta'sir qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng samarali CVE kamaytirish — skaner emas, minimal base image va muntazam rebuild. Skaner gate'i CRITICAL/HIGH + fix mavjud bo'lsa bloklasin; qolgani SLA bilan backlog'ga. VEX hujjatlari "ishlatilmaydigan" zaifliklarni rasmiy belgilaydi.

41043.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OCI `config.json` — **runtime bundle**'dagi deklarativ fayl: low-level runtime (runc) container'ni qanday yaratishni shundan o'qiydi — `process` (args, env, user, cwd, capabilities, rlimits), `root` (rootfs yo'li, readonly), `mounts`, `linux.namespaces`, `linux.resources` (cgroup limitlari), `linux.seccomp`, `hooks`. (Image config'dagi `config` JSON bilan adashtirmang — u boshqa narsa.)

**Muammo:** containerd/CRI-O sizning K8s pod spec'ingizni (`securityContext`, `resources`) kernel darajasidagi aniq sozlamalarga aylantirishi kerak — oraliq standart format shu.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod spec / docker run flags
   --> containerd (image config + flags birlashtiriladi)
   --> bundle/: config.json + rootfs/
   --> runc create --bundle bundle/
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
runc spec && jq '{args:.process.args, user:.process.user, caps:.process.capabilities.bounding,
  ns:[.linux.namespaces[].type], mem:.linux.resources.memory}' config.json
# ishlab turgan container'ning haqiqiy spec'i
crictl inspect <id> | jq '.info.runtimeSpec.linux.resources'
sudo cat /run/containerd/io.containerd.runtime.v2.task/k8s.io/<id>/config.json | jq .process.capabilities
```
Qisqa misol:
```json
{"process":{"args":["/app"],"user":{"uid":10001,"gid":10001},"noNewPrivileges":true},
 "root":{"path":"rootfs","readonly":true},
 "linux":{"namespaces":[{"type":"pid"},{"type":"network"},{"type":"mount"}],
          "resources":{"memory":{"limit":268435456},"pids":{"limit":200}}}}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Image config (`docker inspect` dagi Env/Cmd) va runtime `config.json` ni bir narsa deb o'ylash.
- `config.json` ni qo'lda o'zgartirish — keyingi restart'da containerd qayta yaratadi.
- Hook'lar (`prestart`) deprecated yoki o'zgargan — eski misollar.

**Senior nuqta:** "Pod'ga haqiqatan qanday cheklov qo'llandi?" degan savolga eng aniq javob — runtime spec. Security audit'da `crictl inspect` orqali capability, seccomp va namespace'larni tasdiqlash YAML'ga ishonishdan ishonchliroq.

41044.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Flatpak** va **Snap** — **desktop/CLI ilovalarni** turli Linux distro'larga tarqatish uchun sandbox'li paket formatlari (portal'lar orqali ruxsat, avtomatik yangilanish). **Docker/OCI container** — **server process'lari** va mikroservislarni ishga tushirish, orkestratsiya va deploy uchun. Hammasi namespace/cgroup kabi kernel primitivlarini ishlatadi, lekin maqsad va ekotizim boshqa.

**Muammo:** "GIMP'ni Docker'da ishlataymi?" yoki "API'ni Snap qilib deploy qilaymi?" — noto'g'ri tool tanlash.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**

| | Flatpak | Snap | Docker/OCI |
|---|---|---|---|
| Maqsad | desktop GUI | desktop + CLI + IoT/server daemon | server servislar |
| Sandbox | bubblewrap + portal'lar | AppArmor + seccomp | namespace + seccomp/LSM |
| Tarqatish | Flathub | Snap Store (Canonical, markaziy) | istalgan OCI registry |
| Runtime | umumiy runtime'lar (GNOME, KDE) | squashfs, core snap | base image |
| Yangilanish | foydalanuvchi/avtomatik | avtomatik (majburiy) | deploy orqali |
| Orkestratsiya | yo'q | yo'q | K8s, Swarm, Nomad |

**Amalda:**
```bash
flatpak install flathub org.gimp.GIMP
flatpak info --show-permissions org.gimp.GIMP
snap install lxd; snap connections lxd
docker run -d -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Snap'ning majburiy avtomatik yangilanishi — server'da kutilmagan restart (`snap refresh --hold`).
- GUI ilovani Docker'da ishlatish — X11/Wayland socket mount = sandbox teshigi.
- Flatpak "sandbox"i ko'p ilovada `--filesystem=host` bilan amalda ochiq.

**Senior nuqta:** Tanlov — iste'molchi kim: oxirgi foydalanuvchi kompyuteri (Flatpak/Snap) yoki infra/orkestrator (OCI). Server'da Snap orqali kelgan daemon'lar (masalan LXD, microk8s) yangilanish siyosatini aniq boshqaring.

41045.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Fork bomb — o'zini cheksiz ko'paytiradigan process (`:(){ :|:& };:`) — bir necha soniyada kernel PID/task jadvalini to'ldiradi va host'da yangi process (hatto SSH) ishga tushmay qoladi. Container'da oldi cgroup **PID limiti** bilan olinadi: `docker run --pids-limit`, K8s'da kubelet `podPidsLimit`.

**Muammo:** PID'lar butun host uchun umumiy resurs (`kernel.pid_max`). Bitta buzuq yoki zararli container butun node'ni ishlamay qoldirishi mumkin — CPU/RAM limiti bunga yordam bermaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
:(){ :|:& };:
 f -> f|f -> 4 -> 8 -> 16 ... 2^n
pids.max=200 bo'lgan cgroup:
 201-chi fork() --> EAGAIN ("Resource temporarily unavailable")
 faqat shu container zarar ko'radi, host va boshqa pod'lar ishlaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run --rm -it --pids-limit 100 alpine sh -c ':(){ :|:& };:'
# sh: can't fork: Resource temporarily unavailable — host xavfsiz
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-<id>.scope/pids.max
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-<id>.scope/pids.events   # max N — necha marta urildi
```
K8s kubelet config:
```yaml
apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: KubeletConfiguration
podPidsLimit: 4096
systemReserved: {pid: "1000"}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Limit juda past — Java/Go ilovalar thread'lar uchun ham PID ishlatadi (har thread = task).
- Docker'da default PID limit yo'q.
- `ulimit -u` (nproc) user bo'yicha, container'lar orasida bir xil UID bo'lsa chalkashadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Node darajasida `podPidsLimit` va `pid` eviction chegaralarini standart qiling — bu bitta pod'ning butun node'ni "o'ldirishi" ga qarshi arzon himoya. `pids.events` metrikasiga alert qo'ying: limitga urilish ko'pincha thread oqishining belgisi.

41046.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `--memory-swappiness` (0-100) — xotira bosimi paytida kernel shu container'ning **anonymous** sahifalarini (heap) swap'ga chiqarishga qanchalik moyilligini belgilaydi: 0 — iloji boricha swap qilma (page cache'ni avval bo'shat), 100 — agressiv swap. Bu cgroup **v1** sozlamasi; cgroup v2'da per-cgroup swappiness yo'q — o'rniga `memory.swap.max` (`--memory-swap`) ishlatiladi.

**Muammo:** Latency'ga sezgir servis heap'i swap'ga chiqib, javob vaqti 10 ms dan soniyalarga sakraydi. Boshqa tomondan, swap'ni butunlay o'chirish OOM kill'ni tezlashtiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
xotira bosimi --> kernel reclaim:
   page cache (fayl sahifalari) --> diskdan qayta o'qilishi mumkin, bo'shatish arzon
   anonymous (heap) --> faqat swap'ga yozib bo'shatiladi
swappiness past --> page cache avval qurbon; yuqori --> heap ham swap'ga
v2: memory.swap.max=0 --> bu cgroup umuman swap ishlatmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# cgroup v1
docker run -d --memory 512m --memory-swappiness 0 myapp
# cgroup v2: swap limiti bilan boshqarish
docker run -d --memory 512m --memory-swap 512m myapp     # swap = 0 qo'shimcha
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/.../memory.swap.max /sys/fs/cgroup/.../memory.swap.current
vmstat 1          # si/so ustunlari — swap in/out
```
K8s: 1.34 da `NodeSwap` GA — `LimitedSwap` rejimida faqat Burstable pod'lar swap oladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- cgroup v2 host'da `--memory-swappiness` e'tiborsiz qoldiriladi (ogohlantirish bilan).
- `--memory-swap` = `--memory` ning ikki baravari default — kutilmagan swap.
- Swap bilan "OOM yo'q, lekin servis amalda o'lik" holati — thrashing.

**Senior nuqta:** Latency servislar uchun swap'siz + to'g'ri memory limit + `memory.high`; batch/kam muhim yuklama uchun cheklangan swap zichlikni oshiradi. Qaror PSI `memory.pressure` metrikasi bilan o'lchab qabul qilinsin.

41047.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OOMKilled — container cgroup xotira limitidan (`--memory` / K8s `limits.memory`) oshganda kernel **OOM killer** process'ni `SIGKILL` bilan o'ldiradi; exit code **137** = 128 + 9. K8s'da `Last State: Terminated, Reason: OOMKilled` ko'rinadi.

**Muammo:** Pod har 2 soatda restart bo'ladi, log'da hech qanday xato yo'q (SIGKILL — ilova hech narsa yozishga ulgurmaydi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
memory.current yaqinlashadi memory.max (512Mi)
  --> kernel reclaim (page cache bo'shatish)
  --> yetmasa --> cgroup OOM --> eng katta oom_score process --> SIGKILL
exit 137 --> kubelet restart (CrashLoopBackOff bo'lishi mumkin)
Node OOM (limit yo'q pod'lar) --> boshqa, sizniki bo'lmagan pod'lar ham o'lishi mumkin
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-7f9 | grep -A5 'Last State'
#   Reason: OOMKilled   Exit Code: 137
kubectl top pod api-7f9 --containers
docker inspect -f '{{.State.OOMKilled}} {{.State.ExitCode}}' app
dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process'
# Prometheus
# container_memory_working_set_bytes / container_spec_memory_limit_bytes
```
Ilova tomonda: JVM `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75`, Go `GOMEMLIMIT=400MiB`, Node `--max-old-space-size`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Exit 137 har doim OOM emas — `docker stop` timeout'dagi SIGKILL ham 137; `OOMKilled` maydonini tekshiring.
- Runtime heap limitini container limitiga moslamaslik — GC "xotira ko'p" deb yig'maydi.
- Limitni shunchaki oshirish — oqish (leak) bo'lsa faqat kechiktiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** `requests.memory = limits.memory` (Guaranteed QoS) xotira uchun eng bashorat qilinadigan rejim. OOM'ni metrika bilan oldindan ko'ring: working set'ning limitga nisbati >90% — alert; keyin heap profiling (pprof, heap dump) bilan sababni toping.

41048.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CFS throttling — CPU **limit** `cpu.max` (kvota/davr) bilan majburlanadi: davr odatda 100 ms. Container o'z kvotasini (masalan 1 CPU = 100 ms CPU vaqti, lekin 4 thread bilan 25 ms real vaqtda) davr oxirigacha tugatsa, qolgan vaqt **muzlatiladi** — so'rovlar kutib qoladi va p99 latency sakraydi, hatto o'rtacha CPU past bo'lsa ham.

**Muammo:** Dashboard'da CPU 30%, lekin p99 latency 200 ms. Sabab — ko'p thread'li ilova har davr boshida kvotani yeb, qolgan qismida throttled.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
limit 1 CPU: cpu.max = "100000 100000"
davr 100ms:  [4 thread x 25ms = 100ms kvota tugadi][----- 75ms THROTTLED -----]
             so'rov shu 75ms ichida kelsa -> kutadi
nr_throttled / nr_periods yuqori = muammo
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/.../cpu.stat
# nr_periods 12000  nr_throttled 3400  throttled_usec 98000000
```
PromQL:
```
rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m])
  / rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m]) > 0.25
```
Yechimlar: limitni olib tashlash yoki oshirish (requests'ni to'g'ri qo'yib); runtime thread sonini limitga moslash (Go 1.25+ GOMAXPROCS'ni avtomatik moslaydi, eski versiyalarda `automaxprocs`; JVM `-XX:ActiveProcessorCount`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- O'rtacha CPU utilization throttling'ni yashiradi — throttle nisbatini kuzating.
- GOMAXPROCS = node yadrolari soni (64), limit 2 CPU — og'ir throttling.
- Limitlarni olib tashlab, requests'ni ham noto'g'ri qoldirish — noisy neighbor.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p jamoalar latency servislar uchun CPU **limit qo'ymaydi**, faqat to'g'ri **requests** (CPU — siqiladigan resurs, CFS shares adolatli taqsimlaydi); xotira limiti esa doim bo'lsin. Qaror throttle metrikasi va load test bilan qabul qilinsin.

41049.a:
**Qisqa javob:** seccomp (secure computing mode) — kernel mexanizmi: process qaysi **syscall**'larni (va qaysi argumentlar bilan) chaqira olishini BPF filtr bilan cheklaydi. Docker default profili ~44 ta xavfli syscall'ni bloklaydi (`reboot`, `kexec_load`, `mount`, `keyctl`, `bpf`, ...). K8s'da `seccompProfile: RuntimeDefault` — runtime default profili (K8s'da u avtomatik yoqilmaydi, siz belgilashingiz kerak).

**Muammo:** Kernel ~400 ta syscall taqdim etadi; ilovaga odatda 50-100 tasi kerak. Har ortiqcha syscall — kernel zaifligidan foydalanish uchun eshik.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
process --syscall(unshare)--> seccomp BPF filtr
   allow  --> kernel bajaradi
   errno  --> EPERM qaytaradi (Docker default xulqi)
   kill   --> process o'ldiriladi
   log    --> audit log, ruxsat beriladi (profil yozishda foydali)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run --rm alpine unshare -r id          # default profil: Operation not permitted
docker run --rm --security-opt seccomp=unconfined alpine unshare -r id   # ishlaydi (xavfli)
grep Seccomp /proc/$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' app)/status   # 2 = filtr faol
```
K8s:
```yaml
securityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault        # yoki Localhost + localhostProfile: profiles/api.json
```
Kubelet `--seccomp-default` bilan barcha pod'lar uchun RuntimeDefault default qilish mumkin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- K8s'da seccomp default'da **Unconfined** (kubelet flag'isiz) — ko'pchilik buni bilmaydi.
- `seccomp=unconfined` ni "tez yechim" sifatida qo'yish.
- Custom profil yozib, runtime/libc yangilanishida yangi syscall (masalan `clone3`) bloklanib qolishi.

**Senior nuqta:** Minimal qadam — hamma joyda RuntimeDefault (PSS `restricted` buni talab qiladi). Yuqori xavfli servislar uchun Security Profiles Operator bilan `log` rejimida haqiqiy syscall'larni yozib, aniq profil yarating.

41050.a:
**Qisqa javob:** AppArmor va SELinux — Linux **Mandatory Access Control (MAC)** modullari (LSM): process root bo'lsa ham, profil/policy ruxsat bermagan fayl, capability va tarmoq operatsiyalarini kernel bloklaydi. **AppArmor** — yo'l (path) asosidagi profillar (Ubuntu/Debian/SUSE); **SELinux** — label (type, MCS category) asosida (RHEL/Fedora/OpenShift). Docker/Podman container'larga default profil (`docker-default`, `container_t`) qo'yadi.

**Muammo:** Container escape'dan keyin hujumchi host fayllariga (`/etc/shadow`, boshqa container volume'lari) yetishi kerak — MAC aynan shu qadamni to'xtatadi. SELinux MCS har container'ni boshqasidan ham ajratadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SELinux: process label  system_u:system_r:container_t:s0:c12,c87
         fayl label     system_u:object_r:container_file_t:s0:c12,c87
         policy: container_t faqat o'z MCS (c12,c87) faylini o'qiy oladi
AppArmor: profil docker-default: deny mount, deny /proc/sys/** w, deny /sys/firmware/** ...
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# SELinux
getenforce                                 # Enforcing
ps -eZ | grep container_t
podman run -v /data:/data:Z alpine ls /data   # :Z — volume'ni qayta label'lash
ausearch -m avc -ts recent                 # bloklangan urinishlar

# AppArmor
aa-status | grep docker
docker run --security-opt apparmor=my-profile nginx
```
K8s: `securityContext.appArmorProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}` (1.30+ GA), `seLinuxOptions`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Muammo chiqsa `setenforce 0` qilib qoldirish — butun himoya o'chadi.
- Volume'da `:z`/`:Z` siz — `Permission denied`, root bo'lsa ham.
- `/` yoki `/home` ga `:Z` — host fayllar label'i o'zgarib, tizim buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** MAC — container escape'ga qarshi oxirgi qatlamlardan biri; uni o'chirib emas, AVC log'larini o'qib to'g'rilang (`audit2allow` faqat tahlil uchun). SELinux'li node'lar (RHEL/OpenShift) bir qancha runc CVE'larining ta'sirini bloklagan.

41051.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `docker system prune` — ishlatilmayotgan Docker resurslarini o'chiradi: **to'xtagan container'lar**, **hech qaysi container ishlatmaydigan tarmoqlar**, **dangling image'lar** (tag'siz) va **build cache**. `-a` — ishlab turgan container ishlatmaydigan **barcha** image'lar; `--volumes` — ishlatilmayotgan (anonim) volume'lar ham. Qaytarib bo'lmaydi.

**Muammo:** CI runner yoki dev mashinada `/var/lib/docker` 200 GB'ga yetdi, disk to'lib build'lar yiqilyapti.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
docker system df  --> nima qancha joy egallayapti
prune             --> stopped containers + unused networks + dangling images + build cache
prune -a          --> + barcha ishlatilmagan image'lar (keyingi pull qayta yuklaydi)
prune --volumes   --> + ishlatilmagan volume'lar  (DB ma'lumoti bo'lishi mumkin!)
--filter until=24h / label=...  --> tanlab
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker system df -v
docker system prune -f --filter "until=72h"
docker image prune -a -f --filter "until=168h"
docker builder prune -f --keep-storage 20GB
docker volume ls -f dangling=true          # avval ko'ring, keyin o'chiring
# cron/systemd timer CI runner'da:
0 3 * * * docker system prune -af --filter "until=48h"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--volumes` — to'xtatilgan compose loyihasining DB volume'i ham "ishlatilmayotgan" hisoblanadi.
- `-a` dan keyin hamma image qayta pull — CI birinchi build'lari sekin, registry rate limit.
- Disk to'lishining sababi log fayllar bo'lsa (`*-json.log`), prune yordam bermaydi — log rotation sozlang.

**Senior nuqta:** Qo'lda prune o'rniga siyosat: `daemon.json` da `log-opts max-size`, BuildKit GC (`builder.gc` keepStorage), K8s node'larda kubelet image GC chegaralari. Prune — favqulodda tool, rejali tozalash emas.

41052.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Docker plugin — `dockerd` imkoniyatlarini kengaytiruvchi tashqi process (odatda maxsus container sifatida ishlaydi): **volume** driver (NFS, cloud disk), **network** driver, **logging** driver (Loki, Datadog), **authorization** plugin (API so'rovlarini ruxsat/rad). Daemon ular bilan HTTP/JSON API orqali socket bo'yicha gaplashadi.

**Muammo:** Container log'larini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Loki'ga yuborish yoki volume'ni tarmoq storage'da saqlash kerak — Docker yadrosiga bu funksiyalarni qo'shib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
dockerd --> /run/docker/plugins/<id>/<name>.sock --> plugin process
   VolumeDriver.Create / Mount / Unmount
   LogDriver.StartLogging
   AuthZPlugin.AuthZReq (har API so'rov)
Managed plugin: docker plugin install (rootfs + config.json, kerakli privilege'lar so'raladi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker plugin install grafana/loki-docker-driver:3.3.2-amd64 --alias loki --grant-all-permissions
docker plugin ls
docker run -d --log-driver=loki \
  --log-opt loki-url=http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/push --log-opt loki-batch-size=400 nginx
docker plugin inspect loki | jq '.[0].Config.Linux.Capabilities'
docker plugin disable loki && docker plugin upgrade loki ...
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--grant-all-permissions` — plugin'ga host'da keng huquq (capability, mount); ko'r-ko'rona bermang.
- Logging plugin osilib qolsa — container start/stop ham osilishi mumkin; `mode=non-blocking` ko'ring.
- Ko'p plugin'lar rivojlanishi to'xtagan — K8s'da CSI/CNI va log agent'lari standart.

**Senior nuqta:** Plugin'lar daemon'ning ishonch doirasida ishlaydi — har biri supply chain xavfi. K8s muhitida bu ehtiyojlar CSI, CNI va DaemonSet log agent'lari (Fluent Bit, Vector) bilan hal qilinadi; Docker plugin'lar asosan standalone host'lar uchun.

41053.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Docker **iptables** (yoki nftables) qoidalarini avtomatik boshqaradi: container'larning tashqariga chiqishi uchun **MASQUERADE** (SNAT), `-p` publish qilingan portlar uchun **DNAT**, tarmoqlar orasidagi izolyatsiya uchun `FORWARD` filtrlari. Muhim: publish qilingan portlar `nat` jadvalining `PREROUTING` da DNAT qilinadi, shuning uchun **UFW/firewalld `INPUT` qoidalarini chetlab o'tadi**.

**Muammo:** Server'da UFW bilan faqat 22/443 ochiq, lekin `docker run -p 5432:5432 postgres` — Postgres butun internetga ochiq bo'lib qoldi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
internet --> eth0:5432 --> PREROUTING (nat) DOCKER zanjiri: DNAT -> 172.17.0.2:5432
         --> FORWARD (filter) DOCKER-USER -> DOCKER -> container
         (INPUT zanjiri — UFW shu yerda — umuman ko'rilmaydi!)
container --> tashqariga --> POSTROUTING MASQUERADE -> host IP
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo iptables -t nat -L DOCKER -n --line-numbers
sudo iptables -L DOCKER-USER -n
# faqat ma'lum tarmoqqa ruxsat (DOCKER-USER — sizning qoidalaringiz uchun)
sudo iptables -I DOCKER-USER -i eth0 ! -s 10.0.0.0/8 -p tcp -m conntrack --ctorigdstport 5432 -j DROP
# eng oddiy: faqat localhost'ga publish
docker run -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 postgres:17
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `"iptables": false` daemon.json'da — container'lar tarmog'i buziladi, qo'lda hammasini yozish kerak.
- Firewall qayta yuklanganda (`firewall-cmd --reload`) Docker qoidalari o'chib ketishi.
- DOCKER-USER qoidalarida DNAT'dan keyingi port (container porti) ko'rinadi — `conntrack --ctorigdstport` ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Qoida: hech qachon UFW'ga ishonib `-p` qilmang; ichki servislarni faqat `127.0.0.1` yoki ichki tarmoqqa bog'lang, tashqi filtrni DOCKER-USER yoki cloud security group darajasida qiling. Docker 28+ nftables backend'ini ham qo'llaydi — firewall tool'ingiz bilan mosligini tekshiring.

41054.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `dockerd` — Docker Engine'ning fon daemon'i: Docker REST API'ni (`/var/run/docker.sock`) tinglaydi, image build (BuildKit), image/volume/tarmoq boshqaruvi, log driver'lar va container lifecycle'ni bajaradi; container'larni ishga tushirish uchun **containerd** (u esa shim + runc) ga murojaat qiladi. Odatda **root** sifatida ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** `docker ps` "Cannot connect to the Docker daemon" deydi yoki container'lar g'alati holatda — muammoni to'g'ri qatlamdan (CLI, dockerd, containerd) qidirish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
docker CLI --HTTP REST--> dockerd (/var/run/docker.sock)
   build (BuildKit), images, networks (libnetwork + iptables), volumes, logs
   --> containerd (gRPC) --> shim --> runc --> container
Konfiguratsiya: /etc/docker/daemon.json
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl status docker; journalctl -u docker --since "1 hour ago"
docker info | grep -E 'Server Version|Storage Driver|Cgroup|Logging Driver'
curl --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock http://localhost/v1.47/containers/json | jq '.[].Names'
```
`/etc/docker/daemon.json`:
```json
{
  "log-driver": "json-file",
  "log-opts": {"max-size": "10m", "max-file": "3"},
  "live-restore": true,
  "default-address-pools": [{"base": "172.30.0.0/16", "size": 24}],
  "userns-remap": "default"
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `live-restore` siz dockerd restart/upgrade — barcha container'lar to'xtaydi.
- Log rotation yo'q — `*-json.log` fayllar diskni to'ldiradi.
- Default bridge tarmoq diapazoni korporativ VPN bilan to'qnashadi — `default-address-pools`.
- API'ni TCP'da TLS'siz ochish (`-H tcp://0.0.0.0:2375`) — kriptomayning botlari daqiqalarda topadi.

**Senior nuqta:** dockerd — root daemon, hujum yuzasi katta. K8s node'larida u umuman kerak emas (containerd yetarli); standalone host'larda rootless rejim yoki Podman ko'rib chiqilsin.

41055.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Image digest — image **manifest'ining SHA-256 hash'i** (`nginx@sha256:4c0f...`). Content-addressable: tarkib bir bit o'zgarsa digest o'zgaradi, shuning uchun digest **o'zgarmas** va aynan bir xil image'ni kafolatlaydi. Tag (`:1.27`, `:latest`) esa o'zgaruvchan ko'rsatkich — istalgan payt boshqa image'ga qayta ko'chirilishi mumkin.

**Muammo:** Staging'da `api:1.4` test qilindi; kimdir shu tag'ni qayta push qildi va prod boshqa kodni oldi. Yoki base image `python:3.13` ertaga boshqa paketlar bilan keladi va build reproducible emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
tag api:1.4 ---(o'zgaruvchan)---> sha256:aaa (bugun)
                              \--> sha256:bbb (ertaga, qayta push)
api@sha256:aaa --> HAR DOIM bir xil manifest --> bir xil layer digest'lari
Multi-arch: index digest (hamma platforma) va platforma manifest digest'i farq qiladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 --format '{{json .Manifest.Digest}}'
crane digest ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4
docker images --digests
docker pull ghcr.io/corp/api@sha256:aaa...
```
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.13-slim@sha256:3f1c...   # tag o'qish uchun, digest haqiqat uchun
```
```yaml
image: ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4@sha256:aaa...
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `docker images` dagi IMAGE ID (config digest) ni manifest digest bilan adashtirish.
- Digest'ga pin qilib, keyin yangilamaslik — xavfsizlik patch'lari kelmaydi (Renovate/Dependabot ishlating).
- Registry'lar orasida ko'chirishda (`docker save/load`) manifest qayta yaratilib digest o'zgarishi; `skopeo copy` digest'ni saqlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod deploy va imzo tekshiruvi digest asosida bo'lsin; tag'lar faqat odamlar uchun. Registry'da tag immutability yoqing (ECR, Harbor) — ikki himoya birga.

41056.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Layer invalidation — Dockerfile'dagi biror instruktsiyaning cache kaliti o'zgarsa (buyruq matni, `COPY` qilingan fayllar tarkibi, `ARG` qiymati, base image), o'sha qadam **va undan keyingi barcha qadamlar** cache'dan foydalanmay qayta bajariladi. Oldingi qadamlar cache'da qoladi.

**Muammo:** Bitta README o'zgarishi 15 daqiqalik to'liq rebuild'ga olib keladi — chunki `COPY . .` erta turibdi va keyingi barcha og'ir `RUN`'lar invalid bo'ladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
1 FROM node:22          cached
2 COPY package*.json    cached (fayllar o'zgarmagan)
3 RUN npm ci            cached
4 COPY . .              INVALID (src/a.js o'zgardi)
5 RUN npm run build     qayta  (4 dan keyin)
6 ... hammasi qayta
Invalidatsiya manbalari: fayl checksum (COPY/ADD), buyruq matni, ARG/ENV qiymati,
FROM image yangilanishi (--pull), --no-cache
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker build --progress=plain . 2>&1 | grep -E '^#[0-9]+ (\[|CACHED)'
```
Yaxshi tuzilma:
```dockerfile
FROM node:22-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm ci
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src ./src                 # faqat kerakli papka, butun repo emas
RUN npm run build
ARG GIT_SHA                    # o'zgaruvchan ARG — oxirida
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.revision=$GIT_SHA
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ARG` ni boshida e'lon qilib, `RUN` da ishlatish — har yangi qiymat keyingi hammasini invalid qiladi.
- `ADD https://...` — har safar yuklab, checksum o'zgarsa invalid; `--checksum` bilan pin qiling.
- `.dockerignore` siz `.git` o'zgarishi `COPY . .` ni invalid qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Dockerfile'ni "o'zgarish chastotasi" bo'yicha tartiblang: base -> tizim paketlari -> dependency manifest -> dependency o'rnatish -> kod -> metadata. CI build vaqti dashboard'i bilan cache hit ratio'ni kuzating.

41057.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `/var/run/docker.sock` — Docker CLI `dockerd` API'si bilan gaplashadigan UNIX socket. Unga yoza oladigan har kim daemon'ga istalgan buyruq bera oladi — masalan host `/` ni mount qilgan privileged container ishga tushirish. Shuning uchun socket'ni container'ga mount qilish = shu container'ga **host root** berish.

**Muammo:** CI agent, Portainer yoki "auto-update" container uchun qulaylik sifatida `-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock` qo'shiladi; ilovada RCE topilsa hujumchi butun host'ni oladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (hujum):**
```
container ichida (socket mount qilingan):
  docker -H unix:///var/run/docker.sock run -it --privileged --pid=host \
     -v /:/host alpine chroot /host sh
  --> host'da root shell
Docker CLI ham shart emas: curl --unix-socket ... POST /containers/create
```

**Amalda:** topish va alternativalar:
```bash
docker ps -q | xargs docker inspect -f '{{.Name}} {{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} {{end}}' | grep docker.sock
kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.volumes[]?.hostPath.path=="/var/run/docker.sock") | .metadata.name'
ls -l /var/run/docker.sock     # srw-rw---- root docker  -> docker guruhi = root
```
Alternativalar: CI build uchun BuildKit rootless/Kaniko/Buildah; monitoring uchun read-only API proxy (masalan faqat `GET /containers` ga ruxsat beradigan socket proxy); rootless Docker.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `:ro` bilan mount qilish himoya qilmaydi — socket'ga yozish baribir ishlaydi.
- `docker` guruhiga user qo'shish — unga root berish bilan teng.
- K8s'da `hostPath` orqali `containerd.sock` mount qilish — xuddi shunday xavf.

**Senior nuqta:** Socket mount'ni policy (Kyverno/OPA, PSS) bilan bloklang va istisnolarni hujjatlashtiring. Agar daemon API'si haqiqatan kerak bo'lsa — endpoint'lar allowlist'i bilan proxy, alohida izolyatsiyalangan host'da.

41058.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Container attestation — image digest'iga bog'langan, **kriptografik imzolangan bayonot** (in-toto format): bu image qanday, qayerda, qaysi manbadan build qilingan (**SLSA provenance**), ichida nima bor (**SBOM**), qaysi test/skan o'tgan (vulnerability, test natijasi). Registry'da OCI artifact sifatida saqlanadi va deploy'da policy bilan tekshiriladi.

**Muammo:** Imzo faqat "kim imzoladi" ni aytadi. "Bu image rasmiy CI'da, `main` branch'dan, review qilingan commit'dan build qilinganmi va CVE skandan o'tganmi?" degan savolga ham isbotli javob kerak (SolarWinds kabi build tizimi buzilishi hujumlari).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CI build --> image sha256:aaa
   +-- attestation: predicateType=https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1
   |     builder: github-actions, repo: corp/api, commit: 9f3c, workflow: release.yml
   +-- attestation: predicateType=https://spdx.dev/Document (SBOM)
   +-- attestation: vuln scan natijasi
   (har biri DSSE konvertida imzolangan, Rekor log'da)
Deploy: admission policy --> "provenance builder == bizning CI va repo == corp/api" --> ruxsat
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# BuildKit o'zi provenance va SBOM qo'shadi
docker buildx build --provenance=mode=max --sbom=true -t ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 --push .
docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 --format '{{json .Provenance}}' | jq .SLSA.invocation

# cosign bilan
cosign attest --predicate sbom.spdx.json --type spdxjson ghcr.io/corp/api@sha256:aaa
cosign verify-attestation --type slsaprovenance \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/corp/.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com ghcr.io/corp/api@sha256:aaa
# GitHub
gh attestation verify oci://ghcr.io/corp/api:1.4 --owner corp
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Attestation yaratilib, hech qayerda tekshirilmasa — qog'oz uchun.
- `mode=max` provenance'da build argumentlari (ehtimol secret'lar) ko'rinishi mumkin.
- Imzolanmagan SBOM — ishonchsiz ma'lumot.

**Senior nuqta:** Yetuklik yo'li: SBOM -> imzo -> SLSA provenance (Level 3: izolyatsiyalangan, buzib bo'lmaydigan builder) -> admission'da majburiy tekshiruv. Asosiy qiymat — incident paytida "qaysi prod image'larda shu paket bor va ular qayerdan kelgan" ga daqiqalarda javob.

41059.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `cri-dockerd` — Mirantis/Docker tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan **adapter**: Docker Engine'ga CRI interfeysini beradi, shunda kubelet Docker'ni container runtime sifatida ishlatishda davom eta oladi. K8s 1.24 da kubelet ichidagi `dockershim` olib tashlangandan keyin paydo bo'lgan.

**Muammo:** Ba'zi klasterlar node'da Docker'ga bog'liq (DinD build'lar, Docker log/monitoring tooling, `docker.sock` ishlatadigan agent'lar). 1.24 upgrade'da ular darhol containerd'ga o'ta olmagan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
1.23 gacha:  kubelet (ichida dockershim) --> dockerd --> containerd --> runc
1.24+:       kubelet --CRI--> cri-dockerd --> dockerd --> containerd --> runc
odatiy:      kubelet --CRI--> containerd --> runc        (bitta qatlam kam)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl status cri-docker.socket cri-docker.service
# kubelet sozlamasi
--container-runtime-endpoint=unix:///var/run/cri-dockerd.sock
kubectl get nodes -o wide       # CONTAINER-RUNTIME: docker://27.x
crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///var/run/cri-dockerd.sock ps
```
Docker'ga bog'liqlikni topish: `kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq` bilan `hostPath` = `/var/run/docker.sock` bo'lgan pod'lar.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Qo'shimcha qatlam — ko'proq resurs, ko'proq nosozlik nuqtasi, sekinroq yangi CRI xususiyatlari.
- Managed K8s (EKS, GKE, AKS) Docker runtime'ni qo'llamaydi — cri-dockerd faqat self-managed'da.
- "Docker'da build qilingan image containerd'da ishlamaydi" — noto'g'ri tushuncha; image'lar OCI, hammasi mos.

**Senior nuqta:** cri-dockerd — vaqtinchalik ko'prik, maqsad emas. Migratsiya rejasi: docker.sock'ga bog'liq workload'larni topish -> BuildKit/Kaniko va CRI-mos agent'larga o'tkazish -> node'larni containerd bilan qayta yaratish (in-place emas, rolling node replacement).

41060.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Firecracker — AWS'ning ochiq kodli (Rust), KVM asosidagi **microVM** monitori (VMM): minimal virtual qurilmalar (virtio-net, virtio-block, serial), ~125 ms dan kam start va har microVM uchun ~5 MiB overhead. VM darajasidagi izolyatsiyani container'ga yaqin tezlik va zichlik bilan beradi; **AWS Lambda va Fargate** asosida.

**Muammo:** Multi-tenant serverless: millionlab turli mijoz kodini bir host'da xavfsiz ishlatish kerak. Container (umumiy kernel) — izolyatsiya zaif; oddiy VM (QEMU) — sekin start va katta overhead.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
host Linux + KVM
  +-- firecracker process (har microVM uchun bitta, jailer: chroot + seccomp + cgroup)
        +-- guest kernel + rootfs --> mijoz kodi
  +-- firecracker process --> boshqa mijoz
Minimal qurilma modeli = kichik hujum yuzasi; REST API (unix socket) bilan boshqariladi
Snapshot/restore --> Lambda SnapStart
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
firecracker --api-sock /tmp/fc.sock &
curl --unix-socket /tmp/fc.sock -X PUT http://localhost/boot-source \
  -d '{"kernel_image_path":"vmlinux","boot_args":"console=ttyS0 reboot=k panic=1"}'
curl --unix-socket /tmp/fc.sock -X PUT http://localhost/drives/rootfs \
  -d '{"drive_id":"rootfs","path_on_host":"rootfs.ext4","is_root_device":true,"is_read_only":false}'
curl --unix-socket /tmp/fc.sock -X PUT http://localhost/machine-config -d '{"vcpu_count":1,"mem_size_mib":128}'
```
