```bash
curl --unix-socket /tmp/fc.sock -X PUT http://localhost/actions -d '{"action_type":"InstanceStart"}'
```
Container dunyosiga ulash: **Kata Containers** (Firecracker backend) yoki firecracker-containerd.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- KVM kerak — ko'p cloud VM'larida nested virtualization yo'q (bare metal instance yoki qo'llaydigan tur kerak).
- GPU va ko'p qurilma passthrough cheklangan — umumiy maqsadli VM o'rnini bosmaydi.
- Snapshot'dan tiklashda random seed, vaqt va unique ID'lar takrorlanishi.

**Senior nuqta:** Firecracker — "container ergonomikasi + VM izolyatsiyasi" yo'nalishining namunasi (Fly.io, Lambda, Fargate, ba'zi CI sandbox'lar). Ishonchsiz kod ishlatadigan platforma qursangiz, gVisor va Kata/Firecracker'ni performans va moslik bo'yicha o'z yuklamangizda solishtiring.

41061.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Control plane — klasterning "miyasi": `kube-apiserver` (yagona kirish nuqtasi), `etcd` (holat bazasi), `kube-scheduler` (pod'ni node'ga joylash), `kube-controller-manager` (reconcile loop'lar) va cloud'da `cloud-controller-manager`.

**Nega kerak:** Kubernetes deklarativ: siz "3 ta replika bo'lsin" deysiz, control plane esa haqiqiy holatni doimiy shu istakka yaqinlashtiradi. Har komponent bitta vazifani bajaradi va ular faqat API server orqali gaplashadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl apply --> kube-apiserver --(authn/authz/admission)--> etcd
                     ^      ^       ^
                     |      |       |
             scheduler  controller-mgr  cloud-controller-mgr
             (watch)    (watch+update)  (LB, route, node)
                     ^
                  kubelet (har node'da, watch)
```
- **kube-apiserver** — REST API, validatsiya, admission. etcd'ga faqat u yozadi. Stateless, gorizontal scale qilinadi.
- **etcd** — Raft asosidagi consistent key-value store; butun klaster holati shu yerda.
- **kube-scheduler** — `nodeName` bo'sh pod'larni ko'radi, filter (resurs, taint, affinity) va score bosqichidan keyin node tanlaydi.
- **kube-controller-manager** — Deployment, ReplicaSet, Node, Job, EndpointSlice, ServiceAccount controller'lari bitta binary'da.
- **cloud-controller-manager** — `type: LoadBalancer` uchun LB yaratish, node'ning cloud'dagi holatini tekshirish.

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kube-system          # kubeadm'da static pod sifatida
kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'      # apiserver sog'ligi
kubectl get lease -n kube-system         # scheduler/controller leader kim
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Managed klasterda (EKS/GKE/AKS) control plane ko'rinmaydi — uni provider boshqaradi, siz faqat API'ni ko'rasiz.
- Scheduler va controller-manager HA'da bir nechta replikada turadi, lekin faqat bittasi leader (Lease orqali).
- etcd sekin disk'da tursa butun klaster sekinlashadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Control plane o'lsa ishlab turgan pod'lar to'xtamaydi — faqat o'zgarish (deploy, scale, self-healing) to'xtaydi. Shuning uchun self-managed'da 3 control plane node + alohida SSD'li etcd standart.

41062.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Worker node'da uchta asosiy komponent bor: `kubelet` (node agenti), `kube-proxy` (Service trafigi qoidalari) va CRI container runtime (containerd yoki CRI-O). Ular ustida CNI plugin tarmoqni beradi.

**Nega kerak:** Control plane faqat "nima bo'lishi kerak"ni yozadi. Haqiqatda container'ni ishga tushiradigan, tarmoqni ulaydigan va holatni qayta xabar qiladigan narsa node'da turishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kube-apiserver
     | watch: nodeName=bu-node bo'lgan pod'lar
     v
  kubelet --CRI(gRPC)--> containerd --> runc --> container
     |   --CNI--> pod'ga IP va interfeys
     |   --CSI--> volume mount
     +--> status (Ready, pod phase) apiserver'ga
  kube-proxy --watch Service/EndpointSlice--> iptables/IPVS/nftables qoidalari
```
- **kubelet** — PodSpec'ni bajaradi, probe'larni ishga tushiradi, eviction qiladi, node lease'ni yangilaydi (heartbeat).
- **kube-proxy** — ClusterIP'ga kelgan paketni haqiqiy pod IP'ga DNAT qiladi.
- **Runtime** — Docker (dockershim) 1.24'da olib tashlangan; bugun containerd yoki CRI-O.

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl status kubelet
journalctl -u kubelet -f            # pod nega start bo'lmayapti
crictl ps; crictl logs <id>         # runtime darajasida
kubectl describe node <node>        # Conditions, Allocatable
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Node `NotReady` — ko'pincha kubelet o'lgan, CNI o'rnatilmagan yoki disk to'lgan.
- `docker ps` bilan debug qilish endi ishlamaydi — `crictl` ishlating.
- Cilium kube-proxy replacement rejimida kube-proxy umuman bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** kubelet'ga `kubeReserved`/`systemReserved` ajrating, aks holda pod'lar node'ning o'z servislarini bo'g'ib qo'yadi va node butunlay qulaydi.

41063.a:
**Qisqa javob:** etcd — **Raft** consensus asosidagi distributed key-value store. Har yozuv leader orqali o'tadi, WAL'ga yoziladi va **majority** (quorum) tasdiqlagandan keyin commit qilinadi. Ma'lumot MVCC bilan revision'lar ko'rinishida saqlanadi, o'qish default'da linearizable.

**Nega kerak:** Klaster holati bitta "haqiqat manbai"da bo'lishi kerak va node yiqilganda ham yo'qolmasligi, ikki xil versiyaga bo'linmasligi (split-brain) shart.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
client --> leader
             | 1. WAL'ga yozadi
             | 2. AppendEntries --> follower1, follower2
             | 3. majority ack (3 dan 2)
             v
          commit --> bbolt (MVCC, revision++) --> client'ga OK
```
| Member | Quorum | Chidaydi |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 0 |
| 3 | 2 | 1 |
| 5 | 3 | 2 |
| 4 | 3 | 1 (3 dan yaxshi emas) |

Quorum = floor(N/2)+1. Shuning uchun toq son: 4 member 3 dan ko'proq yiqilishga chidamaydi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 \
  --cacert=ca.crt --cert=server.crt --key=server.key \
  endpoint status -w table      # leader, DB size, raft index
etcdctl member list -w table
etcdctl get /registry/pods/default --prefix --keys-only | head
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sekin disk (fsync latency > 10ms) leader election'larga va timeout'larga olib keladi — SSD/NVMe shart.
- Member'larni AZ'lar orasida juda uzoqqa qo'yish latency'ni oshiradi.
- Quorum yo'qolsa klaster read-only ham emas — yozish butunlay to'xtaydi; tiklash snapshot'dan.

**Senior nuqta:** `etcdctl snapshot save` bilan muntazam backup va restore'ni mashq qiling. Monitoring: `etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds` p99 va `etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total`.

41064.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pod — Kubernetes'dagi eng kichik deploy birligi: bir yoki bir nechta container, ular bitta IP, port maydoni (network namespace), IPC va volume'larni bo'lishadi va doim bitta node'da birga joylashadi.

**Nega kerak:** Ba'zan ikki process juda yaqin ishlashi kerak: masalan ilova va uning log yuboruvchi sidecar'i. Ularni alohida joylash noqulay — Pod ularni "bitta mantiqiy host" sifatida birlashtiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod (IP 10.1.2.3)
+-------------------------------+
| pause (namespace egasi)       |
| app      :8080   <- localhost |
| sidecar  :9090   -> localhost |
| volume: /shared (emptyDir)    |
+-------------------------------+
```
Container'lar bir-biriga `localhost` orqali murojaat qiladi, lekin bir xil portni ikki container ochishi mumkin emas.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: { name: web }
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: nginx:1.27
    ports: [{ containerPort: 80 }]
```
```bash
kubectl apply -f pod.yaml
kubectl get pod web -o wide     # IP, NODE
kubectl describe pod web        # Events: pull, start, xatolar
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Pod'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yaratmang — u o'lsa hech kim qayta yaratmaydi. Deployment/StatefulSet ishlating.
- Pod IP vaqtinchalik; unga emas, Service'ga murojaat qiling.
- Bir pod'ga bog'liq bo'lmagan servislarni tiqmang — ular birga scale bo'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Pod — "cattle", qayta yaratiladigan birlik. Dizaynda har qanday pod istalgan payt o'lishi mumkinligini hisobga oling: state tashqarida, graceful shutdown bor.

41065.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pause (infra) container — har pod'da birinchi ishga tushadigan juda kichik container. U hech narsa qilmaydi (`pause()` chaqirib uxlaydi), faqat pod'ning network, IPC va UTS namespace'larini ushlab turadi; ilova container'lari shu namespace'larga qo'shiladi.

**Nega kerak:** Agar namespace ilova container'iga tegishli bo'lsa, u restart bo'lganda pod IP va tarmoq yo'qolar edi. Pause container barqaror "egasi" bo'lib, ilova qayta ishga tushsa ham IP o'zgarmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet -> CRI RunPodSandbox
   v
pause container (netns + IP, CNI shu yerga ulanadi)
   v
app container   --join netns/ipc/uts--> pause
sidecar         --join netns/ipc/uts--> pause
```
Shuningdek, PID namespace bo'lishilsa (`shareProcessNamespace: true`), pause PID 1 bo'lib zombie process'larni yig'adi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
crictl pods                        # sandbox'lar (har pod uchun bittadan)
crictl ps -a | grep pause          # containerd'da ko'rinmasligi mumkin
crictl inspectp <pod-id> | grep -i ip
```
Image: `registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10` (versiya kubelet/containerd konfigida).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Air-gapped klasterda pause image mirror'da bo'lmasa hech qanday pod start bo'lmaydi ("failed to create sandbox").
- `kubectl get pods` da pause ko'rinmaydi — bu normal.
- containerd config'dagi `sandbox_image` va kubelet kutgan versiya mos kelmasligi ogohlantirishlar beradi.

**Senior nuqta:** "Sandbox" tushunchasi Kata Containers/gVisor kabi runtime'larda muhim: u yerda pod sandbox — alohida VM yoki kernel, pause esa shu chegarani ifodalaydi.

41066.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Pod** — ishlab turgan container'lar. **ReplicaSet** — selector bo'yicha aynan N ta pod borligini ta'minlaydi. **Deployment** — ReplicaSet'larni boshqarib rolling update, rollback va versiya tarixini beradi. Amalda siz faqat Deployment yozasiz.

**Nega kerak:** Yangi versiyani chiqarishda eski va yangi pod'larni bosqichma-bosqich almashtirish kerak. Bitta ReplicaSet buni qila olmaydi — Deployment ikki ReplicaSet'ni parallel boshqaradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Deployment (image v2)
   |-- ReplicaSet v1 (hash abc)  replicas 3 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0
   +-- ReplicaSet v2 (hash def)  replicas 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3
                                     |
                                   Pod'lar (ownerReference -> RS)
```
`pod-template-hash` label har RS'ni ajratadi. Eski RS 0 replikada saqlanadi — rollback uchun (`revisionHistoryLimit`, default 10).

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx:1.26 --replicas=3
kubectl set image deploy/web nginx=nginx:1.27
kubectl rollout status deploy/web
kubectl get rs -l app=web           # ikki RS ko'rinadi
kubectl rollout history deploy/web
kubectl rollout undo deploy/web --to-revision=1
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- ReplicaSet'ni qo'lda tahrirlash — Deployment uni qaytarib yozadi.
- `maxUnavailable: 0, maxSurge: 0` bo'lsa rollout hech qachon tugamaydi.
- Readiness probe yo'q bo'lsa rollout "muvaffaqiyatli" ko'rinadi, lekin ilova ishlamaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** `progressDeadlineSeconds` va readiness probe bilan buzuq rollout avtomatik to'xtaydi; canary/blue-green kerak bo'lsa Argo Rollouts yoki Flagger qo'shiladi.

41067.a:
**Qisqa javob:** StatefulSet — har pod'ga **barqaror identitet** beradigan controller: doimiy nom (`db-0`, `db-1`), headless Service orqali barqaror DNS, har pod'ga o'z PVC'si (`volumeClaimTemplates`) va tartibli start/update. Deployment esa pod'larni o'zaro almashtiriladigan deb hisoblaydi.

**Nega kerak:** PostgreSQL, Kafka, ZooKeeper kabi tizimlarda har node o'z ma'lumotiga va o'z nomiga ega: `kafka-2` qayta tug'ilganda aynan o'z diskini va nomini olishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
StatefulSet db (replicas 3, serviceName db)
  db-0 --> PVC data-db-0   DNS: db-0.db.ns.svc.cluster.local
  db-1 --> PVC data-db-1   DNS: db-1.db.ns.svc.cluster.local
  db-2 --> PVC data-db-2
Start: 0 -> 1 -> 2 (oldingisi Ready bo'lgach)
Update: 2 -> 1 -> 0 (teskari tartib)
```
| | Deployment | StatefulSet |
|---|---|---|
| Pod nomi | tasodifiy hash | tartib raqami |
| Storage | umumiy yoki yo'q | har pod'ga o'z PVC |
| Tartib | parallel | ketma-ket (default) |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  serviceName: db
  replicas: 3
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata: { name: data }
    spec:
      accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
      resources: { requests: { storage: 20Gi } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- StatefulSet o'chirilsa PVC'lar qoladi (xavfsizlik uchun) — qo'lda tozalang yoki `persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy`.
- Pod buzuq bo'lib Ready bo'lmasa, keyingi update to'xtab qoladi.
- StatefulSet replikatsiya yoki failover qilmaydi — bu DB'ning yoki operator'ning ishi.

**Senior nuqta:** Production DB uchun xom StatefulSet emas, operator (CloudNativePG, Strimzi) yoki managed servis tanlang — backup, failover, upgrade logikasi asosiy murakkablik.

41068.a:
**Qisqa javob:** DaemonSet — har (yoki tanlangan) node'da aynan **bitta** pod ishlashini ta'minlaydi. Yangi node qo'shilsa pod avtomatik tushadi, node olib tashlansa pod ham ketadi.

**Nega kerak:** Ba'zi agentlar har node'da bo'lishi shart: CNI (Cilium), log yig'uvchi (Fluent Bit), monitoring (`node_exporter`), CSI node plugin, security agentlari (Falco).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
DaemonSet fluent-bit
  node-a --> fluent-bit-xxxx
  node-b --> fluent-bit-yyyy
  node-c (yangi) --> controller avtomatik pod yaratadi
```
DaemonSet controller pod'ga node affinity qo'yadi va default scheduler joylaydi; tolerations orqali control plane yoki tainted node'larga ham tushishi mumkin.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata: { name: node-exporter }
spec:
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: ne } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: ne } }
    spec:
      nodeSelector: { kubernetes.io/os: linux }
      tolerations: [{ operator: Exists }]
      hostNetwork: true
      containers:
      - name: ne
        image: quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter:v1.8.2
```
```bash
kubectl get ds -A      # DESIRED / CURRENT / READY / UP-TO-DATE
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `tolerations: Exists` hamma taint'ga chidaydi — keraksiz node'larga ham tushadi.
- Resource request'siz DaemonSet har node'dan kutilmagan resurs yeydi; 100 node'da ko'paytirib hisoblang.
- `hostNetwork`/`hostPath` ishlatadigan DaemonSet — kuchli privilegiya, PSA bilan cheklang.

**Senior nuqta:** DaemonSet'larga yuqori PriorityClass (`system-node-critical`) bering — aks holda node to'lganda ilova pod'lari agentni chiqarib yuboradi va monitoring "ko'r" bo'lib qoladi.

41069.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Job** — pod'larni ishga tushirib, belgilangan sonda muvaffaqiyatli tugashini (run-to-completion) ta'minlaydi. **CronJob** — cron jadvali bo'yicha muntazam ravishda yangi Job yaratadi.

**Nega kerak:** Migration, hisobot, backup kabi vazifalar doim ishlamaydi — bir marta bajarilib tugaydi. Deployment ularni qayta-qayta restart qilar edi; Job esa "tugadi"ni tushunadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CronJob (schedule "0 2 * * *")
   | har kuni 02:00
   v
Job backup-28812345
   | completions, parallelism, backoffLimit
   v
Pod --> exit 0 = Succeeded | exit !=0 = qayta urinish
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata: { name: backup }
spec:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  timeZone: "Asia/Tashkent"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid        # oldingisi ishlayotgan bo'lsa yangisini boshlama
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 300
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 3
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers: [{ name: b, image: backup:1.0 }]
```
```bash
kubectl create job manual-1 --from=cronjob/backup   # qo'lda ishga tushirish
kubectl get jobs; kubectl logs job/manual-1
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Job pod'larida `restartPolicy: Always` mumkin emas.
- CronJob "kamida bir marta" kafolat beradi: ba'zan ikki marta yoki o'tkazib yuborilishi mumkin — vazifa idempotent bo'lsin.
- `ttlSecondsAfterFinished` yo'q bo'lsa tugagan Job'lar to'planib qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Og'ir batch uchun `podFailurePolicy` (masalan exit code 42 = retry qilma) va Indexed Job'dan foydalaning; murakkab DAG'lar uchun Argo Workflows yaxshiroq.

41070.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **ClusterIP** (default) — faqat klaster ichida virtual IP. **NodePort** — har node'da `30000-32767` oralig'idagi port. **LoadBalancer** — cloud'da tashqi LB yaratadi (ichida NodePort + ClusterIP). **ExternalName** — proxy'siz DNS CNAME.

**Nega kerak:** Pod IP'lari o'zgarib turadi. Service ularga barqaror nom va IP beradi, trafikni sog'lom pod'lar orasida taqsimlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Internet --> Cloud LB --> NodeIP:31080 --> ClusterIP 10.96.0.10:80 --> pod:8080
            (LoadBalancer)  (NodePort)       (ClusterIP)
ExternalName: my-db.ns.svc --CNAME--> db.example.com (IP yo'q)
```
Har tur oldingisi ustiga quriladi: LoadBalancer o'z ichida NodePort va ClusterIP'ni ham yaratadi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: web }
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector: { app: web }
  ports: [{ port: 80, targetPort: 8080 }]
```
```bash
kubectl get svc web
kubectl get endpointslice -l kubernetes.io/service-name=web   # pod IP'lar
kubectl run t --rm -it --image=busybox -- wget -qO- web
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- EndpointSlice bo'sh bo'lsa — selector label'lari pod'ga mos emas yoki pod'lar Ready emas.
- Har servisga LoadBalancer — har biri pullik LB. HTTP uchun bitta Ingress/Gateway ishlating.
- ExternalName'da TLS SNI/Host header muammolari bo'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** `externalTrafficPolicy: Local` client source IP'ni saqlaydi va qo'shimcha hop'ni olib tashlaydi, lekin pod'siz node'lar health check'dan yiqiladi va yuk notekis bo'ladi — trade-off.

41071.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Headless Service (`clusterIP: None`) virtual IP ajratmaydi va kube-proxy uni balans qilmaydi. CoreDNS servis nomiga barcha Ready pod IP'larini `A` yozuvlari sifatida qaytaradi, StatefulSet bilan esa har pod'ga alohida nom beradi.

**Nega kerak:** Kafka, Cassandra, DB cluster'larida client aniq qaysi node'ga ulanishini bilishi kerak (masalan leader'ga). Load balancer bu yerda xalaqit beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Oddiy:    nslookup web      --> 10.96.0.10 (bitta VIP)
Headless: nslookup kafka    --> 10.1.0.5, 10.1.0.6, 10.1.0.7
          nslookup kafka-0.kafka.ns.svc.cluster.local --> 10.1.0.5
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: kafka }
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector: { app: kafka }
  ports: [{ port: 9092 }]
```
```bash
kubectl run d --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 -- nslookup kafka
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Client DNS natijasini cache'lab qo'ysa (masalan eski JVM), pod IP o'zgarganda eski IP'ga ulanadi.
- Ready bo'lmagan pod'lar DNS'da ko'rinmaydi — cluster bootstrap uchun `publishNotReadyAddresses: true` kerak bo'ladi.
- Headless'da load balancing yo'q — client o'zi tanlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** gRPC client-side balancing uchun ham headless Service qulay: ClusterIP bilan HTTP/2 uzun ulanish bitta pod'ga "yopishib" qoladi.

41072.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Ingress** — L7 (HTTP/HTTPS) routing qoidalarini yozadigan API resurs (host/path, TLS). **Ingress Controller** — shu qoidalarni o'qib haqiqatda trafikni yo'naltiradigan reverse proxy (ingress-nginx, Traefik, HAProxy, AWS LB Controller). Controller'siz Ingress obyekti hech narsa qilmaydi.

**Nega kerak:** 20 ta HTTP servisga 20 ta LoadBalancer qimmat. Bitta LB + Ingress Controller host va path bo'yicha hammasiga tarqatadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Internet --> LB --> Ingress Controller pod (nginx)
                       | api.example.com/   --> svc api:80
                       | shop.example.com/  --> svc shop:80
                       +-- TLS (Secret tls-cert)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata: { name: web }
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls: [{ hosts: [api.example.com], secretName: api-tls }]
  rules:
  - host: api.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend: { service: { name: api, port: { number: 80 } } }
```
```bash
kubectl get ingressclass
kubectl describe ingress web     # ADDRESS bo'sh bo'lsa controller ko'rmayapti
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ingressClassName` yo'q — controller resursni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.
- Annotation'lar controller'ga xos: nginx annotation Traefik'da ishlamaydi.
- Community `ingress-nginx` 2026-yil mart oyida retire qilinishi e'lon qilingan — yangi loyihalarda Gateway API yoki boshqa controller rejalashtiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Ingress API "muzlatilgan" — yangi imkoniyatlar Gateway API'ga qo'shiladi. Uzoq muddatli platforma uchun Gateway API'ga migratsiyani rejalashtiring.

41073.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Gateway API — Ingress'ning zamonaviy vorisi (GA 2023, v1.0+). Resurslar rollarga bo'lingan: `GatewayClass` (infra provayder), `Gateway` (platforma jamoasi: listener, port, TLS), `HTTPRoute`/`GRPCRoute`/`TLSRoute` (dasturchi: routing qoidalari).

**Nega kerak:** Ingress'da hamma narsa bitta obyektda va annotation'lar orqali — header routing, trafik bo'lish (canary), cross-namespace ruxsat yo'q edi va har controller o'z "dialekt"ini qilardi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
GatewayClass (cilium / envoy / istio)   <- infra admin
   v
Gateway  ns: infra, listener :443 TLS   <- platforma jamoasi
   v  allowedRoutes: namespace'lar
HTTPRoute ns: team-a  /api -> svc v1 90%, v2 10%   <- dasturchi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata: { name: api, namespace: team-a }
spec:
  parentRefs: [{ name: main-gw, namespace: infra }]
  hostnames: [api.example.com]
  rules:
  - matches: [{ path: { type: PathPrefix, value: / } }]
    backendRefs:
    - { name: api-v1, port: 80, weight: 90 }
    - { name: api-v2, port: 80, weight: 10 }
```
```bash
kubectl get gateway,httproute -A
kubectl describe httproute api    # status.parents: Accepted / ResolvedRefs
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CRD'lar klasterga alohida o'rnatiladi (standard yoki experimental channel).
- Boshqa namespace'dagi Service'ga murojaat uchun `ReferenceGrant` kerak.
- Har implementatsiya hamma xususiyatni qo'llamaydi — conformance jadvalini tekshiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Gateway API service mesh (GAMMA) uchun ham standart bo'lib bormoqda — bitta API bilan north-south va east-west trafik.

41074.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Namespace — bitta klaster ichidagi mantiqiy bo'linma: obyekt nomlari, RBAC, ResourceQuota, LimitRange va NetworkPolicy uchun doira. Lekin u **to'liq xavfsizlik chegarasi emas**: default'da tarmoq ochiq, node va kernel umumiy.

**Nega kerak:** Bir klasterda bir nechta jamoa yoki muhit (dev/stage) ishlaganda nomlar to'qnashmasligi, ruxsat va resurslarni ajratish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Namespace team-a: RBAC (Role), ResourceQuota (cpu 20), NetworkPolicy
Namespace team-b: ...
Umumiy: Node, PV, StorageClass, CRD, ClusterRole (cluster-scoped)
Tarmoq: team-a pod --> team-b pod  (NetworkPolicy yo'q bo'lsa OCHIQ)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl create ns team-a
kubectl api-resources --namespaced=false     # namespace'ga tegishli bo'lmaganlar
kubectl create quota q --hard=cpu=20,memory=64Gi,pods=100 -n team-a
kubectl label ns team-a pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted
```
DNS: `svc.team-b.svc.cluster.local` — boshqa namespace'dagi servis nomi to'liq yozilsa ishlaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Namespace o'chirilsa ichidagi hamma narsa o'chadi; finalizer'lar sabab `Terminating` da qotib qolishi mumkin.
- Privileged pod boshqa namespace'dagi pod'lar bilan bitta node'da — kernel orqali chiqib ketishi mumkin.
- `default` namespace'da production ishlatish — tartibsizlik.

**Senior nuqta:** Soft multi-tenancy (ishonchli jamoalar) uchun namespace + RBAC + NetworkPolicy + PSA yetadi. Hard multi-tenancy (begona mijozlar) uchun alohida klaster, vCluster yoki sandbox runtime kerak.

41075.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **ConfigMap** — maxfiy bo'lmagan konfiguratsiya. **Secret** — parol, token, kalit; base64 bilan **kodlangan, shifrlanmagan**. etcd'da shifrlash faqat `EncryptionConfiguration`/KMS yoqilganda bo'ladi; kirishni RBAC cheklaydi.

**Nega kerak:** Konfiguratsiyani image ichiga tiqmaslik kerak — bitta image har muhitda boshqa config bilan ishlaydi (12-factor).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ConfigMap / Secret --> env var    (pod start'da bir marta o'qiladi)
                  --> volume fayl (kubelet ~1 daqiqada yangilaydi)
Secret: kubelet tmpfs'da (RAM) saqlaydi, diskka yozmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl create configmap app --from-literal=LOG_LEVEL=info
kubectl create secret generic db --from-literal=password='S3cr3t'
kubectl get secret db -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' | base64 -d   # oson ochiladi!
```
```yaml
envFrom:
- configMapRef: { name: app }
env:
- name: DB_PASS
  valueFrom: { secretKeyRef: { name: db, key: password } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret YAML'ni git'ga qo'yish = parolni ochiq qo'yish. Sealed Secrets, SOPS yoki External Secrets ishlating.
- Env var'dagi qiymat yangilanganda pod restart bo'lmaguncha o'zgarmaydi.
- `list secrets` ruxsati namespace'dagi hamma sirni ochadi.
- Hajm limiti ~1MiB.

**Senior nuqta:** KMS v2 bilan envelope encryption yoqing, Secret'larni tashqi manbadan (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) sinxronlang va o'zgarmas config uchun `immutable: true` qo'ying — kube-apiserver yukini ham kamaytiradi.

41076.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **PV (PersistentVolume)** — klasterdagi haqiqiy storage bo'lagi (EBS disk, NFS share), cluster-scoped. **PVC (PersistentVolumeClaim)** — foydalanuvchining "menga 10Gi RWO disk kerak" degan so'rovi, namespace'ga tegishli. Kubernetes PVC'ni mos PV bilan **bind** qiladi.

**Nega kerak:** Dasturchi diskning qayerdan kelishini bilmasligi kerak; admin yoki StorageClass storage beradi. Bu storage'ni pod hayotidan ajratadi — pod o'lsa ham ma'lumot qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod --volumes.persistentVolumeClaim--> PVC (10Gi, RWO, sc gp3)
                                         | bind (1:1)
                                         v
                                        PV (EBS vol-0abc, 10Gi)
                                         |
                                       CSI driver -> node'ga attach + mount
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata: { name: data }
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  storageClassName: gp3
  resources: { requests: { storage: 10Gi } }
```
```bash
kubectl get pvc data          # STATUS: Pending / Bound
kubectl get pv                # RECLAIM POLICY, STATUS
kubectl describe pvc data     # Pending sababi Events'da
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Delete` — PVC o'chirilsa disk ham o'chadi. Muhim ma'lumot uchun `Retain`.
- PVC `Pending` — StorageClass yo'q, hajm mos emas yoki AZ muammosi.
- PV bir marta bind bo'lsa boshqa PVC'ga avtomatik o'tmaydi (`Released` holat).

**Senior nuqta:** PVC — backup emas. VolumeSnapshot yoki Velero bilan backup oling va restore'ni sinab ko'ring; disk kengaytirish uchun `allowVolumeExpansion: true`.

41077.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Dynamic provisioning — PVC `storageClassName` ko'rsatsa, CSI driver haqiqiy diskni (masalan AWS gp3) **avtomatik yaratadi** va PV'ni bind qiladi. Admin oldindan PV tayyorlab qo'yishi shart emas.

**Nega kerak:** Static provisioning'da admin yuzlab PV'ni qo'lda yaratishi kerak edi. StorageClass "disk shabloni"ni beradi, qolganini Kubernetes o'zi qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PVC (sc: gp3) --> external-provisioner (CSI) --> cloud API CreateVolume
                                               v
                                    PV yaratiladi --> PVC bilan bind
WaitForFirstConsumer: pod schedule bo'lguncha kutadi -> disk pod'ning AZ'ida yaratiladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: gp3
  annotations: { storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true" }
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
parameters: { type: gp3, encrypted: "true" }
reclaimPolicy: Delete
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
allowVolumeExpansion: true
```
```bash
kubectl get sc                 # (default) belgisi
kubectl describe pvc data      # "waiting for first consumer" — normal
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Immediate` binding'da disk `us-east-1a` da, pod esa `1b` ga tushadi — pod abadiy Pending.
- Ikki default StorageClass bo'lsa natija kutilmagan.
- In-tree provisioner'lar (`kubernetes.io/aws-ebs`) olib tashlangan — CSI driver o'rnating.

**Senior nuqta:** Turli SLA uchun alohida klasslar (`fast-ssd`, `standard`, `retain`) yarating va default'ni ehtiyotkor (shifrlangan, expansion yoqilgan) qiling.

41078.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Access mode — volume qanday ulanishi mumkinligi: **RWO** (bitta node read-write), **ROX** (ko'p node read-only), **RWX** (ko'p node read-write), **RWOP** (faqat bitta pod read-write, 1.29'dan GA).

**Nega kerak:** Har storage turi har xil imkoniyatga ega: blok disk (EBS) bir vaqtda bitta mashinaga ulanadi, NFS/EFS esa ko'pchilikka. Noto'g'ri mode tanlash pod Pending yoki ma'lumot buzilishiga olib keladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
| Mode | Kim yozadi | Misol storage |
|---|---|---|
| RWO | bitta **node** (undagi bir nechta pod ham) | EBS, PD, Azure Disk |
| ROX | ko'p node, faqat o'qish | NFS, snapshot'dan |
| RWX | ko'p node, yozish | EFS, NFS, CephFS, Azure Files |
| RWOP | aynan bitta **pod** | CSI disk'lar |

```
RWO: node-a [pod1, pod2] OK   node-b [pod3] --> Multi-Attach error
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get pvc -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,MODES:.spec.accessModes
kubectl describe pod web | grep -A3 Multi-Attach
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- RWO "bitta pod" degani emas — bir node'dagi bir nechta pod yozishi mumkin; aniq bitta pod uchun RWOP.
- Deployment rolling update'da RWO disk: yangi pod boshqa node'ga tushsa eski pod disk'ni bo'shatmaguncha kutadi — `Recreate` strategiya yoki StatefulSet.
- RWX (NFS) ustida DB ishlatish — locking va performance muammolari.

**Senior nuqta:** RWX'ga ehtiyoj ko'pincha arxitektura signali: umumiy fayllar uchun object storage (S3) odatda yaxshiroq va arzonroq.

41079.a:
**Qisqa javob:** ServiceAccount — pod'ning (inson emas, ilovaning) Kubernetes API'dagi identiteti. Pod'ga qisqa muddatli, audience'ga bog'langan token projected volume orqali mount qilinadi (`/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token`); RBAC shu identitetga ruxsat beradi.

**Nega kerak:** Operator, CI agent yoki ilova API'ga murojaat qilsa, kimligini isbotlashi va faqat kerakli ruxsatga ega bo'lishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod (serviceAccountName: app)
  token (JWT, ~1 soat, kubelet avtomatik yangilaydi)
   v
kube-apiserver: sub=system:serviceaccount:ns:app
   v RBAC
RoleBinding app -> Role (get configmaps)
Cloud: IRSA / EKS Pod Identity / GKE Workload Identity -> IAM rol
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl create sa app -n prod
kubectl create token app -n prod --duration=10m     # qo'lda token
kubectl auth can-i list pods --as=system:serviceaccount:prod:app
```
```yaml
spec:
  serviceAccountName: app
  automountServiceAccountToken: false   # API kerak bo'lmasa
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har namespace'da `default` SA bor va avtomatik mount qilinadi — buzilgan pod token bilan API'ga chiqadi.
- 1.24'dan uzoq muddatli Secret token'lar avtomatik yaratilmaydi; eski skriptlar buziladi.
- Bitta SA'ni ko'p ilovaga berish — least privilege buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** SA token'ni OIDC orqali cloud IAM'ga federatsiya qiling — statik cloud access key'larini butunlay yo'qotadi.

41080.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Role** — bitta namespace'dagi ruxsatlar. **ClusterRole** — klaster bo'yicha yoki cluster-scoped resurslar (Node, PV) uchun ruxsatlar. **RoleBinding** — Role yoki ClusterRole'ni namespace ichida subject'ga beradi. **ClusterRoleBinding** — ClusterRole'ni butun klasterda beradi.

**Nega kerak:** "Kim nima qila oladi"ni least privilege bilan boshqarish: dasturchi o'z namespace'ida deploy qila olsin, lekin node yoki boshqa jamoaning Secret'iga tegmasin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Role/ClusterRole = NIMA (apiGroups, resources, verbs)
Binding          = KIMGA (User, Group, ServiceAccount) + QAYERDA

ClusterRole "view" + RoleBinding ns:team-a  --> faqat team-a'da view
ClusterRole "view" + ClusterRoleBinding     --> hamma namespace'da view
```
RBAC faqat ruxsat beradi (allow); "deny" qoidasi yo'q.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata: { name: deployer, namespace: team-a }
rules:
- apiGroups: [apps]
  resources: [deployments]
  verbs: [get, list, watch, create, update, patch]
---
kind: RoleBinding
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata: { name: deployer, namespace: team-a }
subjects: [{ kind: Group, name: team-a-devs, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io }]
roleRef: { kind: Role, name: deployer, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io }
```
```bash
kubectl auth can-i create deploy -n team-a --as=alice --as-group=team-a-devs
kubectl auth can-i --list -n team-a
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `*` verb/resource — keyinchalik qo'shilgan resurslarga ham ruxsat beradi.
- `create pods` yoki `escalate`/`bind`/`impersonate` — amalda admin'ga chiqish yo'li.
- `roleRef` o'zgartirilmaydi — binding'ni qayta yaratish kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Qayta ishlatiladigan ClusterRole + namespace'li RoleBinding — eng toza pattern. RBAC'ni muntazam audit qiling (`rakkess`, `kubectl-who-can`).

41081.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Admission controller — so'rov autentifikatsiya va avtorizatsiyadan o'tgandan keyin, lekin obyekt etcd'ga yozilishidan **oldin** uni ushlaydigan plugin. **Mutating** obyektni o'zgartiradi (default qo'shish, sidecar inject), **Validating** esa qabul yoki rad qiladi.

**Nega kerak:** RBAC faqat "kim nima qila oladi"ni tekshiradi, lekin "privileged pod yaratmang" yoki "har pod'da limit bo'lsin" kabi mazmun qoidalarini tekshira olmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl --> authn --> authz (RBAC) --> Mutating admission --> schema validation
                                           (webhook, built-in)        v
                                    Validating admission (VAP, webhook) --> etcd
```
Built-in misollar: `NamespaceLifecycle`, `LimitRanger`, `ResourceQuota`, `PodSecurity`, `DefaultStorageClass`. Tashqi: `MutatingWebhookConfiguration` / `ValidatingWebhookConfiguration` (Kyverno, Gatekeeper, Istio injector). In-tree: `ValidatingAdmissionPolicy` (CEL, 1.30 GA) — webhook'siz.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata: { name: replicas-limit }
spec:
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules: [{ apiGroups: [apps], apiVersions: [v1], operations: [CREATE, UPDATE], resources: [deployments] }]
  validations:
  - expression: "object.spec.replicas <= 20"
    message: "replicas 20 dan oshmasin"
```
```bash
kubectl get validatingwebhookconfigurations,mutatingwebhookconfigurations
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Webhook servisi o'lsa va `failurePolicy: Fail` bo'lsa — butun klasterda deploy to'xtaydi.
- Mutating webhook'lar tartibi kafolatlanmagan; bir-biriga bog'lanmang.
- Webhook'ni `kube-system` ga ham qo'llash — o'zini o'zi bloklash xavfi; `namespaceSelector` bilan istisno qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** Oddiy qoidalar uchun webhook emas, CEL asosidagi ValidatingAdmissionPolicy/MutatingAdmissionPolicy afzal — tarmoq hop'i va qo'shimcha failure point yo'q.

41082.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Startup** — ilova ishga tushib bo'ldimi (o'tguncha qolgan probe'lar o'chiq). **Liveness** — process tirikmi; yiqilsa kubelet container'ni **restart** qiladi. **Readiness** — trafik qabul qilishga tayyormi; yiqilsa pod Service endpoint'laridan **chiqariladi**, restart bo'lmaydi.

**Nega kerak:** Process tirik bo'lishi uning ishlayotganini anglatmaydi: deadlock'da qotgan ilovani faqat liveness restart qiladi; cache isitayotgan ilovaga trafik yubormaslikni readiness hal qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
start --> startupProbe (failureThreshold*period gacha kutadi)
            | OK
            v
        livenessProbe  -- fail N marta --> restart container
        readinessProbe -- fail --> EndpointSlice'dan olib tashlash
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
startupProbe:
  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }
  failureThreshold: 30
  periodSeconds: 5          # 150s gacha start'ga vaqt
livenessProbe:
  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 3
readinessProbe:
  httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }
  periodSeconds: 5
```
```bash
kubectl describe pod web | grep -A5 -i unhealthy
kubectl get pod web -w    # RESTARTS ortib borayaptimi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Liveness ichida DB'ni tekshirish: DB sekinlashsa hamma pod'lar birdan restart bo'ladi — kaskad nosozlik.
- `initialDelaySeconds` kichik, startup probe yo'q — sekin JVM ilovasi cheksiz restart loop'ga tushadi.
- Liveness va readiness bir xil endpoint va bir xil threshold — ma'nosi yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Liveness faqat "process o'zini tiklay olmaydigan holatda"ni tekshirsin (arzon, lokal). Dependency holati — readiness yoki umuman circuit breaker'ning ishi.

41083.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Init container — asosiy container'lardan **oldin**, ketma-ket ishlab, muvaffaqiyatli tugashi shart bo'lgan container'lar. Biri yiqilsa pod `Init:Error`/`Init:CrashLoopBackOff` holatida qoladi va asosiy container start bo'lmaydi.

**Nega kerak:** Tayyorgarlik ishlarini ilova image'idan ajratish: DB tayyor bo'lishini kutish, config yuklab olish, fayl ruxsatlarini to'g'rilash. Asboblar (curl, git) asosiy image'ga kirmaydi — attack surface kichik.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
init-1 (wait-db) --exit 0--> init-2 (migrate) --exit 0--> app + sidecar (parallel)
       | exit 1
       v restartPolicy bo'yicha qayta urinish
```
1.29'dan beri **native sidecar**: `initContainers` ichida `restartPolicy: Always` — u init sifatida start bo'ladi, lekin pod umri bo'yi ishlaydi (Istio, log agent uchun).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
initContainers:
- name: wait-db
  image: busybox:1.36
  command: ['sh','-c','until nc -z db 5432; do echo kutyapman; sleep 2; done']
- name: log-agent            # native sidecar
  image: fluent-bit:3.1
  restartPolicy: Always
containers:
- name: app
  image: app:1.0
```
```bash
kubectl logs web -c wait-db
kubectl get pod web     # Init:0/2, PodInitializing
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Migration'ni init container'da qilish: 10 replika = 10 ta parallel migration. Alohida Job yoki lock kerak.
- Init container'da probe yo'q (native sidecar'dan tashqari).
- Init resource request'lari pod request hisobiga kiradi (max qoidasi).

**Senior nuqta:** "DB'ni kutish" o'rniga ilovaning o'zi retry bilan ulansin — bu restart va network blip'larda ham ishlaydi; init container faqat haqiqiy one-time tayyorgarlik uchun.

41084.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ephemeral container — ishlab turgan pod'ga **restart qilmasdan** debug uchun vaqtincha qo'shiladigan container (`kubectl debug`). Pod spec'da `ephemeralContainers` ga yoziladi, port, probe va resurs kafolati yo'q, olib tashlab bo'lmaydi.

**Nega kerak:** Production image'lar distroless yoki minimal — ichida `sh`, `curl`, `tcpdump` yo'q. Restart qilsak muammo (masalan xotira oqishi) yo'qoladi. Ephemeral container shu holatni o'zgartirmasdan ichiga kirishga imkon beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod web
  app (distroless, PID 1)
  debugger-x (busybox/netshoot)  --target=app --> app'ning PID namespace'ini ko'radi
  umumiy: network namespace (localhost, IP)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Ishlayotgan pod'ga debug container
kubectl debug -it web --image=nicolaka/netshoot --target=app -- bash
  ps aux                 # app process'larini ko'rasiz
  ss -tlnp; curl localhost:8080/healthz
  ls /proc/1/root/app    # app'ning fayl tizimi

# Pod nusxasi (original'ga tegmaslik uchun)
kubectl debug web -it --copy-to=web-dbg --image=busybox --share-processes

# Node'ni debug qilish
kubectl debug node/node-a -it --image=ubuntu    # /host ga node root
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--target` bo'lmasa process'lar ko'rinmaydi (alohida PID namespace).
- Restricted PSA `--profile` ga qarab bloklashi mumkin; `--profile=restricted|netadmin|sysadmin` tanlang.
- Ephemeral container o'chirilmaydi — pod qayta yaratilguncha spec'da qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** `pods/ephemeralcontainers` subresource'iga RBAC ruxsati — bu amalda pod ichiga kirish huquqi; uni `exec` kabi kuchli ruxsat sifatida cheklang va audit qiling.

41085.a:
**Qisqa javob:** PodDisruptionBudget (PDB) — **ixtiyoriy** uzilishlarda (node drain, cluster upgrade, Karpenter consolidation) bir vaqtda nechta pod o'chirilishi mumkinligini cheklaydi: `minAvailable` yoki `maxUnavailable`.

**Nega kerak:** Node upgrade paytida 3 replikali servisning hamma pod'lari bitta node'da bo'lsa, drain ularni birdan o'chiradi va servis yiqiladi. PDB Eviction API'ni "kut"ga majburlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl drain node-a
   v Eviction API (DELETE emas)
PDB tekshiradi: Ready pod'lar - 1 >= minAvailable ?
   ha  --> evict
   yo'q --> 429 Too Many Requests, drain kutadi va qayta urinadi
```
Majburiy uzilishlar (node crash, OOM) PDB'ni hurmat qilmaydi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata: { name: api }
spec:
  maxUnavailable: 1
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow
```
```bash
kubectl get pdb      # ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS ustuni
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- 1 replika + `minAvailable: 1` = drain hech qachon tugamaydi, upgrade qotadi.
- `kubectl delete pod` PDB'ni chetlab o'tadi — faqat eviction hisobga olinadi.
- Selector boshqa servis pod'larini ham ushlasa hisob noto'g'ri bo'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** `maxUnavailable` foiz bilan (`25%`) scale bilan moslashadi; `unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow` buzuq pod'lar drain'ni bloklashining oldini oladi.

41086.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Requests** — pod uchun rezerv qilingan resurs; scheduler shunga qarab node tanlaydi. **Limits** — yuqori chegara: CPU oshsa **throttling** (sekinlashadi), memory oshsa **OOMKill** (container o'ldiriladi).

**Nega kerak:** Request'siz scheduler node'ni haddan tashqari to'ldiradi; limit'siz bitta "shovqinli qo'shni" pod butun node xotirasini yeb qo'yishi mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Scheduler: sum(requests) <= node allocatable ?  (haqiqiy ishlatish EMAS)
Runtime (cgroup v2):
  cpu.weight   <- cpu request (raqobatda ulush)
  cpu.max      <- cpu limit   (100ms davrda kvota -> throttle)
  memory.max   <- memory limit (oshsa OOM killer)
```
Birlik: `500m` = 0.5 CPU; `512Mi` = 512 MiB.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
resources:
  requests: { cpu: 250m, memory: 256Mi }
  limits:   { memory: 512Mi }        # CPU limit ko'pincha qo'yilmaydi
```
```bash
kubectl top pod --containers
kubectl describe node node-a | grep -A8 "Allocated resources"
kubectl get pod web -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState}'  # OOMKilled?
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CPU limit latency'ni buzadi: ko'p thread'li ilova 100ms kvotani 20ms'da tugatib, 80ms kutadi (p99 o'sadi).
- Memory request << limit — node overcommit, keyin eviction.
- JVM/Go heap limit'ni bilmasa OOMKill; `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage` yoki `GOMEMLIMIT` qo'ying.

**Senior nuqta:** Amaliy qoida: memory request = limit (bashorat qilinadigan), CPU request bor, CPU limit yo'q (yoki keng). Request'larni VPA tavsiyasi yoki real p95 ishlatishdan oling.

41087.a:
**Qisqa javob:** QoS klass resurs sozlamasidan avtomatik chiqadi: **Guaranteed** (har container'da CPU va memory request = limit), **Burstable** (kamida bitta request/limit bor, lekin Guaranteed emas), **BestEffort** (hech narsa yo'q). Xotira bosimida birinchi BestEffort, oxirida Guaranteed evict qilinadi.

**Nega kerak:** Node xotirasi tugaganda kubelet kimni qurbon qilishni hal qilishi kerak — QoS shu tartibni belgilaydi va OOM score'ga ta'sir qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
| QoS | Shart | oom_score_adj | Eviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Guaranteed | request = limit (cpu+mem, hamma container) | -997 | oxirgi |
| Burstable | qisman | 2..999 | o'rtada (request'dan oshganlar avval) |
| BestEffort | yo'q | 1000 | birinchi |

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get pod web -o jsonpath='{.status.qosClass}'
kubectl get pods -A -o custom-columns=NS:.metadata.namespace,NAME:.metadata.name,QOS:.status.qosClass
```
```yaml
resources:     # Guaranteed
  requests: { cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi }
  limits:   { cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bitta sidecar'da limit yo'q — butun pod Burstable bo'lib qoladi.
- Guaranteed + butun CPU son + `cpuManagerPolicy: static` — eksklyuziv core beradi; buni bilmasdan latency farqini tushunish qiyin.
- QoS yaratilgandan keyin o'zgarmaydi (in-place resize ham QoS'ni saqlashi kerak).

**Senior nuqta:** Kritik servislarni Guaranteed qiling, batch ishlarni Burstable/BestEffort — node'dan samarali foydalanish va himoya o'rtasidagi balans.

41088.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Node affinity** — pod qaysi node'larga tushishi mumkinligini node label'lari bo'yicha belgilaydi. **Pod anti-affinity** — pod'ni boshqa pod'lar (odatda o'z replikalari) bor joydan uzoqroq joylaydi. Ikkalasida `required...` (qat'iy) va `preferred...` (afzal, og'irlik bilan) bor.

**Nega kerak:** GPU ilovasi faqat GPU node'ga tushsin (affinity); 3 replika bitta node'da bo'lmasin, aks holda node o'lsa servis o'ladi (anti-affinity).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
nodeAffinity:      node label'lari  (zone=a, gpu=true)
podAffinity:       "X pod'lar bor topology'ga tush" (cache yonida)
podAntiAffinity:   "X pod'lar bor topology'ga tushma"
topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname | topology.kubernetes.io/zone
IgnoredDuringExecution: label keyin o'zgarsa pod ko'chirilmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
affinity:
  nodeAffinity:
    requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions: [{ key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type, operator: In, values: [m6i.large, m7i.large] }]
  podAntiAffinity:
    preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
    - weight: 100
      podAffinityTerm:
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
        labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `required` anti-affinity + replika soni > node soni = ortiqcha pod'lar abadiy Pending.
- Pod (anti-)affinity katta klasterda scheduler'ni sezilarli sekinlashtiradi.
- Oddiy holatda `nodeSelector` yetarli — murakkab sintaksis keraksiz.

**Senior nuqta:** Replikalarni tarqatish uchun anti-affinity o'rniga **topology spread constraints** aniqroq va arzonroq; anti-affinity'ni "bir node'da ikkitasi bo'lmasin" qat'iy holatlar uchun qoldiring.

41089.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Taint** node'ga qo'yiladi va pod'larni "itaradi" (`key=value:Effect`). **Toleration** pod'ga qo'yiladi va mos taint'li node'ga tushishga **ruxsat** beradi, lekin u yerga **majburlamaydi** — buning uchun affinity/nodeSelector ham kerak.

**Nega kerak:** GPU yoki maxsus node'larga oddiy pod'lar tushib, qimmat resursni egallamasligi uchun. Shuningdek muammoli node'dan pod'larni chiqarish (`NoExecute`).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
| Effect | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `NoSchedule` | toleration'siz yangi pod tushmaydi |
| `PreferNoSchedule` | iloji bo'lsa tushirma |
| `NoExecute` | mavjud toleration'siz pod'lar ham chiqariladi (`tolerationSeconds`) |

```
node gpu-1 taint: gpu=true:NoSchedule
pod A (toleration yo'q)  --> X
pod B (toleration + nodeSelector gpu=true) --> gpu-1
```
Avtomatik taint'lar: `node.kubernetes.io/not-ready`, `unreachable` (default 300s tolerate), `node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane`.

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl taint nodes gpu-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule
kubectl taint nodes gpu-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule-     # olib tashlash
kubectl describe node gpu-1 | grep Taints
```
```yaml
tolerations:
- { key: gpu, operator: Equal, value: "true", effect: NoSchedule }
nodeSelector: { gpu: "true" }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat toleration qo'yib "pod GPU node'ga tushadi" deb kutish.
- `operator: Exists` kalit'siz — hamma taint'ga chidaydi.
- `NoExecute` taint'ni qo'shish darhol pod'larni o'ldiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Dedicated node pool pattern: taint (begonalarni itar) + label va affinity (o'zinikini jalb qil) — ikkalasi birga.

41090.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Topology spread constraints — pod'larni failure domain'lar (zone, node, rack) bo'ylab **teng** taqsimlash qoidasi. `maxSkew` — eng ko'p va eng kam pod bo'lgan domain orasidagi ruxsat etilgan farq.

**Nega kerak:** 6 replika bo'lsa ham hammasi bitta AZ'da bo'lsa, AZ o'chganda servis o'ladi. Anti-affinity "bittadan ko'p bo'lmasin" deydi, spread esa "teng bo'lsin" deydi — ko'p replikada ancha moslashuvchan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
maxSkew: 1, topologyKey: zone
 zone-a: 2   zone-b: 2   zone-c: 1   -> yangi pod zone-c ga (skew saqlanadi)
 zone-a: 3   zone-b: 1               -> skew 2 > 1, ruxsat yo'q
whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule (qat'iy) | ScheduleAnyway (afzal)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
topologySpreadConstraints:
- maxSkew: 1
  topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
  whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  matchLabelKeys: [pod-template-hash]     # faqat joriy versiya hisoblanadi
- maxSkew: 1
  topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
  whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
```
```bash
kubectl get pods -l app=api -o wide    # NODE ustunidan taqsimotni tekshiring
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Spread faqat **scheduling paytida** ishlaydi; keyin muvozanat buzilsa avtomatik tuzatilmaydi (descheduler kerak).
- `matchLabelKeys` siz rolling update'da eski versiya pod'lari ham hisoblanib, taqsimot qiyshayadi.
- Node'siz zone (autoscaler hali yaratmagan) hisobga olinmaydi — `minDomains` bilan majburlang.

**Senior nuqta:** Zone bo'yicha `DoNotSchedule` + host bo'yicha `ScheduleAnyway` — amaliy default; klaster darajasida `defaultConstraints` bilan hamma workload'ga qo'llash mumkin.

41091.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubelet eviction manager node resurslarini (memory, disk `nodefs`/`imagefs`, PID) kuzatadi va chegara oshganda node'ni qutqarish uchun pod'larni **evict** qiladi. Bu kernel OOM killer'dan oldin, "nazorat ostidagi" himoya.

**Nega kerak:** Agar node xotirasi butunlay tugasa, kernel OOM killer tasodifiy process'ni (hatto kubelet'ni) o'ldirishi va node `NotReady` bo'lishi mumkin. Eviction manager buni oldindan, tartib bilan qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
signal: memory.available < 100Mi (hard)  -> darhol evict
        memory.available < 500Mi 1m30s (soft + grace) -> evict
tartib: 1) request'dan oshgan pod'lar  2) PriorityClass  3) request'ga nisbatan ishlatish
node condition: MemoryPressure / DiskPressure / PIDPressure -> yangi pod'lar tushmaydi
disk: avval image va o'lik container'larni GC, keyin evict
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# KubeletConfiguration
evictionHard:
  memory.available: "200Mi"
  nodefs.available: "10%"
  imagefs.available: "15%"
evictionSoft: { memory.available: "500Mi" }
evictionSoftGracePeriod: { memory.available: "1m30s" }
```
```bash
kubectl describe node node-a | grep -A6 Conditions
kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Failed | grep Evicted
kubectl get events -A --field-selector reason=Evicted
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Evicted pod'lar `Failed` holatda to'planib qoladi — vaqti-vaqti bilan tozalang.
- Eviction tezligi kubelet poll intervaliga bog'liq; tez o'sgan xotirada baribir kernel OOM ishlaydi.
- Log fayllari `nodefs`ni to'ldirib, DiskPressure va ommaviy eviction'ga olib keladi.

**Senior nuqta:** `systemReserved`/`kubeReserved` + to'g'ri request'lar eviction'ning asosiy oldini olish; eviction — oxirgi himoya chizig'i, normal ish rejimi emas.

41092.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **PriorityClass** pod'ga nisbiy muhimlik raqamini beradi. Yuqori prioritetli pod resurs yo'qligi sababli joylasha olmasa, scheduler past prioritetli pod'larni **preempt** qiladi (o'chiradi) va joy bo'shatadi.

**Nega kerak:** Klaster to'lganda to'lov servisi batch hisobot ortida navbatda turmasligi kerak. Shuningdek kube-system komponentlari doim joy topishi shart.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pending pod P (priority 1000000)
  scheduler: hech bir node mos emas
   v
  node-a'da past prioritetli pod'larni olib tashlasa P sig'adimi?
   ha -> victim'larni graceful o'chiradi, P.status.nominatedNodeName=node-a
   v
  P node-a'ga joylanadi
```
Built-in: `system-cluster-critical` (2000000000), `system-node-critical` (2000001000).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata: { name: business-critical }
value: 1000000
preemptionPolicy: PreemptLowerPriority   # yoki Never
globalDefault: false
description: "To'lov va auth servislari"
```
```yaml
spec:
  priorityClassName: business-critical
```
```bash
kubectl get priorityclass
kubectl get events | grep -i preempt
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hamma jamoa o'z servisini "eng muhim" qilsa tizim ma'nosiz bo'ladi — ResourceQuota bilan PriorityClass ishlatishni cheklang.
- Preemption PDB'ni "imkon qadar" hurmat qiladi, lekin kafolat bermaydi.
- `preemptionPolicy: Never` — navbatda oldinda turadi, lekin boshqalarni o'ldirmaydi (batch uchun yaxshi).

**Senior nuqta:** "Overprovisioning" pattern: manfiy prioritetli bo'sh pause pod'lar joy egallab turadi; haqiqiy pod kelganda ular preempt bo'ladi va autoscaler yangi node'ni oldindan qo'shadi — scale-up latency yashiriladi.

41093.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) — metrikaga (CPU, memory, custom yoki external) qarab Deployment/StatefulSet **replika sonini** avtomatik o'zgartiradigan control loop. Default har 15 soniyada tekshiradi.

**Nega kerak:** Kunduzi 20 pod kerak, tunda 3 ta yetadi. Qo'lda scale qilish kech va qimmat.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
desired = ceil( current * currentMetric / targetMetric )
misol: 4 pod, CPU 90%, target 60% -> ceil(4*90/60) = 6
metrics.k8s.io (Metrics Server)  -> cpu/memory
custom.metrics.k8s.io (Prometheus Adapter) -> RPS, queue
external.metrics.k8s.io (KEDA) -> SQS, Kafka lag
```
CPU foizi **request**ga nisbatan hisoblanadi — request yo'q bo'lsa HPA ishlamaydi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata: { name: api }
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 30
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource: { name: cpu, target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 60 } }
  behavior:
    scaleDown: { stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300 }
```
```bash
kubectl get hpa api -w        # TARGETS: 45%/60%
kubectl describe hpa api      # <unknown> bo'lsa metrics kelmayapti
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Deployment manifest'ida `replicas` qoldirilsa, har `kubectl apply` HPA tanlagan sonni qaytarib yozadi.
- Memory bo'yicha scale ko'pincha ishlamaydi — ko'p ilova xotirani qaytarmaydi.
- Pod'lar sekin start bo'lsa HPA kech qoladi; minReplicas'ni zaxira bilan qo'ying.

**Senior nuqta:** CPU proxy metrika; navbat yoki RPS bo'yicha scale ko'pincha aniqroq. HPA'ni cluster autoscaler bilan birga o'ylang — pod qo'shilsa ham node bo'lmasa ular Pending.

41094.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) — pod'larning tarixiy ishlatishiga qarab CPU/memory **request**larini (va proporsional limit'larni) tavsiya qiladi yoki avtomatik o'rnatadi. Replika sonini emas, har pod "o'lchami"ni o'zgartiradi.

**Nega kerak:** Dasturchilar request'ni taxminan yozadi: ko'pincha 4 marta ortiq (pul isrofi) yoki kam (OOMKill). VPA real ma'lumotdan to'g'ri qiymat beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Recommender  --> Metrics/Prometheus tarixi -> target, lowerBound, upperBound
Updater      --> request juda farq qilsa pod'ni evict qiladi (Auto/Recreate)
Admission    --> yangi pod yaratilganda request'ni o'zgartiradi
updateMode: Off (faqat tavsiya) | Initial | Recreate | Auto | InPlaceOrRecreate (yangi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling.k8s.io/v1
kind: VerticalPodAutoscaler
metadata: { name: api }
spec:
  targetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }
  updatePolicy: { updateMode: "Off" }
  resourcePolicy:
    containerPolicies:
    - containerName: "*"
      minAllowed: { memory: 128Mi }
      maxAllowed: { cpu: "2", memory: 4Gi }
```
```bash
kubectl describe vpa api    # Recommendation: Target cpu 320m memory 410Mi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- VPA va HPA bir xil metrika (CPU) bo'yicha birga — bir-biriga qarshi ishlaydi.
- `Auto` rejimda pod'lar evict bo'ladi; PDB bo'lmasa uzilish.
- VPA alohida o'rnatiladi (klasterda default yo'q).

**Senior nuqta:** Eng xavfsiz yo'l — `Off` rejimda tavsiyani yig'ib, uni GitOps orqali manifest'ga kiritish. 1.33+ dagi in-place pod resize VPA'ni restart'siz qilishga yo'l ochmoqda.

41095.a:
**Qisqa javob:** KEDA (Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling) — tashqi event manbalariga (Kafka lag, SQS navbat uzunligi, RabbitMQ, Prometheus query, cron) qarab workload'ni scale qiladi, shu jumladan **0 gacha** va 0 dan. CNCF graduated loyiha.

**Nega kerak:** Navbat consumer'i uchun CPU yomon signal: navbatda 100 000 xabar turgan bo'lishi mumkin, CPU esa past. Bundan tashqari, bo'sh paytda 0 replika — pul tejaydi; oddiy HPA min 1.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ScaledObject --> KEDA operator
                   | 0 <-> 1 (o'zi aktivatsiya qiladi)
                   | 1 <-> N (HPA yaratib, external metrics beradi)
                   v
             scaler: kafka / aws-sqs-queue / prometheus / cron ...
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata: { name: orders-consumer }
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { name: orders-consumer }
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 50
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  triggers:
  - type: kafka
    metadata:
      bootstrapServers: kafka:9092
      consumerGroup: orders
      topic: orders
      lagThreshold: "1000"
```
```bash
kubectl get scaledobject; kubectl get hpa     # keda-hpa-orders-consumer
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kafka'da replika soni partition sonidan oshsa ortiqcha pod'lar bekor turadi.
- 0 dan 1 ga o'tish — cold start; latency-sezgir HTTP uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.
- Bir workload'ga ham KEDA, ham qo'lda yozilgan HPA — to'qnashuv.

**Senior nuqta:** Uzoq ishlaydigan vazifalar uchun `ScaledJob` — har xabar uchun Job; scale-down paytida ishni yarimda o'ldirmaslik uchun graceful shutdown muhim.

41096.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Karpenter — ochiq kodli node autoscaler (AWS boshlagan, endi Kubernetes SIG Autoscaling ostida; Azure provider ham bor). U Pending pod'lar talablarini ko'rib, ASG/node group'larsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri mos instance'larni (EC2 Fleet API) soniyalar ichida yaratadi.

**Nega kerak:** Cluster Autoscaler oldindan belgilangan node group'lar bilan ishlaydi: har instance turi uchun alohida ASG, sekin va moslashuvchan emas. Karpenter pod'ga qarab "eng arzon mos" instance'ni tanlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pending pod'lar (cpu, mem, arch, zone, spot/on-demand talablari)
   v batch
Karpenter: NodePool cheklovlari ichida instance tanlaydi (bin-packing, narx)
   v EC2 Fleet CreateFleet
NodeClaim -> EC2 -> kubelet join -> pod'lar joylanadi
```
v1 API (2024): `NodePool` (talablar, limitlar, disruption) va `EC2NodeClass` (AMI, subnet, SG, IAM).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata: { name: default }
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef: { group: karpenter.k8s.aws, kind: EC2NodeClass, name: default }
      requirements:
      - { key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type, operator: In, values: [spot, on-demand] }
      - { key: kubernetes.io/arch, operator: In, values: [amd64, arm64] }
  limits: { cpu: "1000" }
```
```bash
kubectl get nodepool,nodeclaim
kubectl logs -n kube-system deploy/karpenter | grep -i launched
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `limits` yo'q — xato workload cheksiz node yaratib, katta hisob chiqaradi.
- Karpenter controller'ining o'zi Karpenter yaratgan node'da tursa — o'zini o'chirib qo'yishi mumkin; uni Fargate yoki alohida managed node group'da ishlating.
- Spot uchun interruption handling (SQS navbati) sozlanmasa pod'lar ogohlantirishsiz o'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Instance turlarini keng ochiq qoldiring (ko'p oila, ko'p arch) — Spot mavjudligi va narx optimallashuvi shundan keladi.

41097.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Consolidation — Karpenter'ning node sonini va narxini kamaytirish mexanizmi: kam yuklangan node'lardagi pod'larni boshqa node'larga ko'chirib, bo'sh qolgan node'ni o'chiradi yoki uni arzonroq/kichikroq instance bilan almashtiradi.

**Nega kerak:** Scale-up'dan keyin yuk tushganda node'lar 20% band holda qoladi — pul isrof. Consolidation klasterni doimiy "zichlab" turadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
disruption:
  consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized | WhenEmpty
  consolidateAfter: 1m
Karpenter simulyatsiya qiladi:
  node-x pod'lari boshqa node'larga sig'adimi? -> ha -> Delete
  yoki bitta arzonroq node'ga sig'adimi?      -> Replace
  -> node taint qilinadi -> pod'lar eviction (PDB hurmat) -> terminate
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized
    consolidateAfter: 5m
    budgets:
    - nodes: "10%"                                  # bir vaqtda maks 10%
    - nodes: "0"
      schedule: "0 9 * * mon-fri"                   # ish vaqtida to'xtat
      duration: 8h
```
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations: { karpenter.sh/do-not-disrupt: "true" }   # muhim pod'ni himoya
```
```bash
kubectl get events -A | grep -i -E 'disrupt|consolidat'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PDB'siz servislar consolidation paytida uziladi.
- Juda agressiv consolidation — doimiy pod "churn", cold cache, uzun Job'lar o'ldiriladi.
- Request'lar noto'g'ri bo'lsa Karpenter haqiqiy yukni bilmaydi — zich joylab, keyin throttling.

**Senior nuqta:** Disruption budget'lar va `do-not-disrupt` bilan narx tejash va barqarorlik o'rtasida balans qiling; tejamni aniq request'lar bilan birga o'lchang.

41098.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cluster Autoscaler (CA) — an'anaviy node autoscaler: pod'lar resurs yo'qligidan `Pending` bo'lsa node group'ning (AWS ASG, GCP MIG, Azure VMSS) desired sonini oshiradi, node'lar uzoq vaqt kam band bo'lsa ularni olib tashlaydi.

**Nega kerak:** HPA pod qo'shadi, lekin node'lar to'la bo'lsa pod'lar joylashmaydi. CA infratuzilmani pod ehtiyojiga moslaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Scale-up:  Pending pod -> qaysi node group shablonida sig'adi? (simulyatsiya)
           -> expander (least-waste, priority, random) -> ASG desired +N
Scale-down: node utilization < 50% (default) 10 daqiqa
           -> pod'lar boshqa joyga sig'adimi? -> drain -> ASG'dan olib tashlash
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# CA argumentlari (Deployment)
--node-group-auto-discovery=asg:tag=k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled,k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/my-cluster
--expander=least-waste
--balance-similar-node-groups
--scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.5

kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler | grep -i -E 'scale-up|scale_down'
kubectl get cm -n kube-system cluster-autoscaler-status -o yaml
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Local storage yoki PDB'si qattiq pod'lar node'ni scale-down'dan bloklaydi (`safe-to-evict: "false"` annotation).
- Multi-AZ'da bitta ASG bir nechta AZ'ni qamrasa, AZ'ga bog'langan EBS'li pod'lar uchun noto'g'ri node yaratilishi mumkin — har AZ'ga alohida group.
- CA versiyasi Kubernetes minor versiyasiga mos bo'lishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** EKS'da yangi loyihalar ko'pincha Karpenter tanlaydi (tezroq, moslashuvchan); GKE/AKS'da esa CA o'rnatilgan va NAP/auto-provisioning bilan yetarli. Tanlov — provider va operatsion tajribaga bog'liq.

41099.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CoreDNS — klaster ichidagi DNS server (Deployment, `kube-dns` Service orqali). U servis nomlarini (`my-svc.my-ns.svc.cluster.local`) ClusterIP'ga, headless servislarda pod IP'larga resolve qiladi, tashqi domenlarni esa upstream DNS'ga forward qiladi.

**Nega kerak:** Pod'lar bir-birini IP orqali emas, barqaror nom orqali topishi kerak — service discovery'ning asosi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
pod /etc/resolv.conf:
  nameserver 10.96.0.10
  search ns.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local
  options ndots:5
"api" so'rovi -> api.ns.svc.cluster.local -> CoreDNS (kubernetes plugin, watch Service/EndpointSlice)
"google.com"  -> avval search domain'lar bilan 3-4 marta NXDOMAIN, keyin forward -> upstream
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system get cm coredns -o yaml        # Corefile
kubectl run d --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 -- nslookup kubernetes.default
kubectl -n kube-system logs -l k8s-app=kube-dns
```
```
.:53 {
    errors
    health
    kubernetes cluster.local in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa { pods insecure; fallthrough in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa }
    prometheus :9153
    forward . /etc/resolv.conf
    cache 30
    loop
    reload
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ndots:5` tashqi nomlar uchun 4-5 marta ortiqcha so'rov beradi — FQDN oxiriga nuqta (`api.example.com.`) yoki `dnsConfig` bilan `ndots: 2`.
- CoreDNS replika kam — katta klasterda DNS timeout'lar (`cluster-proportional-autoscaler` ishlating).
- `loop` plugin node'ning resolv.conf'i 127.0.0.53 bo'lsa CoreDNS'ni CrashLoop'ga tushiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** "Ba'zan 5 soniya kechikish" — klassik conntrack/UDP race muammosi; yechim NodeLocal DNSCache va DNS metrikalarini (`coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds`) kuzatish.

41100.a:
**Qisqa javob:** NodeLocal DNSCache — har node'da DaemonSet sifatida ishlaydigan lokal DNS cache (link-local IP `169.254.20.10`). Pod'lar DNS so'rovini avval shu lokal agentga yuboradi; cache miss bo'lsa u CoreDNS'ga TCP orqali murojaat qiladi.

**Nega kerak:** Katta klasterda har DNS so'rovi tarmoq orqali CoreDNS'ga boradi; UDP + conntrack race sabab paketlar yo'qoladi (5s timeout), `ndots:5` esa so'rovlar sonini ko'paytiradi. Lokal cache latency'ni va CoreDNS yukini keskin kamaytiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Avval:  pod --UDP--> kube-proxy DNAT --> CoreDNS pod (boshqa node)  [conntrack]
Keyin:  pod --UDP--> 169.254.20.10 (shu node, NOTRACK)
                         | hit -> darhol javob
                         | miss
                         v TCP
                      CoreDNS
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system get ds node-local-dns
kubectl run d --rm -it --image=busybox:1.36 -- cat /etc/resolv.conf
# nameserver 169.254.20.10 bo'lsa kubelet clusterDNS shu IP'ga sozlangan
```
O'rnatish: rasmiy `nodelocaldns.yaml` manifest'ida `__PILLAR__LOCAL__DNS__`, `__PILLAR__DNS__SERVER__` ni almashtirish; iptables/IPVS rejimiga qarab kubelet `clusterDNS` ni o'zgartirish yoki o'zgartirmaslik.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Agent DaemonSet o'lsa o'sha node'dagi barcha pod'lar DNS'siz qoladi — yuqori prioritet va resurs bering.
- Cilium kube-proxy replacement bilan maxsus sozlash (Local Redirect Policy) kerak.
- Cache TTL sabab o'zgargan tashqi DNS yozuvlar kechroq yangilanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** NodeLocal DNSCache — o'rta va katta klasterlar uchun deyarli majburiy; GKE va EKS add-on sifatida taklif qiladi. Uni yoqishdan oldin va keyin DNS p99 latency'ni o'lchang.

41101.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Endpoints** — Service ortidagi barcha pod IP'larini bitta obyektda saqlaydi. **EndpointSlice** — ularni bo'laklarga (default maks 100 endpoint) ajratadi. Endpoints API 1.33'da deprecated; kube-proxy, CoreDNS va ingress'lar EndpointSlice'dan foydalanadi.

**Nega kerak:** 5000 pod'li servisda bitta pod o'zgarsa, butun ulkan Endpoints obyekti qayta yoziladi va har node'dagi kube-proxy'ga to'liq yuboriladi — etcd, apiserver va tarmoqqa katta yuk.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Endpoints:      [ 5000 IP ] --1 pod o'zgardi--> butun 5000 qayta yuboriladi
EndpointSlice:  slice-1 [100] slice-2 [100] ... slice-50 [100]
                --1 pod o'zgardi--> faqat bitta slice (100) yangilanadi
```
EndpointSlice qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi: `ready`/`serving`/`terminating` holatlari, `zone` va `nodeName` (topology-aware routing uchun), dual-stack (IPv4 va IPv6 alohida slice).

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api
kubectl get endpointslice api-abc12 -o yaml | grep -A4 conditions
```
Ilova o'z kodida servis a'zolarini kuzatsa — `discovery.k8s.io/v1` EndpointSlice'ga o'ting.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eski operator/skriptlar `Endpoints` ni o'qiydi — 1000 dan ortiq endpoint'da u kesiladi (`endpoints.kubernetes.io/over-capacity`).
- Bitta servisga bir nechta slice — ularni birlashtirib o'qish kerak, birinchisi emas.
- Selector'siz Service uchun slice'larni qo'lda yaratganda `kubernetes.io/service-name` label'ini unutish.

**Senior nuqta:** EndpointSlice `terminating` holati graceful shutdown'ni yaxshilaydi: proxy yangi ulanishlarni yubormaydi, lekin mavjud ulanishlar tugashiga imkon beradi.

41102.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **iptables** rejimi har servis/endpoint uchun ketma-ket qoidalar zanjirini yaratadi — paket moslash O(N) va katta klasterda yangilash sekin. **IPVS** rejimi kernel'dagi hash jadvalli L4 load balancer'dan foydalanadi — O(1) qidiruv va ko'proq algoritm (rr, lc, sh). 1.31'dan **nftables** rejimi ham bor (1.33'da GA) va kelajakdagi tavsiya.

**Nega kerak:** 10 000 servisli klasterda iptables qoidalari yuz minglab bo'ladi: har o'zgarishda butun jadval qayta yoziladi (soniyalar), birinchi paket latency'si o'sadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
iptables: KUBE-SERVICES -> KUBE-SVC-xxx -> (random probability) -> KUBE-SEP-yyy -> DNAT
          N ta qoida ketma-ket tekshiriladi
IPVS:     virtual server 10.96.0.10:80 --hash--> real server'lar (pod IP)
nftables: map/set'lar bilan O(1) ga yaqin, qisman (incremental) yangilash
```
| | iptables | IPVS | nftables |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lookup | O(N) | O(1) | O(1) |
| Yangilash | butun jadval | incremental | incremental |
| Holat | default, eski | maintenance | yangi tavsiya |

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system get cm kube-proxy -o yaml | grep mode
iptables-save | grep -c KUBE-SEP        # qoida soni
ipvsadm -Ln                              # IPVS rejimida
nft list table ip kube-proxy             # nftables rejimida
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- IPVS ham ba'zi ishlar uchun iptables'dan foydalanadi (masquerade, NodePort filter) — "iptables'siz" emas.
- IPVS kernel modullari (`ip_vs`, `ip_vs_rr`) yuklanmagan bo'lsa iptables'ga qaytadi.
- Rejim almashtirgandan keyin eski qoidalar qoladi — `kube-proxy --cleanup` yoki node reboot.

**Senior nuqta:** Yangi klasterda yoki nftables, yoki eBPF (Cilium kube-proxy replacement) tanlang; IPVS loyihasi faol rivojlanmayapti.

41103.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cilium — eBPF asosidagi CNI: pod tarmog'i, Service load balancing (kube-proxy o'rniga), NetworkPolicy (L3/L4 va L7), shaffof shifrlash (WireGuard/IPsec) va Hubble orqali tarmoq kuzatuvini kernel'ga yuklangan eBPF dasturlari bilan bajaradi. CNCF graduated.

**Nega kerak:** iptables minglab servisda sekinlashadi va IP asosida ishlaydi — pod IP'lari doim o'zgaradigan dunyoda IP qoidalari mo'rt. Cilium identitet (label) asosida va O(1) hash map'lar bilan ishlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
pod --> veth --> eBPF (tc / XDP hook)
                  | service lookup (BPF map, O(1)) -> backend tanlash
                  | policy: identity(label) ruxsat bormi?
                  | L7 kerak bo'lsa -> Envoy proxy
                  v
             boshqa pod (shu node yoki tunnel/native routing)
Hubble: har oqimni ko'rish (kim, kimga, verdict)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
cilium install --set kubeProxyReplacement=true
cilium status --wait
cilium connectivity test
hubble observe --namespace prod --verdict DROPPED     # nega paket tashlandi
```
```yaml
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata: { name: api-l7 }
spec:
  endpointSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  ingress:
  - fromEndpoints: [{ matchLabels: { app: web } }]
    toPorts:
    - ports: [{ port: "8080", protocol: TCP }]
      rules: { http: [{ method: GET, path: "/v1/.*" }] }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eski kernel'larda ba'zi funksiyalar ishlamaydi — kernel versiya talablarini tekshiring.
- kube-proxy replacement yoqilganda kube-proxy DaemonSet'ini olib tashlashni va qoidalarini tozalashni unutmang.
- L7 policy Envoy orqali o'tadi — latency va resurs qo'shiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Cilium ko'p hollarda alohida service mesh'ga ehtiyojni kamaytiradi (mTLS, L7 policy, observability); lekin murakkab trafik boshqaruvi uchun mesh hali ham kuchliroq — ehtiyojni aniq belgilang.

41104.a:
**Qisqa javob:** NetworkPolicy — pod'lar orasidagi L3/L4 trafikni label selector'lar bilan boshqaradigan deklarativ firewall. Uni **CNI** (Calico, Cilium) amalga oshiradi; Flannel kabi qo'llamaydigan CNI'da policy jim e'tiborsiz qoladi.

**Nega kerak:** Default'da Kubernetes'da har pod har pod bilan gaplashadi. Bitta pod buzilsa, hujumchi DB'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiqadi. NetworkPolicy lateral movement'ni cheklaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
podSelector: qaysi pod'larga qo'llanadi
policyTypes: Ingress / Egress
Pod hech bir policy tanlamasa -> hammasi ochiq
Pod biror policy tanlasa      -> faqat ruxsat berilgan oqimlar (allow-list, qo'shiluvchan)
from/to: podSelector | namespaceSelector | ipBlock
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata: { name: db-allow-api, namespace: prod }
spec:
  podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: postgres } }
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
    ports: [{ protocol: TCP, port: 5432 }]
```
```bash
kubectl get netpol -n prod
kubectl run t --rm -it -n prod --image=busybox -- nc -zv postgres 5432   # test
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `from` ichida bitta element (`podSelector` + `namespaceSelector` birga = AND) va ikki element (`- podSelector`, `- namespaceSelector` = OR) — bitta tire farqi butun ma'noni o'zgartiradi.
- `deny` qoidasi yo'q; faqat allow. Deny uchun default-deny + allow pattern.
- L7 (HTTP path) yoki FQDN bo'yicha qoida standart API'da yo'q — Cilium/Calico kengaytmalari kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Policy'larni label'lar ustiga qurilgan servis grafigi bilan boshqaring va Hubble/Calico flow log'lari bilan tekshiring; yangi standart `AdminNetworkPolicy` klaster admin darajasidagi (deny bilan) qoidalarni beradi.

41105.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Default-deny NetworkPolicy — namespace'dagi barcha pod'larni (`podSelector: {}`) tanlab, hech qanday ruxsat qoidasi bermaydigan policy. Natijada hamma kiruvchi (va/yoki chiquvchi) trafik yopiladi, keyin kerakli oqimlar alohida policy'lar bilan aniq ochiladi.

**Nega kerak:** Zero-trust yondashuv: "nima ruxsat etilganini bilamiz, qolgani yopiq". Yangi pod qo'shilsa ham u avtomatik himoyalangan bo'ladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
1) default-deny (Ingress+Egress)    -> hammasi yopiq
2) allow-dns (egress UDP/TCP 53 -> kube-dns)
3) allow-web-to-api, allow-api-to-db ...
Policy'lar qo'shiluvchan: yakuniy ruxsat = hamma allow'lar yig'indisi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata: { name: default-deny, namespace: prod }
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata: { name: allow-dns, namespace: prod }
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector: { matchLabels: { kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system } }
      podSelector: { matchLabels: { k8s-app: kube-dns } }
    ports: [{ protocol: UDP, port: 53 }, { protocol: TCP, port: 53 }]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DNS egress'ni unutish — hamma ilova "host topilmadi" xatosi bilan yiqiladi.
- Ingress controller, monitoring (Prometheus scrape) va webhook'lar uchun ruxsatni unutish.
- Production'ga birdan qo'llash — avval audit/log rejimida (Cilium/Calico) yoki staging'da sinang.

**Senior nuqta:** Default-deny'ni namespace yaratish shabloniga (Kyverno `generate` qoidasi) kiriting — shunda hech qaysi jamoa uni unutmaydi.

41106.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pod Security Admission (PSA) — 1.25'da olib tashlangan PodSecurityPolicy o'rnini bosgan built-in admission controller. Namespace label'lari orqali uchta Pod Security Standard profilini (**privileged**, **baseline**, **restricted**) uch rejimda (`enforce`, `audit`, `warn`) qo'llaydi.

**Nega kerak:** Privileged container, `hostPath`, `hostNetwork` yoki root sifatida ishlash — node'ni egallashga yo'l. PSA bularni oddiy, standart profil bilan bloklaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
| Profil | Nima beradi |
|---|---|
| privileged | cheklovsiz (system komponentlar) |
| baseline | ma'lum privilege escalation'larni yopadi (privileged, hostPath, hostNetwork) |
| restricted | qattiq: non-root, `drop: [ALL]`, seccomp RuntimeDefault, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false` |

```
enforce -> rad etadi; audit -> audit log'ga yozadi; warn -> kubectl'da ogohlantirish
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl label ns prod \
  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted \
  pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version=latest \
  pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn=restricted
kubectl label --dry-run=server --overwrite ns prod pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted
# mavjud pod'lar qaysi biri buzishini ko'rsatadi
```
```yaml
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  capabilities: { drop: [ALL] }
  seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PSA faqat pod'ni tekshiradi, lekin Deployment yaratilganda faqat `warn` chiqadi — pod'lar keyin ReplicaSet tomonidan yaratilmay qoladi. Events'ni tekshiring.
- Moslashtirish imkoni kam (istisno faqat user/namespace/runtimeClass) — nozik qoidalar uchun Kyverno/Gatekeeper kerak.
- `kube-system` ga restricted qo'yish CNI/CSI'ni buzadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Strategiya: hamma namespace'da `warn`+`audit=restricted`, `enforce=baseline`; ilovalar tayyor bo'lgach `enforce=restricted`.

41107.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OPA Gatekeeper — Open Policy Agent'ni Kubernetes'ga admission webhook sifatida ulaydigan loyiha. Siyosatlar **Rego** tilida `ConstraintTemplate` ga yoziladi, `Constraint` esa ularni parametrlar bilan qo'llaydi. Shuningdek mavjud resurslarni **audit** qiladi.

**Nega kerak:** Tashkilot qoidalari: "image faqat ichki registry'dan", "har Deployment'da `owner` label bo'lsin", "LoadBalancer faqat ma'lum namespace'larda". RBAC va PSA buni qila olmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ConstraintTemplate (Rego mantiq + CRD sxema)
   v generatsiya
CRD K8sRequiredLabels
   v
Constraint (match: Deployment, params: labels=[owner])
   v
admission webhook -> violation -> deny + xabar
audit controller -> mavjud resurslardagi buzilishlar status'da
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sRequiredLabels
metadata: { name: must-have-owner }
spec:
  enforcementAction: dryrun        # avval kuzat, keyin deny
  match:
    kinds: [{ apiGroups: [apps], kinds: [Deployment] }]
  parameters: { labels: [owner] }
```
```bash
kubectl get constrainttemplates
kubectl get k8srequiredlabels must-have-owner -o yaml | grep -A10 violations
```
Tayyor siyosatlar: `gatekeeper-library`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Rego o'rganish qiyin — jamoa uni yozish va test qilishni bilishi kerak (`gator test`).
- Webhook `failurePolicy` va replika soni — HA bo'lmasa deploy'lar to'xtaydi yoki policy chetlab o'tiladi.
- Policy'ni darhol `deny` bilan yoqish mavjud pipeline'larni sindiradi — `dryrun`/`warn` bilan boshlang.

**Senior nuqta:** Agar OPA allaqachon boshqa joylarda (API authz, Terraform `conftest`) ishlatilsa Gatekeeper mantiqiy; faqat Kubernetes uchun bo'lsa Kyverno yoki CEL asosidagi ValidatingAdmissionPolicy soddaroq.

41108.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kyverno — Kubernetes-native policy engine: siyosatlar oddiy **YAML**da (yoki CEL bilan) yoziladi. U resurslarni **validate** (rad etish), **mutate** (o'zgartirish), **generate** (qo'shimcha resurs yaratish), image imzosini **verify** qiladi va `cleanup` siyosatlari bilan resurslarni tozalaydi. CNCF graduated.

**Nega kerak:** Rego o'rganmasdan policy-as-code: Kubernetes YAML'ini biladigan har kim siyosat yoza oladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ClusterPolicy
  rules:
   - validate  -> pattern mos kelmasa deny / audit
   - mutate    -> default label, securityContext qo'shish
   - generate  -> yangi ns uchun default-deny NetworkPolicy
   - verifyImages -> cosign imzo / attestation
Kyverno admission webhook + background scan -> PolicyReport
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata: { name: disallow-latest-tag }
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce
  rules:
  - name: no-latest
    match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Pod] } }] }
    validate:
      message: "':latest' tag ishlatmang"
      pattern:
        spec:
          containers:
          - image: "!*:latest"
```
```bash
kubectl get clusterpolicy
kubectl get policyreport -A
kyverno apply policy.yaml --resource deploy.yaml     # CI'da test
```
