**Tuzoqlar:**
- Pod uchun yozilgan qoida Kyverno autogen orqali Deployment'ga ham qo'llanadi — xabarlar shu yerdan kelishini bilish kerak.
- Murakkab mantiq YAML'da noqulay (JMESPath) — ba'zan CEL yoki Rego aniqroq.
- Kyverno pod'lari o'lsa va `failurePolicy: Fail` — klaster qotadi; HA va `kube-system` istisnosi shart.

**Senior nuqta:** Generate + mutate imkoniyati Kyverno'ni "platform guardrail" vositasiga aylantiradi: yangi namespace'ga avtomatik quota, NetworkPolicy, RBAC — self-service platformaning asosi.

41109.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Helm — Kubernetes paket menejeri: **chart** (shablonlar + `values.yaml`) dan manifest'lar render qilinadi va **release** sifatida o'rnatiladi, versiyalanadi, rollback qilinadi. **Hook**'lar — release lifecycle'ining ma'lum nuqtalarida (`pre-install`, `post-upgrade`, `pre-delete` va h.k.) bajariladigan resurslar (odatda Job).

**Nega kerak:** Bitta ilova o'nlab YAML'dan iborat va har muhitda farq qiladi. Helm ularni parametrlaydi va bitta buyruq bilan o'rnatadi. Hook'lar esa "deploy'dan oldin DB migration" kabi tartibni beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
helm upgrade --install app ./chart -f prod.yaml
  1. render templates (values)
  2. pre-upgrade hook'lar (weight bo'yicha tartib) -> tugashini kutadi
  3. asosiy resurslar apply
  4. post-upgrade hook'lar
  release tarixi: Secret sh.helm.release.v1.app.vN
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: "{{ .Release.Name }}-migrate"
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": pre-upgrade,pre-install
    "helm.sh/hook-weight": "0"
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": before-hook-creation,hook-succeeded
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers: [{ name: m, image: "app:{{ .Chart.AppVersion }}", args: [migrate] }]
```
```bash
helm template app ./chart -f prod.yaml | less      # nima chiqishini ko'rish
helm upgrade --install app ./chart -f prod.yaml --atomic --timeout 10m
helm history app; helm rollback app 3
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hook resurslari release'ning bir qismi sifatida boshqarilmaydi — `hook-delete-policy` siz eski Job'lar qoladi va keyingi deploy "already exists" bilan yiqiladi.
- `helm rollback` DB migration'ni orqaga qaytarmaydi — migration'lar backward-compatible bo'lsin.
- Argo CD hook'larni o'z "sync wave/hook"lariga tarjima qiladi — xatti-harakat biroz farq qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Helm 3 Tiller'siz; chart'larni OCI registry'da saqlang. Migration'ni hook'da emas, alohida pipeline bosqichida qilish ko'pincha boshqarishga osonroq.

41110.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Subchart'lar `Chart.yaml` ning `dependencies` bo'limida (nom, versiya diapazoni, repository) e'lon qilinadi. `helm dependency update` ularni yuklab, aniq versiya va digest'larni `Chart.lock` ga yozadi; `helm dependency build` esa lock fayl bo'yicha aynan o'sha versiyalarni tiklaydi.

**Nega kerak:** Ilova chart'i PostgreSQL yoki Redis chart'iga bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin. Lock fayl bo'lmasa `~12.1` bugun bir versiya, ertaga boshqa versiya beradi — qayta tiklanmaydigan build.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Chart.yaml (diapazon ^15.0.0) --helm dep update--> Chart.lock (15.5.2 + digest)
                                                    + charts/postgresql-15.5.2.tgz
CI: helm dep build  --> Chart.lock bo'yicha aynan shu versiya
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: shop
version: 1.4.0
dependencies:
- name: postgresql
  version: "~15.5.0"
  repository: oci://registry-1.docker.io/bitnamicharts
  condition: postgresql.enabled
- name: common
  version: "2.x.x"
  repository: file://../common
```
```bash
helm dependency update ./shop      # lock'ni yangilaydi
helm dependency build ./shop       # lock bo'yicha tiklaydi (CI)
helm dependency list ./shop
```
Subchart qiymatlari parent `values.yaml` da shu nom ostida: `postgresql.auth.database: shop`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Chart.lock` ni commit qilmaslik — reproducibility yo'qoladi.
- `charts/*.tgz` ni git'ga qo'shish yoki qo'shmaslik bo'yicha jamoa kelishuvi kerak (odatda qo'shilmaydi, CI build qiladi).
- Uchinchi tomon chart'lari sabab registry o'zgarishlari (masalan, Bitnami katalog siyosati 2025) — muhim chart'larni o'z registry'ingizga mirror qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** Production'da DB'ni subchart sifatida ilova bilan birga o'rnatish anti-pattern bo'lishi mumkin — lifecycle'lari har xil; dependency'ni faqat dev/test uchun `condition` bilan yoqing.

41111.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `values.schema.json` — chart ildizidagi JSON Schema fayli. Helm `install`, `upgrade`, `lint` va `template` paytida foydalanuvchi bergan qiymatlarni shu sxema bo'yicha tekshiradi va xato bo'lsa render qilishdan **oldin** to'xtaydi.

**Nega kerak:** `replicaCount: "three"` yoki `image.tag` unutilsa, odatda shablon jim noto'g'ri YAML chiqaradi yoki deploy'dan keyin yiqiladi. Schema xatoni erta va tushunarli xabar bilan ushlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
values.yaml + -f prod.yaml + --set ...  --> birlashgan values
      v
values.schema.json tekshiruvi --xato--> "replicaCount: Invalid type. Expected: integer"
      v OK
templates render --> apply
```

**Amalda:**
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["image"],
  "properties": {
    "replicaCount": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 },
    "image": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["repository", "tag"],
      "properties": {
        "repository": { "type": "string" },
        "tag": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$" }
      }
    },
    "service": { "properties": { "type": { "enum": ["ClusterIP", "LoadBalancer"] } } }
  }
}
```
```bash
helm lint ./chart -f prod.yaml
helm template ./chart --set replicaCount=abc     # schema xatosi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `additionalProperties: false` qo'ymasangiz `replcaCount` kabi xato nomlar jim o'tib ketadi.
- Schema qo'lda yozilsa `values.yaml` bilan sinxronlikni yo'qotadi — generator plugin'lardan (`helm-schema`) foydalaning.
- Subchart'larning o'z schema'si ham tekshiriladi — global qiymatlar to'qnashishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Schema — chart'ning "API kontrakti". Boshqa jamoalar foydalanadigan platform chart'lari uchun majburiy; IDE'larda avtomatik to'ldirish ham beradi.

41112.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kustomize — shablonsiz konfiguratsiya moslash vositasi: oddiy YAML **base** ustiga muhitga xos **overlay**'lar (patch, image tag, label, namespace, configMap generator) qo'llanadi. `kubectl apply -k` ga o'rnatilgan.

**Nega kerak:** Helm'da YAML `{{ }}` shablonlarga aylanadi va o'qish qiyinlashadi. Kustomize'da base — haqiqiy, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlaydigan YAML, overlay faqat farqni yozadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
base/                 overlays/prod/
  deployment.yaml       kustomization.yaml
  service.yaml            resources: [../../base]
  kustomization.yaml      patches: [replicas.yaml]
                          images: [app -> 1.4.2]
kustomize build overlays/prod --> yakuniy YAML
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: prod
resources: [../../base]
labels:
- pairs: { env: prod }
images:
- { name: app, newTag: "1.4.2" }
patches:
- target: { kind: Deployment, name: app }
  patch: |-
    - op: replace
      path: /spec/replicas
      value: 5
configMapGenerator:
- { name: app-config, literals: [LOG_LEVEL=warn] }
```
```bash
kubectl kustomize overlays/prod | less
kubectl apply -k overlays/prod
kubectl diff -k overlays/prod
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `kubectl` ichidagi Kustomize versiyasi mustaqil `kustomize` binary'sidan eski bo'lishi mumkin.
- `configMapGenerator` nomga hash qo'shadi — bu yaxshi (config o'zgarsa rollout), lekin tashqaridan nom bo'yicha murojaat buziladi.
- Juda chuqur overlay zanjiri — farqni kuzatish qiyin.

**Senior nuqta:** Amalda ko'p jamoa Helm (uchinchi tomon paketlar) + Kustomize (o'z ilovalari va post-render patch) kombinatsiyasidan foydalanadi; Argo CD ikkalasini ham qo'llaydi.

41113.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Strategic merge patch — Kustomize (va `kubectl patch`) ning Kubernetes'ga xos birlashtirish usuli: patch qisman YAML sifatida yoziladi va list'lar **kalit bo'yicha** (masalan container `name`) birlashtiriladi, butunlay almashtirilmaydi.

**Nega kerak:** Oddiy JSON merge'da `containers` list'ini patch qilsangiz butun ro'yxat yangi bilan almashadi va sidecar'lar yo'qoladi. Strategic merge faqat `name: app` container'ini topib, uning maydonlarini yangilaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
base containers:  [ {name: app, image: app:1}, {name: proxy, image: envoy} ]
patch containers: [ {name: app, resources: {limits: {memory: 1Gi}}} ]
natija:           [ {name: app, image: app:1, resources: ...}, {name: proxy, ...} ]
Merge kaliti Go struct tag'larida: patchMergeKey=name, patchStrategy=merge
```
| Usul | List bilan nima bo'ladi |
|---|---|
| Strategic merge | kalit bo'yicha birlashtiriladi |
| JSON merge (RFC 7386) | butunlay almashtiriladi |
| JSON 6902 patch | aniq op/path (`add`, `replace`, `remove`) |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# overlays/prod/memory.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: app }
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        resources: { limits: { memory: 1Gi } }
```
```yaml
patches:
- path: memory.yaml
```
O'chirish uchun direktiva: `$patch: delete`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CRD'larda strategic merge kalit ma'lumoti yo'q — list'lar almashtiriladi; JSON 6902 patch ishlating.
- Patch'dagi `metadata.name` base'ga mos kelmasa — "no matches" xatosi.
- Env var list'ida `name` kalit, lekin tartib o'zgarishi mumkin — natijani `kustomize build` bilan tekshiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Server-Side Apply ham shu merge semantikasidan (`x-kubernetes-list-type: map`) foydalanadi — CRD yozayotganda list'lar uchun list-type va map-keys belgilash yaxshi odat.

41114.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CRD (CustomResourceDefinition) — Kubernetes API'ni yangi resurs turi bilan kengaytirish mexanizmi. CRD yaratilgach `kubectl get kafkatopics` kabi buyruqlar ishlaydi, obyektlar etcd'da saqlanadi, RBAC va watch nativ resurslar kabi ishlaydi. Lekin CRD o'zi hech narsa **qilmaydi** — mantiqni controller beradi.

**Nega kerak:** Domen tushunchalarini (Certificate, KafkaTopic, Database) Kubernetes'ning deklarativ modeliga olib kirish — bitta tooling (kubectl, GitOps, RBAC) bilan boshqarish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CRD (group, versions, OpenAPI schema, scope)
   v apiserver yangi endpoint ochadi: /apis/example.com/v1/namespaces/*/backups
Custom Resource (kind: Backup) --> etcd
   v watch
Controller/Operator --> haqiqiy ish (S3'ga backup) --> status yangilaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata: { name: backups.example.com }
spec:
  group: example.com
  scope: Namespaced
  names: { plural: backups, singular: backup, kind: Backup, shortNames: [bk] }
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    subresources: { status: {} }
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required: [schedule]
            properties:
              schedule: { type: string }
              retentionDays: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
```
```bash
kubectl get crd | grep example.com
kubectl explain backup.spec
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CRD o'chirilsa uning barcha obyektlari ham o'chadi — ehtiyot bo'ling (Helm uninstall CRD'ni o'chirmaydi aynan shu sababdan).
- Versiyalar almashganda (v1beta1 -> v1) conversion webhook kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
- Schema'siz yoki juda keng schema — noto'g'ri ma'lumot etcd'ga kiradi; CEL `x-kubernetes-validations` bilan qat'iylashtiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Juda ko'p CRD (yuzlab) apiserver xotirasini va discovery'ni og'irlashtiradi; o'rnatilgan CRD'lar sonini va ular egasini kuzatib boring.

41115.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Operator pattern = CRD + custom controller: operator kerakli holatni (CR `spec`) kuzatadi va haqiqiy dunyoni unga moslashtiradi, odam operator qiladigan domen bilimini (failover, backup, upgrade, scaling) kodga aylantiradi.

**Nega kerak:** StatefulSet PostgreSQL pod'larini ishga tushiradi, lekin primary o'lsa replica'ni promote qilishni bilmaydi. Operator shu "operatsion bilim"ni avtomatlashtiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
            +---------- watch ----------+
            v                           |
   kind: PostgresCluster (spec)    Reconcile loop:
   replicas: 3, version: 16          1. haqiqiy holatni o'qi
            |                        2. spec bilan solishtir
            +--> Operator ---------> 3. farqni yop (StatefulSet, Service, backup Job)
                                     4. status'ni yangila, qayta navbatga qo'y
```
Reconcile **idempotent** va **level-based**: "nima o'zgardi" emas, "hozir qanday bo'lishi kerak" asosida ishlaydi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata: { name: pg }
spec:
  instances: 3
  storage: { size: 50Gi }
  backup:
    barmanObjectStore: { destinationPath: s3://backups/pg }
```
```bash
kubectl get cluster pg -o yaml | yq .status
kubectl logs -n cnpg-system deploy/cnpg-controller-manager
```
Mashhur operator'lar: CloudNativePG, Strimzi (Kafka), Prometheus Operator, cert-manager, ECK.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Operator o'zi ham bug'li dastur — u xato qilsa production DB'ni buzishi mumkin; versiyalarni staging'da sinang.
- Operator CRD versiyalarini yangilash murakkab — upgrade yo'riqnomasini o'qing.
- Har oddiy ilova uchun operator yozish — ortiqcha murakkablik; Helm yetadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Operator tanlashda yetuklik darajasi (Operator Capability Levels 1-5), jamoa, release tezligi va backup/restore'ni sinab ko'rish asosiy mezonlar.

41116.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubebuilder va Operator SDK — Go'da operator yozish uchun scaffolding vositalari. Ikkalasi ham `controller-runtime` kutubxonasiga asoslanadi: loyiha tuzilmasi, CRD manifest'lari, RBAC, webhook va test muhitini (`envtest`) avtomatik generatsiya qiladi. Operator SDK qo'shimcha ravishda Helm/Ansible operator'lari va OLM integratsiyasini beradi.

**Nega kerak:** client-go bilan informer, workqueue, leader election, cache'ni qo'lda yozish uzun va xatoga moyil. Bu vositalar faqat `Reconcile()` mantiqiga e'tibor berishga imkon beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubebuilder init --domain example.com
kubebuilder create api --group apps --version v1 --kind Backup
   -> api/v1/backup_types.go   (Go struct + kubebuilder marker'lari)
   -> internal/controller/backup_controller.go (Reconcile)
make manifests  -> CRD YAML, RBAC (marker'lardan)
make test       -> envtest (haqiqiy apiserver + etcd)
make run / make deploy
```

**Amalda:**
```go
// +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=apps.example.com,resources=backups,verbs=get;list;watch;update
func (r *BackupReconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, req ctrl.Request) (ctrl.Result, error) {
    var b appsv1.Backup
    if err := r.Get(ctx, req.NamespacedName, &b); err != nil {
        return ctrl.Result{}, client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
    }
    // spec'ga qarab CronJob yaratish/yangilash (CreateOrUpdate)
    // status'ni yangilash
    return ctrl.Result{RequeueAfter: 10 * time.Minute}, nil
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Reconcile ichida uzoq bloklovchi ish — workqueue to'xtaydi; asinxron qiling yoki requeue.
- Status'ni `r.Update` bilan yozish — `r.Status().Update` kerak, aks holda konflikt yoki yo'qolish.
- Owner reference qo'yilmasa child resurslar CR o'chirilganda qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Yaxshi operator: idempotent reconcile, `Conditions` bilan aniq status, finalizer orqali tashqi resurs tozalash, metrikalar va envtest bilan integratsiya testlari.

41117.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Leader election — controller'ning bir nechta replikasi bo'lganda faqat **bittasi** faol reconcile qilishini ta'minlash. Kubernetes'da bu `coordination.k8s.io/v1` **Lease** obyekti orqali amalga oshiriladi: leader lease'ni muntazam yangilaydi, yangilanmay qolsa boshqa replika uni egallaydi.

**Nega kerak:** HA uchun 2-3 replika kerak, lekin ikki replika bir vaqtda bitta resursni boshqarsa — ikki marta backup, to'qnashuvchi update'lar, race. Lease aktiv-passiv rejimni beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Lease kube-system/my-operator
  holderIdentity: pod-a
  leaseDurationSeconds: 15
  renewTime: 12:00:05
pod-a: har ~2s renew (renewDeadline 10s)
pod-b, pod-c: kutadi (retryPeriod 2s)
pod-a o'ldi -> 15s renew yo'q -> pod-b lease'ni oladi -> reconcile boshlaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```go
mgr, _ := ctrl.NewManager(cfg, ctrl.Options{
    LeaderElection:          true,
    LeaderElectionID:        "backup-operator.example.com",
    LeaderElectionReleaseOnCancel: true,   // graceful shutdown'da tez topshirish
})
```
```bash
kubectl get lease -n kube-system
kubectl get lease kube-scheduler -n kube-system -o jsonpath='{.spec.holderIdentity}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Lease vaqtga asoslangan: GC pause yoki tarmoq uzilishida eski leader o'zini hali leader deb o'ylashi mumkin — qisqa "split-brain" oynasi. Tashqi tizimlarga yozishda idempotentlik kerak.
- Juda qisqa `leaseDuration` — apiserver sekinlashganda tez-tez leader almashadi.
- Lease uchun RBAC (`leases` get/create/update) unutilsa, operator start bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Leader election throughput'ni oshirmaydi — faqat HA beradi. Masshtab kerak bo'lsa ishni sharding (namespace yoki hash bo'yicha) qiling.

41118.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Compaction** — etcd'dagi eski MVCC revision tarixini o'chiradi (mantiqan). **Defragmentation** — compaction'dan keyin bo'shagan joyni bbolt fayldan diskka **jismonan** qaytaradi. Ikkalasisiz DB hajmi kvotaga (default 2GiB, tavsiya maks 8GiB) yetadi va etcd `NOSPACE` alarm bilan read-only'ga o'tadi.

**Nega kerak:** etcd har o'zgarishni yangi revision sifatida saqlaydi. Tez o'zgaruvchi obyektlar (Lease, Event) ming-minglab revision qoldiradi — tozalanmasa DB shishadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
revision: 1 2 3 ... 100000
compact 95000 -> 95000 gacha bo'lgan eski versiyalar o'chadi (fayl hajmi o'zgarmaydi!)
defrag        -> fayl qayta yoziladi, bo'sh sahifalar OS'ga qaytadi
kube-apiserver har 5 daqiqada avtomatik compaction qiladi (--etcd-compaction-interval)
defrag esa qo'lda / cron bilan, har member alohida
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
etcdctl endpoint status -w table          # DB SIZE va "IN USE"
etcdctl alarm list                        # NOSPACE bormi
etcdctl defrag --endpoints=https://etcd-1:2379   # bittadan, leader'ni oxirida
etcdctl alarm disarm
```
Kvota: `--quota-backend-bytes=8589934592`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Defrag paytida member bloklanadi — hamma member'larni birdan defrag qilish klasterni to'xtatadi.
- Kvotani oshirish asosiy muammoni (masalan, Event spam yoki ulkan CRD'lar) hal qilmaydi.
- Compaction'dan keyin `--rev` bilan eski revision'ni o'qish yoki watch qilish xato beradi — client'lar relist qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Managed klasterda bu provider ishi, self-managed'da esa monitoring shart: `etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes` va in-use nisbati; katta farq — defrag vaqti keldi.

41119.a:
**Qisqa javob:** API versiya yetuklikni bildiradi: **alpha** (`v1alpha1`) — eksperimental, default o'chiq, ogohlantirishsiz o'zgarishi/yo'qolishi mumkin; **beta** (`v1beta1`) — sinovdan o'tgan, 1.24'dan yangi beta API'lar default o'chiq; **GA** (`v1`) — barqaror, uzoq muddat qo'llanadi.

**Nega kerak:** Kubernetes tez rivojlanadi. Versiyalar foydalanuvchiga "bu narsaga qanchalik tayanish mumkin"ni aytadi va API'ni buzmasdan evolyutsiya qilish imkonini beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
| Daraja | Default | Kafolat | Production |
|---|---|---|---|
| alpha | o'chiq (feature gate) | yo'q | yo'q |
| beta | yangi API'lar o'chiq | deprecation siyosati bilan | ehtiyotkorlik bilan |
| GA | yoqiq | olib tashlanmaydi (v1 ichida) | ha |

```
Bitta obyekt bir nechta versiyada xizmat qilishi mumkin; etcd'da bitta "storage version"da saqlanadi,
apiserver so'ralgan versiyaga konvertatsiya qiladi.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl api-versions | grep autoscaling
kubectl api-resources -o wide | grep -i hpa
kubectl explain hpa --api-version=autoscaling/v2
```
Alpha'ni yoqish: apiserver'da `--feature-gates=Foo=true --runtime-config=foo.k8s.io/v1alpha1=true`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Beta API'larga tayangan manifest'lar upgrade'da yo'qoladi (masalan `policy/v1beta1` PodDisruptionBudget 1.25'da, `flowcontrol` beta'lari keyinroq).
- Managed klasterlarda alpha feature'larni yoqib bo'lmaydi.
- `kubectl get` ko'rsatgan versiya etcd'dagi storage versiyasi bilan bir xil emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Platforma uchun qoida: production manifest'larda faqat GA API'lar; beta faqat aniq sabab va chiqish rejasi bilan.

41120.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubernetes deprecation policy: GA API'lar major versiya ichida olib tashlanmaydi; beta API'lar deprecation e'lonidan keyin kamida **9 oy yoki 3 minor release** (qaysi uzoq bo'lsa) xizmat qiladi; alpha istalgan payt yo'qolishi mumkin. Deprecated API ishlatilsa apiserver ogohlantirish (`Warning:` header) qaytaradi.

**Nega kerak:** Har yili ~3 minor release chiqadi. Deprecated API ishlatayotgan manifest yoki Helm chart upgrade'dan keyin "no matches for kind" xatosi bilan butunlay ishlamay qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
1.x   : v1beta1 deprecated (ogohlantirish), v1 mavjud
1.x+3 : v1beta1 olib tashlandi --> eski manifest apply qilinmaydi
etcd'dagi mavjud obyektlar yo'qolmaydi (yangi versiyada o'qiladi),
lekin CI/CD'dagi YAML va Helm release tarixi buziladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubent                                   # klasterdagi deprecated API'lar
pluto detect-files -d ./manifests
pluto detect-helm -o wide                # Helm release'lardagi
kubectl get --raw /metrics | grep apiserver_requested_deprecated_apis
kubectl convert -f old.yaml --output-version apps/v1   # kubectl-convert plugin
```
Rasmiy "Deprecated API Migration Guide" har release uchun ro'yxat beradi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Helm release Secret'ida eski API qolsa `helm upgrade` yiqiladi — `helm mapkubeapis` plugin bilan tuzatiladi.
- Faqat repo'ni tekshirish yetarli emas — klasterga boshqa yo'llar bilan (operator'lar) qo'shilgan resurslar ham bor.
- EKS/GKE "upgrade insights" ogohlantirishlarini e'tiborsiz qoldirish.

**Senior nuqta:** Deprecated API tekshiruvini CI'ga (pluto) va upgrade checklist'iga kiriting; `apiserver_requested_deprecated_apis` metrikasi kim hali eski API chaqirayotganini ko'rsatadi.

41121.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Aggregation layer — kube-apiserver'ga mustaqil qo'shimcha API server'larni ulash mexanizmi. `APIService` obyekti ma'lum group/version'ga (masalan `metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1`) kelgan so'rovlarni ko'rsatilgan Service ortidagi server'ga proxy qiladi. Client uchun bu oddiy Kubernetes API bo'lib ko'rinadi.

**Nega kerak:** CRD ma'lumotni etcd'da saqlaydi va faqat CRUD beradi. Agar ma'lumot etcd'da emas (real-time metrikalar) yoki maxsus mantiq (custom storage, subresource) kerak bo'lsa — alohida API server kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl top pods
   v GET /apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/x/pods
kube-apiserver (authn/authz)
   | APIService v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io -> Service kube-system/metrics-server
   v proxy (front-proxy client cert bilan)
metrics-server --> javob
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get apiservices
kubectl get apiservice v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io -o yaml | grep -A5 status
# Available=False bo'lsa: FailedDiscoveryCheck, MissingEndpoints
```
Misollar: Metrics Server, Prometheus Adapter (`custom.metrics.k8s.io`), KEDA (`external.metrics.k8s.io`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- APIService `Available=False` bo'lsa API discovery buziladi: `kubectl` ba'zi buyruqlarda xato beradi, namespace o'chirish `Terminating` da qotib qolishi mumkin.
- Front-proxy sertifikatlari (`--requestheader-*`) noto'g'ri sozlansa aggregated server autentifikatsiyani tan olmaydi.
- Ortiqcha yoki eskirgan APIService'lar (o'chirilgan add-on'dan qolgan) — tozalang.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p holatda CRD + controller yetarli va operatsion jihatdan oson; aggregated API faqat etcd'ga mos kelmaydigan ma'lumot yoki maxsus semantika kerak bo'lganda.

41122.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Metrics Server — kubelet'lardan (Summary/resource API) CPU va memory ishlatishni yig'ib, xotirada saqlaydigan va `metrics.k8s.io` API orqali beradigan yengil komponent. Uni `kubectl top`, HPA va VPA ishlatadi. Bu monitoring tizimi **emas**: tarix yo'q, faqat oxirgi qiymat.

**Nega kerak:** HPA'ga "hozir pod qancha CPU ishlatyapti" degan tez, arzon javob kerak. To'liq Prometheus stack bunga majburiy emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet (har node, cAdvisor/CRI stats) <-- scrape har 15s -- metrics-server
                                                             | xotirada
                                                             v
                       aggregation layer: metrics.k8s.io --> kubectl top, HPA
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl apply -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/releases/latest/download/components.yaml
kubectl top nodes
kubectl top pods -A --sort-by=memory
kubectl get --raw /apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/nodes | jq .
```
Lokal (kind/minikube) muhitda ba'zan `--kubelet-insecure-tls` kerak — production'da emas.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `error: Metrics API not available` — Metrics Server o'rnatilmagan yoki APIService `Available=False`.
- `kubectl top` qiymatlari Prometheus bilan bir xil emas (vaqt oynasi va manba farqi).
- Bitta replika — o'lsa HPA ishlamay qoladi; katta klasterda HA rejim (2 replika) va resurs bering.

**Senior nuqta:** Metrics Server — autoscaling uchun "nazorat signali", observability uchun Prometheus/OpenTelemetry. Ikkisini aralashtirmang va HPA uchun custom metrikalar kerak bo'lsa Prometheus Adapter yoki KEDA qo'shing.

41123.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Prometheus Operator — Prometheus, Alertmanager va ular konfiguratsiyasini Kubernetes CRD'lari orqali boshqaradigan operator: `Prometheus`, `Alertmanager`, `ServiceMonitor`, `PodMonitor`, `PrometheusRule`, `AlertmanagerConfig`. Odatda `kube-prometheus-stack` Helm chart'i orqali Grafana va exporter'lar bilan birga o'rnatiladi.

**Nega kerak:** Prometheus konfiguratsiyasi bitta katta `prometheus.yml` — har jamoa unga scrape target yoki alert qo'shishi kerak bo'lsa, markaziy fayl tor joy bo'ladi. Operator bilan har jamoa o'z namespace'ida CRD yaratadi, operator ularni yig'ib config'ni avtomatik qayta yuklaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ServiceMonitor / PodMonitor / PrometheusRule (jamoalar)
          v watch (label selector)
Prometheus Operator --> generatsiya: prometheus.yml + rules --> Secret
          v
StatefulSet prometheus-k8s (config-reloader sidecar hot reload)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
helm upgrade --install kps prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack -n monitoring --create-namespace
kubectl get prometheus,servicemonitor,prometheusrule -A
kubectl -n monitoring port-forward svc/kps-kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus 9090
# UI: Status -> Targets (scrape holati), Status -> Configuration
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Prometheus` CR'dagi `serviceMonitorSelector`/`ruleSelector` label'lariga mos kelmagan CRD'lar jim e'tiborsiz qoladi (kube-prometheus-stack'da `release: kps` label).
- Yuqori cardinality'li metrikalar Prometheus xotirasini portlatadi — `metricRelabelings` bilan keraksizini tashlang.
- CRD'lar Helm upgrade'da avtomatik yangilanmaydi — alohida qo'llang.

**Senior nuqta:** Bitta Prometheus uzoq muddatli saqlash va global ko'rinishni bermaydi — Thanos/Mimir yoki managed servisga remote_write; operator shu arxitekturani ham boshqaradi.

41124.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `ServiceMonitor` — Prometheus Operator CRD'si: label selector bo'yicha Kubernetes Service'larni topadi va ularning EndpointSlice'laridagi pod'larni ko'rsatilgan port va path bo'yicha scrape target sifatida Prometheus'ga qo'shadi.

**Nega kerak:** Pod IP'lari doim o'zgaradi. Statik target ro'yxati ishlamaydi. ServiceMonitor "app=api label'li servisning `metrics` porti"ni deklarativ yozadi — yangi replikalar avtomatik monitoring'ga tushadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ServiceMonitor (selector app=api, port: metrics)
   v
Service api (port name: metrics -> 9090)
   v
EndpointSlice -> pod IP'lar
   v
Prometheus target: http://10.1.2.3:9090/metrics (label'lar: namespace, pod, service)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: prod
  labels: { release: kps }          # Prometheus selector'iga mos
spec:
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  namespaceSelector: { matchNames: [prod] }
  endpoints:
  - port: metrics                    # Service port NOMI, raqam emas
    path: /metrics
    interval: 30s
```
```bash
kubectl get svc api -n prod -o yaml | grep -A3 ports    # port nomi bormi
# Prometheus UI -> Status -> Targets -> serviceMonitor/prod/api/0
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Target ko'rinmasa uchta sabab: ServiceMonitor label'i Prometheus selector'iga mos emas, Service selector pod'ga mos emas, port nomi noto'g'ri.
- Service'siz pod'lar (masalan Job) uchun `PodMonitor` ishlating.
- Prometheus'ning RBAC'i boshqa namespace'dagi servislarni ko'rishga ruxsat bermasligi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** ServiceMonitor'ni ilova Helm chart'i ichida ixtiyoriy resurs sifatida bering — monitoring ilova bilan birga deploy qilinadi va "observability as code" bo'ladi.

41125.a:
**Qisqa javob:** External Secrets Operator (ESO) — tashqi secret manager'lardan (AWS Secrets Manager, SSM, HashiCorp Vault, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault) qiymatlarni o'qib, ularni Kubernetes'ning nativ `Secret` obyektiga sinxronlaydigan va `refreshInterval` bo'yicha yangilab turadigan operator.

**Nega kerak:** Secret'larni git'da saqlash xavfli, ularni qo'lda `kubectl create secret` qilish esa qayta tiklanmaydi. Haqiqat manbai — markaziy secret store (audit, rotation bilan), ilovalar esa oddiy Kubernetes Secret'ni o'qiydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SecretStore / ClusterSecretStore (provider + auth: IRSA, Workload Identity)
        v
ExternalSecret (qaysi kalit, qaysi Secret'ga, refreshInterval 1h)
        v ESO controller
AWS Secrets Manager "prod/db" --> Secret prod/db-credentials --> pod env/volume
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata: { name: db, namespace: prod }
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef: { kind: ClusterSecretStore, name: aws-sm }
  target: { name: db-credentials, creationPolicy: Owner }
  data:
  - secretKey: password
    remoteRef: { key: prod/db, property: password }
```
```bash
kubectl get externalsecret -n prod      # STATUS: SecretSynced
kubectl describe externalsecret db -n prod
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret yangilansa ham env var orqali o'qigan pod'lar restart bo'lmaguncha eski qiymatda qoladi — Reloader yoki volume mount ishlating.
- `ClusterSecretStore` hamma namespace'ga ochiq bo'lsa, istalgan jamoa istalgan secret'ni o'qiy oladi — `conditions`/namespace cheklovlari qo'ying.
- Natija baribir etcd'dagi Secret — etcd encryption va RBAC hali ham kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Agar Secret'ning etcd'ga tushishi umuman istalmasa, Secrets Store CSI Driver (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri volume) yoki ilovaning o'zi Vault'dan o'qishi muqobil — trade-off: soddalik va xavfsizlik.

41126.a:
**Qisqa javob:** cert-manager — Kubernetes'da TLS sertifikatlarini avtomatik chiqaradigan va muddati tugashidan oldin yangilaydigan add-on. Manbalar: Let's Encrypt (ACME, HTTP-01/DNS-01), HashiCorp Vault, ichki CA, Venafi va boshqalar. Natija — `kubernetes.io/tls` turidagi Secret. CNCF graduated.

**Nega kerak:** Qo'lda yangilanadigan sertifikat muddati albatta qachondir unutiladi va servis "certificate expired" bilan yiqiladi. Let's Encrypt 90 kunlik (va qisqarib borayotgan) sertifikatlarni avtomatlashtirishsiz boshqarib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Issuer / ClusterIssuer (letsencrypt, DNS-01 Route53)
   v
Certificate (dnsNames: api.example.com, secretName: api-tls)
   v CertificateRequest -> Order -> Challenge (DNS TXT yozuvi)
ACME server tasdiqlaydi -> Secret api-tls (tls.crt, tls.key)
muddatning ~2/3 qismida avtomatik renew
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata: { name: letsencrypt }
spec:
  acme:
    server: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
    email: ops@example.com
    privateKeySecretRef: { name: le-account }
    solvers:
    - http01: { ingress: { ingressClassName: nginx } }
```
Ingress'ga `cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt` annotation qo'shish yetarli.
```bash
kubectl get certificate -A          # READY
cmctl status certificate api-tls -n prod
kubectl describe challenge -A       # nega tasdiqlanmayapti
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sinov paytida production ACME'ga ko'p so'rov — rate limit; avval `letsencrypt-staging` ishlating.
- HTTP-01 wildcard'ni qo'llamaydi — `*.example.com` uchun DNS-01 kerak.
- Ilova sertifikatni faqat start'da o'qisa, renew'dan keyin eski sertifikat bilan qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Sertifikat muddati bo'yicha alert qo'ying (`certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds`) — avtomatlashtirish ham jim buzilishi mumkin. Ichki mTLS uchun cert-manager + trust-manager yoki service mesh.

41127.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubernetes garbage collector egasi (`ownerReferences` dagi owner) o'chirilgan obyektlarni avtomatik o'chiradi — cascading deletion. Deployment o'chsa uning ReplicaSet'lari, ular orqali Pod'lar ham o'chadi. Uch rejim: **background** (default), **foreground**, **orphan**.

**Nega kerak:** Har child resursni qo'lda o'chirish kerak bo'lmasligi va "yetim" resurslar to'planmasligi uchun.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Deployment web
  ^ ownerReferences (uid)
ReplicaSet web-abc
  ^ ownerReferences
Pod web-abc-xyz

background: Deployment darhol o'chadi, GC keyin child'larni o'chiradi
foreground: avval child'lar (blockOwnerDeletion), keyin owner (foregroundDeletion finalizer)
orphan:     faqat owner o'chadi, child'lar qoladi (ownerReference olib tashlanadi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl delete deploy web                         # background
kubectl delete deploy web --cascade=foreground
kubectl delete deploy web --cascade=orphan        # pod'lar ishlashda davom etadi
kubectl get rs web-abc -o jsonpath='{.metadata.ownerReferences}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Owner va child boshqa namespace'da bo'la olmaydi (namespaced child cluster-scoped owner'ga ega bo'lishi mumkin, aksincha emas) — noto'g'ri ownerRef GC'ni chalkashtiradi.
- `--cascade=orphan` dan keyin yangi Deployment xuddi shu selector bilan yaratilsa, u yetim ReplicaSet'ni "asrab oladi".
- Operator child'larga ownerReference qo'ymasa, CR o'chganda resurslar qolib ketadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Orphan deletion — selector o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan maydonlarni (immutable) o'zgartirishning downtime'siz usuli: eski owner'ni orphan bilan o'chirib, yangisini yaratish.

41128.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Finalizer — obyekt `metadata.finalizers` ro'yxatidagi kalit. Obyektni o'chirish so'ralganda u darhol o'chmaydi: `deletionTimestamp` qo'yiladi va controller tashqi tozalashni (cloud LB, disk, DNS yozuvi) tugatib, finalizer'ni olib tashlamaguncha etcd'da qoladi.

**Nega kerak:** `type: LoadBalancer` Service o'chsa, cloud'dagi LB ham o'chishi kerak. Agar obyekt darhol yo'qolsa, controller nimani tozalashni bilmay qoladi va pullik "yetim" resurslar qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl delete pvc data
   v
deletionTimestamp set, finalizers: [kubernetes.io/pvc-protection]
   v (obyekt "Terminating")
controller: tozalash (pod hali ishlatayotgan bo'lsa kutadi)
   v
finalizer olib tashlanadi --> ro'yxat bo'sh --> etcd'dan o'chiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get ns stuck -o jsonpath='{.spec.finalizers}{.metadata.finalizers}'
kubectl get pvc data -o jsonpath='{.metadata.finalizers}'
# Terminating'da qotgan namespace — qaysi resurs qolganini topish:
kubectl api-resources --verbs=list --namespaced -o name \
  | xargs -n1 kubectl get -n stuck --ignore-not-found --show-kind
# Oxirgi chora (controller yo'q bo'lsa):
kubectl patch pvc data -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Finalizer'ni majburan olib tashlash tashqi resursni yetim qoldiradi (pullik LB, disk) — avval sababni tushuning.
- Controller o'chirilgan, lekin finalizer qolgan (masalan operator uninstall qilingan) — obyektlar abadiy Terminating.
- Namespace Terminating ko'pincha `Available=False` APIService sabab — discovery ishlamaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Operator yozganda: finalizer'ni tashqi resurs yaratishdan **oldin** qo'shing, tozalash idempotent bo'lsin va tashqi resurs allaqachon yo'q bo'lsa ham muvaffaqiyat deb hisoblang.

41129.a:
**Qisqa javob:** DaemonSet ikki update strategiyasiga ega: `RollingUpdate` (default) — pod'lar node'lar bo'ylab `maxUnavailable` (default 1) bo'yicha birma-bir almashtiriladi; `OnDelete` — yangi pod faqat eskisi qo'lda o'chirilganda yaratiladi. 1.25'dan `maxSurge` ham GA: yangi pod eskisi o'chishidan oldin ishga tushadi.

**Nega kerak:** DaemonSet ko'pincha CNI, log va monitoring agentlari. Hamma node'da birdan yangilash xavfli: yangi versiya buzuq bo'lsa butun klasterning tarmog'i yoki log'i yo'qoladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
maxUnavailable: 1 (maxSurge: 0)
  node-a: eski o'chadi -> yangi start -> Ready -> keyingi node
maxSurge: 1 (maxUnavailable: 0)
  node-a: yangi start (eski hali ishlaydi) -> Ready -> eski o'chadi   [uzilishsiz]
OnDelete: siz pod'ni o'chirgan node'dagina yangilanadi (qo'lda canary)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: "10%"
  minReadySeconds: 30
```
```bash
kubectl rollout status ds/fluent-bit -n logging
kubectl rollout undo ds/fluent-bit -n logging
kubectl get ds fluent-bit -n logging     # UP-TO-DATE ustuni
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `maxSurge` `hostPort` yoki eksklyuziv resurs ishlatadigan DaemonSet bilan ishlamaydi — ikkita pod bir portni ololmaydi.
- Readiness probe va `minReadySeconds` yo'q bo'lsa buzuq versiya juda tez hamma node'ga tarqaladi.
- 500 node'da `maxUnavailable: 1` — rollout soatlab davom etadi; foiz bilan qo'ying.

**Senior nuqta:** CNI kabi kritik agentlar uchun `OnDelete` yoki kichik canary node pool'da avval sinash — tarmoq agentining buzilishi butun klaster incident'i.

41130.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Cordon** — node'ni `unschedulable` qiladi: yangi pod'lar tushmaydi, mavjudlari ishlashda davom etadi. **Drain** — cordon qilib, keyin barcha pod'larni (DaemonSet'dan tashqari) Eviction API orqali PDB'ni hurmat qilib chiqaradi — reboot, kernel yangilash yoki node'ni o'chirish uchun.

**Nega kerak:** Node'ni texnik xizmat uchun to'xtatishdan oldin undagi ish yuklarini boshqa node'larga xavfsiz ko'chirish kerak, aks holda servislar uziladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
cordon:  node.spec.unschedulable=true (taint node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable)
drain:   cordon
         -> har pod uchun Eviction (PDB tekshiruvi)
         -> controller'lar pod'larni boshqa node'da qayta yaratadi
         -> terminationGracePeriod kutiladi
uncordon: node yana schedulable
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl cordon node-a
kubectl drain node-a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=10m
# ... reboot / upgrade ...
kubectl uncordon node-a
kubectl get nodes     # STATUS: Ready,SchedulingDisabled
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Controller'siz "yalang'och" pod'lar drain'ni bloklaydi; `--force` ularni butunlay yo'qotadi.
- `emptyDir` ma'lumotlari drain paytida yo'qoladi — shuning uchun alohida flag talab qilinadi.
- PDB `ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS 0` bo'lsa drain abadiy kutadi — sababni (1 replika, buzuq pod'lar) tuzating, PDB'ni o'chirmang.
- Uncordon'ni unutish — node bo'sh turadi va pul isrof bo'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Klaster upgrade'larini avtomatlashtiring (managed node group, Karpenter drift, kured) — ular drain'ni to'g'ri tartibda qiladi; sizning vazifangiz PDB, probe va graceful shutdown to'g'ri ekanini ta'minlash.

41131.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `kubectl exec` container ichida **yangi** process ishga tushiradi (masalan `sh`). `kubectl attach` esa container'ning **mavjud** asosiy process'iga (PID 1) stdin/stdout/stderr orqali ulanadi — yangi process yaratilmaydi.

**Nega kerak:** Debug uchun shell kerak bo'lsa — exec. Interaktiv ilovaning (masalan REPL yoki `-it` bilan start bo'lgan container) o'zi bilan gaplashish yoki uning jonli chiqishini ko'rish — attach.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
exec:   kubectl -> apiserver -> kubelet -> CRI Exec -> yangi process (PID N) container namespace'ida
attach: kubectl -> apiserver -> kubelet -> CRI Attach -> PID 1 ning stdio oqimlari
```
| | exec | attach |
|---|---|---|
| Process | yangi | mavjud PID 1 |
| Image'da shell kerakmi | ha | yo'q |
| Chiqishda | process tugaydi | Ctrl+C PID 1'ga borishi mumkin |

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl exec -it web -c app -- sh
kubectl exec web -- cat /etc/resolv.conf
kubectl run -it repl --image=python:3.12 -- python   # stdin bilan
kubectl attach -it repl                               # keyin qayta ulanish
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Distroless image'da `exec ... sh` ishlamaydi ("executable file not found") — `kubectl debug` ishlating.
- `attach` qilib Ctrl+C bosish asosiy process'ni o'ldirishi mumkin; chiqish uchun `Ctrl+P Ctrl+Q` (tty bo'lsa).
- `pods/exec` ruxsati amalda container ichidagi hamma narsaga (secret'lar, token) kirish — RBAC'da qattiq cheklang.

**Senior nuqta:** Production'da exec'ni istisno qiling: audit log'da kuzating, imkon bo'lsa faqat break-glass rol orqali bering. Kuzatuv uchun log/metric/trace yetishmasa — bu observability kamchiligi signali.

41132.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `kubectl port-forward` lokal mashinadagi portni klaster ichidagi pod (yoki Service/Deployment orqali tanlangan bitta pod) portiga API server va kubelet orqali **tunnel** qiladi. Service'ni tashqariga ochmasdan vaqtinchalik ulanish uchun.

**Nega kerak:** Klaster ichidagi DB, admin panel yoki Prometheus UI'ni tez tekshirish uchun Ingress yoki LoadBalancer yaratish ortiqcha va xavfli.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
localhost:5432 --> kubectl --(HTTPS/WebSocket, SPDY)--> kube-apiserver
                                                        v
                                                     kubelet --> pod netns:5432
```
Service ko'rsatilsa ham trafik **bitta** pod'ga boradi (load balancing yo'q); ulanish faqat TCP.

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl port-forward svc/postgres 5432:5432 -n prod
psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U app

kubectl port-forward pod/web-abc 8080:80
kubectl port-forward deploy/grafana 3000 --address 0.0.0.0   # boshqa mashinadan (ehtiyot!)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Pod restart bo'lsa yoki boshqa pod'ga almashsa tunnel uziladi — qayta ishga tushirish kerak.
- UDP qo'llanmaydi; uzun va yuqori trafikli ishlar uchun sekin.
- `--address 0.0.0.0` ichki servisni butun lokal tarmoqqa ochadi.
- `pods/portforward` RBAC ruxsati NetworkPolicy'larni chetlab o'tishga imkon beradi.

**Senior nuqta:** port-forward — debug vositasi, doimiy kirish yo'li emas. Doimiy admin kirish uchun VPN, bastion yoki identity-aware proxy (Teleport, Tailscale) — audit va SSO bilan.

41133.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Admission webhook'ning `failurePolicy` webhook javob bermasa (timeout, xato, TLS muammo) nima bo'lishini belgilaydi: **`Ignore`** — so'rov webhook'siz qabul qilinadi (fail-open); **`Fail`** — so'rov rad etiladi (fail-closed). `admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1` da default `Fail`.

**Nega kerak:** Bu xavfsizlik va mavjudlik o'rtasidagi tanlov: security policy chetlab o'tilmasligi kerak, lekin webhook o'lganda butun klaster deploy qila olmay qolishi ham falokat.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
apiserver --> webhook (timeoutSeconds: 10, max 30)
   javob yo'q:
     Ignore -> obyekt yaratiladi (policy tekshirilmagan!)
     Fail   -> "failed calling webhook ..." xatosi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
webhooks:
- name: policy.example.com
  failurePolicy: Fail
  timeoutSeconds: 5
  sideEffects: None
  namespaceSelector:
    matchExpressions:
    - { key: kubernetes.io/metadata.name, operator: NotIn, values: [kube-system, policy-system] }
  clientConfig: { service: { name: policy, namespace: policy-system, path: /validate } }
```
```bash
kubectl get validatingwebhookconfiguration,mutatingwebhookconfiguration
kubectl get events -A | grep -i 'failed calling webhook'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Fail` + webhook'ning o'z namespace'i ham tekshirilsa: webhook pod'i o'lsa, uni qayta yaratishni ham webhook bloklaydi — deadlock.
- Bitta replika, PDB va anti-affinity yo'q — node drain webhook'ni o'chirib, klaster deploy'larini to'xtatadi.
- Katta `timeoutSeconds` — sekin webhook har API so'rovni sekinlashtiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Security webhook'lari uchun `Fail` + HA (3 replika, PDB, yuqori PriorityClass) + tizim namespace'larini istisno qilish + latency/xato metrikalariga alert. Mumkin bo'lsa in-process CEL policy'lariga o'ting.

41134.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` — pod o'chirilganda container'lar toza to'xtashi uchun beriladigan umumiy vaqt (default **30s**). Kubelet avval `preStop` hook'ini bajaradi, keyin `SIGTERM` yuboradi; vaqt tugaganda hali tirik process'larga `SIGKILL` yuboriladi. `preStop` vaqti ham shu davr ichiga kiradi.

**Nega kerak:** Ilova yarim bajarilgan so'rovlarni tugatishi, ulanishlarni yopishi, navbatdagi xabarni commit qilishi kerak. Aks holda har deploy foydalanuvchilarga 502 xatolar beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
t=0   pod Terminating; endpoint'lardan olib tashlash boshlanadi (parallel!)
      preStop (masalan sleep 10)
t=10  SIGTERM -> ilova yangi so'rov olmaydi, mavjudlarini tugatadi
t=30  hali tirik? -> SIGKILL (exit 137)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
  containers:
  - name: app
    lifecycle:
      preStop: { sleep: { seconds: 10 } }   # 1.30+ native sleep
```
Go'da SIGTERM ishlovi:
```go
ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM)
defer stop()
<-ctx.Done()
shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 40*time.Second)
defer cancel()
srv.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ilova shell orqali start bo'lsa (`sh -c "java ..."`), SIGTERM shell'ga boradi va ilovaga yetmaydi — `exec` yoki `tini` ishlating.
- Ilovaning ichki shutdown timeout'i grace period'dan uzun bo'lsa baribir SIGKILL.
- Juda katta grace period (masalan 3600) node drain va rollout'ni soatlab cho'zadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Grace period = preStop + ilovaning eng uzun so'rov/ish vaqti + zaxira. Uzun ishlovchi consumer'lar uchun ishni kichik bo'laklarga bo'ling — grace period'ni cheksiz oshirmang.

41135.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `preStop` — container to'xtatilishidan oldin, `SIGTERM` yuborilishidan **oldin** bajariladigan lifecycle hook (`exec` buyruq, `httpGet` yoki 1.30'dan native `sleep`). Kubelet u tugaguncha kutadi (grace period ichida).

**Nega kerak:** Pod o'chirilganda ikki narsa **parallel** sodir bo'ladi: kubelet container'ni to'xtatadi va endpoint controller pod'ni Service'dan olib tashlaydi, kube-proxy/ingress esa buni biroz kechikib ko'radi. Agar ilova darhol to'xtasa, bu oraliqda kelgan so'rovlar "connection refused" oladi. `preStop: sleep` shu oraliqni yopadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
delete pod
  |-- EndpointSlice'dan chiqarish --> kube-proxy / ingress yangilanishi (1-5s)
  |-- kubelet: preStop sleep 10  (ilova hali so'rovlarga javob beradi)
                  v
               SIGTERM -> graceful shutdown -> exit
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    sleep: { seconds: 10 }          # image'da sleep binary kerak emas
# eski usul:
#   exec: { command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 10"] }
# yoki ilovaga drain buyrug'i:
#   httpGet: { path: /drain, port: 8080 }
```
```bash
kubectl describe pod web | grep -A3 -i prestop
kubectl get events | grep FailedPreStopHook
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Distroless image'da `exec: sleep` ishlamaydi — native `sleep` (1.30+) ishlating.
- preStop vaqti grace period'dan katta bo'lsa — ilova SIGTERM'ni umuman olmasdan SIGKILL bilan o'ladi.
- preStop xatosi pod o'chishini to'xtatmaydi, faqat event yoziladi — muhim mantiqni unga ishonmang.

**Senior nuqta:** Rolling update'dagi 502/503 xatolarning eng keng tarqalgan sababi — shu endpoint propagatsiya oralig'i. preStop sleep + readiness + to'g'ri grace period — uchtasi birga zero-downtime deploy'ni beradi.

41136.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Server-Side Apply (SSA) — apply mantiqini client'dan (`kubectl`) API server'ga ko'chiradi. Server har maydonga qaysi "manager" (kubectl, Helm, HPA, operator) egalik qilishini `metadata.managedFields` da kuzatadi; boshqa manager egalik qilgan maydonni o'zgartirmoqchi bo'lsangiz **konflikt** qaytariladi. 1.22'dan GA.

**Nega kerak:** Client-side apply `last-applied-configuration` annotation'iga tayanadi va bir nechta vosita bitta obyektni boshqarganda bir-birining o'zgarishlarini jim ustidan yozadi (klassik: GitOps `replicas` ni qaytaradi, HPA esa uni o'zgartiradi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
managedFields:
  - manager: argocd      fields: spec.template, spec.selector
  - manager: hpa         fields: spec.replicas
argocd apply replicas: 3  --> CONFLICT (egasi hpa)
  --force-conflicts       --> egalik argocd'ga o'tadi
YAML'dan maydonni olib tashlash = egalikni bo'shatish (o'chirish emas, agar boshqa egasi bo'lsa)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl apply --server-side -f deploy.yaml --field-manager=ci
kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f deploy.yaml
kubectl get deploy web -o yaml --show-managed-fields | less
```
Go'da: `client.Apply` patch turi yoki client-go `ApplyConfiguration` tiplari.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Manifest'da `replicas` ni qoldirib HPA bilan ishlatish — SSA konfliktni ko'rsatadi; yechim — maydonni manifest'dan olib tashlash.
- Har deploy'da `--force-conflicts` ishlatish SSA'ning ma'nosini yo'qotadi.
- Client-side'dan server-side'ga o'tishda egalik migratsiyasi ba'zan kutilmagan natija beradi — avval `kubectl diff --server-side`.

**Senior nuqta:** Operator va GitOps vositalari uchun SSA standart bo'lib bormoqda (Argo CD `ServerSideApply=true`, Flux default) — bir nechta controller bitta obyektni xavfsiz bo'lishishining asosi.

41137.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `subPath` — butun volume'ni emas, uning ichidagi **bitta fayl yoki papkani** container'dagi aniq yo'lga mount qilish. Muhim cheklov: `subPath` bilan mount qilingan ConfigMap/Secret **avtomatik yangilanmaydi**.

**Nega kerak:** ConfigMap'ni `/etc/nginx/` ga to'liq mount qilsangiz, papkadagi boshqa fayllar yashirinib qoladi. `subPath` faqat `nginx.conf` faylini qo'yib, qolganini saqlaydi. Shuningdek bitta PVC'ni bir necha container'ga turli papkalar bilan bo'lishish mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Oddiy mount:  volume (key'lar) --> /etc/nginx/          (papka butunlay almashadi)
subPath:      volume/nginx.conf --> /etc/nginx/nginx.conf (faqat bitta fayl)

Yangilanish: oddiy mount -> symlink (..data) atomik almashtiriladi -> fayl yangilanadi
             subPath     -> bind mount aniq inode'ga -> eski kontent qoladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
volumes:
- name: cfg
  configMap: { name: nginx-config }
- name: data
  persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: shared }
containers:
- name: nginx
  volumeMounts:
  - { name: cfg, mountPath: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf, subPath: nginx.conf }
  - { name: data, mountPath: /var/lib/app, subPathExpr: $(POD_NAME) }
  env:
  - name: POD_NAME
    valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.name } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Config yangilandi, lekin ilova eski qiymatni ko'radi — sabab subPath; pod'ni restart qiling yoki butun papkani mount qiling.
- `subPath` mavjud bo'lmasa papka sifatida yaratiladi — fayl kutgan ilova "is a directory" xatosini oladi.
- Tarixan subPath bilan symlink zaifliklari (CVE'lar) bo'lgan — klasterni yangi saqlang.

**Senior nuqta:** Config o'zgarishini deploy bilan bog'lang: ConfigMap nomiga hash (Kustomize generator) yoki pod template'ga checksum annotation (Helm) — shunda config o'zgarishi kontrollik rollout bo'ladi, jim hot-reload emas.

41138.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Projected volume — bir nechta manbani (`secret`, `configMap`, `downwardAPI`, `serviceAccountToken`, 1.29+'da `clusterTrustBundle`) **bitta papkaga** birlashtirib mount qiladigan volume turi.

**Nega kerak:** Ilova bitta konfiguratsiya papkasini kutadi (masalan `/etc/app/`), lekin ma'lumot turli joydan keladi: sertifikat Secret'da, sozlama ConfigMap'da, pod nomi metadata'da. Projected volume ularni bitta joyda yig'adi. ServiceAccount token'ining zamonaviy mexanizmi ham aynan projected volume.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Secret tls        --+
ConfigMap app     --+--> projected volume --> /etc/app/
downwardAPI labels--+                           tls.crt, tls.key
SA token (aud=vault, 1h) --+                    app.yaml, labels, token
```
`serviceAccountToken` manbasi audience va muddat bilan maxsus token so'raydi; kubelet uni muddat 80% o'tganda avtomatik yangilaydi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
volumes:
- name: app-config
  projected:
    defaultMode: 0440
    sources:
    - secret: { name: tls, items: [{ key: tls.crt, path: tls.crt }] }
    - configMap: { name: app }
    - downwardAPI:
        items: [{ path: labels, fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.labels } }]
    - serviceAccountToken:
        audience: vault
        expirationSeconds: 3600
        path: vault-token
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ikki manbada bir xil fayl nomi — to'qnashuv; `items.path` bilan aniq nom bering.
- Barcha manbalar pod bilan bir namespace'da bo'lishi kerak.
- Ilova token'ni faqat start'da o'qisa, yangilangan token'ni ko'rmaydi — faylni har safar qayta o'qing.

**Senior nuqta:** Audience'ga bog'langan projected SA token — Vault, cloud IAM yoki boshqa servislarga workload identity berishning eng toza usuli: qisqa muddatli, avtomatik aylanadigan va maqsadga cheklangan.

41139.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Downward API — pod va container haqidagi ma'lumotni (nom, namespace, pod IP, node nomi, label/annotation'lar, request/limit'lar) ilovaga **env var** yoki **fayl** sifatida, Kubernetes API'ga murojaat qilmasdan beradi.

**Nega kerak:** Ilova log'ga pod nomini yozishi, metrikaga node nomini qo'shishi yoki thread sonini CPU limit'iga moslashi kerak. Buning uchun API ruxsati va client kutubxona berish ortiqcha va xavfli.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
env (fieldRef / resourceFieldRef)   -> start'da bir marta, keyin o'zgarmaydi
volume (downwardAPI)                -> label/annotation o'zgarsa fayl yangilanadi
Mavjud: metadata.name, metadata.namespace, metadata.uid, metadata.labels['x'],
        spec.nodeName, spec.serviceAccountName, status.podIP, status.hostIP,
        limits.cpu, limits.memory, requests.*
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
env:
- name: POD_NAME
  valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.name } }
- name: NODE_NAME
  valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: spec.nodeName } }
- name: POD_IP
  valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: status.podIP } }
- name: GOMEMLIMIT
  valueFrom:
    resourceFieldRef: { containerName: app, resource: limits.memory }
- name: GOMAXPROCS
  valueFrom:
    resourceFieldRef: { resource: limits.cpu, divisor: "1" }
```
```bash
kubectl exec web -- env | grep -E 'POD_|NODE_'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Barcha label'lar (`metadata.labels`) env orqali berilmaydi — faqat volume fayl sifatida; env uchun aniq kalit kerak.
- Env qiymatlari pod hayoti davomida yangilanmaydi.
- CPU limit yo'q bo'lsa `limits.cpu` node'ning allocatable qiymatini qaytaradi — kutilmagan katta GOMAXPROCS.

**Senior nuqta:** `GOMEMLIMIT` / JVM `MaxRAMPercentage` ni limit'ga bog'lash OOMKill'ning eng arzon oldini olish; pod/node nomini log va trace atributlariga qo'shish esa incident tahlilini keskin tezlashtiradi.

41140.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubernetes Event — klasterda nima sodir bo'lganini yozadigan qisqa muddatli obyekt: scheduling qarorlari (`FailedScheduling`), image pull xatolari, probe yiqilishlari, OOM, eviction, scaling. Default'da faqat **~1 soat** saqlanadi (`--event-ttl`), shuning uchun uzoq tahlil uchun eksport qilinishi kerak.

**Nega kerak:** "Pod nega Pending?", "nega restart bo'ldi?" degan savollarning birinchi javobi — Event'larda. Log ilova ichini ko'rsatadi, Event esa Kubernetes'ning o'zi nima qilganini.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
scheduler / kubelet / controller --> Event (type: Normal|Warning, reason, message,
                                            involvedObject, count, lastTimestamp)
   v
etcd (alohida etcd server'ga ajratish mumkin) --> TTL 1h --> o'chadi
Takroriy event'lar birlashtiriladi (count++), API: events.k8s.io/v1
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get events -n prod --sort-by=.lastTimestamp
kubectl get events -A --field-selector type=Warning
kubectl events --for pod/web -n prod --watch          # yangi buyruq
kubectl describe pod web       # pastki qismida Events
```
Tipik reason'lar: `FailedScheduling` (resurs/taint/affinity), `ImagePullBackOff`, `BackOff` (CrashLoop), `Unhealthy` (probe), `OOMKilling`, `Evicted`, `FailedMount`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Incident'dan 2 soat keyin tahlil qilinsa event'lar allaqachon yo'q.
- `--sort-by` siz `kubectl get events` tartibi chalkash.
- Juda ko'p event yaratadigan buzuq controller etcd'ni to'ldirishi mumkin — katta klasterda event'lar uchun alohida etcd.

**Senior nuqta:** Event'larni log tizimiga eksport qiling (kubernetes-event-exporter, OpenTelemetry Collector `k8sobjects`/`k8s_events` receiver) va `Warning` turidagi muhimlari (`FailedScheduling`, `OOMKilling`) bo'yicha alert yarating.

41141.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `CrashLoopBackOff` — container ishga tushadi, yiqiladi, kubelet uni qayta ishga tushiradi va har safar kutish vaqtini oshiradi (10s, 20s, 40s ... 5 daqiqagacha). Bu sabab emas, oqibat: sababni exit code, event va **oldingi** log'dan topasiz.

**Muammo:** Deploy'dan keyin pod `Running` bo'lmaydi, restart soni o'sib boradi. Ko'pchilik `kubectl logs` ni ishlatib bo'sh ekran ko'radi — chunki yangi container hali ishga tushmagan, log oldingisida.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
start -> crash (exit != 0) -> kubelet restart
   ^                              |
   +---- backoff 10s,20s,40s...<--+   (max 5m, 10 daqiqa barqaror ishlasa reset)
```

**Amalda (tartib bilan):**
```bash
kubectl get pod api-7d9f -o wide          # RESTARTS soni, qaysi node
kubectl describe pod api-7d9f             # Last State, Exit Code, Reason, Events
kubectl logs api-7d9f --previous          # yiqilgan container log'i
kubectl logs api-7d9f -c migrate --previous   # ko'p container bo'lsa
kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -20
```
`describe` da qarang:
```
Last State:  Terminated
  Reason:    Error        <- yoki OOMKilled
  Exit Code: 1            <- ilova xatosi; 137 = SIGKILL; 127 = binary yo'q
```

**Exit code bo'yicha yo'naltirish:**
| Kod | Ma'nosi | Qayerga qarash |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ilova exception | `--previous` log |
| 127/126 | binary yo'q / ruxsat yo'q | image, `command` |
| 137 | OOMKilled yoki liveness kill | limit, probe |
| 0 | process tugadi (server emas) | `command`, Job bo'lishi kerakmi |

**Tipik sabablar:** env/Secret yo'q, DB'ga ulana olmaydi, noto'g'ri entrypoint, config fayl topilmaydi, liveness probe startup tugamasdan o'ldiradi, OOM.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--previous` siz log ko'rib "log bo'sh" deb xulosa qilish.
- Agressiv liveness probe'ni sezmaslik — sekin startup'da `startupProbe` kerak.
- Log hech narsa yozmasa — `kubectl debug` bilan image ichini ko'rish (41209).

**Senior nuqta:** Avval zararni to'xtating (`kubectl rollout undo`), keyin tekshiring. Ilova startup'da config'ni validate qilib aniq xato bilan yiqilishi (fail fast) — diagnostikani daqiqalarga qisqartiradi; `terminationMessagePolicy: FallbackToLogsOnError` ham yordam beradi.

41142.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Exit code 137 = 128 + 9, ya'ni process `SIGKILL` oldi. Kubernetes'da eng ko'p sabab — container `limits.memory` dan oshib kernel OOM killer uni o'ldirgan (`Reason: OOMKilled`). Kamroq — grace period tugab majburan o'ldirilgan yoki liveness probe yiqilgan.

**Muammo:** Pod vaqti-vaqti bilan restart bo'ladi, log'da hech qanday xato yo'q — chunki SIGKILL'ni ushlab bo'lmaydi, ilova hech narsa yozib ulgurmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
container RSS o'sadi -> cgroup memory.max ga yetadi
   -> kernel OOM killer -> SIGKILL -> exit 137 -> kubelet: OOMKilled
```
CPU limit'dan oshish o'ldirmaydi (faqat throttle), memory esa o'ldiradi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -A5 "Last State"
#   Reason: OOMKilled   Exit Code: 137
kubectl top pod api-x --containers        # joriy iste'mol
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].resources}'
dmesg -T | grep -i oom                    # node'da (node OOM bo'lsa)
```
Prometheus: `container_memory_working_set_bytes` vs `kube_pod_container_resource_limits`.

**Tuzatish:**
```yaml
resources:
  requests: { memory: 512Mi }
  limits:   { memory: 768Mi }
env:
- name: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
  value: "-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0"   # JVM heap limit'ga moslanadi
- name: GOMEMLIMIT
  value: "650MiB"                      # Go GC limit'dan oldin agressivlashadi
```
Leak bo'lsa — heap profiling (pprof, heap dump) bilan topish; limit'ni cheksiz oshirish yechim emas.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Reason: Error` + 137 — OOM emas, grace period'dan keyin SIGKILL yoki liveness kill bo'lishi mumkin; event'larni o'qing.
- JVM eski versiyalari cgroup limitni ko'rmaydi — heap limit'dan katta bo'ladi.
- Node darajasidagi OOM (node RAM tugadi) boshqa pod'larni ham o'ldiradi — eviction va reserved resurslarni tekshiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Memory uchun `requests == limits` (Guaranteed QoS) bashorat qilinadigan xulq beradi. Limit'ni p99 iste'mol + 20-30% zaxira bilan qo'ying va `OOMKilled` hodisasiga alert qo'ying — u jim ishlamay qolishning eng keng tarqalgan sababi.

41143.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Exit code 143 = 128 + 15, ya'ni container `SIGTERM` olib, o'zi to'xtadi. Bu odatda **normal**: rolling update, node drain, scale-down yoki `kubectl delete pod` paytida Kubernetes pod'ni muloyim to'xtatadi.

**Muammo:** Monitoring'da "143 bilan tugadi" ko'rib vahima qilish yoki aksincha — kutilmagan joyda 143 bo'lsa (masalan hech kim deploy qilmagan) uni e'tiborsiz qoldirish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl delete / rollout / drain
  -> endpoint'dan olib tashlash (parallel)
  -> preStop hook (bo'lsa)
  -> SIGTERM -> ilova drain qiladi -> exit 143 (yoki 0)
  -> terminationGracePeriodSeconds (default 30s) tugasa -> SIGKILL -> 137
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-x | grep -A4 "Last State"
#   Reason: Error   Exit Code: 143
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=api-x
kubectl rollout history deploy/api        # yaqinda deploy bo'lganmi
```
Ilova SIGTERM'ni ushlasa va `exit(0)` qilsa — kod 0 bo'ladi, bu yanada toza.

Go misol:
```go
ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM)
defer stop()
<-ctx.Done()
srv.Shutdown(context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second))
```

**Qachon xavotir:**
- Hech qanday deploy/drain bo'lmagan — liveness probe yiqilib kubelet restart qilgan bo'lishi mumkin (event: `Liveness probe failed`).
- Node eviction (disk/memory pressure) — event: `Evicted`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Shell wrapper (`sh -c "app"`) SIGTERM'ni ilovaga yetkazmaydi — `exec app` yoki `tini` ishlating, aks holda 30s kutib 137 olasiz.
- Grace period ilovaning haqiqiy drain vaqtidan qisqa.

**Senior nuqta:** 143 — "to'xtatildi", 137 — "o'ldirildi". Yaxshi ilovada deploy paytidagi barcha tugashlar 0/143 bo'lishi kerak; 137 ko'rinsa graceful shutdown buzilgan.

41144.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `ErrImagePull` — kubelet image'ni yuklay olmadi; `ImagePullBackOff` — qayta urinishlar orasida kutish holati. Sabab doim `kubectl describe pod` Events'dagi aniq xabarda: noto'g'ri tag, auth yo'q, tarmoq, rate limit yoki arxitektura.

**Muammo:** Yangi versiya deploy qilindi, pod'lar `ContainerCreating` dan o'tmaydi — servis eski replikalarda qoladi yoki umuman yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet -> containerd -> registry (DNS, TLS, auth)
   xato -> ErrImagePull -> backoff (max 5m) -> ImagePullBackOff
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-x | sed -n '/Events/,$p'
```
Xabar bo'yicha diagnoz:
| Event xabari | Sabab |
|---|---|
| `manifest unknown` / `not found` | tag yoki repo nomi xato |
| `401 Unauthorized` / `no basic auth credentials` | `imagePullSecrets` yo'q, ECR token eskirgan, IAM ruxsat yo'q |
| `toomanyrequests` | Docker Hub rate limit |
| `i/o timeout`, `dial tcp` | firewall, NAT, proxy, private endpoint |
| `no matching manifest for linux/arm64` | arxitektura mos emas |

Node'dan qo'lda tekshirish:
```bash
crictl pull 123.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/api:1.4.2
kubectl create secret docker-registry regcred \
  --docker-server=ghcr.io --docker-username=bot --docker-password=$TOKEN
```
```yaml
spec:
  imagePullSecrets: [{ name: regcred }]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret boshqa namespace'da — `imagePullSecrets` faqat o'z namespace'idagi secret'ni ko'radi.
- `:latest` tag + `imagePullPolicy: Always` — har restart registry'ga bog'liq.
- Multi-arch image o'rniga faqat amd64 build qilish, keyin Graviton node'lar qo'shilishi.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod'da image'larni digest (`@sha256:...`) bilan pin qiling, Docker Hub'dan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tortmang — pull-through cache yoki o'z registry (ECR/Harbor) ishlating. Registry ham yagona nosozlik nuqtasi: undan uzilsangiz scale-up ham to'xtaydi.

41145.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `Pending` — pod hali hech qaysi node'ga joylashmagan (yoki volume kutyapti). Sabab `kubectl describe pod` Events'ida scheduler yozadi: `0/12 nodes are available: 5 Insufficient cpu, 7 node(s) had untolerated taint...`.

**Muammo:** Deploy qildingiz, replikalar `Pending` da turibdi, HPA scale qila olmayapti — trafik oshgan paytda bu outage.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod yaratildi -> scheduler: Filter (resurs, taint, affinity, volume)
   -> mos node yo'q -> Pending + FailedScheduling event
   -> Cluster Autoscaler/Karpenter yangi node qo'shishga urinadi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-x | sed -n '/Events/,$p'
# Warning FailedScheduling 0/6 nodes are available:
#   3 Insufficient memory, 3 node(s) had untolerated taint {gpu: true}
kubectl describe node <n> | grep -A8 "Allocated resources"
kubectl get pvc                             # Pending PVC bormi
kubectl describe quota -n team-a            # ResourceQuota to'lganmi
```

**Sabablar va yechim:**
| Xabar | Yechim |
|---|---|
| `Insufficient cpu/memory` | request'ni kamaytirish yoki node qo'shish |
| `untolerated taint` | toleration qo'shish yoki to'g'ri node pool |
| `didn't match node affinity/selector` | label'larni tekshirish |
| `unbound immediate PersistentVolumeClaims` | StorageClass, AZ, provisioner |
| `exceeded quota` (event Deployment/RS'da) | quota oshirish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Scheduler `requests` ga qaraydi, real iste'molga emas — node "bo'sh" ko'rinsa ham request'lar band qilgan bo'lishi mumkin.
- Quota xatosi pod'da emas, ReplicaSet event'larida (`kubectl describe rs`).
- `Immediate` volume binding boshqa AZ'da disk yaratib pod'ni abadiy Pending qiladi — `WaitForFirstConsumer` ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** `Pending` pod'lar soniga (`kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"}`) 5 daqiqalik alert qo'ying. Autoscaler bo'lsa ham node chiqishi 1-3 daqiqa — kritik servislar uchun overprovisioning yoki PriorityClass kerak.

41146.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pod `Terminating` da qolib ketishining sabablari: bajarilmagan **finalizer**, o'lik/ulanmaydigan node (kubelet tasdiqlay olmaydi), yoki volume unmount osilgan. Avval sababni toping; `--force` faqat node haqiqatan o'lik va ikkita nusxa ishlash xavfi yo'qligini bilganda.

**Muammo:** `kubectl delete pod` qildingiz, pod soatlab yo'qolmaydi. StatefulSet yangi replika yarata olmaydi (bir xil nom), deploy to'xtaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
delete -> deletionTimestamp qo'yiladi -> kubelet container'ni to'xtatadi
   -> kubelet API'ga "tugadi" deydi -> finalizers bo'sh bo'lsa -> obyekt o'chadi
Node o'lik bo'lsa: kubelet hech qachon tasdiqlamaydi -> abadiy Terminating
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl get pod db-0 -o jsonpath='{.metadata.finalizers}{"\n"}{.spec.nodeName}'
kubectl get node <node>                 # NotReady?
kubectl describe pod db-0 | tail        # volume unmount xatosi?
```
Node o'lik va qaytmasligi aniq bo'lsa:
```bash
kubectl delete node <node>              # yoki out-of-service taint:
kubectl taint node <node> node.kubernetes.io/out-of-service=nodeshutdown:NoExecute
```
Oxirgi chora:
```bash
kubectl delete pod db-0 --grace-period=0 --force
kubectl patch pod db-0 --type=merge -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Force delete faqat API'dan o'chiradi — agar node aslida tirik bo'lsa, eski container ishlashda davom etadi. StatefulSet'da bu ikkita `db-0` va ma'lumot buzilishi demak.
- Finalizer'ni olib tashlash tashqi resursni (LB, disk) yetim qoldiradi.
- RWO volume eski node'dan ajratilmaguncha yangi pod ulay olmaydi (6 daqiqalik attach timeout).

**Senior nuqta:** Node'ni avval fencing qiling (cloud konsoldan o'chirish), keyin force delete. `out-of-service` taint (K8s 1.28 GA) volume'larni xavfsiz detach qilish uchun to'g'ri yo'l.

41147.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pod `resolv.conf` da `ndots:5` va bir nechta search domen bor. Nomda 5 tadan kam nuqta bo'lsa, resolver avval search domen'larni qo'shib so'raydi — `api.stripe.com` uchun 3 ta behuda NXDOMAIN, A+AAAA bilan 6+ so'rov. Natija: CoreDNS yuklanadi, tashqi chaqiruvlar latency oladi.

**Muammo:** Ilova tashqi API'ni ko'p chaqiradi; p99 latency sakraydi, CoreDNS CPU 100%, ba'zan 5s timeout (conntrack race bilan).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
/etc/resolv.conf:
  search default.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local
  options ndots:5

lookup "api.stripe.com" (2 nuqta < 5)
  -> api.stripe.com.default.svc.cluster.local  NXDOMAIN
  -> api.stripe.com.svc.cluster.local          NXDOMAIN
  -> api.stripe.com.cluster.local              NXDOMAIN
  -> api.stripe.com                            OK
```
`ndots:5` sababi — `svc.ns` kabi qisqa ichki nomlar ishlashi uchun.

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl exec api-x -- cat /etc/resolv.conf
kubectl exec api-x -- dig +search api.stripe.com    # nechta so'rov
```
Yechimlar:
```yaml
spec:
  dnsConfig:
    options:
    - { name: ndots, value: "2" }
```
- FQDN nuqta bilan: `api.stripe.com.` — search ishlatilmaydi.
- **NodeLocal DNSCache** — har node'da cache, NXDOMAIN'lar ham keshlanadi, conntrack muammosi yo'qoladi.
- CoreDNS `autopath` plugin (`pods verified` talab qiladi, xotira oshadi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ndots:1` qilsangiz `my-svc.other-ns` kabi qisqa ichki nomlar buziladi (birinchi bo'lib tashqariga so'raydi).
- Alpine/musl resolver search'ni boshqacha ishlaydi va TCP fallback yo'q eski versiyalarda.
- Muammo faqat yuqori RPS'da ko'rinadi — lokal testda topilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** NodeLocal DNSCache — katta klasterlarda default bo'lishi kerak. CoreDNS metrikasi `coredns_dns_responses_total{rcode="NXDOMAIN"}` ulushi yuqori bo'lsa — ndots muammosining aniq belgisi.

41148.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Zero-downtime uchun 4 narsa birga kerak: `maxUnavailable: 0` strategiya, haqiqiy readiness probe, `preStop` sleep (endpoint yangilanishini kutish) va ilovada SIGTERM'da graceful drain. Bittasi yo'q bo'lsa — deploy paytida 502/503 lar.

**Muammo:** Kubernetes pod'ni o'chirganda ikkita ish **parallel** bo'ladi: SIGTERM yuborish va pod'ni Endpoints/ingress/kube-proxy'dan olib tashlash. Endpoint yangilanishi barcha node'larga 1-5 s'da yetadi — shu orada trafik allaqachon to'xtagan pod'ga boradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
delete pod
  |-> EndpointSlice'dan olish -> kube-proxy/ingress yangilanadi (1-5s)
  |-> preStop: sleep 10  (pod hali trafik qabul qiladi)
        -> SIGTERM -> yangi ulanish yo'q, eskilari tugaydi -> exit
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds >= preStop + drain
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  strategy:
    rollingUpdate: { maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0 }
  template:
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
      containers:
      - name: api
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 2
        lifecycle:
          preStop:
            sleep: { seconds: 10 }   # K8s 1.30+; eskida exec: ["sleep","10"]
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
spec: { maxUnavailable: 1, selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } } }
```
Tekshirish: deploy paytida `hey`/`k6` bilan yuklama berib 5xx sonini o'lchang.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Readiness `/health` faqat "process tirik" desa — yangi pod DB'ga ulanmasdan trafik oladi.
- Keep-alive ulanishlar: drain'da `Connection: close` yubormasa client eski pod'ga yozishda davom etadi.
- `minReadySeconds` yo'q — tez yiqiladigan pod'lar rollout'ni "muvaffaqiyatli" deb o'tkazadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Zero-downtime'ni da'vo emas, test qiling: CI'da rollout paytida xato sonini o'lchaydigan smoke test. Long-lived ulanishlar (gRPC, WebSocket) uchun client tomonda reconnect va `GOAWAY` kerak.

41149.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Istio — service mesh: servislar orasidagi trafikni ilova kodini o'zgartirmasdan boshqaradi. Uch vazifa: **traffic management** (canary, retry, timeout), **security** (avtomatik mTLS, authz) va **observability** (metrika, trace). Ikki qism: control plane `istiod` va data plane Envoy proxy'lar.

**Muammo:** 50 ta mikroservis. Har birida retry, mTLS, metrika kodini turli tilda qayta yozish — qimmat va nomuvofiq. Mesh buni infratuzilmaga ko'chiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
            istiod (Pilot + Citadel + Galley birlashgan)
          xDS config |  sertifikatlar (SDS)
        +-----------+-----------+
        v                       v
 [app A | Envoy] --mTLS--> [Envoy | app B]
   iptables trafikni Envoy'ga yo'naltiradi
```
- `istiod`: VirtualService/DestinationRule'ni Envoy config'ga (xDS) tarjima qiladi, workload sertifikatlarini chiqaradi (SPIFFE ID).
- Envoy: L4/L7 proxy — routing, retry, mTLS, metrika.
- Ingress/Egress Gateway: chegara proxy'lari.

**Amalda:**
```bash
istioctl install --set profile=default
kubectl label ns shop istio-injection=enabled
istioctl proxy-status          # proxy'lar sinxronmi
istioctl analyze               # config xatolari
```
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1
kind: VirtualService
spec:
  hosts: [reviews]
  http:
  - route:
    - { destination: { host: reviews, subset: v1 }, weight: 90 }
    - { destination: { host: reviews, subset: v2 }, weight: 10 }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sidecar har pod'ga ~50-100MB RAM va bir oz latency qo'shadi.
- Sidecar ilovadan keyin start bo'lsa — startup'da tarmoq yo'q (native sidecar yoki `holdApplicationUntilProxyStarts`).
- Mesh retry + ilova retry = retry storm.

**Senior nuqta:** Mesh murakkablik qo'shadi; faqat mTLS kerak bo'lsa Linkerd yoki Cilium yetarli. Istio yangi o'rnatishlarda sidecar o'rniga Ambient rejimni ko'rib chiqing.

41150.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Istio Ambient Mesh — sidecar'siz rejim (2024'da GA). Mesh ikki qatlamga bo'linadi: har node'dagi **ztunnel** (L4: mTLS, identity, L4 authz) va kerak bo'lgandagina **waypoint proxy** (L7: HTTP routing, retry, L7 authz). Pod'lar restart qilinmasdan mesh'ga qo'shiladi.

**Muammo:** Sidecar modeli: 1000 pod = 1000 Envoy — RAM/CPU sarfi katta, sidecar upgrade uchun hamma pod restart, startup tartib muammolari.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
[pod A]   [pod B]           node 1
    \       /
   ztunnel (DaemonSet, Rust, L4) ==HBONE mTLS==> ztunnel (node 2) -> [pod C]
                     |
         L7 kerak bo'lsa: waypoint (Envoy, namespace/servis uchun Deployment)
```
HBONE — HTTP CONNECT ustidagi mTLS tunnel (port 15008).

**Amalda:**
```bash
istioctl install --set profile=ambient
kubectl label ns shop istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient     # restart kerak emas
istioctl waypoint apply -n shop --enroll-namespace         # L7 kerak bo'lsa
istioctl ztunnel-config workloads
```

**Sidecar vs Ambient:**
| | Sidecar | Ambient |
|---|---|---|
| Resurs | har pod'da Envoy | node'da ztunnel + kam waypoint |
| Upgrade | pod restart | DaemonSet rollout |
| L7 | har doim | faqat waypoint bilan |
| Izolyatsiya | pod darajasida | ztunnel node'dagi pod'lar uchun umumiy |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Waypoint'siz VirtualService L7 qoidalari ishlamaydi — "konfig qo'llanmayapti" deb o'ylash.
- Ba'zi CNI'lar bilan moslik va eBPF/iptables redirect cheklovlarini tekshiring.
- Ztunnel buzilsa — butun node'dagi pod'lar ta'sirlanadi (blast radius kattaroq).

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p jamoalarga faqat mTLS va L4 policy kerak — Ambient bunda overhead'ni keskin kamaytiradi. L7 ni faqat haqiqatan kerak bo'lgan servislar uchun waypoint bilan yoqing.

41151.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Linkerd — CNCF graduated, soddalikka yo'naltirilgan service mesh. Data plane — Rust'da yozilgan `linkerd2-proxy` (Envoy emas), control plane — Go. Default'da avtomatik mTLS, golden metrics (success rate, RPS, latency), retry/timeout beradi; resurs va latency Istio sidecar'dan sezilarli past.

**Muammo:** Jamoaga mTLS va observability kerak, lekin Istio'ning yuzlab CRD va sozlamalari og'ir.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
control plane: destination, identity (CA), proxy-injector
        |
[app | linkerd2-proxy] --mTLS--> [linkerd2-proxy | app]
   ~10-20MB RAM, sub-ms latency
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
linkerd check --pre
linkerd install --crds | kubectl apply -f -
linkerd install | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl annotate ns shop linkerd.io/inject=enabled
kubectl rollout restart deploy -n shop
linkerd viz install | kubectl apply -f -
linkerd viz stat deploy -n shop     # SUCCESS  RPS  LATENCY_P99
```

**Istio bilan solishtirish:**
| | Linkerd | Istio |
|---|---|---|
| Proxy | Rust micro-proxy | Envoy (C++) |
| Murakkablik | past | yuqori |
| L7 imkoniyatlar | asosiy (HTTPRoute, retry, split) | juda boy (filter, Wasm) |
| Sidecar'siz | yo'q | Ambient |
| Litsenziya | stable build'lar Buoyant orqali (2024 dan) | to'liq open source |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- 2024'dan open source loyihada faqat edge release'lar; production stable build'lar Buoyant Enterprise orqali — litsenziya shartini tekshiring.
- Envoy filter'lari, Wasm plugin'lari yo'q — murakkab L7 kerak bo'lsa yetmaydi.
- Sertifikat trust anchor muddatini kuzatmasangiz mesh to'xtaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Mesh tanlovi = talab: faqat mTLS + metrika -> Linkerd yoki Istio Ambient; murakkab traffic shaping, multi-cluster, Wasm -> Istio. Litsenziya va support modeli ham texnik mezon.

41152.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cilium Service Mesh — sidecar'siz mesh: L3/L4 ishlarini (load balancing, policy, shifrlash, observability) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kernel'da eBPF bilan, L7 ishlarini esa har node'dagi umumiy Envoy bilan bajaradi. CNI va mesh bitta komponentda.

**Muammo:** CNI (Calico/Flannel) + kube-proxy + Istio sidecar — uchta qatlam, uchta upgrade, paket bir necha marta userspace'dan o'tadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
pod A -> eBPF (tc/socket hook): service LB, NetworkPolicy, metrika
   L4 bo'lsa -> to'g'ridan pod B (proxy yo'q)
   L7 qoida bo'lsa -> node'dagi cilium-envoy -> pod B
shifrlash: WireGuard/IPsec (kernel)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
cilium install --set kubeProxyReplacement=true \
  --set envoy.enabled=true --set encryption.enabled=true \
  --set encryption.type=wireguard
cilium status
```
L7 policy:
```yaml
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
spec:
  endpointSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  ingress:
  - fromEndpoints: [{ matchLabels: { app: web } }]
    toPorts:
    - ports: [{ port: "8080", protocol: TCP }]
      rules: { http: [{ method: GET, path: "/v1/.*" }] }
```
Gateway API va mTLS (SPIFFE asosida, beta) ham qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cilium mutual auth (mTLS) hali Istio darajasida yetuk emas — compliance talabida tekshiring.
- Node'dagi umumiy Envoy — bir node'dagi tenant'lar o'rtasida izolyatsiya kamroq.
- Kernel versiyasi talablari (eBPF imkoniyatlari uchun 5.10+ tavsiya).

**Senior nuqta:** Agar Cilium allaqachon CNI bo'lsa, alohida mesh qo'shishdan oldin uning mesh imkoniyatlari yetarliligini baholang — bir komponent kam = bitta muammo manbai kam.

41153.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Hubble — Cilium'ning observability qatlami. eBPF orqali har bir tarmoq flow'ini (kim kimga, qaysi port, ruxsat berildi/tashlandi, HTTP/DNS/Kafka L7 tafsilotlari) ilovani o'zgartirmasdan ko'rsatadi: CLI, UI (servis grafi) va Prometheus metrikalari.

**Muammo:** "Pod A pod B ga ulana olmayapti" — NetworkPolicy blokladimi, DNS xatomi, servis javob bermayaptimi? tcpdump bilan har node'da qidirish — sekin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
