**Senior nuqta:** Cilium BGP — Cilium CNI'li on-prem klasterda MetalLB BGP'ning o'rnini bosadi (bir komponent kam). ECMP bilan haqiqiy load balancing beradi; tarmoq jamoasi bilan yaqin ishlash shart — bu infra qaror, faqat K8s config emas.

41199.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CSI volume cloning — mavjud PVC'ning ma'lumotini aynan nusxalab yangi PVC yaratish, `dataSource` ni PVC'ga qaratib. Snapshot'dan farqi — oraliq snapshot obyektisiz, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri PVC -> PVC. Storage darajasida (CSI driver qo'llasa) tez va samarali.

**Muammo:** Prod DB diskining nusxasini staging yoki test uchun olish; yoki template volume'dan ko'plab bir xil disk yaratish. Ma'lumotni qo'lda `cp` qilish sekin va ilovani to'xtatishi mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PVC "test-db" (dataSource: PVC "prod-db")
  -> CSI CreateVolume(volumeContentSource: volume)
  -> storage darajasida clone (ko'pincha copy-on-write yoki tez nusxa)
  -> yangi mustaqil PVC
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata: { name: test-db }
spec:
  storageClassName: gp3
  dataSource:
    kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
    name: prod-db
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  resources: { requests: { storage: 100Gi } }   # >= manba hajmi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Manba va clone bir xil StorageClass va (ko'pincha) bir xil AZ'da bo'lishi kerak.
- Clone crash-consistent — ishlab turgan DB'da avval flush/quiesce qiling.
- Barcha driver qo'llamaydi; manba hajmidan kichik so'ralsa rad etiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Clone — "prod ma'lumot bilan test" uchun tez yo'l, lekin prod PII staging'ga ko'chishi — maxfiylik/compliance xavfi: maskalash yoki anonimlashtirishni unutmang. Snapshot (41163) backup uchun, clone — ko'paytirish uchun.

41200.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CSI ephemeral inline volume — pod spec'ida `volumes` ichida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri CSI driver'ni chaqirib vaqtinchalik storage ulash, alohida PVC obyektisiz. Pod bilan birga yaratiladi va o'chadi. Odatda driver'lar uchun (secret mount, lokal NVMe) ishlatiladi, hajm/holat kuzatishni talab qilmaydigan hollarda.

**Muammo:** Secrets Store CSI yoki lokal tez disk'ni pod'ga ulash kerak, lekin PVC lifecycle (bind, kuzatuv) ortiqcha. Inline volume buni pod spec ichida soddalashtiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod.spec.volumes:
  - csi: { driver: secrets-store.csi.k8s.io, ... }
  pod yaratildi -> CSI driver NodePublishVolume darhol (PVC yo'q)
  pod o'chdi -> NodeUnpublishVolume -> tozalanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  volumes:
  - name: secrets
    csi:
      driver: secrets-store.csi.k8s.io
      readOnly: true
      volumeAttributes: { secretProviderClass: "aws-secrets" }
  containers:
  - volumeMounts: [{ name: secrets, mountPath: /mnt/secrets, readOnly: true }]
```

**Inline vs generic ephemeral (41165):**
| | CSI inline | Generic ephemeral |
|---|---|---|
| PVC obyekti | yo'q | avtomatik yaratiladi |
| StorageClass | yo'q | ha |
| Hajm so'rovi | driver'ga bog'liq | PVC'da |
| Tipik ishlatilish | secret mount, special driver | katta scratch disk |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har driver inline'ni qo'llamaydi — driver `volumeLifecycleModes: [Ephemeral]` e'lon qilishi kerak.
- Hajm/kapasitetni PVC kabi cheklab bo'lmaydi — driver mas'ul.
- RBAC: inline volume pod yaratuvchiga driver orqali resurs ulash imkonini beradi — Gatekeeper/VAP bilan qaysi driver ruxsatini cheklang.

**Senior nuqta:** Inline volume'ni asosan maxsus driver'lar (Secrets Store CSI) uchun ishlating; umumiy vaqtinchalik disk uchun generic ephemeral yoki emptyDir aniqroq va kuzatiladigan. Driver ruxsatini admission policy bilan cheklash — xavfsizlik yaxshi amaliyoti.

41201.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval zararni to'xtating (`kubectl rollout undo`), keyin diagnostika qiling. Yangi versiya CPU'ni 100% qilgani — deyarli har doim kod o'zgarishi: cheksiz loop, index'siz DB so'rov, regex backtracking, retry storm yoki noto'g'ri konfiguratsiya. Root cause'ni profiling bilan toping, taxmin bilan emas.

**Muammo:** Deploy'dan keyin pod'lar CPU limit'ga urилиб throttle bo'ladi, javob sekinlashadi, liveness probe yiqilib restart — kaskad. Har daqiqa — foydalanuvchiga ta'sir.

**Qanday ishlaydi (triage tartibi):**
```
1. to'xtat: rollout undo (eski, ishlaydigan versiyaga)
2. o'lcha: kubectl top, Prometheus (CPU, RPS, latency)
3. taqqosla: nima o'zgardi? (diff, config, feature flag)
4. profil: pprof/async-profiler -> qaysi funksiya CPU yeyapti
5. tuzat -> kichik canary bilan qayta chiqar
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api
kubectl top pod -l app=api --containers
kubectl describe hpa api              # CurrentCPU, maxReplicas'ga urildimi
# ishlab turgan pod'dan profil:
kubectl exec api-x -- curl -s localhost:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30 > cpu.prof
go tool pprof -top cpu.prof           # yuqori CPU funksiyalari
kubectl logs api-x | grep -iE "retry|timeout|deadlock"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CPU limit juda past -> throttling (real "100%" emas, `container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total` ga qarang).
- Liveness probe CPU to'yinganda yiqiladi -> restart -> cold start -> yana CPU; probe'ni bardoshli qiling.
- `rollout undo` qilmasdan "tahlil qilay" deb turish — outage'ni uzaytiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Deploy'ni canary/progressive qiling (Argo Rollouts/Flagger): yangi versiya avval 5% trafik oladi, CPU/error metrikasi yomon bo'lsa avtomatik rollback — bu incident umuman boshlanmaydi. Continuous profiling (Pyroscope) root cause'ni daqiqalarga qisqartiradi.

41202.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CoreDNS `OOMKilled` — DNS so'rov hajmi (ko'pincha `ndots:5` tufayli ko'paygan NXDOMAIN'lar, 41147) CoreDNS xotirasini yoki undagi kesh/cache'ni limit'dan oshirgan. Tez tiklash: memory limit'ni oshirish; butunlay tuzatish: NodeLocal DNSCache + proporsional scale + `ndots` ni tuzatish.

**Muammo:** CoreDNS yiqilsa — butun klaster DNS'siz: Service discovery ishlamaydi, pod'lar bir-birini topa olmaydi, hamma joyda timeout. Bu eng og'ir klaster incidentlaridan.

**Qanday ishlaydi (tiklash + oldini olish):**
```
qisqa muddat: limit oshir -> CoreDNS restart bo'lmaydi
uzoq:
  NodeLocal DNSCache (har node kesh, upstream yukini kamaytiradi)
  cluster-proportional-autoscaler (41178)
  ilovalarda ndots:2 / FQDN -> behuda so'rovlar kamayadi
  so'rov bo'ronini yaratayotgan pod'ni topish (metrika bo'yicha)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system set resources deploy coredns \
  --limits=memory=340Mi --requests=memory=170Mi
kubectl -n kube-system describe pod -l k8s-app=kube-dns | grep -i oom
# so'rov manbasini topish (Hubble yoki CoreDNS log):
kubectl -n kube-system logs -l k8s-app=kube-dns | grep -c NXDOMAIN
```
NodeLocal DNSCache (manifest) + pod `dnsConfig: {options: [{name: ndots, value: "2"}]}`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat limit oshirish — vaqtinchalik; so'rov bo'roni davom etsa yana OOM.
- CoreDNS `cache` plugin TTL'i katta + yuqori kardinallik -> xotira o'sadi.
- NodeLocal DNSCache conntrack/iptables sozlamasini talab qiladi — noto'g'ri bo'lsa DNS butunlay buziladi, bosqichma-bosqich joriy qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** DNS klasterning eng kritik umumiy yo'li — unga alohida SLO va alert qo'ying (`coredns_dns_responses_total`, latency, OOM). Sabab deyarli har doim ilova tomonda (ndots, retry); CoreDNS'ni kattalashtirish simptomni yopadi, lekin ildizni ilova/`dnsConfig` tuzatadi.

41203.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `/var/lib/containerd` to'lishi — foydalanilmagan image'lar, katta/aylanmaydigan container log'lari va ephemeral-storage limitsiz pod'lar sabab. Tez: `crictl rmi --prune`; butunlay: kubelet image GC chegaralari, container log rotation va pod'larga `ephemeral-storage` limiti. Disk to'lsa kubelet `DiskPressure` eviction boshlaydi — node beqaror bo'ladi.

**Muammo:** Node diski to'lsa: yangi image pull bo'lmaydi (`ImagePullBackOff`), pod'lar evict bo'ladi, kubelet `DiskPressure` taint qo'yadi -> pod'lar boshqa node'larga ko'chib ularni ham to'ldiradi — kaskad.

**Qanday ishlaydi (tiklash + oldini olish):**
```
tez: crictl rmi --prune (yetim image'lar)
     eng katta log/overlay qatlamlarni topish (du)
doimiy:
  kubelet image GC: High/Low threshold
  containerd log: containerLogMaxSize/Files
  pod ephemeral-storage request/limit (41224)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
crictl rmi --prune
du -sh /var/lib/containerd/* | sort -h | tail
crictl images | awk '{print $3}' | sort | uniq -c    # qaytalanuvchi image'lar
```
```yaml
# KubeletConfiguration
imageGCHighThresholdPercent: 80
imageGCLowThresholdPercent: 65
containerLogMaxSize: 50Mi
containerLogMaxFiles: 3
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `imagefs` va `nodefs` alohida (yoki bir xil disk) — GC `imagefs` ga qaraydi, log'lar `nodefs` ga; qaysi biri to'lganini aniqlang.
- `latest` tag + har deploy yangi image -> eski image'lar yig'iladi.
- Ephemeral-storage limitsiz pod (katta temp fayl, verbose log) — bitta pod diskni to'ldiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Diskni 80% da alert qiling va `predict_linear` bilan prognoz qiling. Node'larni immutable qilib (Karpenter expiration, 41194) muntazam almashtirsangiz — yig'ilgan image/log muammosi tabiiy hal bo'ladi; log'larni node diskida emas, markaziy tizimda saqlang.

41204.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Namespace o'chirilsa — ichidagi **barcha** resurs (Pod, Service, PVC, Secret, ConfigMap) kaskad o'chadi; reclaimPolicy `Delete` bo'lgan PV'larning disklari ham ketadi. Qaytarib bo'lmaydi. Oldini olish: RBAC'da namespace delete'ni cheklash, admission policy bilan prod ns'ni himoyalash, PV'da `Retain`, Velero backup.

**Muammo:** Dasturchi `kubectl delete ns prod` ni `staging` o'rniga terdi. Bir soniyada butun prod yo'q; backup'siz tiklash — soatlar yoki imkonsiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
delete ns prod -> namespace deletionTimestamp + "Terminating"
  -> namespace controller ichidagi hamma obyektni o'chiradi (GC)
  -> PVC o'chadi -> PV reclaimPolicy Delete bo'lsa -> cloud disk o'chadi
finalizer'lar ketsa namespace yo'qoladi (qaytarib bo'lmaydi)
```

**Oldini olish — amalda:**
```yaml
# 1. RBAC: faqat break-glass role namespace o'chira oladi
# 2. ValidatingAdmissionPolicy / Kyverno: prod ns delete'ni bloklash
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata: { name: protect-prod-ns }
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce
  rules:
  - name: block
    match: { any: [{ resources: { kinds: [Namespace], names: [prod, prod-*] } }] }
    exclude: { any: [{ subjects: [{ kind: Group, name: break-glass }] }] }
    validate:
      message: "prod namespace o'chirish taqiqlangan"
      deny: { conditions: { any: [{ key: "{{request.operation}}", operator: Equals, value: DELETE }] } }
```
```yaml
# 3. Muhim PV
persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
```
+ Velero jadval bilan backup; cloud resurslarda deletion protection.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- RBAC `delete namespaces` ko'pincha keng `admin` role'da — tekshiring.
- `Retain` PV o'chmaydi, lekin PVC bog'lanishi yo'qoladi — qo'lda qayta bind kerak.
- Velero faqat sozlangan bo'lsa yordam beradi — restore'ni oldindan sinang.

**Senior nuqta:** Buni "ehtiyot bo'ling" bilan yopib bo'lmaydi — texnik guardrail kerak: prod ns o'chirishni admission policy bloklaydi, break-glass audit bilan. GitOps (Argo/Flux) `prune` sozlamasi ham butun ns'ni o'chira olishini yodda tuting — reconcile xatosi ham shu xavf.

41205.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bir node'da ishlab, node'lararo ishlamaydigan pod aloqasi — deyarli har doim **tarmoq qatlami** muammosi: security group/firewall overlay portini (VXLAN 8472, Geneve 6081, WireGuard 51871) bloklagan, CNI routing noto'g'ri, yoki MTU mos emas. Bir node ichida CNI tarmoqdan o'tmaydi — shuning uchun ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** Servis vaqti-vaqti ishlaydi (so'rov bir xil node'dagi pod'ga tushsa OK, boshqa node'ga tushsa timeout) — "flaky" ko'rinadi, aslida tarmoq.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
pod A (node1) -> pod B (node2)
  CNI: paket overlay'ga encapsulate (VXLAN/Geneve) -> node2 -> decapsulate -> pod B
muammolar:
  SG overlay UDP portini bloklagan -> paket yetmaydi
  node'da peer CIDR'ga route yo'q -> qayerga yuborishni bilmaydi
  MTU: overlay 1450 vs host 1500 -> katta paket fragment/tushib qoladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# boshqa node'dagi pod IP'siga:
kubectl exec -n shop web-node1 -- ping -c3 <pod-b-ip>
kubectl exec -n shop web-node1 -- nc -zv <pod-b-ip> 8080
# MTU muammosi belgisi: kichik paket OK, katta osiladi
kubectl exec web-node1 -- ping -M do -s 1472 <pod-b-ip>   # fragmentatsiyasiz
ip route        # node'da peer pod CIDR route'i bormi
# CNI loglari
kubectl -n kube-system logs -l k8s-app=cilium
```

**Sabablar jadvali:**
| Belgi | Sabab | Tekshir |
|---|---|---|
| hech qanday cross-node trafik | SG/firewall overlay port | cloud SG qoidalari |
| kichik OK, katta osiladi | MTU mos emas | `ping -M do -s` |
| ba'zi node'lar OK | route/CNI qisman buzilgan | `ip route`, CNI log |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- MTU muammosi klassik "kichik so'rov ishlaydi, katta javob osiladi" — TLS handshake yoki katta payload'da sinadi; buni DNS yoki ilova xatosi deb o'ylash oson.
- Cloud'da yangi node pool boshqa subnet/SG'da — eski node'lar ishlaydi, yangilari yo'q.
- NetworkPolicy ham cross-node bloklashi mumkin — avval policy'ni istisno qiling (Hubble/`DROPPED`).

**Senior nuqta:** Avval L3/L4 (ping, nc) ni ildizgacha tekshiring, keyin ilovaga o'ting — "flaky servis" ko'pincha MTU yoki SG. MTU'ni CNI va cloud (jumbo frame, VPC) bo'ylab bir xil sozlang; Hubble/`DROPPED` flow'lar policy sababini bir zumda ko'rsatadi.

41206.a:
**Qisqa javob:** 429 — API Server **API Priority and Fairness (APF)** yoki `max-requests-inflight` chegarasiga yetib so'rovlarni rad etyapti. Triage: qaysi **flow schema / priority level** to'lganini metrikalardan topish, audit log'dan "shovqinli" client'ni (user-agent, service account) aniqlash, keyin client'ni tuzatish va faqat oxirida limitlarni oshirish.

**Muammo:** Odatda sabab bitta noto'g'ri yozilgan controller yoki CI skripti: informer o'rniga har soniyada `LIST pods --all-namespaces` qiladi. U API Server va etcd'ni bo'g'adi, natijada kubelet va boshqa controller'lar ham 429 oladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
so'rov --> FlowSchema (kim? qaysi user/SA/verb) --> PriorityLevel (navbat + concurrency ulushi)
             |                                         |
             |                         ulush to'la, navbat to'la --> 429 + Retry-After
             v
   system / leader-election / workload-high / workload-low / global-default
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# qaysi priority level rad etyapti
kubectl get --raw /metrics | grep apiserver_flow_control_rejected_requests_total
# PromQL:
#   sum by (priority_level, flow_schema) (rate(apiserver_flow_control_rejected_requests_total[5m]))
#   sum by (priority_level) (apiserver_flow_control_current_inqueue_requests)
kubectl get flowschemas,prioritylevelconfigurations
kubectl get --raw /debug/api_priority_and_fairness/dump_priority_levels
# kim ko'p so'rov yuboryapti (audit log)
jq -r 'select(.verb=="list") | .userAgent + " " + .user.username' audit.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
```
Yechim tartibi: client'ni informer/watch'ga o'tkazish, `resourceVersion` va pagination (`limit`) bilan LIST; kerak bo'lsa shovqinli SA uchun alohida past FlowSchema yaratib uni izolyatsiya qilish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Darhol `--max-requests-inflight` ni oshirish — muammoni etcd'ga ko'chiradi va API Server OOM bo'lishi mumkin.
- Client'lar 429'da `Retry-After` ni hurmat qilmay darhol qayta urinsa — retry storm.
- Managed klasterlarda (EKS/GKE) APF parametrlarini o'zgartirish cheklangan; metrikalar baribir ko'rinadi.

**Senior nuqta:** APF — izolyatsiya mexanizmi: muhim trafik (system, leader-election) himoyalangan bo'lsin, "noma'lum" client'lar `global-default`/`workload-low` da. Operator'larni review qilishda "LIST qayerda va qanchalik tez-tez?" degan savol majburiy bo'lsin.

41207.a:
**Qisqa javob:** etcd har yozuvni WAL'ga `fsync` qiladi. Disk sekinlashsa (p99 fsync > ~10ms) leader heartbeat'lari kechikadi, follower'lar leader'ni o'lik deb hisoblab **tez-tez leader election** boshlanadi, yozuvlar osiladi; API Server timeout'lar beradi, kubelet node status yangilay olmaydi va node'lar `NotReady` bo'lishi mumkin.

**Muammo:** Shared/network disk (gp2 burst tugagan, noisy neighbour) ustidagi etcd — "klaster tasodifan sekinlashadi" turidagi eng og'ir nosozliklardan biri.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
API write --> etcd leader --> WAL append + fsync (disk!) --> follower'larga replikatsiya
                                                             --> kvorum fsync --> commit
fsync sekin --> heartbeat (100ms) kechikadi --> election timeout (1000ms)
           --> yangi election --> "leader changed" --> so'rovlar retry/timeout
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# asosiy metrikalar (PromQL)
histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))     # < 10ms bo'lsin
histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(etcd_disk_backend_commit_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) # < 25ms
rate(etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total[15m])                                       # ~0 bo'lsin
etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes                                                       # quota (default 2GiB, max 8GiB)
# diskni oldindan sinash (etcd hujjatidagi fio testi)
fio --rw=write --ioengine=sync --fdatasync=1 --directory=/var/lib/etcd-test --size=22m --bs=2300 --name=etcdtest
etcdctl endpoint status --cluster -w table
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- etcd'ni boshqa og'ir I/O (log, container image'lar) bilan bitta diskda ushlash.
- Election timeout'ni oshirib "davolash" — simptomni yashiradi, failover sekinlashadi.
- DB hajmi quota'ga yetsa etcd `NOSPACE` alarm bilan read-only bo'ladi — compaction + defrag muntazam.

**Senior nuqta:** etcd uchun ajratilgan lokal NVMe/SSD (yoki provisioned IOPS), past latency'li tarmoq va 3/5 a'zo. Managed K8s'da bu provider muammosi, lekin katta obyektlar va ko'p event yozuvchi controller'lar sizning muammongiz.

41208.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ingress va Gateway API'ni **parallel** ishlatib, trafikni bosqichma-bosqich o'tkazish: Gateway controller va alohida LB o'rnatish -> `ingress2gateway` bilan HTTPRoute'lar generatsiya -> har servisni yangi LB orqali test -> DNS'ni weighted record bilan 1% -> 100% -> kuzatish davri -> Ingress'larni o'chirish. Rollback — DNS og'irligini qaytarish.

**Muammo:** 1000 ta Ingress'ni bir kechada almashtirish — annotation'lar (rewrite, auth, rate limit) har controller'da turlicha, bitta xato yuzlab servisni o'chiradi. Shuningdek ingress-nginx loyihasi 2026-yil martida retire qilinishi e'lon qilingan, shuning uchun migratsiya ko'p jamoalar uchun majburiy.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
            DNS (weighted)
           /              \
     90%  v                v 10%
   Ingress LB          Gateway LB (yangi)
   ingress-nginx       Envoy Gateway / Cilium / Istio
        |                   |
        +----> bir xil Service/Pod'lar <----+
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl apply --server-side -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.3.0/standard-install.yaml
ingress2gateway print --providers ingress-nginx --all-namespaces > routes.yaml
```
```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata: {name: api, namespace: shop}
spec:
  parentRefs: [{name: public-gw, namespace: infra}]
  hostnames: ["api.example.com"]
  rules:
  - matches: [{path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /v1}}]
    backendRefs: [{name: api, port: 8080}]
```
Har bosqichda: 5xx, latency, TLS xatolari, sertifikatlar (cert-manager Gateway qo'llovi) va ikkala LB'dagi so'rov hajmini solishtirish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Controller-specific annotation'lar (`nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/*`) avtomatik konvertatsiya bo'lmaydi — ro'yxatini oldindan audit qiling.
- DNS TTL yuqori bo'lsa rollback sekin — migratsiyadan oldin TTL'ni 60s ga tushiring.
- Namespace'lar aro `ReferenceGrant` va Gateway `allowedRoutes` unutilsa route'lar "Accepted: False".

**Senior nuqta:** Avval kam xavfli servislar bilan "pilot wave", keyin namespace bo'yicha to'lqinlar. Gateway API'ning role modeli (platform -> Gateway, jamoa -> HTTPRoute) migratsiya bilan birga ownership'ni ham tartibga soladi.

41209.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Log bo'sh va container darhol tugasa, odatda process **umuman ishga tushmagan**: entrypoint/binary topilmadi, ruxsat yo'q, arxitektura mos emas, kerakli kutubxona yo'q yoki config yo'qligi sababli jimgina chiqib ketgan. Triage: exit code va `describe` -> oldingi container log'i -> image'ni interaktiv shell bilan ochib tekshirish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl describe pod --> Last State: Terminated, Exit Code: ?
   0    -> process "muvaffaqiyatli" tugadi (CMD daemon emas, fonga ketgan)
   1    -> ilova xatosi (config, env)
   126  -> permission denied / executable emas
   127  -> command not found (yo'l, shebang, kutubxona)
   137  -> SIGKILL (OOMKilled?)
   139  -> segfault
   "exec format error" -> arm64/amd64 mos emas
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl describe pod api-7d9f -n shop | sed -n '/Last State/,/Ready/p'
kubectl logs api-7d9f -n shop --previous
kubectl get pod api-7d9f -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState}'
# image'ni o'z entrypoint'isiz ochish
kubectl debug api-7d9f -n shop -it --copy-to=api-debug --container=api -- sh
# distroless bo'lsa (shell yo'q) - ephemeral container bilan
kubectl debug -it api-7d9f --image=busybox:1.36 --target=api
# lokal
docker run --rm -it --entrypoint sh registry/api:1.4
docker image inspect registry/api:1.4 --format '{{.Architecture}} {{.Config.Entrypoint}} {{.Config.Cmd}}'
ldd /app/server       # "not found" kutubxonalar (glibc binary alpine'da)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CMD shell skript bo'lsa va oxirida `&` bilan fonga o'tsa — PID 1 tugaydi, container exit 0 bilan o'ladi.
- Windows'da tahrirlangan skript (`\r\n`) — "no such file or directory" (shebang buziladi).
- Log stdout'ga emas faylga yozilsa `kubectl logs` doim bo'sh.

**Senior nuqta:** Ilovalar startup'da config'ni validatsiya qilib, xatoni stderr'ga aniq yozsin; `terminationMessagePolicy: FallbackToLogsOnError` describe'da oxirgi log'ni ko'rsatadi. Multi-arch image'larni CI'da `docker buildx` bilan yig'ing.

41210.a:
**Qisqa javob:** kubeadm klasterida: muddatni tekshirish -> etcd va `/etc/kubernetes/pki` backup -> `kubeadm certs renew all` -> har control-plane node'da static pod'larni (apiserver, controller-manager, scheduler, etcd) qayta ishga tushirish -> yangi `admin.conf` ni tarqatish -> kubelet client sertifikat rotatsiyasi yoqilganini tekshirish. Node'lar bittalab, kvorumni saqlab.

**Muammo:** kubeadm leaf sertifikatlari **1 yil** amal qiladi. Muddat o'tsa API Server'ga ulanish to'xtaydi ("x509: certificate has expired") — klaster "birdan" boshqarib bo'lmaydigan bo'ladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CA (10 yil): ca.crt, etcd/ca.crt, front-proxy-ca.crt
   |
   +-- leaf (1 yil): apiserver, apiserver-kubelet-client, etcd-server/peer, front-proxy-client
   +-- kubeconfig'lar: admin.conf, controller-manager.conf, scheduler.conf
kubelet client sertifikati -> rotateCertificates: true bilan avtomatik
```
Eslatma: `kubeadm upgrade` ham sertifikatlarni avtomatik yangilaydi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubeadm certs check-expiration
cp -a /etc/kubernetes/pki /root/pki-backup-$(date +%F)
ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot save /root/etcd-$(date +%F).db \
  --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt \
  --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key
kubeadm certs renew all
# static pod'larni qayta yaratish: manifest'ni vaqtincha ko'chirib qaytarish
mkdir -p /tmp/m && mv /etc/kubernetes/manifests/*.yaml /tmp/m/ && sleep 20 && mv /tmp/m/*.yaml /etc/kubernetes/manifests/
cp /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf ~/.kube/config
kubectl get nodes && kubeadm certs check-expiration
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `renew` dan keyin restart qilinmasa komponentlar eski sertifikatni xotirada ushlab turadi.
- Barcha control-plane node'larda bir vaqtda restart — etcd kvorumi yo'qoladi; bittalab qiling.
- CA muddati tugashi — boshqa, ancha og'ir jarayon (barcha komponent va node'lar uchun yangi trust).

**Senior nuqta:** Muddatni monitoring qiling (`apiserver_client_certificate_expiration_seconds`, x509-certificate-exporter) va kalendar eslatmasiga tayanmang. Muntazam (yiliga kamida bir marta) K8s upgrade qiladigan jamoada bu muammo deyarli bo'lmaydi.

41211.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Node Problem Detector — har node'da DaemonSet sifatida ishlaydigan agent; kernel log, journal va maxsus tekshiruv skriptlarini kuzatib, muammolarni **Node Condition** (`KernelDeadlock`, `ReadonlyFilesystem` ...) va **Event** sifatida API Server'ga xabar qiladi.

**Muammo:** Kubelet faqat o'z ishini (disk/memory pressure) biladi. Kernel "task blocked for more than 120 seconds", fayl tizimi read-only bo'lishi, NIC xatolari kubelet uchun ko'rinmaydi — node `Ready` turaveradi, lekin pod'lar ishlamaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
/dev/kmsg, journald, custom plugin (script exit code)
          |
          v
   NPD (DaemonSet) -- qoidalar (regex) --> permanent problem -> NodeCondition
                                       --> temporary problem -> Event
          |
          v
   remediation: Draino / Node Healthcheck / cluster-autoscaler / managed node auto-repair
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
helm repo add deliveryhero https://charts.deliveryhero.io/
helm install npd deliveryhero/node-problem-detector -n kube-system
kubectl get node worker-3 -o jsonpath='{range .status.conditions[*]}{.type}={.status}{"\n"}{end}'
# KernelDeadlock=False  ReadonlyFilesystem=True  Ready=True
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.kind=Node,reason=OOMKilling -A
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- NPD faqat **aniqlaydi** — node'ni avtomatik tuzatmaydi; remediation alohida komponent.
- Custom condition'lar scheduler'ga avtomatik ta'sir qilmaydi — taint qo'shuvchi tool kerak.
- GKE va AKS'da NPD default yoqilgan; EKS'da odatda o'zingiz o'rnatasiz (yoki EKS node monitoring agent).

**Senior nuqta:** NPD condition'larini Prometheus alert'lariga va avtomatik "cordon + drain + almashtirish" oqimiga ulang. Node'lar — "pets" emas: buzilgan node'ni tuzatishdan ko'ra almashtirish tezroq.

41212.a:
**Qisqa javob:** kube-janitor — klasterdagi resurslarni **TTL** (`janitor/ttl: 7d` annotation) yoki **muddat** (`janitor/expires: 2026-10-10`) va global qoidalar bo'yicha avtomatik o'chiradigan controller. Preview/dev muhitlarni tozalash uchun.

**Muammo:** Har PR uchun preview namespace yaratiladi, lekin hech kim o'chirmaydi: 300 ta unutilgan namespace node, PV va LoadBalancer xarajatini "yeydi".

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kube-janitor (har N daqiqada)
   |
   +--> resurslarni o'qiydi --> creationTimestamp + ttl < hozir ?  --> delete
   +--> rules.yaml: "pr- bilan boshlanuvchi namespace'lar 3 kunda"
   --dry-run --> faqat log
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: pr-1423
  annotations:
    janitor/ttl: "72h"
```
```yaml
# rules.yaml
rules:
  - id: temporary-pr-namespaces
    resources: [namespaces]
    jmespath: "starts_with(metadata.name, 'pr-')"
    ttl: 3d
```
```bash
kubectl annotate deploy load-test janitor/expires="2026-10-10T18:00:00Z"
# avval --dry-run bilan ishga tushirib log'larni tekshiring
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Noto'g'ri qoida production resursini o'chirishi mumkin — `--dry-run`, `--include-namespaces`/`--exclude-namespaces` bilan chegaralang.
- Namespace o'chirilganda ichidagi PV `Delete` reclaim policy bilan ma'lumot ham yo'qoladi.
- Loyiha (hjacobs/codeberg) faol rivojlanmayapti — muqobillarni ham ko'rib chiqing.

**Senior nuqta:** Muqobil: Kyverno **cleanup policy** (`ClusterCleanupPolicy`) va `cleanup.kyverno.io/ttl` label — allaqachon Kyverno ishlatilsa yangi tool qo'shmaslik yaxshiroq. Eng yaxshisi — preview muhitni yaratgan pipeline PR yopilganda o'zi o'chirsin, janitor esa xavfsizlik to'ri.

41213.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Popeye — jonli klasterni (faqat o'qish rejimida) skanerlab **misconfiguration va "isrof"**ni topadigan CLI: probe'siz container'lar, `latest` tag, limit'siz pod'lar, ishlatilmagan ConfigMap/Secret/PVC, o'lik Service'lar, ortiqcha RBAC. Natija — sanitizer hisoboti va umumiy ball.

**Nega kerak:** Klaster yillar davomida o'sadi va "axlat" yig'iladi. Popeye linter kabi tezkor audit beradi — YAML'ni emas, aynan klasterda nima borligini tekshiradi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
brew install derailed/popeye/popeye      # yoki binary
popeye                                   # joriy context
popeye -n shop                           # bitta namespace
popeye -o json --save                    # CI uchun
popeye -f spinach.yaml                   # o'z qoidalari / istisnolar
```
```
DEPLOYMENTS (12 SCANNED)       x 1  w 4
  shop/api
    [POP-106] No resources requests/limits defined.
    [POP-102] No probes defined.
PERSISTENTVOLUMECLAIMS
  shop/old-data  [POP-400] Used? Unable to locate resource reference.
Your cluster score: 78 -- C
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Unused" deb ko'rsatilgan resurs boshqa yo'l bilan ishlatilishi mumkin (operator, tashqi tool) — o'chirishdan oldin tekshiring.
- Natija muhitga xos: system namespace'larni spinach.yaml bilan istisno qiling, aks holda shovqin.

**Senior nuqta:** Popeye — klaster holatining "health check"i; oldini olish uchun esa admission (Kyverno/Gatekeeper) va CI'dagi manifest linting (kube-linter, kubeconform) kerak. Popeye'ni haftalik job qilib natijani dashboard'ga chiqarish tendensiyani ko'rsatadi.

41214.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Reloader (Stakater) — ConfigMap va Secret'larni kuzatadigan controller: ular o'zgarganda annotation bilan belgilangan Deployment/StatefulSet/DaemonSet'larni **rolling restart** qiladi, shunda pod'lar yangi konfiguratsiyani oladi.

**Muammo:** ConfigMap env sifatida ulangan bo'lsa, o'zgartirish ishlab turgan pod'larga **umuman** yetib bormaydi; volume sifatida ulanganda fayl yangilanadi, lekin ko'p ilovalar uni qayta o'qimaydi. Natija: "config o'zgardi, lekin hech narsa o'zgarmadi".

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ConfigMap app-config o'zgardi
   |
   v
Reloader watch --> unga bog'liq Deployment'ni topadi (annotation)
   |
   v
pod template'ga hash env/annotation yozadi --> Deployment rollout (maxUnavailable bo'yicha)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  annotations:
    reloader.stakater.com/auto: "true"          # ishlatgan barcha CM/Secret'lar
    # yoki aniq: configmap.reloader.stakater.com/reload: "app-config"
```
```bash
helm install reloader stakater/reloader -n reloader --create-namespace
kubectl rollout history deploy/api
```
Tool'siz muqobil — Helm'da checksum annotation:
```yaml
annotations:
  checksum/config: {{ include (print $.Template.BasePath "/configmap.yaml") . | sha256sum }}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Noto'g'ri config darhol barcha replikalarga tarqaladi — readiness probe va `maxUnavailable` himoya qilsin.
- Secret har kuni avtomatik rotatsiya bo'lsa (External Secrets) — keraksiz restart'lar.
- `subPath` mount'lar volume yangilanishini umuman olmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng xavfsiz pattern — immutable, versiyalangan ConfigMap (`app-config-v42`, Kustomize `configMapGenerator` hash suffix): o'zgarish yangi rollout bo'lib git'da ko'rinadi va rollback oson.

41215.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Goldilocks (Fairwinds) — har workload uchun **VPA'ni faqat recommendation rejimida** (`updateMode: "Off"`) yaratib, uning CPU/memory tavsiyalarini dashboard'da ko'rsatadigan tool. Pod'larni o'zi o'zgartirmaydi.

**Muammo:** Request'lar "taxminan" yozilgan: biri 2 CPU so'raydi va 0.1 ishlatadi (pul isrofi), boshqasi past so'raydi va throttling/OOM'ga uchraydi. To'g'ri qiymat uchun haqiqiy foydalanish ma'lumoti kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
namespace label: goldilocks.fairwinds.com/enabled=true
   |
   v
Goldilocks controller --> har Deployment uchun VPA (mode Off)
   |
   v
VPA recommender (metrics-server/Prometheus tarixi) --> target / lowerBound / upperBound
   |
   v
Goldilocks dashboard --> Guaranteed va Burstable QoS uchun tayyor YAML
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# VPA o'rnatilgan bo'lishi kerak
helm install goldilocks fairwinds-stable/goldilocks -n goldilocks --create-namespace
kubectl label ns shop goldilocks.fairwinds.com/enabled=true
kubectl -n goldilocks port-forward svc/goldilocks-dashboard 8080:80
kubectl get vpa -n shop
kubectl describe vpa goldilocks-api -n shop | sed -n '/Recommendation/,$p'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Yangi workload'da tarix kam — tavsiya ishonchsiz; kamida bir haftalik (peak'lar bilan) ma'lumot kuting.
- VPA tavsiyasi o'rtacha yuklamaga moslashadi — kamdan-kam spike (oy oxiri hisobot) uchun zaxira qo'shing.
- HPA CPU bo'yicha ishlasa, request'ni o'zgartirish HPA xulqini ham o'zgartiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Goldilocks — tavsiya, qaror emas. Request'larni GitOps orqali PR bilan yangilang va o'zgarishdan keyin throttling (`container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total`) va OOM'larni kuzating.

41216.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Descheduler — vaqt o'tishi bilan "noto'g'ri joyda" qolgan pod'larni topib **evict** qiladigan komponent (CronJob yoki Deployment). Pod'ning o'zi ko'chirilmaydi — evict'dan keyin uning controller'i yangi pod yaratadi va scheduler uni hozirgi holatga mos joylashtiradi.

**Muammo:** Scheduler faqat pod yaratilganda qaror qiladi. Keyin yangi node qo'shiladi (bo'sh qoladi), taint/affinity o'zgaradi yoki pod'lar bitta node'da to'planib qoladi — scheduler buni hech qachon qayta ko'rib chiqmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Descheduler (profile + plugins)
   +-- LowNodeUtilization / HighNodeUtilization  -> yuklamani muvozanatlash / bin-packing
   +-- RemoveDuplicates                         -> bir node'da bir xil ReplicaSet pod'lari
   +-- RemovePodsViolatingNodeAffinity / Taints / TopologySpreadConstraint
   +-- PodLifeTime                              -> juda eski pod'lar
       |
       v
   Eviction API (PDB'ni hurmat qiladi) --> controller yangi pod --> scheduler
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: descheduler/v1alpha2
kind: DeschedulerPolicy
profiles:
- name: default
  pluginConfig:
  - name: LowNodeUtilization
    args:
      thresholds:       {cpu: 20, memory: 20, pods: 20}   # shundan past = kam yuklangan
      targetThresholds: {cpu: 60, memory: 60, pods: 60}   # shundan yuqori = ortiqcha
  - name: RemovePodsViolatingNodeAffinity
    args: {nodeAffinityType: [requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution]}
  plugins:
    balance:  {enabled: [LowNodeUtilization]}
    deschedule: {enabled: [RemovePodsViolatingNodeAffinity]}
```
```bash
helm install descheduler descheduler/descheduler -n kube-system --set kind=CronJob --set schedule="*/30 * * * *"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PDB'siz workload'lar evict'da bir vaqtda ko'p replika yo'qotishi mumkin.
- Utilization hisoblash **request** bo'yicha, haqiqiy foydalanish bo'yicha emas (default'da).
- Cluster-autoscaler/Karpenter consolidation bilan to'qnashib pod'larni "ping-pong" qilishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Karpenter ishlatilsa uning consolidation'i ko'p hollarda Descheduler'ni ortiqcha qiladi. Descheduler'ni avval dry-run (`--dry-run`) bilan ishga tushirib, nimani evict qilishini ko'ring.

41217.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Chaos Mesh — CNCF Kubernetes **chaos engineering** platformasi: CRD'lar (`PodChaos`, `NetworkChaos`, `IOChaos`, `StressChaos`, `TimeChaos`, `DNSChaos`...) orqali nazorat ostida nosozlik kiritadi va `Workflow`/`Schedule` bilan eksperimentlarni rejalashtiradi.

**Muammo:** "Pod o'lsa yoki tarmoq 200ms sekinlashsa servis chidaydimi?" — bu savolga javobni incident paytida emas, oldindan, nazorat ostida bilish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Chaos CRD (selector: namespace + label, duration)
   |
   v
chaos-controller-manager --> chaos-daemon (har node'da, privileged DaemonSet)
   |                          --> tc netem (latency/loss), cgroup stress, FUSE (IO), kill
   v
duration tugadi --> avtomatik tiklash
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: NetworkChaos
metadata: {name: payments-latency, namespace: chaos-testing}
spec:
  action: delay
  mode: one                      # bitta tasodifiy pod
  selector:
    namespaces: [shop]
    labelSelectors: {app: payments}
  delay: {latency: "200ms", jitter: "50ms"}
  duration: "5m"
```
```bash
kubectl apply -f payments-latency.yaml
kubectl get networkchaos -n chaos-testing
# kuzatish: p99 latency, error rate, timeout/circuit breaker xulqi
```
Eksperiment shabloni: gipoteza ("p99 < 500ms qoladi") -> kichik blast radius -> o'lchash -> to'xtatish mezoni -> xulosa va tuzatish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- chaos-daemon privileged — kim chaos CRD yarata olishini RBAC va namespace filtri bilan qat'iy cheklang.
- `mode: all` va keng selector bilan production'da boshlash — eksperiment emas, incident.
- Monitoring'siz chaos — natijani o'lchab bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval staging, keyin production'da "game day" sifatida, on-call xabardor holda. Muqobillar: LitmusChaos (CNCF), AWS FIS. Chaos'ning qiymati — topilgan zaiflikni tuzatish va regress testga aylantirishda.

41218.a:
**Qisqa javob:** kube-state-metrics (KSM) — API Server'dagi **obyektlar holati**ni (Deployment kerakli/mavjud replikalar, pod phase, restart soni, resource request/limit, Job natijasi, node condition) Prometheus metrikalari sifatida chiqaradigan servis. Resurs **foydalanishini** emas, **holatini** o'lchaydi.

**Muammo:** CPU/xotira metrikalari (cAdvisor, metrics-server) "Deployment'da 3 dan 1 ta replika tayyor" yoki "CronJob 2 kundan beri muvaffaqiyatsiz" kabi savollarga javob bermaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
API Server --watch--> kube-state-metrics (in-memory) --/metrics--> Prometheus
                                                                   |
cAdvisor/kubelet (usage) ---------------------------------------->+--> alert'lar
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Deployment to'liq tayyor emas
kube_deployment_spec_replicas != kube_deployment_status_replicas_available
# tez-tez restart
increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[1h]) > 3
# CrashLoopBackOff
kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff"} == 1
# request vs haqiqiy foydalanish (KSM + cAdvisor)
sum by (namespace) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m]))
  / sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
```
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring port-forward svc/kube-state-metrics 8080 && curl -s localhost:8080/metrics | head
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Katta klasterda KSM ko'p xotira oladi va juda ko'p series chiqaradi — `--metric-allowlist`/`--metric-denylist`, sharding.
- Label'lar default chiqarilmaydi (`kube_pod_labels` bo'sh) — `--metric-labels-allowlist` bilan aniq tanlang (cardinality!).
- KSM metrikalari "snapshot" — tarixiy ma'lumot Prometheus'da.

**Senior nuqta:** kube-prometheus-stack KSM'ni tayyor alert'lar bilan beradi. Eng foydali alert'lar — simptomga yo'naltirilgan (rollout tiqilib qoldi, Job yiqildi), har bir pod restart'iga emas.

41219.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Oddiy pod o'z **network namespace**ini va CNI bergan alohida IP'ni oladi. `hostNetwork: true` bilan pod **node'ning network namespace'ini** ishlatadi: node IP'si, node interfeyslari, node portlari. Bu kuchli imkoniyat va jiddiy xavfsizlik/operatsion xavf.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
oddiy:                         hostNetwork: true:
node eth0 10.0.1.5             node eth0 10.0.1.5
   |                               |
 CNI bridge/veth                pod process --> to'g'ridan eth0, port 80 = node port 80
   |
 pod eth0 10.244.3.17 (o'z netns)
```

| | Oddiy pod | hostNetwork |
|---|---|---|
| IP | pod CIDR | node IP |
| Port konflikt | yo'q | bir node'da bitta |
| NetworkPolicy | qo'llanadi | odatda qo'llanmaydi |
| Node interfeyslari | ko'rinmaydi | ko'rinadi (localhost servislari ham) |

**Qachon kerak:** CNI agentlari, kube-proxy, node exporter, ba'zi ingress/LB agentlari — ya'ni node tarmog'ini boshqaradigan yoki kuzatadigan tizim komponentlari.

**Amalda (aniqlash va cheklash):**
```bash
kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath='{range .items[?(@.spec.hostNetwork==true)]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}{"\n"}{end}'
kubectl label ns apps pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=baseline   # baseline hostNetwork'ni taqiqlaydi
```
```yaml
spec:
  hostNetwork: true
  dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet     # aks holda cluster DNS ishlamaydi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `dnsPolicy` o'zgartirilmasa pod `*.svc.cluster.local` ni resolve qila olmaydi.
- Pod node'ning `127.0.0.1` da tinglayotgan servislarga (masalan kubelet read-only port, metadata proxy) kira oladi — izolyatsiya yo'qoladi.
- Bir node'ga ikkita replika tushsa port konflikti — pod `Pending`.

**Senior nuqta:** Ilova workload'lari uchun `hostNetwork` deyarli hech qachon kerak emas — `hostPort`, NodePort yoki LoadBalancer yetarli. Pod Security Admission `baseline`/`restricted` darajasi bilan uni faqat system namespace'larda ruxsat eting.

41220.a:
**Qisqa javob:** RuntimeClass — cluster darajasidagi obyekt bo'lib, pod qaysi **container runtime handler** bilan ishga tushishini tanlaydi (`spec.runtimeClassName`). Shu bilan bir klasterda oddiy workload'lar `runc`, ishonchsiz kod esa sandbox runtime (`gVisor/runsc`, `Kata Containers`) bilan ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** Oddiy container'lar host kernel'ini bo'lishadi: kernel zaifligi orqali izolyatsiyadan chiqish xavfi bor. Foydalanuvchi yuklagan kodni (CI runner, multi-tenant SaaS, AI agent sandbox) ishga tushirishda qo'shimcha izolyatsiya qatlami kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Pod (runtimeClassName: gvisor)
   |
   v
kubelet --CRI--> containerd --handler "runsc"--> gVisor (user-space kernel, syscall'larni ushlaydi)
                            --handler "kata"---> Kata (har pod uchun yengil VM, alohida kernel)
                            --default "runc"---> oddiy namespace/cgroup
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: node.k8s.io/v1
kind: RuntimeClass
metadata: {name: gvisor}
handler: runsc                     # containerd config'dagi handler nomi
scheduling:
  nodeSelector: {sandbox: gvisor}  # faqat runsc o'rnatilgan node'larga
overhead:
  podFixed: {cpu: 100m, memory: 64Mi}   # sandbox xarajati scheduling'da hisobga olinadi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: untrusted-job}
spec:
  runtimeClassName: gvisor
  containers: [{name: job, image: registry/job:1.0}]
```
GKE Sandbox (gVisor) va AKS Pod Sandboxing (Kata) managed variantlar.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Handler node'da sozlanmagan bo'lsa pod `ContainerCreating` da qoladi — `scheduling.nodeSelector` muhim.
- gVisor barcha syscall'larni qo'llamaydi va I/O-og'ir ishlarda sekinroq — mos kelishini test qiling.
- RuntimeClass o'zi siyosat emas: ishonchsiz tenant'lar uni tanlashga majburlanishi kerak (Kyverno/Gatekeeper).

**Senior nuqta:** Sandbox — defense in depth qatlami, `restricted` Pod Security, seccomp, non-root va NetworkPolicy o'rnini bosmaydi. Xavf modeli "ishonchsiz kod" bo'lsa, eng kuchli chegara — alohida node pool yoki alohida klaster.

41221.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pod `spec.securityContext.sysctls` orqali **namespaced** kernel parametrlarini (faqat o'z network/IPC namespace'i uchun) o'rnatishi mumkin, masalan `net.core.somaxconn`, `net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range`. "Safe" sysctl'lar default ruxsat etilgan; "unsafe" lari kubelet'da `--allowed-unsafe-sysctls` bilan aniq ruxsat talab qiladi. Node-wide (namespaced bo'lmagan) sysctl'larni pod orqali o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.

**Muammo:** Yuqori yuklamali proxy/DB pod'ga katta `somaxconn` kerak, lekin node'ning global sozlamasini o'zgartirish boshqa pod'larga ta'sir qiladi. Namespaced sysctl faqat shu pod'ga tegadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
safe (default ruxsat): kernel.shm_rmid_forced, net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range,
                       net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies, net.ipv4.ping_group_range,
                       net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start, net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_* (yangi versiyalar)...
unsafe (namespaced, lekin kubelet ruxsati kerak): net.core.somaxconn, kernel.msg*, ...
node-level (vm.*, fs.file-max): pod'dan TAQIQLANGAN -> node tuning (DaemonSet/MachineConfig)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: haproxy}
spec:
  securityContext:
    sysctls:
    - {name: net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range, value: "1024 65000"}
    - {name: net.core.somaxconn, value: "4096"}     # unsafe
  nodeSelector: {sysctl-tuned: "true"}               # ruxsat berilgan node'lar
  containers: [{name: haproxy, image: haproxy:3.0}]
```
```yaml
# KubeletConfiguration (faqat maxsus node pool)
allowedUnsafeSysctls: ["net.core.somaxconn"]
```
```bash
kubectl exec haproxy -- sysctl net.core.somaxconn
```
Ruxsat yo'q node'ga tushsa pod `SysctlForbidden` sababi bilan rad etiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Unsafe sysctl'larni hamma node'larda yoqish — bir tenant boshqalarga ta'sir qilishi mumkin; taint + alohida node pool.
- Pod Security `baseline` faqat safe ro'yxatga ruxsat beradi.
- `hostNetwork: true` pod'da net.* sysctl node'ning o'ziga tegadi — shuning uchun bu kombinatsiya taqiqlangan.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval sysctl haqiqatan kerakligini o'lchang (`ss -lnt` da Recv-Q to'lishi, `ListenOverflows`). Node darajasidagi tuning IaC orqali node image'da yoki privileged DaemonSet'da, pod'larda emas.

41222.a:
**Qisqa javob:** StorageClass'dagi `volumeBindingMode`:
- `Immediate` — PVC yaratilishi bilan PV darhol provision qilinadi, pod qayerga tushishi hali noma'lum;
- `WaitForFirstConsumer` — provisioning PVC'ni ishlatadigan pod **schedule qilingandan keyin**, aynan o'sha node'ning zonasida bajariladi.

**Muammo (Immediate):** EBS volume `us-east-1a` da yaratildi, scheduler esa pod'ni CPU yetarli bo'lgan `us-east-1b` node'ga qo'ymoqchi. EBS boshqa AZ'ga ulanmaydi — pod `Pending` ("volume node affinity conflict").

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Immediate:            PVC --> PV (1a) --> pod schedule --> faqat 1a node'lar (yoki Pending)
WaitForFirstConsumer: PVC (Pending) --> pod schedule (CPU, affinity, taint hisobga) --> node 1b
                                     --> CSI 1b'da volume yaratadi --> bind --> mount
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata: {name: gp3}
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
allowVolumeExpansion: true
reclaimPolicy: Delete
parameters: {type: gp3}
```
```bash
kubectl get pvc data-db-0     # STATUS Pending - WaitForFirstConsumer'da pod'gacha normal
kubectl describe pvc data-db-0 | grep -i waiting   # "waiting for first consumer to be created"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- WFFC'da PVC'ning `Pending` bo'lishi xato emas — monitoring alert'larini shunga moslang.
- `spec.nodeName` bilan to'g'ridan qo'yilgan pod scheduler'ni chetlab o'tadi va WFFC bilan muammo beradi.
- StorageClass'ning `volumeBindingMode` maydoni o'zgarmas — yangi class yarating.

**Senior nuqta:** Zonali block storage (EBS, Azure Disk, PD) uchun doim `WaitForFirstConsumer`. Lekin u bir marta bind qilingandan keyin StatefulSet pod'i abadiy shu zonaga bog'lanadi — zona o'lsa pod ko'chmaydi; HA'ni ilova darajasida replikatsiya bilan hal qiling.

41223.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Storage topology awareness — CSI driver va scheduler **volume qayerdan ulanishi mumkinligini** (zona/region/node) bilishi: volume pod tushadigan zonada yaratiladi, mavjud volume'li pod esa faqat shu volume'ga ulanishi mumkin bo'lgan node'larga schedule qilinadi.

**Muammo:** Block storage zonaviy (EBS faqat o'z AZ'idagi EC2'ga ulanadi). Topologiyani bilmaydigan tizim volume'ni bir zonada, pod'ni boshqasida yaratib, "Multi-Attach / volume node affinity conflict" xatolarini beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CSI node plugin --> node'ga topology label: topology.ebs.csi.aws.com/zone=us-east-1a
CSI controller  --> yaratilgan PV'ga nodeAffinity: zone In [us-east-1a]
scheduler       --> pod'ni faqat PV nodeAffinity'ga mos node'ga qo'yadi
StorageClass allowedTopologies --> volume yaratiladigan zonalarni cheklash
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata: {name: gp3-zonal}
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
allowedTopologies:
- matchLabelExpressions:
  - key: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
    values: [us-east-1a, us-east-1b]
```
```bash
kubectl get pv pvc-123 -o jsonpath='{.spec.nodeAffinity}'
kubectl get nodes -L topology.kubernetes.io/zone
kubectl get csinode <node> -o yaml      # driver topology kalitlari
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bitta zonada node qolmasa (autoscaler scale-down, spot interruption) PV'li pod `Pending` — har zonada node bo'lishini ta'minlang (Karpenter/ASG zonalar bo'yicha).
- EBS snapshot'dan boshqa zonada tiklash mumkin, lekin to'g'ridan ko'chirib bo'lmaydi.
- Regional disklar (GCP regional PD, Azure ZRS) cheklovni yumshatadi, lekin latency/narx boshqacha.

**Senior nuqta:** Stateful workload'lar uchun topology'ni dizayn bosqichida hisobga oling: StatefulSet replikalarini `topologySpreadConstraints` bilan zonalar bo'ylab tarqating — har replika o'z zonasidagi volume bilan, ilova esa replikatsiya qiladi.

41224.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ephemeral storage — node'ning lokal diskidagi pod ishlatadigan vaqtinchalik joy: container **writable layer**, **container log'lari** va **`emptyDir`** (medium Memory bo'lmagan). `resources.requests/limits.ephemeral-storage` bilan scheduling va cheklov beriladi; limitdan oshsa kubelet pod'ni **evict** qiladi.

**Muammo:** Bitta pod `/tmp` ga 80GB yozib node root diskini to'ldirdi — node `DiskPressure` holatiga o'tdi va kubelet o'sha node'dagi boshqa, aybsiz pod'larni ham evict qila boshladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
node disk (nodefs / imagefs)
  +-- container writable layer   \
  +-- /var/log/pods/... log'lar   +--> pod ephemeral-storage hisobi
  +-- emptyDir (disk)            /
kubelet (davriy o'lchash) --> limit oshdi --> Evicted: "ephemeral local storage usage exceeds the total limit"
scheduler --> request'lar yig'indisi <= node allocatable ephemeral-storage
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  containers:
  - name: worker
    image: registry/worker:2.1
    resources:
      requests: {ephemeral-storage: "2Gi"}
      limits:   {ephemeral-storage: "4Gi"}
    volumeMounts: [{name: scratch, mountPath: /scratch}]
  volumes:
  - name: scratch
    emptyDir: {sizeLimit: "3Gi"}
```
```bash
kubectl describe node worker-2 | grep -A5 -i 'allocatable' | grep ephemeral
kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Failed | grep Evicted
kubectl get --raw /api/v1/nodes/worker-2/proxy/stats/summary | jq '.pods[] | {n:.podRef.name, eph:.["ephemeral-storage"].usedBytes}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kubelet o'lchovni davriy bajaradi — tez yozuvchi pod qisqa vaqt limitdan oshishi mumkin.
- `emptyDir.medium: Memory` diskni emas, xotira limitini ishlatadi.
- Evicted pod'lar `Failed` holatida qolib ketadi va ro'yxatni ifloslantiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** LimitRange bilan namespace'da default ephemeral-storage limit qo'ying. Ko'p vaqtinchalik ma'lumot kerak bo'lsa (build cache, ML) generic ephemeral volume (`ephemeral:` PVC shabloni) yoki lokal NVMe'li alohida node pool ishlating.

41225.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Secrets Store CSI Driver — tashqi secret store'lardagi (AWS Secrets Manager/Parameter Store, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager, HashiCorp Vault) secret'larni pod'ga **CSI volume (tmpfs) fayllari** sifatida mount qiladi. `SecretProviderClass` qaysi secret qayerdan olinishini belgilaydi; ixtiyoriy ravishda K8s Secret'ga sinxronlash ham mumkin.

**Muammo:** K8s Secret'lar etcd'da base64 ko'rinishida saqlanadi (encryption at rest yoqilmagan bo'lsa ochiq), GitOps'da esa ularni git'ga yozib bo'lmaydi. Haqiqat manbai tashqi vault bo'lishi va rotatsiya markazlashgan bo'lishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
pod (serviceAccount: api, IRSA/Workload Identity)
   |  volume: csi secrets-store
   v
kubelet --> CSI driver (DaemonSet) --> provider plugin (aws/azure/gcp/vault)
                                         | pod identity bilan autentifikatsiya
                                         v
                                   Secrets Manager --> tmpfs fayl: /mnt/secrets/db-password
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: secrets-store.csi.x-k8s.io/v1
kind: SecretProviderClass
metadata: {name: api-secrets, namespace: shop}
spec:
  provider: aws
  parameters:
    objects: |
      - objectName: "prod/api/db"
        objectType: "secretsmanager"
---
# pod spec bo'lagi
volumes:
- name: secrets
  csi:
    driver: secrets-store.csi.k8s.io
    readOnly: true
    volumeAttributes: {secretProviderClass: api-secrets}
```
```bash
kubectl exec api-xyz -- ls /mnt/secrets
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret faqat pod mount qilganda olinadi — vault ishlamasa pod start bo'lmaydi.
- Rotatsiya (`enableSecretRotation`) faylni yangilaydi, lekin ilova uni qayta o'qishi kerak; env variable sifatida sync qilingan bo'lsa restart shart.
- `secretObjects` bilan K8s Secret'ga sync — secret yana etcd'da paydo bo'ladi (afzallikning bir qismi yo'qoladi).

**Senior nuqta:** Muqobil — External Secrets Operator (vault -> K8s Secret sync): oddiyroq, env variable'lar bilan mos, lekin secret etcd'da (KMS encryption at rest shart). Tanlov: "secret etcd'ga tushmasin" talabi bo'lsa CSI, soddalik kerak bo'lsa ESO.

41226.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CRD bir nechta versiyani (`v1alpha1`, `v1beta1`, `v1`) bir vaqtda serve qila oladi, lekin etcd'da faqat bitta **storage version** saqlanadi. Sxemalar farq qilsa, API Server versiyalar orasidagi o'girishni **conversion webhook**ga (sizning servisingiz) yuboradi: client qaysi versiyani so'rasa, shu ko'rinishda qaytariladi.

**Muammo:** Operator API'ni rivojlantirmoqda: `spec.replicas` -> `spec.scaling.replicas`. Eski client'lar `v1alpha1` bilan, yangilari `v1` bilan ishlaydi; ikkalasi ham bir xil obyektni to'g'ri ko'rishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
client GET v1alpha1 --> API Server --> etcd (storage: v1)
                                   --> ConversionReview(v1 -> v1alpha1) --> webhook
                                   <-- o'girilgan obyekt
strategy: None    -> faqat apiVersion o'zgaradi (sxema bir xil bo'lsa)
strategy: Webhook -> maydon o'girish mantiqi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
spec:
  versions:
  - {name: v1alpha1, served: true, storage: false, schema: {...}}
  - {name: v1,       served: true, storage: true,  schema: {...}}
  conversion:
    strategy: Webhook
    webhook:
      conversionReviewVersions: ["v1"]
      clientConfig:
        service: {namespace: op-system, name: op-webhook, path: /convert}
        caBundle: <base64 CA>   # yoki cert-manager cainjector annotation
```
Kubebuilder'da: "hub" versiya (`v1`) va har boshqa versiya uchun `ConvertTo/ConvertFrom` funksiyalari.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Webhook ishlamasa (pod yo'q, TLS muddati o'tgan) shu CRD bo'yicha **barcha** so'rovlar yiqiladi, garbage collection ham — webhook'ni HA qiling.
- Konvertatsiya lossless bo'lishi kerak (round-trip): yangi maydonni eski versiyada annotation'da saqlash pattern'i.
- Storage version almashgandan keyin eski versiyadagi obyektlar etcd'da qoladi — storage version migration bilan qayta yozing, keyin eski versiyani `served: false`.

**Senior nuqta:** Webhook'ga ehtiyojni kamaytiring: iloji boricha faqat additive o'zgarishlar (yangi optional maydon) — ular `None` strategiya bilan ishlaydi. Breaking o'zgarish — yangi versiya + webhook + deprecation rejasi.

41227.a:
**Qisqa javob:**
- **Typed client (`kubernetes.Clientset`)** — har resurs uchun generatsiya qilingan Go struct'lar (`corev1.Pod`): compile-time type tekshiruvi, IDE autocomplete; faqat oldindan ma'lum turlar uchun.
- **Dynamic client (`dynamic.Interface`)** — `GroupVersionResource` bo'yicha istalgan resurs, `unstructured.Unstructured` (`map[string]interface{}`) bilan: CRD'lar va generic tool'lar uchun, lekin type xavfsizligi yo'q.

**Qachon qaysi:** O'z operator'ingiz o'z CRD'si bilan — typed (yoki controller-runtime client). Har qanday resurs bilan ishlaydigan generic tool (backup, policy, `kubectl`ga o'xshash) — dynamic.

**Amalda:**
```go
// typed
cs := kubernetes.NewForConfigOrDie(cfg)
pods, err := cs.CoreV1().Pods("shop").List(ctx, metav1.ListOptions{LabelSelector: "app=api"})
for _, p := range pods.Items { fmt.Println(p.Name, p.Status.Phase) }

// dynamic
dc := dynamic.NewForConfigOrDie(cfg)
gvr := schema.GroupVersionResource{Group: "cert-manager.io", Version: "v1", Resource: "certificates"}
list, err := dc.Resource(gvr).Namespace("shop").List(ctx, metav1.ListOptions{})
for _, u := range list.Items {
    ready, found, _ := unstructured.NestedSlice(u.Object, "status", "conditions")
    fmt.Println(u.GetName(), found, len(ready))
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Dynamic client'da maydon nomidagi xato compile'da emas, runtime'da `found=false` bo'lib chiqadi — doim `found` va `err` ni tekshiring.
- Typed client uchun boshqa loyihaning CRD'si kerak bo'lsa uning Go modulini import qilish dependency'larni og'irlashtiradi — dynamic yoki `runtime.DefaultUnstructuredConverter` bilan typed'ga o'girish.
- Resource nomi (plural, `certificates`) va Kind (`Certificate`) farqli — RESTMapper/discovery bilan aniqlang.

**Senior nuqta:** Controller yozishda controller-runtime `client.Client` ikkalasini birlashtiradi (typed obyektlar + `unstructured` qo'llovi) va cache'dan o'qiydi. Xom client-go client'larini to'g'ridan loop'da ishlatish API Server'ni yuklaydi — informer'lar orqali o'qing.

41228.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Informer — API Server'dan obyektlarni bir marta **LIST** qilib, keyin **WATCH** bilan o'zgarishlarni oladigan va ularni lokal **cache (indexer)**da saqlaydigan mexanizm; o'zgarishda `OnAdd/OnUpdate/OnDelete` handler'larni chaqiradi. **SharedInformer(Factory)** bitta resurs turi uchun bitta watch va bitta cache'ni bir process ichidagi barcha controller'larga ulashadi.

**Muammo:** Har controller har soniyada `LIST pods` qilsa API Server va etcd bo'g'iladi (429, sekinlik). Informer bilan o'qishlar lokal xotiradan, API'ga esa faqat bitta uzluksiz watch oqimi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
API Server --LIST+WATCH--> Reflector --> DeltaFIFO --> Indexer (lokal cache)
                                                  |
                                                  +--> event handler'lar --> workqueue'ga key
controller: lister.Pods(ns).Get(name)  --> cache'dan (API so'rovsiz)
watch uzildi --> resourceVersion'dan davom; "too old" bo'lsa qayta LIST
resync period --> cache'dagi obyektlar uchun davriy Update event (qayta reconcile)
```

**Amalda:**
```go
factory := informers.NewSharedInformerFactory(clientset, 10*time.Minute)
podInf := factory.Core().V1().Pods()
podInf.Informer().AddEventHandler(cache.ResourceEventHandlerFuncs{
    AddFunc:    func(obj any) { key, _ := cache.MetaNamespaceKeyFunc(obj); queue.Add(key) },
    UpdateFunc: func(_, obj any) { key, _ := cache.MetaNamespaceKeyFunc(obj); queue.Add(key) },
    DeleteFunc: func(obj any) { key, _ := cache.DeletionHandlingMetaNamespaceKeyFunc(obj); queue.Add(key) },
})
factory.Start(ctx.Done())
if !cache.WaitForCacheSync(ctx.Done(), podInf.Informer().HasSynced) { panic("sync") }
pod, err := podInf.Lister().Pods("shop").Get("api-0")   // cache'dan
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cache'dan olingan obyektni **o'zgartirmang** — u umumiy; `DeepCopy()` qiling.
- `WaitForCacheSync` siz reconcile bo'sh cache bilan ishlab "obyekt yo'q" deb noto'g'ri qaror qiladi.
- Butun klaster pod'larini cache qilish katta xotira oladi — label/field selector yoki metadata-only informer.

**Senior nuqta:** Handler'larda og'ir ish qilmang — faqat key'ni workqueue'ga qo'ying. Cache "eventually consistent": o'z yozuvingizni darhol ko'rmasligingiz mumkin — mantiq buni hisobga olsin.

41229.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Workqueue (client-go `workqueue`) — informer event'lari va reconcile worker'lari orasidagi navbat: **key'larni** (`namespace/name`) saqlaydi, bir key'ni **dedup** qiladi (navbatda bo'lsa qayta qo'shilmaydi), bitta key'ni bir vaqtda faqat **bitta worker** qayta ishlashini kafolatlaydi va xatoda **rate-limited retry** (exponential backoff) beradi.

**Muammo:** Deployment'ning status'i 1 soniyada 20 marta yangilanadi. Har event uchun alohida reconcile — isrof va bir obyektni parallel o'zgartiruvchi worker'lar orasida conflict.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
event x20 (shop/api) --> queue: [shop/api]  (bitta, dedup)
worker1 Get() --> shop/api "processing" (boshqa worker olmaydi)
   reconcile xato --> AddRateLimited(key)  --> 5ms, 10ms, 20ms ... max backoff
   muvaffaqiyat   --> Forget(key) (backoff hisobini tozalash)
   har holda      --> Done(key)
processing paytida yangi event --> "dirty", Done'dan keyin qayta navbatga
```

**Amalda:**
```go
q := workqueue.NewTypedRateLimitingQueue(workqueue.DefaultTypedControllerRateLimiter[string]())
func processNext(ctx context.Context) bool {
    key, shutdown := q.Get()
    if shutdown { return false }
    defer q.Done(key)
    if err := reconcile(ctx, key); err != nil {
        if q.NumRequeues(key) < 10 { q.AddRateLimited(key); return true }
        utilruntime.HandleError(err)          // taslim bo'lish, log
    }
    q.Forget(key)
    return true
}
for i := 0; i < 4; i++ { go wait.UntilWithContext(ctx, func(ctx context.Context){ for processNext(ctx) {} }, time.Second) }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Done()` chaqirilmasa key abadiy "processing" da qoladi va boshqa hech qachon qayta ishlanmaydi.
- `Forget()` unutilsa keyingi xatoda backoff juda katta bo'lib qoladi.
- Navbatga obyektni emas, key'ni qo'ying — reconcile paytida eng so'nggi holatni cache'dan oling.

**Senior nuqta:** controller-runtime bularning barchasini yashiradi (`MaxConcurrentReconciles`, `RateLimiter` sozlanadi). `workqueue_depth`, `workqueue_retries_total`, `workqueue_work_duration_seconds` metrikalari controller sog'lig'ining asosiy signallari.

41230.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Reconcile loop — controller'ning yuragi: `Reconcile(ctx, Request{namespace/name}) (Result, error)` funksiyasi obyektning **desired state** (spec) ini **actual state** bilan solishtiradi va farqni yo'qotish uchun minimal o'zgarishni bajaradi. U **level-based** va **idempotent**: necha marta chaqirilsa ham bir xil natija beradi.

**Muammo:** Event'lar yo'qolishi, dublikat bo'lishi yoki tartibsiz kelishi mumkin. "Qaysi event keldi?" ga emas, "hozir holat qanday va qanday bo'lishi kerak?" ga qarab ishlash tizimni ishonchli qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Request(key) --> obyektni cache'dan o'qish --> yo'q? --> (o'chirilgan) cleanup, return
      |
      v
DeletionTimestamp bor? --> finalizer mantiqi (tashqi resursni o'chirish) --> finalizer'ni olib tashlash
      |
      v
desired (spec) vs actual (child obyektlar, tashqi API)
      |
      v
create/update/delete --> status yangilash (/status) --> Result{RequeueAfter?} / error (backoff)
```

**Amalda:**
```go
func (r *AppReconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, req ctrl.Request) (ctrl.Result, error) {
    var app v1.App
    if err := r.Get(ctx, req.NamespacedName, &app); err != nil {
        return ctrl.Result{}, client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
    }
    dep := &appsv1.Deployment{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: app.Name, Namespace: app.Namespace}}
    _, err := controllerutil.CreateOrUpdate(ctx, r.Client, dep, func() error {
        dep.Spec.Replicas = &app.Spec.Replicas
        // ... template
        return controllerutil.SetControllerReference(&app, dep, r.Scheme)
    })
    if err != nil { return ctrl.Result{}, err }          // backoff bilan qayta
    app.Status.ReadyReplicas = dep.Status.ReadyReplicas
    if err := r.Status().Update(ctx, &app); err != nil { return ctrl.Result{}, err }
    return ctrl.Result{RequeueAfter: 5 * time.Minute}, nil   // tashqi drift uchun
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har reconcile'da yangi tasodifiy nom/ID yaratish — idempotentlik buziladi, dublikatlar.
- Status'ni `Update` bilan yangilab spec'ni ham yozish — conflict va keraksiz generation o'sishi; status subresource ishlating.
- Ham `error`, ham `Requeue` qaytarish — error ustun bo'ladi; mantiqni aniq ajrating.

**Senior nuqta:** `status.observedGeneration` va conditions (`Ready`, `Progressing`) bilan foydalanuvchiga controller spec'ning qaysi versiyasini ko'rganini ko'rsating. Reconcile tez va qisqa bo'lsin — uzoq tashqi operatsiyalar uchun holatni status'da saqlab, keyingi reconcile'da davom eting.

41231.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Har K8s obyektida `metadata.resourceVersion` bor (etcd revision'ga asoslangan, client uchun "opaque" string). Client obyektni o'qib, o'zgartirib, **o'sha resourceVersion bilan** `Update` yuboradi; agar shu orada boshqa birov obyektni o'zgartirgan bo'lsa API Server **409 Conflict** qaytaradi. Client qayta o'qiydi va o'zgarishni yangi versiyaga qo'llaydi. Bu — lock'siz optimistic concurrency.

**Muammo:** Ikki controller bir Deployment'ni o'qidi; biri replikani, ikkinchisi annotation'ni o'zgartirdi. Tekshiruvsiz ikkinchi yozuv birinchisini jim o'chirib yuborardi (lost update).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
A: GET (rv=100)            B: GET (rv=100)
A: PUT (rv=100) --> OK, rv=101
                           B: PUT (rv=100) --> 409 Conflict ("the object has been modified")
                           B: GET (rv=101) --> o'zgartirish --> PUT (rv=101) --> OK
```

**Amalda:**
```go
err := retry.RetryOnConflict(retry.DefaultRetry, func() error {
    dep, err := cs.AppsV1().Deployments("shop").Get(ctx, "api", metav1.GetOptions{})
    if err != nil { return err }
    dep.Spec.Replicas = ptr.To[int32](5)
    _, err = cs.AppsV1().Deployments("shop").Update(ctx, dep, metav1.UpdateOptions{})
    return err
})
```
Conflict'ni umuman chetlab o'tish — faqat o'z maydonlaringizni yuborish:
```bash
kubectl patch deploy api -p '{"spec":{"replicas":5}}'          # strategic merge, rv'siz
kubectl apply --server-side --field-manager=my-controller -f dep.yaml   # SSA: maydon egaligi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `resourceVersion` ni son sifatida solishtirish yoki undan tartib chiqarish — u opaque, faqat tenglik ma'noli.
- Butun obyektni `Update` qilish (eski cache nusxasi bilan) — boshqa controller maydonlarini qaytarib yozish xavfi.
- Conflict'ni cheksiz retry qilish — doimiy kurash (ikki controller bir maydon uchun) belgisini yashiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Server-Side Apply (`fieldManager`) zamonaviy yondashuv: har maydonning egasi aniq, conflict maydon darajasida, bir nechta controller bir obyektni xavfsiz bo'lishadi. 409 lar ko'paysa — ikki aktor bir maydonni boshqarayotganini tekshiring.

41232.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubernetes controller'lari **eventual consistency** modelida ishlaydi: o'zgarish darhol va atomik ravishda butun tizimga tarqalmaydi; har controller o'z cache'idan o'qiydi, kichik qadam qiladi va holat desired state'ga **vaqt o'tib** yaqinlashadi. Xato yoki kechikish bo'lsa reconcile qayta uriniladi.

**Muammo:** `kubectl apply` Deployment'ni darhol "tayyor" qilmaydi: Deployment -> ReplicaSet -> Pod -> scheduler -> kubelet -> container -> readiness. Har bosqich alohida controller va har biri bir oz kechikadi yoki xato beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
spec o'zgardi (etcd)
   |-> deployment controller (cache biroz eski bo'lishi mumkin) -> ReplicaSet
   |-> replicaset controller -> Pod'lar
   |-> scheduler -> nodeName
   |-> kubelet -> container, status
har qadam: xato -> backoff -> retry ... oxir-oqibat: status == spec
```
Natijalar:
- Controller o'z yaratgan obyektini keyingi reconcile'da cache'da hali **ko'rmasligi** mumkin.
- Tashqi resurslar (cloud LB) ham asinxron — status'da `Pending`/condition'lar orqali bildiriladi.

**Amalda (to'g'ri kutish):**
```bash
kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml
kubectl rollout status deploy/api --timeout=180s       # spec'ni emas, status'ni kutadi
kubectl wait --for=condition=Available deploy/api --timeout=180s
kubectl get deploy api -o jsonpath='{.metadata.generation} {.status.observedGeneration}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CI'da `apply` dan darhol keyin test boshlash — hali eski pod'larga tegish.
- Controller "yaratdim, cache'da yo'q -> yana yarataman" — deterministik nomlar yoki `expectations` mexanizmi bilan dublikatdan saqlaning.
- Bir-biriga bog'liq resurslarda (CRD -> CR) tartib: CRD `Established` bo'lmaguncha CR yaratish xato beradi; GitOps tool'lari sync-wave bilan hal qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Eventual consistency — dizayn xususiyati: tizim crash va tarmoq uzilishlaridan o'zi tiklanadi. Kuzatuvda "converged"ni o'lchang: `observedGeneration == generation` va `Ready` condition, oddiy "apply muvaffaqiyatli"ni emas.

41233.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Subresource — obyektning alohida qismi uchun alohida API endpoint: `/status` (faqat `.status`ni yozadi, spec o'zgarishlari e'tiborsiz), `/scale` (faqat replikalar soni, HPA va `kubectl scale` uchun umumiy interfeys), shuningdek `/log`, `/exec`, `/eviction`, `/binding`. RBAC ularga alohida beriladi (`deployments/status`, `pods/exec`).

**Muammo:** Foydalanuvchi spec'ni, controller esa status'ni yozadi. Bitta endpoint'da ular bir-birining yozuvini buzardi va har status yangilanishi `generation` ni oshirib, keraksiz rollout'larni boshlardi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PUT /apis/apps/v1/namespaces/shop/deployments/api         -> spec (status e'tiborsiz), generation++
PUT .../deployments/api/status                            -> faqat status, generation o'zgarmaydi
PUT .../deployments/api/scale  (Scale obyekti)            -> spec.replicas
RBAC: "deployments" va "deployments/status" -- alohida resurslar
```

**Amalda (CRD'da yoqish):**
```yaml
versions:
- name: v1
  served: true
  storage: true
  subresources:
    status: {}
    scale:
      specReplicasPath: .spec.replicas
      statusReplicasPath: .status.replicas
      labelSelectorPath: .status.selector
```
```bash
kubectl scale myapp/demo --replicas=3          # /scale orqali, HPA ham ishlaydi
kubectl auth can-i create pods/exec -n shop --as=dev@corp
kubectl get --raw /apis/apps/v1/namespaces/shop/deployments/api/scale
```
```go
r.Status().Update(ctx, &app)   // controller-runtime: /status ga yozish
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CRD'da status subresource yoqilgandan keyin oddiy `Update` status'ni yozmaydi — "status yangilanmayapti" bug'ining keng tarqalgan sababi.
- `pods/exec`, `pods/attach`, `pods/portforward` ruxsatlari amalda container ichiga kirish demak — `pods` ga `get` berish bilan bir xil emas, ehtiyot bo'ling.
- Wildcard `resources: ["*"]` subresource'larni ham qamrab oladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Least privilege: controller'ga `myapps/status` ga `update`, foydalanuvchilarga esa faqat spec. `pods/exec` va `nodes/proxy` ni audit qiling — bu ruxsatlar privilege escalation yo'lini ochadi.

41234.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `metadata.ownerReferences` — child obyektni parent'ga bog'laydi (ReplicaSet -> Pod). Parent o'chirilganda **garbage collector** child'larni avtomatik o'chiradi. `controller: true` — asosiy boshqaruvchi controller'ni bildiradi. `blockOwnerDeletion: true` — **foreground** o'chirishda parent child'lar o'chirilmaguncha yo'qolmasligini ta'minlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Deployment --owns--> ReplicaSet --owns--> Pod
kubectl delete deploy api --cascade=?
  background (default): parent darhol o'chadi, GC child'larni fonda o'chiradi
  foreground: parent'ga deletionTimestamp + "foregroundDeletion" finalizer,
              avval blockOwnerDeletion=true child'lar, keyin parent
  orphan:     parent o'chadi, child'lar qoladi (ownerReference olib tashlanadi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
metadata:
  name: api-7d9f
  ownerReferences:
  - apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: ReplicaSet
    name: api-7d9f
    uid: 3b1c...            # UID bo'yicha bog'lanadi, nom bo'yicha emas
    controller: true
    blockOwnerDeletion: true
```
```bash
kubectl delete deploy api --cascade=foreground
kubectl delete rs api-7d9f --cascade=orphan        # pod'lar qoladi (debug/migratsiya)
kubectl get pod api-7d9f-x -o jsonpath='{.metadata.ownerReferences[*].kind}'
```
```go
controllerutil.SetControllerReference(&app, dep, r.Scheme)  // operator'da
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cross-namespace owner reference ruxsat etilmaydi (namespaced child'ning owner'i boshqa namespace'da bo'lolmaydi) — GC buni noto'g'ri talqin qiladi.
- `blockOwnerDeletion: true` qo'yish uchun owner'ga `update` ruxsati kerak (OwnerReferencesPermissionEnforcement).
- Owner reference — K8s ichidagi obyektlar uchun; tashqi resurslarni (cloud bucket) tozalash uchun finalizer kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Operator'da har yaratilgan child'ga controller reference qo'ying — tozalash bepul bo'ladi va `Owns()` watch'i child o'zgarganda parent'ni reconcile qiladi. Ma'lumot yo'qotish xavfi bor resurslarni (PVC) cascade o'chirishdan ataylab ajrating.

41235.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Headless Service (`clusterIP: None`) uchun CoreDNS virtual IP o'rniga **har pod'ning IP'sini** qaytaradi va har **nomlangan port** uchun `SRV` yozuvlari yaratadi: `_<port-name>._<protocol>.<svc>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local` -> port raqami + pod hostname. Client'lar shu bilan port va a'zolarni DNS orqali topadi.

**Muammo:** StatefulSet ilovalari (Cassandra, Kafka, MongoDB, etcd) har bir a'zoga alohida murojaat qilishi va qaysi portda nima borligini bilishi kerak — load balancing qiluvchi bitta ClusterIP bu uchun yaramaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Service "db" (headless, port name: "client" 27017/TCP), StatefulSet db-0, db-1
A:   db.shop.svc.cluster.local              -> 10.244.1.5, 10.244.2.7
A:   db-0.db.shop.svc.cluster.local         -> 10.244.1.5     (barqaror nom)
SRV: _client._tcp.db.shop.svc.cluster.local -> 0 50 27017 db-0.db.shop.svc.cluster.local
                                               0 50 27017 db-1.db.shop.svc.cluster.local
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: {name: db, namespace: shop}
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector: {app: db}
  ports: [{name: client, port: 27017, protocol: TCP}]
```
```bash
kubectl run -it dns --image=busybox:1.36 --rm -- sh
nslookup -type=srv _client._tcp.db.shop.svc.cluster.local
dig SRV _client._tcp.db.shop.svc.cluster.local +short     # dnsutils image'da
```
MongoDB `mongodb+srv://` connection string'i SRV'dan foydalanadi (lekin TXT yozuvi ham talab qilinadi — K8s DNS uni bermaydi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Port nomlanmagan bo'lsa SRV yozuvi yaratilmaydi.
- Tayyor bo'lmagan pod'lar DNS'da ko'rinmaydi; ular ham kerak bo'lsa (cluster bootstrap) `publishNotReadyAddresses: true`.
- Client'lar DNS natijasini cache qilsa (JVM `networkaddress.cache.ttl`), pod IP o'zgarganda eskisiga uriladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Headless + StatefulSet — barqaror tarmoq identifikatsiyasi (`db-0.db`) uchun asosiy pattern. Klaster tashqarisidagi discovery uchun SRV'ga tayanmang; u ichki mexanizm.

41236.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `sessionAffinity: ClientIP` — Service bir xil **client IP**dan kelgan so'rovlarni `timeoutSeconds` (default 10800 = 3 soat) davomida **bir xil pod**ga yo'naltiradi. kube-proxy (iptables `recent` moduli / IPVS persistence) yoki eBPF data plane darajasida ishlaydi; cookie yoki header'ni bilmaydi.

**Muammo:** Eski ilova sessiyani pod xotirasida saqlaydi — so'rov boshqa pod'ga tushsa foydalanuvchi "logout" bo'ladi. ClientIP affinity tez, ammo qo'pol yechim.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
client 203.0.113.7 --> Service VIP --> kube-proxy jadval: 203.0.113.7 -> pod-b (timeout)
client 203.0.113.7 --> ...          --> yana pod-b
client 198.51.100.2 --> ...         --> pod-a (yangi tanlov)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: {name: legacy-web}
spec:
  selector: {app: legacy-web}
  ports: [{port: 80, targetPort: 8080}]
  sessionAffinity: ClientIP
  sessionAffinityConfig:
    clientIP: {timeoutSeconds: 1800}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Client'lar NAT/proxy ortida bo'lsa (korporativ tarmoq, CDN, `externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster` SNAT) hammasi bitta IP — yuklama bitta pod'ga to'planadi.
- Ingress controller ortida Service affinity'si ma'nosiz: Service'ga ulanuvchi client — ingress pod'i. Sticky session ingress darajasida (cookie) qilinadi.
- Pod o'lsa sessiya baribir yo'qoladi — affinity kafolat emas.

**Senior nuqta:** To'g'ri yechim — stateless ilova va sessiyani tashqi store'da (Redis, DB, JWT) saqlash. Affinity'ni faqat migratsiya davridagi vaqtinchalik choralar sifatida ishlating; HPA scale-out'da yangi pod'lar ham sekin yuklanadi.

41237.a:
**Qisqa javob:**
- `Cluster` (default): NodePort/LoadBalancer trafigini olgan node uni **istalgan node'dagi** pod'ga yuboradi; buning uchun **SNAT** qiladi — client IP yo'qoladi, qo'shimcha hop bo'lishi mumkin, lekin yuklama teng taqsimlanadi.
- `Local`: trafik faqat **shu node'dagi** pod'larga boradi; **client IP saqlanadi**, ortiqcha hop yo'q; pod'i yo'q node'lar LB health check'idan (`healthCheckNodePort`) o'tmaydi va LB ularga yubormaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Cluster:  LB --> node1 (pod yo'q) --SNAT--> node2 pod     (client IP = node1 IP)
Local:    LB --> node2 (pod bor)  ------->  node2 pod     (client IP saqlanadi)
          LB -x  node1 (health check 503: lokal pod yo'q)
```

| | Cluster | Local |
|---|---|---|
| Client IP | yo'qoladi | saqlanadi |
| Hop | +1 bo'lishi mumkin | yo'q |
| Taqsimot | teng (pod bo'yicha) | node bo'yicha (notekis bo'lishi mumkin) |
| Rollout xavfi | past | pod ketayotgan node'ga trafik (drain'ni to'g'ri qilish kerak) |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local
  selector: {app: ingress-nginx}
```
```bash
kubectl get svc ingress -o jsonpath='{.spec.healthCheckNodePort}'
curl -s http://<node-ip>:<healthCheckNodePort>/healthz     # localEndpoints soni
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Node1'da 1 pod, node2'da 5 pod bo'lsa LB node'lar bo'yicha teng bo'lsa node1'dagi pod 5 barobar ko'p yuk oladi — topologySpreadConstraints yoki DaemonSet bilan teng tarqating.
- Pod terminating bo'lganda LB health check yangilanguncha so'rovlar tushishi mumkin — `preStop` delay, yangi versiyalarda terminating endpoint'lar mexanizmi yordam beradi.
- AWS NLB IP target rejimi (pod'ga to'g'ridan) bu muammoni boshqacha hal qiladi — node darajasidagi policy ahamiyati kamayadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ingress/edge proxy uchun ko'pincha `Local` + DaemonSet/teng tarqatish: audit, rate limit va geo uchun haqiqiy client IP kerak. Muqobil — `Cluster` + PROXY protocol yoki `X-Forwarded-For`.

41238.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `spec.trafficDistribution: PreferClose` (K8s 1.31 da beta, 1.33 da GA) — kube-proxy/data plane'ga trafikni iloji bo'lsa **client bilan bir zonadagi** endpoint'larga yuborishni maslahat beradi; zonada sog'lom endpoint bo'lmasa boshqa zonalarga qaytadi. Cross-AZ trafik narxi va latency kamayadi. (Yangi versiyalarda aniqroq `PreferSameZone` / `PreferSameNode` qiymatlari ham qo'shilgan.)

**Muammo:** Cloud'da AZ'lar orasidagi trafik pullik (AWS'da ~$0.01/GB har yo'nalishda). Chatty mikroservislar oyiga minglab dollarni faqat cross-AZ uchun to'laydi, har chaqiruvga ~1ms latency qo'shiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
EndpointSlice controller --> har endpoint'ga hints.forZones (zona belgisi)
kube-proxy (zone=a) --> faqat zone a endpoint'lariga yo'naltiradi
zone a da endpoint yo'q --> barcha endpoint'lar (fallback)
```
Eski mexanizm — `service.kubernetes.io/topology-mode: Auto` annotation (Topology Aware Routing), u endpoint'lar zona bo'yicha proporsional bo'lmasa o'zini o'chirardi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: {name: catalog}
spec:
  selector: {app: catalog}
  ports: [{port: 80, targetPort: 8080}]
  trafficDistribution: PreferClose
```
```bash
kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=catalog -o yaml | grep -A3 hints
```
Pod'larni zonalarga teng tarqatish:
```yaml
topologySpreadConstraints:
- {maxSkew: 1, topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone, whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule, labelSelector: {matchLabels: {app: catalog}}}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Client'lar bir zonada ko'p, pod'lar teng bo'lsa — shu zona pod'lari ortiqcha yuklanadi (PreferClose sig'imni hisobga olmaydi).
- Zona ichidagi barcha pod'lar sog'lom, lekin sekin bo'lsa ham trafik u yerda qoladi.
- Service mesh (Istio locality LB) ham shu ishni qiladi — ikkalasini birga sozlashda xulqni tushuning.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval o'lchang: cross-AZ trafik hajmi (VPC Flow Logs, Kubecost). PreferClose + zonalar bo'yicha teng replika + zonaviy HPA — xarajat va latency'ni kamaytiradi, lekin bitta zonaning ortiqcha yuklanishiga alert qo'ying.

41239.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubernetes IPAM (IP Address Management) — pod va servis IP'larini **ajratish, kuzatish va qaytarish**. Ikki darajada: (1) node'larga **pod CIDR bloklari**ni berish (kube-controller-manager `--allocate-node-cidrs` yoki CNI'ning o'zi), (2) node ichida har pod'ga shu blokdan **bitta IP** berish (CNI IPAM plugin: `host-local`, Calico IPAM, Cilium, AWS VPC CNI).
