```
[https://site] <--probe-- [blackbox_exporter :9115/probe?target=...] <--scrape--
```

**Mashhur exporter'lar:**
| Exporter | Nima uchun |
|---|---|
| `node_exporter` | Linux host: CPU, RAM, disk, tarmoq |
| `postgres_exporter`, `mysqld_exporter` | DB statistikasi |
| `redis_exporter`, `kafka_exporter` | cache/MQ |
| `blackbox_exporter` | tashqi tekshiruv (HTTP, TCP, ICMP, DNS) |
| `kube-state-metrics` | K8s obyekt holati |
| `cAdvisor` (kubelet ichida) | container resurs sarfi |

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run -d -p 9187:9187 \
  -e DATA_SOURCE_NAME="postgresql://exporter:pw@db:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable" \
  quay.io/prometheuscommunity/postgres-exporter
curl -s localhost:9187/metrics | grep pg_up
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Exporter'ga superuser DB huquqi berish — faqat monitoring roli (`pg_monitor`).
- Qimmat custom query'lar har scrape'da DB'ni yuklaydi.
- Exporter o'zi tirik, lekin manbaga ulana olmaydi — `up=1`, lekin `pg_up=0`; ikkalasiga alert kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Exporter'ni iloji boricha manba yonida (sidecar yoki shu host'da) ishlating, uning o'z resurs sarfi va scrape vaqtini (`scrape_duration_seconds`) kuzating. Ko'p zamonaviy tizimlar (etcd, CoreDNS, Envoy) nativ `/metrics` beradi — exporter shart emas.

41658.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ikkalasi ham counter'ning soniyalik o'sish tezligini hisoblaydi va counter reset'larni to'g'rilaydi. `rate()` — oynadagi **barcha** nuqtalar bo'yicha o'rtacha tezlik (silliq, barqaror) — alert, recording rule va SLO uchun. `irate()` — oynadagi faqat **oxirgi ikki** nuqta bo'yicha oniy tezlik (sakrashlarni ko'rsatadi, lekin shovqinli) — tez o'zgaruvchan grafiklar uchun.

**Farq vizual:**
```
counter o'sishi:  qisqa burst 10:00:30 da
rate([5m]):   ____/‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾\____   burst 5 daq davomida "yoyilgan", past cho'qqi
irate([5m]):  ______|\_________     o'tkir cho'qqi, scrape'lar orasiga tushsa ko'rinmay qolishi ham mumkin
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Alert / SLO: barqaror
sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) > 0.01
# Dashboard'da oniy sakrashlar
irate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device="eth0"}[1m])
# Oyna davomida jami o'sish
increase(http_requests_total[1h])
```
Oyna qoidasi: `range >= 4 x scrape_interval` (15s scrape -> kamida `[1m]`). Grafana'da `$__rate_interval` o'zgaruvchisini ishlating — avtomatik to'g'ri oyna.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `irate` bilan alert — `for:` bo'lsa ham flapping qiladi.
- Oyna juda kichik (`[15s]` da 15s scrape) — faqat bitta nuqta, natija bo'sh.
- `sum` ni `rate` dan oldin qo'llash: `rate(sum(...))` — noto'g'ri, reset'lar buziladi; doim avval `rate`, keyin `sum`.
- Dashboard'da zoom out qilinganda `irate` ko'p nuqtalarni tashlab yuboradi (step > oyna).

**Senior nuqta:** Amalda `irate` kamdan-kam kerak; `rate` + mos oyna standart. `increase()` ham ekstrapolyatsiya qiladi, shuning uchun butun bo'lmagan qiymat qaytarishi normal — hisob-kitob (billing) uchun Prometheus ishlatmang.

41659.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `histogram_quantile(0.99, ...)` kumulyativ bucket hisoblagichlaridan (`le`) 99-persentil tushadigan bucket'ni topadi va uning chegaralari orasida **chiziqli interpolatsiya** qilib **taxminiy** p99 qaytaradi. Aniqlik bucket chegaralariga bog'liq; agregatsiya `le` label'ini saqlab qilinishi shart.

**Hisob misoli:** 5 daqiqada 1000 so'rov, bucket'lar (kumulyativ):
```
le="0.1"  -> 900
le="0.25" -> 985
le="0.5"  -> 996     <- 990-chi so'rov (99%) shu bucket ichida
le="1"    -> 1000
p99: 0.25 + (0.5-0.25) * (990-985)/(996-985) = 0.25 + 0.25*0.4545 ~= 0.364 s
```
Haqiqiy p99 0.26 ham, 0.49 ham bo'lishi mumkin edi — natija faqat bucket ichidagi bir tekis taqsimot farazi.

**Amalda:**
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99,
  sum by (le, service) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```
To'g'ri tartib: `rate` -> `sum by (le, ...)` -> `histogram_quantile`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `sum` da `le` ni tashlab yuborish — natija `NaN` yoki bo'sh.
- Oxirgi bucket'dan (`+Inf`) katta qiymat — natija eng katta chekli chegaraga "qisiladi" (masalan doim 5 s).
- Default bucket'lar (`.005 ... 10`) sizning SLO chegarangizga (masalan 300 ms) mos emas — aynan SLO atrofida bucket qo'ying.
- p99'larni servislar bo'yicha o'rtachalash — noto'g'ri; bucket'larni yig'ib keyin quantile.

**Senior nuqta:** SLO uchun quantile emas, **"chegaradan tez bo'lgan so'rovlar ulushi"** ni aniq hisoblang: `rate(..._bucket{le="0.3"}[5m]) / rate(..._count[5m])` — interpolatsiyasiz va aniq. Native histogram'lar xatolikni sezilarli kamaytiradi.

41660.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cardinality — metrika uchun label qiymatlari kombinatsiyalaridan hosil bo'lgan **unikal time series soni**. Har series Prometheus head block'ida xotira (~bir necha KB), indeks yozuvi va disk egallaydi. `user_id`, `order_id`, `email`, to'liq URL path kabi cheksiz qiymatli label'lar series sonini millionlarga chiqarib, xotira tugashiga (OOM), sekin so'rovlarga va restart'da uzoq WAL replay'ga olib keladi.

**Hisob:**
```
http_requests_total{method, code, route}
   5 method x 10 code x 50 route         = 2 500 series   (OK)
 + user_id (1 000 000 user)              = 2.5 mlrd series (o'lim)
 x pod (har deploy'da yangi pod nomlari)  -> "churn" ham o'sadi
```

**Amalda — aniqlash:**
```promql
topk(10, count by (__name__) ({__name__=~".+"}))      # eng ko'p series'li metrikalar
count by (route) (http_requests_total)                # label qiymatlari soni
prometheus_tsdb_head_series                            # jami faol series
```
```bash
promtool tsdb analyze /prometheus      # label cardinality hisobotи
```
UI: Status -> TSDB Status.

**Himoya:**
```yaml
metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__name__]
    regex: "http_request_duration_seconds_bucket"
    action: keep
  - regex: "user_id|session_id"
    action: labeldrop
sample_limit: 50000          # scrape_config darajasida
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Route o'rniga xom path (`/users/123`) — har ID yangi series; template'ni ishlating (`/users/{id}`).
- Histogram x ko'p label — bucket'lar soniga ko'payadi (12 bucket = 12 barobar).
- Xato xabarini label qilish (`error="timeout after 3021ms"`).

**Senior nuqta:** Qoida: label qiymatlari chegaralangan va kichik bo'lsin; individual identifikatorlar log, trace va exemplar'larga tegishli. Platforma darajasida `sample_limit`, `label_limit` va har team uchun series kvotasi qo'ying (Mimir'da tenant limitlari).

41661.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Exemplar — metrika sample'iga biriktirilgan namunaviy hodisa havolasi, odatda `trace_id` (va qiymat, vaqt). Histogram bucket'iga "shu bucket'ga tushgan aniq bir so'rov — mana bu trace" degan ma'lumot qo'shadi. Grafana'da latency grafigidagi nuqtani bosib, aynan shu sekin so'rov trace'ini Tempo/Jaeger'da ochasiz.

**Nega kerak:** Metrika "p99 = 2.4 s" deydi, lekin qaysi so'rov? Exemplar'siz trace'lar orasidan qidirish kerak; exemplar bilan bir bosish.

```
p99 grafik  .  .  .  *(exemplar: trace_id=4bf92f...)  .  .
                      |
                      v  bosish
              Tempo: checkout -> payment -> db.query 2.1s
```

**Amalda:**
Go'da yozish:
```go
hist.(prometheus.ExemplarObserver).ObserveWithExemplar(
    dur.Seconds(), prometheus.Labels{"trace_id": span.SpanContext().TraceID().String()})
```
Prometheus'ni yoqish va OpenMetrics formatda scrape:
```bash
prometheus --enable-feature=exemplar-storage
```
`/metrics` chiqishi (OpenMetrics):
```
http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="2.5"} 120 # {trace_id="4bf92f3577b34da6"} 2.31 1727950000.000
```
Grafana: Prometheus data source -> Exemplars -> `trace_id` -> Tempo data source; panelda "Exemplars" ni yoqish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Scrape OpenMetrics formatida bo'lmasa exemplar'lar tashlanadi.
- Exemplar havola qilgan trace sampling'da tashlangan — bosganda "trace topilmadi"; tail sampling yoki sampled trace'larnigina exemplar qilish.
- Exemplar storage xotirada cheklangan (`max_exemplars`) — uzoq tarix yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Exemplar — yuqori cardinality'li identifikatorni (trace_id) metrikaga label qilmasdan bog'lashning to'g'ri yo'li. OTel SDK'lar sampled span konteksti bo'lsa exemplar'ni avtomatik qo'shadi.

41662.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana — ochiq kodli vizualizatsiya va observability platformasi: ko'plab data source'larga (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Elasticsearch, CloudWatch, PostgreSQL...) ulanib, dashboard'lar, ad-hoc tahlil (Explore), alerting va signallar orasida bog'langan navigatsiyani (metrika -> trace -> log -> profil) bir UI'da beradi. U ma'lumot saqlamaydi — so'rovni manbaga yuboradi.

**LGTM stack'dagi o'rni:**
```
            +------------- Grafana (UI, alerting, korrelyatsiya) -------------+
            |                |                 |                  |
         Mimir/Prom        Loki             Tempo             Pyroscope
         (Metrics)         (Logs)           (Traces)          (Profiles)
            ^                ^                 ^                  ^
            +--------- Alloy / OTel Collector (yig'ish) ----------+
```

**Amalda:**
- Explore: dashboard'siz ad-hoc PromQL/LogQL/TraceQL, split view'da metrika va log yonma-yon.
- Dashboard'lar: variables (`$namespace`), `$__rate_interval`, annotation'lar (deploy vaqtlari).
- Provisioning (kod sifatida):
```yaml
# /etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources/prom.yaml
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: Prometheus
    type: prometheus
    url: http://prometheus:9090
    jsonData:
      exemplarTraceIdDestinations: [{ name: trace_id, datasourceUid: tempo }]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- UI'da qo'lda yasalgan dashboard'lar — versiyasiz, yo'qoladi, drift; provisioning yoki dashboard-as-code.
- Og'ir panellar (uzoq oyna, recording rule'siz) — har ochilishda Prometheus'ni yuklaydi.
- 50 panelli "hamma narsa" dashboard — incident'da hech narsa topilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Dashboard ierarxiyasini qur: yuqori darajada SLO/RED overview, undan drill-down servis va infra dashboard'lariga. Grafana — "yagona oyna", lekin signallarning sifati instrumentatsiyaga bog'liq; Grafana'ni HA (tashqi DB, bir nechta replika) bilan ishga tushiring, chunki incident paytida u ham kritik.

41663.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Alertmanager — Prometheus (yoki Mimir/Loki ruler) yuborgan alert'larni qabul qilib, ularni **dedup** qiladi, **group**laydi, **route** bo'yicha kerakli **receiver**ga (Slack, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, email, webhook) yuboradi, **inhibition** va **silence** bilan keraksizlarini o'chiradi va qayta eslatish (`repeat_interval`) ni boshqaradi. Prometheus faqat "alert firing" deydi; xabarnoma mantiqi Alertmanager'da.

**Oqim:**
```
Prometheus HA (x2) --alerts--> Alertmanager klaster (gossip)
                                  |
                       dedup (fingerprint) -> inhibit -> silence
                                  |
                          route tree (label'lar)
                         /            |          \
                 PagerDuty       Slack #alerts   webhook
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
route:
  receiver: slack-default
  group_by: [alertname, cluster, service]
  group_wait: 30s        # birinchi xabardan oldin guruh yig'ilishini kutish
  group_interval: 5m     # guruhga yangi alert qo'shilsa
  repeat_interval: 4h    # hal bo'lmasa qayta eslatish
  routes:
    - matchers: [severity="critical"]
      receiver: pagerduty
receivers:
  - name: pagerduty
    pagerduty_configs: [{ routing_key: <secret> }]
  - name: slack-default
    slack_configs: [{ channel: "#alerts", send_resolved: true }]
```
```bash
amtool check-config alertmanager.yml
amtool alert query
amtool config routes test severity=critical service=api
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Alertmanager'ni bitta nusxada ishlatish — u yiqilsa hech kim bilmaydi (klaster + Watchdog).
- `group_by` juda tor — bir hodisa 200 ta alohida xabar.
- Secret'larni (webhook URL, routing key) konfigda ochiq saqlash.

**Senior nuqta:** Alertmanager — shovqin boshqaruvining markazi: har page actionable va runbook havolasi bilan bo'lsin, qolgani ticket/Slack. Alert'lar sonini va "ack qilinmasdan yopilgan"larni hafta sayin ko'rib chiqish — alert fatigue'ga qarshi asosiy jarayon.

41664.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Grouping** — bir xil `group_by` label qiymatlariga ega alert'larni bitta xabarnomaga jamlaydi (node yiqildi — 50 ta pod alert'i bitta xabar). **Inhibition** — "manba" alert faol bo'lganda unga bog'liq "nishon" alert'larni o'chiradi (`NodeDown` firing bo'lsa, o'sha node'dagi `PodNotReady` xabar bermaydi), chunki ular bir sababning oqibati.

**Grouping vizual:**
```
group_by: [alertname, cluster]
 KubePodCrashLooping{pod=a, cluster=prod}  \
 KubePodCrashLooping{pod=b, cluster=prod}   >--> 1 ta xabar: "3 alerts: KubePodCrashLooping prod"
 KubePodCrashLooping{pod=c, cluster=prod}  /
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
route:
  group_by: [alertname, cluster, namespace]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m

inhibit_rules:
  - source_matchers: [alertname="NodeDown"]
    target_matchers: [severity=~"warning|critical"]
    equal: [node]                # faqat AYNAN o'sha node'dagilar
  - source_matchers: [severity="critical"]
    target_matchers: [severity="warning"]
    equal: [alertname, service]  # critical bor bo'lsa shu servis warning'i jim
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `equal` ni yozmaslik — bitta node yiqilsa butun klasterdagi alert'lar o'chadi; haqiqiy muammo yashirinadi.
- Manba alert'ning o'zi xabar bermaydigan route'da bo'lsa — hamma jim.
- `group_by: ['...']` (maxsus "hamma label") — amalda grouping'ni o'chiradi.
- Juda uzun `group_wait` — kritik page kechikadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Inhibition — sabab-oqibat bog'lanishini kodlash; uni ehtiyotkorlik bilan, test qilib (`amtool`) qo'ying. Yaxshiroq asos — symptom-based alerting (SLO): u holda kaskad alert'lar kamroq bo'ladi va inhibition qoidalari soni kichik qoladi.

41665.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Elasticsearch** har log qatorining to'liq matnini inverted index'da indekslaydi — ixtiyoriy so'z bo'yicha qidiruv juda tez, lekin ingest CPU, RAM va storage qimmat. **Loki** faqat **label'lar**ni (`app`, `namespace`, `level`) indekslaydi, log matnini siqilgan chunk'larda arzon object storage'da (S3, GCS) saqlaydi; so'rovda avval label'lar bilan stream'larni toraytirib, keyin matnni brute-force (parallel) skanerlaydi.

```
Elasticsearch:  "error timeout user=42" -> [error] [timeout] [user] [42] -> inverted index
Loki:           {app="api", env="prod"} -> index (kichik)
                "error timeout user=42" -> siqilgan chunk -> S3
```

| | Elasticsearch / OpenSearch | Loki |
|---|---|---|
| Indeks | to'liq matn | faqat label'lar |
| Narx | yuqori (index 1-2x ma'lumot hajmi) | past (S3 + kichik index) |
| Ixtiyoriy matn qidiruv | juda tez | label'lar bilan toraytirilsa yaxshi, aks holda sekin |
| Analitika / agregatsiya | kuchli | LogQL metrikalari, cheklanganroq |
| Ops murakkabligi | shard, heap, mapping | object storage, kamroq tuning |

**Amalda (LogQL):**
```logql
{namespace="prod", app="api"} |= "timeout" | json | status >= 500
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Loki'da yuqori cardinality'li label (`user_id`, `trace_id`) — stream'lar portlaydi, ingest buziladi. Ular log ichida qolsin (yoki structured metadata).
- Loki'da label'siz keng so'rov (`{env="prod"} |= "x"` 30 kun) — terabaytlarni skanerlaydi.
- Elasticsearch'da dynamic mapping portlashi va heap muammolari.

**Senior nuqta:** Tanlov ish yukiga bog'liq: debug va operatsion log'lar (asosan "shu servisning shu vaqtdagi log'i") — Loki arzon va yetarli; xavfsizlik analitikasi, ixtiyoriy matn qidiruv, murakkab agregatsiya (SIEM) — Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. Ko'p kompaniyalar ikkalasini turli maqsadda ishlatadi.

41666.a:
**Qisqa javob:** LogQL — Loki'ning so'rov tili, PromQL'dan ilhomlangan. Ikki turi bor: **log query** — stream selector (`{label="..."}`) + pipeline (filtr, parser, formatlash) bilan log qatorlarini qaytaradi; **metric query** — log'larni `rate`, `count_over_time`, `sum_over_time` kabi funksiyalar bilan time series'ga aylantiradi (dashboard va alert uchun).

**Pipeline tartibi:**
```
{app="payment", env="prod"}      <- stream selector (indeks, majburiy)
  |= "failed"                    <- line filter (tez, chunk skanerlash)
  != "healthcheck"
  | json                         <- parser (logfmt, regexp, pattern ham bor)
  | status_code >= 500           <- label filter (parse qilingan maydon)
  | line_format "{{.user}} {{.msg}}"
```

**Amalda:**
```logql
# Log'lar
{app="payment"} |= "timeout" | json | duration_ms > 2000

# Regex filter
{app="nginx"} |~ "HTTP/1.1\" 5\\d\\d"

# Metrika: soniyalik xato soni region bo'yicha
sum by (region) (rate({app="payment"} |= "ERROR" [5m]))

# Xatolar ulushi
sum(count_over_time({app="api"} | json | level="error" [5m]))
  / sum(count_over_time({app="api"} [5m]))
```
Alert (Loki ruler):
```yaml
- alert: PaymentErrorsHigh
  expr: sum(rate({app="payment"} |= "ERROR" [5m])) > 10
  for: 5m
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Line filter'ni parser'dan keyin qo'yish — har qatorni behuda parse qiladi; avval `|=`, keyin `| json`.
- Selector juda keng — butun klaster log'ini skanerlash.
- `| json` parse qilingan maydonlarni `by (...)` agregatsiyada ishlatish — yuqori cardinality.

**Senior nuqta:** Tez-tez ishlatiladigan log metrikalarini recording rule qiling yoki, yaxshiroq, ilovada to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Prometheus metrikasi chiqaring — log'dan metrika hisoblash har doim qimmatroq.

41667.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana Tempo — distributed tracing backend: span'larni qabul qiladi (OTLP, Jaeger, Zipkin) va ularni **indekssiz** (faqat trace_id bo'yicha) arzon object storage'da (S3, GCS, Azure Blob) saqlaydi. Trace'ga asosan metrika exemplar'i yoki log'dagi `trace_id` orqali o'tiladi; TraceQL bilan atributlar bo'yicha qidirish ham mumkin.

**Nega:** Jaeger + Elasticsearch/Cassandra'da har span indekslanadi — katta hajmda qimmat. Tempo "trace_id bo'yicha topish + qolganini boshqa signallar orqali" yondashuvi bilan 100% trace saqlashni arzonlashtiradi.

```
apps --OTLP--> [Alloy/OTel Collector] --> distributor -> ingester -> S3 (Parquet bloklar)
                                                                        ^
Grafana: exemplar / log trace_id / TraceQL --> query-frontend -> querier
metrics-generator -> span'lardan RED metrikalar + service graph -> Prometheus/Mimir
```

**Amalda (TraceQL):**
```traceql
{ resource.service.name = "checkout" && duration > 2s }
{ span.http.response.status_code >= 500 } >> { span.db.system = "postgresql" }
{ status = error } | count() > 3
```
Grafana'da: Explore -> Tempo -> trace_id yoki TraceQL; trace view'dan "Logs for this span" (Loki) va "Profiles" (Pyroscope).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Trace'lar sampled bo'lsa (head 1%) exemplar havolasi bo'sh trace'ga olib boradi.
- `service.name` resource atributi yo'q — trace'lar "unknown_service" ostida.
- Retention'ni sozlamaslik — object storage cheksiz o'sadi (compactor `block_retention`).

**Senior nuqta:** metrics-generator orqali span'lardan RED metrikalarini va servis grafini avtomatik olish mumkin — instrumentatsiya qilinmagan servislarga ham tez ko'rinish beradi, lekin metrika cardinality'sini (span nomlari) nazorat qiling.

41668.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ikkalasi ham Prometheus'ni uzoq muddatli, global va HA qiladi, ma'lumotni object storage'da saqlaydi. **Thanos** — mavjud Prometheus'lar yoniga **sidecar** qo'shadi: 2 soatlik TSDB block'larni S3'ga yuklaydi, Querier ko'p Prometheus + S3 ustidan global so'rov va dedup qiladi (alternativ: Receive komponenti remote_write qabul qiladi). **Mimir** (Grafana Labs, Cortex vorisi) — **remote_write** qabul qiladigan, gorizontal scale qiladigan, multi-tenant markaziy TSDB servisi.

**Arxitektura farqi:**
```
Thanos (sidecar model):
 [Prom+sidecar] [Prom+sidecar] --block'lar--> S3 <-- Store Gateway
        ^              ^                               |
        +---- Thanos Querier (fan-out + dedup) --------+

Mimir (push model):
 [Prom/Alloy agent] --remote_write--> distributor -> ingester (replication 3) -> S3
                                      query-frontend -> querier -> store-gateway
```

| | Thanos | Mimir |
|---|---|---|
| Yozish | sidecar (pull saqlanadi) yoki Receive | remote_write |
| Multi-tenancy | cheklangan | nativ (tenant limitlari) |
| Lokal Prometheus | to'liq ishlashda davom etadi | agent mode yetarli |
| So'nggi ma'lumot | so'rov Prometheus'larga ham boradi | ingester'larda |
| Murakkablik | bosqichma-bosqich qo'shish oson | ko'p mikroservis (yoki monolithic mode) |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Thanos'da HA Prometheus juftligida `replica` external label'ni sozlamaslik — dedup ishlamaydi, qiymatlar ikki baravar.
- Compactor'ni ikki nusxada ishlatish (Thanos) — block'lar buziladi.
- Mimir'da tenant limitlarini default qoldirish — katta team series limitiga uriladi va ma'lumot tashlanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Bir nechta mustaqil klaster va mavjud Prometheus'lar bo'lsa Thanos tabiiy kengaytma; ko'p tenant'li markaziy platforma (yuzlab team) uchun Mimir. Ikkalasida ham downsampling/retention va so'rov limitlari (query-frontend, cache) narx va barqarorlikni belgilaydi. VictoriaMetrics — uchinchi kuchli alternativa.

41669.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OpenTelemetry (OTel) — CNCF loyihasi: telemetriya (trace, metrika, log, eksperimental profil) yaratish va uzatish uchun **vendor-neytral standart**: API (instrumentatsiya interfeysi), tillar bo'yicha SDK'lar, auto-instrumentation, OTLP protokoli, semantic conventions va Collector. U backend emas — ma'lumotni saqlamaydi, istalgan backend'ga (Prometheus, Tempo, Jaeger, Datadog, Honeycomb) yuboradi.

**Nega kerak:** Ilgari har vendor o'z agent'i va SDK'si — vendor almashtirish = butun kodni qayta instrumentatsiya qilish. OTel bilan bir marta instrumentatsiya qilasiz, backend'ni konfig bilan almashtirasiz. OpenTracing va OpenCensus OTel'ga birlashgan.

```
[App + OTel SDK] --OTLP--> [OTel Collector] --> Tempo / Jaeger      (traces)
[auto-instr agent]                          --> Prometheus / Mimir  (metrics)
                                            --> Loki / Elastic      (logs)
                                            --> Datadog (vendor)
```

**Amalda (Go, qisqa):**
```go
exp, _ := otlptracegrpc.New(ctx)   // OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT dan o'qiydi
tp := sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(sdktrace.WithBatcher(exp),
    sdktrace.WithResource(resource.NewWithAttributes(semconv.SchemaURL,
        semconv.ServiceName("checkout"))))
otel.SetTracerProvider(tp)
ctx, span := otel.Tracer("checkout").Start(ctx, "charge")
defer span.End()
```
Muhit o'zgaruvchilari: `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Signallar barqarorligi turlicha: trace va metrika stable, log ko'p tillarda yangi, profil hali rivojlanmoqda.
- SDK'dan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri vendor'ga yuborish — Collector'siz retry, batching, PII filtr yo'q.
- `service.name` ni bermaslik — hamma narsa `unknown_service`.

**Senior nuqta:** OTel'ni standart instrumentatsiya qatlami deb qabul qilish vendor lock-in'ni kamaytiradi, lekin migratsiya bepul emas: semantic conventions versiyalari o'zgarib turadi (masalan `http.method` -> `http.request.method`), dashboard'larni shunga moslash kerak.

41670.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OTel Collector — telemetriyani qabul qilib, qayta ishlab, yuboradigan alohida process. U **pipeline**lardan iborat (har signal uchun: traces, metrics, logs): **receiver** — ma'lumotni qabul qiladi (OTLP, Prometheus scrape, Jaeger, filelog, kafka); **processor** — o'zgartiradi (memory_limiter, batch, attributes/PII olib tashlash, k8sattributes, tail_sampling, filter); **exporter** — backend'larga yuboradi (otlp, prometheusremotewrite, loki, kafka, vendor). Qo'shimcha: **extension** (health_check, pprof) va **connector** (bir pipeline chiqishini boshqasiga kirish qiladi, masalan spanmetrics).

```
receivers        processors (tartib muhim!)                 exporters
[otlp]   --+--> memory_limiter -> k8sattributes -> batch --+--> otlp/tempo
[prometheus]                                                +--> prometheusremotewrite
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols: { grpc: { endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317 }, http: { endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318 } }
processors:
  memory_limiter: { check_interval: 1s, limit_percentage: 80, spike_limit_percentage: 20 }
  attributes/pii:
    actions: [{ key: user.email, action: delete }]
  batch: { send_batch_size: 8192, timeout: 5s }
exporters:
  otlp/tempo: { endpoint: tempo:4317, tls: { insecure: true } }
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, attributes/pii, batch]
      exporters: [otlp/tempo]
```
Deploy shakllari: **agent** (har node'da DaemonSet, lokal yig'ish) + **gateway** (markaziy Deployment: tail sampling, eksport).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Komponentni e'lon qilib `service.pipelines` ga qo'shmaslik — u ishlamaydi.
- `memory_limiter` birinchi emas yoki `batch` yo'q — OOM yoki samarasiz eksport.
- Core distributiv'da kerakli komponent yo'q — `contrib` yoki o'z build'ingiz (`ocb`).
- Collector'ning o'z metrikalarini (`otelcol_exporter_send_failed_*`, queue size) kuzatmaslik.

**Senior nuqta:** Collector — telemetriya uchun "policy enforcement" nuqtasi: PII tozalash, sampling, routing va vendor almashtirish kodga tegmasdan shu yerda. Uni ham prod servis kabi resurs limitlari, HA va monitoring bilan ishlating.

41671.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Trace** — bitta request (yoki operatsiya)ning butun tizim bo'ylab to'liq yo'li; barcha span'lari bitta `trace_id` ga ega. **Span** — trace ichidagi bitta ish birligi (HTTP handler, DB so'rov, Kafka publish): nomi, boshlanish/tugash vaqti, `span_id`, ota span (`parent_span_id`), atributlar, event'lar, status va kind (SERVER, CLIENT, PRODUCER, CONSUMER, INTERNAL).

**Tuzilma:**
```
trace_id = 4bf92f...
[GET /checkout          SERVER  0 ms ---------------------------- 820 ms]  (root span)
   [auth.verify         CLIENT  5 ---- 40]
   [payment.charge      CLIENT       45 ------------------- 700]
        [POST /charge   SERVER       50 ----------------- 690]   (payment servisida)
             [SELECT orders  CLIENT   60 -------------- 650]     <- asosiy vaqt shu yerda
   [kafka.publish       PRODUCER                          705 -- 720]
```
Span'lar daraxtni ota-bola bog'lanishi orqali hosil qiladi; servislar orasida kontekst `traceparent` header bilan uzatiladi.

**Amalda (Go):**
```go
ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, "payment.charge",
    trace.WithSpanKind(trace.SpanKindClient),
    trace.WithAttributes(attribute.String("payment.provider", "stripe")))
defer span.End()
if err != nil {
    span.RecordError(err)
    span.SetStatus(codes.Error, "charge failed")
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ctx` ni keyingi chaqiruvlarga uzatmaslik — bola span'lar yangi, bog'lanmagan trace'lar bo'lib ketadi.
- `span.End()` ni unutish — span hech qachon eksport qilinmaydi.
- Har kichik funksiyaga span — trace o'qib bo'lmaydigan va qimmat bo'ladi; tarmoq/IO chegaralari va muhim biznes bosqichlariga qo'ying.
- Span nomida yuqori cardinality (`GET /users/123`) — nom route template bo'lsin.

**Senior nuqta:** Async oqimlarda (navbat, batch) bitta trace sun'iy cho'ziladi — u yerda **span link**'lar ishlatiladi (consumer span producer kontekstiga link). Trace'ning qiymati — servislar orasidagi kritik yo'l va kutish vaqtini ko'rsatishida.

41672.a:
**Qisqa javob:** W3C Trace Context — trace kontekstini servislar orasida HTTP header'larda uzatish uchun W3C standarti. `traceparent` — majburiy: versiya, 16-baytli `trace-id`, 8-baytli `parent-id` (chaqiruvchi span), flag'lar (`01` = sampled). `tracestate` — ixtiyoriy, vendorlarga xos key=value ro'yxati. Standartgacha har vendor o'z header'ini (`X-B3-TraceId`, `uber-trace-id`) ishlatgan — turli tool'lar orasida trace uzilardi.

**Format:**
```
traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01
             |  |                                |                |
          versiya     trace-id (32 hex)         parent-id (16 hex)  flags (01=sampled)
tracestate:  congo=t61rcWkgMzE,rojo=00f067aa0ba902b7
```

**Oqim:**
```
Service A (span X)  --HTTP traceparent: 00-<T>-<X>-01-->  Service B
                                                          yangi span Y, parent = X, trace = T
```

**Amalda:**
```go
otel.SetTextMapPropagator(propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(
    propagation.TraceContext{}, propagation.Baggage{}))
client := http.Client{Transport: otelhttp.NewTransport(http.DefaultTransport)} // inject
handler := otelhttp.NewHandler(mux, "server")                                   // extract
```
```bash
curl -H 'traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01' https://api/x
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Proxy/gateway (eski nginx, API gateway) header'ni tashlab yuboradi — trace ikkiga bo'linadi.
- Turli servislarda turli propagator (B3 va W3C) — konfigda ikkalasini composite qiling migratsiya paytida.
- Tashqi (ishonchsiz) client'dan kelgan `traceparent` ga ko'r-ko'rona ishonish — sampling qarorini tashqaridan boshqarishga yo'l beradi; chekkada (edge) yangi trace boshlash yoki siyosat.

**Senior nuqta:** Message queue'larda ham kontekstni xabar header'iga (Kafka record headers) qo'ying — aks holda async yo'l trace'dan tushib qoladi. W3C Trace Context Level 2 `random` flag'ini qo'shgan (trace-id tasodifiyligini bildiradi).

41673.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Head-based** sampling — qaror trace **boshida** (birinchi span'da) qabul qilinadi va `traceparent` flag'i orqali hamma servislarga uzatiladi (masalan 5% tasodifiy). Arzon va oddiy, lekin qaysi trace xato yoki sekin bo'lishini oldindan bilmaydi. **Tail-based** sampling — Collector butun trace span'larini yig'ib, trace **tugagandan keyin** qaror qiladi: barcha xatoli va sekinlarni 100%, normal'larning kichik qismini saqlaydi.

```
Head:  request kelishi -> tanga tashlash (5%) -> sampled=1/0 butun zanjirga
       + arzon, past overhead
       - kamyob xatolarning 95% i yo'qoladi

Tail:  hamma span -> [Collector buffer: decision_wait 10s] -> siyosat:
                      status=ERROR -> saqla
                      duration>2s  -> saqla
                      qolgani      -> 5% saqla
       + qiziqarli trace'lar saqlanadi
       - xotira, bitta trace'ning barcha span'lari BITTA collector'ga kelishi shart
```

**Amalda (Collector gateway):**
```yaml
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    decision_wait: 10s
    num_traces: 100000
    policies:
      - { name: errors, type: status_code, status_code: { status_codes: [ERROR] } }
      - { name: slow,   type: latency,     latency: { threshold_ms: 2000 } }
      - { name: rest,   type: probabilistic, probabilistic: { sampling_percentage: 5 } }
```
Agent qatlami trace_id bo'yicha yo'naltiradi:
```yaml
exporters:
  loadbalancing:
    routing_key: traceID
    resolver: { k8s: { service: otel-gateway-headless } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Loadbalancing exporter'siz bir nechta gateway — trace span'lari bo'linadi, qaror noto'g'ri.
- `decision_wait` dan uzoq davom etadigan trace'lar — kech span'lar alohida qarorga tushadi.
- Head sampling 5% + tail — tail faqat head o'tkazgan 5% ichidan tanlaydi.
- Sampled ma'lumotdan hisoblangan RED metrikalar noto'g'ri — metrikani sampling'dan oldin hisoblang (spanmetrics connector).

**Senior nuqta:** Odatiy kompromiss: SDK'da `parentbased_always_on` (hamma narsa Collector'ga), gateway'da tail sampling. Hajm juda katta bo'lsa — head sampling'ni yuqori darajada qoldirib, xatolar uchun log/metrika exemplar'lariga tayanish.

41674.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Continuous profiling — prod'da doimiy, past overhead (~1-3%) bilan CPU, xotira allokatsiyasi, lock/mutex contention va goroutine stack'larini yig'ib, vaqt bo'yicha saqlash va **flame graph** sifatida ko'rsatish. **Pyroscope** (Grafana) va **Parca** — shu ishni qiluvchi ochiq tool'lar; yig'ish SDK orqali (Go pprof, Java async-profiler) yoki **eBPF** agent orqali (kodga tegmasdan, butun node'dagi process'lar).

**Nega kerak:** Metrika "CPU 80%", trace "shu span 900 ms" deydi, lekin **qaysi funksiya** vaqtni yeyapti? Profil kod qatorigacha javob beradi. Muammo qayta paydo bo'lmaydigan bo'lsa ham o'tmishdagi profil tayyor.

```
Flame graph (kenglik = CPU ulushi):
[------------------------------ main ------------------------------]
[------------ handleCheckout ------------][----- gc / runtime -----]
[--- json.Marshal ---][--- db.Query ---]
[reflect.Value ...]                        <- kutilmagan "issiq" joy
```

**Amalda:**
```go
pyroscope.Start(pyroscope.Config{
    ApplicationName: "checkout",
    ServerAddress:   "http://pyroscope:4040",
    ProfileTypes: []pyroscope.ProfileType{pyroscope.ProfileCPU,
        pyroscope.ProfileAllocSpace, pyroscope.ProfileMutexDuration},
})
```
Yoki Alloy'ning `pyroscope.ebpf` komponenti DaemonSet sifatida. Grafana'da: Explore -> Profiles; "diff" rejimi bilan deploy oldi va keyingi profilni solishtirish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- eBPF profil'da symbol'siz (stripped) binary yoki JIT tillar — funksiya nomlari o'rniga adreslar.
- Faqat CPU profil — xotira/GC muammolari va lock kutishlar ko'rinmaydi.
- Profillarni label'larsiz (versiya, pod) yig'ish — regressiyani deploy bilan bog'lab bo'lmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng katta qiymat — deploy'lar orasidagi diff va trace-to-profile bog'lanish (span ID bo'yicha profil). Cloud xarajatini kamaytirishda (CPU optimallashtirish) continuous profiling ko'pincha o'zini tez oqlaydi. OTel'da profiles signali standartlashtirilmoqda.

41675.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Hubble — Cilium CNI ustidagi tarmoq observability qatlami. eBPF orqali kernel'da har tarmoq oqimini (flow) ko'radi va ilova kodiga tegmasdan beradi: servislararo bog'liqlik xaritasi, L3/L4 flow'lar (kim kimga, qaysi port, forwarded/dropped va sababi), L7 ma'lumot (HTTP metod/status/latency, DNS so'rovlari, Kafka) va Prometheus metrikalari.

**Nega kerak:** "Pod A pod B ga ulana olmayapti" — NetworkPolicy blokladimi, DNS xatomi, yoki B o'zi javob bermayaptimi? Hubble drop sababini aniq ko'rsatadi (`POLICY_DENIED`).

```
Pod A --> [eBPF (Cilium datapath)] --> Pod B
                 |
          Hubble (har node) -> Hubble Relay (klaster) -> CLI / Hubble UI / Prometheus
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
cilium hubble enable --ui
hubble observe --namespace prod --verdict DROPPED
hubble observe --from-pod prod/frontend --to-pod prod/api --protocol http
hubble observe --type l7 --http-status 500
hubble observe --protocol dns --namespace prod     # DNS xatolari (NXDOMAIN)
```
Chiqish:
```
prod/frontend-7c9 -> prod/api-5d8:8080 policy-verdict:none DENIED (TCP Flags: SYN)
   drop reason: POLICY_DENIED
```
Hubble UI — servis grafi (service map); metrikalar `hubble_flows_processed_total`, `hubble_drop_total`, `hubble_http_requests_total`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- L7 ko'rinish faqat shu trafik uchun L7 policy/proxy yoqilganda (Envoy orqali) — default faqat L3/L4.
- TLS shifrlangan trafikning L7 tafsilotlari ko'rinmaydi.
- Metrika label'larida pod nomlari — cardinality katta klasterlarda o'sadi; context'ni (`workload`) sozlang.
- Flow buffer kichik — eski oqimlar tez yo'qoladi; uzoq saqlash uchun eksport kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Hubble NetworkPolicy'ni xavfsiz joriy qilishda bebaho: avval audit rejimida qaysi oqimlar bloklanishini ko'rasiz, keyin enforce. Ilova instrumentatsiyasini almashtirmaydi, lekin instrumentatsiya qilinmagan (legacy, uchinchi tomon) servislarga darhol ko'rinish beradi.

41676.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SLO alerting'da xato **ulushi** emas, **error budget'ning yonish tezligi** (burn rate) kuzatiladi: burn rate 1 = budget aynan SLO davri (30 kun) oxirida tugaydi; 14.4 = 30 kunlik budget'ning 2% i 1 soatda yonadi (budget ~2 kunda tugaydi). **Multi-window**: alert faqat uzun oyna (1h) VA qisqa oyna (5m) ikkalasida chegara oshsa yonadi — uzun oyna shovqinni yo'qotadi, qisqa oyna muammo tugaganda alert tez o'chishini ta'minlaydi. **Multi-burn-rate**: tez yonish -> page, sekin yonish -> ticket.

**Google SRE Workbook jadvali (SLO 99.9%, 30 kun):**
| Burn rate | Uzun oyna | Qisqa oyna | Budget sarfi | Harakat |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14.4 | 1h | 5m | 2% | page |
| 6 | 6h | 30m | 5% | page |
| 1 | 3d | 6h | 10% | ticket |

Hisob: `14.4 x (1 - 0.999) = 0.0144` -> xato ulushi 1.44% dan oshsa.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# recording rule
- record: slo:error_ratio:rate1h
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",code=~"5.."}[1h])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api"}[1h]))
# (rate5m, rate6h, rate30m ham xuddi shunday)
- alert: ApiErrorBudgetFastBurn
  expr: slo:error_ratio:rate1h > (14.4 * 0.001) and slo:error_ratio:rate5m > (14.4 * 0.001)
  for: 2m
  labels: { severity: critical }
```
Bunday qoidalarni qo'lda yozmaslik uchun generator'lar: **Sloth**, **Pyrra**, OpenSLO.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Oddiy "xato > 1% 5 daqiqa" alert — kechasi kichik spike'larda page, sekin oqishni esa hech qachon ushlamaydi.
- Kam trafikli servis: 10 so'rovdan 1 xato = 10% — soxta page; minimal trafik shartini qo'shing yoki sintetik trafik.
- Faqat bitta oyna — muammo tugagandan keyin ham alert soatlab yonib turadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Burn-rate alerting "foydalanuvchiga ta'sir" va "budget"ni bog'laydi: page faqat SLO xavf ostida bo'lganda keladi. SLO'ning o'zi (99.9 yoki 99.95) biznes bilan kelishilgan bo'lsin — aks holda texnik jihatdan to'g'ri alert'lar ham noto'g'ri narsani himoya qiladi.

41677.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **WAL** (Write-Ahead Log) — Prometheus kelgan sample'larni xotiradagi head block'ga qo'shishdan oldin diskdagi `wal/` papkasiga ketma-ket yozadi; crash/restart'dan keyin WAL qayta o'qilib (replay) xotiradagi ma'lumot tiklanadi. **Remote write** — Prometheus WAL'ni "tail" qilib, sample'larni snappy-siqilgan protobuf'da HTTP orqali tashqi storage'ga (Mimir, Thanos Receive, VictoriaMetrics, Cortex) stream qiladi; har endpoint uchun shard'lar va navbat bilan.

```
scrape -> WAL (disk) -> head block (RAM) -> 2h block (disk)
            |
            +--> remote_write reader -> queue (shards) -> HTTP POST -> Mimir
                     endpoint ishlamasa: retry/backoff, WAL'da (~2 soatgacha) kutadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: https://mimir.example.com/api/v1/push
    headers: { X-Scope-OrgID: team-a }
    queue_config:
      capacity: 10000
      max_shards: 50
      max_samples_per_send: 2000
    write_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        regex: "go_gc_.*"
        action: drop       # keraksizini yubormaslik (narx)
```
Kuzatish:
```promql
prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds - ignoring(remote_name, url) group_right prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds   # lag
rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total[5m])
prometheus_remote_storage_shards
```
Faqat yuborish kerak bo'lsa: `--agent` rejimi (lokal so'rov/TSDB yo'q, kam resurs).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Endpoint uzoq ishlamasa WAL truncation (head compaction ~2h) — ma'lumot yo'qoladi.
- Restart'da katta WAL replay daqiqalab davom etadi — bu vaqtda scrape yo'q.
- Remote write'da 4xx (masalan tenant limiti, out-of-order) — retry qilinmaydi, sample'lar tashlanadi.
- `max_shards` kichik — lag doimiy o'sadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Remote write lag'ini alert qiling — u global dashboard va SLO'larning "ko'rinmas" kechikishi. Prometheus 3.x / Remote Write 2.0 metadata, exemplar va native histogram'larni samaraliroq uzatadi.

41678.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Synthetic monitoring** — skriptlangan bot'lar muntazam (masalan har daqiqa, bir nechta region'dan) endpoint yoki to'liq user journey'ni (login -> savat -> checkout) bajaradi: trafik bo'lmasa ham, foydalanuvchidan oldin nosozlikni topadi. **RUM** (Real User Monitoring) — haqiqiy foydalanuvchilar brauzeri/mobil ilovasidan JS SDK orqali haqiqiy tajribani yig'adi: sahifa yuklanishi, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), JS xatolari, qurilma/region bo'yicha taqsimot.

| | Synthetic | RUM |
|---|---|---|
| Trafik | sun'iy, nazoratli | haqiqiy |
| Kechasi/kam trafikda | ishlaydi | ma'lumot kam |
| Qamrov | faqat skriptlangan yo'llar | hamma real holatlar (eski telefon, sekin 3G) |
| Asosiy savol | "ishlayaptimi?" | "foydalanuvchilar uchun qanday?" |
| Tool'lar | Blackbox exporter, Grafana Synthetic Monitoring, Checkly, k6 browser | Grafana Faro, Datadog RUM, Sentry, OTel web |

**Amalda (synthetic, Playwright uslubida):**
```js
test('checkout', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('https://shop.example.com');
  await page.click('text=Add to cart');
  await page.click('text=Checkout');
  await expect(page.locator('#order-confirmed')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
});
```
RUM: sahifaga Faro SDK qo'shiladi, `traceparent` orqali frontend sessiyasi backend trace bilan bog'lanadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Synthetic test prod'da haqiqiy buyurtma/to'lov yaratadi — test akkaunt va bekor qilish oqimi kerak.
- Faqat ichki tarmoqdan synthetic — CDN/DNS muammolari ko'rinmaydi.
- RUM'da PII (URL'dagi email, input qiymatlari) yig'ish — maxfiylik; maskalash va consent.
- RUM o'rtachasiga qarash — p75/p95 va segmentlar (qurilma, mamlakat) muhim.

**Senior nuqta:** Ikkalasi birga: synthetic — erta ogohlantirish va SLA tashqi isboti, RUM — haqiqiy UX va qaysi segment azob chekayotgani. Frontend SLO'larini (masalan LCP p75 < 2.5 s) RUM asosida belgilang.

41679.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ikkalasi ham yengil, yuqori unumli telemetriya (asosan log) agent/forwarder'lari: node'larda (K8s'da DaemonSet) container log'larini o'qiydi, parse qiladi, boyitadi (K8s metadata), filtrlaydi va Loki, Elasticsearch, Kafka, S3, OTLP kabi manzillarga yuboradi. **Fluent Bit** — C'da yozilgan, juda kichik xotira, CNCF (Fluentd oilasi), keng tarqalgan default. **Vector** — Rust'da yozilgan (Datadog), kuchli transform tili **VRL**, end-to-end acknowledgement va disk buffer.

```
/var/log/containers/*.log --> [Fluent Bit / Vector DaemonSet]
                                 parse (CRI/JSON) -> k8s metadata -> filter/redact
                                 -> buffer (disk) -> Loki / Kafka / Elastic
```

**Amalda — Fluent Bit (YAML konfig):**
```yaml
pipeline:
  inputs:
    - name: tail
      path: /var/log/containers/*.log
      parser: cri
      storage.type: filesystem
  filters:
    - name: kubernetes
      match: "*"
  outputs:
    - name: loki
      match: "*"
      host: loki
      labels: job=fluentbit, namespace=$kubernetes['namespace_name']
```
**Amalda — Vector (VRL bilan):**
```toml
[transforms.clean]
type = "remap"
inputs = ["k8s"]
source = '''
. = merge(., parse_json!(.message))
del(.password)
'''
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Xotira buffer'i bilan backend uzilsa — log'lar yo'qoladi; disk buffer va backpressure sozlang.
- Ko'p-qatorli log'lar (Java stack trace) — multiline parser'siz har qator alohida yozuv.
- Agent resurs limitlarisiz — log portlashida node'ni bo'g'adi; limitsiz bo'lsa, o'zi OOM.
- Loki label'lariga pod nomini/ID'ni qo'shish — cardinality.

**Senior nuqta:** Agent tanlovidan muhimroq — yetkazish semantikasi (at-least-once, buffer, retry) va pipeline'da PII tozalash. Ko'p tashkilotlar OTel Collector yoki Grafana Alloy'ni yagona agent sifatida ham ko'rib chiqadi; Fluentd (Ruby) yangi o'rnatishlarda kamroq tanlanadi.

41680.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `predict_linear(v[range], t)` — gauge'ning `range` oynadagi qiymatlariga oddiy chiziqli regressiya qo'llab, `t` soniyadan keyingi qiymatini bashorat qiladi. Disk uchun: "shu trend davom etsa 24 soatda bo'sh joy 0 dan pastga tushadimi?" — statik "disk 90%" alert'idan ancha foydaliroq, chunki sekin to'layotgan va tez to'layotgan diskni farqlaydi.

**Nega statik chegara yomon:**
```
Disk A: 92%, lekin 1 yildan beri o'zgarmaydi    -> statik alert: shovqin
Disk B: 60%, lekin soatiga 5% o'smoqda          -> statik alert: kech (8 soatda to'ladi!)
predict_linear: A - jim, B - darhol alert
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- alert: DiskWillFillIn24h
  expr: |
    predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}[6h], 24*3600) < 0
    and
    node_filesystem_avail_bytes / node_filesystem_size_bytes < 0.4
    and
    node_filesystem_readonly == 0
  for: 30m
  labels: { severity: warning }
- alert: DiskWillFillIn4h
  expr: predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}[1h], 4*3600) < 0
  for: 5m
  labels: { severity: critical }
```
(Bu kube-prometheus / node-mixin'dagi `NodeFilesystemSpaceFillingUp` qoidalariga o'xshash.)

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kichik oyna (`[10m]`) — vaqtinchalik fayl yozilishi "24 soatda to'ladi" alert'ini beradi; oyna bashorat ufqiga mos bo'lsin.
- Log rotatsiyasi kabi arra-tishsimon (sawtooth) naqsh — chiziqli model chalg'iydi.
- `free_bytes` (root uchun zaxira ham kiradi) o'rniga `avail_bytes` ishlatish to'g'ri.
- Faqat bashorat — joriy foiz shartisiz katta, deyarli bo'sh disklarda ham ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Xuddi shu usul inode'lar, sertifikat muddati, kvotalar va DB jadval o'sishi uchun ham ishlaydi. Bashorat alert'i "harakat qilish uchun vaqt bor" degan signal — warning/ticket, qisqa ufqlisi esa page.

41682.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Node exporter — Prometheus'ning rasmiy exporter'i: Linux (va boshqa *nix) host'ning hardware va OS metrikalarini `/proc` va `/sys` dan o'qib `:9100/metrics` da beradi — CPU, xotira, disk hajmi va I/O, fayl tizimi, tarmoq, load, PSI, hwmon, systemd va boshqalar. K8s'da odatda DaemonSet sifatida har node'da ishlaydi.

**Asosiy metrikalar va so'rovlar:**
```promql
# CPU utilization
1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m]))
# Xotira ishlatilishi (available asosida!)
1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes
# Disk joyi
1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes
# Disk band vaqti
rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[5m])
# Tarmoq
rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device!~"lo|veth.*"}[5m])
# Bosim (PSI)
rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total[5m])
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run -d --net=host --pid=host -v /:/host:ro,rslave \
  quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter --path.rootfs=/host
curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep node_load1
```
Custom metrika: textfile collector — skript `/var/lib/node_exporter/*.prom` ga yozadi (masalan backup muvaffaqiyati vaqti).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Container ichida host mount'larisiz ishga tushirish — container'ning o'z fayl tizimi ko'rinadi.
- Xotirani `MemFree` bo'yicha o'lchash — Linux cache'ni hisoblamaydi, doim "to'la" ko'rinadi.
- Keraksiz collector'lar (masalan ko'p diskli host'da) — cardinality; `--collector.disable-defaults` va kerakligini yoqish.
- Port 9100 tashqariga ochiq — tizim haqida ma'lumot sizadi.

**Senior nuqta:** node_exporter metrikalari USE metodining asosi; tayyor alert va dashboard'lar uchun `node-mixin` (kube-prometheus) dan boshlang. Container darajasidagi sarf uchun esa cAdvisor (kubelet) metrikalari kerak — node_exporter faqat host ko'rinishi.

41683.a:
**Qisqa javob:** kube-state-metrics (KSM) — Kubernetes API server'ni watch qilib, obyektlarning **holati** haqida metrikalar beradi: Deployment kerakli/mavjud replikalar, Pod phase va restart soni, container'ning `requests/limits` qiymatlari, Job muvaffaqiyati, Node condition'lari, PVC holati, HPA. U resurs **sarfini** (CPU/RAM ishlatilishi) bermaydi — bu cAdvisor/kubelet va metrics-server ishi.

```
              K8s API (desired/actual state)            kubelet/cAdvisor (real sarf)
                     |                                          |
              kube-state-metrics                          container_cpu_usage_...
      kube_deployment_status_replicas_available        container_memory_working_set_bytes
      kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total
      kube_pod_container_resource_limits
```

**Amalda (foydali so'rovlar):**
```promql
# Deployment to'liq emas
kube_deployment_spec_replicas != kube_deployment_status_replicas_available
# CrashLoop
increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[15m]) > 3
# OOMKilled sababi
kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"} == 1
# Sarf / limit nisbati (KSM + cAdvisor birga)
sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!=""})
  / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"})
# Pending pod'lar
sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"}) > 0
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- KSM bilan CPU ishlatilishini qidirish — u yerda yo'q.
- Katta klasterda bitta KSM nusxasi — xotira va scrape vaqti katta; sharding (`--shard`, `--total-shards`).
- Label'lar (`kube_pod_labels`) default cheklangan — kerakli label'larni `--metric-labels-allowlist` bilan yoqing (ehtiyotkorlik bilan, cardinality).
- KSM'ni bir nechta Prometheus scrape qilsa metrikalar takrorlanadi (honor_labels, instance).

**Senior nuqta:** K8s alert'larining katta qismi (kubernetes-mixin) KSM metrikalariga tayanadi. Uning qiymati — "kutilgan holat va haqiqiy holat" farqini ko'rsatishda: rollout qotib qoldi, HPA maksimumga yetdi, Job jim fail bo'ldi.

41684.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OpenSearch — 2021-yilda Elastic Elasticsearch va Kibana litsenziyasini Apache 2.0'dan SSPL/Elastic License'ga o'zgartirgach, AWS boshchiligida yaratilgan Elasticsearch 7.10.2 va Kibana fork'i (OpenSearch Dashboards), Apache 2.0 litsenziyasida. 2024-yildan OpenSearch Linux Foundation qoshidagi OpenSearch Software Foundation'da. Elastic esa 2024-yilda Elasticsearch'ga AGPLv3 variantini ham qo'shdi.

**Farqlar (2025-2026 holati):**
| | Elasticsearch | OpenSearch |
|---|---|---|
| Litsenziya | SSPL / Elastic License / AGPLv3 | Apache 2.0 |
| Egasi | Elastic NV | OpenSearch Software Foundation (LF) |
| Managed | Elastic Cloud | Amazon OpenSearch Service (+ boshqalar) |
| UI | Kibana | OpenSearch Dashboards |
| Xavfsizlik | basic tier'da bepul (8.x) | Security plugin o'rnatilgan |
| Kuchli tomonlari | ES|QL, ML, vektor qidiruv, Elastic Observability/Security | to'liq ochiq plugin'lar, PPL/SQL, vektor qidiruv (k-NN) |
| API mosligi | 8.x+ | 7.10 asosida, keyin ajralib ketgan |

**Amalda:**
```bash
curl -s localhost:9200 | jq .version          # distribution: "opensearch" yoki ES
```
Client'lar: ES 8.x client'lari OpenSearch'ga mahsulot tekshiruvi sababli ulanmasligi mumkin — `opensearch-py`, `opensearch-go` ishlating. Beats/Logstash o'rniga Data Prepper yoki Fluent Bit/Vector.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Ikkalasi bir xil" deb snapshot'larni yoki plugin'larni o'zaro ko'chirish — 7.10'dan keyingi versiyalar mos emas.
- Litsenziyani tekshirmasdan Elasticsearch'ni SaaS sifatida xizmat qilib sotish — SSPL cheklovlari.
- Migratsiyada client kutubxona va index template farqlarini hisobga olmaslik.

**Senior nuqta:** Tanlov ko'pincha texnik emas: litsenziya siyosati, managed servis (AWS'da OpenSearch Service), mavjud ekotizim va kerakli xususiyatlar (Elastic'ning ML/Security yoki ochiqlik). Log'lar uchun esa birinchi savol — umuman to'liq matn indeks kerakmi (Loki, ClickHouse arzonroq).

41685.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Strukturali logging — har log yozuvini erkin matn qatori emas, maydonlari aniq nomlangan obyekt (odatda JSON yoki logfmt) sifatida chiqarish: `{"ts":"...","level":"error","msg":"charge failed","order_id":"o-91","trace_id":"4bf9...","duration_ms":812}`. Log tizimi uni regex'siz parse qiladi, maydonlar bo'yicha filtr, agregatsiya va signallararo bog'lash (trace_id) darhol ishlaydi.

**Nega majburiy:**
```
Matn:  "2026-10-03 10:01 ERROR Charge failed for order o-91 after 812ms"
   -> har servisda boshqacha format, regex mo'rt, format o'zgarsa dashboard sinadi
JSON:  {"level":"error","msg":"charge failed","order_id":"o-91","duration_ms":812}
   -> | json | duration_ms > 500 and level="error"
```

**Amalda (Go, `log/slog` standart kutubxona):**
```go
logger := slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: slog.LevelInfo}))
logger.ErrorContext(ctx, "charge failed",
    slog.String("order_id", id),
    slog.Int64("duration_ms", d.Milliseconds()),
    slog.Any("err", err))
```
Trace bilan bog'lash: OTel log bridge yoki handler ichida `ctx` dan `trace_id`/`span_id` qo'shish. Qidiruv (Loki):
```logql
{app="payment"} | json | level="error" | duration_ms > 500
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bir servisda `userId`, boshqasida `user_id` — sxema kelishilmagan; OTel semantic conventions yoki ichki standart.
- Parol, token, karta raqami, PII'ni log'ga yozish — redaction kerak.
- Butun request/response body'ni log'lash — narx va maxfiylik.
- Ko'p qatorli stack trace'ni JSON'dan tashqarida chiqarish — yozuv bo'linadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Log'lar eng qimmat signal bo'lib ketishi oson: daraja (level) siyosati, sampling (bir xil xatoning har 1000 tasidan biri), retention va har servis log hajmi bo'yicha kvota kerak. Strukturalik — boshqa hamma narsa (korrelyatsiya, alert, xavfsizlik tahlili) uchun asos.

41686.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Baggage — OTel'da trace konteksti bilan birga servis chegaralari orqali (HTTP `baggage` header, W3C Baggage standarti) uzatiladigan ixtiyoriy key=value juftliklar: masalan `tenant.id=enterprise_456`, `feature_flag=new_checkout`. Downstream servislar uni o'qib, o'z span/metrika/log'lariga atribut sifatida qo'shishi yoki biznes mantiqida ishlatishi mumkin. Span atributlaridan farqi: atribut faqat o'sha span'da, baggage esa **keyingi barcha** servislarga ketadi.

```
API gateway (tenant=ent_456 ni biladi)
   | baggage: tenant.id=ent_456
   v
order-service ---> payment-service ---> ledger-service
                   (tenant.id ni span atributiga qo'shadi; "har tenant bo'yicha latency")
```

**Amalda (Go):**
```go
m, _ := baggage.NewMember("tenant.id", "ent_456")
b, _ := baggage.New(m)
ctx = baggage.ContextWithBaggage(ctx, b)        // propagator uni header'ga qo'yadi

// downstream'da
tenant := baggage.FromContext(ctx).Member("tenant.id").Value()
span.SetAttributes(attribute.String("tenant.id", tenant))
```
Header: `baggage: tenant.id=ent_456,feature_flag=new_checkout`. Collector yoki SDK'da baggage'ni avtomatik span atributiga ko'chiruvchi span processor'lar bor.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Baggage avtomatik ravishda **tashqi** servislarga (uchinchi tomon API) ham ketishi mumkin — PII, token, maxfiy ma'lumot qo'ymang.
- Har request header hajmini oshiradi — ko'p yoki katta qiymatlar latency va header limitlariga uriladi.
- Kelgan baggage'ga ishonib ruxsat (authz) qarori qilish — client uni soxtalashtira oladi.
- Baggage o'z-o'zidan telemetriyaga yozilmaydi — atributga qo'shishni o'zingiz qilasiz.

**Senior nuqta:** Baggage — multi-tenant tizimlarda "qaysi mijoz azob chekyapti" savoliga barcha qatlamlarda javob berishning arzon yo'li. Chegaralarda (egress) baggage'ni tozalash siyosatini qo'ying va kalitlar ro'yxatini standartlashtiring.

41687.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Fingerprint — alert'ning barcha label'laridan (alertname + qolgan label'lar, annotation'lar emas) hisoblangan hash; u alert'ning **identifikatori**. Alertmanager bir xil fingerprint'li alert'larni bitta alert deb hisoblaydi: HA juftligidagi ikkita Prometheus bir xil target'larni scrape qilib bir xil alert yuborsa, xabarnoma bir marta ketadi. Alertmanager klaster nusxalari ham gossip orqali "kim nima yubordi" va silence'larni ulashib, takroriy xabarni oldini oladi.

```
Prometheus-A --alert{alertname=HighLatency, service=api, severity=critical}--+
Prometheus-B --alert{alertname=HighLatency, service=api, severity=critical}--+--> AM klaster
                         fingerprint bir xil  ->  1 ta alert  ->  1 ta page
```

**Amalda — muhim sozlama:**
```yaml
# Prometheus-A
global:
  external_labels: { cluster: prod, replica: A }
alerting:
  alert_relabel_configs:
    - regex: replica
      action: labeldrop        # replica label'ini alert'dan olib tashlash!
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs: [{ targets: [am-0:9093, am-1:9093, am-2:9093] }]
```
Prometheus alert'ni **barcha** Alertmanager nusxalariga yuboradi (load balancer orqali emas).
```bash
amtool alert query -o extended      # fingerprint va label'larni ko'rish
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `replica` external label'i alert'da qolsa — fingerprint'lar farq qiladi, har alert ikki marta keladi.
- Alert label'ida o'zgaruvchan qiymat (`value="{{ $value }}"` label sifatida) — har baholashda yangi fingerprint, alert "flap" qiladi va qayta-qayta yuboriladi. Qiymatni annotation'ga qo'ying.
- Alertmanager'lar orasida gossip porti (9094) yopiq — klaster bo'linib, takroriy xabarlar.

**Senior nuqta:** Label = identifikator, annotation = tavsif. Bu qoidani buzish dedup, silence va inhibition'ni bir vaqtda buzadi. HA'ni test qiling: bitta Prometheus va bitta AM nusxasini o'chirib, xabar bir marta kelishini tekshiring.

41688.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Dashboard as code — Grafana dashboard'larini UI'da qo'lda yasash o'rniga kod sifatida yozish (Jsonnet + **grafonnet** kutubxonasi, Grafana Foundation SDK — Go/TypeScript/Python, yoki Terraform/Grafana Operator), Git'da saqlash, code review va CI/CD orqali deploy qilish. Natija: versiya tarixi, takrorlanuvchanlik, bir xil standart panellarni ko'p servisga generatsiya.

**Muammo:** 200 servisli kompaniyada UI'da qo'lda qilingan dashboard'lar — har biri boshqacha, kimdir tasodifan o'chiradi, staging va prod farq qiladi, metrika nomi o'zgarsa 50 ta dashboard'ni qo'lda tuzatish kerak.

**Amalda (Jsonnet + grafonnet):**
```jsonnet
local g = import 'github.com/grafana/grafonnet/gen/grafonnet-latest/main.libsonnet';
local red(svc) = g.dashboard.new(svc + ' RED')
  + g.dashboard.withPanels([
    g.panel.timeSeries.new('Rate')
    + g.panel.timeSeries.queryOptions.withTargets([
      g.query.prometheus.new('$datasource',
        'sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="%s"}[$__rate_interval]))' % svc)]),
  ]);
{ ['%s.json' % s]: red(s) for s in ['checkout', 'payment', 'orders'] }
```
```bash
jb install github.com/grafana/grafonnet/gen/grafonnet-latest@main
jsonnet -J vendor -m out/ dashboards.jsonnet
```
Deploy: Grafana provisioning (`dashboards/*.json` papkasi), Terraform `grafana_dashboard`, K8s ConfigMap + sidecar yoki Grafana Operator CRD. Tayyor to'plamlar: **monitoring mixins** (kubernetes-mixin, node-mixin) — dashboard + alert + recording rule birga.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Provisioned dashboard'ni UI'da tahrirlash — keyingi deploy'da o'zgarish yo'qoladi.
- UI'dan eksport qilingan JSON'ni "kod" deb saqlash — o'qib bo'lmaydigan, review qilib bo'lmaydigan diff.
- Data source UID'larini qattiq yozish — boshqa muhitda ishlamaydi; o'zgaruvchi ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Asosiy foyda — standartlash: har yangi servis avtomatik RED dashboard va SLO alert'lari bilan tug'iladi. Eksperimental dashboard'lar uchun UI erkinligini qoldiring, lekin "rasmiy" (on-call ishlatadigan) dashboard'lar faqat kod orqali.

41689.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `scrape_interval` — Prometheus target'lardan metrikani **qanchalik tez-tez yig'ishi** (default 1m, amalda ko'pincha 15s-30s). `evaluation_interval` — recording va alerting rule'larni **qanchalik tez-tez hisoblashi** (default 1m). Ikkalasi `global` da beriladi va mos ravishda job yoki rule group darajasida qayta belgilanadi.

```
scrape   |----15s----|----15s----|----15s----|     (ma'lumot kelishi)
evaluate |---------30s---------|---------30s--|    (rule'lar hisobi)
alert:   expr true -> pending --(for: 5m)--> firing -> Alertmanager
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  scrape_timeout: 10s          # scrape_interval dan katta bo'lmasligi kerak
  evaluation_interval: 30s
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: heavy-exporter
    scrape_interval: 60s        # qimmat exporter uchun kamroq
rule_files: [/etc/prometheus/rules/*.yml]
```
```yaml
groups:
  - name: slo
    interval: 15s              # shu guruh uchun evaluation_interval
    rules: [...]
```

**Alert kechikishi hisobi:** muammo boshlanishi -> keyingi scrape (<=15s) -> keyingi evaluation (<=30s) -> `for: 5m` -> `group_wait` (30s) -> xabar. Ya'ni minimal `for` + bir daqiqacha qo'shimcha.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `rate(x[30s])` 15s scrape bilan — oynada 2 ta nuqta, ishonchsiz; oyna >= 4 x scrape_interval.
- Juda qisqa scrape (1-5s) hamma joyda — series hajmi va xarajat bir necha barobar.
- Har job'da turli scrape interval — bir dashboard'da `rate` oynalarini moslashtirish qiyin; Grafana'da `$__rate_interval` va data source'da to'g'ri "scrape interval" sozlamasi.
- `scrape_timeout` > `scrape_interval` — konfig xatosi.

**Senior nuqta:** Standart: butun tashkilotda bitta scrape interval (15s yoki 30s), istisnolar sababli. `evaluation_interval` ni scrape interval'idan juda kichik qilish foyda bermaydi — yangi ma'lumot kelmaydi, faqat CPU sarfi.

41690.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Recording rule — PromQL ifodasini har `evaluation_interval` da oldindan hisoblab, natijani **yangi time series** sifatida saqlaydigan qoida. Dashboard va alert'lar qimmat so'rovni har safar qayta hisoblash o'rniga tayyor series'ni o'qiydi — tez va arzon; Mimir/Thanos'ga yuboriladigan hajmni ham kamaytirish mumkin.

**Nega kerak:** 10 000 pod bo'yicha `histogram_quantile(... sum by (le) (rate(..._bucket[5m])))` har dashboard ochilishida millionlab sample'ni skanerlaydi; 20 kishi bir vaqtda ochsa Prometheus bo'g'iladi. Recording rule bilan bu bitta series'ni o'qish.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
groups:
  - name: api_rules
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - record: job:http_requests:rate5m
        expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
      - record: job:http_request_errors:ratio_rate5m
        expr: |
          sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m]))
          / sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
      - record: job:http_request_duration_seconds:p99_5m
        expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```
```bash
promtool check rules rules.yml
promtool test rules tests.yml        # unit test: kirish series -> kutilgan natija
```
Nomlash konvensiyasi `level:metric:operations`: `level` — qaysi label'lar qoldi (`job`, `instance`), `metric` — asl nom, `operations` — qo'llangan amallar (`rate5m`, `ratio_rate5m`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Recording rule natijasi faqat yaratilgan paytdan boshlab mavjud — tarix yo'q (backfill uchun `promtool tsdb create-blocks-from rules`).
- Rule'lar orasida bog'liqlik: bir guruh ichida ketma-ket baholanadi, guruhlar parallel — boshqa guruh natijasiga tayanish kechikish beradi.
- Har narsani recording qilish — series soni o'sadi, foyda yo'q.
- `rate` ni recording qilib keyin uni yana `rate` qilish — noto'g'ri; counter'ni emas, natijani saqlayapsiz.

**Senior nuqta:** SLO alerting (burn rate oynalari) va katta agregatsiyalar recording rule'larsiz amalda ishlamaydi. Rule'larni kod sifatida test bilan saqlang (`promtool test rules`) — noto'g'ri recording rule jim va uzoq vaqt noto'g'ri ma'lumot beradi.

41691.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Compaction — Prometheus TSDB'ning fon jarayoni: head'dan chiqqan 2 soatlik block'larni kattaroq block'larga (2h -> 6h -> 18h -> ... maksimal retention'ning ~10% i yoki 31 kun, qaysi kichik bo'lsa) birlashtiradi. Bunda index'lar birlashtiriladi, chunk'lar qayta yoziladi, tombstone (o'chirilgan deb belgilangan) series'lar haqiqatan olib tashlanadi va retention'dan eskirgan block'lar o'chiriladi.

**Nega kerak:** Har 2 soatda yangi block — 30 kunda 360 ta block. So'rov har block'ning index'ini ochishi kerak bo'lardi (sekin, ko'p fayl). Kam va katta block'lar — tez so'rov va kamroq disk (takroriy index ma'lumoti yo'q).

```
head (RAM, ~2-3h) --cut--> [2h][2h][2h] --compact--> [6h] ... [6h][6h][6h] --> [18h] ...
                                                                       retention -> o'chirish
har block: chunks/  index  meta.json  tombstones
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ls /prometheus                       # 01HXYZ... (ULID nomli block papkalari), wal/, chunks_head/
cat /prometheus/01HXYZ.../meta.json  # minTime, maxTime, compaction.level, sources
promtool tsdb list /prometheus       # block'lar va hajmlari
```
Kuzatish:
```promql
rate(prometheus_tsdb_compactions_failed_total[1h]) > 0
prometheus_tsdb_compaction_duration_seconds_sum
```
Thanos/Mimir sidecar bilan ishlaganda lokal compaction o'chiriladi (`--storage.tsdb.min-block-duration=2h --storage.tsdb.max-block-duration=2h`), compaction object storage'da (Thanos Compactor / Mimir compactor) qilinadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Compaction vaqtida vaqtinchalik qo'shimcha disk kerak — disk deyarli to'la bo'lsa compaction fail bo'ladi va block'lar to'planadi.
- Admin API bilan series o'chirish (`delete_series`) darhol joy bo'shatmaydi — faqat tombstone; `clean_tombstones` yoki compaction kerak.
- Sidecar bilan lokal compaction'ni o'chirmaslik — Thanos block'larni noto'g'ri yuklaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Disk hajmini rejalashtirishda formula: `retention_soniya x sample/s x ~1-2 bayt` + compaction uchun ~zaxira. `prometheus_tsdb_compactions_failed_total` va disk bo'sh joyiga alert — jim buzilgan compaction oxir-oqibat Prometheus'ni to'xtatadi.

41692.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Head block** — Prometheus'ning xotiradagi faol qismi: oxirgi ~2-3 soatlik sample'lar shu yerga yoziladi, yozish mumkin, WAL bilan himoyalangan (crash'da replay) va to'ldirilgan chunk'lar `chunks_head/` ga mmap qilinadi. **Persistent block** — head'dan "kesilgan" 2 soatlik (keyin compaction bilan kattalashgan) diskdagi **o'zgarmas** (immutable) block: `chunks/`, `index`, `meta.json`, `tombstones`.

```
              YOZISH                               O'QISH
scrape -> [WAL] -> [HEAD block: RAM + chunks_head mmap]  <- so'nggi ma'lumot
                          | har ~2h (head 3h bo'lganda eng eski 2h kesiladi)
                          v
               [block 2h] [block 2h] ... [block 18h]     <- disk, immutable, compaction
```

| | Head block | Persistent block |
|---|---|---|
| Joy | RAM (+ mmap chunk'lar) | disk |
| O'zgaruvchanlik | yoziladi | o'zgarmas |
| Himoya | WAL | o'zi faylda |
| Xotira sarfi | faol series soniga proporsional | asosan page cache |

**Amalda:**
```promql
prometheus_tsdb_head_series          # faol series (RAM'ning asosiy omili)
prometheus_tsdb_head_chunks
rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total[5m])
prometheus_tsdb_head_min_time / prometheus_tsdb_head_max_time
```
UI: Status -> TSDB Status — head statistikasi va eng ko'p series'li metrikalar.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Prometheus RAM'i "ma'lumot hajmi" emas, head series soni bilan o'sadi — cardinality portlashi = OOM.
- Pod churn (har deploy'da yangi pod label'i) — eski series'lar head'dan 2-3 soatgacha chiqmaydi, xotira vaqtincha ikki baravar.
- Out-of-order sample'lar head vaqt oynasidan tashqarida rad etiladi (`out_of_order_time_window` sozlamasi yoqilmagan bo'lsa).

**Senior nuqta:** Xotira rejalashtirish uchun qo'pol qoida: faol series boshiga bir necha KB (label uzunligiga bog'liq). Restart vaqti WAL replay'ga bog'liq — head snapshot (`--enable-feature=memory-snapshot-on-shutdown`) restart'ni tezlashtiradi.

41693.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Silence — Alertmanager'da label matcher'lar bilan berilgan vaqt oralig'ida mos keluvchi alert'larning **xabarnomalarini** o'chirish. Alert'lar baholanishda va UI'da ko'rinishda davom etadi, faqat receiver'larga yuborilmaydi. Rejali texnik ish (maintenance), ma'lum va ustida ishlanayotgan muammo yoki shovqinli alert vaqtincha tuzatilguncha ishlatiladi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
amtool silence add alertname=HighLatency service=payment \
  --duration=2h --author="ali" --comment="DB migratsiyasi, JIRA OPS-123"
amtool silence query
amtool silence query -o extended service=payment
amtool silence expire <silence-id>        # muddatidan oldin tugatish
```
UI: Alertmanager -> Silences -> New Silence (yoki Grafana'dan). Matcher'lar: `=`, `!=`, `=~` (regex), `!~`.

Silence, inhibition, routing farqi:
| | Silence | Inhibition | Route |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kim yaratadi | inson, qo'lda, vaqtinchalik | konfig, avtomatik | konfig |
| Shart | label matcher + vaqt | boshqa alert faolligi | label |
| Maqsad | ma'lum ish/muammo | kaskad shovqin | qayerga yuborish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Juda keng matcher (`cluster="prod"`) — maintenance paytida boshqa haqiqiy incident ham jim qoladi.
- Muddatsiz yoki juda uzun silence — muammo tuzatilmay unutiladi; doim izoh va qisqa muddat.
- Silence alert'ni o'chiradi deb o'ylash — Prometheus'da u hali firing; dashboard'lar qizil.
- Alertmanager klasterida gossip ishlamasa silence boshqa nusxaga yetmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Rejali deploy/maintenance'da silence'ni pipeline'dan avtomatik yarating (API orqali) va ish tugaganda expire qiling. Faol silence'lar ro'yxatini muntazam ko'rib chiqish — "abadiy silence" lar alert gigiyenasining yashirin qarzi.

41694.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Routing tree — Alertmanager'da alert qaysi **receiver**ga, qanday grouping va vaqt parametrlari bilan borishini belgilaydigan ierarxik qoidalar daraxti. Ildiz (`route`) default receiver; bola `routes` label matcher'lar bilan tanlanadi; alert daraxt bo'ylab chuqurlikka qarab birinchi mos kelgan bolaga tushadi (`continue: true` bo'lsa keyingi qardoshlarni ham tekshiradi). Bola route ota parametrlarini (group_by, vaqtlar) meros oladi.

```
route (receiver: default-slack, group_by: [alertname, cluster])
 |- matchers: team="payments"           -> payments-slack
 |    |- matchers: severity="critical"  -> payments-pagerduty
 |- matchers: team="platform"           -> platform-slack
 |- matchers: alertname="Watchdog"      -> deadmansnitch (repeat_interval: 1m)
 (hech biri mos kelmasa)                -> default-slack
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
route:
  receiver: default-slack
  group_by: [alertname, cluster, namespace]
  routes:
    - matchers: [alertname="Watchdog"]
      receiver: deadmansnitch
      repeat_interval: 1m
    - matchers: [team="payments"]
      receiver: payments-slack
      routes:
        - matchers: [severity="critical"]
          receiver: payments-pagerduty
          group_wait: 10s
    - matchers: [severity="critical"]
      receiver: oncall-pagerduty
      continue: true               # bundan keyin ham davom etsin
    - matchers: [severity="critical"]
      receiver: incident-channel
```
```bash
amtool config routes show
amtool config routes test --config.file=alertmanager.yml team=payments severity=critical
```
Grafana'da "Notification policies" — xuddi shu konsepsiya.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tartib xatosi: umumiy matcher (`severity="critical"`) aniqroqidan (`team="payments"`) yuqorida — team'ga yetmaydi.
- `continue` ni unutish — alert faqat birinchi mos route'ga ketadi.
- Alert'larda `team`/`severity` label'i yo'q — hammasi default'ga tushadi; rule'larda majburiy label'lar standarti kerak.
- Konfigni test qilmasdan deploy — kritik alert noto'g'ri kanalga.

**Senior nuqta:** Routing'ni egalik (ownership) asosida quring: har alert'da `team` va `severity` label'i bo'lsin, route'lar shu ikki o'lchov bo'yicha. Route konfigini CI'da `amtool check-config` va `routes test` bilan tekshiring.

41695.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana Unified Alerting (Grafana 8+ da joriy, 11'dan boshlab eski "legacy" dashboard alerting olib tashlangan) — Grafana ichidagi yagona alert tizimi: alert rule'lar dashboard panellariga bog'lanmagan, istalgan data source (Prometheus, Loki, CloudWatch, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch) bo'yicha so'rov + shart sifatida yoziladi; xabarnomalar ichki Alertmanager-uslubidagi **contact points**, **notification policies** (routing tree), silences va mute timings orqali. Mimir/Loki ruler'larining rule'larini ham shu UI'dan boshqarish mumkin.

**Ikki turdagi rule:**
```
Grafana-managed rule:  Grafana o'zi so'raydi va baholaydi  -> istalgan data source, SQL ham
Data source-managed:   Mimir/Loki ruler'da yashaydi         -> PromQL/LogQL, Prometheus formatida
                               |
              notification policies -> contact points (Slack, PagerDuty, email, webhook)
```

**Amalda (provisioning):**
```yaml
apiVersion: 1
groups:
  - orgId: 1
    name: db
    folder: Database
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      - uid: pg-repl-lag
        title: Replication lag > 30s
        condition: C
        data:
          - refId: A
            datasourceUid: prometheus
            model: { expr: "max(pg_replication_lag_seconds)" }
          - refId: C
            datasourceUid: __expr__
            model: { type: threshold, expression: A, conditions: [{ evaluator: { type: gt, params: [30] } }] }
        for: 5m
        labels: { severity: warning, team: dba }
```
Terraform provider (`grafana_rule_group`) yoki Grafana API ham ishlatiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Alert'larni faqat UI'da yaratish — versiyasiz, review'siz.
- Grafana-managed rule'lar Grafana'ning o'zi ishlamasa baholanmaydi — kritik alert'lar uchun Grafana HA yoki Prometheus/Mimir ruler.
- Ikkita parallel alert tizimi (Prometheus + Alertmanager va Grafana alerting) — dublikat va chalkash routing.
- SQL data source bo'yicha qimmat so'rovni har daqiqa ishlatish.

**Senior nuqta:** Bitta "alert source of truth" tanlang. Prometheus metrikalari uchun ko'pincha Mimir/Prometheus ruler + Alertmanager ishonchliroq (Grafana'ga bog'liq emas), Grafana-managed esa Prometheus bo'lmagan manbalar (SQL, CloudWatch) uchun qulay.

41696.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `relabel_configs` — scrape'dan **oldin**, target darajasida ishlaydi: service discovery meta label'lari (`__meta_kubernetes_*`) asosida target'larni saqlash/tashlash (`keep`/`drop`), manzilni, metrics path'ni o'zgartirish va target label'larini (`namespace`, `pod`) yaratish. `metric_relabel_configs` — scrape'dan **keyin**, TSDB'ga yozishdan oldin, har bir **sample** darajasida: keraksiz metrikalarni yoki label'larni tashlash, nomlarni o'zgartirish — cardinality va xarajat nazorati.

```
service discovery -> [relabel_configs] -> scrape HTTP /metrics -> [metric_relabel_configs] -> TSDB
  (target meta)        target tanlash          sample'lar           sample filtr        -> [write_relabel_configs] -> remote_write
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: k8s-pods
    kubernetes_sd_configs: [{ role: pod }]
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
        action: keep
        regex: "true"
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
        target_label: namespace
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
        target_label: pod
    metric_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        regex: "go_gc_duration_seconds.*|apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket"
        action: drop
      - regex: "user_agent|request_id"
        action: labeldrop
```
Natijani tekshirish: UI -> Status -> Targets / Service Discovery ("Discovered labels" va "Target labels").

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Keraksiz metrikani `relabel_configs` da tashlashga urinish — u yerda `__name__` hali yo'q.
- `metric_relabel_configs` scrape va parse xarajatini kamaytirmaydi — faqat saqlashni; katta muammoda manbada tuzating.
- `labeldrop` natijasida ikki series bir xil bo'lib qoladi — "duplicate sample" xatolari.
- `__` bilan boshlanadigan label'lar relabel'dan keyin tashlanadi — kerakligini oddiy label'ga ko'chiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Cardinality nazoratini qatlamlarda qiling: manbada (instrumentatsiya), `metric_relabel_configs` (scrape), `write_relabel_configs` (remote storage'ga faqat kerakli). Prometheus Operator'da xuddi shular `ServiceMonitor` dagi `relabelings` va `metricRelabelings`.

41697.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `unwrap` — LogQL'da log qatoridan (parse qilingan maydondan) **son qiymatni** ajratib olib, uni sample qiymati sifatida ishlatish; shundan keyin `sum_over_time`, `avg_over_time`, `max_over_time`, `quantile_over_time` kabi "unwrapped range" agregatsiyalari qo'llanadi. Oddiy `count_over_time`/`rate` faqat qatorlar sonini sanaydi, `unwrap` esa qatordagi raqamni (latency, bayt) hisoblaydi.

```
log: {"route":"/pay","duration_ms":812,"bytes":5120}
 | json                         -> maydonlar label bo'ladi
 | unwrap duration_ms           -> sample qiymati = 812
 quantile_over_time(0.99, ...[5m]) by (route)
```

**Amalda:**
```logql
# Route bo'yicha p99 latency (log'lardan)
quantile_over_time(0.99,
  {app="api"} | json | unwrap duration_ms [5m]) by (route)

# Yuborilgan baytlar jami
sum by (route) (sum_over_time({app="api"} | json | unwrap bytes [5m]))

# Birlik konvertatsiyasi
avg_over_time({app="nginx"} | logfmt | unwrap duration(request_time) [5m])   # "1.2s" kabi qiymat
avg_over_time({app="api"} | json | unwrap bytes(size) [5m])                  # "5KB" kabi

# Parse qilib bo'lmagan qatorlarni chiqarib tashlash
... | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" 
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `by (...)` da yuqori cardinality'li maydon (`user_id`, `request_id`) — juda ko'p series, so'rov yiqiladi.
- Son bo'lmagan qiymat — `__error__` label'i bilan xato; `| __error__=""` filtri kerak.
- `unwrap` dan keyin `rate()` emas, `*_over_time` funksiyalari ishlatiladi.
- Keng oyna va label'siz selector — terabaytlab log skanerlash.

**Senior nuqta:** `unwrap` — instrumentatsiya qilinmagan (legacy, nginx) tizimlardan tez metrika olishning yaxshi vaqtinchalik yo'li. Doimiy dashboard/alert uchun natijani Loki recording rule qiling yoki ilovada haqiqiy histogram chiqaring — u ancha arzon va aniq.

41698.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OpenTelemetry semantic conventions — telemetriya atributlari, span nomlari, metrika nomlari va birliklari uchun tillar va vendorlar bo'ylab umumiy lug'at: `http.request.method`, `http.response.status_code`, `url.path`, `db.system`, `db.query.text`, `rpc.service`, `messaging.system`, `service.name`, `k8s.pod.name` va h.k. Hamma bir xil nom ishlatsa — Go va Java servislari bitta dashboard, bitta so'rov va backend'lardagi avtomatik tahlilga tushadi.

**Muammo:**
```
Go servis:    span.attr "method" = "GET",   "status" = 200
Java servis:  span.attr "http_method" = "GET", "statusCode" = 200
Python:       "http.verb" ...
-> "barcha 5xx'lar" so'rovi uch xil yozilishi kerak
semconv bilan: hammasi http.request.method, http.response.status_code
```

**Amalda (Go):**
```go
import semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.26.0"
span.SetAttributes(
    semconv.HTTPRequestMethodKey.String("POST"),
    semconv.HTTPResponseStatusCode(500),
    semconv.DBSystemPostgreSQL,
)
```
Metrikalar ham: `http.server.request.duration` (soniyada, histogram). Auto-instrumentation kutubxonalari bu nomlarni avtomatik qo'yadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Versiya o'zgarishlari: HTTP semconv barqarorlashganda (v1.23) `http.method` -> `http.request.method`, `http.status_code` -> `http.response.status_code` bo'ldi; eski dashboard'lar bo'sh qoladi. `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=http/dup` bilan o'tish davrida ikkalasi chiqariladi.
- Turli servislarda turli semconv versiyalari — aralash nomlar.
- Standartda yo'q biznes atributlarini nomlashda prefiks ishlatmaslik (`app.order.id` o'rniga `id`) — to'qnashuv.
- Semconv'dagi ba'zi atributlar (masalan `db.query.text`) PII sizdirishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Semconv'ni ichki standartga aylantiring: o'z biznes atributlaringiz uchun ham namespace (`app.*`, `tenant.*`) va lug'at. Bu signallararo korrelyatsiya va vendor almashtirishning poydevori.

41699.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OTLP (OpenTelemetry Protocol) — OpenTelemetry'ning nativ, vendor-neytral telemetriya uzatish protokoli: trace, metrika, log (va profil) ma'lumotini Protocol Buffers sxemasi bilan kodlab, **gRPC** (port **4317**) yoki **HTTP/protobuf** yoki HTTP/JSON (port **4318**, yo'llar `/v1/traces`, `/v1/metrics`, `/v1/logs`) orqali yuboradi. SDK -> Collector -> backend zanjirining umumiy tili; Tempo, Jaeger, Mimir/Prometheus, Loki, Datadog va boshqalar OTLP qabul qiladi.

```
[SDK] --OTLP/gRPC :4317--> [Collector] --OTLP--> [Tempo]
[browser SDK] --OTLP/HTTP :4318 /v1/traces--> [Collector]   (brauzerda gRPC yo'q)
                                          --OTLP/HTTP--> [Prometheus /api/v1/otlp] (metrika)
```

| | gRPC (4317) | HTTP (4318) |
|---|---|---|
| Samaradorlik | yuqori, streaming, HTTP/2 | yaxshi |
| Proxy/LB moslik | L7 LB gRPC'ni bilishi kerak | oddiy HTTP infra |
| Brauzer | yo'q | ha (JSON yoki protobuf) |

**Amalda:**
```bash
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://otel-collector:4317
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=grpc          # yoki http/protobuf
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS="authorization=Bearer xxx"
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_COMPRESSION=gzip
```
Collector:
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: { endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317 }
      http: { endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318 }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- HTTP endpoint'iga gRPC portini berish (yoki aksincha) — tushunarsiz connection xatolari.
- HTTP'da `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` ga SDK `/v1/traces` qo'shadi, `..._TRACES_ENDPOINT` ga esa qo'shmaydi — yo'l ikki marta yoki yo'q.
