```yaml
  delete_request_store: s3
limits_config:
  retention_period: 30d          # global default
  retention_stream:
    - selector: '{namespace="dev"}'
      priority: 1
      period: 7d
    - selector: '{app="audit"}'
      priority: 2
      period: 365d
```
Tenant bo'yicha — `runtime_config` overrides'da `retention_period`.
Tekshirish: `loki_compactor_apply_retention_last_successful_run_timestamp_seconds`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `retention_enabled` yoqilmagan — `retention_period` yozilgan, lekin hech narsa o'chmaydi.
- S3 lifecycle rule'ni Loki retention'dan qisqa qo'yish — index bor, chunk yo'q, so'rovlar xato beradi.
- Retention 24h index period'ga karrali bo'lishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p darajali retention (dev 7d, prod 30d, audit 1y) xarajatni keskin kamaytiradi. Juda uzoq saqlash kerak bo'lsa (compliance), Loki'dan ko'ra arzonroq arxiv (S3 Glacier) va alohida pipeline ko'rib chiqing.

41743.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Prometheus har scrape uchun `up` series yozadi: muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa `1`, yiqilsa `0`. Alert: `up == 0` bir necha daqiqa (`for: 2m`) davom etsa — target yoki exporter yiqilgan.

**Nega `for` kerak:** bitta scrape timeout (tarmoq pirpirashi) page qilmasligi uchun. 2-5 daqiqa — shovqin va tezlik o'rtasida muvozanat.

```
scrape OK  -> up=1
scrape xato (connection refused, timeout, 5xx) -> up=0
target SD'dan yo'qoldi -> up series yo'qoladi (0 emas!) -> absent() kerak
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
groups:
  - name: availability
    rules:
      - alert: TargetDown
        expr: up == 0
        for: 2m
        labels: {severity: warning}
        annotations:
          summary: "{{ $labels.job }} / {{ $labels.instance }} scrape yiqildi"
      - alert: JobMostlyDown
        expr: avg by (job) (up) < 0.5
        for: 5m
        labels: {severity: critical}
      - alert: JobAbsent
        expr: absent(up{job="payment-api"})
        for: 5m
```
Sabab: Status -> Targets sahifasida "Last error" ustuni.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Har instance uchun alohida critical page — 100 pod'li deploy'da 100 page. Job darajasida foiz bilan aggregatsiya qiling.
- Target butunlay yo'qolishini `up == 0` ushlamaydi — `absent()` qo'shing.
- Auto-scaling'da pod o'chishi `up=0` emas (SD'dan chiqadi) — bu to'g'ri, lekin alert yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** `up` — monitoring yetib borishini o'lchaydi, servis sog'ligini emas. Foydalanuvchi ta'siri uchun SLO burn-rate alert asosiy, `TargetDown` esa warning darajasida.

41744.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `redaction` processor — OTel Collector contrib'da span (va log/metrika) atributlaridan sezgir ma'lumotni eksportdan **oldin** tozalaydi: ruxsat etilgan kalitlar ro'yxati (`allowed_keys`), taqiqlanganlar (`blocked_values` regex bilan mask), qolganini o'chirish.

**Nega kerak:** dasturchi tasodifan `user.email`, `Authorization` header yoki karta raqamini span'ga yozadi. U uchinchi tomon SaaS backend'iga ketsa — PCI-DSS/GDPR buzilishi. Collector — markaziy nazorat nuqtasi.

```
app -> span{card="4111111111111111", http.url=".../?token=abc"}
     -> collector: redaction
     -> span{card="****", http.url=".../?token=****"}  -> backend
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
processors:
  redaction:
    allow_all_keys: false
    allowed_keys: [http.request.method, http.route, http.response.status_code, url.path, db.system.name]
    blocked_values:
      - "4[0-9]{12}(?:[0-9]{3})?"          # Visa
      - "(?i)bearer\\s+[a-z0-9._-]+"
    summary: info        # nechta atribut o'chirilganini qo'shadi
```
Log body uchun `transform` processor (OTTL) bilan:
```yaml
transform:
  log_statements:
    - context: log
      statements:
        - replace_pattern(body, "password=\\S+", "password=***")
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `allow_all_keys: false` bilan kerakli atributlarni ro'yxatga kiritishni unutish — trace'lar foydasiz bo'ladi.
- Faqat collector'ga tayanish — ma'lumot app'dan collector'gacha ochiq ketadi; SDK darajasida ham sanitize qiling.
- Regex'lar CPU'ga qimmat — yuqori throughput'da o'lchang.

**Senior nuqta:** Allow-list (ruxsat etilganlar) block-list'dan xavfsizroq: yangi sezgir maydon avtomatik tushib qoladi. Redaction'ni unit test qiling (namuna span bilan) — PII oqishi audit'da topilganda kech bo'ladi.

41745.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Span metrics — trace span'laridan real vaqtda **RED** metrikalarini (Rate, Errors, Duration histogram) hosil qilish: servis, operatsiya, status bo'yicha. Tempo **metrics-generator** yoki OTel Collector **spanmetrics connector** bajaradi; natija Prometheus'ga remote write qilinadi.

**Nega kerak:** har servisda qo'lda RED metrikalarini yozish shart emas — tracing bor joyda metrika avtomatik. Bundan tashqari metrika va trace bir xil manbadan, mos.

```
app --spans--> collector
                 +-- spanmetrics connector --> calls_total, duration_bucket --> Prometheus
                 +-- tail_sampling --> Tempo (faqat 10%)
Metrika 100% span'dan hisoblanadi, trace esa sample'langan.
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
connectors:
  spanmetrics:
    histogram:
      explicit: {buckets: [50ms, 100ms, 250ms, 500ms, 1s, 2s, 5s]}
    dimensions:
      - name: http.request.method
      - name: http.response.status_code
    exemplars: {enabled: true}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:          {receivers: [otlp], exporters: [spanmetrics, otlp/tempo]}
    metrics/span:    {receivers: [spanmetrics], exporters: [prometheusremotewrite]}
```
```promql
sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]))
  / sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total[5m]))
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sampling'dan keyin hisoblash — rate 10 barobar kam chiqadi.
- `dimensions` ga `user_id`, `url.full` qo'shish — cardinality portlaydi; `http.route` ishlating.
- Tail sampling bilan bir collector'da — span'lar loadbalancing'dan oldin hisoblanishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Span metrics + exemplar = metrikadan bir bosishda trace'ga. Lekin ilova ichidagi biznes metrikalarini (buyurtma summasi) almashtirmaydi — u faqat request darajasidagi RED.

41746.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Prometheus TSDB disk'dagi block (chunk va index) fayllarini **mmap** qiladi: fayl OS virtual xotirasiga bog'lanadi, o'qishda kernel page cache'dan beradi. Head block'ning to'lgan chunk'lari ham diskka yozilib mmap qilinadi. Natija: Go heap kichik, ma'lumot ikki marta nusxalanmaydi.

**Nega muhim:** `top` da Prometheus RSS katta ko'rinadi, lekin uning bir qismi page cache — kernel bosim bo'lsa qaytarib oladi. Haqiqiy xavf — Go heap (head series, so'rovlar).

```
Disk block'lar (chunks/, index) --mmap--> virtual memory --> page cache
Head block: aktiv chunk RAM'da, to'lgani (120 sample) -> chunks_head/ -> mmap
Go heap: series metadata, label'lar, query natijalari
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
go_memstats_heap_inuse_bytes{job="prometheus"}     # haqiqiy heap
process_resident_memory_bytes{job="prometheus"}    # RSS (mmap sahifalari ham kiradi)
prometheus_tsdb_head_chunks
```
```bash
cat /proc/$(pidof prometheus)/smaps_rollup   # Rss, Pss, Anonymous (heap) vs File-backed
```
Kubernetes'da memory limit: container_memory_working_set ga page cache'ning faol qismi ham kiradi — limitni heap'dan ancha yuqori qo'ying.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- RSS'ga qarab "leak" deb o'ylash — file-backed sahifalarni Anonymous'dan ajrating.
- NFS kabi tarmoq fayl tizimida TSDB — mmap va lock bilan muammolar; Prometheus buni qo'llab-quvvatlamaydi.
- Juda tor memory limit — kernel page cache'ni siqib, disk I/O va query latency keskin oshadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Prometheus xotirasini rejalashtirishda formula: head series x ~4KB + query budjet + page cache uchun bo'sh joy. `GOMEMLIMIT` (v3 da avtomatik container limit'idan) GC'ni limitga moslashtiradi.

41747.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Mimir multi-tenancy: har so'rov (write va read) `X-Scope-OrgID` HTTP header'ida tenant ID olib keladi. Mimir ma'lumotni, rule'larni, Alertmanager config'ni va limitlarni (series soni, ingest rate) shu ID bo'yicha **qat'iy ajratadi**. Autentifikatsiyani Mimir qilmaydi — oldidagi gateway qiladi.

**Nega kerak:** bitta Mimir klasteri 20 jamoaga xizmat qiladi; bitta jamoaning cardinality portlashi boshqalarni yiqitmasligi va ular bir-birining ma'lumotini ko'rmasligi kerak.

```
Prometheus (team-a) --remote_write + X-Scope-OrgID: team-a--> gateway(auth) --> distributor
Grafana DS (team-a) --query + X-Scope-OrgID: team-a-------->               --> querier
                                         per-tenant limits: max_global_series_per_user ...
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# Prometheus
remote_write:
  - url: https://mimir.example/api/v1/push
    headers: {X-Scope-OrgID: team-a}
```
Runtime overrides:
```yaml
overrides:
  team-a:
    ingestion_rate: 200000
    max_global_series_per_user: 3000000
    compactor_blocks_retention_period: 90d
```
Bir nechta tenant'ni birga so'rash (federation): `X-Scope-OrgID: team-a|team-b` (`tenant_federation.enabled: true`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Header'ni client o'zi qo'yadi — gateway'siz istalgan kishi boshqa tenant nomini yozib ma'lumotni o'qiydi.
- `multitenancy_enabled: false` — hamma `anonymous` tenant'ga tushadi.
- Juda ko'p mayda tenant — har biri uchun alohida block/compaction overhead.

**Senior nuqta:** Tenant chegarasini jamoa/xarajat markazi bo'yicha belgilang va limitlarni xarajat budjetiga bog'lang. Gateway'da (masalan, OIDC token'dan) tenant ID'ni server tomonda chiqarish — client'ga ishonmaslik.

41748.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Span event — span ichidagi **vaqt belgili** hodisa: nomi, timestamp va atributlari bor, lekin o'z davomiyligi yo'q. Masalan `cache_miss`, `retry attempt=2`, `token_validated`. Exception'lar ham `exception` nomli event sifatida yoziladi.

**Nega kerak:** har kichik qadam uchun alohida span ochish qimmat va waterfall'ni shovqinli qiladi. Event — "span davomida shu daqiqada mana bu bo'ldi" degan arzon belgi, log'ga o'xshaydi, lekin trace kontekstida.

```
[span: GET /order 320ms]
   |-- t+5ms   event: cache_miss {key="order:42"}
   |-- t+12ms  event: retry {attempt=1}
   |-- t+300ms event: exception {exception.type=TimeoutError, exception.message=...}
```

**Amalda (Go):**
```go
span.AddEvent("cache_miss", trace.WithAttributes(attribute.String("cache.key", key)))

if err != nil {
    span.RecordError(err)                 // "exception" event
    span.SetStatus(codes.Error, err.Error())
}
```
TraceQL:
```traceql
{ event:name = "exception" && resource.service.name = "api" }
```

**Span event vs log vs child span:**
| Nima | Qachon |
|---|---|
| Child span | Davomiylik muhim (DB call, HTTP) |
| Span event | Bir lahzalik belgi, trace ichida |
| Log | Mustaqil, ko'p, trace'siz ham kerak |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `RecordError` status'ni o'zi Error qilmaydi — `SetStatus` alohida chaqiriladi.
- Loop ichida minglab event — span hajmi limitga (default 128 event) yetadi, qolgani tashlanadi.
- Event atributlariga PII yozish.

**Senior nuqta:** OTel yo'nalishi — event'larni Logs API orqali yuborish (span events deprecation muhokamasi bor); yangi kodda log + trace_id korrelyatsiyasi ham bir xil natija beradi. Backend'ingiz qaysisini yaxshi ko'rsatishini tekshiring.

41749.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `blackbox_exporter` HTTPS/TCP-TLS probe qilganda `probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry` metrikasini (zanjirdagi eng yaqin tugash vaqti, Unix soniya) chiqaradi. Alert: `probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time() < 14 * 86400` — 14 kundan kam qolganda.

**Nega kerak:** sertifikat muddati tugashi — eng "ahmoqona", lekin eng ko'p uchraydigan outage. cert-manager/ACME auto-renew ham jim yiqilishi mumkin (DNS challenge xatosi, rate limit).

```
Prometheus --> blackbox_exporter /probe?target=https://shop.uz&module=http_2xx
                   -> TLS handshake -> sertifikat zanjiri
                   -> probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry = 1767225600
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: blackbox-https
    metrics_path: /probe
    params: {module: [http_2xx]}
    static_configs:
      - targets: [https://shop.uz, https://api.shop.uz]
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__address__]
        target_label: __param_target
      - source_labels: [__param_target]
        target_label: instance
      - target_label: __address__
        replacement: blackbox-exporter:9115
```
```yaml
- alert: SSLCertExpiringSoon
  expr: (probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time()) / 86400 < 14
  for: 1h
  labels: {severity: warning}
  annotations: {summary: "{{ $labels.instance }}: {{ $value | humanize }} kun qoldi"}
- alert: SSLCertExpiryCritical
  expr: (probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time()) / 86400 < 3
  labels: {severity: critical}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Probe yiqilsa (`probe_success=0`) metrika yo'q — alert jim; `probe_success` alert'ini ham qo'ying.
- LB ortida bir nechta backend turli sertifikat bilan — bitta probe hammasini ko'rmaydi.
- Ichki mTLS sertifikatlari (24 soatlik) uchun 14 kun chegarasi ma'nosiz — alohida qoida.

**Senior nuqta:** Let's Encrypt 90 kunlik (va qisqarish yo'lida) sertifikatlarda renew 30 kun qolganda bo'ladi, shuning uchun 14 kun = "renew 2 hafta yiqilmoqda" signali. cert-manager'da `certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds` bilan ichkaridan ham kuzating.

41750.a:
**Qisqa javob:** LogQL'da tartib: **stream selector** (`{app="api"}`) -> **line filter** (`|= "error"`, `!=`, `|~`) -> **parser** (`| json`, `| logfmt`) -> **label filter** (`| status >= 500`) -> formatlash. Sabab: arzon operatsiyalar avval, parse qilinadigan qatorlar soni kamayadi.

**Nega muhim:** Loki matnni index'lamaydi — faqat label'larni. Selector qaysi chunk'larni yuklashni belgilaydi; line filter oddiy substring qidiruv (juda tez); parser esa har qatorni JSON deserializatsiya qiladi (qimmat).

```
{app="api"}              -> 10 GB chunk yuklanadi (selector toraytiradi)
  |= "error"             -> 50 MB qoladi (tez substring)
  | json                 -> faqat 50 MB parse qilinadi
  | status_code >= 500   -> natija
Teskari tartibda: 10 GB ning hammasi parse qilinadi.
```

**Amalda:**
```logql
# Yaxshi
{namespace="prod", app="api"} |= "error" != "healthcheck" | json | status_code >= 500 | line_format "{{.msg}}"

# Yomon
{namespace="prod"} | json | app="api" | level="error"
```
Metrika so'rov:
```logql
sum by (status_code) (rate({app="api"} |= "error" | json | __error__="" [5m]))
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Selector'da faqat `{namespace="prod"}` — butun namespace yuklanadi; eng tor label'larni qo'shing.
- `|~` regex `|=` dan sekinroq — oddiy substring yetsa `|=`.
- Parser xatolari (`__error__`) — `| __error__=""` bilan tozalang, aks holda aggregatsiya buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Tez-tez filtrlangan maydonni label qilishdan oldin o'ylang: yuqori cardinality label Loki'ni sekinlashtiradi. Yaxshiroq — structured metadata yoki line filter. So'rov statistikasi (`Query inspector`) bilan "bytes processed" ni o'lchang.

41751.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `prometheusremotewrite` exporter — OTel Collector'dagi exporter, OTel metrikalarini Prometheus **remote write** protobuf formatiga aylantirib Prometheus, Mimir, Thanos Receive, VictoriaMetrics, Cortex kabi backend'ga push qiladi.

**Nega kerak:** ilovalar OTLP bilan metrika chiqaradi, lekin saqlash va alerting Prometheus ekotizimida. Exporter ikkalasini bog'laydi: scrape'siz, push modeli.

```
app --OTLP--> collector --(delta->cumulative, nom tarjimasi)--> remote write --> Mimir
   http.server.request.duration (s)  ->  http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket
   resource attrs                    ->  target_info + job/instance
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
exporters:
  prometheusremotewrite:
    endpoint: https://mimir.example/api/v1/push
    headers: {X-Scope-OrgID: team-a}
    resource_to_telemetry_conversion: {enabled: true}   # resource atributlarini label qilish
    remote_write_queue: {enabled: true, queue_size: 10000, num_consumers: 5}
    retry_on_failure: {enabled: true}
processors:
  deltatocumulative: {}      # delta manbalar uchun
```
Muqobil: Prometheus/Mimir'ning o'zi OTLP qabul qiladi (`/api/v1/otlp/v1/metrics`, Prometheus 3.x da `--web.enable-otlp-receiver`) — exporter `otlphttp` bo'ladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Delta temporality'li metrikalar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yuborilsa rad etiladi/buziladi — `deltatocumulative` kerak.
- `resource_to_telemetry_conversion` hamma atributni label qiladi — `k8s.pod.uid` kabi qiymatlar cardinality'ni oshiradi.
- Nomdagi nuqta/birlik tarjimasi — dashboard'larda nom kutilganidan farq qiladi (`_seconds`, `_total` suffikslar).

**Senior nuqta:** 2025 dan boshlab Prometheus va Mimir'ning nativ OTLP ingest'i ko'p hollarda soddaroq (kamroq tarjima qatlami). Remote write exporter'ni eski backend'lar yoki WAL/queue kerak bo'lgan holat uchun saqlang.

41752.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `scrape_timeout` — Prometheus target'ning `/metrics` javobini qancha kutishi (default 10s). Shu vaqtda javob kelmasa scrape yiqilgan hisoblanadi: `up=0`, sample'lar yozilmaydi. Qiymat `scrape_interval` dan katta bo'lishi mumkin emas.

**Nega muhim:** og'ir exporter (masalan, 50k series chiqaradigan DB exporter yoki har scrape'da so'rov yuboradigan cloud exporter) sekin javob beradi. Timeout qisqa bo'lsa — vaqti-vaqti bilan `up=0` va grafikda bo'shliqlar.

```
scrape_interval: 30s
|---- scrape_timeout: 10s ----|
 javob 12s da keldi -> bekor -> up=0, scrape_duration_seconds ~10
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: mysql
    scrape_interval: 60s
    scrape_timeout: 45s
```
Diagnostika:
```promql
scrape_duration_seconds{job="mysql"}                       # timeout'ga yaqinmi
max_over_time(scrape_duration_seconds[1h]) > 8
scrape_samples_scraped
```
Target ham timeout'ni biladi: Prometheus `X-Prometheus-Scrape-Timeout-Seconds` header yuboradi — exporter shu vaqt ichida qisman javob berishi mumkin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Timeout'ni oshirib muammoni yashirish — asl sabab exporter'ning sekinligi (hisoblashni scrape'dan ajrating, cache qiling).
- `scrape_timeout > scrape_interval` — config yuklanmaydi.
- Juda ko'p series — tarmoq transfer'i; `sample_limit` va keraksiz metrikalarni drop qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** `scrape_duration_seconds` ni timeout'ning 80% iga yetganda ogohlantiring. Qimmat metrikalarni (cloud API) alohida, uzunroq interval'li job'ga ajrating.

41753.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana plugin'lari uch asosiy turda: **data source** (yangi ma'lumot manbaiga ulanish: ClickHouse, MongoDB, Jira), **panel** (yangi vizualizatsiya), **app** (data source + panel + sahifalar + dashboard'lar to'plami, masalan Kubernetes monitoring). Frontend React/TypeScript, backend qismi ixtiyoriy Go (plugin SDK).

**Nega backend qismi:** frontend-only data source so'rovni brauzerdan yuboradi — alerting ishlamaydi va kredensial brauzerga chiqadi. Backend plugin so'rovni Grafana server'da bajaradi: alerting, caching, secret'larni server'da saqlash.

```
Brauzer (React panel) --> Grafana server --> backend plugin (Go, alohida process, gRPC)
                                               --> tashqi API / DB
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
grafana cli plugins install grafana-clickhouse-datasource
# yoki container'da:
GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS=grafana-clickhouse-datasource,grafana-polystat-panel
# yangi plugin yaratish:
npx @grafana/create-plugin@latest
```
Imzolanmagan (o'z) plugin uchun:
```ini
[plugins]
allow_loading_unsigned_plugins = my-company-datasource
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Angular asosidagi eski plugin'lar — Grafana 11+ da Angular o'chirilgan, ular ishlamaydi; migratsiya kerak.
- Imzolanmagan plugin'larni hammasiga ruxsat — supply chain xavfi.
- Plugin versiyasini pin qilmaslik — Grafana yangilanganda mos kelmay qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Plugin'larni image ichiga yoki provisioning orqali pin'langan versiya bilan o'rnating (GitOps). Ichki tizim uchun plugin yozishdan oldin mavjud Infinity/JSON API data source yetarli emasligini tekshiring.

41754.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `repeat_interval` — alert hali **firing** bo'lsa, xuddi shu xabarni qayta yuborishdan oldin Alertmanager qancha kutishi (default 4h). Masalan disk to'liq bo'lib qolsa, har 4 soatda eslatma.

**Nega kerak:** juda qisqa — kanal spam, odamlar e'tibor bermay qo'yadi (alert fatigue). Juda uzun — unutilgan alert yana eslanmaydi.

```
t=0     alert firing -> group_wait (30s) -> 1-xabar
t+5m    yangi alert guruhga qo'shildi -> group_interval -> yangilangan xabar
t+4h    o'zgarish yo'q, hali firing -> repeat_interval -> eslatma
```
Muhim: amalda takror yuborish `group_interval` ga karrali vaqtda bo'ladi (eng yaqin keyingi tick).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
route:
  receiver: slack
  group_by: [alertname, cluster]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  routes:
    - matchers: [severity="critical"]
      receiver: pagerduty
      repeat_interval: 1h     # PagerDuty o'zi escalation qiladi
    - matchers: [severity="info"]
      receiver: slack-info
      repeat_interval: 24h
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PagerDuty'ga qisqa repeat — u dedup qiladi, foydasi yo'q; escalation PagerDuty'da sozlanadi.
- `repeat_interval` < `group_interval` — mantiqsiz, amalda group_interval'ga yaxlitlanadi.
- Alertmanager restart'da notification log (nflog) yo'qolsa takroriy xabarlar — HA va persistent storage.

**Senior nuqta:** Repeat eslatmalari ko'p bo'lsa bu alert ega va action'ga ega emas degani — muammo interval'da emas, alert dizaynida. Uzoq davom etayotgan warning'lar ticket'ga aylantirilsin.

41755.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `TracerProvider` — OTel SDK'da tracing'ning markaziy obyekti: Tracer'larni yaratadi va barcha span'lar uchun umumiy sozlamalarni ushlaydi — **Resource** (service.name), **Sampler**, **SpanProcessor**'lar (Batch) va ular orqali **Exporter**. Ilova boshida bir marta yaratiladi, oxirida `Shutdown` bilan flush qilinadi.

```
TracerProvider
  +-- Resource {service.name=order-api, version=1.4}
  +-- Sampler: ParentBased(TraceIdRatio 0.1)
  +-- BatchSpanProcessor --> OTLP exporter --> collector:4317
  +-- Tracer("orders/http"), Tracer("orders/db") ...
```

**Amalda (Go):**
```go
exp, _ := otlptracegrpc.New(ctx)
tp := sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(
    sdktrace.WithBatcher(exp),
    sdktrace.WithResource(resource.NewWithAttributes(semconv.SchemaURL,
        semconv.ServiceName("order-api"), semconv.ServiceVersion("1.4.0"))),
    sdktrace.WithSampler(sdktrace.ParentBased(sdktrace.TraceIDRatioBased(0.1))),
)
otel.SetTracerProvider(tp)
otel.SetTextMapPropagator(propagation.TraceContext{})
defer func() {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
    defer cancel()
    _ = tp.Shutdown(ctx) // buferdagi span'larni yuboradi
}()
```
Env bilan sozlash: `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Shutdown` chaqirilmaydi — qisqa umrli job/Lambda'da oxirgi span'lar yo'qoladi.
- Global provider o'rnatilmagan — kutubxonalar no-op tracer ishlatadi, trace bo'sh.
- `SimpleSpanProcessor` prod'da — har span sinxron eksport, latency oshadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Provider bitta, Tracer'lar ko'p (kutubxona nomi bilan — instrumentation scope). Testlarda in-memory exporter bilan provider yaratib span'larni assert qilish — instrumentatsiyani test qilishning eng oson yo'li.

41756.a:
**Qisqa javob:** PromQL label matcher'lari: `=~` — label qiymati regex'ga **mos keladi**, `!~` — **mos kelmaydi**. Regex RE2 sintaksisida va **to'liq moslanadi** (avtomatik `^...$`), ya'ni `=~"api"` faqat aynan `api` ni tanlaydi.

**Misollar:**
```promql
http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}                 # 500-599
http_requests_total{method=~"GET|HEAD"}            # yoki
http_requests_total{handler!~"/health|/metrics"}   # bularsiz
up{job=~"api.*"}                                   # api bilan boshlanadigan
container_memory_usage_bytes{namespace=~"team-a-.*", container!=""}
```

```
=   aniq teng           job="api"
!=  teng emas           env!="dev"
=~  regex mos (to'liq)  status=~"5.."
!~  regex mos emas      path!~"/internal/.*"
```

**Amalda (Grafana variable):**
```promql
sum by (pod) (rate(http_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))
```
Multi-value variable Grafana'da `(a|b|c)` ko'rinishiga aylanadi — shuning uchun `=~` ishlatiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `{job=~"api"}` dan `api-gateway` ham kutish — to'liq moslik sabab yo'q; `api.*` kerak.
- Faqat `!~` yoki bo'sh mos keladigan matcher bilan selector — `{job!~"x"}` xato: "kamida bitta bo'sh bo'lmagan matcher kerak". `__name__` yoki boshqa matcher qo'shing.
- Bo'sh label: `label=~".*"` label yo'q series'ni ham tanlaydi; `label=~".+"` faqat bor bo'lganlarini.

**Senior nuqta:** Regex matcher'lar index'da sekinroq (ayniqsa `.*foo`); yuqori cardinality metrikada aniq `=` afzal. Murakkab regex'ni dashboard'da emas, recording rule'da bir marta hisoblang.

41757.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Explore — Grafana'dagi ad-hoc so'rov rejimi: dashboard yaratmasdan va o'zgartirmasdan istalgan data source'ga PromQL, LogQL, TraceQL yozib natijani ko'rish. Debug va incident tahlili uchun asosiy ish joyi.

**Nega kerak:** incident paytida dashboard'da yo'q savol tug'iladi ("faqat shu pod log'lari?"). Dashboard'ni tahrirlash boshqalarga xalaqit beradi; Explore — xavfsiz qoralama.

```
Explore (split view)
  chap: Prometheus  rate(errors[5m])  --exemplar--> Tempo trace
  o'ng: Loki {pod="api-7x"} |= "error"  --trace_id link--> Tempo
Trace span --> "Logs for this span" --> Loki; --> "Profiles" --> Pyroscope
```

**Amalda:**
- Split view: ikki so'rovni yonma-yon, vaqt bir xil sinxron.
- Query history: oxirgi so'rovlar saqlanadi, yulduzcha bilan.
- "Add to dashboard" — topilgan foydali so'rovni panelga aylantirish.
- Correlations / derived fields: log'dagi `trace_id=(\w+)` ni Tempo havolasiga aylantirish:
```yaml
datasources:
  - name: Loki
    type: loki
    jsonData:
      derivedFields:
        - name: TraceID
          matcherRegex: 'trace_id=(\w+)'
          url: '$${__value.raw}'
          datasourceUid: tempo
```
- Explore Metrics/Logs/Traces ("Drilldown" ilovalari) — so'rov yozmasdan bosib tahlil qilish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Explore ruxsati — Viewer'larga default yopiq bo'lishi mumkin (`viewers_can_edit` / RBAC).
- Juda keng vaqt oralig'i va tor bo'lmagan selector — backend'ni yuklaydi.
- Derived field'lar sozlanmagan — log'dan trace'ga o'tish qo'lda nusxalash.

**Senior nuqta:** Explore'ning kuchi — signallar orasidagi bog'lanish (metrika -> exemplar -> trace -> log -> profil). Shu bog'lanishlarni (exemplars, derived fields, trace-to-logs) oldindan sozlash MTTR'ni eng ko'p qisqartiradigan ish.

41758.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `group_wait` — yangi alert guruhi paydo bo'lganda Alertmanager **birinchi** xabarni yuborishdan oldin qancha kutishi (default 30s). Shu vaqt ichida bir xil guruhga tushgan boshqa alert'lar ham bitta xabarga yig'iladi.

**Nega kerak:** node yiqilsa 40 ta pod alert'i bir necha soniya farq bilan keladi. `group_wait` bo'lmasa 40 ta alohida xabar; bilan — bitta "40 alert firing" xabari.

```
t=0s   alert A (cluster=eu) -> yangi guruh, timer boshlanadi
t=8s   alert B (cluster=eu) -> shu guruhga
t=20s  alert C (cluster=eu) -> shu guruhga
t=30s  group_wait tugadi -> 1 ta xabar: A, B, C
keyin  yangi alert'lar -> group_interval bo'yicha
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
route:
  group_by: [alertname, cluster, namespace]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  routes:
    - matchers: [severity="critical"]
      group_wait: 10s     # critical tezroq
```

**Uchlik farqi:**
| Parametr | Qachon ishlaydi |
|---|---|
| `group_wait` | yangi guruhning birinchi xabari |
| `group_interval` | guruh o'zgarganda keyingi xabar |
| `repeat_interval` | o'zgarishsiz takror eslatma |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Juda uzun (5m) — critical alert kechikadi; Prometheus `for:` bilan qo'shilganda umumiy kechikish kattalashadi.
- `group_by` noto'g'ri — guruhlash bo'lmasa group_wait foyda bermaydi.
- `group_by: ['...']` — har alert alohida guruh.

**Senior nuqta:** Umumiy "detection latency" = scrape interval + rule evaluation + `for` + `group_wait`. SLO burn-rate alert'larida buni hisoblab qo'ying — 2% budjet yonishini 15 daqiqada aniqlash kerak bo'lsa, har bosqich budjetga kiradi.

41759.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Jaeger o'z client kutubxonalari va maxsus Jaeger exporter'larini **deprecated** qildi: Jaeger backend endi OTLP'ni nativ qabul qiladi (gRPC 4317, HTTP 4318). Shuning uchun ilovada standart OTel SDK + OTLP exporter ishlatiladi; OTel Collector ham `jaeger` exporter'ini olib tashlagan (`otlp` exporter bilan Jaeger'ga yuboriladi).

**Tarix:**
```
2017-2021: Jaeger client (jaeger-client-go, java) + Thrift/UDP 6831 agent
2022:      Jaeger client'lar deprecated, OTel SDK tavsiya; Jaeger OTLP qabul qila boshladi
2023:      OTel SDK'lardan Jaeger exporter olib tashlandi, Collector'dan ham
2024-25:   Jaeger v2 — OTel Collector asosida qurilgan, jaeger-agent yo'q
```

**Migratsiya:**
```
Eski:  app (jaeger-client) --UDP 6831--> jaeger-agent --> jaeger-collector
Yangi: app (OTel SDK) --OTLP 4317--> [OTel Collector] --OTLP--> Jaeger v2
```
```bash
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://jaeger-collector:4317
export OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=order-api
export OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,baggage,jaeger   # o'tish davrida eski header ham
```
Collector:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/jaeger:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector:4317
    tls: {insecure: true}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Propagation: eski servislar `uber-trace-id` header yuboradi, yangilari `traceparent` — o'tish davrida ikkala propagator, aks holda trace'lar uziladi.
- jaeger-agent sidecar/DaemonSet'ni olib tashlashni unutish — ortiqcha resurs.
- Jaeger v1 config'lari v2 da ishlamaydi (YAML formati OTel Collector'niki).

**Senior nuqta:** Instrumentatsiyani vendor-neutral (OTel) qilish backend'ni keyin almashtirishni (Jaeger -> Tempo) faqat collector config o'zgarishiga aylantiradi. Bu tracing'dagi eng katta arxitektura yutuq.

41760.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Prometheus bir vaqtda bajariladigan PromQL so'rovlar sonini `--query.max-concurrency` (default 20) bilan cheklaydi; qolganlari navbatda kutadi. Bunga yana `--query.timeout` (default 2m) va `--query.max-samples` (bitta so'rov xotiraga yuklaydigan sample'lar, default 50M) qo'shiladi. Maqsad — og'ir dashboard'lar Prometheus'ni OOM qilmasligi.

**Muammo:** 30 kishi bir vaqtda 7 kunlik, 50 panelli dashboard ochadi -> yuzlab og'ir so'rov parallel -> xotira portlaydi -> Prometheus yiqiladi -> alerting ham to'xtaydi.

```
so'rovlar --> [semafor: max 20 parallel] --> engine
                 | navbat (kutish, timeout'ga qadar)
har so'rov: max_samples dan oshsa -> "query processing would load too many samples"
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
prometheus \
  --query.max-concurrency=20 \
  --query.timeout=1m \
  --query.max-samples=30000000 \
  --query.lookback-delta=5m
```
Kuzatish:
```promql
prometheus_engine_queries                  # hozir bajarilayotgan
prometheus_engine_queries_concurrent_max
prometheus_engine_query_duration_seconds{slice="inner_eval", quantile="0.9"}
```
Sekin so'rovlarni topish: `--query.log-file` (yoki v3 da config'da `query_log_file`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Concurrency'ni oshirish — muammoni OOM'ga ko'chiradi.
- Rule evaluation ham shu engine'dan foydalanadi — dashboard yuki alert'larni kechiktiradi.
- Grafana'da refresh 5s va "Last 30 days" — eng ko'p uchraydigan aybdor.

**Senior nuqta:** Katta tashkilotda o'qish yo'lini ajrating: alerting uchun Prometheus, dashboard'lar uchun query-frontend (Thanos/Mimir) caching va so'rovni bo'laklash (splitting) bilan. Og'ir panellarni recording rule'larga ko'chiring.

41761.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana Live — Grafana'ning real vaqt streaming tizimi: server brauzer bilan doimiy **WebSocket** ulanish ochadi va ma'lumotni panellarga push qiladi (refresh polling o'rniga). Manbalar: streaming qo'llovchi data source plugin'lar, `/api/live/push` HTTP endpoint (Influx line protocol) va dashboard o'zgarishlari haqida xabarlar.

**Nega kerak:** 1s refresh polling har panel uchun har soniya so'rov — backend'ga katta yuk va baribir kechikadi. Push modelida ma'lumot kelishi bilan ko'rinadi (IoT sensor, trading, live deploy holati).

```
Polling:  brauzer --(har 5s so'rov)--> Grafana --> Prometheus
Live:     manba --push--> Grafana Live (channel) ==WebSocket==> brauzer panellar
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Ma'lumot push qilish (Influx line protocol)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  http://grafana:3000/api/live/push/sensors \
  --data-binary 'temperature,room=a value=23.4'
```
Panelda data source: `-- Grafana --` -> "Live Measurements" -> kanal `stream/sensors/temperature`.
```ini
[live]
max_connections = 100
allowed_origins = https://grafana.example.com
```
Ko'p replica'li Grafana'da HA uchun Redis engine (`ha_engine = redis`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Reverse proxy (nginx) WebSocket upgrade header'larini o'tkazmaydi — Live ishlamaydi.
- `max_connections` default kichik — NOC ekranlari ko'p bo'lsa limit.
- Live ma'lumot saqlanmaydi — sahifa yangilansa tarix yo'q; saqlash uchun alohida TSDB.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p operatsion monitoring uchun 10-30s refresh yetarli va soddaroq; Live'ni haqiqiy sub-second talab bo'lgandagina ishlating — u qo'shimcha infratuzilma (WebSocket, HA engine) talab qiladi.

41762.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `group_interval` — guruh uchun birinchi xabar yuborilgandan keyin, shu guruhga **yangi** alert qo'shilsa (yoki biri resolved bo'lsa) yangilangan xabarni yuborishdan oldin kutish vaqti (default 5m).

**Nega kerak:** incident rivojlanayotganda har yangi alert uchun darhol xabar — spam. `group_interval` o'zgarishlarni to'plab, har 5 daqiqada bitta yangilanish yuboradi.

```
t=0     A firing -> group_wait 30s -> xabar #1 [A]
t=1m    B qo'shildi -> kutadi
t=3m    C qo'shildi -> kutadi
t=5m30s group_interval tick -> xabar #2 [A, B, C]
t=7m    A resolved -> keyingi tick (10m30s) da xabar #3 (send_resolved bo'lsa)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
route:
  group_by: [alertname, cluster]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
```
Tekshirish:
```bash
amtool alert query --alertmanager.url=http://am:9093
curl -s http://am:9093/api/v2/alerts/groups | jq '.[].labels'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Uzun `group_interval` (30m) — yangi critical alert shu guruhga tushsa 30 daqiqa kechikadi.
- Resolved xabarlari ham `group_interval` ga bog'liq — "nega resolved kech keldi?" savolining javobi.
- `repeat_interval` amalda `group_interval` ga karrali — 4h repeat, 7m interval bo'lsa ~4h12m.

**Senior nuqta:** Critical route'larda `group_interval` ni qisqaroq (1-2m), info'larda uzunroq qiling. Guruhlash kalitlari (`group_by`) noto'g'ri bo'lsa bu taymerlarni tuning qilish foydasiz.

41763.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Injection** — chiquvchi so'rovga (HTTP header, gRPC metadata, Kafka header) joriy trace context'ni yozish. **Extraction** — kiruvchi so'rovdan context'ni o'qib, yangi span'ni uning farzandi qilish. Ikkalasini **propagator** (W3C TraceContext, Baggage, B3) bajaradi.

**Nega kerak:** trace servislar orasida faqat shu ikki amal orqali "uzilmaydi". Bitta servis extraction qilmasa — trace ikkiga bo'linadi.

```
Service A                                  Service B
span(ctx) --Inject--> traceparent: 00-<trace-id>-<span-id>-01 --> Extract --> ctx
                       (HTTP header)                               span (parent = A)
```
`traceparent` formati: `version-traceid(32 hex)-parentid(16 hex)-flags` (`01` = sampled).

**Amalda (Go):**
```go
// Client: inject
req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "GET", url, nil)
otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Inject(ctx, propagation.HeaderCarrier(req.Header))

// Server: extract
ctx := otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Extract(r.Context(), propagation.HeaderCarrier(r.Header))
ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, "GET /orders", trace.WithSpanKind(trace.SpanKindServer))
```
Amalda `otelhttp.NewHandler` va `otelhttp.NewTransport` buni avtomatik qiladi.
```go
otel.SetTextMapPropagator(propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(
    propagation.TraceContext{}, propagation.Baggage{}))
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Propagator o'rnatilmagan (default no-op) — header yozilmaydi.
- `context.Background()` bilan yangi so'rov — ctx yo'qoladi, inject bo'sh.
- Proxy/API gateway header'ni o'chiradi yoki o'z formatini (B3) ishlatadi — composite propagator.

**Senior nuqta:** Trust boundary'da (tashqi client'dan kelgan `traceparent`) ehtiyot: tashqi trace ID'ni qabul qilish yoki yangisini boshlab link qilish siyosatini aniqlang — aks holda tashqi tomon sampling qaroringizni boshqaradi.

41764.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Instant vector** — har series uchun bitta (baholash vaqtidagi) qiymat: `http_requests_total`. **Range vector** — har series uchun vaqt oynasidagi barcha sample'lar: `http_requests_total[5m]`. Range vector to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chizilmaydi; `rate()`, `increase()`, `avg_over_time()` kabi funksiya uni instant vector'ga aylantiradi.

```
Instant:  http_requests_total{pod="a"}       -> 1520 @ 12:00
Range:    http_requests_total{pod="a"}[1m]   -> [1490@11:59:15, 1500@11:59:30,
                                                  1510@11:59:45, 1520@12:00:00]
rate(...[1m])                                -> 0.67 /s (instant vector)
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
http_requests_total                          # instant: grafikda chiziladi
rate(http_requests_total[5m])                # range -> instant
avg_over_time(node_load1[10m])               # gauge uchun oyna o'rtachasi
max_over_time(up[1h])                        # oxirgi soatda tirik bo'lganmi
```
Grafana "Query type: Instant" — faqat oxirgi qiymat (stat panel); "Range" — har `step` da instant so'rovni takrorlab grafik chizadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `http_requests_total[5m]` ni range query'da chizish — xato: "range vector'ni chizib bo'lmaydi".
- Oyna `scrape_interval` ning kamida 4 baravari bo'lsin (`[1m]` 30s scrape bilan — 2 sample, shovqinli yoki bo'sh). Grafana'da `$__rate_interval`.
- `rate()` faqat counter'ga; gauge'ga `deriv()` yoki `*_over_time`.

**Senior nuqta:** Grafik ostida range query = ko'p instant so'rovlar; oyna (`[5m]`) va `step` munosabati natijaga ta'sir qiladi — step oynadan katta bo'lsa ma'lumot o'tkazib yuboriladi. `$__rate_interval` buni avtomatik hal qiladi.

41765.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana har dashboard saqlanganda yangi **versiya** yozadi (kim, qachon, izoh bilan). Settings -> Versions'da ikki versiyani **diff** qilish (JSON yoki vizual) va istalganiga **restore** qilish mumkin.

**Nega kerak:** kimdir muhim panelni o'chirdi yoki so'rovni buzdi — incident paytida "kecha ishlardi". Version history bilan bir daqiqada qaytarasiz.

```
v12 (Ali, 10:02 "threshold 300ms")
v13 (Vali, 14:30 "panel o'chirildi")   <- muammo
Restore v12 -> v14 yaratiladi (tarix o'chmaydi)
```

**Amalda:**
- UI: Dashboard -> Settings -> Versions -> ikki versiyani belgilash -> "Compare" -> "Restore".
- API:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" https://grafana/api/dashboards/uid/$UID/versions | jq '.[] | {version, createdBy, message}'
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://grafana/api/dashboards/uid/$UID/restore -d '{"version": 12}'
```
- Saqlanadigan versiyalar soni: `[dashboards] versions_to_keep = 20`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Provisioned (fayldan) dashboard'larni UI'da tahrirlash — keyingi provisioning ustidan yozadi.
- Version history Grafana DB'sida — DB backup bo'lmasa u ham yo'q.
- Izohsiz saqlash — 50 ta "Save" orasidan keraklisini topish qiyin.

**Senior nuqta:** Version history — xavfsizlik to'ri, manba haqiqat emas. Muhim dashboard'larni Git'da (Jsonnet/Grafonnet, Terraform, yoki Grafana Git Sync) saqlang; UI tarixi esa tezkor undo uchun.

41766.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Alertmanager webhook receiver'ga POST qilinadigan JSON: guruh darajasida `version`, `groupKey`, `status` (`firing`/`resolved`), `receiver`, `groupLabels`, `commonLabels`, `commonAnnotations`, `externalURL`, `truncatedAlerts` va `alerts[]` ro'yxati — har birida `status`, `labels`, `annotations`, `startsAt`, `endsAt`, `generatorURL`, `fingerprint`.

**Nega bilish kerak:** o'z incident botingizni, ticket yaratuvchini yoki auto-remediation'ni yozganda aynan shu payload'ni parse qilasiz.

**Namuna:**
```json
{
  "version": "4",
  "groupKey": "{}/{severity=\"critical\"}:{alertname=\"HighErrorRate\"}",
  "status": "firing",
  "receiver": "ops-webhook",
  "groupLabels": {"alertname": "HighErrorRate"},
  "commonLabels": {"alertname": "HighErrorRate", "severity": "critical", "service": "api"},
  "commonAnnotations": {"summary": "API error rate 7%"},
  "externalURL": "http://alertmanager:9093",
  "truncatedAlerts": 0,
  "alerts": [{
    "status": "firing",
    "labels": {"alertname": "HighErrorRate", "pod": "api-7x"},
    "annotations": {"runbook_url": "https://wiki/runbooks/api"},
    "startsAt": "2026-10-03T09:00:00Z",
    "endsAt": "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "generatorURL": "http://prometheus:9090/graph?g0.expr=...",
    "fingerprint": "a1b2c3d4"
  }]
}
```
```yaml
receivers:
  - name: ops-webhook
    webhook_configs:
      - url: https://incident-bot/alert
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 20
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Idempotentlik: bir xil guruh qayta yuboriladi (repeat, HA) — `groupKey` + `fingerprint` bo'yicha dedup qiling.
- `endsAt` firing'da nol-sana — uni haqiqiy vaqt deb parse qilmang.
- Webhook sekin javob bersa timeout va retry — handler tez 2xx qaytarib, ishni navbatga qo'ysin.

**Senior nuqta:** Auto-remediation webhook'lari xavfli: dublikat va kechikkan xabarlarga chidamli, rate-limit'li va dry-run rejimli bo'lsin. `fingerprint` — alert'ning barqaror ID'si, ticket bilan bog'lash uchun.

41767.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Instrumentation scope — telemetriyani (span, metrika, log) **qaysi kutubxona yoki modul** yaratganini bildiradi: nomi, versiyasi, ixtiyoriy schema URL va atributlar. `tracer := otel.Tracer("go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/.../otelhttp", trace.WithInstrumentationVersion("0.60.0"))` dagi nom — scope.

**Nega kerak:** bitta servisda HTTP, gRPC, DB auto-instrumentatsiyasi va o'z kodingiz span chiqaradi. Scope bo'yicha: qaysi kutubxona shovqin qilyapti, qaysi versiyada bug bor, qaysi scope'ni o'chirish kerak — ajratish mumkin.

```
Resource {service.name=order-api}           <- QAYSI servis
  Scope {name=otelhttp, version=0.60.0}     <- QAYSI kutubxona
     span: GET /orders
  Scope {name=github.com/acme/orders, version=1.4}
     span: calculate discount
```
Avval "instrumentation library" deb atalgan.

**Amalda:**
```go
var tracer = otel.Tracer("github.com/acme/orders/pricing")
var meter  = otel.Meter("github.com/acme/orders/pricing")
```
TraceQL:
```traceql
{ instrumentation.name = "otelhttp" && duration > 1s }
```
Prometheus'ga eksportda scope `otel_scope_name`, `otel_scope_version` label'lari bo'ladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hamma joyda bo'sh nom `otel.Tracer("")` — kelib chiqishni ajratib bo'lmaydi.
- Scope nomiga dinamik qiymat (request ID) — scope'lar soni portlaydi.
- Collector'da scope bo'yicha filtrlash imkonini bilmaslik — shovqinli kutubxonani `filter` processor bilan tashlash mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Scope nomi sifatida paket/modul yo'lini ishlating — barqaror va noyob. SDK `Views` bilan muayyan scope'ning metrikalarini o'chirish yoki bucket'larini o'zgartirish mumkin — bu xarajatni nazorat qilishning nozik vositasi.

41768.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `labeldrop` — relabeling action: **nomi** regex'ga mos keladigan label'larni o'chiradi. `metric_relabel_configs` da ishlatilganda ingest'dan oldin, cardinality'ni kamaytirish uchun. Teskarisi — `labelkeep` (faqat mos kelganlarni qoldiradi).

**Nega kerak:** exporter `pod_template_hash`, `controller_revision_hash`, `request_id` kabi foydasiz yoki cheksiz label chiqaradi — series soni va xotira o'sadi.

```
oldin:  http_requests_total{method="GET", path="/a", request_id="7f3a..."}  (har so'rov yangi series)
labeldrop request_id
keyin:  http_requests_total{method="GET", path="/a"}
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: api
    metric_relabel_configs:
      - action: labeldrop
        regex: "request_id|session_id|pod_template_hash"
```
Natijani tekshirish:
```promql
count by (__name__) ({job="api"})
prometheus_tsdb_head_series
```
Muhim farq: `labeldrop` `regex` ni label **nomiga** qo'llaydi; `source_labels` ishlatilmaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- To'qnashuv: label o'chirilgach ikki series bir xil bo'lib qolsa — "duplicate sample for timestamp" xatolari va ma'lumot yo'qolishi. Faqat haqiqatan ortiqcha label'ni o'chiring.
- `relabel_configs` (target) va `metric_relabel_configs` (series) ni chalkashtirish — target bosqichida metrika label'lari hali yo'q.
- `job`, `instance` ni o'chirish — `up` va target bog'lanishi buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Agregatsiya kerak bo'lsa (masalan `pod` bo'yicha emas, umumiy) `labeldrop` emas, recording rule bilan `sum without (pod)` to'g'ri — sum qilinadi, to'qnashmaydi. `labeldrop` faqat informatsion qiymati yo'q label'lar uchun.

41769.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana **organization** — bitta Grafana instance ichidagi to'liq ajratilgan muhit: har org'ning o'z dashboard'lari, data source'lari, foydalanuvchi rollari, alert'lari bor. Foydalanuvchi bir nechta org'ga a'zo bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bir vaqtda bittasida ishlaydi.

**Qachon ishlatiladi:** mijozlar yoki butunlay alohida bo'linmalar bitta Grafana'da, lekin bir-birining ma'lumotini umuman ko'rmasligi kerak (MSP, white-label).

```
Grafana instance
  +-- Org 1 "Acme"   : DS Prometheus-acme, dashboards, users
  +-- Org 2 "Globex" : DS Prometheus-globex, dashboards, users
Ular orasida dashboard/DS ulashish yo'q.
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -u admin:$P \
  https://grafana/api/orgs -d '{"name":"Globex"}'
curl -X POST -u admin:$P https://grafana/api/orgs/2/users \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"loginOrEmail":"ali@globex.com","role":"Editor"}'
```
OAuth bilan org mapping:
```ini
[auth.generic_oauth]
org_mapping = globex-admins:2:Admin, *:1:Viewer
```

**Org vs Team/Folder:**
| Kerak | Yechim |
|---|---|
| To'liq izolyatsiya (mijozlar) | Organization |
| Bitta kompaniya ichidagi jamoalar | Team + Folder permission |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Jamoalar uchun org ishlatish — umumiy dashboard'larni har org'ga nusxalash, provisioning murakkablashadi.
- Data source izolyatsiyasi faqat Grafana darajasida — backend (Mimir) tenant'larini ham ajratish kerak.
- Server admin hamma org'ni ko'radi.

**Senior nuqta:** Grafana jamoasi o'zi ham kompaniya ichidagi bo'linish uchun org emas, folder + team + RBAC'ni tavsiya qiladi. Org'lar xarajatli boshqaruv; haqiqiy multi-tenant'da ko'pincha alohida Grafana stack'lari soddaroq.

41770.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Notification template — Alertmanager'da Slack, email, Telegram, webhook xabarlarining matnini Go `text/template` (email HTML uchun `html/template`) bilan shakllantirish. Template fayllarda `define` bilan nomlanadi va receiver'da chaqiriladi.

**Nega kerak:** default xabar label'larning xom ro'yxati — on-call muhandis "nima, qayerda, nima qilish kerak"ni darhol tushunmaydi. Yaxshi template: qisqa sarlavha, ta'sir, runbook va dashboard havolasi.

```
Alert data (.Status, .Alerts, .CommonLabels, .CommonAnnotations, .ExternalURL)
   -> template "slack.title" / "slack.text"
   -> "[FIRING:3] HighErrorRate api (prod)  Runbook | Dashboard | Silence"
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
templates: ['/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl']
receivers:
  - name: slack-api
    slack_configs:
      - channel: '#alerts-api'
        title: '{{ template "slack.title" . }}'
        text:  '{{ template "slack.text" . }}'
        send_resolved: true
```
```gotemplate
{{ define "slack.title" -}}
[{{ .Status | toUpper }}{{ if eq .Status "firing" }}:{{ .Alerts.Firing | len }}{{ end }}] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }} ({{ .CommonLabels.cluster }})
{{- end }}
{{ define "slack.text" -}}
{{ range .Alerts -}}
*{{ .Annotations.summary }}*
{{ if .Annotations.runbook_url }}Runbook: {{ .Annotations.runbook_url }}{{ end }}
{{ end -}}
{{- end }}
```
Test: `amtool template render --template.glob='templates/*.tmpl' --template.text='{{ template "slack.title" . }}'`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Template xatosi — xabar umuman yuborilmaydi (log'da error); CI'da render test qiling.
- Bitta xabarda 200 alert — Slack limitidan oshadi; `range` ni kesing yoki faqat soni.
- Mavjud bo'lmagan annotation — bo'sh qatorlar; `if` bilan tekshiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Annotation'lar (`summary`, `description`, `runbook_url`, `dashboard_url`) ni rule darajasida majburiy qiling, template esa umumiy bo'lsin. Har alertda runbook havolasi — MTTR'ni eng arzon qisqartirish.

41771.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OTel Zipkin bilan ikki yo'nalishda mos: Collector'da **zipkin receiver** (Zipkin JSON/Proto v1/v2 span'larini qabul qilib OTLP'ga aylantiradi) va **zipkin exporter** (OTel span'larini Zipkin backend'ga yuboradi). Propagation uchun **B3** propagator (`X-B3-TraceId` yoki bitta `b3` header). Bu bosqichma-bosqich migratsiyani ta'minlaydi.

**Muammo:** eski servislar Zipkin/Brave/Spring Cloud Sleuth bilan, yangilari OTel bilan. Hammasini bir kunda ko'chirib bo'lmaydi, lekin trace'lar bitta zanjirda bo'lishi kerak.

```
Eski servis (Brave) --Zipkin JSON :9411--> Collector [zipkin receiver]
Yangi servis (OTel) --OTLP :4317--------> Collector [otlp receiver]
                                              --> Tempo/Jaeger (OTLP)
Header: eski b3 <-> yangi traceparent: composite propagator ikkalasini yozadi/o'qiydi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
receivers:
  zipkin:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:9411
  otlp:
    protocols: {grpc: {}, http: {}}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces: {receivers: [zipkin, otlp], processors: [batch], exporters: [otlp/tempo]}
```
SDK:
```bash
export OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,baggage,b3multi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat `tracecontext` propagator — eski servisdan kelgan `X-B3-*` o'qilmaydi, trace uziladi.
- Zipkin 64-bit trace ID'lari — OTel 128-bit; chap tomoni nol bilan to'ldiriladi, qidiruvda farq.
- Spring Cloud Sleuth endi Micrometer Tracing'ga o'tgan — u OTel bridge bilan ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Migratsiya tartibi: avval Collector'ni markazga qo'ying (ikkala formatni qabul qilsin), keyin propagator'larni composite qiling, keyin servislarni birma-bir OTel SDK'ga o'tkazing. Oxirida B3 ni o'chiring.

41772.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Counter faqat o'sadi, lekin process restart'da 0 ga tushadi (reset). `rate()`, `irate()`, `increase()` ketma-ket sample'larda qiymat **kamayganini** ko'rsa, buni reset deb hisoblaydi va yangi qiymatni oldingisiga qo'shib "tuzatadi". Shuning uchun counter'larda oddiy ayirma emas, shu funksiyalar ishlatiladi.

```
sample:   100  120  140  (restart)  5   25
oddiy farq oxiri - boshi: 25 - 100 = -75   (noto'g'ri)
rate/increase: 20 + 20 + 5 + 20 = 65       (to'g'ri: reset'dan keyin 5 = 0 dan 5)
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
rate(http_requests_total[5m])          # soniyaga o'rtacha
increase(http_requests_total[1h])      # oxirgi soatda nechta (ekstrapolyatsiya bilan)
resets(http_requests_total[1h])        # nechta reset bo'ldi (restart'larni topish)

# Noto'g'ri:
http_requests_total - http_requests_total offset 1h
```
Diqqat: tartib — avval `rate`, keyin `sum`:
```promql
sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))   # to'g'ri
rate(sum by (service) (http_requests_total)[5m:])  # noto'g'ri: sum reset'ni yashiradi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `sum()` ni `rate()` dan oldin — bitta pod restart bo'lsa yig'indi kamayadi, rate uni noto'g'ri "reset" deb talqin qiladi.
- `increase()` butun son bermaydi (ekstrapolyatsiya) — 1h da 9.7 so'rov normal.
- Gauge'ga `rate()` — kamayish reset deb tushuniladi, natija bema'ni.

**Senior nuqta:** Juda tez-tez restart (crashloop) bo'lsa reset orasidagi o'sish yo'qolishi mumkin — `resets()` ni ham kuzating. OpenMetrics `_created` timestamp'i yangi Prometheus'larda reset aniqlashni aniqroq qiladi (created timestamps feature).

41773.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Library panel — Grafana'da bir marta yaratilib, bir nechta dashboard'ga **havola** sifatida qo'shiladigan panel. Uni bir joyda tahrirlasangiz, u ishlatilgan barcha dashboard'larda yangilanadi.

**Nega kerak:** "Servis RED" yoki "SLO budjet" paneli 40 ta dashboard'da nusxa bo'lsa, so'rovdagi xatoni 40 joyda tuzatish kerak. Library panel — DRY tamoyili dashboard'lar uchun.

```
Library panel "API SLO burn rate"
     ^          ^           ^
 Dashboard A  Dashboard B  Dashboard C   (hammasi bir manbaga ishora)
Tahrir -> hammasida yangilanadi
```

**Amalda:**
1. Panel menyusi -> More -> **New library panel** -> nom va folder tanlash.
2. Boshqa dashboard'da: Add -> **Import from library**.
3. Panelni o'zgartirib saqlaganda Grafana "bu N ta dashboard'ga ta'sir qiladi" deb ogohlantiradi.
4. Panel so'rovlarida dashboard variable'lari (`$service`) ishlatilsa, har dashboard o'z qiymatini beradi — shuning uchun variable nomlari mos bo'lishi kerak.

API:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" "https://grafana/api/library-elements?searchString=SLO" | jq '.result.elements[] | {uid, name, meta.connectedDashboards}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Variable nomlari dashboard'lar orasida farq qiladi — panel bir joyda ishlaydi, boshqasida bo'sh.
- Bitta o'zgarish ko'p dashboard'ni buzishi — muhim library panel'larni ehtiyotkorlik bilan tahrirlang.
- Library panel'ni o'chirish uchun avval barcha dashboard'lardan uzish kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Katta tashkilotda kod asosidagi yondashuv (Grafonnet/Jsonnet funksiyalari yoki Terraform modullari) library panel'lardan ko'ra boshqariladigan: versiya, review, test. Library panel — UI'da ishlaydigan jamoalar uchun yengil variant.

41774.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Silence `startsAt`–`endsAt` oralig'iga ega. `endsAt` o'tgach silence holati `expired` bo'ladi va mos alert'lar **avtomatik** yana xabar yuboradi — hech kim qo'lda olib tashlashi shart emas. Expired silence'lar `--data.retention` (default 120h) dan keyin o'chiriladi.

**Nega muhim:** maintenance uchun 2 soatga silence qo'ydingiz, ish 4 soat davom etdi — 2 soatdan keyin alert'lar yana page qiladi. Bu xavfsizlik xususiyati: "abadiy unutilgan silence" bo'lmaydi.

```
silence created (active) ----- endsAt -----> expired
   alert'lar bosiladi            |         alert hali firing -> xabar keladi
                                 |         (keyingi group_interval tick'da)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
amtool silence add alertname=NodeDown instance=db-1 \
  --duration=2h --comment="kernel upgrade, CHG-1234" --author=ali \
  --alertmanager.url=http://am:9093
amtool silence query
amtool silence update <id> --duration=1h      # uzaytirish
amtool silence expire <id>                     # muddatidan oldin tugatish
```
Kuzatish: `alertmanager_silences{state="active"}`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Juda uzun silence (30 kun) — haqiqiy muammo shu davrda yashirinadi.
- Silence tugashi bilan "page bo'roni" — maintenance cho'zilsa oldindan uzaytiring.
- Izohsiz silence — kim va nega qo'yganini bilmaysiz; comment'ga ticket raqami yozing.

**Senior nuqta:** Rejali maintenance uchun silence emas, `time_intervals` (`mute_time_intervals`) yoki CI/CD'dan API orqali avtomatik qisqa silence yaratish yaxshiroq. Aktiv silence'lar sonini dashboard'da ko'rsating — ular yashirin texnik qarz.

41775.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Span link — span'ni boshqa (yoki boshqa trace'dagi) span'lar bilan **sababiy bog'lash**, lekin parent-child munosabatisiz. Bitta span'da bir nechta link bo'lishi mumkin. Asosiy holat: batch consumer bir nechta producer xabarini qayta ishlaydi — har xabarning trace'iga link.

**Nega parent emas:** span'ning faqat bitta parent'i bo'ladi. 100 ta xabarni bitta batch'da qayta ishlasangiz, 100 ta trace'dan qaysi biri parent? Link barchasini saqlaydi. Yana: uzoq kechikkan asinxron ish yoki yangi trace boshlash (trust boundary) holatlarida.

```
Trace A: POST /order  -> PRODUCER send(msg1)
Trace B: POST /order  -> PRODUCER send(msg2)
Trace C: CONSUMER "process batch" (yangi trace)
            links: [A.send span, B.send span]
```

**Amalda (Go):**
```go
var links []trace.Link
for _, m := range batch {
    mctx := otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Extract(ctx, carrierFrom(m))
    links = append(links, trace.Link{SpanContext: trace.SpanContextFromContext(mctx)})
}
ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, "orders process",
    trace.WithSpanKind(trace.SpanKindConsumer), trace.WithLinks(links...))
defer span.End()
```
Tempo/Jaeger UI'da link bosilsa bog'langan trace ochiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Link'ni span yaratilgandan keyin qo'shish — eski SDK'larda faqat start paytida (yangilarida `AddLink` bor).
- Juda ko'p link (10k xabarli batch) — span hajmi limiti (default 128 link).
- Backend link'ni ko'rsatmasa foydasi kam — tekshiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Messaging semantic conventions batch qabulda parent emas, link'ni tavsiya qiladi. Trust boundary'da (tashqi webhook) ham tashqi trace'ni parent qilmasdan link qilish — sampling va xavfsizlik nazoratini o'zingizda qoldiradi.

41776.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Subquery — instant vector qaytaradigan ifodani vaqt oynasida bir necha nuqtada baholab, **range vector** hosil qilish: `<ifoda>[<oyna>:<qadam>]`. Masalan `max_over_time(rate(http_requests_total[1m])[30m:1m])` — oxirgi 30 daqiqada, har daqiqada hisoblangan rate'ning maksimumi.

**Nega kerak:** `*_over_time` funksiyalari range vector talab qiladi, `rate()` esa instant vector qaytaradi. Subquery "funksiya natijasining tarixi"ni beradi.

```
rate(x[1m])               -> instant vector (bitta nuqta)
rate(x[1m])[30m:1m]       -> 30 ta nuqta: t-30m, t-29m, ..., t
max_over_time(...)        -> shu 30 nuqtaning maksimumi
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Oxirgi soatdagi eng yuqori 5 daqiqalik error rate
max_over_time( (sum(rate(http_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])))[1h:1m] )

# Qadam berilmasa global evaluation interval ishlatiladi
avg_over_time(rate(cpu_seconds_total[5m])[1d:])
```
Recording rule bilan yaxshiroq:
```yaml
- record: job:http_error_ratio:rate5m
  expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_errors_total[5m])) / sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
# keyin:
# max_over_time(job:http_error_ratio:rate5m[1h])
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Qimmat: ichki so'rov `oyna/qadam` marta bajariladi; dashboard'da `[30d:1m]` = 43200 baholash.
- Qadam ichki oynadan katta (`rate(x[1m])[1h:5m]`) — ma'lumot tushib qoladi.
- Alert rule'larida subquery — har evaluation'da qayta hisoblanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Subquery ad-hoc tahlil uchun yaxshi, prod dashboard va alert uchun recording rule'ga aylantiring. SLO hisoblarida (30 kunlik) aynan shu farq Prometheus yuki 100 barobar bo'lishini hal qiladi.

41777.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana'da AWS **CloudWatch**, **Azure Monitor** va **Google Cloud Monitoring** uchun o'rnatilgan data source'lar bor: ular cloud provider API'sini IAM orqali so'raydi va managed servis metrikalari (RDS, ELB, SQS, Azure SQL, GCS) va log'larini Grafana'da boshqa manbalar bilan bir dashboard'da ko'rsatadi.

**Nega kerak:** managed servislarning ichiga exporter qo'yib bo'lmaydi — metrikalar faqat provider API'sida. Alohida konsolga o'tmasdan Prometheus metrikalari yonida ko'rish va alert qilish.

```
Grafana --(IAM role / workload identity)--> CloudWatch GetMetricData
                                         --> Azure Monitor REST
                                         --> Cloud Monitoring API
Har so'rov = API chaqiruvi (pullik, rate limit'li)
```

**Amalda (CloudWatch, provisioning):**
```yaml
datasources:
  - name: CloudWatch
    type: cloudwatch
    jsonData:
      authType: default          # EKS'da IRSA / EC2 instance role
      defaultRegion: eu-central-1
      assumeRoleArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/grafana-readonly
```
Minimal IAM: `cloudwatch:GetMetricData`, `cloudwatch:ListMetrics`, `logs:StartQuery`, `logs:GetQueryResults`, `ec2:DescribeRegions`, `tag:GetResources`.
Muqobil: YACE (yet-another-cloudwatch-exporter) yoki CloudWatch Metric Streams -> Prometheus/Mimir.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Statik access key'lar — IAM role / workload identity ishlating.
- Ko'p panelli dashboard 1 daqiqalik refresh bilan — CloudWatch API xarajati sezilarli o'sadi.
- CloudWatch metrikalari 1-5 daqiqa kechikadi — real vaqt alert uchun cheklov.

**Senior nuqta:** Alert va uzoq saqlash uchun cloud metrikalarini Metric Streams yoki exporter orqali o'z TSDB'ingizga olib keling (bir xil PromQL, arzon so'rov); Grafana data source'ni ad-hoc ko'rish uchun qoldiring.

41778.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Alertmanager HA rejimida bir nechta instance **gossip** protokoli (HashiCorp memberlist, default port 9094 TCP/UDP) orqali klaster bo'ladi va **silence**lar hamda **notification log** (kim, qachon xabar yuborgan) holatini sinxronlaydi. Shu tufayli Prometheus alert'ni hammasiga yuborsa ham xabar bir marta ketadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:** Prometheus alert'ni **barcha** Alertmanager'larga yuboradi (load balancer orqali emas!). Har instance'ning klasterdagi pozitsiyasi bor: 0-chi darhol yuboradi, 1-chi `peer_timeout` (15s) kutadi va notification log'da "allaqachon yuborilgan" ni ko'rsa yubormaydi.

```
Prometheus --alert--> AM-0 (pos 0) -> darhol yuboradi -> nflog yozadi
           --alert--> AM-1 (pos 1) -> 15s kutadi -> gossip'dan "yuborildi" -> skip
           --alert--> AM-2 (pos 2) -> 30s kutadi -> skip
AM-0 yiqilsa: AM-1 15s kechikish bilan yuboradi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
alertmanager --cluster.listen-address=0.0.0.0:9094 \
  --cluster.peer=am-1.am:9094 --cluster.peer=am-2.am:9094
```
```yaml
# prometheus.yml — har birini alohida ro'yxatlang
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets: [am-0:9093, am-1:9093, am-2:9093]
```
Kuzatish: `alertmanager_cluster_members`, `alertmanager_cluster_health_score` (0 = sog'lom), `alertmanager_peer_position`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Prometheus'ni LB orqali bitta AM'ga yo'naltirish — dedup buziladi, yiqilishda alert yo'qoladi.
- 9094 UDP firewall'da yopiq — klaster bo'linadi, dublikat xabarlar.
- Gossip eventually consistent — partition paytida dublikat bo'lishi mumkin (yo'qotishdan ko'ra yaxshi).

**Senior nuqta:** Alertmanager dizayni "at-least-once": dublikat yo'qotishdan afzal. Receiver'larni (PagerDuty dedup key, webhook idempotentlik) dublikatga chidamli qiling. 3 replica — standart.

41779.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OTel Logs Data Model — har qanday manbadagi log'ni bitta formatga keltiradigan standart: `Timestamp`, `ObservedTimestamp`, `SeverityNumber` (1-24), `SeverityText`, `Body` (har qanday tur), `Attributes`, `TraceId`, `SpanId`, `TraceFlags`, `EventName`, plus `Resource` va `InstrumentationScope`.

**Nega kerak:** syslog, JSON app log, Windows Event, container stdout — hammasi turli format. Bitta model bo'lsa collector ularni bir xil qayta ishlaydi, backend esa log'ni trace bilan `TraceId` orqali bog'laydi.

```
LogRecord
  Timestamp          hodisa sodir bo'lgan vaqt (manbadan)
  ObservedTimestamp  collector ko'rgan vaqt
  SeverityNumber     17 (ERROR)    SeverityText "error"
  Body               "payment failed"
  Attributes         {order.id=42, http.route=/pay}
  TraceId/SpanId     -> trace bilan korrelyatsiya
Resource             {service.name=pay, k8s.pod.name=pay-7x}
```
SeverityNumber diapazonlari: TRACE 1-4, DEBUG 5-8, INFO 9-12, WARN 13-16, ERROR 17-20, FATAL 21-24.

**Amalda:** Collector'da filelog'dan kelgan JSON log'ni modelga moslash:
```yaml
receivers:
  filelog:
    include: [/var/log/pods/*/*/*.log]
    operators:
      - type: container
      - type: json_parser
        timestamp: {parse_from: attributes.ts, layout_type: gotime, layout: "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"}
        severity: {parse_from: attributes.level}
      - type: trace_parser
        trace_id: {parse_from: attributes.trace_id}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Timestamp` parse qilinmasa faqat `ObservedTimestamp` — log'lar tartibi buziladi.
- Severity map'lanmasa hamma log INFO/unspecified.
- Body'ni string qoldirib, strukturani parse qilmaslik — filtrlash qiyin.

**Senior nuqta:** Log'ni trace context bilan chiqaradigan logger bridge'lardan (slog/zap/logback OTel appender) foydalaning — `TraceId` avtomatik, log-trace korrelyatsiyasi bepul.

41780.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `keep` relabel action — `source_labels` qiymatlari (separator bilan birlashtirilgan) `regex` ga **mos kelmagan** target yoki series'ni tashlaydi; faqat moslari qoladi. Teskarisi — `drop`.

**Nega kerak:** Kubernetes service discovery klasterdagi **hamma** pod'larni topadi. Faqat `prometheus.io/scrape: "true"` annotation'li pod'larni scrape qilish uchun `keep`.

```
SD: 500 pod -> relabel keep (annotation scrape=true) -> 120 target scrape qilinadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: k8s-pods
    kubernetes_sd_configs: [{role: pod}]
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
        action: keep
        regex: "true"
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
        action: keep
        regex: "prod|staging"
    metric_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        action: keep
        regex: "http_.*|process_.*|go_goroutines"
```
Tekshirish: Status -> Service Discovery sahifasida "dropped" target'lar va sababi; `prometheus_sd_discovered_targets`, `prometheus_target_scrape_pools_targets`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Regex to'liq moslanadi: `regex: "prod"` `prod-eu` ni tashlaydi.
- Bir nechta `source_labels` `;` bilan birlashadi — regex'da ham hisobga oling (`true;prod`).
- `metric_relabel_configs` da `keep` — ro'yxatda bo'lmagan yangi kerakli metrika jim tashlanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** `relabel_configs` dagi `keep` arzon (scrape umuman bo'lmaydi), `metric_relabel_configs` dagisi qimmatroq (scrape va parse bo'ladi, keyin tashlanadi). Iloji bo'lsa filtrlashni target bosqichida qiling.

41781.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Public dashboard (Grafana 10+ da "shared dashboards" / externally shared) — dashboard'ni **login'siz** ochiladigan, faqat o'qish uchun maxsus URL orqali ulashish. Masalan status sahifasi yoki mijozga SLA ko'rsatish.

**Nega ehtiyot:** URL bilgan har kim ko'radi. Panel so'rovlari server tomonda dashboard egasi nomidan bajariladi — sezgir label'lar (ichki hostname, mijoz nomlari) oqishi mumkin.

```
Tashqi foydalanuvchi --(token URL, auth yo'q)--> Grafana --> data source
  - template variable'lar o'zgartirilmaydi
  - faqat panel so'rovlari, Explore yo'q
```

**Amalda:**
1. Feature yoqish (eski versiyalarda): `[feature_toggles] publicDashboards = true`.
2. Dashboard -> Share -> Share externally -> vaqt tanlash va annotation'larni yoqish/o'chirish.
3. Ro'yxat va bekor qilish: Dashboards -> Shared dashboards -> revoke / pause.
4. Grafana Cloud/Enterprise'da email orqali faqat tanlangan odamlarga ulashish ham bor.

**Cheklovlar:** template variable'li dashboard'lar ba'zi versiyalarda qo'llanmaydi; ba'zi data source'lar mos emas; real vaqt ulanishlar cheklangan.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ichki infratuzilma dashboard'ini ulashish — IP, hostname, ichki servis nomlari oshkor.
- Og'ir so'rovli dashboard + ko'p tashqi tashrif — Prometheus'ga anonim DoS.
- Revoke qilishni unutish — eski URL yillar davomida ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Public status uchun alohida, minimal dashboard yarating (faqat agregatsiyalangan SLI, recording rule'lardan) va reverse proxy'da rate limit qo'ying. Ulashilgan dashboard'lar ro'yxatini muntazam audit qiling.

41782.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Alertmanager `pagerduty_configs` receiver'i PagerDuty **Events API v2** ga event yuboradi (`routing_key` bilan). Alert firing bo'lsa `trigger`, resolved bo'lsa `resolve` event'i yuboriladi; ikkalasi bir xil **dedup_key** (Alertmanager guruh kaliti hash'i) bilan, shuning uchun PagerDuty'da incident avtomatik yopiladi.

```
Prometheus -> Alertmanager -> PagerDuty Events v2
   firing   -> {event_action: trigger, dedup_key: <groupKey hash>} -> incident ochildi
   repeat   -> shu dedup_key -> yangi incident emas
   resolved -> {event_action: resolve, dedup_key: ...}             -> incident yopildi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
receivers:
  - name: pagerduty-pay
    pagerduty_configs:
      - routing_key_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/pd-pay-key
        severity: '{{ .CommonLabels.severity }}'
        description: '{{ .CommonAnnotations.summary }}'
        details:
          runbook: '{{ .CommonAnnotations.runbook_url }}'
          firing: '{{ .Alerts.Firing | len }}'
        links:
          - href: '{{ .CommonAnnotations.dashboard_url }}'
            text: Dashboard
        send_resolved: true
```
`routing_key` — PagerDuty Service -> Integrations -> "Events API V2" integration key.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `send_resolved: false` — incident'lar qo'lda yopiladi, on-call charchaydi.
- Kalitni config'da ochiq saqlash — `routing_key_file` yoki secret.
- `group_by` o'zgarsa dedup_key o'zgaradi — eski incident'lar ochiq qolib ketadi.
- PagerDuty'ga warning'larni yuborish — page fatigue; faqat critical.

**Senior nuqta:** Escalation, on-call jadval va noise suppression PagerDuty'da, routing va grouping Alertmanager'da — vazifalarni ajrating. Dead man's switch alert'ini PagerDuty "heartbeat" yoki tashqi servisga yuborib, butun zanjirni kuzating.

41783.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `filelog` receiver — OTel Collector contrib'da diskdagi log fayllarini **tail** qiladi va operatorlar zanjiri (parser, multiline, timestamp/severity) bilan OTel log modeliga aylantiradi. Kubernetes'da DaemonSet sifatida `/var/log/pods` ni o'qiydi — Fluent Bit/Promtail kabi alohida agent shart emas.

```
/var/log/pods/<ns>_<pod>_<uid>/<container>/0.log
   -> filelog (offset'larni storage'da saqlaydi)
   -> container parser (CRI format, k8s metadata yo'ldan)
   -> json_parser / regex_parser / recombine (multiline)
   -> k8sattributes -> batch -> otlp/loki exporter
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
extensions:
  file_storage: {directory: /var/lib/otelcol/storage}
receivers:
  filelog:
    include: [/var/log/pods/*/*/*.log]
    exclude: [/var/log/pods/*/otel-collector/*.log]
    start_at: end
    include_file_path: true
    storage: file_storage
    operators:
      - type: container          # CRI-O / containerd / docker formatini avtomatik
      - type: json_parser
        if: 'body matches "^\\{"'
service:
  extensions: [file_storage]
```
Helm chart (`opentelemetry-collector`) `presets.logsCollection.enabled: true` bilan buni avtomatik sozlaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `storage` yo'q — collector restart'da offset yo'qoladi: dublikat yoki yo'qotish.
- Collector o'z log'larini o'qisa — cheksiz loop; exclude qiling.
- Rotatsiya: kubelet faylni siqib (`.gz`) qo'yadi — glob faqat `.log` bo'lsin.
- `hostPath` mount va root/`runAsUser` ruxsatlari kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Bitta agent (collector) bilan log, metrika va trace — kamroq DaemonSet, bir xil metadata. Lekin yuqori log hajmida Fluent Bit hali ham CPU bo'yicha samaraliroq bo'lishi mumkin — o'lchab tanlang.

41784.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `replace` — default relabel action: `source_labels` qiymatlarini birlashtirib `regex` bilan moslaydi, mos kelsa `replacement` (regex guruhlari `$1`, `${2}` bilan) natijasini `target_label` ga yozadi (bor bo'lsa ustidan). Mos kelmasa hech narsa o'zgarmaydi.

**Nega kerak:** discovery meta-label'laridan (`__meta_kubernetes_*`) foydali label yasash, manzilni o'zgartirish, nomlarni standartlashtirish.

```
source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port, __address__]
qiymat:        "9102;10.0.3.7:8080"
regex:         "(\d+);([^:]+)(?::\d+)?"
replacement:   "$2:$1"           -> __address__ = "10.0.3.7:9102"
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
relabel_configs:
  # pod annotation'dagi port bilan scrape manzili
  - source_labels: [__address__, __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port]
    action: replace
    regex: '([^:]+)(?::\d+)?;(\d+)'
    replacement: '$1:$2'
    target_label: __address__
  # metrics path
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_path]
    regex: (.+)
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  # namespace label
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
    target_label: namespace
  # statik qiymat
  - target_label: env
    replacement: prod
```
Default'lar: `action: replace`, `regex: (.*)`, `replacement: $1`, `separator: ;`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `$1` dan keyin harf: `$1_x` — Go `$1_x` nomli guruh deb tushunadi; `${1}_x` yozing.
- Bo'sh natija — `target_label` bo'sh qiymat oladi, ya'ni label o'chadi.
- Regex mos kelmasa jim o'tadi — xato yo'q, debug qiyin; Status -> Targets'da "Discovered labels" ni ko'ring.

**Senior nuqta:** Relabel config'ni promtool bilan emas, **amalda** tekshirish kerak — Prometheus UI'dagi target relabeling ko'rinishi (v3 da "relabeling steps") yoki `promtool` debug. Murakkab relabel'larni Prometheus Operator'ning ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor bilan soddalashtiring.

41785.a:
**Qisqa javob:** TraceQL — Grafana Tempo'ning trace qidiruv tili: span'larni atribut, davomiylik, status, kind va **struktura** (parent/descendant) bo'yicha tanlaydi. Sintaksis: `{ shart }` span to'plamini qaytaradi, `|` bilan aggregatsiya va `select()`.

**Nega kerak:** trace ID bilmasangiz ham "checkout'da 2 soniyadan sekin va DB'da 500ms dan uzun span'i bor trace'lar" degan savolga javob topasiz.

```
{ resource.service.name = "checkout" && duration > 2s }
   span. = span atributi, resource. = servis atributi, intrinsic: duration, status, kind, name
```

**Amalda:**
```traceql
# Xato bilan tugagan 5xx
{ span.http.response.status_code >= 500 && status = error }

# Struktura: checkout ichida sekin DB span
{ resource.service.name = "checkout" } >> { span.db.system.name = "postgresql" && duration > 500ms }

# Aggregatsiya: bir trace'da 10 dan ortiq DB chaqiruvi (N+1)
{ span.db.system.name != nil } | count() > 10

# Kerakli maydonlarni ko'rsatish
{ name = "POST /pay" && duration > 1s } | select(span.http.route, resource.k8s.pod.name)
```
Metrika rejimi (TraceQL metrics):
```traceql
{ resource.service.name = "api" } | quantile_over_time(duration, .99) by (span.http.route)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `span.` va `resource.` prefikslarini aralashtirish — atribut topilmaydi (`.attr` ikkalasini qidiradi, lekin sekinroq).
- Juda keng vaqt oralig'i va shartsiz so'rov — object storage'dan ko'p block o'qiladi.
- Sampling: faqat saqlangan trace'lar qidiriladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Tez-tez qidiriladigan atributlarni Tempo'da **dedicated column** qiling (Parquet) — qidiruv tezligi keskin oshadi. N+1 kabi pattern'larni TraceQL bilan muntazam qidirish — profilaktik performance audit.

41786.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `slack_configs` — Alertmanager Slack receiver'i: Incoming Webhook URL (yoki bot token + `chat.postMessage`) orqali kanalga xabar yuboradi. Template bilan sarlavha, matn, rang (firing qizil, resolved yashil), tugmalar (Runbook, Dashboard, Silence) qo'shiladi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
global:
  slack_api_url_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/slack-webhook
receivers:
  - name: slack-api
    slack_configs:
      - channel: '#alerts-api'
        send_resolved: true
        color: '{{ if eq .Status "firing" }}{{ if eq .CommonLabels.severity "critical" }}danger{{ else }}warning{{ end }}{{ else }}good{{ end }}'
        title: '[{{ .Status | toUpper }}:{{ .Alerts.Firing | len }}] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}'
        title_link: '{{ .CommonAnnotations.dashboard_url }}'
        text: |-
          {{ range .Alerts }}*{{ .Annotations.summary }}*
          {{ .Annotations.description }}
          {{ end }}
        actions:
          - type: button
            text: 'Runbook'
            url: '{{ .CommonAnnotations.runbook_url }}'
          - type: button
            text: 'Silence'
            url: '{{ .ExternalURL }}/#/silences/new?filter=%7Balertname%3D"{{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}"%7D'
route:
  routes:
    - matchers: [team="api"]
      receiver: slack-api
```
Bot token bilan (yangi versiyalar): `api_url: https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage` + `http_config.authorization.credentials_file`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Webhook URL Git'da ochiq — u secret; `*_file` ishlating.
- Incoming webhook bitta kanalga bog'langan — `channel` maydoni e'tiborsiz qolishi mumkin; har kanal uchun alohida webhook yoki bot token.
- Juda uzun xabar — Slack kesadi; alert'lar ro'yxatini cheklang.

**Senior nuqta:** Kanallarni ajrating: `#alerts-<team>-critical` (kam, harakat talab qiladi) va `#alerts-<team>-info`. Slack — xabarnoma, page emas; critical alert PagerDuty/OnCall orqali ketsin, Slack'ga nusxa `continue: true` bilan.

41787.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OTel Collector exporter'larida (exporterhelper) ikki mexanizm: **sending_queue** — yuborilmagan ma'lumotni xotirada (yoki diskda) buferlash, va **retry_on_failure** — qayta urinishli xatolarda **exponential backoff** bilan qayta yuborish. Vaqtinchalik backend uzilishida ma'lumot yo'qolmaydi; queue to'lsa yangi ma'lumot **tashlanadi**.

```
batch -> [sending_queue: 1000 batch] -> consumers (10) -> backend
                                          | xato (503, timeout)
                                          v
                        retry: 5s -> 10s -> 20s ... max 30s, jami max_elapsed 300s
                        keyin -> drop (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_*)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
extensions:
  file_storage: {directory: /var/lib/otelcol/queue}
exporters:
  otlp/tempo:
    endpoint: tempo:4317
    timeout: 10s
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 5s
      max_interval: 30s
      max_elapsed_time: 300s
    sending_queue:
      enabled: true
      num_consumers: 10
      queue_size: 5000
      storage: file_storage     # persistent: restart'da yo'qolmaydi
```
Kuzatish:
```promql
otelcol_exporter_queue_size / otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity
rate(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans_total[5m])
rate(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans_total[5m])   # queue to'lgan -> drop
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat in-memory queue — collector pod restart'da hamma buferlangan ma'lumot yo'qoladi.
- Katta queue + memory_limiter yo'q — uzoq uzilishda collector OOM.
- 400 (bad request) kabi qayta urinilmaydigan xatolar — retry yordam bermaydi, darhol drop.

**Senior nuqta:** Queue'ni "backend necha daqiqa uzilishiga chidashim kerak" savolidan hisoblang: `throughput x uzilish vaqti`. Queue to'lish nisbati alert'i — backend muammosini ma'lumot yo'qolishidan oldin bildiradi.

41788.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `/api/v1/query_range` — Prometheus HTTP API'si: PromQL'ni `start` dan `end` gacha har `step` da baholab, har series uchun `[timestamp, qiymat]` juftliklari matritsasini qaytaradi. Grafana grafiklari aynan shu endpoint'dan foydalanadi.

```
start=12:00 end=13:00 step=60s  -> 61 ta baholash nuqtasi
resultType: "matrix"
  {metric: {job="api"}, values: [[1696330800, "12.5"], [1696330860, "13.1"], ...]}
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
curl -sG http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query_range \
  --data-urlencode 'query=sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))' \
  --data-urlencode "start=$(date -d '-1 hour' +%s)" \
  --data-urlencode "end=$(date +%s)" \
  --data-urlencode 'step=60s' | jq '.data.result[] | {job: .metric.job, points: (.values | length)}'
```
Parametrlar: `query`, `start`, `end` (RFC3339 yoki Unix), `step` (`15s` yoki soniya), ixtiyoriy `timeout`, `limit`. Javob: `status`, `data.resultType`, `data.result`, ixtiyoriy `warnings`/`infos`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kichik `step` + katta oraliq — 11000 nuqtadan ko'p bo'lsa xato ("exceeded maximum resolution of 11,000 points").
- Qiymatlar **string** sifatida keladi (`"12.5"`, `"NaN"`, `"+Inf"`) — parse qiling.
- `step` > rate oynasi — oraliqlar o'tkazib yuboriladi; oynani step'dan kichik qilmang.
- Uzun so'rovni GET bilan yuborish — URL limiti; POST + form-encoded.

**Senior nuqta:** `query_range` natijasi step'ga "hizalanadi" va har nuqta mustaqil instant baholash — shuning uchun Grafana zoom qilinganda qiymatlar o'zgaradi. Hisobotlar uchun aniq raqam kerak bo'lsa `query` bilan `increase(...[30d])` ishlating.

41789.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana RBAC (Enterprise va Cloud) — asosiy rollar (Viewer, Editor, Admin) ustiga nozik **ruxsatlar** (`dashboards:read`, `datasources:query`, `alert.rules:write` ...) va ulardan yig'ilgan **fixed/custom role**'lar. Folder, dashboard, data source va alerting darajasida kimga nima ruxsat ekanini aniq belgilaydi.

**Nega kerak:** OSS'dagi uchta rol qo'pol: "Editor" hamma narsani tahrirlaydi. Kerak: "jamoa A faqat o'z folder'ini tahrirlasin, audit data source'ga faqat security so'rov bersin, on-call silence qo'ya olsin, lekin rule o'zgartira olmasin".

```
User/Team --> Role (custom: "payments-alerting-editor")
                 permissions: alert.rules:write  scope folders:uid:payments
                              alert.silences:create
```
