Data source "audit-logs" --> faqat team security: datasources:query
```

**Amalda (provisioning):**
```yaml
apiVersion: 2
roles:
  - name: custom:payments:alerting-editor
    global: true
    permissions:
      - action: alert.rules:read
        scope: folders:uid:payments
      - action: alert.rules:write
        scope: folders:uid:payments
      - action: alert.silences:create
        scope: folders:uid:payments
    teams: [{name: payments}]
```
OSS'da ham: folder/dashboard permission'lar va data source permission'larning bir qismi mavjud.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Data source query ruxsati bor foydalanuvchi Explore orqali istalgan so'rovni yoza oladi — dashboard yashirish xavfsizlik emas.
- Hamma uchun Editor — tasodifiy o'zgarishlar va drift.
- Rollarni UI'da qo'lda boshqarish — audit va takrorlanuvchanlik yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Ruxsatlarni IdP guruhlariga (team sync) bog'lang va Terraform bilan boshqaring. Ma'lumot darajasidagi izolyatsiya (tenant, label-based access) backend'da bo'lishi kerak — Grafana RBAC UI chegarasi, data chegarasi emas.

41790.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `opsgenie_configs` — Alertmanager Opsgenie receiver'i: Opsgenie Alert API'ga alert yaratadi, label'lardan dinamik **priority** (P1-P5), responders (team), tags beradi; resolved bo'lsa alert'ni yopadi (alias = guruh kaliti orqali dedup).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
receivers:
  - name: opsgenie
    opsgenie_configs:
      - api_key_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/opsgenie-key
        api_url: https://api.eu.opsgenie.com/     # EU hisob uchun
        message: '{{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}: {{ .CommonAnnotations.summary }}'
        priority: '{{ if eq .CommonLabels.severity "critical" }}P1{{ else if eq .CommonLabels.severity "high" }}P2{{ else }}P3{{ end }}'
        responders:
          - type: team
            name: '{{ .CommonLabels.team }}'
        tags: 'cluster={{ .CommonLabels.cluster }},service={{ .CommonLabels.service }}'
        details:
          runbook: '{{ .CommonAnnotations.runbook_url }}'
        send_resolved: true
```
Oqim:
```
firing   -> POST /v2/alerts (alias=<groupKey hash>) -> on-call schedule -> escalation
repeat   -> shu alias -> count++ (yangi alert emas)
resolved -> POST /v2/alerts/<alias>/close
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- EU region hisobida default (US) `api_url` — 401/404 xato, alert'lar yetib bormaydi.
- `responders` dagi team nomi Opsgenie'dagidan farq qiladi — alert egasiz qoladi.
- Priority template xatosi — hammasi default P3.

**Senior nuqta:** Opsgenie (Atlassian) 2025 da yangi sotuvni to'xtatib, funksiyalarni Jira Service Management / Compass'ga ko'chirishni e'lon qildi (to'liq yopilish 2027 ga rejalashtirilgan) — yangi loyihada alternativani (JSM, PagerDuty, Grafana IRM) baholang. Integratsiyani receiver darajasida abstrakt saqlash migratsiyani osonlashtiradi.

41791.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `spanmetrics` — OTel Collector **connector**i: traces pipeline'idan span'larni oladi va metrics pipeline'iga **RED** metrikalarini chiqaradi — `traces.span.metrics.calls` (soni, status bo'yicha) va `traces.span.metrics.duration` (histogram), `service.name`, `span.name`, `span.kind`, `status.code` va tanlangan dimension'lar bo'yicha. Avval processor edi, hozir connector.

**Connector nima:** bir pipeline uchun exporter, boshqasi uchun receiver vazifasini bajaradigan komponent — signal turini o'zgartirish imkonini beradi (trace -> metric).

```
traces pipeline:  otlp -> batch -> [spanmetrics] + otlp/tempo
                                       |
metrics pipeline:              [spanmetrics] -> prometheusremotewrite
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
connectors:
  spanmetrics:
    namespace: traces.span.metrics
    histogram:
      exponential: {max_size: 160}       # yoki explicit buckets
    dimensions:
      - name: http.route
      - name: http.response.status_code
    exemplars: {enabled: true}
    metrics_flush_interval: 15s
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:  {receivers: [otlp], exporters: [spanmetrics, otlp/tempo]}
    metrics: {receivers: [spanmetrics], exporters: [prometheusremotewrite]}
```
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m])))
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Span nomi yuqori cardinality'li (`GET /orders/123`) — metrika series'lari portlaydi; instrumentatsiya `http.route` bilan nomlasin.
- Sampling'dan keyin ulash — noto'g'ri rate.
- Birlik: default ms — PromQL'da nom va bucket'larni tekshiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Agar Tempo metrics-generator ishlatsangiz, spanmetrics'ni ikki joyda yoqmang — dublikat metrika. Bitta joyni (odatda collector, sampling'dan oldin) tanlang.

41792.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `/api/v1/query` — Prometheus HTTP API'si: PromQL'ni **bitta vaqt nuqtasida** (`time` parametri, default hozir) baholaydi. Natija turi `vector` (instant), `scalar`, `string` yoki (range selector so'ralsa) `matrix`. Stat panellar, skriptlar va hisobotlar uchun.

**Amalda:**
```bash
curl -sG http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query \
  --data-urlencode 'query=sum by (job) (up)' | jq '.data.result[] | {job: .metric.job, value: .value[1]}'

# O'tgan vaqt uchun
curl -sG http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query \
  --data-urlencode 'query=increase(http_requests_total[30d])' \
  --data-urlencode 'time=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'

# Xom sample'larni olish (range selector) -> matrix
curl -sG http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query --data-urlencode 'query=up{job="api"}[5m]'
```
Javob:
```json
{"status":"success","data":{"resultType":"vector","result":[
  {"metric":{"job":"api"},"value":[1759449600,"3"]}]}}
```

**`query` vs `query_range`:**
| | `/query` | `/query_range` |
|---|---|---|
| Baholash | 1 nuqta | start..end har step |
| Natija | vector/scalar | matrix |
| Ishlatish | stat, skript, SLO hisobot | grafik |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Instant so'rov 5 daqiqalik lookback'da oxirgi sample'ni oladi — eski (stale bo'lmagan) qiymat "hozirgi" ko'rinadi.
- Qiymat string — `jq tonumber`.
- Alert rule'lari ham ichkarida instant so'rov — Grafana'da rule'ni "Instant" rejimda test qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** Avtomatlashtirishda (deploy gate, canary tahlil) `/api/v1/query` eng oddiy integratsiya nuqtasi: "error ratio < 1% bo'lsa davom et". Lekin timeout va bo'sh natija ("ma'lumot yo'q" = muvaffaqiyat emas!) holatlarini aniq boshqaring.

41793.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana OnCall — on-call boshqaruv vositasi: alert'larni qabul qiladi (Alertmanager, Grafana Alerting, webhook), guruhlaydi, **escalation chain** bo'yicha (Slack -> SMS -> qo'ng'iroq -> keyingi odam) xabar beradi, **on-call jadval**larini (rotation, iCal) boshqaradi. Hozir Grafana Cloud'da **Grafana IRM** (OnCall + Incident) tarkibida.

```
Alertmanager --webhook--> OnCall integration
   -> grouping (bir incident) -> route (team/severity)
   -> escalation chain:
        1. Slack #oncall-pay
        2. 5 daqiqa ack bo'lmasa -> on-call (jadval) ga push/SMS
        3. 15 daqiqa -> phone call
        4. 30 daqiqa -> secondary / manager
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# Alertmanager -> OnCall
receivers:
  - name: grafana-oncall
    webhook_configs:
      - url: https://oncall.example/integrations/v1/alertmanager/<token>/
        send_resolved: true
```
Jadvallar: Web UI, Terraform (`grafana_oncall_schedule`, `grafana_oncall_escalation_chain`) yoki tashqi iCal (Google Calendar).
Slack'dan ack/resolve/silence tugmalari bilan boshqarish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- OSS OnCall 2025 da maintenance rejimiga o'tkazilgan (arxivlanishi e'lon qilingan) — self-hosted yangi loyiha uchun ehtiyot; Cloud IRM yoki boshqa vosita.
- Escalation chain'da oxirgi qadam yo'q — hech kim ack qilmasa alert jim yo'qoladi.
- SMS/qo'ng'iroq uchun Cloud ulanishi kerak (self-hosted'da ham).

**Senior nuqta:** Vosita ikkilamchi — asosiysi jarayon: har alert ack talab qiladi, escalation vaqtlari SLO'ga mos, on-call yuki o'lchanadi (page/hafta). Haftasiga 2 tadan ko'p tungi page — alert sifati muammosi.

41794.a: **Qisqa javob:** `telegram_configs` — Alertmanager (v0.24+) receiver'i: Telegram Bot API orqali guruh yoki kanalga xabar yuboradi. Kerak: bot token (BotFather'dan) va `chat_id`. Template va `parse_mode` (HTML/MarkdownV2) bilan formatlanadi. **Amalda:** 1. `@BotFather` -> `/newbot` -> token oling. 2. Botni guruhga qo'shing, `chat_id` ni oling: ```bash curl -s "https://api.telegram.org/bot$TOKEN/getUpdates" | jq '.result[].message.chat.id' # guruh ID manfiy: -1001234567890 ``` 3. Config: ```yaml receivers: - name: telegram-ops telegram_configs: - bot_token_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/tg-token chat_id: -1001234567890 message_thread_id: 42 # forum topic (ixtiyoriy) parse_mode: HTML send_resolved: true message: |- {{ if eq .Status "firing" }}[FIRING]{{ else }}[OK]{{ end }} {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }} ({{ .CommonLabels.severity }}) {{ range .Alerts }}- {{ .Annotations.summary }} {{ end }} ``` **Tuzoqlar:** - HTML mode'da `<`, `>`, `&` escape qilinmasa (masalan `value > 5` annotation'da) — Telegram 400 qaytaradi, xabar yo'qoladi. - Bot guruh xabarlarini ko'rmaydi (privacy mode) — `getUpdates` bo'sh; botga guruhda bir marta yozing. - Token config'da ochiq — `bot_token_file`. - Xabar 4096 belgidan uzun — kesiladi/rad etiladi. **Senior nuqta:** Telegram — kichik jamoa va xabardor qilish uchun qulay, lekin ack/escalation yo'q; critical page uchun on-call vositasi kerak. Ba'zi tarmoqlarda Telegram API bloklangan bo'lishi mumkin — proxy (`http_config.proxy_url`) va meta-monitoring.

41795.a:
**Qisqa javob:** HTTP semantic conventions (stable, 2023+): `http.request.method` (`GET`, `POST`), `http.response.status_code`, `http.route` (shablon: `/users/{id}`), `url.full` (client), `url.path` va `url.scheme` (server), `server.address`, `server.port`, `network.protocol.version`, `user_agent.original`. Metrika: `http.server.request.duration` (soniya, histogram). Eski nomlar (`http.method`, `http.status_code`, `http.url`) deprecated.

**Nega `http.route` muhim:** latency'ni endpoint bo'yicha guruhlash kerak. `/users/1`, `/users/2` ... million xil `url.path` — cardinality portlaydi. `http.route=/users/{id}` — bitta qiymat.

```
SERVER span "GET /users/{id}"
  http.request.method        = GET
  http.route                 = /users/{id}
  url.path                   = /users/42
  http.response.status_code  = 200
  server.address             = api.shop.uz
CLIENT span "GET"
  url.full                   = https://pay.example/v1/charge
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```
Migratsiya: `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=http/dup` — eski va yangi atributlarni birga chiqaradi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Span nomini `GET /users/42` qilish — span nomi ham past cardinality bo'lishi kerak (`{method} {route}`).
- Status: server span uchun 4xx **xato emas** (client xatosi), faqat 5xx `Error`; client span'da 4xx ham xato.
- `url.full` ga query string bilan token yozilishi — redaction.

**Senior nuqta:** Eski va yangi nomlar aralash dashboard'lar — eng ko'p uchraydigan "ma'lumot yo'qoldi" sababi. `dup` davrida dashboard'larni ko'chirib, keyin eski nomlarni o'chirish rejasini yozing.

41796.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Prometheus chunk'larida Facebook **Gorilla** siqishidan foydalanadi: timestamp'lar **delta-of-delta** (doimiy interval'da deyarli 0 — 1 bit), qiymatlar oldingisi bilan **XOR** (o'zgarmasa 1 bit, o'zgarsa faqat farqli bitlar). Natijada sample'ga ~1.3-1.5 bayt (xom 16 bayt o'rniga).

```
timestamp: 1000 1015 1030 1045      (scrape 15s)
delta:          15   15   15
delta-of-delta:      0    0          -> har biri 1 bit
value:     42.0 42.0 42.0 43.0
XOR:            0    0    !=0        -> 1 bit, 1 bit, keyin faqat farqli bitlar
```

**Nega muhim:** 1M series x 15s scrape x 15 kun = ~86 milliard sample. 16 bayt bo'lsa ~1.4 TB, Gorilla bilan ~120 GB. Siqish samaradorligi — Prometheus sig'imini rejalashtirish asosi.

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Haqiqiy bayt/sample
rate(prometheus_tsdb_compaction_chunk_size_bytes_sum[1h])
  / rate(prometheus_tsdb_compaction_chunk_samples_sum[1h])
```
Disk taxmini: `ingested_samples_per_second x retention_seconds x ~1.5 bayt`.
```promql
rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total[5m])
```

**Siqishni yomonlashtiradigan narsalar:**
- Jitter'li timestamp'lar (`honor_timestamps` bilan notekis vaqt) — delta-of-delta 0 bo'lmaydi.
- Shovqinli float qiymatlar (har safar tasodifiy kasr) — XOR ko'p bit.
- Juda qisqa umrli series — chunk to'lmaydi, overhead.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Disk'ni faqat series soniga qarab hisoblash — sample tezligi va qiymat xarakteri ham muhim.
- Native histogram'lar boshqa encoding ishlatadi — bayt/sample boshqacha.

**Senior nuqta:** Sig'im rejalashda o'z o'lchovingizni (yuqoridagi formula) ishlating, nazariy 1.37 baytni emas. Uzoq saqlash uchun Thanos/Mimir block'larni object storage'ga ko'chiradi — lokal disk faqat qisqa retention uchun.

41798.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Auto-resolve — alert tugaganda avtomatik "[RESOLVED]" xabari. Prometheus alert'ni har evaluation'da `endsAt` (taxminan 4 x evaluation interval keyin) bilan qayta yuborib turadi; alert yo'qolsa u `endsAt` ni hozirgi vaqt qilib yuboradi yoki yuborishni to'xtatadi. Alertmanager `endsAt` o'tgach alert'ni resolved deb belgilaydi va receiver'da `send_resolved: true` bo'lsa xabar yuboradi. `resolve_timeout` (default 5m) — faqat `endsAt` siz kelgan alert'lar (Prometheus'dan boshqa manbalar) uchun.

```
Prometheus: alert firing -> har 15s POST {endsAt: now+4*eval}
            alert tugadi -> POST {endsAt: now} (resolved)
Alertmanager: endsAt o'tdi -> resolved -> group_interval tick'da xabar
Prometheus yiqildi -> yangilanish yo'q -> endsAt o'tadi -> ham "resolved"!
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m
receivers:
  - name: slack
    slack_configs:
      - send_resolved: true
        title: '[{{ .Status | toUpper }}] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}'
```
Resolved alert'larni ko'rish: `amtool alert query --resolved`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Prometheus yiqilsa yoki Alertmanager'ga yetolmasa alert'lar "resolved" bo'ladi — yolg'on tinchlik. Dead man's switch alert'i shu holatni ushlaydi.
- Resolved xabari `group_interval` ga bog'liq — darhol kelmaydi.
- `send_resolved` PagerDuty/Opsgenie uchun muhim (incident yopiladi), Slack info kanallarida shovqin bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** "Resolved" = "alert sharti endi bajarilmaydi", "muammo hal bo'ldi" emas — masalan scrape yiqilsa series yo'qoladi va alert resolved bo'ladi. Muhim alert'larni `absent()` bilan juftlang.

41799.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OTel Collector'da routing — telemetriyani atribut, resource yoki kiruvchi header (masalan `X-Tenant`) qiymatiga qarab **turli pipeline/exporter**larga yo'naltirish. Hozirgi usul — **routing connector** (eski routing processor deprecated). Misol: tenant bo'yicha turli Mimir tenant'lariga, yoki prod va dev telemetriyasini turli backend'ga.

```
otlp -> traces/in -> [routing connector]
             tenant == "acme"   -> traces/acme   -> otlp/acme-tempo
             env == "dev"       -> traces/dev    -> otlp/cheap-backend
             default            -> traces/shared -> otlp/tempo
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
connectors:
  routing:
    default_pipelines: [traces/shared]
    error_mode: ignore
    table:
      - context: resource
        condition: attributes["tenant"] == "acme"
        pipelines: [traces/acme]
      - context: request
        condition: request["X-Tenant"] == "globex"
        pipelines: [traces/globex]
service:
  pipelines:
    traces/in:     {receivers: [otlp], exporters: [routing]}
    traces/acme:   {receivers: [routing], processors: [batch], exporters: [otlp/acme]}
    traces/globex: {receivers: [routing], processors: [batch], exporters: [otlp/globex]}
    traces/shared: {receivers: [routing], processors: [batch], exporters: [otlp/tempo]}
```
Shartlar OTTL tilida yoziladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `default_pipelines` yo'q — hech biriga mos kelmagan ma'lumot jim tashlanadi.
- Header bo'yicha routing uchun receiver'da `include_metadata: true` va batch processor'da `metadata_keys` kerak — aks holda batch header'ni yo'qotadi.
- Resource bo'yicha routing bitta batch ichida aralash resource'larni bo'ladi — CPU narxi.

**Senior nuqta:** Multi-tenant pipeline'da tenant ID'ni client yuborgan header'ga emas, autentifikatsiyadan (bearer token -> tenant) olish xavfsizroq. Routing + har tenant uchun alohida queue = bitta tenant backend'i yiqilsa boshqalar to'xtamaydi.

41800.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `hashmod` relabel action — `source_labels` qiymatining hash'ini `modulus` ga bo'lib qoldiqni `target_label` ga yozadi. Keyin `keep` bilan har Prometheus faqat o'z qoldig'ini qoldiradi. Natija: target'lar N ta Prometheus orasida **gorizontal sharding**.

**Nega kerak:** bitta Prometheus 10M+ series'ni ko'tara olmaydi. Target'larni teng bo'lib, har shard o'z qismini scrape qiladi; global ko'rinish Thanos/Mimir orqali.

```
target'lar: 3000 ta pod
hash(__address__) % 3:
   0 -> prometheus-shard-0 (keep 0)
   1 -> prometheus-shard-1 (keep 1)
   2 -> prometheus-shard-2 (keep 2)
Har shard ~1000 target -> remote write -> Mimir (global query)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# shard-1 uchun (SHARD env bilan template qilinadi)
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__address__]
    modulus: 3
    target_label: __tmp_hash
    action: hashmod
  - source_labels: [__tmp_hash]
    regex: "1"
    action: keep
```
Prometheus Operator'da: `spec.shards: 3` — avtomatik `hashmod` relabeling qo'shadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Shard sonini o'zgartirish — deyarli hamma target boshqa shard'ga ko'chadi; vaqtinchalik bo'shliq va dublikat.
- Shard'lar orasida rule'lar — bitta shard'da `sum()` faqat o'z qismini ko'radi; global rule'lar Thanos Ruler/Mimir ruler'da.
- Notekis taqsimot: bitta "og'ir" target (100k series) bitta shard'ni yuklaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Sharding'dan oldin cardinality'ni kamaytiring — ko'pincha muammo series soni emas, keraksiz label'lar. Agar baribir kerak bo'lsa, Prometheus Agent mode (faqat scrape + remote write) + markaziy Mimir — eng sodda gorizontal arxitektura.

41801.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Multi-line parsing — bir nechta qatordan iborat log'ni (Java/Python stack trace) **bitta** log event'ga yig'ish. Qoida: "yangi event qanday qator bilan boshlanadi" regex'i (masalan sana bilan); unga mos kelmagan qatorlar oldingi event'ga qo'shiladi. Grafana Alloy (`stage.multiline`), Promtail (eskirgan), Fluent Bit (`multiline.parser`) yoki OTel filelog (`recombine`) da qilinadi.

**Muammo:** container runtime har qatorni alohida yozadi. Stack trace 40 ta alohida log bo'lib Loki'ga ketadi — qidiruvda `NullPointerException` qatori topiladi, lekin qaysi so'rov ekani yo'q, `count_over_time` 40 marta hisoblaydi.

```
2026-10-03 10:00:01 ERROR Request failed       <- yangi event (sana bilan boshlanadi)
java.lang.NullPointerException                 <- qo'shiladi
    at com.acme.Order.pay(Order.java:42)       <- qo'shiladi
2026-10-03 10:00:02 INFO next request          <- yangi event
```

**Amalda (Alloy):**
```alloy
loki.process "java" {
  stage.multiline {
    firstline     = "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}"
    max_wait_time = "3s"
    max_lines     = 500
  }
  forward_to = [loki.write.default.receiver]
}
```
OTel filelog:
```yaml
operators:
  - type: container
  - type: recombine
    combine_field: body
    is_first_entry: body matches "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}"
    source_identifier: attributes["log.file.path"]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Regex juda keng/tor — event'lar noto'g'ri qo'shiladi; real log namunasi bilan test qiling.
- `max_wait_time` uzun — oxirgi event kechikadi; qisqa — trace bo'linadi.
- Bir nechta pod log'lari aralashib ketmasligi uchun stream/fayl bo'yicha identifikator.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng ishonchli yechim — manbada: ilova JSON log yozsin, stack trace bitta `exception.stacktrace` maydonida. Multi-line regex — legacy ilovalar uchun murosaga.

41802.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `msteams_configs` (Alertmanager v0.26+) — Microsoft Teams kanaliga incoming webhook orqali xabar (karta) yuboradi. Teams eski **Office 365 Connectors**ni bosqichma-bosqich o'chirgani sababli yangi yo'l — **Power Automate Workflows** webhook'i; buning uchun Alertmanager v0.28+ da `msteamsv2_configs` (Adaptive Card formati) qo'shilgan.

```
Alertmanager --POST (Adaptive Card JSON)--> Workflows webhook URL --> Teams kanal
   eski: msteams_configs + O365 connector URL (outlook.office.com/webhook/...) -> deprecated
   yangi: msteamsv2_configs + Power Automate URL
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
receivers:
  - name: teams-ops
    msteamsv2_configs:
      - webhook_url_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/teams-webhook
        title: '[{{ .Status | toUpper }}] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}'
        text: |-
          {{ range .Alerts }}- **{{ .Annotations.summary }}** ({{ .Labels.severity }})
          {{ end }}
        send_resolved: true
```
Teams'da: kanal -> Workflows -> "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received" -> URL nusxalash.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eski connector URL'lari ishlashdan to'xtaydi — config'ni yangilamasangiz xabarlar jim yo'qoladi; `alertmanager_notifications_failed_total` ni kuzating.
- Webhook URL — secret (bilgan har kim kanalga yoza oladi).
- Juda uzun karta — Teams 28KB limitidan oshsa rad etadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Tashqi messenger API'lari tez-tez o'zgaradi (Teams connector'lar, Slack legacy webhook'lar). Har receiver uchun notification failure alert'i va yiliga bir marta "test alert" mashqi — jim buzilishdan himoya.

41803.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `prometheus` receiver — OTel Collector ichida to'liq Prometheus **scrape** dvigateli: oddiy `scrape_configs` (service discovery, relabeling bilan) ni qabul qilib, `/metrics` endpoint'lardan tortadi va OTel metrikalariga aylantiradi. Prometheus server o'rnatmasdan scrape qilib, OTLP yoki remote write orqali yuborish mumkin.

```
pod'lar /metrics <--scrape-- collector [prometheus receiver]
                                 -> processors (k8sattributes, batch)
                                 -> prometheusremotewrite / otlp -> Mimir
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
receivers:
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
        - job_name: k8s-pods
          scrape_interval: 30s
          kubernetes_sd_configs: [{role: pod}]
          relabel_configs:
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
              action: keep
              regex: "true"
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
              target_label: namespace
```
Diqqat: config ichida `$` env o'zgaruvchi sifatida tushuniladi — regex'dagi `$1` ni `$$1` deb yozing.
Ko'p collector replica bo'lsa target'larni bo'lish uchun **Target Allocator** (OTel Operator) ishlatiladi:
```yaml
spec:
  mode: statefulset
  targetAllocator: {enabled: true, prometheusCR: {enabled: true}}  # ServiceMonitor'larni ham o'qiydi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- DaemonSet'da Target Allocator'siz har collector hamma target'ni scrape qiladi — dublikat.
- Prometheus'ning hamma imkoniyati yo'q: rule evaluation, alerting yo'q.
- Staleness va `up` metrikasi semantikasi biroz farq qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Agar maqsad faqat scrape + remote write bo'lsa, Prometheus Agent mode yoki Grafana Alloy ham variant. Collector afzalligi — bir agentda metrika, log va trace hamda umumiy processor'lar (k8sattributes, redaction).

41804.a:
**Qisqa javob:** PromQL'da taqqoslash operatorlari (`>`, `<`, `==` ...) default holatda **filtr**: shartni bajarmagan series natijadan tushib qoladi. `bool` modifikatori bilan esa filtrlamaydi, har series uchun `1` (rost) yoki `0` (yolg'on) qaytaradi.

```
node_load1:            {a} 3   {b} 0.5   {c} 2
node_load1 > 1         {a} 3             {c} 2      (b yo'qoldi, qiymat saqlandi)
node_load1 > bool 1    {a} 1   {b} 0     {c} 1      (hammasi, 0/1)
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Nechta node yuklangan (filtr bilan ham bo'ladi, lekin 0 holatda natija bo'sh)
sum(node_load1 > bool 4)                     # 0 bo'lsa ham qiymat qaytadi

# Oxirgi soatdagi vaqtning necha foizida SLO bajarilgan
avg_over_time((job:latency_p99:5m < bool 0.3)[1h:1m])

# Skalyarlar orasida bool majburiy
1 > bool 0        # 1
```

**Qachon kerak:**
- Grafikda 0/1 holat (state timeline).
- Shartni bajarganlarni sanash yoki foizini hisoblash.
- Natija bo'sh bo'lib qolmasligi kerak bo'lganda (alert yoki dashboard "No data" o'rniga 0).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Alert rule'da `bool` ishlatish — natija har doim mavjud (0 ham), alert **doim** firing! Alert'larda filtr shakli kerak.
- `bool` metrika nomini olib tashlaydi.
- Ikki skalyar orasida `bool` siz taqqoslash xato beradi.

**Senior nuqta:** SLI hisoblarida "yaxshi daqiqalar foizi" (window-based SLO) ni `bool` + `avg_over_time` bilan hisoblash qulay; lekin request-based SLO (yaxshi so'rovlar / jami) ko'pincha aniqroq va burn-rate'ga mos.

41806.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Inhibit rule'da `target_matchers` — **bostiriladigan** (jim qilinadigan) alert'larni tanlaydi. Agar `source_matchers` ga mos alert firing bo'lsa va `equal` dagi label'lar ikkalasida bir xil bo'lsa, target'ga mos alert'lar xabar yubormaydi.

**Nega kerak:** klaster yoki node yiqilganda undagi 50 ta servis alert'i ham firing bo'ladi. On-call'ga faqat asl sabab ("NodeDown") kerak, simptomlar emas.

```
source: NodeDown {node=n1, severity=critical}       firing
target: PodNotReady {node=n1, severity=warning}     -> bostiriladi (node bir xil)
target: PodNotReady {node=n2, severity=warning}     -> xabar ketadi (equal mos emas)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
inhibit_rules:
  - source_matchers: [alertname = "NodeDown"]
    target_matchers: [severity =~ "warning|info"]
    equal: [node]
  - source_matchers: [severity = "critical"]
    target_matchers: [severity = "warning"]
    equal: [alertname, cluster, namespace]
```
Tekshirish: Alertmanager UI'da bostirilgan alert'lar "inhibited" holatida (`amtool alert query --inhibited`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `equal` yo'q — bitta NodeDown butun klasterdagi warning'larni jim qiladi.
- Target matcher'lar source alert'ning o'ziga ham mos kelsa — o'zini bostiradi (Alertmanager buni oldini oladi, lekin qoidalar chalkash bo'ladi).
- `equal` label'i alert'lardan birida yo'q bo'lsa — ikkalasida "bo'sh" deb teng hisoblanadi, kutilmagan bostirish.

**Senior nuqta:** Inhibition — topologiyani kodlash. Uni oddiy saqlang (node -> pod, cluster -> hammasi, critical -> warning) va test qiling: noto'g'ri inhibit haqiqiy incident'ni jim qilishi mumkin — bu shovqindan xavfliroq.

41807.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `k8sattributes` processor — OTel Collector telemetriyani yuborgan pod'ni (IP yoki `k8s.pod.uid` orqali) aniqlaydi va Kubernetes API'dan olingan metadata'ni qo'shadi: `k8s.namespace.name`, `k8s.pod.name`, `k8s.deployment.name`, `k8s.node.name`, `k8s.container.name`, hamda tanlangan label/annotation'lar.

**Nega kerak:** ilova o'zi qaysi deployment/namespace'da ekanini bilmaydi. Metadata bo'lmasa "qaysi jamoa servisi?" degan savolga javob yo'q, va metrika-log-trace'ni bir xil kalit bilan bog'lab bo'lmaydi.

```
span (source IP 10.0.3.7) -> k8sattributes
   API watch cache: 10.0.3.7 -> pod order-api-7x, ns shop, deploy order-api, node n1
   -> resource{k8s.pod.name=order-api-7x, k8s.namespace.name=shop, ...}
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
processors:
  k8sattributes:
    auth_type: serviceAccount
    passthrough: false
    filter:
      node_from_env_var: K8S_NODE_NAME     # DaemonSet: faqat o'z node pod'lari (xotira tejash)
    extract:
      metadata: [k8s.namespace.name, k8s.pod.name, k8s.deployment.name, k8s.node.name, k8s.container.name]
      labels:
        - tag_name: app.team
          key: team
          from: pod
    pod_association:
      - sources: [{from: resource_attribute, name: k8s.pod.ip}]
      - sources: [{from: connection}]
```
RBAC: `pods`, `namespaces`, `replicasets` (deployment nomi uchun) ga `get/list/watch`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Gateway collector oldida LB/boshqa collector — `connection` IP pod'niki emas; agent'da `passthrough` yoki resource atributi bilan uzating.
- `node_from_env_var` filtrsiz DaemonSet — har agent butun klaster pod'larini xotirada saqlaydi.
- `hostNetwork` pod'lar — IP node'niki, noto'g'ri pod'ga bog'lanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Agent (DaemonSet) darajasida enrichment + `node` filtri eng arzon va aniq. `team`/`owner` label'ini metadata'ga qo'shish — alert routing va xarajat taqsimotining asosi.

41808.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `offset` — selector'ning baholash vaqtini **orqaga suradi**: `http_requests_total offset 1w` — bir hafta oldingi qiymat. Joriy holatni o'tgan davr bilan solishtirish (week-over-week), anomaliyani aniqlash uchun.

```
now = Juma 12:00
rate(x[5m])            -> Juma 11:55-12:00
rate(x[5m] offset 1w)  -> o'tgan Juma 11:55-12:00
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Trafik o'tgan haftaga nisbatan
sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m] offset 1w))

# Trafik 50% dan ko'p tushdi (anomaliya alert)
sum(rate(http_requests_total[10m]))
  < 0.5 * sum(rate(http_requests_total[10m] offset 1w))

# Grafana'da: bitta panelda ikkita so'rov — "bugun" va "o'tgan hafta" (Time shift ham bor)
```
`offset` selector'dan keyin keladi: `rate(x[5m] offset 1h)` — to'g'ri; `rate(x[5m]) offset 1h` — xato.
`@` modifikatori bilan farq: `x @ 1759449600` — aniq vaqt nuqtasi; `offset` — nisbiy siljish. Manfiy offset ham bor (`offset -1h`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Retention'dan oshgan offset (`offset 30d`, retention 15d) — natija bo'sh.
- Bayram/aksiya kunlari bilan solishtirish — yolg'on anomaliya; bir nechta hafta o'rtachasi barqarorroq.
- Ikkala tomondagi label'lar mos kelishi kerak — `sum` bilan aggregatsiya qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** "Traffic drop" alert'i (o'tgan haftaga nisbatan) — xatolar 0 bo'lsa ham foydalanuvchilar yetib kelmayotganini (DNS, CDN, mobil app bug) ushlaydigan kam baholanadigan signal.

41809.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Data link — Grafana panelidagi qiymat yoki series'ga bog'langan **bosiladigan havola**: boshqa dashboard, Explore yoki tashqi URL (runbook, Kibana, Jira). Havolaga o'zgaruvchilar (`${__field.labels.pod}`, `${__value.raw}`, `${__url_time_range}`) qo'shiladi, shuning uchun kontekst (vaqt, pod, servis) saqlanadi.

**Nega kerak:** overview dashboard'da qizil nuqtani ko'rdingiz — bir bosishda shu pod va shu vaqt oralig'idagi batafsil dashboard yoki log'larga o'tasiz. Drill-down navigatsiya MTTR'ni qisqartiradi.

```
Overview: "api p99" grafigi, pod=api-7x nuqtasi
   click -> /d/pod-detail?var-pod=api-7x&from=...&to=...
   click -> Explore Loki {pod="api-7x"}
```

**Amalda:**
Panel -> Field -> Data links -> Add link:
```
Title: Pod tafsilotlari
URL:   /d/abc123/pod-detail?var-namespace=${__field.labels.namespace}&var-pod=${__field.labels.pod}&${__url_time_range}
```
```
Title: Runbook
URL:   https://wiki.example.com/runbooks/${__field.labels.alertname}
```
Bog'liq tushunchalar: **dashboard links** (dashboard tepasidagi havolalar), **correlations** (data source'lar orasida Explore'da), **derived fields** (log ichidan trace ID).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Label nomi xato (`${__field.labels.pod_name}`) — havola bo'sh qiymat bilan ochiladi.
- `${__url_time_range}` yo'q — ochilgan dashboard default vaqtda, kontekst yo'qoladi.
- Dashboard UID o'rniga nom/slug — dashboard ko'chirilganda havola sinadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Dashboard'larni ierarxiya sifatida loyihalang: servislar xaritasi -> servis -> pod -> log/trace/profile, har bosqich data link bilan. Bu "dashboard sprawl" ni kamaytiradi.

41810.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Alertmanager route daraxtida alert yuqoridan pastga tekshiriladi va **birinchi mos** child route'da to'xtaydi. `continue: true` bo'lsa, mos kelgan route ishlagandan keyin ham keyingi **aka-uka** (sibling) route'larni tekshirishda davom etadi — bitta alert bir nechta receiver'ga ketadi.

```
route (default: slack-ops)
  +-- matchers: severity=critical, continue: true  -> pagerduty   (mos, davom)
  +-- matchers: team=pay                           -> slack-pay   (mos, to'xtaydi)
  +-- matchers: team=pay, env=prod                 -> (yetib kelinmaydi)
Alert {severity=critical, team=pay} -> pagerduty + slack-pay
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
route:
  receiver: slack-ops
  routes:
    - receiver: audit-webhook     # hamma alert'larni log qilish
      matchers: [alertname =~ ".+"]
      continue: true
    - receiver: pagerduty
      matchers: [severity = "critical"]
      continue: true
    - receiver: slack-pay
      matchers: [team = "pay"]
```
Test:
```bash
amtool config routes test --config.file=alertmanager.yml severity=critical team=pay
# chiqish: audit-webhook,pagerduty,slack-pay
amtool config routes show --config.file=alertmanager.yml
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `continue` ni unutish — critical alert faqat birinchi mos route'ga ketadi, jamoa kanali ko'rmaydi.
- Hamma joyda `continue: true` — hech qaysi route to'xtamaydi va oxiri default receiver'ga ham tushmaydi (agar mos route bo'lsa default ishlamaydi); kutilmagan dublikatlar.
- Tartib muhim — umumiy route'lar yuqorida bo'lsa aniq route'larga yetib kelinmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Route daraxtini `amtool config routes test` bilan CI'da test-case'lar orqali tekshiring (har jamoa/severity kombinatsiyasi uchun kutilgan receiver'lar). Routing xatosi — "alert bor edi, lekin hech kim ko'rmadi" incident'larining eng ko'p sababi.

41811.a:
**Qisqa javob:** OTLP standart portlari: **4317** — OTLP/gRPC, **4318** — OTLP/HTTP (protobuf yoki JSON). HTTP yo'llari: `/v1/traces`, `/v1/metrics`, `/v1/logs`.

```
SDK --gRPC--> collector:4317
SDK --HTTP--> collector:4318/v1/traces
Brauzer (faqat HTTP mumkin) --> 4318 (CORS kerak)
```

**Qaysi birini tanlash:**
| | gRPC (4317) | HTTP (4318) |
|---|---|---|
| Samaradorlik | HTTP/2 stream, biroz tezroq | yaxshi |
| Proxy/LB | L7 gRPC qo'llovi kerak, uzoq ulanishlar LB'da notekis | oddiy HTTP, har joyda ishlaydi |
| Brauzer | yo'q | ha |
| Debug | qiyinroq | `curl` bilan oson |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317}
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
        cors: {allowed_origins: ["https://shop.uz"]}
```
```bash
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://otel-collector:4318
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf     # yoki grpc (4317)
nc -zv otel-collector 4317 4318
```
Eslatma: SDK'lar default protokoli turlicha (Java/JS — `http/protobuf`, Go — paket bo'yicha tanlanadi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Port va protokol mos emas (`grpc` 4318 ga) — "connection reset" yoki 415 xatolari.
- Collector `localhost:4317` da tinglaydi (yangi versiyalar default) — pod tashqarisidan yetib bo'lmaydi; `0.0.0.0` ni aniq yozing.
- HTTP exporter'da endpoint'ga `/v1/traces` ni ikki marta qo'shish (`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT` to'liq yo'l kutadi, umumiy endpoint esa yo'q).

**Senior nuqta:** Kubernetes'da gRPC uzoq umrli ulanishlari sabab ClusterIP orqali yuk bir collector'ga tushishi mumkin — headless service + client-side balancing yoki HTTP. Tashqi kirishda TLS va autentifikatsiya (bearer token extension) majburiy.

41812.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `label_join(v, "dst", "separator", "src1", "src2", ...)` — har series uchun bir nechta label qiymatini ajratuvchi bilan birlashtirib, yangi `dst` label'ini yaratadi. Asl label'lar saqlanib qoladi.

```
up{job="api", instance="10.0.3.7:8080"}
label_join(up, "target", "/", "job", "instance")
-> up{job="api", instance="10.0.3.7:8080", target="api/10.0.3.7:8080"}
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Grafana legend yoki jadval uchun bitta kalit
label_join(kube_pod_info, "ns_pod", "/", "namespace", "pod")

# Ikki metrikani turli label nomlari bilan join qilish uchun kalit yasash
label_join(metric_a, "key", "-", "cluster", "service")
  * on (key) group_left
label_join(metric_b, "key", "-", "cluster", "svc")
```
Grafana'da ko'pincha legend format (`{{namespace}}/{{pod}}`) yetarli — `label_join` kerak emas.

**`label_join` vs `label_replace`:**
| | `label_join` | `label_replace` |
|---|---|---|
| Kirish | bir nechta label | bitta label + regex |
| Vazifa | birlashtirish | qismini ajratish/o'zgartirish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Mavjud label nomini `dst` qilish — ustidan yoziladi.
- Bo'sh label'lar — natijada `api/` kabi chala qiymat.
- Yuqori cardinality'li natijani recording rule'da saqlash — series soni oshmasa ham label hajmi oshadi.

**Senior nuqta:** `label_join`/`label_replace` — so'rov vaqtidagi plaster; turli exporter'lar label'larni turlicha nomlasa, to'g'ri yechim — scrape paytida relabeling bilan standartlashtirish (bitta `service` label hamma joyda).

41813.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana Alerting'da har alert instance holati: **Normal** (shart bajarilmagan), **Pending** (shart bajarildi, lekin `pending period` hali o'tmadi), **Alerting/Firing** (pending period o'tdi, xabar notification policy'ga ketdi), **NoData** (so'rov hech qanday series qaytarmadi), **Error** (so'rov bajarilmadi: timeout, data source xatosi). Yangi versiyalarda **Recovering** (keep firing for davri) ham bor.

```
Normal --shart rost--> Pending --pending period (for) o'tdi--> Alerting
   ^                     |                                        |
   +---- shart yolg'on --+------------- shart yolg'on ------------+
So'rov bo'sh -> NoData      So'rov xato -> Error
(NoData/Error -> sozlamaga qarab Alerting, Normal yoki KeepLast)
```

**Amalda:**
Rule sozlamalari:
```yaml
- uid: api-errors
  title: API error rate
  condition: C
  for: 5m                       # pending period
  keepFiringFor: 2m             # Recovering
  noDataState: NoData           # NoData | Alerting | OK | KeepLast
  execErrState: Error           # Error | Alerting | OK | KeepLast
```
Holat tarixi: Alerting -> Alert rules -> rule -> "State history" (Loki'da saqlash mumkin).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `NoData` -> `OK` — exporter yiqilsa alert jim; muhim alert'lar uchun NoData'ni alert qiling yoki alohida `absent` qoidasi.
- `Error` -> `Alerting` — data source pirpirasa yolg'on page'lar.
- `for: 0` — bitta noto'g'ri nuqta darhol page qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** NoData/Error siyosatini alert turiga qarab tanlang: "yo'qolgan signal = muammo" (heartbeat) bo'lsa Alerting, shovqinli manba bo'lsa KeepLast. Grafana NoData va Error uchun alohida `DatasourceNoData`/`DatasourceError` alert'larini yaratadi — ularni ham routing'da hisobga oling.

41814.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Alertmanager `webhook_configs` (va boshqa receiver'lar) da `http_config.tls_config` HTTPS sertifikatini **tekshirish**ni boshqaradi: ishonchli CA (`ca_file`), mTLS uchun client sertifikati (`cert_file`, `key_file`), `server_name`, `min_version`. `insecure_skip_verify: true` tekshiruvni o'chiradi — prod'da ishlatmang.

**Nega muhim:** alert payload'ida ichki hostname, IP, ba'zan mijoz ma'lumotlari bor. Tekshiruvsiz TLS — MITM hujumchi alert'larni o'qishi yoki soxta javob qaytarishi mumkin.

```
Alertmanager --TLS--> https://incident-bot.internal
   tekshiradi: sertifikat ichki CA imzolaganmi, server_name mosmi, muddati
   mTLS: o'z client sertifikatini ko'rsatadi -> bot faqat AM'dan qabul qiladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
receivers:
  - name: incident-bot
    webhook_configs:
      - url: https://incident-bot.internal:8443/alert
        http_config:
          tls_config:
            ca_file: /etc/alertmanager/tls/internal-ca.crt
            cert_file: /etc/alertmanager/tls/am-client.crt
            key_file: /etc/alertmanager/tls/am-client.key
            server_name: incident-bot.internal
            min_version: TLS12
          authorization:
            type: Bearer
            credentials_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/bot-token
```
Tekshirish:
```bash
openssl s_client -connect incident-bot.internal:8443 -CAfile internal-ca.crt -servername incident-bot.internal
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ichki self-signed sertifikat bilan "ishlamadi" deb `insecure_skip_verify` qo'yish — `ca_file` to'g'ri yechim.
- Client sertifikat muddati tugashi — alert'lar jim yo'qoladi; muddatni kuzating (`alertmanager_notifications_failed_total`).
- Sertifikat almashtirilganda reload kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Alerting kanali — kritik infratuzilma, uning sertifikatlari va token'lari ham boshqa secret'lar kabi rotation va monitoring ostida bo'lsin. cert-manager bilan avtomatik yangilash + notification failure alert'i.

41815.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `TraceIdRatioBased` sampler trace ID'ga qarab deterministik foizni tanlaydi. U odatda `ParentBased` ichiga o'raladi: **root** span uchun ratio qaror qiladi, **child** span'lar esa parent'ning qarorini (traceparent'dagi `sampled` flag) meros qiladi. Shunda trace to'liq yoki umuman saqlanmaydi — waterfall uzilmaydi.

```
Service A (root): TraceIdRatio(0.1) -> sampled=1 -> traceparent ...-01
Service B: ParentBased -> parent sampled=1 -> sample (o'z ratio'si 0.01 bo'lsa ham)
Service C: ParentBased -> parent sampled=0 -> drop
```
ParentBased'siz har servis o'z ratio'si bilan qaror qilsa: A saqladi, B tashladi -> trace teshik.

**Amalda:**
```go
sampler := sdktrace.ParentBased(
    sdktrace.TraceIDRatioBased(0.1),            // root uchun 10%
    // ixtiyoriy: remote parent sampled emas bo'lsa ham...
    // sdktrace.WithRemoteParentNotSampled(sdktrace.NeverSample()),
)
```
```bash
export OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio
export OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.1
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tashqi client `sampled=1` bilan keladi — ParentBased hamma so'rovni 100% saqlaydi (xarajat, hujum vektori). Edge'da remote parent'ga ishonmaslik siyosati.
- Head sampling xato/sekin trace'larni oldindan bilmaydi — 10% da xatolarning 90% i yo'qoladi. Kerak bo'lsa tail sampling.
- Turli SDK'lar ratio hisoblashda turli bitlarni ishlatgan (eski) — W3C TraceContext Level 2 `random` flag va consistent probability sampling buni standartlashtirmoqda.

**Senior nuqta:** Odatiy arxitektura: SDK'da ParentBased + yuqoriroq ratio (yoki 100%), collector'da tail sampling (xatolar, sekinlar, baseline). Metrikalarni sampling'dan oldin hisoblang.

41816.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `label_replace(v, "dst", "replacement", "src", "regex")` — har series uchun `src` label qiymatini `regex` bilan moslaydi; mos kelsa `replacement` (`$1`, `$2` guruhlari bilan) natijasini `dst` label'iga yozadi. Mos kelmasa series o'zgarmasdan qoladi.

```
up{instance="10.0.3.7:8080"}
label_replace(up, "host", "$1", "instance", "(.*):.*")
-> up{instance="10.0.3.7:8080", host="10.0.3.7"}
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Port'ni olib tashlab node_exporter bilan join qilish
label_replace(rate(app_requests_total[5m]), "node_ip", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+):.*")

# Label nomini moslashtirish (svc -> service) va join
sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
  / on (service)
sum by (service) (label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas, "service", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"))

# Statik label qo'shish (regex bo'sh qatorga ham mos)
label_replace(vector(1), "env", "prod", "", "")
```
Regex to'liq moslanadi (`^...$`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Regex mos kelmasa xato yo'q — natija jim o'zgarmagan; join keyin bo'sh chiqadi.
- `dst` mavjud label bo'lsa ustidan yoziladi; ikki series bir xil label to'plamiga ega bo'lib qolsa — "duplicate series" xatosi.
- `$1` dan keyin harf: `${1}abc` deb yozing.

**Senior nuqta:** Dashboard'da doimiy `label_replace` — label standartlari yo'qligi belgisi. Uzoq muddatda relabeling (ingest'da) yoki recording rule bilan bir marta to'g'rilang; so'rov vaqtidagi tuzatish har so'rovda CPU sarflaydi.

41817.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Grafana Alerting'da rule so'rovi **xato** (timeout, data source yiqilgan, noto'g'ri so'rov) bo'lganda nima qilishni `Alert state if execution error or timeout` (`execErrState`) belgilaydi: **Error** (alohida holat + `DatasourceError` alert), **Alerting** (firing deb hisoblash), **Normal/OK** (jim) yoki **KeepLast** (oldingi holatni saqlash).

**Trade-off:**
| Tanlov | Yaxshi | Xavf |
|---|---|---|
| Alerting | data source o'lsa ham bilasiz | pirpirashda yolg'on page |
| Error | xato alohida ko'rinadi | routing'da hisobga olish kerak |
| KeepLast | qisqa uzilishlarda barqaror | uzoq uzilishda eski holat "muzlaydi" |
| OK | shovqin yo'q | haqiqiy muammo jim o'tib ketadi |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
rules:
  - uid: pay-errors
    title: Payment error rate
    execErrState: KeepLast
    noDataState: Alerting
    for: 5m
```
Data source sog'lig'ini alohida kuzating:
```promql
# Grafana o'z metrikalari
rate(grafana_alerting_rule_evaluation_failures_total[5m]) > 0
```
`DatasourceError` alert'lari `datasource_uid`, `ref_id` label'lari bilan keladi — ularni platform jamoasiga route qiling, servis jamoasiga emas.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hammasini `Alerting` qilish — Prometheus restart'ida butun jamoa page oladi.
- Hammasini `OK` qilish — data source bir kun yiqilib yotsa hech kim bilmaydi.
- Evaluation timeout (`evaluation_timeout`) juda qisqa — og'ir so'rovlar muntazam xato.

**Senior nuqta:** Servis alert'larida `KeepLast` yoki `Error`, platforma darajasida esa bitta "alerting pipeline sog'lig'i" alert'i (evaluation failures, data source up) — har rule data source muammosi uchun alohida page qilmasin.

41818.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Inhibit rule'da `source_matchers` — **bostiruvchi** alert'ni tanlaydi. Shu matcher'larga mos alert firing bo'lsa, `target_matchers` ga mos va `equal` label'lari bir xil bo'lgan alert'lar jim qilinadi. Source odatda yuqori darajali yoki asl sabab alert'i (ClusterDown, NodeDown, critical).

```
source_matchers: [alertname="DatacenterDown"]   equal: [dc]
  firing: DatacenterDown{dc="tash"}
target'lar: ServiceDown{dc="tash"} -> jim;  ServiceDown{dc="sam"} -> xabar
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
inhibit_rules:
  # Butun klaster yiqilsa, ichidagi hamma narsa jim
  - source_matchers: [alertname = "KubeClusterUnreachable"]
    target_matchers: [alertname != "KubeClusterUnreachable"]
    equal: [cluster]
  # Maintenance belgisi (InfoInhibitor pattern)
  - source_matchers: [alertname = "MaintenanceMode"]
    target_matchers: [severity =~ "warning|critical"]
    equal: [cluster]
```
kube-prometheus-stack'da `InfoInhibitor` alert'i shunga misol: `severity=info` alert'lar faqat boshqa alert bilan birga bo'lganda ko'rinadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Source alert'ning o'zi resolved bo'lsa inhibit darhol tugaydi — target'lar to'satdan xabar yuboradi (bu kutilgan).
- Source alert silence qilingan bo'lsa ham inhibit ishlaydi — silence'ni "jim qilish" uchun ishlatish kutilmagan bostirishga olib keladi.
- Source alert yuborilmasa (masalan Prometheus'ning o'zi yiqilsa) — hech narsa bostirilmaydi, aksincha hammasi yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Source alert ishonchli bo'lishi kerak — agar u yolg'on firing bo'lsa, haqiqiy alert'larni yashiradi. Inhibition qoidalarini "dependency graph" ga asoslang va har yangi qoidani routing testlariga qo'shing.

41819.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Memory ballast — OTel Collector'da (va boshqa Go servislarda) ishlatilgan eski usul: katta, tegilmaydigan `[]byte` (masalan heap'ning 1/3 i) ajratiladi, shunda Go GC heap'ni "katta" deb hisoblab kamroq ishlaydi. `memory_ballast` extension endi **olib tashlangan**; o'rniga Go 1.19+ ning `GOMEMLIMIT` (soft memory limit) ishlatiladi.

**Nega ballast kerak edi:** Go GC default'da (`GOGC=100`) heap ikki baravar o'sganda ishga tushadi. Kichik heap'li, ko'p allokatsiyali collector'da GC juda tez-tez ishlab CPU yeydi. Ballast heap bazasini sun'iy kattalashtirgan.

```
Eski:  ballast 600MB (RSS'ga deyarli kirmaydi, sahifalar tegilmaydi) -> GC kam
Yangi: GOMEMLIMIT=1600MiB -> GC limitga yaqinlashguncha kam ishlaydi, yaqinlashganda agressiv
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# Kubernetes: limitning ~80% i
env:
  - name: GOMEMLIMIT
    value: "1600MiB"
resources:
  limits: {memory: 2Gi}
processors:
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 20
```
Yangi collector versiyalari `GOMEMLIMIT` ni avtomatik (container limitidan) ham qo'yishi mumkin — release note'larni tekshiring.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eski config'da `memory_ballast` qolgan — yangi collector ishga tushmaydi ("unknown extension").
- `GOMEMLIMIT` = container limit — GC yetib ulgurmay OOMKill; 80% atrofida qo'ying.
- `memory_limiter` processor'ni olib tashlash — `GOMEMLIMIT` faqat GC'ni boshqaradi, ma'lumot oqimini emas.

**Senior nuqta:** `GOMEMLIMIT` — har qanday Go servis uchun (Prometheus, Loki, o'z ilovalaringiz) container'da foydali sozlama. Lekin u xotira "taqchilligini" yechmaydi — ish yuki limitdan oshsa GC thrash bo'ladi; backpressure (`memory_limiter`) kerak.

41820.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `time()` — baholash vaqtini Unix timestamp sifatida (soniyalarda, float) qaytaradi. Asosan "qancha vaqt o'tdi" yoki "qancha vaqt qoldi" hisoblari uchun: uptime, oxirgi muvaffaqiyatli job'dan beri, sertifikat muddatigacha.

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Process qancha vaqtdan beri ishlayapti (soniya)
time() - process_start_time_seconds{job="api"}

# Backup 26 soatdan beri muvaffaqiyatli bo'lmagan
time() - backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds > 26 * 3600

# Sertifikat qolgan kunlar
(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time()) / 86400

# Yaqinda restart bo'lgan pod'lar (10 daqiqa ichida)
time() - kube_pod_start_time < 600
```
Range query'da `time()` har `step` nuqtasida o'sha nuqtaning vaqti — grafik to'g'ri chiziladi.

**Pattern — batch job monitoring:**
```
job tugadi -> Pushgateway / textfile: backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds = <unix ts>
alert: time() - metrika > SLA
```
Bu "job ishladimi?" degan savolga ishonchli javob (counter emas, timestamp).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Metrika yo'q bo'lsa (job hech qachon ishlamagan) — ifoda bo'sh, alert jim; `absent()` qo'shing.
- Millisekundli timestamp metrikalar (`*_ms`) — 1000 ga bo'ling.
- `time()` va `timestamp()` ni chalkashtirish — biri hozirgi vaqt, ikkinchisi sample vaqti.

**Senior nuqta:** "Oxirgi muvaffaqiyat timestamp'i" pattern'i cron job, backup, ETL va sertifikatlar uchun eng sodda va ishonchli monitoring. Har batch jarayon shu metrikani chiqarishi standart bo'lsin.

41821.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Contact point — Grafana Alerting'da xabar **qayerga va qanday** yuborilishini belgilaydi: bir yoki bir nechta integratsiya (Slack, email, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Teams, Telegram, webhook, OnCall) va ularning sozlamalari/template'lari. Notification policy alert'ni contact point'ga yo'naltiradi.

```
Alert rule (label: team=pay, severity=critical)
   -> Notification policy (team=pay & critical)
   -> Contact point "pay-critical"
        +-- PagerDuty (integration key)
        +-- Slack #pay-alerts
```

**Amalda (provisioning):**
```yaml
apiVersion: 1
contactPoints:
  - orgId: 1
    name: pay-critical
    receivers:
      - uid: pay-pd
        type: pagerduty
        settings:
          integrationKey: $__file{/etc/grafana/secrets/pd-pay}
          severity: critical
      - uid: pay-slack
        type: slack
        settings:
          recipient: "#pay-alerts"
          token: $__file{/etc/grafana/secrets/slack-bot}
          title: '{{ template "default.title" . }}'
        disableResolveMessage: false
```
UI: Alerting -> Contact points -> "Test" tugmasi bilan sinov xabari.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret'larni provisioning faylida ochiq yozish — `$__file{}` yoki `$__env{}`.
- Test qilinmagan contact point — birinchi haqiqiy incident'da ishlamasligi ma'lum bo'ladi.
- Bitta contact point'ga hamma narsa — jamoalar bo'yicha ajratish yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Contact point'larni jamoa x severity bo'yicha nomlang va Terraform (`grafana_contact_point`) bilan boshqaring. Har chorakda "fire drill": test alert yuborib, kim qancha vaqtda ack qilganini o'lchang.

41822.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Alertmanager matcher operatorlari (route, inhibit, silence, `amtool` uchun bir xil): `=` aniq teng, `!=` teng emas, `=~` regex mos keladi, `!~` regex mos kelmaydi. Regex RE2 sintaksisida va **to'liq** moslanadi.

| Operator | Misol | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|---|
| `=` | `severity="critical"` | aynan critical |
| `!=` | `env!="dev"` | dev bo'lmagan (label yo'q bo'lsa ham mos) |
| `=~` | `team=~"pay.*"` | pay bilan boshlanadi |
| `!~` | `alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"` | bular emas |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
route:
  routes:
    - matchers:
        - severity = "critical"
        - env != "dev"
        - service =~ "checkout|payment"
      receiver: pagerduty
```
```bash
amtool silence add 'alertname=~"Disk.*"' 'instance="db-1:9100"' --duration=1h --comment="disk swap"
amtool alert query 'severity!="info"'
```
Ro'yxatdagi matcher'lar AND bilan birlashadi; OR uchun regex (`a|b`) yoki alohida route.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `=~"pay"` faqat aynan `pay` ga mos (to'liq moslik) — `pay.*` kerak.
- `!=` label yo'q alert'larga ham mos keladi — kutilmagan routing.
- `=` bilan bo'sh qiymat (`team=""`) — label yo'q alert'larni tanlaydi (foydali, lekin chalkash).
- Qo'shtirnoqsiz maxsus belgilar — YAML yoki parser xatosi; qiymatlarni doim qo'shtirnoqqa oling.

**Senior nuqta:** Silence'larda regex'dan ehtiyot bo'ling — `alertname=~".*"` butun tizimni jim qiladi. Silence yaratishda avval `amtool alert query` bilan aynan qaysi alert'lar mos kelishini ko'ring.

41823.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `transform` processor — OTel Collector'da telemetriyani **OTTL** (OpenTelemetry Transformation Language) iboralari bilan o'zgartiradi: atribut qo'yish/o'chirish/nomini o'zgartirish, regex bilan almashtirish, log body'ni parse qilish, metrika nomini/birligini o'zgartirish. Har ibora shartli (`where`) bo'lishi mumkin.

**Nega kerak:** ilovalar turli formatda telemetriya chiqaradi; kodni o'zgartirmasdan pipeline'da normallashtirish, PII tozalash, cardinality kamaytirish.

```
span{http.url=".../users/42?token=x", env="PROD"}
  -> transform:
       replace_pattern(attributes["http.url"], "token=[^&]+", "token=***")
       set(attributes["env"], "prod") where attributes["env"] == "PROD"
  -> span{http.url=".../users/42?token=***", env="prod"}
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
processors:
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
      - context: span
        statements:
          - delete_key(attributes, "http.request.header.authorization")
          - replace_pattern(attributes["url.full"], "token=[^&]+", "token=***")
          - set(attributes["deployment.environment"], "prod") where resource.attributes["k8s.namespace.name"] == "shop"
    log_statements:
      - context: log
        statements:
          - merge_maps(attributes, ParseJSON(body), "upsert") where IsMatch(body, "^\\{")
          - set(severity_text, attributes["level"])
    metric_statements:
      - context: datapoint
        statements:
          - delete_key(attributes, "user_id")
```
Kontekstlar: `resource`, `scope`, `span`, `spanevent`, `log`, `metric`, `datapoint`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `error_mode: propagate` (default'lardan biri) — bitta noto'g'ri ibora butun batch'ni tashlaydi; `ignore` va log'ni kuzatish.
- Metrikada label o'chirish — bir xil series'lar to'qnashadi (aggregatsiya qilinmaydi).
- Murakkab regex'lar yuqori throughput'da CPU yeydi.

**Senior nuqta:** OTTL — eski `attributes`, `resource`, `metricstransform` processor'larining umumiy o'rnini bosuvchi yo'nalish. Transform qoidalarini kod kabi test qiling (namuna telemetriya bilan) va o'zgartirishni minimal saqlang — eng yaxshi tuzatish manbada.

41824.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `timestamp(v)` — instant vector'dagi har sample'ning **o'z timestamp'ini** (Unix soniya) qiymat sifatida qaytaradi. Ya'ni "bu qiymat qachon yozilgan?" — oxirgi scrape yoki push vaqti.

**`time()` bilan farq:**
```
time()               -> so'rov baholanayotgan vaqt (hozir)       12:00:00
timestamp(up{...})   -> up'ning oxirgi sample vaqti              11:59:45
time() - timestamp() -> ma'lumot qanchalik eski                  15s
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Pushgateway metrikasi qachon oxirgi marta yangilangan (batch job tirikmi)
time() - timestamp(batch_job_last_run_status) > 3600

# Exporter sekin/to'xtagan: sample'lar eskirgan
time() - timestamp(node_time_seconds) > 120

# Remote write / federation kechikishi
time() - max(timestamp(up{cluster="eu"}))
```
Eslatma: Prometheus 3.x da `timestamp()` aniq sample vaqtini qaytaradi; eski versiyalarda ichki funksiyalar bilan ishlatilganda baholash vaqtiga aylanishi mumkin edi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Instant so'rov 5 daqiqalik lookback ichida oxirgi sample'ni oladi — 5 daqiqadan eski ma'lumot umuman qaytmaydi, `timestamp()` ham bo'sh.
- Pushgateway'da metrika "abadiy" — qiymat o'zgarmasa ham timestamp scrape vaqti bo'ladi (Pushgateway `push_time_seconds` metrikasini ishlating).
- `timestamp(rate(...))` — baholash vaqtini beradi, foydasiz.

**Senior nuqta:** "Ma'lumot yangiligi" (freshness) — o'zi alohida SLI: pipeline (exporter, federation, remote write) kechiksa dashboard'lar yolg'on gapiradi. `time() - timestamp()` bilan freshness alert'i ko'p "nima uchun grafik tekis?" savolini oldini oladi.

41825.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Threshold'lar — Grafana panellarida qiymat diapazonlariga rang biriktirish: masalan 0-70 yashil, 70-90 sariq, 90+ qizil. Stat, gauge, bar gauge, table, time series (chiziq/hudud sifatida) va canvas panellarda ishlaydi. Rejim: **absolute** (qiymat) yoki **percentage** (min/max'ga nisbatan).

**Nega kerak:** raqam o'zi "87%" ni yaxshi yoki yomon ekanini aytmaydi. Rang bir qarashda holatni ko'rsatadi — NOC ekranlari va stakeholder dashboard'lari uchun.

```
Base (yashil) ---- 70 (sariq) ---- 90 (qizil)
qiymat 65 -> yashil; 82 -> sariq; 95 -> qizil
Time series: "Show thresholds: as lines / as filled regions"
```

**Amalda (panel JSON qismi):**
```json
"fieldConfig": {
  "defaults": {
    "unit": "percent",
    "min": 0, "max": 100,
    "thresholds": {
      "mode": "absolute",
      "steps": [
        {"color": "green", "value": null},
        {"color": "orange", "value": 70},
        {"color": "red", "value": 90}
      ]
    },
    "color": {"mode": "thresholds"}
  }
}
```
Teskari metrika (masalan SLO budjeti qolgan %): qizil past qiymatda — `red: null, orange: 20, green: 50`.
Field override bilan bitta panelda turli maydonlarga turli threshold.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Threshold'lar alert chegaralari bilan mos emas — dashboard yashil, alert firing (yoki aksincha).
- Percentage rejimida min/max berilmasa — Grafana ularni ma'lumotdan hisoblaydi, ranglar "sakraydi".
- Rang ko'r foydalanuvchilar — faqat qizil/yashil; matn yoki ikonka bilan to'ldiring.

**Senior nuqta:** Threshold qiymatlarini SLO va alert qoidalaridan oling (bitta manba). Dashboard'ni kod bilan yaratayotganda ularni o'zgaruvchi qilib alert rule bilan bir joyda saqlang.

41826.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Default receiver — Alertmanager route daraxtining **ildiz** (`route.receiver`) receiver'i. Alert hech qaysi child route'ga mos kelmasa (yoki child route o'z receiver'ini bermasa) shu yerga tushadi. U majburiy maydon.

**Nega muhim:** yangi jamoa `team` label'isiz alert yozdi yoki label'da xato bor — alert biror joyga borishi kerak, jim yo'qolmasligi kerak. Default receiver — xavfsizlik to'ri.

```
route (receiver: catch-all-slack)          <- default
  +-- team=pay -> pay-pagerduty
  +-- team=web -> web-slack
Alert {team="paymnt"} (xato) -> hech qaysi mos emas -> catch-all-slack
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
route:
  receiver: catch-all
  group_by: [alertname, cluster]
  routes:
    - matchers: [team = "pay"]
      receiver: pay-pagerduty
    - matchers: [team = "web"]
      receiver: web-slack
    - matchers: [alertname = "Watchdog"]
      receiver: deadmans-switch
receivers:
  - name: catch-all
    slack_configs:
      - channel: '#alerts-unrouted'
        title: 'MARSHRUTSIZ alert: {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}'
```
Child route receiver bermasa, ota-ona receiver'ini meros qiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default receiver = `null` (bo'sh receiver) — marshrutsiz alert'lar jim yo'qoladi.
- Default'ni critical PagerDuty'ga qo'yish — har label xatosi tungi page.
- Hech kim kuzatmaydigan "unrouted" kanal.

**Senior nuqta:** `#alerts-unrouted` kanalini platform jamoasi kuzatsin va undagi har xabar — routing/label gigiyenasini tuzatish uchun ticket. Maqsad: bu kanal bo'sh bo'lishi. Label sxemasini CI'da (promtool + lint) majburlash buni oldini oladi.

41827.a:
**Qisqa javob:** W3C `baggage` — kontekst bilan birga servislar bo'ylab tarqaladigan **key-value** juftliklar header'i: `baggage: tenant=acme,tier=gold,feature.x=on`. `traceparent` faqat trace ID tashiydi; baggage esa biznes kontekstini (tenant, region, eksperiment) zanjirdagi har servisga yetkazadi.

**Nega kerak:** chuqurdagi servis (5-hop) "bu so'rov qaysi tenant'niki?" ni bilishi kerak — har API'ga parametr qo'shmasdan. Masalan metrika va log'larni tenant bo'yicha belgilash, feature flag yoki routing.

```
gateway: baggage tenant=acme
  -> orders (o'qiydi, span atributiga yozadi)
     -> payments (o'qiydi)
        -> fraud (o'qiydi, tenant bo'yicha limit)
Header avtomatik uzatiladi (propagator orqali)
```

**Amalda (Go):**
```go
m, _ := baggage.NewMember("tenant", "acme")
b, _ := baggage.New(m)
ctx = baggage.ContextWithBaggage(ctx, b)        // keyingi chaqiruvlarda header'ga ketadi

// Pastki servisda
tenant := baggage.FromContext(ctx).Member("tenant").Value()
span.SetAttributes(attribute.String("tenant", tenant))
```
Collector/SDK'da baggage'ni span atributlariga avtomatik ko'chiruvchi span processor'lar bor (baggage span processor).
```bash
export OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,baggage
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Baggage **hamma** chiquvchi so'rovga, shu jumladan uchinchi tomon API'lariga ketadi — sezgir ma'lumot (email, token) yozmang.
- Hajm limiti (8192 bayt, 180 a'zo) — katta baggage har so'rov overhead'i.
- Tashqi client yuborgan baggage'ga ishonish — tenant soxtalashtirish; edge'da tozalang.

**Senior nuqta:** Baggage — avtorizatsiya manbai emas, faqat kuzatuv/routing konteksti. Trust boundary'da (ingress) kiruvchi baggage'ni tozalab, o'zingiz autentifikatsiyadan chiqargan qiymatlarni qo'ying.

41828.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `changes(v[range])` — oyna davomida series qiymati **necha marta o'zgarganini** qaytaradi. Gauge yoki "holat/timestamp" metrikalari uchun: config reload'lar, restart'lar (start time o'zgarishi), leader almashinuvi, flapping.

```
sample: 1 1 1 2 2 3 3 3 1
changes(...) = 3   (1->2, 2->3, 3->1)
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Oxirgi soatda process necha marta restart bo'lgan (start time o'zgaradi)
changes(process_start_time_seconds{job="api"}[1h]) > 3

# Config reload'lar soni
changes(prometheus_config_last_reload_success_timestamp_seconds[1d])

# Leader flapping (etcd / Kafka controller)
changes(etcd_server_is_leader[15m]) > 2

# Target pirpirashi (up 0/1 almashinuvi)
changes(up[30m]) > 4
```

**`changes()` vs `resets()` vs `rate()`:**
| Funksiya | Nima sanaydi | Metrika turi |
|---|---|---|
| `changes` | har qanday o'zgarish | gauge |
| `resets` | kamayishlar (counter reset) | counter |
| `rate` | o'sish tezligi | counter |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Counter'ga `changes()` — har scrape'da o'zgaradi, natija = sample soni; ma'nosiz.
- Float shovqinli gauge (CPU temp) — deyarli har sample o'zgaradi.
- Oyna ichida sample kam bo'lsa o'zgarishlar o'tkazib yuboriladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Kubernetes'da restart'lar uchun `increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[1h])` aniqroq; lekin `changes(process_start_time_seconds)` orchestrator'siz (VM, systemd) ham ishlaydi. Flapping alert'lari ko'pincha boshqa alert'larning shovqin manbasi — ularni topishda `changes()` foydali.

41829.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Transformations — Grafana'da so'rov natijalarini panel chizishdan **oldin** (brauzerda) o'zgartirish: bir nechta so'rov natijasini join qilish, maydonlarni qayta nomlash/yashirish, filtrlash, hisoblangan maydon qo'shish, guruhlash, series'ni qatorga aylantirish. Bir nechta transformation zanjir bo'lib ketma-ket qo'llanadi.

**Nega kerak:** turli data source'lardan (Prometheus + PostgreSQL) kelgan ma'lumotni bitta jadvalda ko'rsatish yoki PromQL bilan qiyin bo'lgan formatlash — backend so'rovini o'zgartirmasdan.

```
Query A (Prometheus): pod, cpu
Query B (Prometheus): pod, memory
Query C (PostgreSQL): pod, owner_team
  -> Join by field (pod)
  -> Organize fields (rename, hide)
  -> Add field from calculation (memory / limit * 100)
  -> Filter data by values (cpu > 0.5)
  -> Jadval
```

**Amalda (eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlar):**
| Transformation | Vazifa |
|---|---|
| Merge / Join by field | so'rovlarni bitta jadvalga |
| Organize fields by name | nomlash, tartib, yashirish |
| Add field from calculation | formula (binary, reduce) |
| Reduce | series -> bitta qiymat (last, max) |
| Group by | SQL'dagi GROUP BY |
| Filter data by values | qiymat bo'yicha filtrlash |
| Labels to fields | label'larni ustunlarga |
| Partition by values | bitta natijani bir nechta frame'ga |

PromQL tomonda: jadval uchun so'rovni `Format: Table`, `Type: Instant` qiling.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Brauzerda bajariladi — 100k qatorli natija dashboard'ni muzlatadi; og'ir ishni backend'da qiling.
- Alerting transformation'larni ko'rmaydi (alert'lar server tomonda ishlaydi) — alert mantiqi so'rov/expression'da bo'lsin.
- Zanjir tartibi — rename'dan keyin eski nom bilan join ishlamaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Transformation — ko'rinish qatlami. Mantiq ko'paygan sari uni recording rule, SQL view yoki Grafana server-side expressions'ga ko'chiring — test qilinadigan va alert'da qayta ishlatiladigan bo'ladi.

41830.a:
**Qisqa javob:** 9094 — Alertmanager'ning default **klaster** porti (`--cluster.listen-address=0.0.0.0:9094`): HA replica'lar memberlist gossip orqali silence va notification log'larni almashadi. **TCP va UDP** ikkalasi ham ochiq bo'lishi kerak. 9093 esa HTTP API/UI porti.

```
AM-0 :9093 (API) :9094 (gossip TCP+UDP) <---> AM-1 :9094 <---> AM-2 :9094
Prometheus --> har birining :9093 ga
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
alertmanager \
  --web.listen-address=:9093 \
  --cluster.listen-address=0.0.0.0:9094 \
  --cluster.advertise-address=$(POD_IP):9094 \
  --cluster.peer=alertmanager-0.alertmanager-operated:9094 \
  --cluster.peer=alertmanager-1.alertmanager-operated:9094
```
Kubernetes (Prometheus Operator buni avtomatik qiladi): headless service `alertmanager-operated` 9094 TCP va UDP port'lari bilan.
Tekshirish:
```bash
curl -s http://am-0:9093/api/v2/status | jq '.cluster'   # peers ro'yxati, status "ready"
```
```promql
alertmanager_cluster_members
alertmanager_cluster_failed_peers
```
Bitta instance uchun klasterni o'chirish: `--cluster.listen-address=""`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat TCP ochilgan (NetworkPolicy, security group) — gossip ishonchsiz, `cluster_health_score` yomonlashadi, dublikat xabarlar.
- `advertise-address` noto'g'ri (pod ichki/NAT IP) — peer'lar bir-birini topolmaydi.
- Gossip shifrlanmagan — tarmoqni ishonchli deb hisoblamang; `--cluster.tls-config` mavjud.

**Senior nuqta:** Klaster sog'lig'ini meta-monitoring qiling: `alertmanager_cluster_members` kutilgan replica sonidan kam bo'lsa — alert. Split-brain'da Alertmanager dublikat yuboradi (yo'qotmaydi) — bu dizayn qarori.

41831.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `health_check` extension — OTel Collector'da HTTP health endpoint (default `0.0.0.0:13133`, yo'l `/`) ochadi. Kubernetes liveness va readiness probe'lari shu endpoint'ni tekshiradi: collector ishga tushib pipeline'lar tayyor bo'lsa 200, aks holda 503.

```
kubelet --GET :13133/--> collector health_check
   200 {"status":"Server available"} -> Ready
   503                               -> NotReady (trafik yo'naltirilmaydi) / restart
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:13133
service:
  extensions: [health_check]
```
```yaml
# Deployment
livenessProbe:
  httpGet: {path: /, port: 13133}
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
readinessProbe:
  httpGet: {path: /, port: 13133}
```
Collector'ning o'z metrikalari (`:8888/metrics`) va `zpages` (`:55679/debug/pipelinez`) bilan chuqurroq diagnostika. Yangi `healthcheckv2` extension komponent darajasidagi holatni (masalan exporter xatolari) ham ko'rsatadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Extension `service.extensions` ro'yxatiga qo'shilmagan — endpoint ochilmaydi, probe'lar yiqiladi, pod crashloop.
- Eski `check_collector_pipeline` sozlamasi deprecated/ishonchsiz — exporter xatolari uchun health'ga tayanmang, metrikalarni kuzating.
- Liveness probe exporter muammosiga bog'langan bo'lsa — backend yiqilganda collector'lar ham restart bo'lib bufer yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Liveness = "process tirikmi", readiness = "qabul qila oladimi". Backend muammosi liveness'ni yiqitmasligi kerak — aks holda restart bo'roni ma'lumot yo'qotishni oshiradi. Haqiqiy pipeline sog'lig'i uchun `otelcol_exporter_send_failed_*` va queue metrikalariga alert.

41832.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `deriv(v[range])` — **gauge**ning soniyadagi o'zgarish tezligini oyna ichidagi sample'larga **oddiy chiziqli regressiya** (least squares) orqali hisoblaydi. Counter uchun `rate()` ishlatiladi; `deriv()` counter reset'larni hisobga olmaydi.

```
disk_free (GB): 100, 98, 97, 94, 92 (har 1m)
deriv(...[5m]) ~ -0.033 GB/s  (to'g'ri chiziqning qiyaligi)
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Disk qanchalik tez to'lyapti (bayt/soniya)
deriv(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"}[1h])

# Navbat uzunligi o'syaptimi (backlog)
deriv(kafka_consumergroup_lag[10m]) > 0

# Kelajakni bashorat qilish: 4 soatdan keyin disk tugaydimi
predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"}[6h], 4 * 3600) < 0
```
`predict_linear()` — xuddi shu regressiya, lekin qiymatni kelajakka ekstrapolyatsiya qiladi.

**`deriv` vs `rate` vs `delta`:**
| Funksiya | Metrika | Usul |
|---|---|---|
| `rate` | counter | reset tuzatish, per-second |
| `deriv` | gauge | regressiya (shovqinga chidamli) |
| `delta` | gauge | oxirgi - birinchi (ekstrapolyatsiya bilan) |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Counter'ga `deriv` — restart'da katta manfiy qiyalik.
- Qisqa oyna — shovqin; uzun oyna — sekin reaksiya.
- Chiziqli bo'lmagan o'sish (log rotation, kunlik pattern) — prognoz noto'g'ri.

**Senior nuqta:** `predict_linear` asosidagi "disk N soatda to'ladi" alert'i statik "90% dan oshdi" dan yaxshiroq: katta diskda 90% hali bir hafta, kichik diskda 10 daqiqa bo'lishi mumkin. Ikkala oynani (qisqa va uzun) birlashtirib shovqinni kamaytiring.

41833.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Annotation — Grafana grafiklari ustida vaqt nuqtasi yoki oralig'ini belgilovchi **vertikal belgi** (matn va tag'lar bilan): deploy, incident boshlanishi, config o'zgarishi, chaos eksperimenti. Grafik va hodisani bir ko'rinishda korrelyatsiya qilish uchun.

**Nega kerak:** "latency 14:32 da oshdi" — shu vaqtda nima bo'ldi? Annotation "14:31 order-api v2.4 deploy" ni darhol ko'rsatadi. Incident'larning katta qismi o'zgarishlardan kelib chiqadi.

```
latency ---------/^^^^^^^^\-----
                 |        |
           deploy v2.4   rollback
         (annotation)   (annotation)
```

**Amalda:**
CI/CD'dan API orqali:
```bash
curl -X POST https://grafana/api/annotations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAFANA_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"time\": $(date +%s000), \"tags\": [\"deploy\", \"order-api\", \"prod\"],
       \"text\": \"order-api ${VERSION} deployed by ${GITHUB_ACTOR}\"}"
```
Dashboard'da: Settings -> Annotations -> query "Grafana" (tags: `deploy`, `$service`) yoki Prometheus so'rovi asosida:
```promql
changes(kube_deployment_status_observed_generation{deployment="order-api"}[1m]) > 0
```
Loki'dan ham: `{app="argocd"} |= "sync succeeded"`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tag'lar standart emas — dashboard filtri ishlamaydi; `deploy`, `<service>`, `<env>` kelishuvi.
- Juda ko'p annotation (har pod restart) — grafik o'qib bo'lmaydi.
- Manual annotation'lar — unutiladi; CI/CD va ArgoCD notification'laridan avtomatik.

**Senior nuqta:** Deploy annotation'lari + DORA metrikalari: har o'zgarish belgilangan bo'lsa, "change failure rate" va MTTR'ni ham shu ma'lumotdan hisoblash mumkin. Feature flag o'zgarishlarini ham annotation qiling — ular deploy'siz o'zgarishlar.

41834.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Silence matcher'lari ham route'lardagi kabi: **aniq** (`=`, `!=`) yoki **regex** (`=~`, `!~`). Aniq matcher faqat aynan qiymatni, regex esa naqshga mos keluvchi barcha qiymatlarni jim qiladi. Regex kuchli, lekin keragidan ko'p narsani yashirish xavfi bor.

```
Aniq:  instance="db-1:9100"           -> faqat db-1
Regex: instance=~"db-.*"              -> db-1, db-2, db-backup, db-prod-critical ...
Xavfli: alertname=~".*"               -> hammasi jim!
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Avval: qaysi alert'lar mos keladi?
amtool alert query 'alertname=~"Disk.*"' 'instance=~"db-[12]:9100"' --alertmanager.url=http://am:9093

# Keyin silence
amtool silence add 'alertname=~"Disk.*"' 'instance=~"db-[12]:9100"' \
  --duration=2h --comment="CHG-1234 disk almashtirish" --author="ali"

# Mavjud silence'larni ko'rish
amtool silence query -o extended
```
UI'da silence yaratishda "Affected alerts" bo'limi mos alert'larni ko'rsatadi — doim tekshiring.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Regex to'liq moslanadi: `instance=~"db-1"` `db-1:9100` ga mos kelmaydi.
- Juda keng regex + uzoq muddat — haqiqiy incident yashirinadi.
- Silence faqat `alertname` bilan (instance'siz) — butun flot uchun jim.
- `!=` matcher label yo'q alert'larga ham mos keladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Silence'larni iloji boricha tor qiling (alertname + instance/cluster), muddatni qisqa, comment'ga ticket. Ba'zi tashkilotlar regex silence'larni review talab qiladigan jarayonga qo'yadi — chunki bitta noto'g'ri silence = ko'r monitoring.

41835.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Resource detector — OTel SDK yoki Collector (`resourcedetection` processor) komponenti: ishga tushganda muhitni aniqlab **resource atributlarini** avtomatik to'ldiradi: `cloud.provider`, `cloud.region`, `host.id`, `host.name`, `container.id`, `k8s.*`, `service.instance.id`, OS ma'lumoti va h.k.

**Nega kerak:** har ilovaga qo'lda "men eu-west-1 dagi i-0abc instance'man" deb yozish imkonsiz. Detector cloud metadata API (EC2 IMDS, GCP metadata, Azure IMDS) va muhit o'zgaruvchilaridan oladi.

```
collector start -> detectors: [env, system, ec2, eks]
   env: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
   system: host.name, os.type
   ec2: cloud.provider=aws, cloud.region, host.id=i-0abc, cloud.availability_zone
   -> barcha telemetriyaga qo'shiladi
```

**Amalda (Collector):**
```yaml
processors:
  resourcedetection:
    detectors: [env, system, gcp, ec2, azure, eks]
    timeout: 2s
    override: false        # mavjud atributlarni ustidan yozmaslik
    system:
      hostname_sources: [os]
service:
  pipelines:
    traces: {processors: [memory_limiter, resourcedetection, k8sattributes, batch]}
```
SDK (Go):
```go
res, _ := resource.New(ctx,
    resource.WithFromEnv(), resource.WithHost(), resource.WithContainer(),
    resource.WithDetectors(ec2.NewResourceDetector()))
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Noto'g'ri cloud detector'lar ro'yxatda — har biri metadata API'ni kutib start sekinlashadi (timeout).
- EC2'da IMDSv2 hop limit=1 — container ichidan metadata'ga yetib bo'lmaydi.
- Gateway collector'da detector — gateway host'ining ma'lumotini qo'shadi, ilovaniki emas; agent darajasida ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Resource atributlari — telemetriya korrelyatsiyasining "primary key"i (service.name + instance + k8s/cloud). Ularni agent'da bir marta to'g'ri to'ldiring; har ilova o'zicha qilsa nomlar farqlanadi va join'lar buziladi.

41836.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `holt_winters(v[range], sf, tf)` — gauge qiymatlarini **double exponential smoothing** (daraja + trend) bilan silliqlaydi; `sf` (smoothing factor) va `tf` (trend factor) 0-1 orasida. Prometheus 3.0 da u **`double_exponential_smoothing`** deb qayta nomlandi va eksperimental funksiya bo'ldi (`--enable-feature=promql-experimental-functions`).

**Nega:** nom chalg'ituvchi edi — haqiqiy Holt-Winters mavsumiylikni (seasonality) ham hisobga oladi, Prometheus'niki esa yo'q.

```
xom:      10 30 12 28 11 31  (shovqinli)
smoothed: 10 16 15 19 17 21  (sf kichik -> silliqroq, sekin reaksiya)
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
# Prometheus 2.x
holt_winters(node_load1[30m], 0.3, 0.1)

# Prometheus 3.x (feature flag bilan)
double_exponential_smoothing(node_load1[30m], 0.3, 0.1)
```
Ko'proq ishlatiladigan muqobillar:
```promql
avg_over_time(node_load1[10m])                       # oddiy silliqlash
quantile_over_time(0.9, node_load1[10m])
predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes[6h], 3600) # trend prognozi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Prometheus 3 ga yangilanganda eski `holt_winters` so'rovlari xato beradi — dashboard'larni yangilang.
- Faqat gauge uchun; counter'ga avval `rate`.
- Parametrlarni tanlash empirik — noto'g'ri `sf` signalni kechiktiradi yoki shovqinni qoldiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Anomaliya aniqlash uchun mavsumiylikni hisobga oluvchi yondashuv kerak (masalan, o'tgan haftalar bilan `offset` taqqoslash yoki z-score recording rule'lari). Eksperimental funksiyalarga alert qurmang — API o'zgarishi mumkin.

41837.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Playlist — Grafana'da dashboard'lar ro'yxatini belgilangan interval bilan (masalan har 30s) **avtomatik aylantirib** ko'rsatish. NOC/ofisdagi TV ekranlar uchun; kiosk rejimi bilan menyusiz to'liq ekran.

```
Playlist "NOC main" (interval 1m)
  -> Overview -> Payments SLO -> Kafka lag -> K8s cluster -> (qaytadan)
Dashboard'lar UID bo'yicha yoki tag bo'yicha (tag=noc -> hammasi)
```

**Amalda:**
1. Dashboards -> Playlists -> New playlist -> nom, interval, dashboard'lar yoki tag qo'shish.
2. Start -> rejim: Normal / TV / Kiosk.
3. URL'ni TV brauzerida ochish:
```
https://grafana.example.com/playlists/play/<uid>?kiosk
```
4. TV uchun alohida service account yoki Viewer foydalanuvchi; yoki anonymous auth faqat ichki tarmoqda:
```ini
[auth.anonymous]
enabled = true
org_role = Viewer
```
API: `POST /api/playlists` — Terraform (`grafana_playlist`) bilan ham.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tag bo'yicha playlist — kimdir dashboard'ga `noc` tag qo'ysa u TV'ga chiqadi.
- Og'ir dashboard'lar har aylanishda qayta yuklanadi — data source yuki; refresh'ni oqilona qiling.
- Session muddati tugashi — TV'da login sahifasi qolib ketadi; service account token yoki anonim.

**Senior nuqta:** NOC ekrani — "harakat talab qiladigan narsa bormi?" degan savolga javob berishi kerak, chiroyli grafiklarga emas. Firing alert'lar ro'yxati va SLO budjetlari panellarini birinchi qo'ying; ko'p kompaniyalarda yaxshi alerting NOC ekranini keraksiz qiladi.

41838.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Alertmanager `email_configs` xabarni Go `html/template` asosidagi **HTML** shablon bilan yuboradi. Default shablon (`email.default.html`) bor; o'zingizning `define` qilingan shabloningiz bilan alert jadvali, rangli status, runbook/dashboard/silence havolalari qo'shiladi. `text` maydoni plain-text versiya uchun. **Amalda:** ```yaml global: smtp_smarthost: smtp.example.com:587 smtp_from: alertmanager@example.com smtp_auth_username: alertmanager smtp_auth_password_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/smtp smtp_require_tls: true templates: ['/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl'] receivers: - name: email-dba email_configs: - to: dba-team@example.com send_resolved: true headers: Subject: '[{{ .Status | toUpper }}] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }} ({{ .CommonLabels.cluster }})' html: '{{ template "email.custom.html" . }}' ``` ```gotemplate {{ define "email.custom.html" }}

{{ .Status | toUpper }}: {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}

{{ range .Alerts }} {{ end }}
InstanceSummaryBoshlangan
{{ .Labels.instance }}{{ .Annotations.summary }} {{ .StartsAt.Format "2006-01-02 15:04 MST" }}

Alertmanager | Runbook

{{ end }} ``` **Tuzoqlar:** - Email client'lar CSS'ni cheklaydi (`

41839.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Cumulative** temporality — har eksportda counter boshlanishdan (start time) beri **umumiy** qiymat (Prometheus modeli: 100, 150, 210). **Delta** — oxirgi eksportdan beri **o'sish** (100, 50, 60). Backend kutganidan farqli temporality grafiklarni buzadi.

```
so'rovlar:  +100     +50      +60
cumulative: 100      150      210     (start_time doimiy)
delta:      100      50       60      (har nuqta o'z oralig'i)
```

**Qaysi backend nima kutadi:**
| Backend | Temporality |
|---|---|
| Prometheus, Mimir, Thanos | cumulative |
| Datadog, Dynatrace, ba'zi SaaS | delta afzal |
| OTLP standart default (SDK) | cumulative |

**Amalda:**
```bash
# SDK'da
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE=cumulative   # yoki delta, lowmemory
```
Collector'da konvertatsiya:
```yaml
processors:
  deltatocumulative:            # delta manbalar -> Prometheus uchun
    max_stale: 5m
  cumulativetodelta: {}         # cumulative -> delta backend uchun
```

**Trade-off:**
- Cumulative: bitta nuqta yo'qolsa ham keyingi nuqta to'g'ri jami beradi (chidamli); lekin SDK har series holatini xotirada saqlaydi (cardinality xotira narxi).
